title: Nihiland
description: Have you ever felt the Nihility? A feeling that everything is meaningless and feeling down because of it... Come to Nihiland to relax and meditate and hopefully you will have all the answers.

title: Wild Harmony
description: Strategically place animals, unlock upgrades, and master the art of ecosystem management. Are you ready to shape the balance of nature? Explore Wild Harmony, a captivating idle clicker.

title: Roomballs
description: Soccer meets air hockey with an incredible twist: fast-paced, zany robots inspired by your favorite pop culture icons. This isn’t just about speed and strength; strategy, quick moves, and clever plays are the keys to victory. This game guarantees endless fun and high-octane action.

title: Koverpark Haunted Subway
description: Koverpark Haunted Subway is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of an abandoned subway station which is haunted by the spirits of passengers, rail engineers who have lost their lives due to tragic accidents.

title: Davy Jones' Deckhand
description: Unleash outrageous counter-attack chains in this swashbuckling adventure where every voyage is a brutal roguelike deckbuilder. Will you break free from Davy Jones’ Locker?

title: Galactivore
description: Galactivore is a gory retro-style action-platformer inspired by the 16-bit era and featuring an all female cast.

title: Anomaly Hunter: Observation Duty
description: In Anomaly Hunter - Observation Duty, you're not just a security guard; you're the last line of defense against the unexplained. With only security cameras as your eyes, witness eerie movements and unsettling whispers echoing in the shadows.

title: Fisher's Idle
description: Welcome to Fisher's Idle! Immerse yourself in the relaxing world of fishing, where you can buy and manage fishing boats to build a thriving fishing empire.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Colosseum
description: Try to escape unharmed from deadly blows from powerful gladiators while riding through the most famous arena of antiquity. This DLC includes: - Roller coaster map: Colosseum - One roller coaster cart

title: Three Wishes
description: Have you ever wondered what the three little sisters of the famous Lilypads get up to in their free time? Find out in this Lilypad Lily spinoff adventure full of headpats, plot twists, and silly hijinks!

title: Pixel Fixel: Remixel Edition
description: Support Pixel Fixel and its developer by purchasing this DLC! Unlock 40 new levels with unique shapes, a colorway creation tool, decorative flair for your multiplayer username, new soundscapes, new themes, and new cheat codes. Thank you for your support!

title: eXoSpace Combat Engineer
description: Design your ship, choose your target, and embark on a hunt through a randomly generated universe. Each hyperjump leads to a new and unexpected encounter, forcing you to make tough choices. What kind of bounty hunter will you become?

title: Thoko
description: Thoko is a thrilling single-player first-person shooter platformer that combines fast-paced action with innovative movement mechanics. Dive into a world where precision, speed, and agility are your greatest allies. Master advanced techniques such as strafing, BHOP (bunny hopping), and surfing.

title: Unhuman Nightmare
description: Unhuman Nightmare is a 4 player online co-op game where a team of thieves want to steal items from haunted places. What they don't know is that the places are full of traps set by ghosts. Chances are, they'll not escape alive...

title: Let me Paddle : Difficult Boat Paddling Game
description: Can you paddle that boat to the finish line?

title: The Adventure of Pixi: The 3 Stones
description: A humorous adventure of epic proportions, spanning 1 fully open map, 2 worlds, and (more than) 3 colors! The Old Man gives Pixi a quest: find the 3 stones and use them to restore the colors! During her adventure, she will have to cross dungeons, another world, and maybe even face... herself.

title: Teatime Samurai
description: Up to four player retro arcade style twin-stick shooter featuring a colorful cast of monsters inspired by Japanese folklore.

title: New Warfare
description: New Warfare is a modern/sci-fi competitive stylised multiplayer first person shooter with multiple game modes. Use extremely fast arcade movements to annihilate your enemies !

title: Amelie Falls Over and Over Again
description: Masamune and Amelie are tasked with infiltrating the Caledonia Magic University. However, various schemes are swirling around the University. Unexpected struggles, a week looping through magic. Where will the story lead...

title: Woohoo!: Game - Fourteens
description: Fourteens is a game where you select pairs of cards that equal 14. The two cards in a pair must be in the same row or column. When you select a pair, the two cards of the selected pair will be removed.

title: Enzio-Ware
description: Play through 40+ Microgames in Enzio-Ware!In this colorful spin-off of 【Onwards! To the Furthest End!! Go Forth Supreme PLC!!!!】 you will play through the episodes of 8 fascinating characters, both new and returning, and complete microgames to help them out in their daily ongoings.

title: Defender's Squad: The Last Ride
description: Defender's Squad is a sci-fi vertical scrolling shooter 2D that combines 7 different levels. Play Solo and pick one of the 3 ships to kill enemies and save the earth from aliens.

title: Conquest Reforged
description: A Casual Board-style Strategy game with a colorful pixel art Fantasy theme! Deploy units using your available energy, march them across the board and attempt to deal enough damage to your opponent's base to win!

title: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic - Biomes
description: From the sweltering deserts of Arabia to the unforgiving tundras of Siberia and the tropical jungles of Southeast Asia, build your glorious Soviet Republic in new and diverse biomes!

title: Playground Mayhem
description: Defend your base solo or with friends against endless waves of foes using your weapons and turrets. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Chaos Moon
description: A classic style SHMUP in the tradition of 80's and 90's vertical scrolling shooters. Maximize your run and get to the top of the High-score Leaderboard. Can you achieve the rank of Fleet Admiral? It's a challenge.

title: Fatal Dopamine
description: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

title: Greybit
description: Greybit is a heart-pounding, adrenaline-fueled first-person shooter (FPS) game paying homage to the iconic 1993 "Doom" while adding a fresh twist. Play as a lone warrior battling hordes of demons in a nightmarish landscape where every corner hides a new threat.

title: Metal Toy Excavator
description: A relaxing and casual decompression game. Control the naughty alloy toy excavator to smash the objects in the game. Have fun and relieve stress.

title: Sound of Slash
description: A rhythm action game in sync with the music, experiencing a variety of cool actions. A ranking system that allows users to compete globally while playing their favorite tunes. A free store system where players can share and play their own created music and notes with others.

title: Shadow Strikers: Arena of Rivals
description: After the "Tournament of Shadows," Shadowhaven faces a new challenge: the "Arena of Rivals." Champions fight for power, honor, and survival. New fighters and unexpected alliances emerge. Prepare for intense battles where each victory redefines the city's destiny!

title: Angor
description: Immersed yourself in an interactive story with multiples choices, in the style of "choose your own Adventure book" (CYOA).Will you be able to survive ?Probably not!

title: Koishiki Manual
description: Ichinose Academy is a famous private school which is the best at everything, except its students have no romantic appeal. One fine autumn morning, the principal’s daughter Himeno declared that they will have a test to determine each student’s riajuu level. For someone who has never had a girlfriend, Hiroki naturally flunked the test. He was moved, along with five others girls who failed, to a special love training class called the "love manual". Let the lessons of love begin!

title: Ama no Sora Retrospect
description:
Amanosora is a small town of around 60,000 people, formed ten years ago from the merger of the villages of Tensei and Sorami. Shikimi attends the local school with the cleaning club leader Himari and his lively kouhai Shinon. There’s a rumour at the school that the door to another world would be opened by pressing a certain sequence of buttons in the elevator at the lighthouse in the Stargazing Commemorative Hall.

One day, the school committee asked the cleaning club to tidy up the interior of the lighthouse. Together with his mysterious book-reading classmate Misumi, they solved the elevator riddle while doing the cleaning. It led to the top floor of the lighthouse, which was a huge fairytale-like library. This was the other world: Remembrance. A small girl named Amahoshi awoke from her slumber and asked for their help in gathering the town’s scattered memories.

title: Project Lazarus 2
description: Deploy, adapt, and upgrade your mech in Project Lazarus 2—the next evolution of survival and rogue-lite action! Battle relentless enemies, unlock powerful upgrades, and forge your own path. Gear up and push your limits as every run brings new strategies and intense challenges.

title: Fall Of Mankind
description: FALL OF MANKIND is a first-person action game where William, a Knight of the Sigma Council hunts the Time and Soul Orb through time and space.

title: Escape: Zombie Maze
description: Number19 is sent into a zombie-filled labyrinth through portals by Dimension Technology Lab. In this terrifying world filled with limited ammunition and mysterious enemies, it takes courage and strategy to survive and escape the labyrinth.

title: Minesweeper 99
description: An incredibly addictive spin-off of the classic Minesweeper game, with new difficulties, new modes and global leaderboards for fastest time and highest score.

title: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
description: Take control of your own airship, hire people for your crew, help them on their personal stories, follow the trail of a whimsical inventor of the colonisation era, trade, fight, discover, and try to stay afloat.

title: Dune: Imperium - Rise of Ix
description: The award-winning first expansion to Dune: Imperium keeps the spice flowing like never before!

title: Project: Icarus
description: Travel with Curias to the ancient greek future and go on a research mission about black holes. Explore the edge of space and time in this rogue-lite management game!

title: Fleshinsane
description: Fleshinsane is a biopunk slasher roguelite, where you explore an ancient spaceship but it's alive, changing and decaying! No checkpoints. Kill, die, upgrade, repeat!

title: Kizunare Fable
description: An RPG/adventure-filled fantasy game about self, friends, and family. Help Damon and his two friends Riley and Sierra to explore a world unfamiliar to them while on a quest to reunite Damon with his mother and father. What awaits the trio as they venture off into the unknown?

title: Gavis Arenarium
description: A scuffle-type action game in which the opponent is attacked and knocked down or pushed out of the game.

title: Into The Dread
description: Something is clearly wrong with this place! The decision to inspect a long-abandoned sewer turned out to be deadly. Will you be able to escape from this nightmare and kill everyone standing in your way?

title: Norse: Oath of Blood
description:
Norse is a turn-based tactics and combat game for PC and console. Set against the rich backdrop of the Viking Age, join Gunnar, a young warrior, on a relentless quest for revenge across the rugged landscapes of Norway.

Build a thriving settlement, govern your community, forge alliances, grow strong, and win the favour of the gods. For this is a time when legends are forged in the fires of conflict, and only the brave are remembered.

Written by prize-winning and Sunday Times bestselling author Giles Kristian, Norse is set in a fully realised historical world, driven by a compelling narrative and brimming with memorable characters.

title: Fruit: Chain Effect
description: "Fruit: Chain Effect" is a link-and-match game where you collect and combine fruits. Obtain fruit items by completing levels or through market drops every 2 hours. Fruits come in Legendary, Rare, High, and Common rarities, with limited drops to maintain balance.

title: ZetaZania Part 1: Vampire Pirates from Uranus
description: Blast off to ZetaZania, a massive alien space station ruled by wicked Vampire Pirates. Dive into a 2D side-scrolling, action-filled quest to wipe out the horrors haunting Uranus. Packed with retro pixel art, an original electronic score, tricky puzzles, and a dose of cheeky British humour.

title: No Man's Sky: Relics
description: Turn your hand to palaeontology in update 5.6, RELICS! Unearth hundreds of unique bones, assemble skeletons to design fossil exhibits, join the community on an expedition to recreate lost creatures, battle against gargantuan stone guardians, and more!

title: Bee Flowers: Royal Garden
description: Are you ready to lead the swarm and let your mind bloom?

title: Chippy's Stash
description: Nature's Challenge Awaits You!

title: You Shouldn't Be Here
description: This short psychedelic visual novel takes place in a strange world inhabited by harrowing creatures shunned by the light. You’ll meet someone who has made this world their own, and in doing so, learn the reason why you shouldn't be there.

title: Fight Club World
description: FCW - Fight Club World - Inspired by Fight Club is an exciting and intense fighting game that puts players in the shoes of skilled combatants from all over the world. The game offers a variety of characters to choose from, each with their unique fighting style and backstory.

title: Sea of Thieves: 2025 Premium Edition
description: Dive into Sea of Thieves with this special edition, which includes all additional content from the 2025 Deluxe Edition and also adds a Premium Bundle containing the Dire Dark Warsmith Ship Collection, Costume Set and Ship's Crest, as well as 1000 Ancient Coins for use in the Pirate Emporium.

title: Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends Edition
Edens Zero Deluxe Edition
description:
● 72-Hours Early Access
Begins 72 hours in advance of release date.
● Pino's Attire "Hunter Attire"
Adds a quest offering Pino's Hunter Attire, which boosts the number of items acquirable through harvesting/mining.
● Accessory "Elsie’s Pirate Flag"
Adds a quest offering Elsie's Pirate Flag. With this back accessory, you can act like you're part of her crew!
* Adds quests offering DLC items in Exploration Mode to the Guild Quests at Shooting Starlight.

title: BeeBop II
description: French Brick breaker game by Daniel Clav

title: Galactic Vibes
description: Blast through waves of enemies, collect powerups and test your skills against challenging bosses. It is a modern take on the retro nokia game: Space Impact. With roguelite elements, changing biomes and faster pacing. Go reach the top of the global leaderboard!

title: Quite a Ride
description: Pedal through the fog, but never look back.Trapped in a constantly shifting horror, you must ride, conserve your phone's battery, and decode cryptic messages to escape. Explore, survive, uncover the truth.

title: BioSynth: Rising
description: Turn-based story-rich classical RPG set in a grim sci-fi world. Explore, collect powerful items and grow your heroes to defeat fearsome enemies, escape dangerous plots, and have an impact on the world.

title: Doodle Empires
description: Doodle Empires is an alternate history sandbox game all about drawing your own nations with your own histories and stories in a variety of maps. Watch your world take shape and evolve over time, and decide which nations will rise and which nations will fall.

title: For All the People I Love
description: Follow the expression of Prince Mont Grand's scattered feelings through different sceneries.

title: Ascent DX
description: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilization. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.

title: Your God Is False
description: A surreal adventure game with elements of puzzles about a girl with delusional ideas of messianic greatness.

title: Galactic Field
description: [ GALACTIC FIELD ] The game story takes place in the distant 24th century future interstellar era, where 3 different factions compete with each other. It supports PVE PVP EVE mode gameplay, and also provides the game's unique squadron fuse mode gameplay and gameplay detail adjustment system.

title: Ballastic
description: A game of ball-swinging, elastic-snapping chaos. Swing the increasingly heavy ball(s) round 'n' round, demolishing the destructibles while grabbing power-ups and avoiding hazards. But be careful, as the elastic is destined to SNAP! Be quick to rack up amazing combos and go for the high score!

title: Oblitus Mortis
description: Metroidvania, Pixel art set in a world full of legends and myths of Venezuela. Explore various settings, face mythical creatures and discover ancient secrets in this incredible odyssey.

title: Midio!
description: MiDiO! is a cozy decoration game, creature collector and platformer! Build and share your own DIO room or view and explore others! Connect with Twitch and let your audience collect cute little critters you can interact with!

title: PyNori
description:
A demake of an RPG game concept by Shirley-XML, written in Python. Not to be confused with Pinori. This is NOT the same thing.

Who needs graphics when you can just describe everything with text? In this game, you "walk" through various areas (using only text to make your way around) in search of "Tones". They are magical crystals that are very valuable and fragile, so they must not be put in the wrong hands. The problem is, they already have; as a result, they were scattered across dimensions. So, what will you do? Will you get the Tones back, or go down a different path?

title: God is Watching
description: "I'm not usually very close to my sister, but since we're coming back from visiting a relative, it's the perfect moment to rebuild trust with her. The journey is long, and it'll be nice to reminisce about old childhood stories."

title: Marshmallow Marvin: Templestone
description: In Marshmallow Marvin: Templestone, players guide a living marshmallow through a trap-filled temple, solving puzzles and avoiding dangers in a thrilling platforming adventure.

title: SnowRunner: Season 14 - Reap and Sow
description:
Season 14: Reap & Sow is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

Austrian officials need you to renovate their region's Renaissance castle and kickstart a new season of farming with 4 vehicles across two new 4km² maps.

title: World of Tanks: Modern Armor - Metal Dragon
description:
Release the fury! Use the Type 59D's punchy gun, ERA armor, and good mobility to become the dragon of the Cold War battlefields.

You will also receive days of Premium Account to boost your earnings and the Zhu Teng Long Commander, a dedicated warrior ready to be trained in Skills that will elevate your tank's potential.

title: Train Sim World 5: Dutch Regional Edition
description: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Embark on an all-new journey in our first route through the Netherlands with the Dutch Regional Edition! Run express Nederlandse Spoorwegen services with the iconic ICMm “Koploper” and dash between commuter towns with the modern SNG Sprinter.

title: Majyo no Nebaneba Note
description: This is a roguelike game that combines cards and dice, where players build card decks and compete for dice points during combat to defeat their enemies.

title: Ballmaster
description:
You take control of Ballmyr, a pure-hearted knight of Ballencia. He was sent out under the order of King Ball to do some nasty work to innocent people. As he returned, King Ball ordered his execution! Betrayed, Ballmyr had no means to run because he followed his King. Unknown in the shadows, Death Ball was watching.

It was the perfect timing for Ballmyr, because his soul was both pure and corrupt, so Death Ball gave him a challenge for his soul only known to God and Death Ball, the Challenge of Ballmaster!

title: PartyIcons
description: Party Icons is a dynamic, multi-game metaverse for mobile & PC that blends casual fun with strategic depth and real stakes. Whether you’re looting in Party Heist, evolving your Heroes, or mining for Mirble—every play is a chance to win big.

title: Godessess' Whim
description: Hentai harem visual novel, sandbox with custom animations!

title: Blobbert 64
description: A 3D platformer interpretation of Blobbert's Bouncy Breakout. Venture through different worlds and realities, encounter different foes, and play as multiple characters. Stop Araka Monoi.

title: Dredge: Blackstone Key
description:
The mysterious workshop on Blackstone Isle is locked tight. Inside are otherworldly creations, products of cruel machinations by the previous occupants. Now they lie idle and abandoned.

With this key you can put them to some use.

title: Pirates of the Asteroid Belt
description: Role-play shooter in space. Your personal space adventure.

title: World of Warships: Legends - Eastern Leaders
description: Power up your Pan-Asian fleet with a seasoned Commander! This set includes a Pan-Asian Commander crate, guaranteed to drop a Pan-Asian Commander, along with gorgeous camouflages and useful Promotion Orders.

title: World of Tanks: Modern Armor - The Roar of History
description:
Tear into the opposition! The M4A2E4 Ripper is a variant of the iconic Sherman tank with a paint job inspired by real-world military history. This collector's vehicle has a rate of fire that will shred enemy defenses.

The Roar of History also gives you valuable Boosters and days of Premium Account to increase your battle earnings.

title: The Zombie Neighborhood
description: Shoot zombies to relieve stress and go back to sleep. Nothing like a peaceful life in the countryside... Forgetting that they were once people helps ease the anxiety. It feels less guilty blowing the brains out of a "non-human".

title: F1 25
description: Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship, featuring a revamped My Team mode, the thrilling third chapter of Braking Point, and more!

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms 8 Remake: Scenario "Tiger and Wolf Unleashed"
description: A hypothetical scenario featuring alternate paths taken by Sun Jian and Lu Bu.

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms 8 Remake: Scenario "Tiger Generals of the Three Kingdoms, Locked in Battle!"
description: A scenario where Wei, Wu, & Shu are further split, returning the land to chaos.

title: Wanko Wanko Adventure
description: A resort hotel where everything has been squared away by a mysterious virus. A dog's great adventure to clear the cubes in closed rooms and search for his stray family!

title: Secret Diaries: Royal Wedding
description: Attend lavish balls and meet handsome bachelors in the new Time Management game!

title: Simple Duel
description: Simple Duel is a rock-paper-scissors style fighting game with players making moves simultaneously. Select a weapon that determines your health, energy, move set, and combo. There are three different match types to choose from next: default, rounds, or lives.

title: Endor Awakens
description: Endor Awakens: Dungeon Crawler is a thrilling evolution of Depths of Endor, where chaos reigns in the changing world after the fall of Mordoth. In this Dungeon Crawler, you'll venture through procedurally generated dungeons, encountering new challenges and treasures with every step.

title: Astro Prospector
description: Astro Prospector is an incremental bullet heaven about mining cofferoids and fighting SpaceCorp. Collect resources, upgrade your ship and become unstoppable. Return AstroCoffee to humanity!

title: Mysteries Mix 2: Whispers of Hollow Town
Roads of the Middle Ages: Collector's Edition
Eternal Odyssey
description: Eternal Odyssey it's Sunsoft’s JPN translation of GameOne’s Hong Kong-created PC RPG ''Eternal Saga''.

title: Gaslamp Cases 10: The Loch Ness Enigma
Gaslamp Cases 9: The Ghost of Automaton City
Sherman's Quest
description:
An outgoing, outdoor-loving, yellow rabbit named Sherman must leave his ill, bed-ridden wife, Alice, at home to rescue his grandchildren, Rodder and Mopsy, from the clutches of the self indulgent crow king, Velcrow. Along the way, you'll even meet up with a few friendly faces, and some challenges to test your consistency.

Traverse through 50 rooms inside Velcrow's nested tower of enemies and obstacles and take back your loved ones in this top-down, dungeon crawling, arcade-based game that takes inspiration from the SG-1000 console released in 1983.

title: Starbot 4Ever
description:
Starbot 4EVER is an action-packed platforming adventure which mixes speed, mobility and combat in a way never seen before!

This game gives you diverse areas to explore and master over time, new enemies to discover and defeat, new weapons to find and obtain and plenty of high-speed action if you know how to earn it.

title: Nature Picross
description: Nature Picross is a puzzle game where you use logic and deduction to create pictures themed around nature. Solve 100 satisfying pixel art puzzles, and continue playing with randomly generated puzzles.

title: Cats Visiting Cozy Art Studios
description: Explore cozy art studios and uncover hidden cats in this charming seek-and-find adventure. Search through beautifully illustrated creative spaces, click to collect every feline, and complete each level. Can you find them all?

title: Barbatus no Majo
description: Artec, which released the niche RPGs "Digan no Maseki" and "Dark Wraith", aimed to create an RPG that anyone could easily enjoy with "Barbatus no Majo".

title: Seaport Man
description: A short horror game where the protagonist, having escaped from a sunken ship, wanders the sea.

title: Rush Ultimate
description: Reach the flag, complete the race and DON'T TOUCH ANYTHING! 24 areas to dominate and enter your name in the global leaderboard!

title: Bad Karma
description:
You play as A1, a deceased creature that had to wake up for some reason. On their journey they meet a bunch of inhabitants of the World of Glamor and Illusion, getting to interact with them - more or less.

The afterlife consists of 7 layers, each unique by design, serving its purpose. One might be calm, other might be aggressive.

title: Rollover
description: Rollover is a brutally punishing climbing game where every roll could be your last. With unpredictable, difficult physics and a movement system designed to test your limits.

title: Unbox The Cats
description: Find and rescue adorable cats hidden among boxes. Feed them treats to add them to your collection. Discover 100 unique cats in this casual puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper.

title: Pale
description: You are sent to a snowy wasteland to investigate a mysterious signal...

title: Parasite Inside
description: In this Sci-Fi Horror game, our protagonist, Oni Lim, awakens aboard a colonization spaceship. However, as she awake from her slumber, she quickly realizes that all other crew members remain in cryogenic stasis, and critical ship systems are malfunctioning. Determined to uncover the source of the problem, Oni embarks on a perilous journey through the labyrinthine corridors of the ship. What she discovers amidst the flickering lights and ominous shadows is nothing short of shocking.

title: Who Is Ethan?
description: You wake up in an abandoned hospital, with no memory of who you are. The silence is heavy. Shadows move. Something—or someone—might be watching you. Trapped between reality and nightmare, the only way out is to piece together the truth hidden in your surroundings.

title: The Jester
description: A first-person psychological horror game with a VHS effect. Something lives in the shadows and feeds on your fear.

title: Cereal Reaper
description: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

title: Velocity High Speed
description: Velocity High Speed is a fast paced action game mixing platformer, third person shooter and racing. Inspired by Sonic, Klonoa and Trackmania, this game will make you travel accross levels at full speed and challenge you by combining your platform and shooting skills.

title: The Last Bloom
description: Margarete receives a letter from Veronika, her kind neighbor, saying she’s ill. Concerned, Margarete decides to visit, but the journey is challenging due to her blindness. Now it’s time for you, her trusty four-legged friend, to guide her and help her reach Veronika’s house.

title: Neon Ascending
description: Grid management roguelike tower defense that emphasizes mechanics and features dazzling visual effects. Don't overthink it, just stack and play! Enhancement modules boost your attributes, affix modules change the mechanics, and more... all within the grid. Time to create a new and improved build!

title: Oddroom
description: Tricked by a shady ad, a cat’s owner signs a contract! Now they must fight through a wild dream to wake up. Crazy weapons, swappable limbs, aerial combat! A roguelite shooting frenzy with spicy difficulty — this is ODDRooM!

title: No Sleep for Kaname Date: From AI - The Somnium Files
description:
Kaname Date and the AI-Ball, Aiba tackle a mysterious case and rescue Iris, an internet idol who has been forced to take part in a dangerous escape game.
Examine crime scenes and listen to testimonies in "Investigation". Enter the dream worlds of suspects and key witnesses in "Somnium". Solve puzzles to break out of locked rooms in the new "Escape" sections.
By moving between these three sections, obtain the necessary clues to solve the case.

title: Raidou Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army
description: The story of apprentice detective and Devil Summoner extraordinaire Raidou Kuzunoha XIV returns in this remastered classic! Call upon your demons to solve supernatural mysteries and dispose of enemies.

title: Patapon 1+2 Replay
description: Remastered bundle of the original critically-acclaimed Patapon and Patapon 2 which were released in 2007 and 2008.

title: Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar
description: Searching for a peaceful farm life, a fresh mountain breeze, and your own market stall? Look no further than the friendly community of Zephyr Town! Here you’ll grow crops and raise animals, get to know the locals, and sell your wares at the town's bazaar to restore it to its former glory.

title: Disney Villains Cursed Café
description: Stir up a fresh take on iconic Disney Villains in this rich visual novel.

title: Gradius Origins
description: This collection features 18 versions across all 7 arcade titles in the series, including the first-ever appearance of Gradius III AM Show Version on home consoles.

title: Salamander III
description: Salamander III is the newest addition to the Gradius series, a legendary pioneer in the side-scrolling shooter genre, and comes with the original arcade versions of the previous games.

title: Tamagotchi Plaza
description: Become a shopkeeper in Tamahiko Town. Engage with more than 100 Tamagotchi as they open, customize and grow more than a dozen different shops and improve your reputation with them in town.

title: Rhythm Heaven Groove
description: The rhythm is starting up again! Rhythm Heaven Groove comes to Nintendo Switch!

title: Strategos
description: Strategos is a real-time tactics wargame set in classical antiquity. Simulate large-scale battles with over 120 factions, and 250+ units, from the ancient world. Create custom battles, or take command of historical ones.

title: Everybody’s Golf: Hot Shots
description: Everybody’s favorite golf game series finally returns to the fairway! Hit the green with a variety of unique characters and courses in online and offline AND single and multiplayer modes!

title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion
description: Marvel Cosmic Invasion is a side-scrolling beat 'em up featuring 15 playable Marvel heroes. Designed in the style of classic 1990s arcade brawlers, the game allows players to switch between two characters mid-battle using the Cosmic Swap mechanic. Each hero brings unique abilities and team-up attacks, with additional upgrades and rewards becoming available as players progress.

title: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
description: Create Mii characters based on family and friends, someone you admire, or something completely original—there are plenty of personality traits, little quirks, and physical traits to choose from—including some face customization options you haven’t seen before! Go deep into getting every detail just right, or create Miis quickly and easily by answering some simple questions, and then help them explore their likes and dislikes, find relationships, and get up to all sorts of fun. Your Miis are bound to surprise you as they take on a life of their own!

title: Bio Goddess: Doomsday Begins
description: Bio Goddess: Doomsday Begins is a third-person shooter survival game where players assume the role of a female high school student surviving in a school struck by a biochemical crisis. They investigate the events, uncover their connection to their father, and explore their own identity.

title: Marfa
description: Marfa is a quest, where you can immerse yourself in the airy atmosphere of the summer and sunny world and help the cat Marfa fulfill the dream of her owner, an artist, to realize the plan of an ideal city.

title: Super Robot Wars Y
description: Super Robot Wars is a grid-based tactical combat RPG that brings units and pilots from a variety of anime together to battle their mutual foes. Rise, Unite, and Triumph!

title: Harmless Lies
description: A short 3D Visual Novel with an emotional and dramatic story.

title: Caribbean Legend: Vile Little God
description: The old gods demand appeasement; honor them, and you'll rival the geniuses of your era. Each sacrifice will require an enormous amount of effort, gold, or blood, but in the end, you will become the most powerful Captain of the Caribbean. Just do it quickly before the Spanish Inquisition arrives.

title: Treasure Journey
description: A charming puzzle adventure where you'll guide a pirate across uncharted islands to uncover hidden treasures!

title: Welcome to the Ungdung Cafe
description: Once a teacher, Choon-sam Choi attends a reunion at Dongil High School, where he worked as a teacher. There, he hears the news about Lee Jin-woo, a student he especially cared about, and he runs a hip cafe because he meets Jin-woo through an accidental opportunity...

title: Shahmaran
description: Kingdom's ruler falls gravely ill and for the cure the Vizier revealing his true side as the evil sorcerer conjures a spell to summon vile creatures to assail Shahmaran for obtaining her flesh. Shahmaran and her helper friend Jamsab must defeat the evil sorcerer.

title: Sliding Bears
description: Slide alone or with friends! The polar bear cubs have come out to play and they have decided to have fun on the ice with a single objective in mind: be the last one standing! Use item boxes to counter your foes' victory and be the winner!

title: The Curse of Town
description: The Curse of Town is an immersive story game in the single-player horror, puzzle and adventure genre. Solve puzzles and save the town from the curse!

title: A-Rabbit
description: This is an original Japanese style slot machine! Reels are stopped by internal flag and your operation. BONUS will be hided at first when you get it. Find out BONUS by patterns, effects and navigation with knowledge and technique, like playing a puzzle game!

title: Alcoholic Daddy
description: In this 2D arcade racing game, take on the role of a father who must complete a simple but important mission - to deliver his beloved dog to his daughter. However, the task is complicated by the fact that the father has had a bit too much to drink.

title: Heart Of The Abyss
description: In Heart of the Abyss, you play as the Sea watcher, who has been awakened following the emergence of a mysterious and dangerous force that corrupts the depths. Your role will be to find a way to halt its progression as it possesses creatures and turns them into monstrous beings.

title: Cursed Cove
description:
Cursed Cove is an exciting 3D strategic game where players immerse themselves in a dark world of pirates and necromancy.
Your task is to capture the enemy tower using an army of skeletons that you can summon.
Strategically position your skeletons to attack the tower's cannons and archers, breaking through defensive lines and moving closer to victory.

title: Fastest Cashier
description: "Fastest Cashier" is an exciting casual simulator game where you become a cashier in a bustling supermarket and must serve all customers within a limited time. You will skillfully scan items, accept payments, pack purchases, and pour yourself a cup of coffee to achieve high scores.

title: Cosmo Magnat
description: Enter the world of Cosmic Megapolis, an exciting 3D construction genre game where you will become the architect of your own city in space! Your task is to create a thriving city on an uncharted planet using advanced technologies and innovative building materials.

title: Survivalo
description: An exciting 3D game in which you, as an adventurer, explore mysterious mazes. Your task is to collect coins while avoiding dangerous monsters. But be careful!

title: Dude Fighter
description: "Dude Fighter" is an exciting side-scrolling 2D arcade game where you play as a boy who finds himself in a world populated by terrifying flying monsters. Your task is to survive and emerge victorious!

title: Goldy Pig Adventure
description: In this exciting arcade 3D platformer game, YOU will take on the role of a brave pig trying to escape from villains. Your task is to run through endless levels full of dangers and obstacles.

title: Tapes of Fear: Smile
description: Tapes of Fear is a psychological horror game where you investigate an isolated mansion while something sinister stalks your every step, testing your will to survive. The Infinity Fear System analyzes your behavior and fears, adapting events to create a deeply personal horror experience.

title: Board Game Society
description: Take on an ever-changing tile-based board with up to 6 players, and see just how much treasure you can scavenge before the big bad boss is defeated! Beware though, your friends might want some of that treasure for themselves.

title: Super Technos World: River City & Arcade Classics
description: This exciting collection brings you 12 games in one, from developer Technos Japan known for creating the legendary River City and Double Dragon series. From arcade classics to region-exclusive titles, you’ll have plenty to explore in this collection! Get your hands on these rare games of legend!

title: Xenobreakers: Classic Tower Defense
description:
A classic 3D tower defense game with a hand-drawn aesthetic. An old-school concept with a fresh new look, set in a unique sci-fi world. Place defense towers to fend off giant bugs, rogue droids, corporate enemies, and more.

The game features 16 levels across 4 distinct biomes, over 30 different enemies, 3 boss fights, 48 skills, 4 active abilities, 5 base towers, and 10 specializations. The story is visually told through a hand-drawn, 12-page comic. You can choose from 3 base difficulty levels.

And if the standard difficulty is too easy, there's a hardcore mode for those seeking a real challenge.

title: Project:; Cold Case.Mirage
description: A mystery adventure that immerses you into solving a case right from your PC. Five girls died in the Mirage Forest Fire. Having lost your memories, you begin investigating the fire to recover them. What is the truth behind the fire? How is it linked to your memories? Will you be able to change fate?

title: Coin Smith
description: Welcome to Coin Smith, an addictive idle clicker game where your journey to unimaginable riches starts with a single tap. Set in a world inspired by the ancient Lydian Empire, the birthplace of coins, you'll build, upgrade, and strategize your way to wealth and glory.

title: Shake the Baby!
description: Shake the Baby! is a fast-paced satirical boomer shooter with a very peculiar weapon system. Pick up a wide variety of babies and merge them into an even more powerful baby. Rip apart your foes in arena combat or traverse carefully made tactical levels. Just remember: SHAKE. THE. BABY!

title: A Very Simple Puzzle...
description: Discover a simple and relaxing solitaire with A Very Simple Puzzle. Match three cubes of the same color to unlock the next one. Can you reach the final cube? With its minimalist aesthetic and laid-back gameplay, this game is perfect for a short, zen break, and can be completed in around two hours.

title: Silent Anomalies
description: Silent Anomalies is an intense surveillance simulator. You are a monitoring operator whose job is to find anomalies. Switch cameras, analyze changes, and detect things that look strange or out of place.

title: Joyquarium
description: Farm fish in idle mode, plant aquatic plants, and build a unique exclusive landscape!

title: Content Warning: Scary Filming
description: Film the fright, survive the night!

title: Mr. Shorty
description: A retro top-down RPG shooter indie game where you play as Mr. Shorty: the heroic ranger in the wild west. Unlock weapons, take on bounties and discover the dormant evil behind the recent onslaught of bandit attacks.

title: Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors
description: Fire up the forge and craft your finest weapons in Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors, a reforged adventure! Equip the local warriors with custom swords, bows, shields and more in your hands-on blacksmith shop. Follow the soldiers into battle as you push onward toward the evil wizard Dudley!

title: Mosaic of the Pharaohs
description: A logic puzzle game featuring a single enormous puzzle inspired by Egyptology.

title: Pillar of Gods
description: A real-time strategy simulation set in a medieval fantasy world where you can summon warriors and heroes to fight. 2D side-scrolling pixel game

title: Glowkeeper
description: A luminescent puzzle game about manipulating elements. By the light of fireflies, link and dissolve elemental forces to construct bridges, break through obstacles, and traverse a glowing, interconnected world.

title: Isles Above
description: Take control of Ribbit, the brave astronaut frog, and explore a charming floating island world. Collect coins and energy crystals, pilot your spaceship, and enjoy a cozy, stress-free platformer adventure.

title: I Commissioned Some Snails 2
description: I paid artists to hide snails and lettuce in 15 more artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Sin Cards: Welcome to the Netherworld
description: SIN CARDS is a horror deckbuilder where every card brings you closer to salvation or damnation. Face terrifying demons, uncover dark lore, and survive a world of permadeath where every choice could be your last.

title: Lewis Quest
description: Reclaim the Lewis family heirloom, in this short 2-D Collectathon Platformer. Navigate treacherous lands and infiltrate Calculus Castle, finding various secrets along the way.

title: Limb: Origins
description: LIMB: Origins is a dark sci-fi horror game where you must survive in a mysterious parallel world following the disappearance of a research team. Unravel the mysteries of your missing colleagues, explore the world, repair the teleporter, and find your way home.

title: Welcome to the Chop House
description: Sneak, create distractions, use parkour and solve puzzles to escape this First-Person survival horror slaughterhouse. Trapped in a factory farm for humans you must survive being hunted by your captors.

title: Mr. Elevator
description: We are developing a puzzle solving game with an elevator motif. This game is currently in the early stages of development, but we plan to upload images and demos of the work in progress. Please follow us and add us to your wishlist!

title: Hajimeru Sekai no Risouron: Goodbye World Index
description:
That's not where you live.

The protagonist, a young boy named Shin Onomiya, is one of the "reincarnations" who answered the call of the god who rules the world.

I want you to save this world towards the right future.

What God has entrusted to him is the future of this twisted world itself. He is surrounded by friends who, like him, have been invited from different worlds. While fighting against a shadowy monster called "enemy of the world" and his quiet and lively daily life is going on.

His heart began to scar. The world he had lived in before was a lie, and the lie was killing him.

When he was reborn in another world, he asked God to give him abilities. It Is the power to see through the lies of others. He hoped that the lies of his past world would not hurt him again.

But at the same time, this power also reveals the hearts of his friends. What they hide in their hearts and what they want to stay away from. By touching the wounds of these girls, awkwardly, little by little, the distance between them grew closer.

Every day, the countdown to the end of the world ticks down in the "Doomsday Index".

Having lost their own place in the past, they hide the ideal of "this is how it should be" in their hearts, the World changes its shape according to the thoughts of men and women who have been invited. Behind the apocalypse.

Towards an ideal world held by others.

title: Infernum Bound
description: Saph and Venus are separated and must pass a trial to be together again.

title: Carrot Overload
description:
Carrot overload is a turn based- simplified rpg and the player control a rabbit
this game is playable with a controler and contain a lot of colorful dungeon.
it is a cute game where player collect carrots to progress in the dungeon,
but many enemies await this adorable rabbit.

title: Transparent Black: Wish
description: This DLC grants you an about one hour long game experience on how the story in the game Transparent Black started. By accidentally touching the mirror in aisle, the heroine saw something that was not supposed to be seen.

title: Taiko on the Web
description: A rhythm game based of the Japanese percussion instrument "Taiko"

title: Saihate Station: Twilight Railway
description:
Two people vowed to escape from everything and spend eternity in paradise.

Many long years later, the train suddenly starts moving.....

title: Marble Mash
description:
Marble Mash is a fast-paced arcade style clicker game where you try to rack up as many points as you can in a round.

Each round you are faced with the challenge of trying to click the blue marbles and avoiding the red ones. The pressure builds as gold marbles get thrown into the mix which earn you extra points.

This game also features a leader board so you can compete to rise to the top!

Do you have what it takes to be the Marble Mash champion?

title: Tamiigi and the War O' Bunnies
Xander: 7-Shot
description: Follow Xander, the self-proclaimed Warping Hero as he needs to stop the Fallen Hero's forces and save the universe from collapsing. Throughout his journey he'll come across various people that stand in his way, shoot your way through and stop the Fallen Hero!

title: Valerie
description: Follow Valerie on a charming 2D adventure where you'll jump, slide, bounce and boost your way through dense forests and dreamscapes using her bubble powers.

title: Please Stop Crying: Terrible Twos
description: PLEASE STOP CRYING: Terrible Twos is a lighthearted horror game about a father yet again struggling to keep up with his baby at a restaurant.

title: Hitokata
description:
A visual novel developed by Oryu & Yuzuha Tomo. There is Hitokata Classic & Hitokata Enhanced.

Hitokata Classic is a kinetic VN. It includes a MIDI version and a MP3 version. The difference being that the MIDI version plays royalty-free music in midi format, while the MP3 version includes an original soundtrack in MP3 format and images that don't originate from the public domain.

Hitokata Enhanced was released on mobile phones, and includes choices and different endings.

title: Iris Dissolution
description: Iris Dissolution is a classic survival horror game where you explore increasingly surreal places, manage scarce resources, and fight for your life against horrid creatures as you struggle to come to terms with loss.

title: Scary Tales: Horror School
description: Scary Tales: Horror School is a first-person survival horror game where you must solve puzzles, evade terrifying entities, and escape a haunted school. With three unique escape routes, each offering different challenges, can you survive the nightmare or become another lost soul?

title: The Void Corridors
description: The Void Corridors is a first-person puzzle horror game where you navigate a maze-like environment, solve intricate puzzles, and manage limited resources to survive.

title: File 47
description: A forgotten file. An echo that repeats. Memories that aren't yours. The past always finds a way back. Are you ready to remember?

title: Silent Whisper
description: Silent Whisper is a single-player horror game that takes you into an abandoned school with a haunting past. What begins as simple exploration turns into a nightmare. Navigate its decaying halls, uncover dark secrets, and do whatever it takes to escape—or risk becoming another victim.

title: Beachside Bloodbath
description: You arrive at a quaint beach house in a small New Jersey town for an idyllic weekend getaway with friends, but little do you know what horrors await... First person survival horror experience in a stylized PS1 / VHS-era aesthetic.

title: Platform5 Dungeons
description: Escape a mysterious station and save the stranded uncle! Experience the first story-driven horror adventure in the popular ‘Platform’ series!

title: Rolling Toss
description: It's a run puzzle game where you have to make the blocks roll and reach the goal. Various gimmicks will appear on each stage! Not only aim for the goal by using the jump when the blocks split, but also aim to clear the stage by making full use of the various gimmicks that appear on the stage!

title: Electrobillion
description: Shape the future of energy in electrobillion! Explore the complex systems underlying modern power infrastructure. Manage electricity production, distribution, and consumption while balancing industrial growth, environmental impact, and market forces.

title: O2Jam Remix
description: Valofe's second game in the series after the overwhelmingly negative reviews of O2Jam Online. This is the first game that has the features of the original O2Jam PC game.

title: F*ck the HELL out
description: Fuck the Hell Out is a top-down action shooter where you purge the vast cosmos of hellish pests. Crush their skulls, shatter their spirits, and dominate with your arsenal in endless space battles.

title: The Seventh Floor
description: An atmospheric horror sandbox, will you be able to free yourself from The Seventh Floor?

title: Hello, your order...
description: Hello, Your Order is a story-driven adventure game about a food deliveryman in a small town. You will have to live a week in his skin, collect orders, drive old buses, take atmospheric photos and soak up the melancholic atmosphere of your town and get to know its inhabitants.

title: Shadey's Quest
description: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through a rich fantasy world, feed and equip him, and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!

title: Opscam
description: OpsCam is a multiplayer team game. Players engage in fast-paced combat in close-quarters environments. Join other players in thrilling PvP battles.

title: Beachgirl Dreams
description: In this game, it's a 3D arcade-style game and flight simulator. Players bring to life the dream of flight by controlling a girl on a jetpack. The goal of the game is to collect as many coins as possible, avoiding falls, and using them to unlock upgrades.

title: Distant Realm
description: Distant Realm is originally an adventure game from 2006, combined with role-playing elements. Now the experience is masterfully redefined.

title: Sintropia
description: Syntropia is a Tower Defense game where you use fruits with different skills to gather resources during the day, but be careful! You have limited time, because at night, creatures will appear to destroy your tower! Use scrap to build turrets to defend your precious home!

title: NecroNegate
description: A mysterious mansion where he arrives in pursuit of his missing lover In order to fight against the threats that are coming your way, you must collect the necessary items and and solve various tricks to open the closed door. What is the shocking truth that awaits you after overcoming various fears

title: Extinction 1306
description: Extinction 1306 is a top-down roguelike shooter. You are the sole survivor after a failed experiment. You must fight off mutant insects, explore the abandoned lab, level up and find upgrades to improve your skills, and defeat bosses to reach a final threat standing in between you and saving Earth.

title: Pillars Of Fog
description: Dive into a dark thrilling environment and fight for your survival while exploring brutalist environments as a young Fogdweller. Escape, kill, and die while the environment and terrifying enemies work to spill your blood. Will you fall victim to the trials or will you prove yourself to your tribe?

title: Tony and Jennie
description: Tony and Jenny are 3D platformer games that move cute characters. It comes with a fairytale background and sound. It has a difficult difficulty level, so you can play it interestingly. Now, let's go on a trip!

title: Selene
description: On a starry night, a shooting star knocks the moon out of the sky... What will the little moon do now?

title: Sonic Color Cursed
description: Sonic Color Cursed is a 2D speed based platformer, inspired by the Genesis classics with a 1-bit artstyle! Dr. Eggman is up to his antics again and this time he’s stolen all the color from the planet! Sonic and friends will have to put an end to Eggman’s plans with flying colors! Or else the world will forever cease to have color! There are RGB scales for you to adjust to have your own shade of the game. You can also enable colored outlines for important objects!

title: Spark in Sonic After the Sequel
Sonic: Lost in Nightmare World
description: A fangame based around the scrapped concepts of Sonic 1, combining some elements from the early prototypes.

title: Project Castlevania Z
description: A Castlevania fan game mainly inspired by Rondo of Blood.

title: Fisher-Price Little People Christmas Activity Center
description:
Join Dudley the Elf and help him get ready for Christmas with Fisher-Price Little People Christmas Activity Center. There are ten holiday crafts and activities to do including such tasks as decorating the Christmas tree, placing presents around it or heading outside to build and decorate a snowman. Many of the activity results can be printed using Avery Kids printable stickers.

Back inside once more, you can choose any number of Christmas craft activities and then join Dudley and the other Little People for a sing along of five perennial favorite Christmas carols such as "Deck the Halls," "Up on the Housetop," and "Jingle Bells."

title: Sonic Essence
description: Sonic Essence is an original 2D Modern Sonic adventure built with the Retro Engine V4 Decompilation. It features completely original sprites, levels, badniks, and an all-new soundtrack featuring remixes and original compositions! This project aims to push the potential of Retro Engine (V4) modding to show the fresh and new experiences the decompilation can offer!

title: Spark the Electric Jester: Recharged
description: Spark The Electric Jester: Recharged is a mod that adds bug fixes and new content to the original game.

title: The Third Pig
description: After your brothers are killed by Mr. Wolf and a mysterious associate you wake up to find yourself trapped in your own home and must use your wits and determination to escape. Do you have what it takes to escape?

title: PC Install Girl
description: A girl because her father owes a huge debt is unable to pay, imprisoned in a private prison to work, every day forced to wear sexy clothes live sell computer debt.

title: Foul Repercussion
description: Challenged by his friends, this young boy stayed overnight at school and successfully overcame evil entities... or so he said. Little did he know, everything he told his friends was coming to reality. Will he manage to survive just like what he said in his lies?

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - The Lion’s Crest
description:
Experience a unique questline that, once completed, will reward you with the legendary armour and weapon set of the famous Knight Brunswick: The Lion's Crest.

Stand out from the crowd with a polearm for long distance combat, a dagger when you want to get up close and personal, a full set of plate armour for your good self and a full caparison (a protective and decorative cloth covering) for your noble steed. This set comes replete with a Bohemian coat of arms, with burgundy and gold trim in abundance. Because no one said you can’t look classy on the battlefield.

title: Dark City: Amsterdam Collector's Edition
description: Amsterdam is in trouble and only you can help! Get ready to tackle one of the biggest cases of Agatha’s investigative career, when the legendary ghost ship The Flying Dutchman returns to Amsterdam, bringing a crew of ghost sailors that stalk the streets, sowing terror and seeking revenge! However, there are some that don’t believe the tall tales, so Agatha is enlisted to start an independent investigation into these so-called ghosts. Do these salty spirits really hold water, or will the legend prove to be all dried up? There’s only one way to find out! Dive into another haunting mystery in this Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

title: Pawfish Bay
description: Fish, grill and serve your feline bosses!

title: Goos Hunt
description: Infinite rounds, every 10 GOOS they get faster. Each round you get to let 2 GOOS escape, and you get 13 bullets, miss 3 or run out of ammo and the game ends... Each GOOS = 10 points.

title: Här Kommer Pippi Långstrump
description: Här kommer Pippi Långstrump is the second game of Pippi Långstrump games. It contains ten different mini-games which can be played with Pippi, Tommy and Annika.

title: Motocross The Game
description:
MTG - Motocross The Game is the materialization of nearly 30 years' experience in both motocross and video games. The entire core project team is or has been a motocross racer, and is an active member of existing motocross video game communities.

MTG is the game that gamers have been dreaming of for decades: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator based on online competition, available on both PC and next-gen consoles, with cross-play capabilities.

title: Starmaker Story
description: Starmaker Story is an immersive Adult Visual Novel where your dialogue choices shape the journey. Encounter and romance a variety of intriguing characters, grow your Starmaker Page, and unlock one of 11 unique endings.

title: Last Laugh
description: Last Laugh is a horror game that tells the story of the fate of 3 teenagers who often bully their classmates.

title: Asylum: Patient Zero
description: Plunge into the frightening depths of horror in this thrilling horror game, where every step conceals new nightmares and darkness hides the creepiest secrets....

title: Twilight Tales: Hollow's Store
description: While trying to avoid the dangers of working the night shift at a store deep in the forest, you'll also make decisions that shape the fate of the story.

title: Hellcats: Missions at Leyte Gulf
description:
Hellcats: Missions at Leyte Gulf is the sequel to Hellcats Over The Pacific (HotP). You are a naval pilot of the F6F "Hellcat" in one of the best early 3D rendered open-world flight simulators. After this project, Graphic Simulations used the same base code to make the next generation flight simulator F/A-18 Hornet.

There are 8 new missions in the Leyte Gulf (Phillipines) theater. New added features included the use of rockets and torpedos. We encounter a brand new enemy aircraft, the Ki-84 "Frank" (first encountered in Mission X), a far superior adversary than the Mitsubishi Ay6M "Zero" in HotP. In addition, new allied aircraft make appearances, including the Lockheed P-38 "Lightning."

title: Death Worm
description: If you've ever secretly harboured a desire to snap up entire elephants in a single bite, Death Worm, more Shai-Hulud than Nibbles, just might be the game for you. Loosely inspired by cryptozoological accounts of the Mongolian Olgoi-Khorkhoi, this game allows the player to be to the Gobi Desert what Jaws was to Amity Island -- a menacing avatar of hunger incarnate, lurking somewhere unseen beneath the surface... waiting to strike!

title: MinecraftEdu
description: MinecraftEdu focuses on allowing the player to explore, interact with, and modify a dynamically-generated map made of one-cubic-meter-sized blocks. In doing so, the student, with the help of the teacher, is intended to learn a variety of subjects. The teacher can change settings to define where students can place and destroy blocks and the world used on the server.

title: Harmony of Fear
description: In Harmony of Fear, you will take on the role of Dian, a music instructor who brings her students to a secluded villa for a music rehearsal. Uncover dark secrets and face supernatural threats in this gripping psychological horror inspired by Indonesian folklore.

title: A Regular Store
description: As a new staff member of "A Regular Store", you're job is to complete tasks such as locking the doors, filling sections of the store, grabbing cash out of the register, etc. But as you do so, horrific events occur, and you learn the horrors of the store's past.

title: Goosthetic
description: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Escape captivity and evade slime mutations in this fast-paced action-platformer FPS.

title: Argonauts Agency: Gorgon Medusa - Collector's Edition
description:
Jason and Medea are on a mission again: the famous relic collector Pelias asked them to retrieve the artifact that protects against Medusa's gaze. Without hesitation, the Argonauts set off on a journey to recover the artifact, save the cursed people, and find new friends. Explore the world, gather resources, and help the heroes lift the curse, using your time management skills and strategy to stop the curse and defeat the evil!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
Complete the exclusive bonus campaign!
View concept art and replay your favorite tracks on the music player!

title: Cursed House 14
description: Banish evil spirits by combining tiles 3 in a row!

title: Cursed House 7
description: Use your Match 3 skills against the demons!

title: Dragon Tale 4: The Raven Plot - Collector's Edition
Avalon Jewels 2: Collector's Edition
description: Avalon Jewels is a story-driven Match-3 adventure in a magical fantasy world. Restore the fading Avalon Jewels, defeat Morgana's minions, and explore enchanted lands. Play 300 total handcrafted levels, including Collector's Edition content, in Relaxed or Puzzle Mode.

title: Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick - Collector's Edition
description: Join the most famous pair of detective twins as they delve into the mysterious deaths of two prominent magicians. Were these tragic accidents, or is there a sinister force at play?

title: Enchancement
description: Enchancement is a mod that aims to completely overhaul vanilla Minecraft's enchanting system, along with some other adjacent mechanics.

title: Wilde Investigations: The Zoo Kerfuffle - Collector's Edition
Incredible Dracula: Academy of Shadows - Collector's Edition
Criminal Archives: Blade of Deceit - Collector's Edition
description: A judge's body is discovered with a clean cut across his jugular, setting the stage for an intense puzzle of motives and clues.

title: Ms. Holmes: The Milverton Plot - Collector's Edition
description: Can you uncover the truth behind your uncle’s dangerous past?

title: Relaxing Time: Enchanting France - Collector's Edition
description: Let the magic of Paris, the city of romance and history, sweep you off your feet as you embark on an architectural journey like no other!

title: Relaxing Time: Italy Tour - Collector's Edition
description: Experience the trip of your dreams as you explore the beauty of Italian cities, uncover the secrets of the Colosseum and find hidden objects!

title: It Happened Here: A Storm is Brewing - Collector's Edition
Wilde Investigations: Animal Sanctuary Shuffle - Collector's Edition
Greek Kitchen Frenzy: Dionysus - Collector's Edition
Fables of the Kingdom V: Collector's Edition
Fables of the Kingdom III: Collector's Edition
Ruins of Tearyn
description: Ruins of Tearyn is the smallest fantasy Indie MMO inspired by classic MMORPGs (but modernized!). There will be formidable warriors, epic healers, try-hard DPS and mesmerizing enchanters.

title: New Yankee: The Way of the Knight - Collector's Edition
Mystery of Myths: Heart of Athens - Collector's Edition
description: Step into a world where ancient legends come alive and danger lurks in every shadow. Uncover the truth behind a deadly cult and save Athens from ancient horrors!

title: Mystical Riddles: Haunted Portraits - Collector's Edition
description: Can you solve the riddle of the disappearing visitors before you lose yourself in the gallery’s macabre beauty?

title: Grim Tales: All Shades of Black - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a haunting hidden-object trip through time!

title: Love Letters: First Bloom
description: Solve word challenges, clear locked tiles, and enjoy relaxing minigames while growing a beautiful garden with each discovery.

title: Alice's Wonderland 7: Sugar Rush - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland 2: Stolen Souls - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland 5: A Ray of Hope - Collector's Edition
Alice's Wonderland 6: Fire and Ice - Collector's Edition
Christmas Fables: The Wishing Store - Collector's Edition
description: Save Christmas from Mr. Greedy! Win over the Christmas-hating mayor, and bring the festive spirit back to Christmasshire.

title: Jewel Match: Dracula - Collector's Edition
description: Sink your teeth into a gothic Match-3 adventure in this ghoulish new installment of the Jewel Match series. As a powerful vampire lord, tackle eerie match-3 puzzles to resurrect and refurbish the legendary Castle Dracula.

title: Knight Cats: Whisper of the Universe
Knight Cats: Waves on the Water - Collector's Edition
Myth or Reality: Snowbound Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: Unlock the secrets of Blue Roche! Are the legends of monsters real, or just figments of the local's imagination? It's time to find the truth!

title: Animal Kingdom 3
description: Animal Kingdom 3 is a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints and cameras while searching animals in fantastic locations! With 3 game modes and jigsaw and swap puzzles between the chapters, Animal Kingdom 3 will provide hours of fun for Hidden Object fans in soothing natural settings!

title: Ramek: Total Machine Death
description: In a future Earth of machine overlords, warrior chieftain Ramek enacts a terrible revenge upon his mechanical enemy. Fly Ramek's genetically-engineered war-budgie through five levels of non-stop carnage, from the irradiated sands of the Dead Zone, to the iron towers of Machine City.

title: ChessBlaze
description: ChessBlaze is a strategy game based on Chess but with a major twist: TURNS DO NOT EXIST! Who needs turns if you can have energy instead. Every move costs energy, no need to wait for opponents response. Some game-modes feature "PowerTiles". They offer unique abilities for pieces entering them!

title: Jixo: The Season of Joy - Collector's Edition
description: Explore a variety of holiday-themed games, from hidden object challenges in enchanting Christmas scenes to captivating jigsaw puzzles that piece together the wonders of winter. And if you're looking to flex those brain muscles, our clever puzzles will keep you happily engaged all season long.

title: Umbra Lumen
description: Roguelike Deckbuilder meets puzzle gameplay. Collect tarot cards and mystic items as you face unpredictable events, meet memorable characters, and explore the beyond life. Each run is different, and every decision matters. Will you ascend or fall in this unique turn-based RPG?

title: Metaneurosis
description: A turn-based RPG blending strategy, surreal worlds, and dark humor. Customize your character, shape the story with your choices, and explore worlds where absurdity meets heart.

title: Ramen Shop Simulator
description: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique restaurant. The aroma of success is just a bowl away!

title: Fillet Fury
description: Set in the Original Wild West, Fillet Fury is a high stakes game of strategy, skill, and survival. Engage in intense showdowns where every decision counts. Will you walk away a legend or lose it all? Literally!

title: Catale
description: Catale is a new type of card game with a mix of CCG and RogueLike. Use units strategically in the field, and attack enemies with spells to win. After opening the loot pack to get the card, make your own deck to face a more powerful enemy...!

title: Staroot
description: 1-person Topdown strategy game. Plant seeds to defend enemy and grow roots. Terraforming the planets!

title: Hailborn: UFO Stole My Egg!
description: A souls-like action game where you fight monsters, explore hail, and build bridges to reclaim your stolen egg. Created by a solo developer.

title: Kingdom Fortress
description: Command powerful heroes in this turn-based, deck-building village defense game. Build strategic fortifications, deploy loyal troops, and protect settlements across the realm of Valora. Manage resources, unlock powerful cards, and lead your forces against the encroaching darkness.

title: Uhilant
description: Cozy, turn-based puzzle game set in a dystopian land overshadowed by a long war. You've made the bold choice to survive instead of becoming cannon fodder. Now You are - "The Uhilant", war dodger. Immerse yourself in this charming adventure, where every move brings you closer to freedom

title: Box King
description: BOXKING - Bounce the box to the target point! Bounce the box by clicking the mouse, avoid obstacles, and reach the target to advance to the next level! 🚀 Collect coins and rubies to upgrade, and enjoy stylish play with unique box skins! ✨ Try BOXKING right now!

title: Any Castle
description: This is a very relaxing and minimalist idle game. However, if you want to defeat the ultimate dragon or obtain the final treasure, you will still need to invest a lot of time and have great luck! Start your journey now!

title: Spell Candle
description: Spell Candle is your grief coping mechanism in a 2D romance visual novel. Take on the role of a foreign correspondent turned investigator of magical crimes to uncover the culprit behind the mysterious disappearance of a sleeping God.

title: WyshBound
description: A great knight is all that stands between his kingdom and demise. Wes…is his squire. When the villainous Fangor defeats the great knight, Wes is the only one who can avenge his mentor. Gather a party of friends, solve unique puzzles, and collect the realm's gifted flowers in this hand-drawn RPG!

title: Paws & Potions
description: You are the pet and kitchen assistant of a young alchemist witch. Run through the garden of the shop she and her girlfriend manage and deliver the correct ingredients to help with sales!

title: The Mnemograph
description: A strategy game that combines deck-building, card-based combat, deduction, and management, all set in a steampunk world of press and crime. Build a unique deck and manage your printing factory to create the city's most influential newspaper.

title: Ventilate
description: A bullet hell top-down/isometric steampunk game where you must fight rogue constructs to get home and flee the city.

title: Phantom of the Grove
description: A fungal fairycore colony sim where you are the vengeful spirit of an ancient forest. Possess and gaslight invaders into fighting each other, reclaim their bodies as fuel for the Grove, and guide your Seely mushroom children to build and expand. The Grove is done being nice.

title: Wizards and Knights
description: Wizards and Knights is turn-based fantasy strategy game featuring randomly generated maps for an infinite variety of games. The goal of the game is to battle five other AI controlled teams to conquer the world.

title: Lonefield Evacutation Survivor
description: Lonefield Evacuation Survivor is a... survivor in which you play as a ship facing an alien incursion. Destroy your enemies, collect bolts and upgrade your ship to survive long enough and escape. Play alone or with up to 3 friends in local multiplayer or with Remote Play Together for online gaming.

title: Drop Dimensions
description: Drop is an endless runner with short enough sessions for quick casual plays and enough features and unlockables to fill more hardcore sessions. Smash your way through walls and dodge traps to survive! RPG-Lite features (leveling), quests, collectibles, achievements, leaderboards and more!

title: Echoes of the Night
description: Two rival phantom theives collide in a high-stakes heist. Will they fall for each other or betray one another? Race, dodge, and fight to the beat of Barney & Company's debut Album "No Refusal"

title: Aster Symphona
description: Aster Symphona allows you to mine, construct, and automate your way through 2D levels each acting as their own puzzle. Fly around space and listen to the sounds of your factory fade in and out as you pass overhead.

title: LuminaRun
description: LuminaRun, a retro-inspired endless runner with two modes: race the clock or test your endurance in Endless Mode. Featuring synthwave visuals, 7 darkwave soundtracks, and fast-paced gameplay, this heartfelt homage to ‘80s and '90s classics is my first Steam release!

title: Blind_Site
description: Explore dark corridors, snap photos, and survive hostile entities hunting you. Use your camera's flash to reveal the way, but beware - each flash draws unwanted attention.

title: Cityventory
description: CITYVENTORY is a minimalist city builder/inventory management game where you build colorful cities just like you are organizing your inventory. Place and move your tiles freely, synergize them to earn points and build the best city possible!

title: Lex Talionis A
description: Lex Talionis A is a team-based, 4 player, couch co-op where aliens fight astronauts, drones, and bosses for revenge against humanity. Choose from four aliens with unique abilities and survive together in this 2D Run n' Gun Adventure.

title: Super Muscle Knight
description: Aim for the top wearing a mysterious mask that generates magnetic force when you strike a macho pose. High difficulty platform game with pixel art. One mistake can lead to despair.

title: Secrets for Taking
description: Take the others' deepest secrets--including your own. Find out where you belong in this decaying world.

title: The Meowfficer
description: You play as a cat in the police force, talking with your allies, fighting in intense gun fights, unraveling the lore, and making moral decisions.

title: Mutant Kingdom
description: Mutant Kingdom thrusts you into a haunting, ever-changing world where survival hinges on clever deckbuilding and tactical exploration. Harness the power of dynamic weather and elemental synergies, discover game-changing items, and unleash adrenaline-pumping combos.

title: Anchor: Quest for Atlantis
description: Dive in and solve the mystery of Atlantis! Explore the depths in this Isometric Action-Game, fight against the Guardians and awaken the powers in your Anchor to uncover the truth behind the fall of the Civilization.

title: BoomerPunk
description: The game takes place in the Far North of Russia in 1997. You play as an investigator who finds themselves in the mysterious settlement of Metallurg-63. Every choice you make affects the course of events and the ending.

title: Strange Jigsaws
description: A game of strange jigsaws.

title: Lunar Elixer
description: You've been tasked with drilling and collecting the valuable resource of elixer that originates from your planet's moon. The native snails are the only thing in your way from collecting this valuable resource. Mine gems and axe down trees to build up your defenses to protect your elixer storage.

title: Necromancy for Homies
description: Necromancy for Homies is a non-linear, black comedy surrealist visual novel, inspired by the legacy of punk band Sektor Gaza.

title: Baseball Legacy Manager 25
description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional baseball team!

title: Orbit Economica
description: Trade, Build, Spy, Negotiate, and Battle for total control of the galaxy's riches. Become the backbone of galactic commerce in a grand strategy universe ripe with opportunity for exploitation and conquest.

title: Braving Chronicles
description: Experience a variety of stories that chronicle the tales of a boundlessly creative universe through a tactical, team-building no microtransactions gacha system featuring a wide variety of characters to utilize amidst the many tales of the Braving Universe.

title: Row Divers
description: Row Divers is a short, experimental incremental game about diving into dungeons in the form of rows, shooting enemies, collecting resources, and upgrading your bow to conquer the depths!

title: Haru and Wonder Land
description: Haru and Wonder Land is a game where Haru, a young cellist, embarks on an adventure in a mysterious world.

title: Crystal Keepers
description: Face hordes in intense battles, unlock abilities, and combine items to create unique builds. Play solo or with up to 3 friends, discover powerful synergies, and survive the insane waves. Evolve your strategy, defeat bosses, and become a true Guardian of the Crystals!

title: Matrix Bro
