description: In 1950, a war veteran living in a house that should feel like home is haunted by eerie hallucinations and a suffocating sense of dread, and must fight to keep his sanity intact. The horror is more real than it seems...

title: Doors: Haunted Tales of Lantern House
description: This game is about reliving mysterious tales surrounding the haunted location, 'Lantern House.'

title: Sky Fields
description: Sky Fields is a Voxel Monster-Tamer. Recruit, battle and trade Goobers to build your ultimate team! You'll need a well-structured team with tanks, supports, and damage dealers to progress far on your journey.

title: Hydraulic Slam
description: In this turn-based, tactical tennis simulation you build, control and improve your own tennis robot. Play on grass, clay and hard courts and balance your energy, precision and condition throughout the match. Maintain and develop your robot between matches.

title: AstroScaper
description: A minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.

title: Digital Legacy of Zero
description: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy basements, upgrade your own to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts using your team. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

title: Few Shall Return
description: Few Shall Return is a PvPvE multiplayer dungeon extraction adventure. You have together to survive, but you're on your own at the end of the day. Each round only takes 7.5 minutes

title: Pecking Order
description: Pecking Order is a fast-paced, absurd party game where sneaky worms must outwit hungry birds to survive. Juke, dodge, and strategise in a frantic battle of wits and reflexes. Work solo or in teams to complete objectives and escape before time runs out!

title: 69 Love
description: 69 LOVE - is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: 8 Ball: Reborn
description: And this time, your mission is to rescue the balls that got stuck in Snookyland. To do this, you need to face enemies, free them from their cages and collect golden tokens to unlock new levels. Each ball has a specific text that is displayed as soon as you rescue it, and when you return to the table, the rescued balls will be running free to celebrate freedom. When you complete the levels you unlock a painting, which will decorate the games room. Furthermore, if you collect all the golden chips and redeem all the balls, the table and game room will have a premium look.

title: 9 Games, 2 Buttons
description: In this game you play up to 9 minigames at the same time, at game speeds of 50-300%. You use the numberpad and QWE down, which match where the minigame is on the grid. Push for a new high score, trash talk your friends!

title: 9 Ways: Hentai Harem
description: 9 Ways: Hentai Harem is a relaxing 2D puzzle game where you assemble pieces of artwork to restore a complete image! The perfect game for unwinding with a pleasant atmosphere, unique artwork, and simple mechanics.

title: 9 Years of Dreaming
description: 9 Years of Dreaming is an action-adventure game where you explore the subconscious of Jacob, who has been in a coma for nine years after a car accident. Trapped in a surreal dreamscape, Jacob meets Lumby, a mysterious guide who helps him on his journey to wake up.

title: A Bad Clicker
description: Some games are good, a few games are great, most are alright. This is not one of those games. Come explore this labyrinth of menus that make number bigger. Watch number get big, only to get small, to get big again, faster this time even!

title: Abject Abyss
description: Abject Abyss is a first person horror adventure on a distant world. Explore Luminary Corporation’s most advanced research facility while piecing together what went wrong, and avoiding the horrors that lurk in the dark.

title: Abode: Definitive Edition
description: Abode: Definitive Edition is the updated edition of Abode, it is a short walking simulator horror game, you are stuck in a loop going through a small house, when horror starts happening around you.

title: Abyssal Shade
description: Abyssal Shade is a deck building roguelike where you dive into a dungeon of the mind. Receives the blessings of your emotions through unique puzzles and expand your deck to protect yourself from the Shades.

title: A Cat's Way Home
description: A Cat's Way Home is a relaxing cat simulation game. Explore China as a cat with cute graphics. Receive personalized letters from the cat and respond using advanced language technology. Enjoy the journey with your virtual cat friend in this busy world.

title: Ace Squared
description: Ace Squared is a multiplayer arena first-person shooter. You can build huge structures and dig tunnels behind enemy lines. Imagination is the only limit. Featuring 32-player servers, different classes and game modes.

title: Across Icaria
description: A boy called Ica decide to visit sea.

title: Adequately Ever After
description: Save a princess! Kill an evil mage! Solve puzzles! Or just argue with the narrator and marry someone inappropriate. With dozens of different endings, adventure is yours to command in this satirical fairy tale.

title: Aera Flying Heroes
description: Dive into a vertical shoot 'em up blending action with a fantasy-aviator universe. Face waves of enemies, upgrade your ship, and take on epic challenges against formidable bosses. Accessible, captivating, and designed for enthusiasts, this game promises an intense and unforgettable experience.

title: A Few Days With: Valentina
description: Embark on a sensual heart-hunting adventure with Valentina, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Valentina's enticing layers.

title: A Frog in a Well
description: This is a hellishly difficult 2D pixel platformer/avoidance game, one of the toughest you've ever seen. You play as a space miner trapped in a mental world by alien monsters, repeatedly escaping the depths of a well and striving to reach your own blue sky, just like a frog at the bottom of the well.

title: Afterlife Reverie
description: A challenging 2D puzzle platformer where a damned spirit must navigate her way through the Underworld and beyond in search of her past. Take over bodies and teleport your way to the answers you seek!

title: A Good Field
description: First of all, the game has level play, players need to start from level 1, by doing tasks, after completing the task to move up to the next level, directly to the full level. Then there's construction, agriculture, industry, military.

title: A Handful of Lewd Games
description: In A Handful of Lewd Games you'll compete in competitive masturbation, draw seedy art commissions to pay rent, and slap disembodied anime butts at the risk of being jumpscared!

title: Aim Trainer Gauntlet
description: Aim Trainer Gauntlet is the first game made by the solo creator, Wingpoo. Thumbsucker Studio presents the bare bones boring ol' aim trainer that fights back. Expect bugs with no support as this is posted for my friends to see my first creation.

title: Akhena: Age of Evil
description: Akhena: Age of Evil is an open-world RPG where the player can explore a vast and dangerous world with a rich history rooted in gritty realism and filled with riches to discover. The story and characters are inspired by classic fantasy novels, where morality is nuanced and defined by cultural bias.

title: Alaska Solitaire Classic Card Game
description: Enjoy playing Alaska Solitaire from the #1 Classic Card Game Collection for free. Customize your game with awesome card designs, backgrounds and win animations adding even more fun to this classic game.

title: Liz and Rose's Alchemy Factory
description: Switch between twin protagonist sisters Liz and Rose to navigate the perilous streets and tiered city walls of Fahran. Uncover secrets, and outwit foes in this “atelier-rific” doujin RPG!

title: Strange Alchemy
description: A casual and light deck-builder with a dark story where you use cards to explore, gather, and create potions.

title: Purrfect Alchemy
description: Purrfect Alchemy is a "purrfect" blend of twin stick shooter, wave survival, tower defender. Craft defenses at the center cauldron with a variety of ingredients you may find. Upgrade spells, defeat bosses and reach the end with up to 3 other friends in this Co-Op adventure

title: Alchemy in Dungeon
description: Roguelike auto chess, delve into dungeons to slay monsters, collect materials, and craft the ultimate potion combinations!

title: AlibAi
description: An AI-driven murder mystery where you play as the killer. Deceive NPCs, shift suspicion, and outsmart the AIs to survive. Strategize late-night kills and morning conversations in a tense game of trickery and deception.

title: Alien Fury
description: Arcade space shooter that gets progressively harder, the longer you play. It's a simple a matter of shooting the alien missiles, before they hit you. How long can you survive?

title: Animal Adventure
description: Animal Adventure is a party game that uses familiar animal characters to help you overcome obstacles to reach your destination. It combines PVE elements through various obstacles and PVP elements through competition between players.

title: Burger Girl Clicker
description: Click on the anime burger girl in the square to score points and just enjoy the process. Minimalistic and relaxing gameplay where the only goal is to press a button. Perfect for those who want to take a break from challenging tasks.

title: Ananas: Pineapple Idle Game
description: Ananas is free Play-to-earn relaxing clicker game where you're gonna get pineapples to trade! Dropped/bought items has their use and have a fair chance to get bought for random value by dev on upcoming live streams, that's where Ananas differs!

title: Ancient Ocean: The Fall of Atlantis
description: Submerge into the ancient ocean of the Cambrian period! Encounter mysterious creatures of times past in this short-and-sweet platforming adventure. Treat yourself to colorful SNES-inspired graphics and an extensive world to explore. Who knows what awaits you?

title: Along the Edge of the Sky
description: Along the Edge of the Sky is a dynamic first-person action-platformer where you must escape Limbo and reach the Heavens. The road ahead is tough, and you will need to destroy hordes of demons along the way. Can you traverse this path and not give up? In this thrilling escape, it all depends on you!

title: Alpha League HD
description: Alpha League HD is a free-to-play, hero based Autobattler. In Alpha League, simply pick and build your favorite hero in a Roguelike fashion with 12 different combat genres, and then battle the other 7 Bots or Players to be the winner.

title: Altar
description: A supernatural horror game where you hunt and banish ghosts by locating altars, using tools, and surviving deadly attacks in procedurally generated environments. Play solo or with friends in this tense and dynamic ghost-extermination experience. This is not a finished project. This is build 1.0

title: Ämäränth: The Last Day of My Adolescence
description: The story of a young graduate witnessing the twilight of his world.

title: Amazing Weekend 2: Search and Relax - Collector's Edition
description: "Amazing Weekend 2 - Search and Relax 2 Collector's Edition" is a great new hidden object game. Experience hiking, horseback riding, and boating provide unforgettable escapes from the rush and bustle of city life. Discover all of the hidden objects and complete loads of challenging mini-games.

title: I Am Immortal Here
description: Only I exist here. It's the world of freedom. Nothing restricts you in this place.

title: Project: Stellar Girls
description: Join the exciting adventure with "Project: Stellar Girls" - a match-3 game. Beautiful girls in stunning costumes, armed with incredible guns, are ready to help you complete the game. Let's embark on this adventure!

title: Cardwoven Empires
description: Deckbuilder with 4X elements. Explore a world to find artefacts, play cards to add cities, farms, temples and ports, trade with your neighbours or invade them, and defend yourself against natural disasters and orcish raiding. Choose one of three factions and add cards to build on their synergies.

title: Succubus: Elysian Fields
description: Play endlessly in visually beautiful locations in a new game mode - Rogulike mode!

title: Linum
description: Difficult puzzles that will test your logical thinking skills.

title: Hamster Combat: Road to Whale
description: Expand the game with unique DLC Chest and instant reward included 3 keys

title: Ultimate Hunting
description: Where each virtual action captures the true essence of hunting: REAL, BRUTAL, UNFORGETTABLE. Embark on a hunting expedition, returning with valuable trophies and memorable experiences. Customize your gear and adapt your hunting techniques to explore vast, realistic environments.

title: Plant Therapy: Coney Island Plus
description: Plant Therapy Coney Island Plus features a new neighborhood with two more apartments and our new wall decorating feature that lets you pick from over 200 wallpapers and wall colors!

title: Enchantment 2: Sun's Tear
description: Enchantment 2: Sun's Tear is a magical hidden object game set in the Melleryn Kingdom, featuring diverse modes and puzzles to locate hidden fragments of enchanted objects, offering hours of fun and entertainment.

title: Dessert Storm Girls
description: Avoid bullets and eliminate enemies to earn points.Take on challenging enemies and bosses across multiple stages, each with its unique design and challenges. Use your skills to stay ahead of the enemy and emerge victorious.Help the CDF stop the separatist uprising and restore peace.

title: Tower of the Dragon
description: Tower of the Dragon is a story-driven, turn-based combat RPG. Treasures and secrets lie in the mysterious tower which appeared after the death of a young dragon.

title: Drum Revolution
description: Drum Revolution - the future of learning drums! Simply connect your E-Drumkit or midi pad to your PC or Mac and control a platformer game while learning and practicing to play the drums.

title: Tunguska: Sound of Music
description: This DLC brings melodies of joy to the Zone! Listen to 3+ hours of soundtrack in HD at any time with an in-game portable radio device. Better yet, you can even listen to your own custom .MP3 music while hunting and crafting!

title: Angkor 5: Volcano's Verge
description: In this Match 3 game, you are the master of Gemcrafting magic, helping build the legendary temple of Angkor Wat. Unexpectedly, the ancient volcano beneath the island stirs, threatening to erupt and engulf the island. Can your gem matching skills quell the volcano and save Angkor Wat?

title: Manor Mania
description: Manor Mania is a Metrovania Randomizer game nut scaled down in size with more focus on replayability. It has a handcrafted map, equippable gear/weapons, and random Powerups that help you navigate the manor. Many randomized elements ensure variety for each run.

title: Silver Daze
description: Collect cards and battle monsters in this retro style coming-of-age JRPG!

title: TheSilentSnowfall
description: The Silent Snowfall is a first-person horror game.Embark on a dark Christmas journey where the silence of a winter night hides blood-chilling secrets.

title: World Quest: Hidden Cities
description: From ancient ruins and majestic castles to colorful markets and serene gardens, each destination offers unique mysteries to discover. With dozens of breathtaking locations and over 1,000 hidden objects to find, the wonders of the world are waiting for you.

title: Skies
description:
Skies is a post-apocalyptic tactical RPG with user-driven economics and tokenomics where you can mine resources , craft goods, launch and rule your business, create a clan, fight for the desert and cities and much more.

There is a World map in the center of Skies with such options as Character, Factories (list of factories - filtered by the distance from the character's location), Clans, NFT market, Business (My factories, Rented locations).

title: Primordial Empire
description: Primordial Empire is a side-on colony sim on the microscopic level. Cultivate a colony of microbes, plants and animals from small beginnings to mutualistic paradise. Connect the web of life in a tangle of nutrients and trophic balance. Scratch out a living and claim your empire from the rock itself!

title: Cursed House 3
description: An advanced Match - 3 puzzle with some nice additions!

title: Neverlander: An Awfully Big Adventure
description: Fantasy Otome Visual Novel inspired by Peter and Wendy by J. M. Barrie

title: How to Turn a Cherry Tree Spirit Into an Idol
description: The protagonist who lost his mother in an accident and returned to his hometown with his father. Small town, countryside, and first-timers are all uncomfortable, and he faces an unexpected connection.

title: Templar 2
description: Templar 2 is a 2D indie action platform game. Immerse yourself in the darkest, scariest and bloodiest Middle Ages. A story told in comic format, and with spectacular dubbing.

title: Pennylooter
description: Pennylooter is a roguelike that takes place in an infinite world, where you'll have to fight increasingly numerous enemies as you explore your surroundings and collect pennies so that you can buy more items and survive the next wave.

title: Lofi aquarium
description: "Lofi Aquarium" is a gamified focus tool designed to enhance concentration and relieve stress. As you work, a group of adorable baby fish will keep you company, all set to soothing lofi music. Over time, the fish grow and can be sold for profit. ﻿

title: Sweet Honey: Cake
description: Each level has some tasks, such as eating 3 breads and 3 candies. You need to control the player to eat these quantities of desserts through the directional keys (left and right).If you complete these tasks within the specified time, you can pass this level, otherwise you will fail.

title: Sunny Trails
description: It was supposed to be a great party, but when Amaterasu and her sisters arrive, they find everything abandoned and all guests turned into stone. Go on an adventure in this cozy turn-based RPG to solve this mystery and save your friends!

title: Strike Protocol
description: Strike Protocol is a modern warfare dungeon crawler and builder game. Engage in intense infiltrations or defend your base with strategic traps and bots. Customize your character with various weapons and gear, and experience dynamic gameplay as an Infiltrator or a Commander.

title: Kallio
description: Help players trapped in a collapsed mine find their way out through different levels in a puzzle-style game. Play in single-player mode or with others online in multiplayer.

title: Fishing Zone
description: "Fishing Zone" is an exciting and interesting fishing game. Players can trade freely in the Steam community market, and the shells can be recycled. Experience the exciting gameplay, enjoy the ultimate fishing fun, and the refreshing experience of gold coins exploding the screen!

title: Global Magnates: Shipping Tycoon
description: Global Magnates: Shipping Tycoon is a maritime simulation game, placing you at the head of a fledgling shipping empire with a new technology: the shipping container.

title: EmojiShooter
description: A tower defense game with Roguelike and casino elements. Players create diverse decks using Emoji shooters and various items, activating unique traits to defeat meme monsters from the digital world.

title: Rain and the Wolf
description: A boys love / yaoi visual novel based loosely on Little Red Riding Hood. Follow Rain as he meets a mysterious werewolf, Zero, deep in the woods, and shape his fate with your choices. Will Rain be able to tame the werewolf, or will he meet a grisly end?

title: Just Skill Shooter 4
description: Just Skill Shooter 4 is an exhilarating first-person shooter that puts your reflexes and marksmanship to the ultimate test.

title: Balloon Warfare
description: Balloon Warfare is a first-person arena shooter with a twist: you become stronger by hunting down specific colored balloons to upgrade your weapon. Together with your team, you must take out the Boss Balloon that spawns on the map.

title: Goat Simulator 3: Gifts from the Rifts
No One's Escaped
description: Escape the towering prison by mastering your grappling hook! Navigate through vertically moving cubes, avoid deadly spinning turbines, and manage your stamina to reach new heights in this thrilling climb. Die, repeat, learn, and conquer your way to freedom.

title: Counting Spices
description: You visit your grandparents' house and discover that your Grandpa has played quite a prank on Grandma. This puzzle game will make you rack your brain looking for patterns to puzzles and answers to Grandpa's questions. Will you help Grandma find her precious spices?

title: Scale: Rise of Dragons
description: SCALE is a highly competitive and FREE fantasy card game that takes all of the best mechanics of popular TCG's and puts them into one action-packed game that gives you ALL of the cards for free. You can react to every move your opponent makes, making for exciting and fast paced competition!

title: Duck N Roll
description: Don't hesitate. Roll the dice! Duck N Roll is a dice-rolling roguelike game where you go on an adventure with the wizard duck and its friends. Roll the dice, use powerful skills and win against monsters!

title: Inscrutable Fortress
description: Inscrutable Fortress - an exciting 3D tower defense game where strategy and tactics are key! Defend your fortress using four unique types of towers, each with its own characteristics and abilities. Engage in thrilling battles against four different types of enemies each requiring a distinct approach

title: Retro Pistol Hero
description: Retro Pistol Hero - a 3D FPS shooter in retro pixel style with procedurally generated locations. The player's task is to clear an unknown office-like space from purple crystal enemies. The game is very challenging and dynamic.

title: Deep Dungeon Knight
description: Deep Dungeon Knight - an immersive 3D rogue-like dungeon adventure where magic and bravery guide your path through treacherous dungeons! Step into the shoes of a valiant knight, wielding powerful spells to combat fearsome monsters lurking in the shadows.

title: Egg Surprise: No more clicks!
description: With this DLC, you will no longer have to click manually. The No More Clicks DLC adds an auto-click function to the game even when minimized, allowing you to collect with ease.

title: Annalynn MD
description: Annalynn MD is a brand new falling block puzzle game made in the style of games from the 16-bit era! A miner no more, Annalynn has now joined world of medicine in pursuit of the ultimate cure! Twist, turn, and take out germs as you help her make the world just a little bit healthier.

title: The Last Meadow
description: April Fool's game published by Discord in 2025

title: Dreams of Aether
description: A collection of dozens of Aether-flavored microgames! Dive into the Dreams of Aether, where everyone is trapped in a never-ending nightmare! Meet some of the strangest characters Aether has to offer!

title: Luntik: Matematika dlya malishey
description: The project of the series "Luntik. Preparing for School", which includes five educational games for children aged 5-7. This is a children's educational computer game about Luntik - a character from the cartoon of the same name. Traveling through a wonderful fairy-tale world with Luntik and his friends, little players will learn to perform basic arithmetic operations - add, subtract and compare numbers, as well as tell time on the clock. Fun mini-games and meetings with the heroes of their favorite cartoon in new funny situations await the little ones.

title: Claycrafter
description: Gather resources, build structures, and craft increasingly wondrous items to unlock the secrets of a mysterious world made entirely out of clay.

title: Awkward Valley
description: Welcome to Awkward Valley! Plan your day, tackle strange activities, and unlock bizarre new options as you go. Gym? Therapy? Vending machine snacks? It’s up to you! Featuring Awkward Yeti’s weird and wonderful characters in a totally normal town.

title: Fused 240
description: A short computer game about driving around in your vehicle, and meeting new people.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2
description:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2 is an action fighting game based on the Demon Slayer series.

It follows the events of the anime, continuing the story of Tanjiro Kamado and his companions. Players take part in arena-based battles using characters with distinct moves and abilities. The game includes a story mode and versus modes for local and online play. It expands on the mechanics and roster introduced in the original Hinokami Chronicles.

title: MILFs of Sunville
description: MILFs of Sunville is an adult game about a young guy forced to leave his luxurious life in a big city behind and return to a college in a small town of Sunville. This is a VN, filled with beautiful girls, romance, moral choices mixed with quality graphics and hot close-up animations.

title: Handstand Hank
description:
Your name is Hank. You are doing a Handstand. Jump to the top.

Handstand Hank is a punishing experience that will test your patience while you attempt to traverse your way up a mountain of obstacles. Jump, Fall and Rage way through increasingly difficult challenges.

Get Ready for a Challenge:
- 4 brutality difficult areas, each introducing new unique challenges to overcome.
- Lose of all your progress and potentially your sanity.
- An unmatched triumph awaits those who reach the top.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Through the Petals in the Land of Repose
description:
Version 3.2 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Castorice and Anaxa
• New Trailblaze Mission: "Through the Petals in the Land of Repose"
• New areas: Demigod Council and Dragonbone City
• Two-year anniversary celebrations and QoL features
• …and more!

title: Artius: Pure Imagination
description: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

title: Ghost Kitchen
description: Online Co-op Cooking game with a twist: some of the chefs are secretly bloodthirsty killers! Play with up to 16 friends, and crack the case before your restaurant becomes… a GHOST KITCHEN

title: Crast
description: CRAST is a dynamic online first-person survival shooter. Game locations are created exclusively for the convenience of the gameplay. You do not need to worry about various weapon settings, CRAST will take care of this. CRAST will determine your level of play and select a worthy opponent.

title: Kaila: The Journey to the Underworld
description: 2D metroidvania with a medieval fantasy atmosphere. Play as Kaila, a young girl searching for her mother, taken by Graygar, the Grey Soul. Explore a vast world, uncover secrets, upgrade your skills, and face challenging bosses on your way to the Underworld. Are you ready to challenge Death itself?

title: Yark Survivors
description: Yark Survivors is a small and casual action roguelike where you play the role of a small kobold trying to survive against the minions of the Proginator, a cosmic entity set on testing the limits of mortality. Pick up various skills and spells to fight your way and prove your yipping worth!

title: XIII: A Final Game of Tarot With Death
description: XIII is a hypnotic and psychedelic card game. Let death read your future with tarot cards and decide your fate. Play the right cards in the right places to keep the scales of karma in check, for that's the only way to delay the inevitable. And never forget: death comes to us all.

title: Xeyyex II: Colour Wars
description: The space-eyed couple is back! This time they will use the ability to change color to fight. An arcade genre game that pays tribute to the first titles of the 80s. 1 or 2 players.

title: Xeno Wipeout!
description: After centuries of invincibility, it became popular for humans to watch live alien hunting shows, participate in alien hunts, save up money, equipment, and use all the loot you find to move on to new maps and defeat more powerful enemies.

title: XBall
description: A real-time tactics PvP sports game with an underground vibe. Control every player on your team in fast-paced matches that blend basketball, football, and hockey. Customize the action with adjustable time pace and team sizes.

title: Wyvern Creations Crossbow Hunter
description: Take a walk thru our store and checkout some of the highest quality real-world crossbows on the market. Take them for a test in our practice range and find your favorite before heading out into the woods. Hunt bear, deer and fox from the ground or up in a treestand.

title: Purgatory’s Flower
description: Hand-drawn 2D point and click Horror x Dating sim Meet the 'Flowers' imprisoned in hell. They long for an escape to purgatory. Your job here is simple. Listen to their stories, and break out together. Easy, right? ...But, doesn't it seem strange? These people... seem to be out of their mind, a bit.

title: Throne of Marrow
description:
Throne of Marrow is a platforming roguelike featuring cosmic horrors and a world that constantly changes to conquer.

Throne of Marrow puts you in control of Benjamin, one of the recently reanimated dead. In your quest to seek an audience with the royal family, you must survive against a horde of monstrosities.

Experience smooth combat designed to keep you, the player, in complete control of your actions.

Death still signifies progress. During each run, you will encounter permanent upgrades to make each subsequent run easier.

title: Wukong Monkey King's Journey West
description: Quirky Journey to the West: Wukong has learned more skills—capture balls, rocket launchers, and dark magic to subdue demons. If the teachings don't resonate, I also know a bit of hand-to-hand combat.

title: Would You Call Him a Bad Man?
description: This game is the official music video for Ian Hinden's "Would You Call Him a Bad Man?" It's a fast-paced indie musical minigame collection that is part pixel art, part anime visual novel. Are you skilled enough to unlock Ava's Happy Ending?

title: Worfy Games
description: Collection of works by Worfy

title: Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story
description: Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story is a point & click puzzle adventure with hand-drawn 2D graphics and a cozy horror setting that tells a short story set in the Tales from Candleforth universe.

title: WolfGirl RoomMate
description: A Cookie Clicker-style hentai game where the protagonist ends up with a wolf-girl as his roommate. As you gather clicks and resources, you unlock increasingly intimate interactions and special moments with her, deepening your bond and uncovering her true nature.

title: Simulator of Sitting in the Driveway
description:
In this game you can have fun by the entrance and smoke like in the good old 2007s
. Firstly, this is a truly realistic yard, even the cars are frozen solid. Secondly, here you have an ABIBAS and a French gopnik hat!
Thirdly, you can smoke. Fourthly, some drunks are wandering here and there. And most importantly, here you can scream in the good, great, powerful and native Russian swear words!
Where else in games can you swear at the press of a button, huh? That's it.

title: Jewelry Nights Arcadia: The Ends of the World
Beneath the Blobs
description:
Congratulations on your new job at the Facility! Your assignment? Conduct experiments on a variety of blobs in an underground research center. Simple enough—until things start to unravel.

As you descend deeper into the mysterious facility, the cheerful voice guiding you becomes less trustworthy, and the truth about your role begins to emerge. What are these blobs? Why are you really here? And most importantly, can you find a way out?

title: Giftquest
description:
GIFTQUEST is a game where you play the role of Kanaya Maryam, trying to find a gift for your wife Rose Lalonde for your anniversary. It has been many, many years since you have settled on Earth C and on your shopping, you chance upon the PNG DISTRICT. There you will meet some old friends... And foes.

Will Rose like your gift? Will Kanaya get laid? All this is up to you in... GIFTQUEST.

title: Anime Clicker
description: Anime Clicker is a Cookie clicker Idle Game, in which you click Anime girls! Get a random anime girl item every 3 hours and grow your collection!

title: Anime Girls Mirror Quest
description: Dive into the captivating world of anime with 50 stunning illustrations of cute and charming anime girls! Test your attention to detail by spotting 3 to 10 differences in each image.

title: Anime Girls Mirror Quest 2
description: Game Features: 50+ stunning anime artworks featuring beautiful and mysterious heroines Various difficulty levels – from easy to truly challenging No time limits – play at your own pace Full immersion in the anime world with a pleasant atmosphere

title: Anthony the Monk
description: Anthony the Monk is a classic 2D platformer combat game. Your only weapon is a Staff to use against demonic entities across the dangerous wilderness.

title: Anturi
description: As Wikku, embark on a search for your missing father in the unknown world of Anturi. Explore the islands and help the inhabitants. Also gather information about your father's fate. Improve your skills to better combat the unknown dangers.

title: Apartment Escape
description: Kidnapped by someone! You have to escape no matter what! This is a lateral scroll 2d escape game. Use/combine items, solve puzzles, and escape. Step towards the truth hidden all over the place.

title: Apocalypse Carnival
description: This game is an exhilarating racing adventure where four characters compete simultaneously.

title: Apocalypse Island
description: As an ex-scientist on a mission, you find yourself in a toxic and infected island, where humans are no where to be seen. Build, explore and survive.

title: Apple Ring
description: Apple Ring is a free multiplayer online game. Players can win apples and become the winner in each match. Apples and rings are convertible, enhancing your community collection in the future. Real-time communication with others is possible during the game.

title: Aquilon Lust: Sex Arcana
description: You Ren, a young merchant aspiring to open his own apothecary. His ordinary life takes a dramatic turn when he discovers a mysterious girl hiding in his wagon.

title: Aquilon's Sex Quest
description: Welcome to Aquilon, the legendary city of monster hunters, where dangers and treasures lurk in mysterious dungeons. In this dark and mysterious place, you will take on the role of a young hunter who has just arrived in the city with one goal: to become famous and win the hearts of the local beauties

title: Arcade Combat
description: If the world of all video games collapses, who wins the battle between them? Protect your video game assets and destroy them.

title: Arcade Reflex
description: Arcade Reflex blends classic arcade feel and modern twists. Control a paddle through fast-paced, evolving levels that start simple but quickly ramp up, testing your reflexes. With minimalist retro-inspired design and surprising depth, it's perfect for quick sessions. Ready to climb the leaderboards?

title: Arcane Ascent
description: Build powerful decks to face the chaos unleashed by the Primeval Witch. With hundreds of combinations available, perfect your strategy in every battle, strengthen your cards and unravel the mysteries that await you - your rise to power begins now!

title: Arcane Raiders
description: Team up with your wizard friends to pillage the magic tower! Create elemental synergies, defeat powerful bosses and claim the tower's treasure in this rogue-like dungeon-raider.

title: ArcArg
description: It is a turn-based TCG game where the player participates in the "Arcarg" match held in the city of Lars. Become Mari and Betty and meet the characters in the cards!

title: Archaeology: Frozen Knights
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Archaeology: Frozen Village
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Archaeology: Frozen Wall
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Archaeology: Medieval
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Archaeology: Post-Apocalypse
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Archaeology: Sand Japanese
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Arcade Archives: Land Sea Air Squad
description:
"Land Sea Air Squad" is an action game released by TAITO in 1986.
Players take on the role of Sergeant SARGY and advance through rounds destroying enemy fortifications.
In addition to hand grenades and machine guns, make full use of super mechs to break through the battlefield.

title: A Prison Digging Game
description: You are in prison and want to escape. To do so, you can only dig a hole. Luckily, you have a map in hand. Read it carefully and use your digging power to find your way to freedom. Look for fossils, pipelines, and antique objects to locate yourself on the map.

title: F1 25: Iconic Edition
description:
Lewis Hamilton Iconic Pack
Lewis Hamilton F1 World Event in F1 24***
3 days of early access
F1 The Movie – Chapter Scenarios**
APXGP Team Pack**
Collection of 2025 season liveries immediately in Time Trial in F1 24***
F1 75 Celebration Pack
F3 Driver Icons
F1 World Bumper Pack
18,000 PitCoin virtual currency to spend in-game

title: Thief Snatch & Run
description: Steal smart. Move fast. And remember — the cake is worth it.

title: Supermarket Simulator 2025
description: Manage your supermarket! Purchase products, stock shelves, serve customers, hire staff, and expand your store. Can you turn your small shop into a retail empire?

title: Star Archer
description: Star Archer is an arcade game in which you control an archer who is tasked with shooting down oncoming stars. These star threats gradually get closer, and if you make contact with any of them, the game will end. Your goal is to survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score by shooting down as many stars as possible. How long can you last before the stars overwhelm you?

title: StackZap
description: StackZap is a game about stacking up differently colored balls in rows, columns and diagonals of 3 or more of the same color. You get points not for clearing them, but based on a distance that the remaining balls fall. There are 5 colors of the balls: red, green, blue, yellow, gray. The game is over when any of the balls is outside the play field.

title: Puzzle Wars
description: Use your brain to win the battle!

title: Operation: Hostage Rescue
description: Gear up. Get in. Get them out!

title: Moe Waifu H: Push-Box
description: Brainteasing block puzzles have never looked so inviting! In Moe Waifu H Push-Box, you’ll meet 5 female companions who will test your problem-solving skills and reward your cleverness.

title: Golf Up Tropical
description: Enjoy Golf Up Tropical with friends and family!

title: Flying Sushi
description: Flying Sushi is a fast-paced, side-scrolling arcade game where you control a sentient piece of sushi as it soars through the air. Navigate through endless obstacles while collecting bonuses and power-ups to rack up the highest score possible. How far can you go in this quirky and fun adventure?

title: Hope Deferred
description: Hope Deferred is a first-person psychological horror RPG. Explore nightmare worlds and search for understanding in this PSX inspired dungeon crawler.

title: Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus
description: Vlad Circus: Curse of Asmodeus drags you into a sordid world of mirrors and shadows where the demon lurks. Dare to take on this macabre pixel-art graphic adventure of horror and madness. Solve puzzles and explore two parallel timelines.

title: Tabulo
description: Position your pieces carefully to max out your score in this Balatro-inspired chess roguelike. Enhance your pieces, purchase powers, and win bonuses from optional challenges, but be careful - your board only has so much room.

title: Kaia's Ascent
description: Run, climb, and charge punch your way out of the deep, dark abyss in this exhilarating first-person 3D parkour platformer.

title: Bad Bitch Blasters
description: In this mind-blowing insane-arcade RPG, Jennyfer takes down "The Organization" and summons The Legendary Devourer of Dead in order to wipe the planet.

title: Pac's Revenge
description: Pac's Revenge is a retro-style FPS game. Strap on your boots, grab the nearest gun, and blast your way through countless demonic creatures before they can corrupt your whole world.

title: Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow
description: Explore the ruined world of Evergrow, where echoes of a lost civilization whisper through the remnants of a once-thriving planet. Solve puzzles to piece together the truth of what led to its downfall. Can you restore what was lost, or will the shards of tomorrow shape its fate forever?

title: Mortality Decomp. Killers
description: MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS is a short, fast-paced 3rd person horror/comedy hybrid of games like Hotline Miami and Post Void, with hand-drawn visuals inspired loosely by retro detective comics. You'll step into the well-polished shoes of Clive, an undead detective working to take down the criminals that initially killed him.

title: Dungeon Mori
description: Dungeon Mori is a game inspired by the classic Dungeon Crawlers and Old School RPGs. With a simple, yet addicting gameplay, it features a turn based battle system combined with a choice based dungeon exploration.

title: Mother of All Battles!
description:
Mother of All Battles is a turn-based strategy game where you build units to conquer the opponents' cities.

The shareware version is restricted to one human and one computer player fighting on a small map at the easiest difficulty setting.

title: Candy Country: Sweet Wonder
description: Mattie, a curious little girl with a great love for sweets, wakes up one day in a world made entirely of candies, chocolates and cookies.

title: Cozy Hunt
description: Find, explore, and relax in a world full of cute details!

title: Psychiatric Prison Romance: Serial Killer Anime Girls Dating Sim
description:
12 girls, 30 days, one prison… and every decision could be your last.
Deep within an isolated prison, twelve girls await you. They are beautiful, intense… and dangerously unpredictable. Each one has a hidden story, an obsession, a secret that might make you crave their love… or fear for your life.

title: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: A deluxe set containing The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- base game, digital art book, and digital soundtrack.

title: Cat From Hell: Cat Simulator
description:
In this game you're about to destroy the grandma's house. Knock over priceless vases, shred curtains mid-nap, and bat heirlooms into oblivion! Whether it's eating the fish from the aquarium, breaking flower pots, or throwing random items across the room, a cat simulator lets you do it all.

Scratch carpets, couches, and any furniture in sight as you explore different rooms filled with destructible objects. Every scratched sofa and shattered plate fuels Granny’s escalating rage. How much havoc can you unleash before she snaps?

title: Little Heroine: The Electric Monsters
description: Lila never imagined that a storm would turn her into a heroine! One night of lightning and rain, the young girl's life suddenly changes completely!

title: Doodle Escape
description:
Doodle Escape is an interactive AI learning universe designed for both total beginners and curious creators. Through hands-on quizzes, real-world exercises, and step-by-step video lessons, you'll go from "never touched AI" to confidently building prompts, generating content, and mastering tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney. Every course concludes with a final exam and certificate, and completing all levels unlocks our exclusive "Jedi" bonus content. Ready to break free from the ordinary and start your AI journey today?

https://DoodleEscape.com

title: Goodwill Scrolls
description: Goodwill Scrolls is a challenging 2D platformer blending action, precision, and faith. Overcome traps, defeat enemies, and unlock scrolls of encouragement across 15 handcrafted levels. Test your skills in a journey of hope and perseverance!

title: Space Filler
description: A sokoban inspired push blocking puzzle game. Use the d-pad to move the space man with the objective of pushing the green blocks until they perfectly cover each hole in order to progress through each level. Undoing moves or restarting levels if you are stuck is possible. Yellow blocks are magnetic. They will stick to any other green block they touch and they too will become magnetic. You can push your blocks into the purple walls to rearrange the shape of the connecting blocks. The spaceman must avoid the holes or they will get sucked out into space.

title: Bouncy Bread
description: Bouncy Bread is a simple and fun game with 40 challenging and balanced levels, offering a relaxing and accessible experience for players of all ages, with easy-to-learn mechanics and smooth progression.

title: Deadside: Flags Set
description: 30 in-game Flags Skin that can be used on a base.

title: Outbreak: The Fedora Files Desperate Struggle Collection
description: Is a bundle of survival horror games from developer Dead Drop Studios.

title: The First Berserker: Khazan - Deluxe Edition
description: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pell Los Empire, who overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

title: The First Berserker: Khazan - Deluxe Edition Upgrade
description: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pell Los Empire, who overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

title: Tunguska: The Visitation - Complete Edition
description: Seek fortune as a Ghoul Hunter in an abandoned Soviet Exclusion Zone. Use your grit and ingenuity to survive deadly radiation, mysterious anomalies, and poisonous mutants. Go in guns-blazing, or stay in the shadows - your choice.

title: Vagrus: The Riven Realms - Praetor Edition
Tekken 8: Advanced Edition
description:
The Advanced Edition includes:
• TEKKEN 8
• 3 Additional playable characters
- Eddy
- Lidia
- Heihachi

TEKKEN 8 is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games.

title: Payday 3: Fear & Greed Heist
description: Fear & Greed takes place in the heart of Wall Street. Choose stealth or loud, then pull off the heist of the century before anyone's the wiser.

title: Exot
description: Discover a still unexplored region of space: the Exot galaxy. With your C.L.I.C. as your only ally, obtain the resources necessary for your survival. Develop your ship, improve your workshops, face creatures to conquer these hostile lands.

title: Sweet Home: Look and Find 4 - Collector's Edition
description: Explore a cozy house full of secrets! Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and design your dream interior. Perfect for relaxation and immersive storytelling.

title: Around the World 3: Amazing Countries
description: An exciting journey through the most scenic places in the world: hidden objects, mini-games, puzzles, and countless discoveries. Feel the spirit of adventure and explore new horizons!

title: Galago
description: As night falls, a galago — also known as a bush baby — ventures into suburbia, searching for elusive golden fireflies. But the world is perilous for one so small… Galago is an exploration-platformer, blending puzzle-solving, survival, and mystery.

title: Disc Golf Masters
description: Step onto the course in Disc Golf Masters, the most realistic disc golf game ever. Featuring the world’s top athletes, throw real-world discs on authentic courses. Start your pro career, refine your skills, and push the limits of the sport in the world's first true disc golf game!

title: Legends of the Wild West: Golden Hill
King's Legacy: A Crown Divided - Collector's Edition
description: The Kingdom is falling apart! But a group of brave and righteous protectors are on their way! Join them in this fun kingdom builder game! Build your own towns and settlements, upgrade the production, manage your food, resources and luxuries, trade, craft and take care of your people.

title: Lucky Season: End of the Rainbow - Collector's Edition
Secrets of Worlds: Mystery Agency - Collector's Edition
Connection of Worlds: Mirrored Earths - Collector's Edition
Wonders of the World: Collector's Edition
Mario Kart World
description: Mario Kart World is a kart racing game for the Nintendo Switch 2, featuring characters from the Mario franchise. It introduces an open-world design to the series, allowing players to drive freely between courses rather than selecting them from a menu. Races support up to 24 players and include new mechanics such as off-roading, boat racing, rail grinding, and wall riding. The game features a Knockout Tour elimination mode where racers compete across connected courses with periodic eliminations at checkpoints, as well as a Free Roam mode for open exploration and collectible-finding.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour
description: Enter a virtual exhibition and gain insights into what makes Nintendo Switch 2 such a unique gaming experience. Through tech demos, minigames and other interactions, players will get to know the new system inside and out in ways they may never have known about otherwise.

title: Super Mario Party Jamboree: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV
description: Super Mario Party Jamboree is getting even more minigames and an upgrade on Nintendo Switch 2! The upgrade expands on the base game and adds Nintendo Switch 2 gameplay features, such as mouse controls, enhanced rumble, sound recognition, and modes that use a camera accessory (sold separately).

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description:
Travel across vast fields, through forests, and to mountain peaks as you discover what has become of the kingdom of Hyrule-and step into a world of discovery, exploration, and adventure that's been upgraded with performance enhancements in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition! With improved framerates, faster load times, and enhanced resolution and textures, this thrilling open-air adventure has never looked better!

The wilds of Hyrule make for a puzzling game of survival. Climb cliffs to scope out a destination; then cross great distances with the Paraglider or the horses you've tamed. You'll discover items for crafting, beasts to hunt, and plants to forage. Scavenge weapons and armor...or claim them from enemies! From hammers to helmets, items have specific stats, resistances, effects, and levels of durability. Use everything at your disposal to find and conquer more than 100 shrines. Luckily, the in-game Sheikah Slate can project Runes that manipulate objects and enemies in clever ways.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description:
In this sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, you’ll decide your own path through the sprawling landscapes of Hyrule and the mysterious islands floating in the vast skies above. Can you harness the power of Link’s new abilities to fight back against the malevolent forces that threaten the kingdom?

Now with 240 additional voice memories in the Zelda Notes mobile app, you can experience the game with additional lore!

title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
description: In Star-Crossed World, a new story included in the upgrade pack, Kirby must use his abilities, including the all-new Mouthful Modes, to clear a trail through uncharted territory. The upgrade pack will include this new content which can be played in single-player and local co-op, as well as improved performance for the entire game.

title: Drag x Drive
description: Drag x Drive (pronounced “Drag and Drive”) challenges players to use the mouse controls with both Joy-Con 2 at the same time to intuitively steer, speed up, perform tricks and make plays such as dunks.

title: Kutar's Typing World
description: Kutar’s Typing World is a PC typing game by MediaKite, set on Techno Island and designed to teach typing through playful mini-games starring the mascot Kutar. It features themed stages like dancing, food battles, and dating missions, along with festival-style events such as goldfish scooping. Players improve typing skills while collecting items and enjoying lighthearted gameplay.

title: Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition
description: This edition of the game includes the original game “Elden Ring” , the expansion “Shadow of the Erdtree”, a new armor and horse appearance customization features.

title: Street Fighter 6: Years 1-2 - Fighters Edition
description:
It’s time to hit the streets! With tons of single player and multiplayer content, Street Fighter 6 Years 1-2 Fighters Edition is the ideal way to play the next evolution of the series.

Content

・Full Game

・Year 1 Character Pass
4 additional characters (Rashid, A.K.I., Ed, Akuma)
4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10
Bonus: 4,200 Drive Tickets

・Year 2 Character Pass
4 additional characters (M. Bison, Terry, Mai, Elena)
4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10
Bonus: 4,200 Drive Tickets

・Years 1-2 Fighters Edition Stages & Colors
4 additional stages (Ruined Lab, Enma's Hollow, Pao Pao Cafe 6, Reniala Remains)
18 launch characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10

title: Hitman World of Assassination: Signature Edition
description:
This greatest hits collection of the HITMAN series was previously available on Nintendo Switch systems via cloud streaming, but the Nintendo Switch 2 version will run natively on the console, allowing players to experience Agent 47’s globe-trotting adventures seamlessly offline and on the go.

HITMAN World of Assassination - Signature Edition includes the main campaign, Contracts mode, Escalation, Elusive Target arcades, featured live content, Freelancer game mode, plus all HITMAN 2 Expansion Pack & HITMAN 3 Deluxe Pack content.

title: Bravely Default: Flying Fairy - HD Remaster
description:
Bravely Default, the first title in the Bravely series, remastered in high definition for a single screen. Discover the origins of the classic Brave and Default battle system alongside new and enhanced features. The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn!

This version includes two new minigames: Luxencheer Rhythm Catch and Ringabel’s Panic Cruise.

title: Yakuza 0: Director's Cut
description:
Yakuza 0: Director's Cut is the definitive edition of the critically acclaimed prequel to the Yakuza series.

Director's Cut content gives deeper insight into key incidents and character backstories with never-before-seen cutscenes and enhanced features like English and Chinese voiceovers, and multi-language text support. Plus, the Red Light Raid online multiplayer mode lets you join forces with friends and choose from 60 playable characters to take down hordes of enemies.

title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
description:
Fight the war for ancient Hyrule! Step on to the battlefield as Princess Zelda, King Rauru, and other legendary heroes as you fight to reclaim your homeland— and live the story of Demon King Ganondorf's invasion that was only briefly alluded to in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom game.

Princess Zelda is not alone in this war! Join Mineru, the Sages, and even some brand-new heroes in battles against Ganondorf's forces. Combine powerful Zonai Devices with your heroes' signature abilities to take down powerful bosses and their legions of minions.

title: Survival Kids
description:
Welcome to Survival Kids, a survival adventure game available exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2!

Picture this: A dusty old attic, cobwebs, forgotten boxes and the faint smell of neglect. Four curious kids stumble upon an ancient, tattered map, sparking an unexpected adventure…

Setting out to sea upon their ramshackle boat, a sudden, ferocious storm hurls them into a hidden world brimming with danger and mystery. Now it’s down to you to help them work together and find their way home in Survival Kids - a fast-paced, co-op survival game for absolutely everyone!

Stranded on a series of unique islands, set upon the back of giant Whurtles, work together with up to 4 players in local or online co-op to explore, chop, craft, fish, cook and solve your way to safety - all whilst surviving everything the islands throw at you!

Master the island's challenges, use the Harmony Stones to tame the storm and make it back home with an epic story to tell!

title: Enter the Gungeon 2
description: Enter the Gungeon 2 is a reloaded, high-caliber sequel to the iconic bullet hell dungeon crawler, reinforced with a new 3D art style, new weapons and enemies, and new gameplay tricks.

title: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions
description: STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet- wide objectives across a multitude of star systems using cutting edge technology.

title: Wild Hearts S
description:
The maximum number of players for both online and local play has been increased from 3 to 4 players.

The update of additional beasts and modes in “WILD HEARTS” is included from the start.

This does not include additional weapons, Karakuri, or beasts. HDR is not supported.

Balance Adjustments.

title: Puyo Puyo Tetris 2S
description: The Ultimate Puzzle Match, now Enhanced

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening - Complete Edition
description: A complete edition of the game with various add-on content and new scenarios.

title: Fast Fusion
description:
The fastest racing game you may have ever experienced! Non stop adrenaline pumping action at 60 fps in up to 4K HDR.

FAST Fusion vehicles are equipped with antigravity hyper jump technology. Cut corners and get ahead of your oppenents by jumping and boosting over them.

Create hundreds of new Racing machines by fusing your favorite vehicles.

Zoom through Redwood Forest, Alpine peaks, futuristic cities and many more breathtaking landscapes.

Play with smooth motion controls, enjoy immersive HD Rumble and customize the buttons.

title: Love and Fear
description: Visual novel with a detective plot. Summer break is a time of adventure and love! However, Hikari does not yet know that the maniac has already gone hunting!

title: D.N.A: Do Not Answer
description: D.N.A is a short first-person, story-driven horror game developed by a small independent studio. Players navigate an eerie, abandoned hospital, uncover clues, manage limited light sources, and face a dark presence. Featuring multiple endings, realistic graphics, and immersive sound design.

title: Phantasist
description: Phantasist是一款體驗社恐生活的遊戲！

title: Arcade Archives 2: Ridge Racer
description:
A port of Ridge Racer, a racing game released by Bandai in 1993. It was originally released in arcades for the Namco System 22 hardware.

The game has four modes to choose from, including three difficulty levels – Novice, Intermediate, and Advanced - as well as T. T. (Time Trial), where players compete one-on-one against a rival car to achieve the best time.

Additionally, a DX version featuring support for an H-shifter and clutch is also included.

title: Haifa
description: Haifa is a hidden object puzzle experience that tells a story about the emotional struggles of trying to maintain hopefulness in times of war. Help your characters keep their head up by finding small objects in their environment to lift their spirits, as they look for their lost friend.

title: Duel Hell Purgatory
description: One weapon. One character. One hit - one kill. Equal conditions for everyone. At any time. Find and eliminate your enemy without getting hit in a tactical and atmospherically dense PVP experience with a slow pace. The only thing that makes the difference in DHP is you.

title: Idle Run Aya
description: Run, run, run! A ambient game, which runs almost by itself and requires only little input. You can enjoy the atmosphere or simply relax and watch Aya's hypnotically wiggling breasts bouncing up and down. Start running now and join Aya on her journey.

title: Lunaria Fantasia
description: Lunaria, a court mage of the kingdom of Sagittaries, is sent to investigate ancient ruins with her comrades. But the seemingly simple mission goes terribly wrong. The ruins are full of monsters, and a mysterious figure appears and robs Lunaria and her allies of their mana, the source of their magic.

title: Tri Survive
description: Action Roguelite that blends elements of Vampire Survivors with Fantasy RPG themes. Introduces a unique mechanic where the player controls a party of three heroes instead of one, offering a fresh strategic gameplay experience. Featuring RPG-inspired hand-drawn art style and an intriguing storyline.

title: The Duskbloods
description: An online multiplayer PvPvE game where players vie for supremacy among themselves and against challenging foes. Play as the "Bloodsworn"; a group that has transcended human strength thanks to their special blood, and throw yourself into a violent fray for "First Blood" as the twilight of humanity approaches. The moontears will flow for one and one alone.

title: Kirby Air Riders
description:
Kirby Air Riders is the long-awaited sequel to Kirby Air Ride on the Gamecube.

Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash!

title: Donkey Kong Bananza
description: Donkey Kong Bananza is exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2! Explore a vast underground world—by smashing your way through it! Bash, throw, and climb through just about anything in DK’s brand-new 3D platforming action-adventure game!

title: Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek
description:
"It's time to take on those monsters!"
Can you escape? Or will you hunt humans as a monster?

title: Overvåkerne
description:
This is an old-school comedy/satire point-and-click game set in a fictional office environment. You play as Henriksen, an ordinary office worker who realizes he has been mistreated by his colleagues and sets out on a quest for revenge.
Everyone speaks Norwegian!

title: The Longest Tale
description: Uncover a forgotten legend as you venture through mythical realms. Play as four heroes bound by a mysterious fate. Explore ancient ruins, outsmart deadly foes and solve arcane puzzles. Each path you take reveals a piece of The Longest Tale.

title: Tamagotchi Plaza: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description:
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Tamagotchi Plaza adds three exclusive shops that can be played with mouse controls.

Become a shopkeeper in Tamahiko Town. Engage with more than 100 Tamagotchi as they open, customize and grow more than a dozen different shops and improve your reputation with them in town.

title: Shear Abnormality
description:
This is a short psychological horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill games.

You must shear all abnormalities in a level while running from any threats in order to progress. Make sure to keep an eye out for key items.

The length of this game is about 30 minutes. There are checkpoints throughout the game for if you die.

title: Flail Your Arm, Hit the Ball: Return of Kusogaki
description:
A new form of suffering awaits. Imagine playing a home run derby…
But with the same infuriatingly precise controls as a certain game where a man in a pot climbs mountains using only a hammer. Yes, that one.
Now swing for the fences—if you can.

title: Some Bullshit
description:
Have you ever wanted to escort a ditzy, hungry girl across the world? Well, now you can with:

Some Bullshit

title: Yet Another One
description: Explore vast canyons and treacherous caves where the power of ancient runes is your only weapon. Draw runes to solve puzzles, summon magic, and avoid dangerous creatures, if you can — all while navigating dark, mysterious landscapes. Also, why is the rabbit swearing at me?

title: Frisson DT
description:
Frisson DT is a single-player, psychological horror game. You play a real-life paranormal investigator / live-streamer. You (and your colleagues) will visit various spooky locations to investigate reports of paranormal activity and figure out whether the reports are legitimate or a hoax. Once that's out of the way, you can identify the cause of the paranormal activity and help to remove it, all whilst trying to keep your viewers engaged and grow your online presence. Oh, and try not to die!

Research new technologies to help locate, identify, pacify and remove Paranormal entities.

Collect cards and grow your collection.

Lean new ways to protect yourself from the imminent danger that comes from meddling with the supernatural.

Buy new equipment to help improve the quality of your live streams and make them more engaging.

Upgrade your player HQ by adding new furniture, or upgrading existing stuff.

Soil yourself with the most intense horror experience

Witness paranormal events to make your stream more exciting for viewers

Grow your online presence to make more money and beat the competition.

title: Mindshadow
description: The Mac port provides and interface compared to text driven input.

title: Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul
description:
Teeth gnash, grinding and gorging until nothing is left. A black and scarlet eye blazes above a grotesque grin. The screams turn to gurgles as they plead for mercy that will never come.

Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul, features new Killer, The Ghoul, a chilling reimagining of Ken Kaneki.

title: Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul Edition
description: Check out Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul Edition, which includes the base game, the Tokyo Ghoul Chapter, and 2 Tokyo Ghoul Outfits: The Ghoul Within for The Ghoul, and Touka’s Struggle for Yui Kimura. Also included are the Maddening Darkness Pack, and the Cursed Legacy Chapter

title: Tiny Auto Knights
description: An asynchronous PvP Auto Battler where you have to recruit and upgrade heroes and place them strategically on the battlefield to compete against other players.

title: Akuma No Akumu: Ar Eq-Kua Er Seta
description:
a game with no focus, only dreams and ideas. a mashup of pre-existing visual assets, new musical work, and nearly anything i want to prototype and play with. the lack of theme is the strongest theme of all.

a lightly and abstractly story-driven single player STG-platformer hybrid focusing on weird scoring systems, inconsistent and cryptic rules for those scoring systems, and difficulty that will only push you as hard as you push it - except the boss encounters. they always push, and if you don't put in the effort leading up to them, you won't get far.

title: Acrolyte
description: Acrolyte is a 2D action-adventure platformer which brings the player through vast, mysterious alien landscapes. Awaken from your dying rest in an endless pursuit of revenge against ancient forces beyond your own comprehension.

title: Veil of Sanity
description: Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival (Chapter 1) combines psychological horror with intense gameplay. Keep your sanity intact as you explore a forsaken carnival. More chapters coming soon!

title: Dash-Da-Dash DX2: Devil Destroyer
description:
this game was originally designed with vertically-oriented touchscreen devices in mind. not necessarily phones specifically, but also larger touchscreen displays. over the course of working on it, a second control type was added which expands on the first - one where opposed to clicking to dash, the ship always follows the player's mouse/finger. this one proved to be really fun and twitchy.

eventually, i decided to also add a keyboard-based one more in line with regular shmups. in this one, the player fires automatically, but is required to "mine" the crystals by hitting the boss, and your crystal combo is directly linked to how powerful your fire is. it's a little weird, admittedly, but this whole thing was kind of an experiment.

Squeedge helped out by designing and realizing three awesome characters and a bunch of super cool boss designs, a little inspired by some of the pixel work Joker Jun did for Toaplan.

title: Control Yourself
description: Control Yourself is a single-player 3d puzzle platformer set aboard a recently returned but seemingly derelict old space craft.

title: Day 178
description:
It has been 178 days since we have been forced to confine ourselves to our homes.
I am beginning to lose track of time, seemingly trapped in an endless loop of passing days. The state has yet to release an explanation of the situation, its only public statement the mandate to remain in our homes. Fortunately, all houses are equipped with a pneumatic transport system that allows the sending and receiving of food and other necessities. The problem, as usual, is money. Only those who work remotely are still able to receive a salary. I'm not one of them. The only way that I can make a living is by selling drugs.

title: Five Nights At Freddy's Pixel Edition
description: Welcome to the FNAF Pixel Edition horror page! Get ready for a terrifying experience in the world of Five Nights at Freddy's.

title: Peek
description: Peek is an audio-driven horror puzzle game where you track the spirit using spatial sound and deduction. In this ritual-based survival experience, a restless presence stalks the room in tense rounds, leaving audio clues on specific, chosen squares as she walks around you. Close your eyes, listen carefully, and track the direction, distance, and nature of each sound to piece together the ritual and end her pain in this game of audio-pattern deduction.

title: Haunted House of Rock
description:
The young members of Pupula Duplex, a hungry new punk band from the Portland area, gets far more than they bargained for when their weekend lodging in a 140-year-old house quickly leads them somewhere out of time haunted by a desperate and dreaming intelligence.

Wandering long hallways stocked with strange clocks that never display the same time twice, the musicians must cooperate to uncover the truth of this strange house and its former residents to escape — all while getting themselves ready for their upcoming gig!

title: Connection Pools
description:
300s... 299s... 298s...

Waiting for connection...

title: Guilty Gear Xrd: Rev 2 - Character Colors: Baiken
description: This DLC will add five more Baiken character color palettes to the game 'Guilty Gear Xrd REV 2.'

title: Guilty Gear Xrd: Rev 2 - Character Colors: Bedman
description: This DLC will add five more Bedman character color palettes to the game 'Guilty Gear Xrd REV 2.'

title: Arctic Wolves
description: Arctic Wolves is an open-world action game that blends the charm of wolves with high-energy combat scenarios. Customize characters and homes for a fully personalized experience, giving you ultimate freedom to shape your adventure.

title: Are You Happy
description: Short psychological horror experience

title: Arkadia
description: Explore Arkadia. Confront the evil beings, uncover their schemes, and fight for justice. Strategize and strengthen your characters to achieve victory.

title: Ark Nova
description: Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.

title: Ars Goetia
description: In ArsGoetia, a thrilling platformer, you must navigate through treacherous traps and perilous landscapes to rescue kidnapped children and escape a dark, mysterious realm. Can you overcome the dangers and save them all?

title: A Safe Place
description: Welcome to the Official Steam page for the game A Safe Place, a game where a strange, pink-haired boy takes a stroll around his hometown, only to find a strange purple liquid is infecting its residents.

title: A Sexy Tour With: Fiona
description: Embark on a titillating journey through Italy with Fiona, your alluring tour guide. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye while rewarding your success with seductive reveals.

title: A Shade Darker Than Gray
description: Short dark comady, casual story game about 15 minutes in length for a play through. There're 6 different endings and 8 collectibles, and 3 different mini games. Over 100+ funny quotes to find throughout and loads of side events to interact with.

title: Astro Arena
description: Astro Arena is a fast-paced, team-based space battleground where Rock, Paper, and Scissors clash. Choose your character, gather resources, and earn points to unlock powerful abilities like invisibility and speed. Outsmart your opponents and lead your team to victory!

title: A Summer in Our Hearts
description: A slice of life VN about three very different young adults, from very different backgrounds, trying to put their best foot forward and find their own ways in life. Will a short summer, away in a foreign town in the middle of nowhere, enough to push your way towards happiness?

title: Axios Football
description: Become the manager of a professional soccer team and lead it to the championship! Show patience and high skills to make your team legendary!

title: Babel Defense
description: A 3D real-time strategy tower defence based on the Tower of Babel. Organise your army of angels as waves of humans appear. Unlock upgrades and prosper to stop the human advance. Use your omnipresent powers to help you in your mission.

title: ASZG Project: Director's Cut
description: ASZG is a psychological horror experience, where you must survive against creatures generated by the harmful DK-19 virus. Explore and survive in a completely devastated apocalyptic environment. The Director's Cut is an atypical version of the original game, a peculiar and highly contested edit.

title: ATC Flight Operator
description: ATC Flight Operator is an air traffic control simulation engine with a powerful interface that gives users complete control of their airspace. Are you capable of taking control of an iconic airport while preventing mid-air collisions, and still directing airplanes to land as quickly as possible?

title: At Daggers Drawn
description: In an open world where the siblings are in bitter enmity, avenge your creator with an arsenal that is anything but ordinary.

title: A Thousand Mouths to Scream
description: Psychological Body Horror visual novel in a space setting with different endings depending on your actions.

title: Eggplant
description: Eggplant is a simple clicker game where you can relax, click on eggplants, and receive plenty of amazing rewards. Receive Eggplant drops and grow your collection!

title: A Very Merry Nightmare
description: A First-Person 3D Christmas Thriller Game

title: Avoidy Virus
description: Survive lockdown with 4-16 players in this viral co-op game of tag. Avoid the virus, grab vaccines, and save your fellow humans. But beware - get sick and you'll join the viral invasion!

title: Super Smash Bros Ultimate: Rabbids Hat
description:
A Mii Fighter hat based on the unpredictable Rabbids characters is now available for purchase! Their big mouth, goofy front teeth and large eyes make them charming. Wear this and go crazy. You'll really feel like Rabbids!

Includes:
Mii Fighter Costume
・Rabbids Hat

title: Back 4 More
description: Third person strategy survival game, teams Compete through turn-based rounds to gain the most influence over the desert!

title: Backrooms: Found Footage
description: Backrooms: Found Footage is a single-player horror game where you are the main character trying to survive the Backrooms. Curiosity wins and you decide to explore this weird place that you got trapped in. What could go wrong?

title: Bakery Shop Match Up
description: Step into the whimsical world of Bakery Shop Match Up! Your task is to find and match items that belong together in this charming bakery-themed puzzle game.

title: Cats Bounce Ball
description: A malfunctioning pinball machine has unexpectedly attracted a bunch of cats! Come and explore the mystery while challenging higher scores with the company of 100 cats!

title: Banana 3D
description: In this game you click to earn skins to trade with and to collect. You receive a drop every 30 minutes, up to 4 a day. There is a short collection of developer-created skins, with an in-game workshop up-loader for the community to create their own skins for the Steam market.

title: Smile Town
description: Pay off your debts by working part-time in the nightlife district of Smile Town! Buy items from your friend Apple Ginger's shop to get an advantage at your part-time job.

title: Banana Girls
description: Banana meets girls. Banan-ify your girls by clicking on them. Make her go bananas. And sometimes (every 3 hours) you get a 100% certified banana girl to claim as your own. Grow your banana girl fruity harem!

title: Banana Massacre
description: In this goofy horror shooter, you play as a cop who has received a 911 call from banana people claiming that they need to be rescued out of a slaughter house that is being run by pigs. It is your duty to free the bananas from slaughter and to eliminate any pigs that stand in your way.

title: Bark Tank
description: This game is a multiplayer online tank shooting game. The game has a team battle mode. Players eliminate enemy tanks through cooperation and flexible positioning. Only the side that survives in the midst of gunfire and kills all enemy players' tanks will win.

title: Bask: The Alchemist Frog
description: Once human, now frog. Begin this unexpected journey into the land of the unknown in-search of a cure for your froggy state. Explore the world around you while helping others in need as you find new ingredients and potions to help you on your path.

title: Bat Tap
description: Bat Tap is a game in which you click on the bat and get points for each click. Accumulated points allow you to get a random bat in your inventory. However, the points themselves cannot be spent on anything else. You can get full information on our discord server.
