title: Battle Bloodlines
description: Battle Bloodlines lets you selectively breed unique creatures for their stats and skills. Create the strongest fighting team, then fight in asynchronous multiplayer. Discover new creature forms and abilities.

title: Beamdown
description: Beamdown is a 3D top-down hack&slash action game featuring fast combat, upgrades, and difficult big bosses. Explore the different planet environments, take down large bosses, upgrade your character, and repeat.

title: Bean Battle Brawl
description: A simple, early beta 3D multiplayer fps!

title: Beast Brawl
description: Beast Brawl is a unique rougelike which pits teams of primal beasts against one another in a battle for survival. Thousands of combos and strategies to try and evolve your team into the apex beasts of the kingdom.

title: Beastly Bites
description: A fast-paced action-adventure where a cursed woman wields an oversized chopstick to battle food-themed monsters. Progressing through surreal realms, will she be able defeat the Food God who's behind her curse and reclaim her humanity?

title: Beats&Boss
description: Beats&Boss is a BossRush style rhythm game. Follow the Beats and defeat the Boss! Ues powerful AOE skills to clear the field! Continuously kill and enter COMBO state，maintain the state without interruption！

title: Swingin' Beats
description: "Swingin' Beats" is a rhythm game that tests your timing and precision across various difficulty levels, offering both solo and multiplayer modes for up to four players.

title: Heartbeats
description: Would you survive a panic attack? Test your limits in this anxiety-inducing twin-stick shooter, blasting away intrusive thoughts using your Inner weapon.

title: Beautiful Checkers
description: Play checkers, feel its beauty. Play in wonderful artist-designed environments whether indoors or outdoors. Whether you are an adult, a retiree, or a child, you can enjoy an immersive visual experience of the game of checkers where difficulty does not matter.

title: Bedtime Story: Saint
description: A writer obsessed with words, a voice in their mind like that of a god, and a strange story unfolding in the depths of winter. Between a cup of coffee and a cigarette, you are the deity that intervenes in the course of the story, guiding the writer to complete the narrative and its ending...

title: The Great Coffee Caper
description: A cute and cozy RPG where it's up to Detective Hootsworth to figure out who stole the town's coffee beans. Uncover clues in fast-paced clue battles, question the charming townsfolk, and figure out hoooo dunnit!

title: Mountain 78
description: Mountain 78 is a frustrating game about climbing a mountain. With only three jumps at a time, every move counts. One mistake can send you tumbling down. Will you reach the top?

title: Holy Beast Online
description: A cartoony MMO that has been shut down. Players were from one of six animal clans, able to use either an animal or human form and choose from three clan-specific classes. It was mostly based on oriental fantasy, with races such as Dog, Monkey, and Dragon.

title: Yooperlite
description: Uncover the secrets of a corrupted land in a unique platforming journey with Yooperlite. Facing exploration and adventure challenges, while you walk, jump, slide and collect the fireflies to purify this world. Save what's been lost and break free from the darkness. Do you have what it takes to restore the light?

title: Sucker head: Bodycam
description: A co-op horror game. In it, players take on the role of a group of people who are trapped, full of dangers and horrors. The goal of the game is to get out by solving puzzles, avoiding traps and fighting monsters.

title: Spring Gothic
description:
After months of flirting and sexting, Nica and Chun are finally meeting up for the first time in London. Nica is a up-and-coming trans retro game streamer, and Chun is a med student who is having cold feet over her workload. They have confided their deepest secrets to each other online, but can they understand each other offline?

Spring Gothic is an unsentimental take on long distance relationships and whether physical love can bloom in a fragmented society connected by a corporatizing internet infrastructure.

title: Tekken 8: Season 2 - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Season 2 Ultimate Edition includes:
• TEKKEN 8
• 8 Additional playable characters
- Eddy
- Lidia
- Heihachi
- Clive
- Anna
- and more
• 4 Additional battle stages
- GENMAJI TEMPLE
- PHOENIX GATE
- and more
• 3-day Early Access for future DLC
• Character Costume: Gold Suit Pack
• Avatar Costume: Classic TEKKEN T-Shirt Set
• 4 Avatar Skins

TEKKEN 8 is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games.

title: Tekken 8: Season 2 - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Season 2 Deluxe Edition includes:
• TEKKEN 8
• 8 Additional playable characters
- Eddy
- Lidia
- Heihachi
- Clive
- Anna
- and more
• 3-day Early Access for future DLC

TEKKEN 8 is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games.

title: Ninja Escape Danger
description: Help the little ninja overcome all the traps and escape the dark dungeon!

title: America Against Ants
description: The year, 1951, the place, Nevada, USA. Take command of Task Force Sable and battle through 30 increasingly challenging missions to defeat giant, mutant ants as they swarm from atomic test sites in the desert. AAA features a unique, narrative driven blend of tower defence and real time tactics.

title: Beer and Rush: Non-VR Edition
description: Experience the hilarious 360º platformer, 'Beer and Rush: Non-VR Edition', where you must find a bathroom in a dream world after having a few beers. Based on a personal experience, this short game is a platformer packed with humor, great music, and challenges.

title: Beer Runner: Yasuke A Samurai
description: Free yourself from slavery, deliver the last keg of beer to your boss, and gain your freedom. The Cosmetic DLC contains the skin of the legendary samurai Yasuke.

title: Be Fly
description: Be Fly — a meditative 2D game where you control a plane to help the main character win competitions. Navigate around obstacles, catch tailwinds, and perform aerial tricks to soothing music.

title: Besert Bydra
description: An exciting spin game where players collect gun skins of different rarities. Spin to get random skins, from common gray to ultra-rare red. Track your collection in real-time and test your luck as you aim to collect all skins and find the rarest ones!

title: Beyond Stories: Jester
description: Can you break free from the trap set by the strange Jester, who is always laughing? Dive into very dark story, adventure awaits. A mix of dark story and a puzzle, where all the pictures support the atmosphere of the story.

title: Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a tribute to one of the earliest roguelikes, Moria. Your journey begins with creating your character by choosing a class. From there, you'll explore six procedurally generated levels before reaching the goal of your quest and making your escape!

title: Beyond the Marion
description: A 3D First Person walking simulator and puzzle game. You will interact with your alien crewmates and repair your spaceship in order to escape a time loop. Explore space in a ship straight from the 70’s, and meet your companions - brought to life with a funky claymated style!

title: Bibbidiba Fan Game
description: Bibbidiba fan game is a vibrant and fast-paced platformer inspired by Hoshimachi Suisei's hit song "Bibbidiba". Players must guide Hoshimachi Suisei through magical and challenging levels to reach the final destination and find out what awaits her at the end.

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 9 - Collector's Edition
description:
Take an amazing trip through some of Europe's most inspiring locations, including ancient castles, culture centers, charming villages, and more!

Get the most out of every stop along the way by finding dozens of hidden objects and solving clever mini-games on an incredible vacation packed with fun and adventure!
This hidden object game is full of new and popular tourist spots.

Use your skills and knowledge to play mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- Ten additional locations to explore!
- Find even more objects, but keep your eye out for a funny raccoon friend!
- Eight bonus mini-games and twelve more challenging puzzles!

title: Big Cat Jigsaw Quest
description: Embark on a majestic adventure into the wild with "Big Cat Jigsaw Quest"—a thrilling puzzle game that immerses you in the untamed beauty of lions and tigers. Piece by piece, bring to life breathtaking scenes of roaring kings of the savanna and stealthy prowlers of the jungle.

title: Bipt
description: BIPT is a single player time attack game with multiple endings. Figure out what to collect, and go for the best time! Bipt can slide, super jump, and teleport. Combine these tools and find the fastest path to the finish.

title: Bird Bump
description: Don't bump into the ledge

title: Birdcage
description:
BIRDCAGE is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shoot’em up inspired by genre classics, blending gritty pixel art sprites with 2.5D backdrops and a pumping retro soundtrack! Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem, facing off against enemy swarms using multiple shot types and rechargeable specials.

Chase high scores by maintaining chains and kill rate. Strategically activate Hyperblade mode in tense situations, and take down screen-filling bosses! Can you break free of your cage and redeem humanity?

title: Bits at Work
description: Build the perfect workplace in this tiny office management sim and keep the lines going up and up and up!

title: Black Market
description: Black Market is an item shop simulator where you are a shopkeeper that pawns items and strikes deals with your villainous customers in order to make rent. It's a cutthroat world out there.

title: Blackout: Director's Cut
description: Upon abandoning your previous life, you find your past has finally caught up to you. Your world has gone dark, and you aren't alone. You must use your eyes to navigate through the dark and uncover the truth of the Meyer City Prison. You can't escape your inner demons. Your end is near.

title: Blend_IT
description: Blend_It gives players a simple black-and-white image. The image has a value of 1 for white and 0 for black. These color values are combined through three operators: multiplication, addition, and subtraction Make it a more complex image!

title: Block Dude Deluxe
description: Your primary goal is to reach the exit door in each level. stack blocks strategically, creating pathways and staircases that allow you to traverse the environment. Each level presents a unique puzzle, requiring careful planning and precise execution

title: Blockhead
description: Blockhead is lost. Can you help Blockhead find his way home? Move through 50 challenging levels by getting tokens, avoiding the bullies and getting help from the characters around you. Use keyboard and X Box controller to move and jump through this 2D platform game.

title: Block Mover Challenge
description: Block Mover Challenge offers a captivating puzzle experience with minimalist graphics and subtle sound effects. Use the white block to push others into the door and complete each level. Navigate obstacles and increasing complexities. Test your problem-solving skills with engaging gameplay.

title: Block Twist Challenge
description: Dive into a captivating puzzle game where your goal is to clear the grid by strategically placing blocks. Arrange the pieces on the board to form complete rows or columns, which will instantly clear, opening up more space for your next move.

title: BlockUrbs
description: BlockUrbs is a small city builder game where you can place a variety of structures and roads on tiles to create tiny, detailed and beautiful city sections without worrying about any goals or scores.

title: Cursed Bloodline
description: A psychological horror where you uncover the dark secret of a cursed bloodline. Echoes of the past and horrifying realities guide you through the abandoned house. But beware—you’re not the only one searching for answers.

title: Wasted Bloodline
description: Wasted Bloodline is a first-person shooter with stunning graphics, singleplayer botmatch mode, online multiplayer, and cooperative play, featuring long-term support.

title: Blood Rising
description: This is a roguelike game with card battles as its core. Players need to play as a vampire ancestor to resist the attacks of a large number of adventurers and defeat three great heroes to achieve ultimate victory.

title: Blood X Thirsty
description: Serve drinks, enhance your brew, and fight off unruly customers in this fast-paced bartending sim!

title: Tennis Manager 25
description:
Dive into the most advanced tennis management experience to date. Manage your academy, develop your staff and facilities, recruit the best players from the men's and women's circuits, both junior and pro, and lead them to the top!
Forge the champions of tomorrow. The future of tennis is in your hands.

title: Crypto Rush
description: This game is a parody created under the influence of the hype of crypto airdrops in clickers. Click on a coin to mine coins, sell coins for other coins, buy video cards to automate mining. Buy chests for mined coins to try to get new types of coins or get it on market or by exchanging with friends.

title: Tower O-ven
description: Tower O-ven is a simple platformer. Whether chicken escapes from tower of oven or not depends on you (and your luck).

title: Going Dark
description: Going Dark is a Stealth Infiltration Game fully coated in the Green Shades of Night Vision.

title: Happy Girls
description: Experience a calming puzzle game that will bring joy and keep you feeling upbeat.

title: Light De Deux
description: Ballet is a lot like love: in both, the partners' connection is all about trust. But will this bond be strong enough to keep two burning hearts together?

title: Arc Tracker
description: Guide A.T. to the target, moving only in circular orbits. With various play modes and levels, it has challenges ranging from brain-teasing puzzles to challenging controls, and sometimes just simple fun. Easy to learn but hard to master, How about trying for a perfect clear for all levels?

title: Sunset High
description: A mystery is afoot, a person has gone missing at Sunset High. Worst yet, they texted you last night. Even worse, you are stuck in a time loop. Hop in this narrative-driven, 2D, choose-your-own adventure game as you rewind and fast-forward through the dilemmas of being a high school student.

title: Spaceship Tactics
description: Spaceship Tactics is a sci-fi strategy autobattler. Build a mighty fleet, improve spaceships with powerful upgrades and find ways to fuse spaceships together. Decide battles by cleverly arranging your fleet!

title: Space Kitten: An Easy Survival Game
description: A space survival, procedurally generated crafting game focused on resource management and farming. Explore, gather, and mine for resources to survive the increasingly harsh environment. Sustain and build your farm until your rescue team arrives.

title: There Was Something In That Room
description: Move through the rooms of the lab in this short but replayable horror game. Debug the computers in each room, watch out for errors, and fix sabotages. Make sure you always know where you are... and where other things are.

title: Cheerleader's Choice: New York Spirit
description: A text-based adventure into the world of cheerleading!

title: Pigeon West: Johnny the Pigeon
description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the cruel and ruthless world of the Wild West, where no one can afford to click their beak. The brave hero of our story is Johnny the Pigeon.

The little nest where Johnny lived was once famous for its steadfast justice and laws. But someone appeared who decided to question the peaceful life of our young hero Johnny the Pigeon.

Can Johnny the Pigeon fight back? Will he have to leave his hometown forever?

title: Heat Index
description: Heat Index is a top down shooter where you must push through against insurmountable odds to reach the end. Create unique builds using tons of powerful items as you run and gun your way to becoming an unstoppable force.

title: Pyhare
description: In Pyhare, lead a village besieged by corrupted monsters. By day, gather resources and upgrade defenses. At night, face intense battles. Build a relic to contain the evil and save your village. Can you survive and complete your mission?

title: Number Stomper
description: Number Stomper is a minimalistic puzzle game where you move in one of 4 directions to step on numbers, reducing their value by 1. Clear every number on the grid to complete a level. Explore the different tile types and challenge yourself with 100 levels!

title: Courage: ZaGame
description: Courage: ZaGame is a thrilling 3D adventure where you must craft an elixir to stop a world-threatening monster. Explore eerie environments, solve puzzles, and make critical choices that shape the outcome.

title: Mythical Ruins
description: Discover a mysterious world without annoying quests in "Mythical Ruins". Fight a variety of enemies, explore different biomes and level up your skills in this epic Soulslike adventure. Venture into the hardcore area for the ultimate challenge!

title: Dinosaur Cousin Squad
description: A cozy lil' prehistoric platformer where you help five dinosaurs escape an apocalyptic disaster through five biomes.

title: Fathoms
description: Gather your crew and set off through hostile waters in this terrifying co-op survival game for up to 4 players. Scavenge for fuel, gear, and scrap while nameless horrors rise from beneath the waves to deny your escape.

title: Rax Runner!
description: An endless runner featuring the infamous 43 of Akron

title: FactoryCapi
description: FactoryCapi is a factory game where you manage and optimize a factory. It stands out by emphasizing multiplayer interaction and offline progression. You can sell to anyone any item produced, or bought what you don't want to produce. Your factory is running when you are offline.

title: Compu-Tron x3000
description: Compu-Tron x3000 presents an alternate history and a short narrative mystery to be uncovered. Presented as a re-creation of a 1982 digital and educational assistant, delve into the records to uncover the mystery behind C. Tech Industries and Compu-Tron x3000.

title: Superfighters of Survival
description: The gods are bored, and you are their entertainment. With fierce champions, fantastic weapons, and a dynamic arena that constantly challenges you, this game promises co-op action, humor, and plenty of fun. Do you have what it takes to be the champion of Superfighters of Survival?

title: Survivors Of The Zombie World
description: Survivors Of The Zombie World is a 3D pixel-style zombie survival game. Survivors fight in a world full of zombies. Your goal is to survive, find food, ammunition, medicine and other supplies on the map and try to survive.

title: Kappa Quest
description: A fast-paced, retro-inspired adventure through ancient Japan!

title: Dwarf Legacy
description: A challenging bullet-hell precision platformer. Climb up vertical dungeons of The Mountainhome, battling relentless swarms of enemies and navigating perilous traps. Uncover the secret of your lost legacy hidden atop the highest peak and secure the future of your village.

title: A Whisper in the Twilight: Chapter Two
description: A first-person story-driven game. A dark sci-fi adventure. Solve the riddles of an ancient moon and discover what your destiny will be.

title: Skateboard Knight
description: Hop on a skateboard and casually save the world! Simple controls—just move up or down the lanes. Horizontal movement and attacks are all auto!

title: The Photographer
description: A soon-to-be married couple take a vacation in Venice. As they arrive however, the weight of unspoken things starts to threaten their relationship.

title: Omnn
description: A tale of hubris in the far-flung future, inspired by that one Sci-Fi novel.

title: The Froglings
description: Grow your community of froglings by gathering resources, upgrading buildings and building cute homes to live in! As night falls, protect the colony from raiding robots using the hero and towers ready to defend your new home.

title: Pioneer Racing
description: Choose your car, customize it, and get ready for the race! In this game, you race against AIs with realistic cars and physics, to unlock better cars and beat your lap time! Drive, win and set the best chronos of all times with your favorite car! New functionnalities coming soon...

title: Temporal Gunslinger
description: An action game where you play as a supernatural gunslinger. You have the power to redirect bullets mid-flight and rewind time to take down multiple foes in the blink of an eye. Travel across different time periods and slay the Reaper's traitorous Heralds.

title: Hanarenga: Takumi no Utage
description: A puzzle game based on the motif of fireworks. The player character must explode and chain all the fireworks together to clear the game in this exhilarating puzzle game! Get back your friends who have been deprived of their energy by the evil doctor!

title: Pocket & Zooom
description: Pocket & Zooom is a puzzle game in which you give commands to aircraft to guide them to their destinations. Players can give only six kinds of commands. It's more difficult than it sounds. Create a strategy to get the aircraft to their destinations!

title: Zui's Witch Academy
description: A boss rush roguelike-styled action game. You build a deck of 3 magical cards to take down one of many bosses. Each boss has an arena specifically tailored to them. Can you help Rysa graduate from Zui's Witch Academy with flying colors?

title: Frog Bard
description: A short, poetic experience about finding inspiration in the world around you. Explore a simple forest and perform reflective ballads as you travel from inn to inn.

title: Hex Bots
description: A chaser horror game for 1-4 players. Pick up components that spawn around the world and insert them into computers to open up the exit. While you do this, there is a monster looking for you and chasing you if it comes close enough.

title: The Basement's Calling
description: Escape the basement, but something will try to stop you.

title: Witchy Business
description: Manage your very own Witchcraft Shop. This is a job simulator game where you brew potions for your customers, collect oddities, grow flowers in your garden, upgrade your alchemy station, and thrive.

title: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.
description: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, and the explosive power of chemistry. As a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter, you’ll craft potions for the resistance, engineer devastating bombs, and dismantle tyranny from the shadows.

title: Soul Brave
description: Soul Brave is a multiplayer action platform MMORPG with anime-style graphics.

title: Silkgrove
description: Become a Restorer in Silkgrove. Use your toolkit to scavenge resources, repair, and upgrade your mobile home. Travel across regions, help rebuild communities, and restore balance to the world.

title: Zulkania
description: Zulkania is a captivating role-playing game in which you explore a fantasy world filled with mysteries, legendary creatures, and epic quests. Take on the role of an adventurer and shape your destiny by developing your skills, battling powerful enemies, and uncovering the secrets of Zulkania. Your choices will influence the course of history in this ever-evolving universe. Prepare for adventure!

title: Drownlight
description: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.

title: Threads of Karma
description: Lin Yue'an embarks on a journey home, but unsettling events soon disrupt her ordinary life. Strange dreams, lost memories, and eerie occurrences lead her to uncover hidden truths. Can she trace everything back to its true origin and escape the net of fate that has already been woven around her?

title: For Her
description: For Her is a single-player, story-driven psychological horror game that delves into the depths of morality, sacrifice, and the human psyche. You play as David Hill, a dedicated police officer in Dismas City. A loving husband and father, David always puts his family first, no matter the cost.

title: House of Terror
description: Do you have what it takes to survive the House of Terror? Step inside… if you dare.

title: The Designer's Curse Chapter 2: Forgotten Horrors
description: An unmissable survival horror experience with satisfying physics, haunting ambience, and terrifying encounters. Can you escape the horrors of Shaw Well Manor?

title: Bring the Book Back
description: You wake up on the floor of a library, guilt-ridden for forgetting to return your borrowed book. Now, you find yourself trapped in an endless loop of bringing it back to ease your conscience, forced to check for anomalies to work off your debt.

title: Station Noctis
description: Find the damaged map in the waiting room of the station and arrive safely to the final station, Noctis Station. Please note that there are mannequins with bombs in each station!

title: Red Rogue Sea
description: Red Rogue Sea is a roguelike strategy game that puts you in the shoes of a pirate captain and their crew. Manage your vessel as you sail through the treacherous waters of the archipelago, interact with the scum that inhabit it, and engage in battle using a tactical deck-building system.

title: Relatos Silenciados: Visita Indesejada
description: Look for what you forgot, be very careful, you are not the only one in the building and there are signs of it, search, explore and interact in search of what you are looking for! Get ready to enter into mystery and unrest, something is not right and you need to find out why. PS2 style horror game.

title: Blood Accord
description: A horror visual novel exploring the dark sides of friendship and the dangerous paths taken to save it.

title: You Are a Failed Murderer
description: A visual novel passed through an image compressor Play as a murder unsure of his entire life, down to his name. But you have a mission. One you NEED to undertake.

title: Dread Chess
description: Philosophical story about God of Madness and a self-playing chess that can be played only once.

title: Dion
description: Dive into Dion, a multiplayer survival game that transports you to the heart of a brutal world inspired by the great West African empires. Here, only your ingenuity and strength will determine your fate.

title: Yandere Goth Boss: Valentine's Day
description: After and incident at your new workplace, Your big-breasted, sadistic, giant, goth yandere boss falls in love with you and becomes obsessed with you

title: Winner In Life
description: This is a free, casual item collection game. Every two minutes you will get a treasure chest. Opening it will randomly give you a beautiful pearl. 4 identical pearls can be combined to create a higher-level pearl. You can exchange the pearls you need with your friends

title: Wings of the Kite in Sky
description: "Wings of The KITE in sky" is an immersive VR game based on Korea's traditional kite, Bangpaeyeon.

title: Wild Ones Battle Stadium
description: Wild Ones Battle Stadium is a 2D turn-based game where players control animals in battles, earning points, coins, and experience. Customize the game with equipment and pets, join clans, and compete in modes like Battle Royale.

title: Wildcat Snack Attack
description: An action survival game where you have to defend your snacks from wildcats. Hit them with water balloons to turn them away and save your snack stash, or turn to vending machines if you find yourself running low.

title: Whoopi
description: Whoopi is a fun clicker game where you interact with a cute monster. Click to feed or attack Whoopi, collect coins, and open cases to get unique skins. Watch as Whoopi grows to a galaxy or shrinks to a molecule. Sell rare skins on the marketplace and earn real money!

title: Who Made This
description: Who Made This is a fun, light and easy-to-play click and point investigation game. Put your detective skills to the test by walking around the city and visiting various places, collecting the information you need to solve the cases.

title: Whispers of Fear
description: You step into the shoes of a woman being stalked by a mysterious figure. What was supposed to be a safe haven in an isolated forest house turns into a nightmare as strange events unfold during the night. Each night grows more terrifying... Can you escape before it’s too late?

title: Whiskey-Four
description:
Never stop running, not with the galaxy at stake. Save it at all costs, and save yourself if you can.

The corpos are after you. The cops are, too. Even your ex has crawled out of the grave to try and get you back. Meanwhile, the fate of the galaxy itself rests on a knife's edge, and only you can bar the doors of hell.

Whiskey-Four is a standalone 396,000-word interactive novel by John Louis. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

You are a retired contract killer from the Anomalous Interference Unit. Injured on the line of duty, you were forced into an early retirement--only to be reactivated on a distant frontier world to address a horrific, unknowable threat.

A great sense of malaise permeates the void. Something big is stirring, something that jeopardizes the entire galaxy.

You're the only person in position to stop it before it's all too late.

Too bad everyone else wants you dead.

title: Where's My Kitty
description: Do you like playing hide and seek with cats? Come and find them.

title: Wheel Of Fates
description: A lovingly crafted RPG with a unique spin, with cheerful characters and fun storytelling.

title: Wheelie King 7
description: Realistic 3D motorbike simulator All devices cross-play (IOS,Steam,Android). Steam-deck compatible. Realistic motorbike wheelie game. Customize bikes. Play offline & online. Change bike parts. Spray paint bike parts. Play offline & online Change bike parts Spray paint bike parts.

title: Wheelie City
description: Wheelie City is a game about doing deliveries as fast as possible, climbing the urban ranks while collecting and customizing your bike to fit your style! Stunt your way accross hand crafted maps to find shortcuts and secrets and become the best delivery driver in the Wheelie City

title: What the Chuck?
description: Jump, Dodge and Chuck your way through a variety of battlefields in this local platforming multiplayer game. Play with two to four players in a chaotic and cartoony free-for-all. Prove yourself as the ultimate woodchuck warrior and crush your friends' dream of achieving gold!

title: WGV: Dreamcatcher
description: A fanmade visual novel game by Virtual 48Group fans for Virtual 48Group fans, which tells multiple-fanmade-stories about a group of sophisticated 48 Vtuber Idol from Jakarta, Indonesia. You play as a 1st year student where you will interact with friends through multi-ended choice-based storyline.

title: Wet Passion
description: A relaxing puzzle game with 100+ levels that will give you a good mood.

title: West Journey
description: "West Journey" is an action-adventure game brimming with mystery and challenge, transporting players into an ancient world rich with legend. Here, along the ancient west wind trail, history stretches back eons, concealing countless undiscovered secrets and treasures.

title: Welcome to Bunny Farm
description: Welcome to Bunny Farm is a tomato clock function idle game where you only need to click the 'Start Working' button and wait, as Bunny, your trusty employee, will take care of the farm for you. Other small animals may drop by for a visit; you can greet them, and who knows?

title: WebCum Secrets
description: Ever wondered what it’s like to manage a webcam business? Find out in WebCum Secrets - a hot visual novel about a model manager. Save your career, build relationships and shape everyone’s future with your decisions!

title: Webcam Love
description: WEBCAM LOVE - is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: We are Blob
description: Hello! Hey! Yeah, you! The one behind the computer! Welcome to We are Blob, a chill and cozy point-and-click game that follows our main hero...BLOB! Help Blob navigate their new job as a game developer while trying not to get fired. You only have ONE week to finish this game so...no pressure!

title: Weapon Rearing
description: Idle weapon collection and weapon development game. Legendary weapons can be automatically obtained.

title: Waste Time Lotto
description: A lottery where winning is rare, but clicking is endless! Watch numbers roll, enter your lucky pick, and embrace the odds. No money, just infinite glory! Plus, a totally useless yet oddly satisfying clicker. Come waste some time—you’ve got nothing to lose… except time!

title: Wasteland Rangers

Ultimately, turn your cave into a fortress capable of defeating the undead king. The fate of the world is in your hands.

title: Unbound Eternity
description: Unbound Eternity is a turn-based roguelite deck-building game where you play as the villain, not the hero. Build your domain, forge powerful cards, and seize every opportunity to establish your reign over the world!

title: Unakis
description: An experimental game that's a mix between a visual novel and heavy 2D action, with an emphasis on telling the story through symbolism and poetry. The events of the game take place in a climactic point, where Nala, the angel, must go through difficult trials, in order to keep her home safe.

title: Ultreïa: Night of the Eclipse
description: Experience a brief yet captivating chapter in Nymo's journey and explore the mysterious desert of Ultreïa during the Night of the Eclipse.

title: Ultra X-Treme Hunting Simulator 2001
description: ULTRA X-TREME HUNTING SIMULATOR 2001 is a short horror hunting sim that satirizes low budget edutainment games with dark humor and absurdist horror.

title: Labyban
description:
Liuri wakes up, alone, deep inside a mine on an abandoned floating island. He doesn’t know how he got there or why. There’s only one thing to do: explore.

A tribute to the timeless Sokoban genre, LABYBAN modernizes the puzzle game experience with an accessible, intuitive, and stimulating approach. Across more than 140 levels, each puzzle pushes the gameplay mechanics even further.

Teleporters, slippery surfaces, conveyor belts... and many more surprises await!

The world of LABYBAN is made up of seven distinct biomes, each with a strong visual identity and unique gameplay mechanics. Some introduce new ways to play, while others combine and transform previous challenges, ensuring a smooth and varied progression.

Will you manage to escape the island?

title: Ultra Sweeper
description: Minesweeper puzzle game with multiple game modes

title: Ultra Sudoku
description: Sudoku puzzle game with 4 different variations including mixed boards

title: Ultimate Chopsticks
description: Chopsticks is a logic hand game with its origins in Japan. Players take it in turns to tap each others hands to knock each other out and win.

title: Ucopia
description: This is a story about art, profit, and friendship.

title: Type One
description: Science Fiction - Third Person shooter - developed with the unreal engine 5 ( by one person ).

title: Túatha Echoes: The Village
description: Immerse yourself in the psychological horror of The Village, where whispers bend reality and ordinary life spirals into madness. Unravel the dark rise of one of Túatha's most infamous figures in this short story visual novel.

title: Tsugunohi: Pocky Dog’s Adventure
description: "Tsugunohi" and the video game play-by-play artist, Pocky, have collaborated. "Tsugunohi -Pocky dog’s adventure-," created in conjunction with Pocky's 10th anniversary event, is now available on Steam. Lured by a white butterfly, Pocky the dog's "little adventure" now begins.

title: Truth Trail: Exorcism of Deception
description: One day when my parents were away, Ally, a sleeping doll, woke up! I need to find clues hidden throughout the house and re-seal Ally... What is true and what is false!

title: Trump Tariff
description: President Trump need avoid traps and find country flag every different countries

title: Trivia War
description: The ultimate trivia showdown! Compete against friends or the CPU in a high-stakes contest where answering questions isn’t just about being right—it’s about survival! Each correct answer lets you attack opponents and upgrade your weapon. Be the last player standing in this fast paced trivia brawl!

title: Trigonomis
description: Modify your own machine to dominate the game

title: Trees and Jellyfish
description: After a questionable decision, Coral gains the ability to talk to jellyfish. Isn't it just so convenient that there's seven of them in her class?

title: Treefiner
description: Treefiner is a short chillmulation game. Use your mouse to purge popups and collect currency. Buy upgrades to get deeper in the loop and refine your skill tree to crack the game.

title: Trapped Out
description: Get ready for an epic showdown in Trapped out! - the ultimate family-friendly action party game where chaos, fun, and laughter collide in a 3D battle arena!

title: Hell of a Birthday
description: IT’S YOUR BIRTHDAY!!! and nobody came to celebrate with you… Hell of a Birthday is a First-Person comedic horror game where you play as the Birthday Boy trying to survive your special day. From the maker of Bite Night and Invasion of the Halloween Fiends comes another unique adventure.

title: Stolen Life
description: Stolen Life is a first-person psychological horror game. While working late, you hear a sudden scream from a coworker. Rushing to investigate, you find everyone is gone. As you search for answers, you uncover hidden secrets in your home and discover your wife is not home.

title: No the Baby
description: no the baby is a short stealth horror game where you escape a kindergarten full of manipulative kids and an overworked teacher. Find items and solve puzzles to open the front door and get out of there for good!

title: Disclosures
description: luke harper, a 25 - year old social media influencer, making vlogs about diffrent places..once he found about old hospital building and he decied to make vlog about that..but after reaching that area he found out something horrible at that night..

title: Make Your Choice
description: How would your life look like if you entered a magic school? if you became a monster hunter? or maybe if you were transported to another world? Pick your scenario, make your choice and discover what you become in this highly customizable choose your own adventure game

title: Kingdom of Cards and Tiles
description: A combination of classic board games such as Carcassonne and Clank! A Deck-Building Adventure. Explore, build a deck of cards, and construct a medieval village from drawn tiles. Unlock new cards, mechanics, and magical artifacts that influence gameplay.

title: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
description: FPV drone simulator. Destroy enemy vehicles with high-precision strikes. Simulation of electronic warfare and realistic armor model.

title: Carnival Heroes: Super Party Minigames
description: Cross-platform online multiplayer board game for 2 to 4 players similar to super mario party. Collect crowns, gems, items and be the best in minigames. Play in 23 minigames in online and solo mode. Race with others, fight, shoot, catch, test your memory, and have fun.

title: Henshin MyBro!
description: Henshin MyBro is a rogue-lite game full of nonstop fun! Play solo or with a buddy, scavenge ingredients from monsters and bosses, experiment with weapons, cook dishes for boosts, and HENSHIN to special heroes. Cook, fight, and HENSHIN your way to victory!

title: Red Pippy
description: Red Pippy is a 2D pixel art platformer starring a red bird who dreams of flying high! Before taking off, he must train with his wise master, facing challenges filled with obstacles and enemies that will test his strength, endurance, and courage.

title: Pinfeather
description:
Ten years ago, Rhiannon discovered that February was a monster. It was the worst night of both their lives.

Today, Rhiannon is a beautician who sees February in secret. They work to disguise Feb’s abnormal features, but their meetings also let Rhiannon keep an eye on her – make sure Feb isn’t able to repeat past mistakes.

Under her watch, Feb will never get the chance to fuck things up for either of them ever again.

A horror game intended for an audience 18 and up. It contains content that may be upsetting to the reader.

title: ShotSurged
description: ShotSurged is a 6v6 arcade shooter that aims to give you that classic shooter feel.

title: So Fart Away
description: Help Linguini, our hero, escape from a stinky trap using only your FARTS! Avoid farting on others and uncover the wild mechanics of your farts by solving simple and challenging puzzles in this comedic sokoban game! Think twice before you fart!

title: PianoGlow
description:
Multiplayer piano visualizer (QWERTY & Midi inputs supported). Customizable themes. Render video & audio from within the app!

The virtual piano can be played either with your computer keyboard or a real piano. With multiplayer mode, you can play duets or as part of a band, or take turns!

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 1
description: The first Title Update for Monster Hunter Wilds features the return of Mizutsune, Arch-Tempered Rey Dau, The Grand Hub, and a new Zoh Shia quest with craftable gear.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 2
description: The second Title Update for Monster Hunter Wilds features the return of Lagiacrus and Seregios, Arch-Tempered Uth Duna, layered weapons, and the Festival of Accord: Flamefete event.

title: Kowloon Simulator 2020
description: Put on some of your favorite tunes and wander the twisting alleys of Kowloon. Discover bizarre and impossible alleys, teleport across great distances, and get lost in an endlessly looping maze.

title: Yandere: Love & Madness
description:
Yandere: Love & Madness is a psychological thriller and action game developed by Gemora Studios. Set in a world of intrigue and obsession, the player will take on the role of a young woman with a dangerous devotion to her beloved. With mechanics inspired by the life simulation genre, the game will offer a deep narrative experience, where the player's moral choices and actions can lead to unpredictable consequences.

Through a carefully designehttps://, Yandere: Love & Madness will combine exploration, stealth, and psychological horror elements. Players must navigate the school and its surroundings, managing social relationships while struggling with the dark side of obsession. The game will offer immersive gameplay, with intense interactions, events triggered by the protagonist's behavior, and a focus on manipulation and control.

With a unique visual style and a deep narrative that explores themes of toxic love and madness, Yandere: Love & Madness will challenge players to question how far they're willing to go for love and what the line between passion and obsession truly means.

title: Ranfren: Not Lucid
description: Fan-made visual novel for the webcomic RANFREN produced by captainhowdie

title: Spectre VR
description:
Spectre VR is a frag-fest that pays homage to the arcade classic Battlezone.

This is the second sequel to Spectre, following Spectre Supreme. New features include texture-mapped graphics and the (limited) ability to fly.

title: How a Body Sounds
description:
The stones of the town resonate at the sound of a hollow hand. The Unmake is near, the fissures dilate. Quick, new chants are needed.

How a Body Sounds is a lore-rich exploration game made with GBStudio. It can be played on GameBoy Color hardware, Analogue Pocket, GB emulators or browser.

title: Soccer Field Pro 3D
description:
Soccer Field Pro 3D is a Multiplayer Football/Soccer game that offers a dynamic and realistic football experience, allowing you to customize your own training, perform incredible dribbles, enjoy advanced physics and fully edit your player.

Play the game how you'll like. Cooperate with friends to create the perfect plays or go solo to demonstrate the beauty of your skills. Use your body to defend the goal or use your ability to attack the opponent's. Be the piece that your team needs or the X factor that changes everything.

Become a great player and start your legacy on the fields!

title: Being a DIK: Season 3
description: Continue your story, deepen your relationships, and experience more songs, mini-games, achievements, and girls in this highly anticipated DLC.

title: The Voyage Sinister
description: The Voyage Sinister it's a Gothic story with an investigative and mystery element, set in a Victorian-inspired world. While a JRPG at its core, the game is also a mixture of Visual Novel and Adventure Game.

title: Wizard Hand
description: A magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. Uncover dazzling combos and accumulate points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

title: The Spike Cross
description:
A volleyball game made by an actual volleyball club player!

"The thrill of spiking in volleyball. Why don't you try it out?"

The volleyball game made after numerous trial and error to contain the appeal of volleyball!

title: The Harmony Chronicles: Cat Out of the Bag - Collector’s Edition
description: Help Mona save the kingdom old kingdom!

title: Argonauts Agency: Ares Games - Collector's Edition
Bohemian Cupid
description: A cute yaoi romcom featuring two couples!

title: Combolite
description: In this satisfying roguelike deckbuilder, every weapon you buy matters! Strategically order them to trigger powerful combos, send the enemy flying with physics-based hits, and watch your damage reach MILLIONS and above!

title: Dimwood
description: A roguelike deck builder where you venture into the Dimwood, armed with unique modal cards. Rendered in dense 1-Bit pixel art, carefully build your deck and modify your cards to balance offense and utility. Battle your way past increasingly fearsome enemies and defeat the Beast at its heart.

title: Lenin Street Geek Shop
description: Become a shopkeeper in the first geek store in a snowy 2000s town: sell CDs, snacks, and fan merch, influence your customers' lives, get involved in shady business, and grow your small store.

title: Decrypto Project
description: Our algorithm has chosen you for inclusion in the Decrypto Project. Your job is simple: we send encrypted texts, you decipher them. Loyalty and diligence will be rewarded with upgrades and customization options for your system. Disobedience and sabotage will be punished.

title: Cardness
description: Cardness is a card-based management and automation game. Build ingenious systems, optimize your resources, and command troops to face threats. Create autonomous machines and dominate a minimalist, strategic world.

title: Ferulorum
description: Strategy/simulation game/Auto-Battler - Higher mercenaries, equip them, organize them into a team and watch as they fight through the dungeon collecting loot and gold. Clear your way through 5 locations in the Kingdome so you can enter the deepest reaches of the castle and reclaim the lost relic.

title: Run Salmon Run
description: During Alaskan summers, salmon can be found swimming upstream rivers during spawning season. You are one such salmon. Can you make it to the top of the river in one piece?

title: Wicked Seed
description:
Wicked Seed is a modern-day horror RPG with tactical combat and survival horror roots.

Hybrid Combat System: Combine real-time actions like dodging and parrying with strategic turn-based attacks.

Rewarding Exploration: Discover hidden paths, solve optional puzzles, and find unique items that enhance your abilities.

Customization: 50 unlockable costumes and a variety of weapons and accessories to tailor your play style.

title: Figments of the Night
description: You wake up on a deserted island with no memory of who you are or what you're doing there. You'll have to explore its surroundings, meet its other visitors, and find clues to uncover the truth behind this mysterious place... Or you can simply relax in this paradise in the middle of the ocean and accept ignorance. Whatever you do, do it before you have to go to sleep...

title: I’ll Fuck Your Grandpa!
description: A frank visual novel for adults, where you will find yourself in the role of a young woman who finds special pleasure in sex with old men.

title: Mind Echoes: The Lost Mysteries - Collector's Edition
description: Join investigator and medium Emily Rivers as she explores the abandoned Starlight Dreams Hotel to find hidden objects and confront a malevolent force known as the Lurker!

title: Whispered Secrets: Cruise of Misfortune - Collector's Edition
description: How deep do the dark waters go?

title: Mamizou's Mimic Check
description: Touhou Project's secondary Speedy Mistake-finding game!Check for errors in the content of the changes! The speed increases when you get consecutive correct answers! Let's check if the various Touhou characters are correct!

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 10 - Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of European adventures with "Trip to Europe 10" and discover the continent from the comfort of your home!

title: Tank Trouble 3D
description: 3D sequel to classic Tank Fighting game of 2007.

title: Mini Cozy Room: Lo-Fi
description: Decorate your own cozy workspace! Mini Cozy Room: Lo-Fi combines relaxing Lo-Fi music and room decoration into one productivity game. Cute avatars and pets will keep you company, while desktop Pomodoro timers, notes, and to-do lists boost your efficiency.

title: InterImperium
description: A tower defence game with realistic graphics. Romans vs barbarians

title: MoteMancer
description: Automate across six Elemental planes, each with unique logistical tools. Infuse ingredients, craft alchemical structures, and uncover elegant solutions through experimentation - cultivating a garden of possibility, one discovery at a time.

title: Miracle Heroes: Temporal Bounty Hunter
description: Miracle Heroes is a multiplayer light rogue-like game where players must select suitable combinations from a rich arsenal of weapons and items to enhance their gear and survive in a world fraught with danger.

title: Spirit Legends: Solar Eclipse - Collector's Edition
Spirit Legends: Finding Balance - Collector's Edition
A Moderately Uncomfortable Night with Tux
description:
You have woke up in a mysterious office -- and Tux from Linux is after you.

Armed with malfunctioning doors and a laptop with a barely functional battery, you must survive to 6 AM while Tux's gang tries to taint your PC. If they fully taint it.. well, something bad will happen.

Beware Tux...

title: Cursed Covenant: The Demonic Pursuit
description:
As a rookie adventurer aiding a powerful Magi on their quest, you'll gradually uncover your own hidden past and fragmented memories. Amidst a backdrop of seduction and intrigue, you'll forge intimate connections with Magis, Demons, and Spirits.

Will you successfully aid the Magi, reclaim your lost memories, or will you be forever condemned to roam the labyrinthine corridors imbued with secrets?

title: Cellitaire
description: Solitaire meets Cellular automaton in this addictive game that requires both observation and strategy.

title: Blightborn
description:
In a dystopian future ravaged by an unstoppable blight, you play as a young scientist on the verge of discovering a cure. But just as you near a breakthrough, a series of deadly “accidents” begin to threaten your life.

Before uncovering the truth, you black out only to awaken in an underground facility. As you struggle to escape, you met... him.

title: End the Endless
description: End the Endless is a dark fantasy turn based RPG set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness unique directional based weapon systems in an oppressive environment. Utilize unique abilities, items and even your party members as a resource. Explore the Afterlife and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.

title: Cartomantic
description: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

title: A Tower
description: A Tower is an atmospheric adventure of exploration and self-discovery. Solve puzzles and collect artifacts in a desolate world, unraveling the mysteries of the colossal structure and your true identity.

title: BearPit
description: Experience a 'painfully human', 'psychological' narrative through dreams and allegory. Live in a flat. Buy things. Use things. Tire yourself out. Sleep. Dream. Wake up. Repeat. And maybe, just maybe, find a Bear in a Pit. What could be scarier than the Bear? Find out.

title: Blanksword
description: You’re a fallen Angel, your brain is missing and half of God’s country wants you dead (again!). Battle legions of weird monsters with your smiling sword. Find and customize a large number of skills. Rebuild your brain from scratch and rise against a tyrannical God in this turn-based roguelike RPG!

title: Murder Is Game Over: Murder Otaku
description: Play as a detective with a clue-sniffing dog partner. Solve the murder of a J-pop singer at an anime convention in a historic high-rise hotel.

title: The Revanchist
description: The Revanchist is a first person survival horror game featuring punishing combat and inventory management. Investigate a mysterious numbers station and its connection to the disappearance of a loved one. Explore depths forgotten by time, and uncover why some things should stay buried.

title: Azoth
description: Build game-breaking combos as you ascend through challenging rituals in this strategic deck builder. Master the unique card linking resource system and discover infinite procedural possibilities.

title: Hellmate
description: "HELLMATE" is a deck-building chess game where king pieces must fight through the seven floors of Hell, playing Hell Chess against the Seven Sins to purify themselves before they can ascend to the world.Prepare your deck in the most suitable way for you and escape from that damned hell.

title: Hear Tell of Hauntings
description: Deep in the mountains of wild west-era Montana, former outlaw Adelaide Clancy ventures to the desolate remains of the Wraith estate in this third-person survival horror game.

title: Fried Rice Apocalypse
description: A cooking simulation game where you serve food in an apocalyptic world while trying to survive yourself! Cook a meal for the survivors, Discover new recipe, Meet strange customers and even finding a unique zombies trying to attack you!

title: Kingdomino
description: Kingdomino is a cosy 1-4 player tile-laying strategy game of kingdom building. Place colorful dominoes, match terrains, and crown your lands to create the most prosperous realm. Simple to learn yet deeply strategic game perfect for quick sessions, solo challenges, or competitive multiplayer.

title: Nomia
description:
Nomia is a story-rich tactics roguelike where two heroes coordinate to execute brilliant skill combos.

Guide a warrior and a wizard through a mystifying tale. Harness grid-based strategy and deep deckbuilding mechanics to battle gorgeously illustrated foes. Blast monsters off cliffs, steal their cards, and sling spear and spell to reach the horizon.

title: Oreblaze
description: Dig up the Adamant Core from a procedurally generated mine, extract ores, sell them for profit, upgrade your equipment, and keep the King happy by sending him tributes before he loses his temper!

title: Keyrin Loves You
description: A section of an upcoming game, THREE VERSES³

title: Journey to Whale Fall
description: Guide a young giant isopod through the perilous deep sea chasm in his quest to reunite with his mother at the whale fall event. Defend yourself against dangerous enemies, meet new friends, and uncover the secrets of the deep sea!

title: Happy Rabbit Farm
description: A little bunny girl named Alice lost her best friend Sebastian. You need to find Sebastian and help Alice to defeat monsters.

title: Paper Mario: Great Star Offensive
description: Paper Mario: Great Star Offensive is a Paper Mario styled fangame by SEVA, it is a full-length game based on the Nintendo 64 game. Great Star Offensive plays like any traditional Paper Mario game, fight Action Command-based battles, equip Badges, buy items, and so forth. The game features new locations along with old ones.

title: Spot Zero
description: Spot Zero is a mission-driven anime action RPG where you lead a squad of Human and Yokai investigators through monster-controlled zones, securing outposts and pushing the frontline, with each character fighting in a distinct style from blade clashes to TPS mode and elemental bursts.

title: Stop the Blight
description: Stop the Blight is a tower defense roguelite with powerful spells and destructible voxel terrain. Build your defenses, reshape the land, and wield elemental power to uncover the truth behind the Blight.

title: Fantasy Trader
description: Guide your trading post in a dynamic fantasy world to riches and fame. Build relationships with visiting heroes, confront their problems and needs. Defend what's yours from the monsters, thieves and tax collectors.

title: Peacebringer
description: Peacebringer takes the addictive auto-attacking gameplay of Vampire Survivors to the next level by introducing a party system. Build and control a team of heroes, each with their own unique abilities and attack patterns, as they battle against endless waves of corrupted beings.

title: Sword Road
description: Make your best sword! Fight monsters in dungeon, collect items and craft a various sword.

title: No Food No Drink
description: Enjoy delicious snacks, earn rewards, and navigate whilst avoiding the librarian. Equip yourself with many tools to distract others creatively. Assist your classmates and prepare to face challenges in this stealth-strategy game at different time or weather.

title: Korokoro
description: This game is a gyro-only game. Please make sure that your controller is equipped with a gyro function before purchasing. Roll around with the gyro control. Overcome numerous gimmicks and aim for the goal! A total of 50 stages. Tilt and roll 5 balls of different shapes to reach the goal.

title: Yubiwa Monogatari: Dai-ni-kan - Futatsu no Tou
description: PC-98 port features different graphics and sound.

title: Yubiwa Monogatari: Dai-ikkan - Tabi no Nakama
description: The PC-98 port features different graphics and sound.

title: Paranormal Files: The Tall Man - Collector's Edition
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Keep on the Borderlands
description: Help the commonfolk trapped within the Keep on the Borderlands in their struggle against the Cult of Evil Chaos. A collection of 8 quest dungeons adapted from the classic D&D module for new characters & early epic levels. The Borderlands is also a large adventure area where players can hunt monsters and obtain horses.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Seal of Shan-to-Kor
description: A premium three-part dungeon for low level characters. Search the sewers for a large hobgoblin town and take back the Seal of Shan-To-Kor before its power is turned against Stormreach.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Sharn Syndicate
description: A small series of very short premium dungeons for low level characters. Protect the marketplace from a gang that extorts innocent business owners.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Archetype - Wild Mage
description: An add-on that has to be purchased in the store. You can make a new character that plays as a variant of the sorcerer class. Wild Mages tap into chaos and luck when they cast their spells.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Warforged
description: An add-on that has to be purchased in the store. Warforged are a race of sentient constructs built to battle in the Last War. The Warforged body is covered by plating, but prevents wearing any other armor. They can be healed with repair magic, which makes them ideal for playing as or partying with arcane spellcasters.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Tabaxi
description: Tabaxi are cat-like humanoid creatures with supernatural powers. Light on their feet, the fearsome Tabaxi favor dexterity and agility as they hunt, leap, and claw their way through many dangers.

title: The Tower of Mimi
description: Explore the Tower of Mimi floor by floor and try to reach the top! Endure games forced on you by Mimi, resident strange funny animal. See if you can survive... ohoho~

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Delera's Tomb
description: A premium collection of short dungeons about ghostly skeletons and other undead. The main quests are narrated by Gary Gygax.

title: Golden Rails: The Heart of the State - Collector's Edition
Farkle with Friends
description: Roll the dice, push your luck, and strategize your way to victory! Compete with friends in this fast-paced multiplayer dice game where every roll counts. With real physics-based rolling, every outcome is truly random—no tricks, just skill and luck! Unlock unique dice skins to show off your style!

title: Adventure Trip: London
description: If you are a virtual bird but love adventure too, this game is just for you.

title: Rescue Team: Ancient Guardian - Collector's Edition
Detectives United: Mission Possible - Collector's Edition
description: Can the Detectives United team unravel the secrets of Myst Hill in time?

title: Cursed Fables: A Gilded Rose - Collector's Edition
description: Can you use your magical gifts to save the prince from a deadly fate?

title: Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel
description:
In "Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel", your stomach is rumbling, and there's only one solution – find the ingredients and cook the world-famous schnitzel! But even in Schländ, the schnitzel-loving country, it won't be easy!

Embark on a quirky adventure filled with unexpected encounters, platforming challenges and a fun merging mechanic. Explore a world brimmed with secrets, strange characters, and even stranger problems. Dig, swing, and sprint your way through a lovingly designed environment, where surprises await around every corner.

title: Memory Recoil
description: Memory Recoil is a short surreal horror visual novel following the story of Von, a boy who lives secluded in his house until one day he receives an unexpected visit from a boy named Liam who invites him to play outside. Nothing bad could happen, right?

title: Double Shoulders
description: Double Shoulders is a two player action-adventure game. You take control of Lois and Sam, two kids trying to escape from a strange place filled with dangers and challenges. You'll have to work together to get out of this place alive.

title: Rack and Run
description: The story is from the perspective of a hunter who finally gets her first kill. However, it turns out to be way more than she bargained for! Will the hunter now become the hunted?

title: Pimbolas
description: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

title: Skools Out
description: Skools Out is an educational adventure game for younger players. The main character, a boy named Derek, must try within twenty days to make sure that the sheet of paper with the latest results of his scientific achievements does not reach home. The notes there are not among the highest, so it would be better not to get them in the hands of parents.

title: Kagerou Labyrinth
description: An old explorer finds the ruins of an old civilization. in them, a few workers claim to have been trapped in "a different world with strange powers". the old explorer asks a scientist among his friends and his daughter to go investigate. they enter and are transported by a blinding light into a strange labyrinth.

title: Demian
description: Emil Sinclair is torn between a monochromatic understanding of the world of childhood and the ambiguity of adulthood. As Emil dives deeper, he's caught in a swirling journey where dreams and desire are indistinguishable from reality. His path is lined with bizarre encounters. Maybe a strange boy with a mouth full of biblical riddles can help him find his way. Demian is a reinterpretation of the novel "Demian" written by Hermann Hesse and published in 1919.

title: Ark: Extinction Ascended
description: An Element-infested, ravaged planet Earth filled with fantastical creatures both organic & technological holds both the secrets of the past and the keys to its salvation. Can you defeat the gigantic roaming Titans which dominate the planet, and complete the ARK cycle to save Earth's future?

title: Epimutation
description: 399 days ago, the world ended. Epimutation is a horror visual novel that follows seven survivors as they attempt to navigate life in the apocalypse. Make life or death decisions, form bonds with your fellow survivors, and attempt to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak.

title: Midas
description:
Train. Customize. FIGHT!

MIDAS is a 3D Platform/Arena Fighter with a heavy focus on movement and positioning that seeks to bring something new to the already vast array of fighting games.

Ready your shield, aim your flail, and launch into the fray against friend and foe alike!

title: Danganronpa: Salvation's Fears
description: Danganronpa: Salvation's Fears is a developing RPG Maker MV fangan with a playable prolouge and fully completed chapter 1. DR: SF has no affiliation with SpikeChunsoft or the official Danganronpa series.

title: Paranormal Survey
description: Paranormal Survey is a "Spot The Difference" style game, look out for moving objects, objects growing in size, paintings may change, and certain other spooky events may occur.

title: Welcome! Uninvited Guest
description:
A short and mildly difficult one shot type horror game I made in two weeks to try and get my game dev groove going after a month long hiatus. Was a bit experimental with this one. While the game may be a bit difficult to play due to it's heavy emphasis on hiding and not getting caught, I do hope people will enjoy the learning curve and have some fun with it!

You must scour the forest in search of gears to unlock the ritual doors. Activate powerful statues, hide wherever you can and most importantly, do NOT let them see you... Once all four of the Formless Statues have been activated, the ritual will be complete. This won't be a simple task. You must use your wit and resourcefulness to hide and evade the Uninvited whilst you explore the forest.

The map randomly generates every time you play, making each run feel a little different from the last. But your objective remains the same, complete the ritual.

title: Nightlings
description: Nightlings is a First Person survival horror game, set in the mind of a child's worst nightmares come true. Prevent the Nightlings from breaking in, and survive until morning. You have 3 nights to survive...could these be your last?

title: Dance To Heck
description: Play as a funny little demon guy as you look out for funny little lava guys don't touch those they'll burn you silly.

title: Blitzr Ball
description: An arcade style game where you control a bumper to bounce the blitzr ball! Destroy all blocks to beat levels. Discover power ups and unlock perks to help you along the way!

title: RNG Quest
description: Zero player randomly generated idle-game by Viktor.

title: Hand of Hexes
description: Play cards to cast spells that control enemy hordes and use your deck to build deadly mazes of towers with funky attack patterns.

title: Clutter 17: Flower Power - Collector's Edition
description: It's Clutter - but with added Flower Power! Flowers used as Stackers and unmissable new Petal Puzzles are among over 1800 puzzles to keep you playing for days and days. Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability!

title: Code Trainer
description: Code Trainer is a programming practice tool. Solve coding problems and improve your understanding of computer science. Prior programming experience is required.

title: Coffee, Snow, and You
description: A short visual novel about a lonely soul spending December 31st at work. A funny and heartwarming story about searching for joy and meaning on the eve of the most magical night of the year.

title: CoinForge
description: CoinForge is a clicker game where you generate S-coins! Click to earn S-coins and exchange them. Try to get your S-Coins every day with every 100 Clicks you press. 3 is max per day. It's time to forge fortune with Coin Forge. Join our community on Discord and help shape the game!

title: Coldblooded
description: After crash landing in the midst of a catastrophic orbital battle, take on the role of a reptilian alien in this non-linear 2D puzzle adventure game.

title: College Gay Sex: Episode 5
description: An erotic VISUAL NOVEL featuring HD graphics, steamy ANIMATIONS, and realistic-looking characters. Cody's gay adventure continues with a steamy ménage at the spa when he and Jax challenge the handsome receptionist to join them in the sauna.

title: Color Breakers 2
description: A casual co-op game about coloring with friends! Form a party of up to 8 players in local and online multiplayer and try to beat crazy levels by coloring procedurally-generated paintings. Expect fast-paced, chaotic fun with plenty of twists and turns to keep you entertained!

title: Colors of the Past
description: Soo-ji is pulled back into her past through haunting melodies and unsaid words. As she uncovers hidden truths, she must face her trauma and decide whether to find redemption or let go forever.

title: Colossal Crisis
description: Colossal Crisis is a fast-paced 2D hack-and-slash platformer where you play as a brave swordsman fighting to reclaim an island overrun by ruthless enemies and towering giants. Will you rise against the "Colossal Counsel" or fall beneath their might?

title: Coming From Above!
description: In an arcade game somewhere. Aim for a high score while stacking blocks falling from the sky and avoid falling off the stage!

title: Concentration Required
description: Concentration Required is a tough bullet hell made to challenge your focus and reaction time. The game has 6 unique retro-themed music tracks with 5 levels plus a tutorial and endless mode.

title: Conduits
description: Nostalgic Screensaver Simulator - With Teapots! Conduits allows you to create nostalgic and original scenes full of colorful pipes using a custom GUI.

title: Confluence: An Of Sense and Soul Soliloquy
description: A poet ponders queer life and love after his happily ever after.

title: Containers
description: Containers – a clicker game where unexpected discoveries await you! Your main task is to click the button to earn balance and open various containers with rare and valuable items. Test your luck!

title: Corporate Chaos
description: Corporate Chaos is a 2D Action game where an office worker must battle the forces of automation to get his job back! Explore the labyrinth like office building with only furniture and broken bits of bots to defend yourself.

title: Corporate Cut: The Hair-Raising Adventure of an Office Employee
description: “Corporate Cut” is a satirical adventure set in a bizarre hair-obsessed magazine company. As the new intern, you'll experience the struggle to fit in while exploring the boundaries between conformity and innovation. Expect intricate lore, experimental game design, and of course… many hair puns!

title: Corporate Suck Up
description: Oliver’s future at Reeve's Capital depends on winning over three strange colleagues while working as a secretary. Nothing ominous is happening if he doesn't think too hard about it.

title: Cosmic Decode
description: Cosmic Decode is a space game where you explore an unknown universe, solving puzzles and discovering the reason for your situation. Immerse yourself in an adventure full of mystery and challenges at every step.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Lost Gatekeepers
description: A small series of short premium dungeons for low level characters. The Gatekeepers have established a new grove outside Stormreach and some of the recently recruited initiates have gone missing. Follow the clues to help rescue these would-be guardians of Eberron.

title: Spinera
description: Spinera is a chaotic yet euphoric civilization management game… decided by a slot machine. Pick a leader, build Wonders, and see if luck favors your empire. Light, surprising, and perfect for short, fun runs.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Devil Assault
description: The Chronoscope premium raid and a dungeon that supports multiple character levels. Travel back in time to find out what happened when a vortex of invading devils destroyed the Stormreach Marketplace.

title: Bullet Yeeters
description: Bullet Yeeters is a third-person shooter where miniature agents navigate oversized household environments using jetpacks. Players engage in combat across domestic settings like kitchens and living rooms, face boss encounters, and can modify their characters' appearances and loadouts. The game emphasizes aerial mobility and firefights within familiar spaces transformed into battlegrounds.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules IV: Mother Nature - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules V: Kids of Hellas - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules VI: Race for Olympus - Collectors Edition
12 Labours of Hercules VII: Fleecing the Fleece - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules VIII: How I Met Megara - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules IX: A Hero's Moonwalk - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules X: Greed for Speed - Collector's Edition
Cloverpit
description:
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.

Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.

Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XI: Painted Adventure - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules XII: Timeless Adventure - Collectors Edition
description:
One sunny day brave Hercules was resting in his hammock and cooking delicious donuts. He dozed off just for a few minutes but it was enough for the hero's brunch to burn to a crisp. All the dreams of a starving Hercules were ruined. What should he do? There was a way. Hercules decided to turn back time, and move the clock's hand back with all his might. What could possibly go wrong? Obviously, everything!

The collector's edition contains additional bonus levels, a guide, and wallpapers.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XIII: Wonder-ful Builder - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules XIV: Message in a Bottle - Collector's Edition
The Terror At Freddy's
description: The Terror At Freddy's Is A FNaF Fan Game Where You Need To Survive All Nights And Complete Challenges And Full Game.

title: Dr. Plague
description: In a world ravaged by plague, a lone plague doctor embarks on a journey to stop both the disease and a sinister order of knights controlling it. Dr. Plague is a stealth-adventure game that combines puzzle-solving, platforming, and ambient soundtracks.

title: Coil's Containment
description: Coil's Containment is a horror roguelike where you start a new job at a local ice cream parlor. To secure your employment and satisfy your boss, Mr. Coil, you must generate enough revenue in 11 days.

title: Chess Force
description: Chess Force! The wicked MAGNUS and his evil minions have taken taken over the moon with their dark chess powers. You, the KING, will earn PAWNS from each boss battle. Spend your hard-earned ELO to PROMOTE your pawns and add to your firepower. Can you become a GRANDMASTER and save the moon?

title: Trivia Murder Party 3
description: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

title: Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC
description: Get ready for adrenaline-fueled racing fun as you climb your way through the motorsports ranks in pure arcade style! Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC is all about speed and pushing your driving skills to the limit.

title: Okko the Exiled
description: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure, where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the demon lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

title: Exo-Calibre
description: Meet the Ex-Calibre Knights, elite pilots in state-of-the-art exo-mechs, defending peace, justice and hope across the world! The Exo-Tech corporation is dedicated to developing advanced weapons and defenses to aid humanity, but when AI drones go haywire and start attacking the populous, it’s up to you to take control of the Ex-Calibre Knights and restore order by any means necessary!

title: Tiny Pixels Vol. 2: Stormy Knights
description: Step into the armored boots of an overzealous knight as you fight across the continent rescuing princesses from monstrous captors in Stormy Knights! Strategic real-time combat ensues as you storm the halls of each castle in side-scrolling pixel art style, from medieval Europe and mystical Persia to feudal Japan and more, all accompanied by an original retro soundtrack!

title: Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
description:
Why settle for ordinary cars when some are real treasures? Live the collector's dream!

Open your own collector car shop and make it an international success. Welcome car enthusiasts and help them find rare and special models. Create a place where fans feel at home!

Upgrade and style your shop. Turn a simple shop into a stunning space for collectors.

Organise everything - add smart features to make shopping easier. Create zones for buying, trading and displaying cars. Add space for the races and let the best win!

Search for hidden gems and sell them to eager customers. Find rare cars to complete your collection!

title: Metahorror Therapy Session
description: Take control of a therapist in a mysterious, never-ending therapy session. Can you unravel the truth behind your patient's lies, and live to tell the tale? A psychological mystery developed by a psychologist.

title: Humanelfo: Um Segredo Vai Te Libertar
