description: Lohan, prince of the Kingdom of Candara, has always lived “imprisoned” in his own castle. Until his father, King Carlus IX, discovers that he is not his son and decides to arrest him and then kill him. Lohan becomes desperate when he learns that his father is planning to kill him. So he decides to flee the castle to get answers about his origin. On his way, he receives a mission to find the Sealed Mana in order to discover who his real parents are, but not everything goes according to plan. The life he knew will change forever.

title: O Horror Amarelo
description: Angela is a young woman who suffered various traumas in her childhood and adolescence, her life plunged into nightmares and anxiety attacks. After being referred to a hypnologist and psychotherapist by her psychologist, the young woman begins a journey through her memories in search of a cure for her problems. What she didn't know was that this internal journey would awaken and bring to light terrible secrets, hidden fears that flirt with the darkness and insanity of the human mind? before the watchful eyes of unnameable mysteries that roam in the shadows of the cosmos.

title: This is Interesting
description: This is Interesting is a psychological horror narrative based game with roguelite elements. You are being watched, and you aren't really sure why. Delve through the depths of memory to uncover the mystery behind the gray purgatory you find yourself in.

title: Animatronic Memories
description: Animatronic Memories is a fnaf fan-game based on the events of the first FNaF game, but set in an alternate universe.

title: RPG Maker Coloring Book
description: A simple coloring book program made within RPG Maker 2003!

title: Super Stream-Bara
description: CAPPA, a hero from capybara legend, needs your help! Your mission: free every capybara in the world from the evil clutches of Capy Land. But wait... who is that mysterious Stream-Bara lurking in the corner of the screen?

title: Transregnum
description: Step into a dystopian visual novel where secrets, betrayal, and self-discovery collide. Follow Garrett Marek's text-driven journey through a world ruled by Deus Magnus Rotamea. Unravel family mysteries, confront fate, and explore a linear story where every revelation brings you closer to the truth!

title: Trainer Eyes
description: Let's workout with a girl! Are you ready for the first-ever workout/rhythm game? This game does not require VR HMD and can be played on a PC.

title: Track Masters Pro
description: Track Masters Pro is a competitive racing game focused on precision driving and adaptive AI opponents. Players race through a variety of tracks with customizable vehicles, aiming to master each circuit and climb the leaderboard. The game emphasizes realistic handling, time trial challenges, and progression through skill-based performance.

title: Tower Of Penguinaria
description: Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica. Through turn based combats where your gear effects what abilities you will learn to aid in battle!

title: Totomi Trainer
description: Totomi trainer is a trainer simulator in which You will become a trainer of runners. But there is one small detail, you will train monsters :) But don't worry, they are cute and don't bite at all ! i guess...

title: Totem Clash
description: Collect blocks to summon units and defeat ghosts! Totem Clash is a roguelike tower fence game where you summon units through blocks to defeat ghosts. Combine and strengthen various units to reclaim areas occupied by ghosts. Use each unit's unique characteristics to strategically defeat ghosts.

title: Toriki: The Castaway Island
description: A companion app necessary for playing the Toriki: The Castaway Island board game from Lucky Duck Games. Toriki: The Castaway Island is a cooperative family game of adventure, exploration and survival mixing an app with physical components.

title: Tomorrow's Land
description: Tomorrow’s Land is a free land Where Adventures Begin. It may not be the best game ever created, but it is surely the most fun. The game is not yet finished and is still in active development.

title: Toey Weedz Smoke One
description: An funny early 3D retro inspired FPS. Become Mr. Weedz himself and fight on the power of Evil. Pass through 6 unique level and upgrade a Toey with gunz and skillz to put an end to the madness once and for all!

title: Toast Astronauts
description: Complete all tasks or exile the assasin!

title: Tiny Shooters
description: Engage in fast-paced 2D deathmatch action! Choose from 9 unique characters, collect weapons, grenades, and health packs as you battle for supremacy in a 5-minute showdown. Play against friends or bots in this thrilling shooter game where every kill counts!

title: Time to Star II
description: A female-led star training game where players aim to win the TTS Starlight King Award. Features include open-world exploration, unique romance systems, and diverse career choices.

title: Tide: 1932
description: A new story of a young girl who escapes from a murder charge and weaves with her chosen lover.

title: Ticker
description: This game is a colorful platformer where players control a nimble character navigating through a vibrant world full of color

title: Pelican Post
description:
Pelican Post is a cozy narrative game about delivering mail to a town of unique characters and helping to regain a lost sense of community.

You play as Pepper, a young pelican who recently moved to Port Pleasant to take a job as the town's mailman. Through your job, you'll get to interact with and get to know the townsfolk and help them out.

"Small acts of kindness" is pretty much in the job description.

title: Throw Home
description: (This game was created as both a proof of concept and game design showcase) A 2D action showcase for players new to video games.

title: Throweat Area
description: A arena FPS multiplayer game, were you can collect lot of items around you and throw EVERYTHING on other players or eat EVERYTHING to regenerate your health.

title: Will She?
description: You want her to be your date for the dance but it is in 5 days. Will you be able to build up the courage to ask her in time, or will you have to go to the dance alone this year?

title: ThrillKings
description: THRILLKINGS is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a set of weapons and movement inspired by games from the early 2000s. Compete in classic and new game modes, dominate your enemies through a variety of maps with unique traversal mechanics, and become the ultimate King.

title: Three Sheets
description: Arcade sailboat racing for all! Take the helm of an offshore racing sailboat in beautiful and challenging waters. Race through the checkpoints and reach the goal before time runs out!

title: Three Kingdoms: Strategy MOBA
description: Fast-paced war strategy mobile game, 7 days per season, North vs South

title: Three Doors: Labyrinth of Fear
description: Trapped in darkness, you've lived in fear for as long as you can remember. Now, thirty rooms stand between you and freedom. Each one holds a deadly challenge, but only one path leads forward. One wrong step, and you're lost forever. Open the door!

title: Three Against the Odds
description: Three Against the Odds is a base defense fantasy roguelike. Build your amphibian hero(es) and settlement as wave after wave of enemies descends from bordering terrain that you can terraform. Play through three campaigns, conquering the shadowy powers that have corrupted the world of Primeva.

title: Thief Office Simulator
description: Simulation game where player mission is to steal as much money, jewelry etc in different places and avoid guardians and cameras

title: The Yapori Clicker
description: Yapori Clicker is a Clicker game where you need to keep clicking Yapori to level up and unlock skins, get coins, armor and more

title: Emoji Puzzle Action: Codename: ManKun
description: In a future transformed by tech, social media and emojis dominate communication. But a disaster strikes when the "Emoji Virus" turns emojis into aggressive beings, overrunning the world. You, "ManKun", the sole survivor and ex-security expert, must now save humanity.

title: Threat: Scream and Escape
description: THREAT -SCREAM AND ESCAPE- is a unique horror game where you must scream into your microphone to stun approaching creatures and make your escape. Use the power of your voice to clear the path and guide the protagonist, who wakes up in a mysterious research facility, to freedom.

title: Breaking the Grip
description: Breaking the Grip is a multiplayer horror and strategy game. As a survivor, complete a ritual to eliminate the spirit before it drives you insane. As the spirit, spread terror and break their will. Who will prevail between life and the beyond?

title: Range
description: Range is a game that helps you stay on-task and focused when you want to be. Set a timer for your focus session, the tasks you want to complete, and enjoy a relaxing, distraction-free drive through a hand-drawn world.

title: Highspeed Etoile Paddock Stories
description:
“This time we’ll be the stars! Prima Stella’s channel begins!”

“HIGHSPEED Etoile Paddock Stories” is Prima Stella’s program featuring various information surrounding the NEX Race.

This special program features close-up footage of the drivers participating in the race.

Hikari and Akari, official ambassadors for the NEX Race known together as “Prima Stella,” bring viewers various stories about the racers’ daily lives and what goes on behind the scenes.

title: Jump to Space
description: Aim for space from the ground. Climb up while jumping on objects. The jump distance changes depending on the degree of accumulation, so delicate control is required. Don't cry no matter how many times you fall! I am sure you can do it!

title: Next Week at Freddy's
description: Welcome to “Next Week at Freddy's”, a realism-based, fan-made reimagining of “Five Nights at Freddy's”. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game features enhanced graphics and spatial audio to immerse you in its atmosphere.

title: Lootbound
description: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

title: The Wungo Dungo Surprise
description: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game, with no combos or roster, just 1 simple enemy to beat repeatedly. The main moves are punching, kicking and dodging, and some extra tools, a few weapons and powers.

title: The Wild Outback
description: The Wild Outback is an arcade top-down shooter game in a Wild Western setting. It's a single player game where you join cowboys in the fight against an alien invasion of mutant animals and lazer-firing robots!

title: The Void Chronicles Chronis
description: Every decision matters. It’s a race against the clock in a story where paranoia, creativity, and courage are your only allies. Will you break the loop, or will time break you?

title: The Viewer's Game
description: Defeat HUGE waves of enemies as Bob, The Viewer's Game is a very satisfying but hectic game where you can Shoot, Burn, and smash into hundreds of enemies and bosses! Each run you get to choose a Class for Bob and discover what each subclass and unlockable weapon does!

title: The Very Brief and Meaningless Adventure of Hero Man
description: Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from a terrible evil ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please in this small, satirical RPG!

title: The Valley: XuGu
description: The Valley: XuGu is a casual deck-building roguelike game that blends Taoist alchemy with cyber technology. Players can combine herbs based on their grades and elemental attributes to create unique alchemy recipes and refine distinct elixirs. These pills can help those who enter Xugu.

title: The Trio
description: The Trio invites you into a world shrouded in mystery and danger. By day, gather resources and reinforce your shelter, but as night falls, sinister creatures rise from the shadows, driven by a dark curse. Survival becomes a desperate fight against cursed creatures that stalk the land.

title: The Tower of Aether
description: Welcome to the Tower of Aether—a labyrinth filled with countless doors, At the heart of this Tower lies the Heart of Aether, an artifact of unimaginable power, coveted by all who enter. But only one player will emerge victorious, claiming the ultimate prize.

title: The Time Traveling Toxicologist
description: Travel back in time, investigate a murder, and prevent it from ever happening!

title: The Tale of: Bubble Boy
description: Help Bubble Boy reach the highest mountaintop in the Alps by moving him upwards inside his giant soap bubble, but don't let the bubble pop, or you will fall, all the way, back down...

title: Meathook
description: PSX-styled survival horror FPS meets point-and-click adventure game. You are bound to a sinister conveyor mechanism. Reach for weapons and items, navigate labyrinthine tunnels, and blast your path to worthiness!

title: The Story Is You: Look Within
description: A freely navigable and open first-person real-time 3D reflective experience. Come see what you see in you. Explore a beautiful and immersive environment that touches on lots of areas of life. See what resonates.

title: The Rose of Cravenmor
description: A gothic short story set in the most Blighted city of the North Kingdom.

title: Dark Witch Fighting Buster
description: Introducing the Majin Shoujo Fukitou Buster Prototype for the first time in a while. It's basically a 1 vs 1 game, but this is a "Battle Royale" that can be played by up to 4 people.

title: The Pancake Paradox
description: The story of two women, who make pancakes in the middle of a sandstorm, even though the planet is dying. is a bit short, right? ...then a story that has a little more than that.

title: The Nutcracker of Riepass: A Nymph's Tale - Episode 2
description: A fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel with jrpg battles

title: Speak, Lord
description:
Matthew 10:28 - “Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul.”

Is God truly there? Is God even real?

These are some of the questions that face practicing Christians each day.

Those who claim to hear the voice of God elate in worship. They spread the gospel

title: Hermit Night
description: A hermit living in the forest has his usual day. He is watching TV, and suddenly the program he was watching is interrupted due to an emergency. Due to an emergency in the country, which the authorities do not disclose, the hermit decides to act in order to survive the night.

title: Yellow Eyes
description:
Dive into the depths of a nightmare in this 3D horror game crafted specifically for the Gdevelop 3D Game Jam. Immerse yourself in an eerie and claustrophobic maze as you gather pieces of mysterious relics of unknown origin.

Be prepared, for there's something hidden within the dark depths and it is coming for you.

title: Bumptz Science Carnival
description: An educational science game from Theatrix

title: Fantasy World Manager
description: Build a massive-scale MMO-themed fantasy world where you design all creatures, objects, quests, events and dungeons. Watch the inhabitants of your world embark on their adventures.

title: Miracle! Panzou Uchu Daisakusen
description: A children’s PC action/educational game featuring the character Panzou. Players embark on a space-themed adventure where gameplay includes simple action challenges and mini-games. Designed for accessibility, it encourages younger players to download and play with parental help.

title: Arcade Archives: Assault Plus
description:
"ASSAULT PLUS" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
Take control of a tank and do battle with enemies! Using separate controls for your left and right treads, the game has a distinctive charm once you master its controls.
This title features minor upgrades over its predecessor, "ASSAULT," offering new stages to play while retaining the fun of the original!

title: Capy's Quest
description: Become the best chef on the summer islands!

title: Deer Hunting Camp
description: Deer Hunting Camp allows you to create your own private deer habitat which can be traded with friends! Once done creating, managing, and scouting your property you will be challenged with early fall bow hunting, late fall black powder hunting, and winter rifle hunting.

title: Doctor Simulator
description: The doctor's simulator. You will have to treat patients from various diseases. For each successfully cured patient, you receive funding. Improve your hospital, treat new diseases, diagnose symptoms.

title: Desert Tank Chaos
description:
Desert Tank Chaos – The Battle in the Desert Begins!

Can you survive the chaos in the scorching desert? Desert Tank Chaos is an action-packed tank warfare game! Fight your way through 6 uniquely designed levels, commanding your powerful tank against relentless enemies. But beware—it's not just rival tanks you'll face! Deadly aircraft patrol the skies, strategic watchtowers guard key locations, and enemy soldiers are ready to ambush you at any moment.

Use your heavy artillery, dodge incoming attacks, and find the best way to survive in the desert! Think tactically, plan your assaults, and conquer the battlefield amidst the chaos.

Are you ready, Commander? The desert awaits!

title: Masters Bowling HD
description: Multiplayer true-physics bowling game, up to 4 players

title: Sprint for Survival
description: Run like your life depends on it — because it does.

title: Valentine Revolution
description: Valentine Revolution is a high-energy, arcade-style shooter where you control Cupid in a heart-shaped hovercraft, shooting Valentine’s Day-themed objects like chocolates, hearts, and rings. Clear waves of romantic icons, dodge enemy attacks, and conquer increasingly challenging levels in this whimsical, love-filled adventure!

title: Twin Colliders
description: In this small arcade game, the player controls two catchers simultaneously—one on the right and one on the left. In the game, particles always move toward each other, and they must be caught at the point of collision using either the right or left catcher. If an annihilation is missed and it explodes, the player will lose one heart. Losing three hearts results in a game over.

title: Alien Cat Story
description: Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies in the game Alien Cat Story. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.

title: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing II: Extended Edition
description: In the second part of the unfolding Van Helsing saga that could also be enjoyed independently, you can explore new corners of this unique world and experience the mix of old-school gothic and mad science, with more action, powerful foes and plenty of stunning places to visit.

title: Little Ralph
description: Face an epic final boss in a challenging 2D platformer with precise mechanics and intense combat! Take control of Ralph as he battles a flying red skull, capable of summoning floating minions and dropping deadly spikes from the ceiling.

title: 3-in-1 Easter Collection
description: Dive into 3 exciting games from different genres that have something for every age group and every taste!

title: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Epic Edition
description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

title: Outbreak: Retro 2D Nightmares Collection
description: Is a bundle of survival horror games from developer Dead Drop Studios.

title: World War Z: Sin City Apocalypse Episode
description: A new story episode set in Las Vegas, featuring new survivors battling the zeke on the strip and in a casino! In the shadow of the outbreak, swarms of infected wander the empty streets of Las Vegas, while the living search for a way out.

title: Depths Debris
description: A walking simulator about a journey in search of the mother ocean. Control "Hoi-chan," a girl with a yellow hat, and collect hearts hidden throughout various locations.

title: RuinsStory
description: A high-speed action shooter that allows you to move at high speed and aim at the floor, wall, and ceiling. Combine various items to create your own build.

title: Fishing Master Kitty
description: You will play as a little cat whose dream is to eat every fish in the world! Pick up your fishing rod and grow from a rookie angler into a legendary Fishing Master!

title: Team Fortress 2 Legacy
description: Team Fortress 2 Legacy is a project that provides some post-2008 Team Fortress 2 features like items and cosmetics on pre-2008 Team Fortress 2 gameplay basis.

Immerse yourself in a grim post-apocalyptic world where survival depends on your skills, ingenuity, and determination. Explore abandoned streets, battle hordes of zombies, solve puzzles, and forge a path to the Central Hospital — your ultimate goal.

title: PomoFish
description: Are you ready to level up your productivity? PomoFish is a game that merges fishing and the Pomodoro studying technique! Work hard while Joe catches fish for you! Sell your fish to level up your skills and buy items.

title: The Count of Monte Clicker
description: The Count of Monte Clicker is an incremental game about breaking out of prison and finding treasure. With the help of fellow prisoner Abbe Faria, you, Edmond Dantes must escape the notorious Chateau d'Idle and claim your destiny.

title: Fruitgeddon
description: Blast through hordes of adorable yet deadly mutant fruits in this intense space shooter with bullet hell action. Shoot, dodge, and survive unique boss battles that push your skills to the limit. Only the strongest will uncover the truth behind the chaos. Are you ready to save the universe?

title: NiuMa
description: This is a third-person controlled combat game where figurines fight on the battlefield until the highest level figurine is born. The last surviving figurine will dominate the battlefield.

title: Cube Lab
description: Portal & Lock: A 2D Puzzle Platformer with Spatial Mastery

title: Free Dunk
description: "Free Dunk" immerses you in street basketball, celebrating individuality and competition. Build your legend, craft a dream team, and join global streetball leagues. Experience the raw joy of the game with controller support—hit the streets for epic battles!

title: Pay Your Crimes
description: Pay Your Crimes is a Tactical Management game with elements of real time strategy, you play as a mafia boss where you need to upgrade your drug dealers, buy dealers, and play with them to sell drug to the people, earn as much money as you can and bribe the cops maintain your freedom

title: Impartial
description: Impartial is an intriguing short 2D narrative game where you take on the role as a conflict resolver - tasked with resolving moral dilemmas between the Police Force and Superheroes to fight crime in Neo-Victorian London.

title: TableSoccer
description: A two-player game on a single computer, where both players control rods to kick the ball into the opponent's goal and score points. This game also features an impostor control mechanic.

title: Videoclub Simulator
description: Manage your own video store in this management simulator. Sell movies, organize shelves, and attract customers in a nostalgic experience inspired by classic video rental stores.

title: Allegro Molto wo Hakobu Game
description: A casual action game starring the Vtuber Allegro Molto and Lead the cat. Balance speed and care as you carry her safely to the live streaming room!

title: Cartoon Bash
description: Cartoon Bash is a horde survivor game where our dear protagonists who just died must fight to get another chance to get back to life. You equip multiple weapons and items, fighting off waves of enemies and bosses.

title: Three Kingdoms Front
description: This is an idle text game based on the Three Kingdoms. As the game progresses, the system will randomly trigger various events, and automatically trigger various military commands and various internal affairs facilities according to different development situations.

title: The Game of Bionic Goat
description: The Game Of Bionic Goat is a suspenseful story-oriented adventure game in which you manipulate the main character to interact with the scene and game characters, advancing the story through communication and choices with other characters.

title: Euplectella
description: A short Visual Novel. Player will play as a reclusive writer who explores in her own dreams by moving and clicking, listening to and recording the story of a dream-prisoner. As the story progresses, she can no longer remain detached ...

title: Cold War: Frontline
description: Join this multiplayer cooperative PVE tank shooting game, drive famous vehicles from the Cold War, and have the opportunity to fight side by side with players around the world. Now, start the engine, the order will come later!

title: Guild Receptionist: Good Luck
description: Become a guild receptionist and save the world! Or pay back your debts! This is a simulation game of a receptionist. Serve the King or turn to the Demon King, the future depends on your choice!

title: Taipei Midsummer Night's Dream
description: You will play as a young tourist from mainland China, and meet five female characters with different styles in a city that is both prosperous and quiet. Every choice is the key to a different ending - is it a sweet romance, or an emotional test full of twists and turns?

title: My Journey
description: This is a Interactive Live-Action Game. You will travel back in time to become a noble Highness and experience the local customs and practices of ancient times. A series of your choices will influence the development trajectory of this world.

title: Trapped Beast
description: Detective Iver investigates the case of a missing girl. As the investigation deepens, Iver is unable to escape and the secrets behind it are slowly being revealed. Can they escape from that crazy world

title: Hell's Cooking Joy
description: "Hell Cooking" is a cute mini-game of business simulation, in which players will play the manager of a Hell restaurant and prepare dishes that meet the needs of customers. In the game, you'll have to take care of the time to chop vegetables, cook them, and appease your guests.

title: Dumpling Together
description: Dumpling Together is a very easy click casual game.You can complete the level all the way with just a few clicks of the mouse.

title: Chronicles of the Great Wilderness
description: It is a multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) that combines multiple gameplay, allowing you to experience the fun of hanging up easily in the cultivation world.

title: Miracle Squirrel Club
description: In Miracle Squirrel Club , you can experience the unique stacked tower defense gameplay, building your tower of heaven, weighing the height and turret performance, and applying unexpected turret Build combinations to easily destroy all enemies!

title: Queen Ant Perfume Episode 0: The Mad Love of Jack the Ripper
description: A visual novel game set in “London at the end of the 19th century” and “modern Tokyo”. The game depicts a love episode between you and a male suspect that “Watson-kun,” the assistant of a famous detective (you), witnesses while investigating a threatening letter sent by Jack the Ripper.

title: Into The Corner
description: A geometric-style tower defense game where your defenses persist beyond victories, becoming permanent strategic assets. Build defenses, repel attacks, expand territory, and snowball economically to gain tech and military advantages.

title: Galaxy Express Chaldea
description: It appears every time I find "true happiness" on the night of the Galaxy Express... This is a visual novel game that helps you discover the brilliance of life.

title: Battle of Emperor Tian
description: "Battle of Emperor Tian" is a casual tower defense game. In the game, players can skillfully place these turrets. According to the characteristics and attack rhythms of different monsters, they can reasonably match the lineup to ensure the stability of the defensive line.

title: Fantasy Illness
description: Pseudo realistic visual novels,I'm Social livestock,Life is full of pressure and fatigue, feeling dissatisfied and confused about the current situation,can only escape reality through fantasy,The spiritual world is hovering on the edge of distortion and collapse.

title: Eternal Tree
description: "Eternal Tree" is a turn-based combat role-playing game that tells the story of a journey spanning the Divine Era and the modern age. A grand epic, unknown challenges, and the continent of Titalyera await your exploration. Your adventure will shape the future of this world.

title: Survive Till 100 Years Old
description: How hard is it to "survive" to 100? This match-3 strategy game brings the answer with fun and challenges! In the game, players must use match-3 mechanics to gain nutrition, maintain health, and acquire skills to survive. Wisdom and strategy might help you achieve the goal, but luck is indispensable!

title: Huanu Poems
description: Huanu Poems is a multi-ending love adventure game. As a photographer, carrying the secret of being a bloodline inheritor of HuaNu Town, you will take lovely Peach to run a B&B, encounter gentle Cloudia. Your choices will affect the direction of the story.

title: Button Cat
description: [Button Cat] is a comprehensive game that consists of several mini-games [horizontal board jumping, snake eating, jerking off, big fish eating small fish] connected into a plot

title: Midori Budou-den
description: Friendship! Effort! And victory! This is the ultimate battle formula! Even NORMAL is difficult, but there are difficulties VERY HRAD! Climb up! There are two peaks of boobs, but there is only one peak of grapes! ...Oh, if you find it too difficult, you can take your time and clear it on VERY EASY.

title: The War Zone Crisis
description: The War Zone Crisis is a third person shooting game for online online combat on the Internet. The game supports remote online games through the steam platform. In the game, players play the roles of red and blue teams of anti-terrorism special forces。

title: Memory of Time
description: This is a science fiction detective themed visual novel game, where players need to play the role of a "detective", connecting seemingly unrelated events and discovering mysterious truths hidden behind them, Please survive, and walk with your head held high towards the 'perfect ending' you expect.

title: Kare Kano Trial: Toki wo Kakeru Toki-meki Daisakusen
Touhou Danmaku Shunsatsu Gekijou: Shoken Koroshi ni Inochi wo Kakete
Dream Management Company
description: Guard every trapped soul. Step into the realm of dreams, and clear away the nightmares. DreamControl Inc—wishing you pleasant dreams!

title: Adventure Book in Dimension
description: Adventure Book in Dimension is a turn-based RPG based on the novel Wonderful Dimensional Journey. In the game, you as a new member of the human wizard team "Tribal Clan", experience the main adventure story of the "Tribal Clan" in a magic book given by your predecessors.

title: Abyss Pact
description: Abyss Pact is an adventure fighting RPG,where you become a talented heroic warrior to protect the last remaining pure land, and embark on your own legendary path!

title: Paintbrush Warrior
description: Once upon a time, there was a kingdom of drawing paper. There, the prince and princess lived happily together. One day, the devil appeared, and the devil took the prince. So, at the request of the princess, the paintbrush brave set out to fight the demon king and save the prince.

title: Wandering Dreams of Yuri
description: She becomes Alice of the fairy tale world and joins forces with the mysterious Zixuan to explore the twisted world of fantasy: name-grabbing factions, invisible witches ...... In their light-hearted adventures, they gradually uncover the truth and endeavour to return to reality.

title: Your Majesty's Arrival
description: A high-simulation emperor simulation game with a real game timeline. From the first perspective of the simulated emperor's accession to the throne, he governs the government, manages officials and concubines, raises children, conquers the world, and experiences the life of an emperor.

title: I Love Spelling!
description: Building spelling skills becomes fun-and-games as you bop from planet to planet with your hilarious game-show host. An intelligent tracking system automatically adds misspelled words to your own personalized list, to give you extra practice where you need it most. With over 5,000 key words and 50 spelling-pattern word groups I Love Spelling! is based on core curriculum lessons, to match what kids learn in school. Words are divided into spelling lists that teach you the basics so you can apply it to almost any word in the English language.

title: Mouse Work
description: Quit mousin' around and get yourselves down to the job centre! Team up with friends or go it alone, facing a range of mini game challenges using the Switch 2 mouse controls. Each job features unique mechanics making full use of the Joy-Con 2’s cursor functionality.

title: Rammy's Great Adventure 1&2 Remake
description: The full remake of the randomly generated dungeon RPG "Rammy's Great Adventure 1 & 2" is here! Join tomboy treasure hunter Rammy for hidden treasures. Revamped controls and UI, nostalgic pixel art. Challenge Mode, new foes, encyclopedia, color options, and online rankings.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Shadow Under Thunderholme
description: Explore the dwarven city of Thunderholme and defeat powerful dragons and their allies. This is a premium quest collection with two raids, a large adventure area for hunting monsters and the ability to craft thunder-forged weapons. Part of D&D's 40th anniversary "Tyranny of Dragons" event across multiple products.

title: Avara Aftershock 1.5
description:
Avara Aftershock is a standalone modification of Avara, made by fans with the blessing of Ambrosia Software.

Primarily inspired by Team Fortress, Aftershock features different classes with their own strengths and weaknesses, with a focus on team play.

There is also an entirely new set of levels built-in, there are some interface alterations, there's a new splash screen, and there has been some visual and audio alterations/enhancements.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Vault of Night
description: A premium six-part quest series, culminating in an epic raid battle against a red dragon. The story revolves around recruiting the lost Laughing Knives companions to help infiltrate a heavily fortified vault. This was the first raid added to Dungeons & Dragons Online.

title: HotCarts
description:
HotCarts is a 1-player go-kart racing game for Macintosh.

The player races against three other opponents on a track. Split screen allows for 2-player games. There is a track editing program for creating custom tracks.

title: GrimKeep
description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

title: Remanence
description: Explore several Large slaughter maps that have seen better days. Ancient ruins lost to time, rediscovered for better or worse.

title: Dragon Nest Classic
description:
Dragon Nest imposes FPS game control that uses WASD and Mouse so it brings fast view change and character movement more than other action games.
Also Dragon Nest arranges a character at left side of screen that make players can see character's movement and opponents attack action more easily.

title: You Are The Code
description: A programming puzzle game where bugs are eating away your code! One problem: YOU CAN'T TYPE. Navigate and run pre-existing lines of code to make your output match the goal!

title: Samly's Merge
description: Easy to learn, hard to master. No time limits. No rush. Just relax and merge in pixel-art goodness.

title: Hole Digging Master
description:
The rules are as simple as possible - dig the hole. Dig deep. Deeper than you can even imagine.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty, because there's real treasure waiting for you in the ground. Start digging and miracles will happen. You have no idea what could be under your lawn.

Everything you find can be sold and used to upgrade your tools or buy new equipment to help you dig faster and find more.

Can you reach the true depths?

title: SkyFighters 1945
description:
SkyFighters 1945 puts you in the cockpit of a World War II-era fighter plane and sends you off to do battle in the skies over Europe or the South Pacific. You can embark on any of 30 missions, each with unique objectives, diverse topographies, and distinct enemy planes. The game supports network play by as many as eight players on a LAN or the Internet. You can also compete head-to-head in a dogfight against a computer-controlled aircraft.

SkyFighters lacks the intricate flight-control systems that high-end flight simulators offer, and its garish graphics sometimes give the game a cartoonish feel. But the mechanics of flying aren’t difficult to master, and the animation is fast and fluid, even on low-end systems.

title: Gost! Buster
description: Gost! Buster is a horror game in the genre of psychological thriller, inspired by Russian mythology. You will have to become a ghost hunter, explore the places where the evil dwells, collect clues, determine the type of ghost and conduct exorcism rituals. Use special equipment, fix anomalies and uncover the secrets of the otherworld to rid the world of evil entities forever.

title: Little Big Adventure: Purple Empire
description: Twinsen’s journey takes him to Zeelich, a bizarre planet ruled by a pompous emperor with grandiose ambitions. Master magic, outwit eccentric foes, and navigate a world where danger meets the absurd. Unravel a cosmic conspiracy in this whimsical, action-packed adventure!

title: Rebel Spirit!
description: The main character is a graduate of the prestigious magic academy, but as it is often to find a job was an impossible task, but he was able to correct the situation! To do this, he will have to teach three students his magical style.

title: Train Simulator Classic: CR400AF Loco Add-On
description: Get ready for some Chinese high speed, 21st-Century-style!

title: Little Spaceman
description: Control an astronaut, a collector of space relics, and explore the mysteries of the universe. Travel through nebulas, dodge asteroids, and discover rare artifacts while facing the challenges of deep space.

title: Leaforia
description: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

title: Ikarus Parkour
description: Ikarus Parkour is a precision 3D platformer set within a deadly game show. Climb the massive 850-meter vertical tower, overcome its obstacles, and claim the fortune that awaits.

title: Sitting
description: A linear narrative game blending card gameplay. Players follow a plot, choosing and replacing cards each round to advance the story. Every decision impacts the ending.

title: What's Needed
description: This is a casual 3rd person shooter game that includes shooter combat mechanics for the playable humanoid, mech and tank. Explore the open world, chat with the quirky inhabitants, and shoot down the monstrous creatures and dangerous rogue robots wandering around the island.

title: Pushing It! Together: Sisyphus Co-Op
description: Roll a boulder up a hill with your friends, in this Online Co-op adventure based off the ancient Myth of Sisyphus.

title: The Ninth Forset
description: This game is designed for Ninth Games' VTuber Kuiri Lulu's birthday. Players will take on the role of Kuiri Lulu, who receives a mysterious invitation on the eve of her birthday. She wakes up in a foggy forest and must find the correct path to reach her birthday party.

title: The Most Perfect Revenge in the World
description: I made one request to the devil, to make my teacher suffer for what he did...

title: The Mad Pantser
description: The Mad Pantser is more than just your typical survival horror game. It’s a tongue-in-cheek, point-and-click journey filled with unexpected twists, mini-games, and a healthy dose of satire. While you may find some creepy moments, this game isn’t about making you sleep with the lights on—it’s about keeping you on your toes and laughing out loud.

title: The Lost Desert
description: The Lost Desert is a online multiplayer shooter game is made in the Blitz3D game engine. It works on basically any PC hardware with windows on it. It is mainly for windows 95-98 but works on XP and above to 11.

title: The Losers Team
description: Lu Yunjie, a junior high school student, annoyed the school bully group by accident. But he also got a powerful superpower unintentionally. With this power, he challenged the bullies, triggering a series of funny events

title: The Lighting Ages
description: RPG adventure game where player mission is to find skulls to finish levels and also accomplish different quests and avoid enemies

title: The Legend of Tomoko
description: In this game, you have to defeat various monsters that have invaded the village and the nearby forest. Can the villagers return? You can use swords, cast wateR and Fire magic. reading this description carefully could be strong weapon to defeat your enemies.

title: The Last Farewell
description: This game is a hidden object puzzle that combines story, psychological horror and reality.

title: The Last Bug
description: The Last Bug is a casual battle wargame, in which you can select a champion among many cute bugs and use their unique skills to defeat your opponents in a randomly created arena filled with random events. May you rise from the fair battles and become the strongest and cutest bug in the Jungle!

title: The Hunting!
description: The Hunting! is a turn-based strategy RPG focused on managing and developing new heroes. Train your heroes so they are ready for the final battle.

title: The Human Test / Restart
description: Two games in one! - Prove you are not human by completing 9 impossible challenges. - Explore various scenes directly inspired by a poem, solving a few riddles along the way.

title: The Horrors at Castle Wülhein
description: Take the reins as the renowned psychic detective, Taylor Lafosse, in this interactive horror novel. Unravel the dark secrets buried deep within the mysterious Castle Wülhein.

title: The Grave Keeper
description:
You have been hired to manage a graveyard in the mountains for 10 days.
The company that hired you says you're supposed to take care of one task each day, working during the day for three days and then at night for the next three days.
And if you notice anything out of the ordinary, you are to return to your quarters immediately and report it to the company by phone.

After reporting the anomaly, you're told you can go to sleep without doing any work.
But be careful, you shouldn't call the company if nothing unusual happened.
Beware, if you fall asleep without finishing your work or reporting anomalies, you'll be stuck with a day that never ends.

title: Sword Dream
description: Sword Dream is a role-playing game system which allows players to create their own scenarios. It was originally released in 1993. The game was later upgraded and became Sword Dream 3D.

title: The Future is Ours
description: You're going to spend 3 days at summer camp! Explore the camp, do camp activities and get to know your fellow campers as you learn about LGBTQ+ issues and more in this storytelling adventure. But, a dark secret awaits

title: The Friendly Droppets
description: The Friendly Droppets is a simple physics based puzzle game. Take your time. Rotate and position the Droppet and let it fall.Fill the gauge to move to the next level and try to collect a new item in each level.

title: The Ethereal Dream
description: An otome-oriented multi-ending AVG. In the blue moonlight, encounter the souls of those who have passed away.

title: The Dreamscape
description: Explore The Dreamscape with the help of Statan Industries and their tech, as you venture into The Range to experiment with different Scapers and items!

title: The Dragons' Twilight III
description: Join Trace and Mila as they unravel the mysteries of Mystrift Isle. Dragons have suddenly reappeared, and magic has returned to the land! Life, while peaceful and prosperous, had become complacent, but now, adventure awaits!

title: The Doors
description: This is a gambling and exciting clicker for memorization and luck. Click on the doors and collect all the crystals before the time runs out. Roll the dice. It will open the randomly dropped number of doors. Remember what's behind them, open others at your own risk.

title: The Devil Ball
description: It is a 3D game whose story revolves around a world where its people are magical orbs surrounded by magic and wonders, ruled by the Celestial Orb Kings.

title: The Depths of Avalon
description: Join Arthur and Merlin in The Depths of Avalon, a cooperative top-down dungeon crawler where you solve puzzles and battle enemies to thwart the dark plans of Morgan La Fey.

title: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season
description: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season is a pixel RPG where players guide the protagonist through cybersecurity threats . Using dialogue choices and mini-games, players must help the protagonist make the right decisions to ensure a safe enrollment.

title: The Cursed Hour
description: "The Cursed Hour" is a cooperative survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion to find cursed relics and exorcise the supernatural. With every wrong move, the ghost gets more aggressive, forcing players to work together before fear and darkness consume them.

title: The Cube of Love
description: The Cube of Love is an enchanting blend of strategy, creativity, and romance, where you become the ultimate matchmaker.

title: The Crimson Call
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian future, two young men set out on a journey to find The Great Appearance which manifests itself inside mankind's mind.

title: The Butterfly Collector
description: investigate the evidence left by a stalker and kidnapper and track the fate of a college girl. The player advances and watches the plot by clicking to make choices for the heroine at key moments, with different choices leading to different endings.

title: The BreakFive
description: In 1421, the seemingly peaceful Ming Empire is actually rife with undercurrents. As the capital relocation project progresses, numerous forces across the realm are beginning to stir. A massive conspiracy is quietly brewing, and the facade of peace and tranquility is about to be torn apart.

title: The Black Knight Chronicles: The Widow without Time
description: The Ancients left us with many secrets that should have stayed hidden...

title: The Big Adventure
description: Explore an entire fantasy world, explore Cat City the beating heart of cats, defeat small or huge bosses, also remember to give Astra some cookies or a cup of Tè before you leave.

title: Bakery Cafe Simulator
description: Bake, build, and grow your dream bakery cafe! Create delicious pastries, design your space, and serve customers. Play solo or with friends in online co-op to expand your business and experience the excitement of running a bustling cafe!

title: The Beyond
description: Your death was a tragedy... your afterlife is a mystery. Unravel the secrets of death with the help of Xochitl, your guide. Can you find your way through the doors of the great library of the Beyond? A new choose-your-path comic book by Jason Shiga.

title: The Backrooms: Anomaly Containment Unit
description: A first-person horror game with bodycam gameplay and tight controls. Explore the eerie, randomly generated Backrooms, catch anomalies, solve puzzles, and face atmospheric horror. Survive endless corridors in this intense PC survival experience.

title: The Armed Shadow
description: Shadows are the most dangerous creatures in the world

title: Bloodbark
description: Bloodbark is a short horror game based on the works of Eduardo Valdés-Hevia, a known horror artist. While specially inspired on his artwork "Bloodbark", many of his other works are also featured on this game.

title: Welcome to Brightville
description: 'Welcome to Brightville' is an action-adventure immersive sim in which you play as a unique automaton guardian. You will explore the mysterious city of Brightville, where magic and steampunk technology collide!

title: Drug Schedule
description: Build your empire! Cook and make illegal drugs, expand your cartel, and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Play solo or team up in co-op to dominate the underworld! Your empire, your rules. Rise to power! Don't get high on your own dope!

title: ZOA: The Zone of Avoidance
description:
A 3D take on Asteroids that finds you defending an orbital space station from damage.

You will have to deal with the deadly 5th waves (wave 5, 10, 15, etc.). A mother ship approaches your space station and you have to enter through an access tunnel in the rear of the ship and destroy its reactor core ... very difficult. As you progress through levels you can update various systems on your ship (to improve your engines, lasers, etc.). Also, more and varied types of enemy ship begin to swarm in on your space station - attacking you, pulling off segments of your space station, etc.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 8
description: The 8th season of Fortnite Festival, featuring modern pop icon Sabrina Carpenter

title: Princess Ursula
description:
Princess Ursula is a short and funny hand drawn adventure game with a folk tale theme. Through the game, the player will impersonate three different characters that each have an important role in the story's progression.

The Princess is looking for a husband but suitors do not abound. It is even said that many fear her. Who is this mysterious princess and will she be able to get married?

title: Band of Crusaders
description: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

title: Riven Crown
description:
Riven Crown is a dark, atmospheric Souls-like Action RPG where death is not the end but the beginning of a mythic descent through layered realms beyond life. Set in a decaying dimension ruled by a corrupt monarchy and haunted by the remnants of lost civilizations, the world is steeped in mystery, ritual, and the echoes of a forgotten society.

Blending classic Souls-like combat with a deep, combo-driven fighting system, Riven Crown introduces a fresh, high-skill twist to the genre. Each weapon comes with its own unique combo routes designed to be memorized, mastered, and chained together with precision. It's an approach that rewards muscle memory and strategic timing, especially during tense encounters with relentless, unforgiving enemies. We call it a “Souls-Fighter” a brutal fusion of methodical combat and stylish execution, built for players who crave both challenge and mastery.

title: A Way Home Uzy's Journey
description: Uzy's navigation system got damaged in a storm, now he and his friends are separated from each other and their home. Join Uzy solving puzzles and help out others along the way.

title: Ridge Racer 8
description: Cancelled mainline Ridge Racer title for Nintendo Switch.

title: Text Your Life
description: Who did you kiss that night? Text Your Life is a mobile phone chat simulator that lets you put yourself in the shoes of our protagonist, a female university student with a group of eccentric friends and a love life that has suddenly turned somewhat... complicated.

title: Text Wall
description: A block matching game. Blocks are selected by typing the matching keyboard character. Over time, new rows are added to the board and the blocks on the board drop further. Clear the blocks on the board before they reach the bottom.

title: TetriMatch
description: TetriMatch is a matchup of two popular games combined to make something new and challenging. Test your skill in this combination of Tetris and Match 3!

title: Tescaris
description: Create blocks and fill the board to clear each level. As new mechanics and power cards are added, the gameplay keeps evolving. Enjoy 120 levels, plus a new puzzle every day! Aim for the highest score and challenge players worldwide!

title: Orbital Descent
description:
Dive into Orbital Descent, a fast-paced maze challenge where every tilt of the maze can lead you to victory or send you spiraling off track. You're in charge of guiding a rolling ball through twists, turns, and obstacles as the maze rotates beneath you.

You can discover hidden shortcuts and speedrun tech to cut your time or find all the coins to go for 100% completion. With simple controls, you can try to master the maze. Use checkpoints to reset to a safe point, but remove the timer, to practice the hardest parts of the level and master the maze.

So jump in, pick your path, and see if you have what it takes to conquer Orbital Descent.

title: Events
description: Events is an anomaly-style horror game designed to challenge your cognitive abilities and test your memory. You must closely observe the monitored area, recall its original state, and report anything unusual. This includes anything that is misplaced, missing, or altered objects (e.g., furniture).

title: Plate
description: Rogue like monster battler where every decision counts.

title: Room Football: Wetlands
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Trump Jigsaw
description: Trump jigsaw is jigsaw puzzle game with Trump themed images

title: Over Shooter
description: In this numbers go up collectathon target practice shooter, one miss and you lose the game. Use and improve your aiming skills to get the most points and jewels and watch those numbers go up. Get more jewels and points the further your ship is from the target. Target gets smaller on each target hit.

title: Launch Dude
description: What happens when unstoppable strength meets zero limits?

title: Merge Pineapple
description: Click the mouse to explode fruits and ultimately synthesize a delicious pineapple!

title: Lights and Shadow
description: The player will take on the role of Shen Hao, experiencing a journey from being a bullied student to dropping out and starting a live streaming career. The surge in digital currencies makes you an overnight millionaire. How will you choose your path and carve out a unique life story?

title: Open Star Fighter
description: Open Star Fighter is a space-themed shooting game where players pilot starfighters to engage in intense battles against enemy forces.

title: Tower of Tori
description: 2.5D-DeathAction

title: Crimson Theory
description: Trapped between dreams and reality, you wake up in an abandoned house. Strange notes appear—written in your own handwriting. But something is waiting beyond these walls... where the real nightmare begins.

title: Monster Jam Showdown: Bad News Travels Fast
description:
Good news travels fast, but bad news travels even faster. And this truck is well aware of that. Originally born in 1998, Bad News Travels Fast is now roaring on the Monster Jam Showdown tracks.

This DLC includes:

Bad News Travels Fast with 2 liveries

title: Through the Wall
description: Through the Wall is a idle game made in two weeks as a fun challenge to help a friend learn how to make a hentai game. The game is short and compact but it has some cool animations paired with some good SFXs.

title: Pixel Transit
description: Pixel Transit is a game where you construct a transit system in an infinitely vast, tile-based world. Your goal is to design efficient transportation networks that enable people to reach their destinations as quickly as possible.

title: Foxxel Quest
