description: "我们想让玩家感受到，塔防不仅是数值游戏，更是武学智慧的较量。每个关卡都是江湖传说——用洪拳对抗东瀛忍者，以唐门暗器破蒙古铁骑，这不止是游戏，更是对中国武侠文化的沉浸式体验。"

title: Super Trailblazers
description: A fast-paced, local multiplayer arcade game. Race around a neon grid with your friends, strategically weaving through the trails of light you leave behind. Use clever tactics and special abilities like missiles, bombs, and invisibility to be the last driver standing!

title: Supershot
description: A retro game simple, complete and funny. Well projected and easy! Perfect for kids!

title: Super Orbital Mega Drift II
description: Defeat the Empire a second time in this short electro-jazz space shooter. Beat up bosses and upgrade your ship as you go deeper into the belly of the beast.

title: Super Dig Man Deluxe
description: Super Dig Man Deluxe is a digging game where you search for ores, rocks, gems and gold in order to upgrade your tools, buy ladders, and buy torches.

title: SuperCowBoy
description: This game is developed using Javafx. This is a 2D side-scrolling game. There are three professions in the game. The game is divided into 8 levels with gradually increasing difficulty, and the total game time is 20 hours. The game map is full scene, with a bright pixel art style high frame rate display

title: Summon The Dudes!
description: A quirky 2D puzzle platformer where your most powerful tool is… the DUDES!

title: Summer for You
description: Summer For You is a spicy 2D visual novel with lots of mechanics where you’ll have to win the hearts of stunning girls! Build your harem or find your soulmate, save your soul or go straight to Hell with a demoness!

title: Tamara
description: Tamara is a Dungeon Crawler with elements of Survival Horror in a Cyberpunk-Fantasy Setting. Explore dungeons, bunkers, castles and abandoned cities in search of loot and methodically fight your way against all types of monsters and machines.

title: Doeoriki
description: Doeo teams up with Gogoriki. Go, go! Doeriki! A collab between 4Kids TV and Raitendo.

title: Tedi şi Vehiculul Timpului
description: 3D-platformer arcade about Tedi, one of mascots of La Festa International company (now Maplex). Game features nice 3D-graphics and classic arcade-platformer gameplay on 11 big levels.

title: Lost Altr
description:
LOST ALTR is a solo rogue-lite card game set within the crumbling halls of a forgotten temple. You’ll face a series of Trials—mysterious encounters drawn from an ever-shifting deck. Each completed Trial leads you deeper into the Ruins of ALTR. Use Aspect cards to shape your fate—mysterious forces that grant you powerful advantages, but always at a cost.

Built on the foundation of the Scoundrel card mechanics by Zach Gage and Kurt Biegand, a heavily reimagined experience, LOST ALTR blends strategy, luck, and lore in a dark, esoteric world. The path forward is never the same. The further you go, the more the ruins remember.

Early Access will evolve with new cards, mechanics, and layers of mystery—shaped by feedback from those brave enough to enter the ALTR.

title: Deathblossom
description: Deathblossom is an action / kinetic novel hybrid about love and mortality. Enjoy visual novel-style written scenes and high-octane top-down action as you shoot, kick and blast your way through an erotic revenge thriller. Featuring a fully illustrated story by Zoquete!

title: Death In The Afternoon
description: In Death In The Afternoon, throw yourself into a night of drinking. You play as Arthur, a young student who likes to drink a little too much... Try to fight your addiction ! And choose your drinks and interactions carefully, or you might have the worst BlackOut of your life !

title: Death in the Gulag
description: Stories from the Russian Gulag

title: Deathly Dominion
description: Deathly Dominion is an intense survival game where players face endless hordes of zombies in a post-apocalyptic world. Each wave brings new challenges, requiring quick skills and well-thought-out strategies to survive. An immersive and challenging game for fans of the genre.

title: Death to the Universe: Act I
description: This game is for people who enjoy classic 3D Platformers, but also have an interest in indie games that combine storytelling, character design and gameplay. Death comes with abilities to challenge any obstacles. Shoot a hookshot to swing across gaps, or wield his scythe to shred any opposition.

title: Debt City
description: A retro open world life sim RPG. Explore a seedy sandbox city, and do anything you can to pay off a debt to a mob boss.

title: Decision Legacy Collection
description: All the games in the classic Decision series bundled together. From the zombie-ravaged streets of the original Decision to the brutal medieval battlegrounds of Decision Medieval, this collection delivers the raw, blood-soaked combat, base building, and survival gameplay that hooked Flash game fans.

title: Decorporate
description: Become the best weeb in the world!!!!!!!!

title: Deep Sea Pursuit
description:
Dive into the mesmerizing world of the deep sea, where hidden treasures await the bold and daring! In this thrilling underwater adventure, you take on the role of a fearless diver exploring the ocean's darkest depths. Your mission is to collect precious pearls and rare artifacts scattered across the ocean floor. But beware, a relentless octopus is on your trail, watching your every move!

As you navigate through stunning underwater landscapes, you'll need to dodge dangerous obstacles and outsmart the cunning octopus. The deeper you go, the more valuable the treasures you’ll find—but the challenges will also increase. The octopus grows faster and more cunning with each passing moment, making escape a true test of skill and strategy.

Featuring rich underwater environments, captivating graphics, and heart-pounding chases, "Deep Sea Pursuit" offers an unforgettable journey beneath the waves. How far can you go? Will you emerge victorious, collecting the ocean’s most elusive treasures, or will the octopus ensnare you in its powerful tentacles? The ultimate underwater treasure hunt begins now!

title: Deep Siege
description: Deep Siege is a fast-paced, first-person endless wave shooter. Play as Akula, an Atlantean sharkfolk warrior, and defend your underwater realm against waves of mutated sea creatures. Rack up kills to gain buffs using Bloodthirst or heal during tough moments.

title: Defenders of the Dune
description: Defenders of the Dune is a game about overcoming the wilderness and establishing a kingdom in defiance of the land itself. Players will fight to survive each day, experiencing the challenge and pride that comes with building up their base against all odds

title: Defend the Vault
description: You're a gun at a bank in front of a vault. There are robbers approaching to destroy the vault. You must shoot the enemies to defend the bank vault to prevent the robbers from getting in. Keep it going.

title: Demonophobia Company
description: 'Angel of glory, Gloria' joined the 'Demonophobia Company' with disguising herself as 'Demon of vanity, Burbary.' Could Burbary finish her mission and go back to her home?

title: Der Fachinformatiker Trainer
description: Computer Sciene Training Program.

title: Descenso
description: A very short adventure in which you will explore a futuristic world and a handsome deck.

title: Desktop Siege
description: 《Desktop Siege》 is a free tower defense idle game you can play on your desktop. Upgrade your base and defense towers to protect against endless waves of monsters!

title: Destroyer Burger
description: DESTROYER BURGER is the 4th best independent fast food simulator game of 2025! Featuring frenetic multi-tasking madness where you assemble burgers in the Kitchen and serve them up in the Front Desk, DESTROYER BURGER is a game of chaos management.

title: Desu Vult
description: A new power is rising on Flat Earth! Figure out who the villain is in this old-school turn-based strategy game and save its mostly innocent denizens with the help of the world's most unhelpful sidekick. Explore secrets, fight bizarre enemies and test your wits in this fantasy adventure!

title: Deva's Neverland: SideStory
description: The game portrays a magical world with three distinctive classes: warriors, mages, and sages. Warriors harness their martial energy for courage; mages wield magic power through their Magic Crystal Ball; and sages utilize the "Book of the Sage" to control the force of rules.

title: DevilReversi
description: "Devil Reversi" is a groundbreaking battle game that redefines Reversi. Two demon kings battle using humanity as their playthings. Utilize special abilities and magic in strategic matches with stunning graphics and immersive sound. Enjoy robust online multiplayer to compete with players worldwide.

title: Dice Making Ending
description: Does rolling the dice determine a person's ending?At every crossroad, we've all wondered about this at least once.Enjoy a casual game where you roll the dice and watch endings unfold.You can play various endings in just a short amount of time.

title: Dicks and Dragons
description: You will have to solve several puzzles for various erotic and hot themes

title: Digital Influence
description: You're hired in 2010 to create and manage a groundbreaking social media platform. Your decisions will shape its growth, user trust, and societal impact.

title: Dine 'n Bash
description: In a world of daunting beasts, brave heroes, and dangerous bandits, someone has to serve up the grub! Become the new owner of The Belligerent Dweller, the most popular tavern in the town of Thurgon. Dash around delivering orders, stacking items, and dodging projectiles that fly your way!

title: Dino Clicker
description: Tap repeatedly to crack open an ancient egg and collect 9 different dinosaurs, from common to rare and elusive creatures. Try out this addictive clicker game that challenges you to unlock them all through luck and perseverance!

title: Dinos TD
description: Prepare for prehistoric pandemonium as you command a dinosaur herd against an insect invasion! Control the battlefield by drawing paths, setting traps, and charting biomes. Discover a diverse cast of dinosaurs with a range of unique abilities. Get ready for a primordial tower-defense adventure!

title: Dirty Halloween
description: Dirty Halloween is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Discover
description: Travel and you can explore uncharted lands, collect resources and find some treasures in this relaxing game. And you may be able to find something interesting. Adventure and beautiful views of nature await you.

title: Eden: Discovery
description: Eden: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic free-for-all extraction shooter where 10 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out - or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.

title: Keplerian Space Discovery
description: Travel through the solar system in your own spaceship! The motion of each celestial body is accurately reproduced by the Kepler equation.

title: Discover Old D'Hanis
description: Step into the past and unravel the rich history of Old D'Hanis. Explore this 19th-century town, from Alsatian and German settlers of 1847 to Black and Mexican families post-Civil War. Unearth archival fragments, archaeological photos, and oral histories to piece together the town's alluring stories.

title: Lost boat: VR Underwater Discovery
description: This is a fascinating VR immersive submarine tour exploration game, which provides players with an unforgettable seabed shipbuilding and aircraft wreckage exploration experience.

title: Disseminate
description: This game immerses players in an anime-styled world where they take on the role of a male protagonist dressed in a suit uniform, exploring around residential areas.

title: Docaay
description: Docaay is a collectible card game where you draw, collect, trade, and sell cards. Collect them all, climb the ranks, and unlock exclusive rewards!

title: Doctor Dash ASMR Hospital
description: Your dream hospital awaits! Addictive levels and unique locations. Hours of entertainment in the time-management genre.

title: Dodgeball Circuit
description: Welcome to Dodgeball Circuit, a multiplayer dodge ball competition for two teams of up to 6 players each! Customize your robot's arms and legs for different performance attributes and super moves! Utilize a variety of moves to be the last team standing in the arena!

title: Dodgeball Dojo: Pusoy Dos
description: Play competitive card games inspired by Big 2 / pusoy dos with friends and family! Collect cool anime and manga Spirit Pets, and watch Athletes dodge, duck, dip, dive, and dodge!

title: Dodge It! 3
description: Dodge It! 3 is an intense 3D action game where your survival depends on fast reflexes. Navigate through a series of increasingly challenging obstacles. With sharp visuals and competitive leaderboards, it’s all about skill and precision as you dodge your way to the top!

title: Doge Head Attack
description: Doge Head Attack is a meme-inspired platformer that takes you through four unique and challenging levels. Face themed bosses and earn extra lives with fun mini-games. Dare to discover the secrets and challenges that await you!

title: Dominate & Conquer
description: Dominate & Conquer is a tactics autobattler set in a medieval fantasy world. Take on the role of a king and challenge rival kings for their resources. Build your army by choosing from a variety of units. Enhance your army further by creating synergies between units based on their skills.

title: Don't Shoot Politics
description: 2d shooter game where mission is to shoot items to collect points and avoid shooting politics

title: Dookie Clicker
description: Dookie Clicker is the most absurdly addictive game that unapologetically puts you in charge of a steaming pile of... well, you know. Your mission? Click the crap out of it and watch as your dookie evolves from a simple turd into a majestic, over-the-top, freak show of fecal artistry.

title: Doomba
description: Doomba is a sci-fi cleaning simulator adventure made from Ringling College. Your job? Clean the infected cargo ship and eliminate the source of the infection. Led along by the snarky ship AI, you'll pick up tools and upgrades along the way. Just be careful- In space, no one can hear you clean.

title: Make Your Country Dominate Again
description: Welcome to a global multiplayer meat grinder. This is a strategy game where you don’t just win — you collectively erase countries from a single, shared world map. Only one nation is allowed to survive!

title: Out of Moves
description: Every step matters... Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Ellphaser
description: An elephant, precise jumps, and a world that changes with every leap!

title: Marshmallow Marvin: Grimvault
description: Embark on a perilous adventure in Marshmallow Marvin: GrimVault, where haunted tombs, deadly traps, and ancient secrets await. Test your wits and agility and uncover the dark mysteries of the cursed vault!

title: Suika and Dragons
description: The moment of destiny has arrived—the dragon eggs are ready to hatch! As the revered Elder Dragon, it is your sacred duty to guide these young hatchlings, ensuring they grow, evolve, and rise to become majestic, unstoppable forces of nature. Will you lead them to greatness, forging a new era of dragonkind?

title: Cassette Beasts: New Wirral Edition
description: A perfect fit for savvy collectors is Cassette Beasts' New Wirral Edition! Includes the base game and all DLCs.

title: Commandos: Origins - Deluxe Edition
description: Commandos: Origins - Deluxe Edition delivers a unique experience for fans of the series, delving into the rich history of Commandos, a genre-defining series for the real-time tactics space, and adding some extraordinary goodies along the way.

title: Monster Energy Supercross 25: Special Edition
description: Be the first out of the gate! Pre-order the Monster Energy Supercross 25 - Special Edition and get 3 days of early access in addition to the Full Game, Season Pass and the two DLCs Stars & Stripes Pack and Touchdown Pack.

title: Monster Energy Supercross 25 x Monster Jam Showdown: Dirt Master Edition
description: Get the ultimate off-road experience, pre-purchase now Monster Energy Supercross 25 X Monster Jam Showdown - Dirt Master Edition!

title: Danganronpa: Hope Recration+
description: This is a fan-made April Fools' Danganronpa game, released on April Fools' Day. This game is a side story to the previous April Fools' game.

title: Dots Survivors
description: DOTS Survivors is a casual action game where you play as an astronaut exploring the cosmos fending off hostile aliens along the way! As you progress through each run you can choose from a selection of futuristic weapons that can be leveled up to increase power!

title: Down Abyss
description: Down Abyss is a two-phase adventure survival game where you play as a transforming robot who protects a little girl by collecting, climbing, and fighting.

title: Dragon's Dog Mother
description: A hilarious medieval fantasy adventure with an epic world that will immerse you. Strange and diverse monsters let you build a unique team, while the funny yet profound storyline will make you laugh and ponder.

title: Drag Racing 3D: Streets 2
description: The racing simulator created on game engine with a realistic physics and wide customization options. Create a unique car, installing new parts and tuning up car characteristics. Compete with other players in various tournaments on colorful race tracks. Prove that you are worthy to be a champion!

title: Dragrave Marauders
description: A classic JRPG style semi-open world game that let's you explore how you want. Choose from many classes, collect loot, complete quests, defeat foes and meet new allies along the way! "Frequent" updates to so you can come back once in a while to experience new content!

title: Drama Queens
description: JAE-WOO JEON, a naive freshman, happened to step into the p&m theatre club. Little did he know it was a club full of flirting campus queens. Will Jae-Woo be able to safely go through his bumpy campus life?

title: Dread It
description: Use your arsenal of traps to protect yourself as you exorcise the victims of the malevolent Pillar.

title: Dreamline 404
description: Thank you for calling the Dreamline Service Center. We are dedicated to providing you with the highest quality dream services. How may I assist you today?

title: Dream Rhythm
description: "Dream Rhythm" is an addictive rhythm game. Simple operation, beautiful songs, bring you a dreamy flow experience.

title: Dream & Sugar
description: Welcome to Dream & Sugar, a wholesome visual novel exploring relationships, love, and the transition to adulthood. Navigate relationships with unique dialogue and branching endings in this cozy LGBTQ+ friendly otome game!

title: Drift Desert Race
description: Drift Desert Race - A wild and chaotic game where you will embark on an 8-hour non-stop journey across an endless desert, all to discover the answer to the ultimate question: "What is the meaning of life?"

title: Drift On Snow
description: Who doesn't look forward to winter as much as we do?

title: Driving Around
description: Drive through serene landscapes to the sound of relaxing lo-fi. Choose to explore a vast open world or follow an endless road, with no rush, no limits. With stunning graphics, simple controls, and a calm atmosphere, this is the perfect game to relax and enjoy the journey.

title: DropDisk
description: DropDisk is a F2P Idle Clicking Game for collecting Floppy Disks. Click to gain XP, battle to gain more XP, the more XP the higher your level, the higher your level the better your Disk drops to collect and trade!

title: Ducky Runners
description: Ducky Runnerz is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer where you play as a determined mother duckling rescuing her stolen eggs from the malicious raccoon gang!

title: Dueholo
description: Rogue-like card RPG where you build your deck with cards of hololive members! Fight against holomem to strengthen your deck and defeat boss holomem!

title: Dungeon CEO
description: Take on the role of a Victorian-era Dungeon CEO. Manage resources, recruit monsters, and customize your deck to dominate turn-based fights. Outwit your opponents, acquire coins, and lead the Dungeon Company to victory in a world teeming with adventures and gods.

title: Dungeon Mana
description: In this turn-based roguelite, each run is unique: characters are randomly generated with different abilities. Combat revolves around three colors of mana: red, blue, and green, creating dynamic strategies. Overcome battles and face the final boss. Master the mana!

title: Dungeon of Love: Catch Monsters
description: Capture monsters, discover their human form, and fall in love with a unique cast of girls while exploring dangerous dungeons. Love has never been this adventurous!

title: Dusty
description: Dusty is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter where strategy and skill determine victory. Join intense battles in Capture the Flag, Team Deathmatch, and Free for All, with more modes coming soon. Choose your team, fight for dominance, and experience adrenaline-fueled combat!

title: Dusty Dunes Tycoon
description: Welcome to Dusty Dunes Tycoon! A VR Gemstone Tycoon game. Unlock and upgrade unique Droppers and explore different areas each with unique attractions. Grab a pickaxe and hit the mines, grab a brush and polish some geodes, or strap up and hit the range, there's much to experience!

title: Dusty's Sweeping Cleanup
description: Clean your way around the house as a robot vacuum with this action and racing inspired experience!

title: EarthClicker
description: Build your fishing empire in this relaxing idle tycoon game. Upgrade your boat, explore new waters, catch rare fish, and earn profits—even while offline. Master the seas and grow your Trawler's Empire!

title: Earth-Quack
description: Earth-Quack is an adventure focused game with some survival elements where you play as a young boy on a mission to save a group of lost little ducklings and return them to their worried mother. As you journey through these lands you will encounter many things that will both help and hinder you in your quest to save the ducklings:

title: Eat That Ice Cream
description: Eat ice cream with absurdly inefficient utensils in this silly and chaotic physics game with clicker elements. Get drops. Open chests. Recycle what you don't want. Progress further and further into the unknown.

title: Echoes of Madness: The Hawthorne Case
description: Detective Norman faces one of the longest nights of his career. Alone, he searches for the missing girl, Felicia, only to discover that this case runs far deeper than he ever imagined.

title: Echoes of the Iron Prison
description: Echoes of the Iron Prison is a platform game in which the player, through stealth and manipulation, must guide an amnesiac prisoner out of a steampunk prison while collecting shards of her identity.

title: Shellbound
description: Shellbound is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where life can only exist on a gigantic snail. Explore a vibrant world, fight bizarre flora and fauna and discover civilizations fueled by the powerful snail mucus. It is the key to your natural role: Devour everything so life itself continues to exist.

title: Baixos de Quebrada: Mobile
description:
Baixos de Quebrada (BDQ) - Mobile is a car game in the Drive style. In it, you will have the opportunity to customize your dream car, making modifications such as lowering the suspension, adding window tint, changing the wheels, and much more. If you want to change cars, you can save money by doing small jobs, and you can also find different special cars scattered around the map to cruise around.

Additionally, BDQ - Mobile features Role Play style missions that allow you to earn money to acquire new vehicles and customizations.

title: Haro no Daibouken
description: Dungeon RPG where you control Haro to take down Gundam characters.

title: Get a Body Language Expert, Pronto!
description: A body language expert simulator where you analyze videos brought to you by clients.

title: Platforming Experience Required
description:
Platforming Experience Required is a hardcore 2D platform game inspired by the 8-bit era of gaming with an emphasis on creative and varied level gimmicks. Play as Amanda, local locksmith, and help her with a specially difficult service call!

You can play this game either downloading it (versions available for Windows and Linux) or directly in the browser.

title: Sacrata
description: A dark-themed Roguelike survivor game where you must withstand relentless waves of enemies, craft powerful skill builds, unlock new survivors, and take on dark bosses. Claim sacred artifacts and experience an unparalleled thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

title: Okey.gg
description: Turkish traditional games Okey and 101, are finally on Steam. Enjoy them with your friends or try to win competitive matches and reach the top level.

title: Baking Bustle: Ashley's Dream - Collector's Edition
Neverway
description: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

title: Frostrail
description: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless open world survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

title: Enshrouded: Thralls of Twilight
description: Here we are with our sixth update! We’re thrilled to bring you Thralls of Twilight, a new update designed to make the Shroud more inviting and more dangerous than ever, adding some new gameplay mechanics, as well as a huge number of new locations to explore, and a bunch of gameplay improvements and additions. We've also updated a slew of locations and points of interest across the world, and as always, a bunch of miscellaneous other fixes and improvements!

title: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect x Dead Cells
description:
New Playable Character (Prototype) – The Prisoner
Step into the boots of the iconic Prisoner from Dead Cells, wield 27 signature weapons, skills and mutations from the original game as well as 20+ combo variants that pay tribute to other Dead Cells’ iconic gears.
Exclusive Challenge Biome
Dive into a new roguevania-inspired challenge biome built for The Prisoner, where Dead Cells’ fast, fluid combat meets BBEE’s satisfying combos!

title: Ballistik
description: A brick busting game with fireballs, bombs, and rockets.

title: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
description: The ultimate competitive platformer is back! Outrun, outjump, and outsmart your rivals in cutthroat online/local races, now up to 8 players. Master the movement, learn meticulously designed maps, use powerful pick-ups, swing around with a grappling hook, and don't get knocked off-screen!

title: X4: Foundations - Diplomacy Update
description: At the core of the 8.00 update for X4: Foundations is the new Diplomacy system, which will make the sandbox and economy simulation elements of X4: Foundations shine in new ways. The Diplomacy system is a deeply integrated new gameplay feature, built around three main components: A new embassy facility, a new class of hireable NPCs (Agents) who can be specialized in negotiation or espionage, and the ability to trigger and influence dynamic diplomatic standing between NPC factions.

title: Big City Adventure: Shanghai
description: Collect postcards, learn all about this historic city, play exciting mini-games and earn cool mementos. It's a hidden object trip of a lifetime.

title: Carimara: Beneath the Forlorn Limbs
description: You are the Carimara, and your mission is to conjure a ghost by answering their questions using your cards. A short and creepy fairytale, full of surprises and mysteries.

title: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

title: Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama
description: Become a Showstopper of SaGa legend in Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama

title: Katana Zero DLC
description: This isn't a Chronos hallucination - the free Katana ZERO DLC is finally nearing completion. Get ready to continue Zero's journey right where it left off - and glimpse into his murky past. Featuring all new characters, levels, gameplay and story, this massive DLC promises to be worth the wait. Come play, my lord.

title: I Mother
description: Embark on an adventure as a solitary Neanderthal woman in a prehistoric world devoid of language, inspired by the latest scientific discoveries. Decode prehistoric symbols, humanity’s earliest form of communication, and survive long enough to unravel the mystery of human evolution.

title: Percipio
description: Percipio is a colorful, joyful, and beautiful puzzle platformer. 12 creative levels pose increasingly complex puzzles as you navigate a gorgeous floating world.

title: Sengoku Koihime X: Otome Kenran Sengoku Emaki Koujou-ke Souran-hen
description:
Kensuke trained hard every day under the tutelage of his uncle Kazuto. One day, when he held a sword he found in the storehouse, he lost consciousness. When he came to, he found himself in a place he did not recognize. He met a girl who introduced herself as Oda Saburou Kuon Nobunaga. She held out her hand to a stunned Kensuke and asked him to become her husband and accompany her on the road to national supremacy.

They travelled across the country, racking up victories in this period of social upheaval. However, there was one enemy they could not defeat: the oni. These man-eating, blood-drinking beasts soon took over all of Japan, plunging the country into hell. However, Kuon and Kensuke vowed to continue fighting, issuing a written appeal to all the influential lords: “Samurai who are not afraid of even the oni, gather under me and let us save Japan together!”

title: Sengoku Koihime + Sengoku Koihime X Set
description:
Kensuke trained hard every day under the tutelage of his uncle Kazuto. One day, when he held a sword he found in the storehouse, he lost consciousness. When he came to, he found himself in a place he did not recognize. He met a girl who introduced herself as Oda Saburou Kuon Nobunaga. title: New York Mysteries: Power of Art - Collector's Edition
description: Laura is on a new mission to discover the history of the mysterious fantasy-world paintings, unaware of the monstrous plan behind this evenings mystical events. She can't handle such a difficult mission alone!

title: Arcane Path
description: Unlock 12 ancient artifacts, each bestowing special powers and a unique starting deck. Battle relentless automatons on your quest to the heart of the enchanted city as you uncover stories of an ancient book.

title: Chronicles of Albian 2: The Wizbury School of Magic
description: The Wizbury School of Magic has been burgled and the thief is on the loose! It’s up to you to follow the clues and track down the culprit. Collect items across campus and sell them at the local shop to rebuild Wizbury in time for the coming Magician’s Guild inspection. Meet a quirky cast of wizards, witches, students, professors, ghosts and ghouls. Upgrade every last part of Wizbury, from the drawbridge to the dirigible. Seek out hidden secrets across campus and even try your hand at spellcasting in Chronicles of Albian 2: The Wizbury School of Magic! * Hidden objects change each time you play a scene! * Meet a full cast of hilarious characters, fully voiced! * All-new unique Seek & Sprint mode * Check out our Blog Walkthrough

title: Rollick N' Roll
description: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist. Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for things to get a bit chaotic.

title: EasyAim Trainer
description: Lightweight design with endless customization meets heavyweight performance—all for free.

title: Off the Shelf!
description: Off the Shelf! is a hilarious physics-based romp made for maximum chaos! Launch a free ragdoll character into a frantic rush, knocking objects off shelves to rack up points. Master the art of Shelf Surfing as you jump, dash, and smash your way to a high score!

title: Suho Defense
description: Suho Defense is a top-view style defense game. Experience battles and cool characters, and win the game with strategic judgment and flashy battle play.

title: Succubus Challenge
description: Fight a succubus, a seductress who will unleash sexual attacks on you. Fight back with nothing but degenerate moves, including head pats.

title: Deep Space Bellhop
description: A cute turn-based-action game where your job is to transport strange and unfamiliar characters between floors in the galaxy's largest space hotel.

title: Sub0ptimal
description: Low ploy, linear, FPS shooter that is set in a simulation including physics based bullets and movement with a underlying story to discover. Sub0ptimal is a short game but has great replayability. Try to see how fast you can go!

title: Stronghold: Caverns of Sorcery
description: Deep beneath the earth, the dragon is rising! Quest into ancient caverns, learn magical lore, and draw strength from friends and family to save your home! A text-based interactive fantasy novel.

title: StrikeNet
description: A fast-paced, dynamic PvP shooter. Choose your strategy with a variety of weapons and dive into multiple game modes! Team up with friends or battle against others! Use buffs like shields, speed, super jumps and invisibility to dominate the battlefield!

title: Stray Sketch
description: " Where are we going?" You have a ticket to the exhibition. Find your favorite picture.

title: Strawberry
description: Strawberry is an engaging clicker game, your objective is to smash click the vibrant strawberry repeatedly. By clicking the Strawberry, you accumulate more Strawberries. Every 3 hours an additional strawberry drops, rewarding your persistent clicking.

title: Strange Pong
description: Strange Pong is a classic Pong game with the addition of new game mechanics. This game is a game of tennis, the player controls a racket and must hit the ball. However, each level has its own features that make the game more interesting.

title: Strange New Tides
description: Explore: Wander around Saltbay Cove and develop relationships with kooky and tasty-looking villagers. Earn Money: Fish, Gamble and collect geodes daily in order to earn your keep. Upgrade: Build your sandcastle kingdom from a humble trash-can-sized home.

title: Still Light
description: Welcome to the universe of dark, ominous hallways that seem endless. Explore alone, or with your friends with this horrifying first-person experience. You are safe in the Still Light.

title: Stele
description: Stele is a challenging and intellectually stimulating puzzle game where players need to utilize movable stone pillars and plan their routes to trigger a series of events, paving the way for a small square to reach its destination smoothly.

title: Steel Covenant
description: "Steel Covenant" is a 3D real-time strategy game. The game is set against the backdrop of World War II. Players can transform into Allied or German commanders, commanding multiple units to participate in battles

title: SteamForge
description: SteamForge is an indie clicker game where you farm diamonds by clicking an anvil. Use your diamonds to open mysterious creatures that drop valuable items. These items can be sold on the Steam Marketplace. Simple, addictive gameplay with endless opportunities for trading and earning.

title: Stay Alive
description: A deep web community celebrates Halloween with a live broadcast. Girls are kidnapped and forced to navigate a scenario full of deadly traps for the viewer's entertainment.

title: StartPlay
description: StartPlay is ultimate game creator for kids, allowing young minds to bring their imagination to life without writing a single line of code! user-friendly game builder empowers children to design, develop, and share their own games with players around the world.

title: Sonic Sky Chase Zone
description:
This is a Flash version of part of the Sky Chase Zone from the classic 1992 game "Sonic the Hedgehog 2".

Your mission is to help Sonic to kill 25 Valkyn badniks in each level in order to progress to the next one, and finally to take on Dr. Robotnik in an aerial battle. Use the Cursor keys (Arrow keys) to fly Tails's Tornado airplane towards the enemies and then use the Space Bar to make Sonic spin-jump off the wing to attack.

Be VERY careful though, because in this game the controls are reversed and are the same as in a real airplane!! You have to press the Down Arrow key to go UP, and the Up Arrow key to go DOWN!

There are twice as many badniks to kill in each level as in the previous one, and each time you defeat Dr. Robotnik in Level 4 the game returns to Level 1 and the badniks speed up.

Because the game becomes very difficult after a while, there is an invincibility cheat just in case you want one - press Up, Down, Left, Right + "A" in the title screen to activate it - Sonic will turn yellow and will be invulnerable to enemy hits if you enter the cheat correctly. (But since you can then never die, you will need to either press your keyboard's F5 key or click your browser's refresh button to reload the game and reset it back to "normal" mode.)

title: Scavland
description: Scavland is a hardcore, top-down pixel art survival game set in a Post-Apocalyptic Soviet Era. Explore a world ravaged by war and the deadly Mist, scavenging for resources, taking risky jobs, and seeking refuge in harsh settlements. The wasteland is relentless—everything is out to kill you.

title: Tomo: Endless Blue
description: Set sail through the Endless Blue, an ocean realm inhabited by mysterious creatures known as the Tomo. Team up with your companions to fight, or simply enjoy daily life. Build vehicles & contraptions to explore procedurally generated islands & villages, and meet unique characters!

title: Crushiator
description: An experimental arena battle game! Choose from 4 unique characters, smash 6 breakable objects, and race against time. Play solo or challenge a friend in local split-screen multiplayer! Indie game, designed and developed by a solo creator.

title: Driving Life
description: Driving Life is a hardcore driving survival game set in rural America. Earn money by driving manual cars, vans, and trucks, transport tourists, pay rent, buy fuel, and survive on a tight budget. Every dollar counts - spend wisely or go broke!

title: Kill the Twister
description: Jump, shoot, and throw a lot of barrels in this self-contained FPS boss fight against a massive tornado.

title: I Commissioned Some Frogs 5
description: I paid more artists to hide frogs and flies in 15 more pieces of artwork. Can you find them all?

title: I Commissioned Some Frogs 3
description: I paid more artists to hide frogs and flies in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Frogs 4
description: I paid more artists to hide frogs and flies in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all?

title: Shards of the Realm
description: Immerse yourself in a turn based tactical RPG/Strategy set in an expansive open world, where you manage a diverse party of heroes and construct formidable fortresses. Strategize in battles, explore vast lands, and lead your team to glory in a dynamic fantasy adventure.

title: Arcade Jumper
description: Arcade Jumper is a simple but precise platformer in which you have to reach the finish line at the highest point of the level as quickly as possible. Whether you make it to the finish line is up to you.

title: Dr. Suun
description: Dr. Suun is a thrilling horror experience that combines intense chases with mind-bending puzzles. Players step into the shoes of James, a man drawn into the mystery of an abandoned hospital with a haunting past. As he uncovers its secrets, the lines between reality and nightmare begin to blur.

title: Reclaimers
description: In this single-player roguelike, control an army of RECLAIMERS through a dangerous procedurally generated world. Recruit troops, collect resources, and craft upgrades to advance your army to fight orcs, trolls, and more monsters. Defeat enemies in battle & fight the Orc King!

title: Summit: Steps of Solace
description: Summit : Steps of Solace is an exhilarating mountain climbing game that requires precision platforming. Players embark on an epic journey to conquer the mountain by overcoming puzzle platforming obstacles and mastering climbing techniques.

title: Bubble Frog DX
description: Bubble Frog DX is a fun and challenging short Action Puzzle game where you take on the role of a Frog in a Bubble who's been tasked to save 160 Onigiri from all kinds of hazards across 50 levels and 4 colorful zones in this retro throwback title!

description: Enjoy the 5 extra festive levels

description: 50 new levels on a refreshed set of shapes

title: Chained Backrooms
description: CHAINED BACKROOMS is a horror game where players are chained together, forced to survive and explore procedurally generated Backrooms levels. Only coordinated teamwork can help avoid dangers and find an escape. Co-op for 1-4 players.

title: A Night Filled With the Sound of Rain
description: A rainy night brings you to a small bar. When you step inside, you're met with soothing music. Your eyes land on a beautiful woman by the counter. Get to know Michiru and share your story with her. This unforgettable evening will be etched into your memory forever.

title: EcoChess
description: Save the forest in this improved version of chess with new boards with obstacles and power-ups.

title: Edge of Reality: The Legend of Greenbush Collector's Edition
description: Can you save your friend from a sunken town’s curse?

title: Eggman
description: FEED EGGS. Drag eggs from your basket and feed them to Eggman. Keep feeding him until… well, no one's gotten there before. Could it be you?

title: Ekphrasis
description: Ekphrasis is a 2D puzzle game where you can solve and examine a collection of artifacts. Piece together historical artworks, arrange musical notes, and decipher codes. Uncover the secrets behind the artifacts and those that curated them through a branching story.

title: Electrial
description: Welcome to Electrial!, an innovative puzzle game based in electrical physics. You will clear levels by interacting with charged elements. Choose between a positive or negative charge, then launch it at an appropriate speed and angle to reach the target!

title: Elemental Defender
description: Elemental Defender is a tower defense game using card to power up your units. Build your deck and place powerful units to defend your base from passing enemies.

title: Elemental Guardians
description: The world has plunged into chaos after the altars were deactivated. As the chosen hero, only you can restore balance by taking the unique abilities from the Guardians. Harness their powers to bring harmony back to the shattered world and revive the altars!

title: Elemental Surge
description: A challenging action platformer in which players embark on an epic journey fighting their way to the top of towering castle to confront a once-mighty but fallen king. Immerse yourself in an experience filled adventure, danger, and magic!

title: Elf World Adventure
description: Elf World Adventure is an exciting hentai game in the anime and puzzle genre, offering numerous levels where you must assemble images of enchanting elf girls. Immerse yourself in a magical world with a splendid atmosphere, accompanied by relaxing and melodic music.

title: Elf World Adventure 2
description: Elf World Adventure 2 is a sequel to the addictive hentai game in the anime and puzzle genre, offering many levels in which you have to collect images of charming elf girls. Immerse yourself in a magical world with a splendid atmosphere, accompanied by relaxing and melodic music.

title: Elf World Adventure 3
description: Elf World Adventure 3 is the continuation of an exciting H-game in the anime and puzzle genre. You’ll enjoy many levels where you need to collect illustrations of charming elf girls. Immerse yourself in a magical world with a splendid atmosphere and relaxing melodic music.

title: Elf World Adventure 4
description: Elf World Adventure 4 is the continuation of an H-game in the anime and puzzle genres, immersing you in a captivating world inspired by samurai aesthetics. You'll enjoy many new levels where you collect images of beautiful elf girls dressed in exquisite outfits.

title: Elf World Adventure 5
description: Elf World Adventure 5 is the continuation of an H-game in the anime and puzzle genres, immersing you in a captivating world inspired by samurai aesthetics. You'll enjoy many new levels where you collect images of beautiful elf girls dressed in exquisite outfits.

title: Elohim Eternal: Exodus
description: Overthrow the corrupt emissary of the Kingdom of Heaven in this turn-based RPG with visual novel storytelling. This free game takes place a thousand years before the events of Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code. Before the Idinites and Cainites, there were the Misru and Simru, based on ancient Egypt.

title: Eloquent
description: This is a highly interesting parkour game where players will control an extremely cute penguin to embark on an adventure in a beautiful and dreamy ice and snow world.

title: El pasante elementalista
description: [VR Only] Escape room VR game where you embody a beginner magician seeking to graduate. Enter an ancient crypt to return the golden scroll using your powers and creativity. Extract elements, cast spells, interact with the environment, and combine spells to create new ones in this mystical adventure!

title: Embodied Tournament
description: Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of Embodied Tournament, an innovative auto-battle game where strategy and collection intertwine.

title: Empire Idle
description: In this game you will be harvesting resources, upgrading your buildings, waging war, and prestiging, Most mechanics in-game are automated. You won`t need to be active while playing it.

title: Enchanted: A Magic Shop
description: Welcome to your magical shop where you run a magical bookstore specializing in selling mystical grimoires. As you progress, complete quests are given to you by mystical creatures, and interact with various magical customers.

title: End Chess Arrow
description: It seems like Chinese Chess, but perhaps you can hold the entire game with just a crossbow. A strategy-based turn-based roguelike game.

title: Endless Defense: Survival
description: This is a innovative roguelike TD game made with the 『CliCli』. No need for path planning or tower combos—just one tower! With almost 100 weapons, you’ll be mowing down foes and dominating the battlefield. Enjoy the rush and let off some steam!

title: Endless Life
description: This game is a captivating puzzle platformer where players control a string of three square blocks that leap over gaps by pressing the space bar.

title: End Transmission?
description: If the world was ending, how would you spend your final days? Explore a narrative management game set shortly before the end of the world, about enjoying the time you have left. Play music, take calls, and help the town face the challenges of saying goodbye to those closest to them.

title: Entity Onboard
description: In this sci-fi survival horror game, you'll use tools such as a flashlight and tape recorder to survive while a mysterious entity chases you. Hide in the light and don't let it touch you. Power up each floor to escape!

title: Envguard
description: The aim of Envguard is to instill environmental awareness in students in a fun and effective way. Competing in two teams at Izmit 30 August Primary School, players collect recyclable waste and perform strategic tasks that encourage environmentally friendly behavior.

title: Ephemeral Night
description: Ephemeral Night is a challenging, colorful FPS trial game where you travel through extraordinary obstacles to embrace unique, colorful powers and aim to strike down the radiance of fluorescent targets.

title: Epoch of Guardians
description: In history, many brilliant civilizations faced annihilation due to the invasion of powerful empires, leaving only sighs of regret. In a fictional world, you will take on the role Guardian of Civilization. Can you help these civilizations grow and thrive, resisting the invasion of formidable enemies?

title: Epoch Makers
description: Step into the past and rebuild history with Epoch Makers, a cooperative renovation and restoration simulation designed for your buddies. Work together to repair, clean, and reconstruct some of the world’s most iconic historical landmarks.

title: Equality
