description: A 2000s styled dress up game with a dark twist.

title: Keyboard Soldier
description: A fast-paced action-survival game where you fend off hordes of zombies by typing words, level up to unlock powerful items, and strategize to survive as long as possible in an ever-challenging environment.

title: Kharakov
description: Explore forgotten land, climb on structures, view the scenery and interact with NPCs and environment to discover secrets and more lore from most recent campaign from BaniakBaniaka.

title: Kingdom Cum
description: KINGDOM CUM is a visual novel for adults in a medieval setting. There is a lot of sex and dangerous adventures waiting for you.

title: Shoot the Wall
description: Shoot the wall! Simple, right? Use your gun to blast your way through the wall, upgrade and change your weapons so you can shoot your way through the wall even faster!

title: Forgot to Poo
description: A dog that forgot to poo trying to poo at it's favorite poo place.

title: Williams Digital Arcade
description:
The first known arcade emulation available publicly was the Williams Digital Arcade series from Digital Eclipse Software, released for the Macintosh in 1994. This series featured the Williams Electronics' arcade classics Joust, Defender and Robotron: 2084. In 1995, it was repackaged and expanded upon as Williams Arcade Classics for the PC.

For these games, Digital Eclipse developed an interpreter that emulated the games' arcade machines' chipset, including the Motorola 6809 central processing unit. This approach was meant to have the emulations act true to the original versions of these games, and not carry any imperfections direct ports could have introduced.

title: Shadow's Gamble
description:
Description:
In Shadow's Gamble, you step into the boots of a skilled thief on a high-stakes mission to infiltrate the grand mansion of a corrupt duke. The mansion, known for its lavish parties and countless treasures, hides more than just riches—it holds dark secrets that could change the fate of the entire kingdom.

Your goal? To steal something precious from the duke, gather valuable loot, and leave without a trace. You’ll use your sharp wits and even sharper skills to navigate through the mansion’s labyrinthine halls and pickpocket the unsuspecting people.

title: Catastrophe: Earthquake
description: Trapped in a condemned building, you must escape before the earthquakes and collapses bring a tragic end. Survive the tremors, find essential items, and flee. Each tremor is a new challenge in this fight for survival. Time is running out...

title: Dream Prison
description: "Dream Prison" is a 3D horror escape game similar to Exit 8. Find the anomalous rooms and escape the cult church.

title: Angry Golf 2
description: sequel to angry golf. Try to shoot angry ball to goal, less quantity of shoots possible to beat all the levels. Avoid traps and falling from map in this strategic golf game

title: SnakeVib
description: SnakeVib is a modern twist on the classic Snake game, featuring regenerating food, rotten food to avoid, and a competitive computer snake. With unique mechanics like 'Tug of War,' arrow shooting, and increasing speed, every level offers fresh challenges. Can you master all 10 levels?

title: Soul Oath
description: Help Zeke on his quest to protect his hometown and live up to his lineage, as he will learn from love, pain, friendship, death and ultimately, life, in this classic RPG worth about 15 hours of playtime.

title: Normenhill: Chapter 1 - "Your New Look"
description: Normenhill is an Action-Adventure videogame with RPG elements about adventures in the World of Darkness, trust and problem solving without violence (Or not quite?)

title: Lootplot
description: Re-arrange items, discover synergies, bend the rules, and break the game! LOOTPLOT is a points-based, inventory builder Roguelite centered around items, which all have a unique twist.

title: Carrot Cake
description: Compete in the Easter games, solve puzzles, and escape the Easter Bunny in this PS1 style survival horror game!

title: Flushed
description: Flushed is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you awaken in an abandoned asylum. To escape, you must find hidden keys in each room while facing a shifting, unsettling world. Explore, progress, and question reality as the environment distorts around you.

title: Bound Survivor
description: Bound Survivor is a 2D pixel top-down roguelike action game. Combine weapons with “bond” tags to trigger powerful synergies and create your own combat style. Every run offers fresh challenges!

title: Russian Cat Simulator
description: Russian Cat Simulator is a meditative game that allows the player to take a look at the life of a cat and the surrounding world in realistic graphics. In this calm and meditative game, exciting adventures and the opportunity to feel like a real cat await you. In the game you will have to perform various tasks and errands: catch all the mice, steal the catch from the fisherman and much more! Sound accompaniment will add coziness and tranquility, making the gameplay even more enjoyable.

title: Parámetro Zero: Calígine
description: Calígine is a point-and-click graphic adventure where, as a detective, you'll investigate the disappearance of a colleague in the unsettling village of Risco de la Colina. What begins as a seemingly routine case will soon uncover dark secrets tied to the town's mysterious past.

title: Oroboros Square
description:
This game is based on real events.

Reality however, is a fickle thing.

Play through one of many lost dreams where you must escape reality.
You know nothing, and have to find out...

What lies underneath it all?

title: Clockwatching
description:
As an employee of an unremarkable supermarket chain... Your coworker "Feather Face" (otherwise known as Ted) has always been sort of... Well, weird.

Watch the clock, go through the daily motions, decide whether to talk to him. It's all in a day's work here. Although... Today feels different.

title: FNAF 1 Remake
description:
FNaF 1 Remake is a bite-sized FNaF Experience based on a lot of popular media surrounding the game in the current day.

This game was made for 2025's April Fools

title: Ooze Less
description:
A visceral interactive fiction game about being an ooze-creature in a human world and all the themes of feeling like an outside that creates.

"a lump in my throat that i had to get out with no heart and no head and no hope and no mouth"

title: Giving Yourself Away
description: An interactive fiction game about the choices we are forced to make in employment. You work at a depressing fishmeal factory as your think about what led you here and what could have been.

title: Maintenance
description:
You are a calibration inspector. Don't hold on to your memories and follow instructions. Contact your supervisor if you have any questions.

Hold N to skip any level. Press ESC to go to the menu; you can replay previous levels there. Your progress is saved between sessions.

An excellent single screen puzzle game with engaging mechanics.

title: Monster Survivors
description:
Survive, adapt, and conquer in a world overrun by monstrous creatures!

The world is overrun by terrifying creatures, and only the toughest will make it out alive! Battle endless waves of monsters, face massive bosses, and upgrade your survivors to become unstoppable.

Every run is a new challenge! Improve your stats, unleash devastating abilities, and buy epic artifacts as you carve your path through the apocalypse.

title: ANY SAND
description:
ANY SAND is vaguely autobiographical, inspired by Palestinian resistance & resilience, & owes its name to Rasha Abdulhadi's words & work.

Point-and-click through an old rowhouse in near-future Tkaronto; chat with your Gren about memories of struggling towards justice, at home and across incomprehensible distances.

title: The Royal Writ
description:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honor the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of diverse warriors with interesting abilities that shape your strategy. Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the food taster cow, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

title: Colorful Boi 2
description: Get ready for a pulse-pounding platforming challenge in Colorful Boi 2! With 74 meticulously designed levels, you'll test your reflexes, precision, and patience against a gauntlet of devious traps and hazards.

title: Arcade Archives: Tatakae! Big Fighter
description:
"Tatakae! Big Fighter" is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1989.
In this game, you can switch between fighter jet and robot form during battle.
The key to clearing a stage is to strengthen your ship with power-up items that appear along the way and change its shape to suit the situation.

title: Car Parking: Garage Simulator
description: Build your dream garage, customize every detail, and tune high-performance machines. Restore classics, fulfill client orders, and race your creations on streets and tracks. Car Tuning Simulator is your ultimate playground for creativity and car culture.

title: Crazy Cats vs. Crazy Cyborgs
description: In this arcade shoot 'em up game you play as Princess Anna, the savior of cat people. Fight against the attack of Crazy Cyborgs for 12 boss rush levels!

title: Airborne Ranger: FightOut
description: Gear up in Airborne Ranger: Fightout, a thrilling tactical-action game. Play solo or jump in 4-player co-op as you take on missions behind enemy lines—eliminate targets, gather intel, sabotage infrastructure and rescue hostages. Rely on skill, strategy, and courage to survive and make it out alive!

title: Ninja Party
description: Ninja Party is a free parkour action game from the creators of Shadow Fight and Vector. Compete with other players in fun challenges for the title of the best ninja!

title: Asuka: The Ascent
description: Enter Asuka’s world of intense street races across Japan’s iconic mountains. Tune and personalize JDM cars as you face fierce rivals, uncover secrets, and forge alliances. Follow a manga-inspired story filled with mystery where nothing is as it seems, until the very end.

title: Truck Driver: Gold Edition
description: Get the ultimate trucking experience with Truck Driver: Gold Edition! This definitive edition includes the Truck Driver base game, the Heading North DLC, additional paint jobs inspired by the USA, UK, Germany, and France, and the Hidden Places & Damage System DLC. Plus, enjoy enhanced visuals and performance, including faster loading times, improved frame rates, extended draw distance, enhanced reflections, increased world density, a smoother day-night cycle, and more!

title: Dig! Dig! Dino!
description: is a game about digging... for dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

title: Twist of Light
description: A puzzle game about rotating space and moving blocks.

title: H.G.
description: H.G. (Horror Game) is a PS1 style horror game inspired by P.T. and creepy photos of familiar places. Explore a looping mundane hallway with dark secrets to be discovered.

title: UFO Builder
description: Meet the new kind of UFO!

title: Occlude
description: Occlude is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious. Don’t worry; you can always start over.

title: The Flying Car
description: The Flying Car is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

title: Weed Drug Empire
description: Step into the shadows of a world where power is taken, not given. In this underground simulator, you're building more than a business—you're creating an empire from nothing. No cash, no allies—just ambition, strategy, and the will to rise. Every move matters. Every mistake leaves a mark.

title: Klostyn
description: KLOSTYN is a sci-fi shooter that stays true to the late-'90s FPS style. The protagonist fights alien creatures and space pirates on a distant planet.

title: Leyline Chronicles
description:
Lambert, Devan, and Jaskya are Ley Sensitives, gifted people with supernatural abilities.
But what is the story behind these powers?

Join 8 different characters on a journey where they learn more about themselves,
their talents, and how they are part of a larger plan that will decide the fate of the
world of Orphania and beyond.

Leyline Chronicles is a classic JRPG and a tribute to the retro RPGs of the 90s.

title: Army Bus Driving Simulator
description: Your task is to safely transport soldiers between bases through difficult routes, overcoming off-road terrain, checkpoints and other obstacles.

title: Breakpoint: Viper Squad
description: "Outsmart. Overload. Dominate." Viper Squad brings high-stakes strategy to a futuristic FPS. Build your squad, master unique classes, and experience the explosive Overload Mode. Your skills, your legacy, your battlefield. Add Viper Squad to your wishlist and change the game.

title: Are You Awake?
description: As a result of your insomnia, you can never sleep. You can only complete your work or kill time playing video games. With the inability to sleep for the past few days, you start hallucinating strange realities. Realities that aren't possible, yet feel like they make sense.

title: Back to Saturn X Episode 2: Tower in the Fountain of Sparks
description:
Back to Saturn X is a series of megawad/partial conversion projects for Doom II, designed to be compatible with DOOM2.EXE. Created by the Back to Saturn X Team, it features an exclusive texture set, original music, and a new palette and colormap.

Back to Saturn X Episode 2: Tower in the Fountain of Sparks was beta-released on 1 September, 2014, with another twenty-two levels, a secret level, four episode hubs and an ending screen. It received one of the 2014 Cacowards. Its final version was released on August 14, 2020.

title: Convicts
description: Principality of Carantania, 753 AD. The times of Slavic paganism in these lands have dried up, and the ancient gods are gone, along with all those who believe in them. You play as a simple peasant boy named Gavrila. That night, he must look after the pagans in prison. Seems like a simple job. But what could these underground stone corridors hide?

title: Pages of Time
description: Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Play as the witch who controls the magic of time, in a beautiful and magnificent magic academy, utilize the skills of recording and rewinding time, solve all kinds of puzzles, and look forward to the adventure of the future.

title: Sayonalaika
description: My grandmother went to space—and came back. After that, the world began to spin, round and round...What was this country, this society, meant to be? We simply process the things that come our way. What was the world supposed to be like? I don’t know. SAYONALAIKA is an adventure game.

title: Kingdom of Piss
description: Join two punk-rock royal heirs, Pretty Piss Princess and Asian American, as they dodge their royal duties in favor of adventures. This hilarious visual novel, inspired by TROMA films, follows the duo as they navigate the absurdities of royal life, and embrace their rebellious spirit.

title: King of the Pirates
description: Embark on an epic journey in sea war, a thrilling naval combat game where strategy, skill, and bravery determine your fate on the high seas. Command your own ship, upgrade it, and become the most feared pirate captain of all time.

title: Knight's Pride
description: This game isn`t rich story-wise! It plays almost as much as Knights and Dungeons another game of mines.... This is also not an Idle game and battles aren`t automated. This game is about actively doing repeatable tasks to unlock new content such as new gear and new enemies.

title: Knockturne
description: KNOCKturne is an RPG game that tells the story of the protagonist's adventure to free a boss with many emotions in his dreams and escape from there.

title: Knuckle Knockout
description: An action-packed 2D platformer fighting game for 2-4 players. Brawl with friends across three unique maps with the first player to win three rounds taking the crown!

title: Kombi
description: Kombi is a fun, minimalist, grid-based puzzle game. The aim of the game is to move tiles across the board, picking up points along the way, in order to end up with a single tile with a value that matches the number of the target tile.

title: Konchi
description: Konchi is a clicker game played by clicking on various acquired Konchis. Get a random Konchi every 30 minutes to increase your collection. We are also looking for Konchi designs on Discord! Your design may appear in the game. We look forward to hearing from you! Discord: https://discord.gg/tJ6w6Jsu

title: Kosmolaris
description: Kosmolaris is a relaxing puzzle game where you'll have combine a wide variety of elements to create new ones, starting with four basic elements: Air , Fire , Earth , and Water .

title: Krax Ca-caw's Concoction Chaos
description: You are Krax Ca-caw’s new intern. Learn the craft of potion brewery, memorise the recipes, and become the next best potion maker. Fill the cauldron with the correct ingredients and stir. Don’t let it overflow!

title: Jianghu Diary
description: The game recreates the ever-changing scenes of the ancient martial arts world. Players can experience rich gameplay in the game, such as freely exploring the rivers and lakes, making friends with various heroes and heroes, and challenging various martial arts masters.

title: Landonia
description: Developed by a one-man team, Landonia is a single-player, turn-based RPG that includes exploration, loot, factions, level grinding, and class-based progression. Your characters can interact with each other to help -- or stop -- each other in the land of Landonia!

title: Lanesplitterz
description: Lanesplitterz is a 3D arcade-style bowling game. Join Hiro as he competes in a brutal bowling tournament to become King of Neo Las Vegas!

title: Last 22
description: Last 22 is a thrilling survival adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world. In a land ravaged by zombies, bandits, and scarcity, you must protect your family by gathering resources and making tough choices.

title: Last Definitive Fantasy
description: A parody to shabby made RPG Maker games and homage to old classics of the J-RPG genre.

title: Empty Human Beans
description: Short dystopian horror game with multiple endings. Your phone would never lie to you. There is no way out.

title: Latent Experience
description: Latent Technology's first tech demo. A journey through different worlds built with Generative Physics Animation technology, featuring, for the very first time, fully physical and interactive characters.

title: Latent Leftovers
description: Latent Leftovers is an arcade puzzle game where you play as an underdog wizard crafting potions from leftover reagents. With help from a mysterious benefactor, master 9 unique scenarios and rise to the rank of Arch Wizard—all for free!

title: Latex, Leather, Lipstick, Love, Lust
description: A self-described "chronically online" trans guy goes to a kink club thinking it will fix him. It doesn't.

title: Launch & Loot
description: Launch & Loot is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler with vibrant pixel art, where each room is procedurally generated. Use the environment to your advantage by throwing objects and loot to defeat enemies. Discover unique power-ups that change your playstyle with every run!

title: Lawnmower Day
description: A simple collection game with spawning tokens and enemy

title: Lawnmower Game: 2024
description: Lawnmower game saga is back. Drive now original lawnmower vehicle, cut grass, hang around and collect items in this story which is based now to futuristic food place

title: Lawnmower Game Jigsaw
description: Lawmmower game jigsaw is jigsaw puzzle game with lawnmower game themes

title: Lawnmower Game Racing 2: Drunken
description: Sequel to lawnmower racing game. Drive now against stupid ai opponents in this world slowest racing game. Try to finish tracks and collect achievements

title: Lazer Tag Arena
description: Join One Man Makes Games for the release of my latest title "Lazer Tag Arena". A free-to-play, multiplayer, peer-to-peer, free-for-all Arena Shooter, which is heavily inspired by the laser tag aesthetic and playstyle. Play with up to 6 friends people per lobby.

title: Leaf Clicker: Grow Your Green Thumb!
description: Grow Your Green Thumb! Click the leaf to earn crops, then use them to buy tools and upgrade them. Each tool boosts your crop yield, turning your leaf into a lush paradise. Start clicking and watch your leaf flourish!

title: Legend of the Dark War God
Lethal Women: World of Femdom and Espionage
description: Lethal Women is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel full of spies, dominatrixes, fetishes, and sex. Sex scenes range from vanilla sex to hardcore femdom gangbangs. You're Agency’s golden agent Kris. Travel the world, fight your nemesis, and experience sex with various lethal women.

title: Let's Build a Garden
description: Create your dream garden with . .is a Unreal 5.2 production、Realistic style、Full map、Pure construction casual game, high degree of freedom construction system, exquisite 3D graphics, allowing you to experience the fun of construction in person.

title: Let's Play Cards Baccarat
description: Let's Play Cards: Baccarat is a thrilling and exciting card game that is perfect for players who love strategy and luck.

title: Letters from the War
description: Modern reimagining of text adventure games with a new gameplay and multiple endings. Censor letters coming from soldiers at the front and make the history of your nation.

title: Lifetakers & Heartbreakers
description: "Lifetakers & Heartbreakers" is an intense 2D side-scrolling shooter set in the war-torn world of Pavlovia.

title: Lift/Shift
description: In Lift/Shift, you're a research agent documenting a strange apartment where objects constantly change. Use your specialized camera to stabilize reality across multiple floors.

title: Lightmatter Anniversary
description: Join us for a walk down memory lane with never-before-released Lightmatter prototypes. Get a peak behind the game design curtains and learn how we made a first-person puzzle game about lights and shadows.

title: Light the Candles in Hell
description: Light the candles in hell, a journey for those you hold dear.

title: Liminal Death
description: Liminal Death is a first person psychological horror game with liminal space environments where you will experience what will happened when someone falls in coma and gets trapped in between worlds, you will have to fight through a maze and find your path to get to the other side.

title: Literally Just Pixels On A Screen
description: Welcome to Literally Just Pixels On A Screen. In this "game" you get to collect pixels. That's it.

title: Squids in a Pickle
description: Uh oh, looks like there are squids in a pickle!

title: Ines
description: Experience a unique psychological horror set in the 90s with retro style. Solve complex puzzles and uncover ominous rituals of a secret society. Immerse yourself in someone else's past and feel deep emotional pain and fears. Face your own demons and uncover dark secrets that will keep you on edge.

title: LSD Battlefield Simulator
description: Experience the most surreal shooter ever made. LSD Battlefield Simulator, the mythical 12th installment in the #1 best-selling FPS franchise Tour of Honor, is finally here—remastered and unleashed after 25 years in the vault.

title: The Boba Teashop
description: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.

title: Earworm
description:
In the depths below, an underground artist called DJ Earworm is struggling. Looking for a chance to prove his skills, he takes on gigs fixing the loops of various quirky producers. Your mission is to help him match the beat, combine loops into a diverse set of songs and make DJ Earworm a household name!

Earworm is a unique new rhythm game spanning multiple genres and 16 unique songs. Start with a beat, loop back around to add a lead and finish it off with a catchy melody! These randomized microgame-like challenges get progressively faster and harder, with different modifiers constantly changing the way you play the game.

Earworm was created for the GMTK Game Jam 2025.

title: Smol Kobold Garden
description: Collect, breed, and train small creatures known as kobolds. Expand your garden and compete in a variety of mini-games in a cozy creature raising game.

title: I Can’t Stop Gooning and Jorking to My Virtual Girlfriend
description: How long will your budget last when your cruel virtual girlfriend starts demanding absurd amounts of money in exchange for mercilessly teasing you? Submit to her and give her all of your hard-earned money, or try to resist your cruel virtual girlfriend.

title: Rabit
description: RABIT is an arcade style platforming game with retro graphics and a mysterious atmosphere. It's central mechanic is the ability to toggle certain object on and off at the click of a button. This along with several other movement abilities allows for some devious and exciting platforming sections.

title: The Edge
description: Trapped on a drifting boat in the open sea, uncover a chilling mystery as you follow a distant vessel that slips further away while you get closer to the truth.

title: Backrooms: Hide Together
description: A visually realistic 1-7 player co-op survival horror game. Explore 5 levels filled with confined environments, puzzles, and entities — with new levels and content added regularly. Beware of terrifying moments and ruthless monsters. Do whatever it takes to escape, even if it means hiding.

title: Tsugunohi: The Chamber of Phantom Name
description: A new graduate, Kana Sakuragi, begins her new life in a renovated old house, "Akembara House." What seemed like a shiny, ideal property soon turns into a nightmare, as she is plagued by strange phenomena every night...

title: Davis Haunted House
description: Davis Haunted House is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a haunted house that was built during the 1970s, haunted by demons and other evil spirits.

title: BodyRecords
description: BodyRecords is a chilling horror experience, blending bodycam immersion,microphone sensitivity to your voice, and eerie spaces. Work together with teammates to solve puzzles, evade lurking horrors, and escape. True cooperative play and unsettling atmosphere make every moment a tense challenge.

title: Tomb Offering
description: A thief broke into an ancient Chinese tomb, harboring ill intentions to plunder its treasures. The tomb was filled with countless riches of gold and silver. You trespassed into this grand tomb, driven by greed for wealth. Remember: "As you act, God is always watching you."

title: Rusted
description: Rusted is a Linear horror game. You wake up after coma, but something isn't right. Everything is worn down and there's rust everywhere. How long have you been out for? Figure out what happen and find your way out. But be careful, you're not alone.

title: Encrypted_Nightmares
description: Inspired by found footage films, you control a live-stream broadcast in the dark web. Will you capture the most thrilling moments, or will the horror be too much to handle?

title: A Mirror, Darkly
description: Explore your surrounds in this short narrative using a novel mechanic to find objects in a mirror's reflection

title: Neuro Nightmare
description: Neuro Nightmare is a horror game that utilizes brain-computer interface technology to maximize immersion. Run all the levers and escape from boarding schools, running away from monsters. Your concentration and stability directly affect gameplay.

title: Framed Fear
description: You must discover the differences between what you see through the camera and with your own eyes to distinguish real floors from fake ones and escape. It is said that ghosts behave the opposite of humans, and taking the elevator is no exception.

title: Beat Ball
description: An arkanoid-like indie game made to promote the creator's music.

title: The Truth of a Snowy Night
description: This is a single horror game that collects the horror stories of people who have climbed Everest. Play it if you want to have a similar experience to them, or if you think you can handle it. You never know where the truth lies in extreme horror.

title: Sharks and Minnows
description: Find supplies to maintain your stamina. Complete ten laps. Escape.

title: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga
description: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.

title: Slide And Perform
description:
Slide and Perform is a short platformer with a sliding mechanic.

The sliding mechanic allow the player to jump higher. You can also slide further if you started sliding in air.

To finished the game, you just need to reach the top and grab one of the three orbs.

title: Not My Floor
description: You get into the elevator... You press the button... Oh, looks like this isn't your floor! Explore strange floors of an unknown building. Who knows, what waits for you there...

title: Fèitǔ Xiǎohóngmào
description:
"Feitu Tonghua" First Chapter.

Stories that take place in a wasteland world following a nuclear war.

title: Kid Blocks
description: Just like when you were little.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Roving Among Clouds
description:
Version 8.2 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter VIII: Till the Long Road Reaches the Sky
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Peregrine Sword (Li Sushang)
• New Featured Event: Yunchin's Culinary Wonders
• New Reworked Battle Pass System
• ...and more!

title: Bouncy Egg
description: Bouncy Egg is a physics-based puzzle game where you have to move the springs, platforms, conveyer belts, and more to get your egg into the basket. The game has 40 levels to challenge your brain. Are you smart enough to figure out how to bounce the egg into the basket?

title: Hired Explorer
description: Game from STUDIO-Van

title: Jensen Strikes Back
description: Jensen Strikes Back is a fast-paced action platformer with tight controls and satisfying evil robot-destroying combat, featuring a variety of weapons and a variety of levels with unique challenges. Fight through a world overtaken by a mechanical army while also working out your own complicated feelings.

title: Uh Oh Airlines
description: Uh Oh Airlines is a silly, casual, single player or couch co-op flight attendant simulator where you and a friend perform normal flight attendant duties, but must also wrangle your passengers to make it through the day.

title: Confidential Killings
description: A series of murders is shocking Hollywood! Use your detective skills: search the crime scene, find clues, solve the mystery. Who is pulling the strings behind these Confidential Killings?

title: Nikoderiko: The Magical World - Director’s Cut
description: Jump into adventure in Nikoderiko: The Magical World - Director's Cut, a love letter to platformers! Play in single-player or couch co-op, and enjoy 8 colorful worlds, classic platforming challenges, and music by legendary composer David Wise.

title: Wireframe Warfare
description: Wireframe Warfare is a Singleplayer Action/Tower Defense hybrid game created by a solo developer over the course of a year. Blast and strategize your way through various levels, combating waves of viruses attacking Cyber Beacons across the pathways of a digital space.

title: The Beast of Lycan Isle: Collector's Edition
Knight Cats: Whisper of the Universe - Collector's Edition
Election Day
description: Make new friends, convince the citizens of Votaria, and run for mayor in this humorous 2.5D paper-style RPG! Play as Viktor the Dino, explore the island, and fight the corrupt mayor's henchmen in tactical turn-based battles.

title: Dooms
description:
Dooms is a serial killer simulator made in RPG Maker 2000.

On a rainy night, a man named Bob catches his wife cuckolding him in bed with another man and, driven by rage, kills them both. Over 30 years later, he escapes from prison and, together with his new partner Jack who disguises as a clown, they begin a brutal killing spree.

Two versions of this game exist, the original one from 2002 that was lost until 2022 and another one almost made from scratch in RPG Maker 2003 in 2010.

title: The Flowertest
description: Welcome to Mr. Nose’s Flowertest, the ultimate challenge for master florists. Six contestants enter, but only few will win the chance to survive and be the best in town. Do you have what it takes to craft the perfect scent?

title: Potrick Snap
description: you clean potrick house but there is something strange in the house but potrick did't want to tell you what happend in this house

title: Overwatch 2: Season 16 - Stadium
description: Enter the ultimate battleground with Stadium mode, an all-new experience where customization takes the reigns in a fun, best of seven, round based fight. Then, celebrate the launch with the Stadium: Initiation seasonal event to unlock exclusive rewards. Plus, the relentless bounty hunter Freja arrives as the latest DPS hero, bringing precision and mobility to every match. Meanwhile, the battlefield transforms with stunning skins, from the Dokiwatch team—led by Mythic Heart of Hope Juno—to Legendary Ashe, Genji, Brigitte, Lifeweaver, and Mauga in the Premium Battle Pass. Whether you’re outwitting opponents in Stadium, hunting your prey with Freja, or wielding magic with Dokiwatch, this season is packed with action, strategy, and a whole lot more.

title: Last Epoch: Tombs of the Erased
description: Experience epic endgame updates, face off against brand-new and fearsome bosses, and unlock a trove of exclusive items and Uniques. With groundbreaking quality-of-life updates, this is the most extensive update Last Epoch has ever seen. Don't miss out—jump into the world of Eterra

title: Beach Buggy Racing 2: Tesla Edition
description: Exclusive to supported Tesla vehicles, Beach Buggy Racing 2: Tesla Edition features a whole new driving experience (while parked, of course!). Tesla owners can play their very own cars in the game, with their actual customization options like paint color and wheel rims. Cars can be controlled using the actual steering wheel and brake pedal, on-screen touch controls, or USB-connected gamepad controllers. You can even play 2-player split-screen with driver and passenger(s).

title: Xenosaga Pied Piper Recreation
description: A fan-recreation of Xenosaga Pied Piper, which originally released in Japan in 2004 for mobile devices using RPG Maker featuring an overhauled battle system based on Xenosaga Episode III as well as no random encounters.

title: Potrick Snap 2
description: You Finally Escape From Potrick but Police man want To Talk With YOU

title: Mix Universe
description: A musical sandbox game where you play as a Mixonaut adding beautiful vibes to the universe. Everything you hear and see is 100% real-time and editable in-game.

title: Stevo Life
description: You're a drunk man named Stevo. You just want to drink rakija but you're already drunk. You have to go buy it and come home fast before your wife comes back. What could go wrong?

title: Build It: Miami Beach Resort
description: Build your own beach resort right where Miami began. Starting in the 1920s, every year is a new level. Build wonderful art-deco hotels, newly invented cinemas, the first fast-food diner and, decades later, giant hotels right on the beach. Design everything the way you'd like to see it over the course of 60 years on a huge scrollable map.

title: Devil Spire Falls
description: The role-playing experience, where you can do anything, of your dreams... as if it came out 30 years ago!

title: Bubble Shooter Adventures
description: Aim precisely and clear all the bubbles as fast as you can.

title: I Want to Go for a Walk
description:
I like going for walks.

I use them to sort through my thoughts, to try to make sense of them, but lately that hasn't seemed to help as much.

title: Ghost Hunters: Collector's Edition
description: Capture ghosts in a tech-infused world full of mysteries and adventures.

title: Secrets of Salem: Shadow of the Witch - Collector's Edition
description: A hidden object puzzle adventure. Uncover Salem's dark secrets as Dakota battles shadows and her fate.

title: Dino SpeedBoat
description: Crazy arcade game, with loveable hero - Dino the dinosaur. Try yourself in a wild race against time and ride to the victory.

title: Incredible Dracula: License to Relax - Collector's Edition
description: Prepare the Dark Dreams Hotel for its grand reopening in this time management game.

title: The Stickman
description: The Stickman is a movement-based FPS inspired by Titanfall 2 and Trackmania! Shatter PvE leaderboard records, battle friends in PvP, or create custom stages with the built-in Level Editor!

title: Abyss Kitchen
description: Abyss Kitchen is a survival action game in which you play the role of Lop a cook who accompanies a party of adventurers, and guides them with the power of food. Feed yourself in the dungeon and eat whatever you can to keep from starving and falling down. Eat up anything that stands in your way!

title: Infinite Rails
description: A railway-building adventure in an endless, procedurally generated world. Lay tracks, transport passengers and goods, complete tasks, and unlock unique locomotives. Play solo or with friends and create your ultimate railway network!

title: La Pasion XR
description: “La Pasión XR" takes guests on an ephemeral, audio-reactive journey through the Gateway Chamber Orchestra's Spring 2023 performance of Osvaldo Golijov's La Pasion según San Marcos.

title: Wild West Pioneers
description: Follow the American dream and start settling in the frontier with the city-builder Wild West Pioneers. Build and manage your ever-growing villages, establish production chains as well as outposts and build trade routes to support your cities and outposts.

title: Drill Space
description: A survival mining game where gravity shapes your journey. Explore a vibrant, randomly generated solar system, mine for resources, upgrade your ship, and defend against alien invasions.

title: Aperture Narbacular
description: A re-imagining of Nuclear Monkey Software's 'Narbacular Drop' built from the ground up for Portal to celebrate Narbacular Drop's 20th Anniversary.

title: Galosphere
description: Galosphere is a mod that aims to improve the underground by adding new content such as new biomes, mechanics, mobs... etc.

title: Vampire Master
description: As a Vampire Master, you will command an army of undead, conquer powerful realms, and build an empire under the cover of night.

title: Sejm The Game
description: Become a member of the Polish parliament, create a powerful party and lead it to victory - get a taste of power and don't let anyone take it away from you!

title: Born Into Darkness
description: Amber Blythe is the night curator at the Bostonian Museum, where she is happily surrounded by artifacts and relics of the past. Considering she's spent the last two hundreds years as a vampire, she feels right at home. When the new assistant curator, Nathaniel Black, invites her to help him find the legendary Shroud of Lazarus, the two embark on a worldwide hidden object adventure that may ultimately result in Amber regaining her humanity.

title: Bubblefish Bob
description: You're Bob, and you must save your fishy friends by matching three same-colored bubbles before the fish inside reach their awful fate. Beware of giant piranha-like guppies waiting to gobble up your friends unless you can free them in time by breaking and matching the bubbles. Collect falling treasures to bolster your score and gain lives to free more fish.

title: Breach Signal
description: Breach Signal is a 1-6 Player Co-op Psychological Horror game. Enter a special unit operating for The Agency, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

title: Watching Paint Dry: The Game
description: In this game, you watch paint dry in real time. There's also some other things but it's mostly about watching paint dry. Have fun.

title: Boutique Boulevard
description: It's time to upgrade clothing stores and impress customers. Hire staff, pick clothes, and personalize your store with hundreds of decorations. Experiment with fabric and colors to discover new clothing. Train your staff to improve their skills in greeting, sales, and more.

title: Masters of Mystery: Crime of Fashion
description: The New York fashion world is turned upside down when detective Carrie Chase discovers that a famous fashion designer has been murdered. She soon comes to the frightening realization that a serial killer is at large with an eye for design and a thirst for murder. Masters of Mystery: Crime of Fashion is a thrilling hidden object game with an intriguing story, stunning environments and visual effects, unique investigative tools, and cunning puzzles.

title: Jikoronpa: Laments of Isolation
description: Jikoronpa: Laments of Isolation is a fangame for the series Danganronpa from Spike Chunsoft. It has no official relations to it and is completely non-profit. This game may contain sensitive topics or implied mentions of topics such as abuse or suicide. There will also be depictions of gore as well. If you may feel uncomfortable with these things, please exercise caution before playing. (Up to Chapter 3 Trial)

title: Of The Lilies
description: When the curses that only come once a century suddenly resurface, you are tasked to stop them—with a choice that also forces you to face your past. Explore a lore-rich world with 5 possible love interests, and decide if choosing your own motives over the greater good is worth a single sacrifice.

title: Danganronpa: Survivor's Guilt
description: Danganronpa: Survivor's Guilt is an in-progress Fangan (a Danganronpa fan game that follows the DR formula with original cast and story) made in RPG Maker MV by Aru & Raven. It is a sequel to Danganronpa: LIVe or Die , but is a standalone game and can be played without any knowledge of the prequel. The game up to chapter 3 (of 6) is available for download.

title: Liminal Game
description: Experience that nostalgic/uneasy feeling liminal images present by progressing through the game. Find the keys to open the doors and explore distant dreams.

title: Campfire Legends: The Last Act - Premium Edition
Cases of Stolen Beauty
description: Journalist Eva Sanders has been sent to Rio de Janeiro for Carnival. After numerous strange events take place, she realizes she is being framed. Can you help uncover evidence in this hidden object game to restore her reputation?

title: A Lakeside Walk in the Dolomites
description: A solitary evening walk along one of the most beautiful lakes in the Dolomites. The air in Alleghe is crisp, the stillness envelops the path, and the water glistens with the last rays of the sun. Suddenly, the silence shifts. It grows dense. A noise stirs in the woods, a shadow slipping beyond your gaze. Is solitude your only company? With every step, you venture further; at every corner, another piece of a lost mystery unfolds. As you move deeper into the unnatural quiet of the forest, doubts creep in. Are these really just old stories? And the lake... the lake watches.

title: Call of the Ages: Collector's Edition
description: History itself is in peril! The Calendar of Ages has stopped working and it's up to you to fix it. Travel through 8 countries, solve 150 levels, witness history and collect artifacts in this match-3 game.

title: Dapithapon
description: Dapithapon is an interactive story-driven game where the player follows the story of a doctor, the new public hospital head struggling to keep the hospital in a functional state. Frazzled over the sad realities happening within the hospital, he is forced to go against his beliefs and question the integrity of his sworn oath. Solve puzzles to help the Doctor hold the hospital together in his pursuit to give its patients a better life.

title: Dora Is Dead
description: Dora the Explorer meets the horror genre! For some reason...

title: Arcane Investigations
description: It's after midnight on the Quartzway Express, and there's been a MAGICAL CRIME! Investigate the crime scene, question suspects, and defend the accused through unique cross-examination puzzles in this "Phoenix Wright" inspired mystery comedy

title: Ninja Hayate HD Remaster
description:
Encounter relentlessly-attacking ninjas, their ninja dogs, zombie samurai and more, all whilst avoiding countless deadly traps in your mission to save the princess from the evil ninja clan who kidnapped her in this thrilling, interactive anime adventure!
First appearing in arcades in 1984, Ninja Hayate was Taito's 1st Laser Disc game, and this release features visuals remastered from the original laser disc.

title: Lady Knight Quest
description: When the city-state of Marito falls on hard times, it submits to annexation by the expansive Vanderland Empire. But not all in Marito are pleased by their new overlords, and dissent is brewing. Felicia Arde, a stoic and accomplished imperial knight, is given an important task: go to Marito and win the support of the people by any means necessary. Leaving behind her fiance, she travels to unfamiliar shores to carry out her duty...

title: Tenebyss
description: Enter the world of Tenebyss, a dystopian gothic castles world that is flooded by thick mist and clouds. A world where Dark Souls and Risk Of Rain meet each other. Play alone or with friends, gather loot and prepare for your next dungeon! Customize your character and enchant your weapons.

title: Hiyoshi Clinic
description: The newly renovated haunted house, Hiyoshi Clinic, is the star attraction of Horizon Amusement Park. Journalist Eiji Sakuma visits for a report but is drawn into eerily realistic scares. Guided by a child's voice, he encounters strange phenomena.

title: Eternal Survival
description: Eternal Survival is a Horde Survival game, where you enter and level up taking power and destroying enemies, collecting gold to buy more passive power to your character and can participate on hardest runs

title: Omori: The Dreamer
description: THE DREAMER is an OMORI mod (fan sequel) set immediately after the good ending. While telling the truth, SUNNY passes out due to his injuries, returning to dreaming, despite his choice to let go. HEADSPACE is now empty of any residents...or so it appears. Remember to stay alert, and pay attention. Some things aren't yours anymore.

title: Wuthering Waves: Fiery Arpeggio of Summer Reunion
description:
Version 2.3 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Zani and Ciaccona
• New story quests
• First anniversary celebrations
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Lover Interface
description: A 29-year-old ordinary guy, Ethan Syu works as an on-site computer engineer by day and runs a struggling personal video channel by night. On his way to a filming location, he gets into an accident. When he wakes up the next day, he discovers a mysterious user interface occasionally popping up in his vision, seemingly showing him the affection levels of certain people around him...

title: Danganronpa: Hope Restoration
description: Danganronpa: Hope Restoration is a fan-made Danganronpa game being created using RPG Maker MV. Completely unaffiliated with the official Danganronpa brand, games, or Spike Chunsoft.

title: The Circle Move
description: Explore a strange and mysterious world and challenge your mind with intricate puzzles with The Circle Move.

title: Roxy's Dream Mansion
description:
Roxy wakes up at home but soon she realizes that this place is not her home.

Help her face her fears in this mystery and puzzle video game. Join Roxy on her adventure inside a mysterious mansion.

title: Eclipsic
description: A terraria adventure survival clone developed by rar

title: Doobie
description: Doobie is a cartoon-style horror survival game by FiX Studios, where you're trapped in a room with strange creatures known as Doobies. Armed with a flashlight and a few throwable objects, your goal is to find a randomly hidden key across the map and escape before the Doobie(s) catch you.

title: Pet Hero vs. Zombie
description:
The zombie apocalypse is here! Choose your animal warrior - a brave cat with a gun, a mighty crocodile with a bazooka or a bold chicken with a revolver! More heroes are waiting to be unlocked.

Face endless hordes of zombies, fight for survival and collect gold coins to upgrade your weapons and unlock new characters and maps. Each battle is a test of skill and endurance - how long can you survive?

title: Ednoka
description: Ednoka is an educational game where studying and gaming meet. You can create your own quizzes, share them, and play them through various game worlds. Questions pop up during play and affect your gaming experience.

title: Myth: Twice Born Edition
description: Myth: Twice Born Edition, this is a full on remaster of Myth: The Fallen Lords (through its ports to Myth II: Soublighter), Myth II: Soulblighter, and Myth II: Chimera. Some of the HD assets will also cover third party plugins, but they will not be as uniform as the rest.

title: Fossil Island
description: It's the summer holidays and this year you're going to visit Fossil Island. Dig up fossils, explore the island, and stay away from the abandoned mine! This will be a summer to remember, for better or worse...

title: Amikin Village
description: Explore the enchanting world of Amiterra, home to the cute yet formidable creatures known as Amikins! Dive into an open-world adventure where you can fight, farm, and build. Collect and evolve Amikins, construct your enchanted base, and embark on thrilling quests blending fantasy and sci-fi!

title: Hauntsgiving
description: Thanksgiving can be spooky, too.

title: Birdie
description:
If you had dreams to be a bird, this game will make them true. Here you are a Birdie in some sci-fi world filled with robots, carnivorous plants, parachutes, raptors, barbarians, lasers, butterflies, magical doors, hyperspace, etc. You should survive in this world with help of your wings and flying techniques.

The game is flown in third-person view, where you may control a bird moving him/her left or right, flying up or descending down, and flapping the wings. To fly correctly, the bird has to move in the air at a certain speed. Once the latter increases, the bird is handy. If bird's speed drops below a certain threshold, the bird then follows one of the oldest laws of the universe, gravity. Flapping wings enables bird to gain altitude and flying down on the wings increases speed.

The scoreboard on the screen tells you your speed (red = stall), altitude, the remaining time before the night, your life energy (no energy = game over). Flying at altitude for too long will attract predators, give no points, and exhaust the energy unnecessarily. Eating butterflies allows you to recover energy, but remember that eating too much makes you aggressive!

The environment, where Birdie is flying, will change during the game. Starting in the forest, you will visit other dimensions through Magical Doors as well as descend the dungeons, and even meet lamas.

title: Scale the Depths
description: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. Scale the Depths is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.

title: Caput Mortum
description: Caput Mortum is a short first-person horror experience inspired by retro 3D dungeon crawlers and survival horror games. It focuses on exploration and atmosphere while providing puzzles, simple combat, and light resource management.

title: Juggernaut
description: An early truck simulation game from Pete Cooke, a developer that later had more success with Tau Ceti and Tower of Babel. In this you have to drive a truck through a maze-style "world" and find the target of your cargo. Then you have to park your truck reverse in a parking bay to reload and refuel it. The game is made with vector graphics.

title: Animalia Memories
description: Animalia Memories is a short PSX inspired horror/walking sim. The lore of the game was inspired by the theme as well as some of the level design choices.

title: Kero Kero Cowboy
description: Kero Kero Cowboy is a brand new western themed platformer for the Game Boy Color! You play as Kero Kero, a frog on a journey to wrangle the wild west's most dangerous outlaws & bring peace to the untamed land. Face dastardly foes, perilous platforming challenges, and intense shootouts across deserts, mines, mountains, trains, forests, and beyond!

title: Dad Hungry!
description: You're stuck on the island of hunger, and you need to find all the food to escape. However, you come to realize that you're not the only one who's hungry…

title: Aivern
description:
A third-person psychological horror game.

Wander the ghost town of Aivern as Ina, a lost soul with no memory of her death. Explore twisted remnants of reality—abandoned schools, decaying libraries, and the mysterious Mirror Station—as you piece together fragments of a forgotten life.

With dynamic lighting, reactive fog, and haunting environments, every step feels like walking through someone else's nightmare.

Uncover the truth.
Or become part of the silence.

title: Fiction.Colors
description: Endless subway rides, void probes, cosmic gardens and the fate of a planet, fiction.colors is a series of short atmospheric experiences to explore at leisure. A collection of places to explore, or ambient 'games,' made from 2015 to 2022. Some are walking sims and others are fully passive. Take an endless train ride or roam sun-baked deserts. There's plenty to see at your own pace.

title: Fantastic Petty
description: An adorable, fantastic, poppy, and slightly bizarre 2D side-scrolling shooter game! Conquer all 5 stages in order to bring back spring to the island of Esideci!

title: Sangokushi Tactics
description:
"Three Kingdoms: Strategy Edition" has created an extremely real strategic battlefield——
The mountains and rivers are magnificent, and the ancient battlefield is truly restored here. The majestic Mount Tai, the beautiful Jiuzhaigou, the historical checkpoint wharf... not only "good-looking", but also "fun", because everything you see can be used by you and becomes an important part of the strategy competition. Use valleys to block, use plains to set up cards; play with sounds and play to lure the enemy into depth. Here you can show off all kinds of ancient warfare and strategies, and experience the best sense of war presence in the most authentic Three Kingdoms!

You will become a hero of the Three Kingdoms, and hundreds of military commanders with their own characteristics are waiting for you to recruit. Not only that, there are a lot of powerful tactics for you to use with your favorite generals, such as: Yan Ren roars, all brave, use your strategy to create a unique lineup! Don't forget, the game also has five arms. You can use arms to counteract each other, match your lineup cleverly, and achieve victory by defeating the enemy, and even winning with less.

title: Static Sky: And Yet It
description: "Static Sky: And Yet It █████" is a literary computer game based on the fear of and resistance to artificial intelligence. It imagines a future dominated by the generative AI "Sekai", where reality and hallucination blend and become indistinguishable.

title: The Infinity Road
description: The Infinity Road is a classic-style game where you control a car, dodge traffic, and avoid crashing to chase the highest score. An endless runner where the road never ends!

title: My Xiuxian World
description: This is an action role-playing game and you can customize your character, control with a mouse and keyboard, and defeat enemies. The story begins on Lingshi Island, defeat the enemy and then challenge the Black Sword sect all the way to ascend to immortality.

title: Mindhive: Wilds
description:
Mindhive: Wilds invites you to embark on a journey in an open-world adventure game set within the Mindhive universe.

Uncover the mysteries of a vast and diverse world, where dense forests, snow-capped mountains, and desolate deserts await your exploration. Dive into a complex crafting system to forge powerful weapons, tools, and magical artifacts, all while crafting your destiny. Create your own refuge amidst the challenges, and uncover secrets that shape your path. With a compelling original soundtrack.

title: Dough Slapping: A Touch to Desire
description: Enter the quirky world of Dough Slapping: A Touch to Desire, where you slap dough with your left or right hand. Join Mark's journey filled with humor, heartfelt monologues, and unexpected revelations as you master the art of the perfect slap in this unique and comedic simulator.

title: Mama Cabra
description:
Mama Cabra is a goat space shooter. Shoot space foes, save sheepies and smell the flowers.

Made with Pico-8 for the I, Rebel game jam 2025. Powered by Atari

title: Little Knight
description: This is a medieval horizontal pixel-style game that can achieve unlimited gold coins. Players can control the little knight and experience the endless fun of monster swiping and exploration.

title: Little Knight 2: Old Dreams
description: Little Knight 2: Dark Souls of the Past "is the official 3D RPG sequel to the classic" Little Knight ", continuing the passion and adventurous spirit of its predecessor, and creating a broader and more free medieval fantasy world.

title: Little Luna
description: Little Luna is an engaging puzzle-platformer where every step is a race against time! Help little moth to escape the dark and dangerous cave!

title: Little Rooms
description: Welcome to Little Rooms! Enter a house, pick a room and search the requested objects! Take your time.

title: Little Witches vs. Monsters
description: Get ready for battle in "Little Witches vs Monsters"! Defend your enchanted kitten with magic and strategy as you face hordes of enemies who want to take your kitten to turn into a monster, in this tower defense game on the Crystal Island.

title: Lonely Christmas: Cupid's Punishment
description: Santa has ordered one of her helpers, Cupid, to punish you. However, the "punishment" that Cupid has in mind for you is far from painful

title: Lonely Christmas: Cute Santa
description: This is your first Christmas alone, life is tough and you're deep in depression and thinking of ending things, however that all changes when you catch an unexpected intruder in your apartment on Christmas Day who claims to be your personal Santa

title: Lonely Christmas: Succubus Santa
description: On the North Pole, there's a secret civilization of Santa's helpers that produce presents for humans around the world. The overseer, Ms. Clause notices that your productivity has dropped recently and decides to punish you in her own cruel, sensual, sadistic way

title: Loot Box
description: Loot Box Clicker is an addictive and rewarding clicker game where your goal is reach the highest number of clicks!

title: Lost City of Bardo
description: A massive open-world maze adventure game.

title: Lost & Found Collection
description: Lost & Found Collection is a game where players explore diverse stories on VHS tapes, each unfolding around the same time.

title: Lottery World
description: A free-to-play global multiplayer online arcade gaming platform.

title: Love 15
description: Classic 15-block sliding puzzle with a devious twist.

title: Loveland's Leap
description: Leap into the forest in this 2d puzzle platformer! Swing through the woods, find flies, and solve simple brain teasers. Let the trees envelope you as the water colored backgrounds and kalimba themed music create an unforgettable story book like atmosphere.

title: Love Love 2024: The Love Election
description: Experience the future of democracy where romance is the key to choosing America’s next leader. But beware, a shadowy manipulator is attempting to rig the election! Date your favorite candidates and see if love can truly save the nation—what could go wrong??

title: Love x Debut
description: Live the life of an idol manager! Following a car accident, you’re transported into a video game world filled with great music and steamy h-scenes. Build your talent agency, train future stars and lead them to stardom in the music industry. Conquer their hearts one idol at the time!

title: Lower? Higher!: Buy or Bye
description: your pawnshop will usher in guests with different needs every day, bargain with them, let the income soar! With the expansion of pawnshops, activities such as sending shop assistants and responding to emergencies are also essential. you seem ordinary transaction may cause the butterfly effect.

title: Lucky Realtor
description: Lucky Realtor is a clicker Game, Tap, collect, and equip! Endless fun with a simple tap. Tap, tap, tap your way to cooler skins! The more you tap, the faster you'll unlock new and unique rooms. Download now and start tapping!

title: Luke The Hybrid
description: 1-4 Player Action Created By Jacob Boehm (Dulmari_Creations) Set In a Post Apocalyptic Dystopian Future Where Hybrids Must Battle Robots. Explore In The Open World Campaign, Fight Each other In The Multiplayer, And Survive Waves of Bot Zombies.

title: Lumen World of Color
description: Lumen World of color is an action adventure game made as a student project.

title: Lunara
description: Lunara is a captivating 2D platformer where players explore vibrant levels, collecting keys to unlock doors and progress. With challenges and engaging gameplay, you'll navigate obstacles and strategize your moves to conquer each level.

title: Lure: Free
description: LURE: FREE is an open-world multiplayer survival game with a zombie theme. You can improve your character in 3 different ways, can build a base, drive a car, capture loot zones for your clan, can hunt animals, can loot towns, and of course kill the zombies and the players.

title: Lust Fantasy
description: Jump into the world full of elves, orcs, unbelievable situations and hot 18+ action in Lust Fantasy - an adult isekai visual novel about a regular guy who accidentally gets teleported into a medieval world full of magic and mysteries! Would you find the way back?..

title: Lustful Dead
description: Survive, seduce, and fight in a zombie-infested dorm! Loot resources, battle sexy zombies, rescue girls, and build your ultimate survival harem.

title: Lust in Space
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting space adventure in the genre of adult visual novel. In the game Lust in Space you take on the role of Leon, an agent of the Peace Corps, who, during one of his missions, finds a wrecked, deserted ship from Earth.

title: Lust Lady Friends
description: Players need to turn over the hidden cards and find the cards of the same color or pattern to match and eliminate them! Players need to successfully match and clear all the cards to pass the level. After passing the level, they can unlock the charming dynamic CG of three natural beauties~

title: Lust 'n Dead
description: Destroy enemy waves one after another using an extensive range of weapons as you attempt to save the town from invasion! Improve your arsenal, level up, find the cure and witness some hot adult action!

title: Lust Night
description: Lust Night invites you to step into a mysterious world, blending elements of horror and romance in this captivating adult visual novel. A group of friends finds themselves trapped in a cursed house, then murder comes onto the scene and a game for their lives begins!

title: Lyra Convolution
description: Lyra Convolution : The Future of Gaming is Here

title: Magatch
description: Sultan is very fond of precious stones, he adores and collects them, but his time is limited for collecting stones, but driven by passion and greed, he will never stop

title: Mage at Stake
description: Roguelite wizard game, where you play as a wizard fighting off waves of monsters and bosses using powerful magic, gathering helper bats and perks. Each time you play, you'll face new challenges in different biomes, making you think on your feet and try different strategies to win.

title: Magic Puzzle King 2: Rolling Cat
description: In this free 2D puzzle game, piece together the items your feline friends have knocked off and shattered.

title: Magic Sword
description: Magic Sword is a medieval CRPG with synchronous turn-based strategy where you develop your character, explore the map, and compete for victory points in Combat, Knowledge, Capital, Reputation, and Fellowships.

title: Malpractice
description: Malpractice is an Online Multiplayer Horror Experience. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and avoid corrupted entities to escape a plague ridden hospital.

title: Malpractice Hospital
description: Malpractice Hospital is a new take on the strategy simulation genre, that blends purposeful patient mismanagement and surgical treatment into one unique malpractice experience.

title: Manaballs
description: Manaballs is an online survival game with roguelike, extraction and farming elements. Venture into the woods, gather resources, build bases, and engage with players through voice chat. Team up to conquer dungeons, craft weapons, and raid enemy bases for that sweet loot.

title: Mangoo
description: Casual mini games.

title: Man in a Suit in a Building in a City
description: A tale as old as machines. Everyday wake up and plow the land of your lord, as you need the shine of the coin. Requiem for the common man.

title: Mansion Affairs
description: Mansion Affairs is a mature visual novel that explores the complexities of relationships, desire, and betrayal. Players control either Alex or Emma, navigating a mansion filled with secrets and erotic encounters. The game features branching narratives, multiple endings, and a rich cast of characters.

title: MarbleGP

From Easy to Expert, test your timing and let your fingers dance.
Hit the right keys at the right moment and become the master of rhythm.
The music is rising... the stage is yours, the tempo is with you!

From counting and addition to multiplication and division, explore 20 levels per topic, starting with simple visuals like fingers and dice, and working up to complex challenges with numbers up to 25x25. Earn stars for every correct answer, improve your score, and choose your own path to learning success. Visit each pal at their cozy home and let them guide you through fun, interactive quizzes designed to make math magical!

Take something literally is a compilation of 25 puzzles.
This game is abstract, conceptual, non-conform and uses new interactivities.

The rules are quite simple. Take the hints literally and just think outside the box. Be aware of your environment. Everybody can play and enjoy this game. You don’t have to be an hardcore gamer to play you just have to be logical.

title: Take Something Literally 2
description: Take Something Literally 2 is a compilation of 25 original puzzles. In this game you just have to think outside the box. This game is abstract, conceptual and uses new interactivities. This new episode contains new features: new scoring system, new tip system and more funny rewards.

title: Obscula
description:
Obscula is a first-person psychological horror game where players navigate a fragile reality distorted by fear, hallucinations, and memory.

Armed with only a mysterious vintage camera, you explore forgotten places and capture the unseen to uncover fragments of a haunting narrative. As the line between reality and delusion blurs, each photograph reveals more than what the eye can see.

Built in Unreal Engine 5, Obscula delivers a cinematic and immersive experience with atmospheric storytelling, fully voiced characters, and disturbing soundscapes. Nothing you see is certain — are you brave enough to document the truth?

title: Unnatural Beauties
description:
In Unnatural Beauties, you will have to capture animals, splice them together, and enter them into beauty pageants.

You start the game in your garden, this is where a variety of creatures live. Using only your cardboard box and fishing gnome, it's time to catch as many animals as you can.

When you are done hunting, head to your lab; this is where you will create your pageant contender. Using the animals you captured, pick the best parts of each creature and combine them to form a potential winner.

Now it's time to enter a contender into a pageant. Pageants take the form of mini games which test your contender's different qualities; looks, smarts, strength, and swimming ability. Each body part of your contender has different stats across these areas, tailoring your creation to the different pageants will make the mini games easier.

Placing in the top three will unlock the next pageant and give you a cash reward. Cash can be spend in the shop to unlock other methods of catching creatures and to encourage a wider variety of animals to enter your garden.

Keep catching creatures, create more contenders, and try to win every pageant to become the world's best beauty queen creator!

Command's support of how everything transpired is weak and many of her crew face disciplinary actions for their part in the operation. It all weighs heavily on Major Natalie Puccile, whose investigation led them down that route, but not nearly as much as the knowledge that she was forced to decide between the woman she cared about and her mission. With only a tankard and a collection of games to distract her from her life, Natalie begins to question why she signed up in the first place.

title: Project Nightcall
description: A short, atmospheric horror experience set in a dark, decaying town. You've been called in to deal with a problem at your workplace, something urgent. As you make your way through the silent, shadowy streets, a question creeps in: Are you really alone out here?

title: Memoralia
description:
Memoralia is a surreal journey through a fragmented dreamscape, where memories blur and reality bends. As you explore this eerie world, you'll uncover pieces of yourself—while facing the haunting choice of whether to awaken... Or remain lost in the dream.

This game is not about survival. It's about identity, discovery, and the fragile line between comfort and truth.

title: The Last Spell: Elves of Amberwald
description: Elves of Amberwald is the second DLC for the acclaimed rogue-lite tactical RPG The Last Spell.

title: Voidling Bound
description: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

title: Pocket Vampire Girl
description:
Take care of a vampire girl in this virtual pet game, feed her every day, and participate in mini-games to earn money that you can use to buy new clothes and hairstyles.

Also, explore the town and meet its strange inhabitants, but make sure to go only at night!

title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered Deluxe Edition includes:
- Digital base game
- Unique digital Akatosh and Mehrunes Dagon Armors, Weapons, and Horse Armor Sets
- Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App
- Shivering Isles and Knights of the Nine story expansions
- Additional downloadable content: Fighter’s Stronghold expansion, Spell Tome Treasures, Vile Lair, Mehrune’s Razor, The Thieves Den, Wizard’s Tower, Orrery, and Horse Pack Armor

title: Dawn of Ages
description:
At the dawn of medieval history, build your castle and evolve your army using real weapons and armor from ages past. March against hostile civilizations as you re-trace the steps of history. Engage your rivals and crush their empires in battle!

️No Dragons, No Magic, Not Now, Not Ever.

Dawn of Ages is a game that’s grounded in historical accuracy. No fantasy creatures, no mystical spells, just real, historical empires and war strategy games like no other. Every weapon, armor, and tactic you use is based on the reality of ancient battlefields.

title: Bombshell Blitz
description: BOMBSHELL BLITZ is an explosive twin-stick tank shooter with minor roguelite elements. Upgrade your tank and ace your combat exams to impress your cute supervisors with the highest scores you can!

title: Tales of Tuscany
description: Tuscany has been obliterated by Thunder Goober for his own entertainment! Play as Lambypoo and adventure through the broken land of Tuscany, either making friends and having them join your team or defeating enemies for their EXP in your efforts to save your cousins and reunite Tuscany.

title: Cozy Beach
description: ️Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an enchanting tropical beach where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

title: Strawberry Jumping Journey
description: Embark on the Strawberry Jumping Journey and help the strawberry navigate through the forest! With countless obstacles blocking her path, you'll need to rely on the power of the quadruple jump to overcome them. Stay focused and survive as long as possible to achieve the highest score!

title: Care(taking)
description:
You are the caretaker of a graveyard at world's end. Each day, five spirits show at a random grave on the plot. Only two may be freed from this world.

Your choices in this world do not matter.

title: Examples of Human Capital
description: A short narrative experience set in a corporate structure...

title: The Shrimp Crematorium
description: You work at the Universal Crematorium System. They are doing some weird stuff with shrimps here. Your job is simple: Find out which shrimp are rotting and... Well, exclude these shrimp from the tests.

title: Displacement
description: Displacement is a gripping action-horror with elements of immersive storytelling. You play as a psychologist who finds themselves at a polar station where the staff have fallen victim to a mysterious madness. Keep your sanity — or lose your mind. The choice is yours.

title: Rip & Tear
description: Rip &Tear is a brutal top-down 2D arcade shooter where your shotgun is your only lifeline. Face endless waves of demons, cultists, and biomechanical horrors in a blood-soaked battle for survival. No gimmicks—just pure, relentless carnage.

title: Moth
description: You are a police investigator searching the underground parking hall for a murderer. Soon you will find out that absolutely nothing is what it seems. What has really happened? What is the real crime?

title: Misterios Ocultos
description: A terrifying story that immerses you in a dark world full of horrific surprises that will leave the player frozen in fear.

title: Enormosword
description: The prequel to the redeveloped Ginormo Sword. An early showcase of what is to come.

title: Ginormo Sword
description:
In the words of the developer himself:

"Ginormo Sword is a Flash-made action RPG, from developer Babarageo. You play as a purple-clad adventurer armed with nothing but a sword, fighting monsters to accumulate gold and buy upgrades to make yourself stronger. The title comes from players' ability to upgrade the size of their sword, and there are plenty levels for that."

In 2008, Ginormo Sword was developed in flash for web browsers. The developer, Babarageo has decided to remake this game from the ground up with updated gameplay mechanics and additional content.

title: Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise
description: Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise is a brain-training puzzle game featuring dozens of challenges like Sudoku, Nonogram, and Fill Lines. Players engage their cognitive skills across hundreds of levels, solving puzzles while improving memory, focus, and problem-solving abilities.

title: Puzzle Paradise
description: Embark on an exciting adventure where you will have to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a local resident. Use your powers of observation and logical thinking to solve a variety of puzzles, collect clues and reconstruct the events.

title: Puzzle Machine
description: Puzzle Machine is a classic 2D logic game in which the player has to find the only possible solution based on statements.

title: Push 3D
description: Push 3D is a turn-based multiplayer board game, where the goal is to PUSH your opponent off the board!

title: Puppycraft: Maze
description: A turn-based strategic duel where you command a tactical cat against AI dog armies on a 7x7 dynamic board; Deploy 10 unique barriers per match to build evolving mazes while racing to breakthrough enemy lines; Victory demands razor-sharp calculation of distance optimization and resource management.

title: Punishment Special Edition
description: Help the knight Roger in his mission to rescue survivors in an ancient dungeon, in this turn-based RPG game with horror elements based on old games and other Survivor Horror and Soulslike titles. Face challenges like dealing with monsters, puzzles and yourself.

title: Pumpkin's Revenge
description: Pumpkin's Revenge Embark on an epic adventure with the Pumpkin-Head Hero. Navigate through mysterious dungeons, collect powerful loots, and battle fearsome monsters. Can you survive and become a legend?

title: Pumpkin Clicker
description: A idle-clicker game, Pumpkin Clicker is about making as many pumpkins as you can, and then some more!

title: Pug and Seek
description: Pug and Seek is a hide-and-seek game: clever pugs run, hide, and cause chaos, while Jack, the unstoppable streamer, must find, catch, and return them to the pen. Challenge friends online and prove who is the master of hide-and-seek!

title: Psychopathy Assessment
description: Psychopathy Assessment is a retro-80s V.H.S PS1 style analog horror game that blurs the line between reality and delusion.
