title: Sunshine Love
description:
You are an aspiring junior associate at a prestigious law firm, with hopes of one day becoming a trial lawyer, just like your current girlfriend of five years, Nicole.
But that dream has been put on hold the moment your sister calls you out of the blue, needing you to help her save her struggling hotel business and offering you a job down at Sunshine Bay during the summer.

title: Toki Hako Time Capsule
description: A summer vacation day. Main heroine digs up a time capsule buried as a child with two friends. Surprisingly, there is also a fourth person belongings inside the capsule, and none of the three friends have any recollections of that person. They start investigation to find out the shocking truth.

title: Rat Wrap
description: Rat Wrap is a single-screen precision platformer, where you can only jump when you're off the ground and are able to wrap about the screen (hence the name). You are THE RAT and you must get THE CHEESE, that's all you need to know!

title: Pretty Girls Game Collection 4
description: A collection of four games in the Pretty Girls mini-games series on a single PS4 disc / Switch cart. The bundle includes Pretty Girls 2048 Strike, Pretty Girls Breakers! PLUS, Pretty Girls Escape and Pretty Girls Tile Match.

title: At Sixes and Sevens
description: At Sixes and Sevens is a PSX detective mystery horror game where you play as an investigator tasked with solving bizarre crime cases. The story unravels through a blend of interviews, computer-based investigations, and unsettling psychological elements.

title: I Am Ripper
description:
A British Thriller set in the brutality and economic decline of the 1980's. You are a forensic investigator called on to solve one of the UK's most prolific crimes.

Step into the world of Ripper.

It's 1988, a small north-western dock town in Britain has witnessed multiple victims by a single killer who have been confirmed through forensic analysis.
Throughout the game, you will be faced with critical decisions which will change the outcome of your investigation.
You must confront a series of gut-wrenching challenges placing the fates of others in your hands.
Find the forensics, reveal the secrets and pursue the person responsible.

title: SoulPactum
description: SoulPactum is a brutal 2D platformer where every wrong jump ends in failure. Precise timing and patience are the keys to finally making it through the deadly levels.

title: Cat Named Mojave
description: Stranded in the desert, your only hope of escaping rests in a strange Catman. His one request: hunt down surreal creatures, skin them, and chop them up so he can keep them as trophies. In this uncanny place, Death will become all too familiar.

title: Apex Legends: Prodigy
description:
It's time to Take Your Shot in Apex Legends: Prodigy! Step into the spotlight with new Legend Sparrow, an agile archer with a habit of showing off, set your sights on glory with explosive new updates to the Bocek. Energize it with Frag Grenades to make Explosive Arrows! Now’s your chance to take aim and target greatness!

But that’s just the start. Carve out a new legacy and return to the hallowed grounds of Arenas. You’ll get your chance to stand out with Ranked updates like the new Ranked Ladder and its rewards. Pathfinder even got some new buffs, like double charge on his Tactical and Ultimate abilities. Plus, shine like a rising star with cosmetics from the Prodigy Battle Pass!*

title: Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate
description: The first chapter of a new Destiny saga is here. Guardians will venture into the unknown, where the mysteries of the cosmos – and The Nine – await.

title: Extra Evolution: L’Era del Primordiale
description:
Extra Evolution: L’Era del Primordiale is a Pokémon fangame made by DayanVS
The game, made in RPG Maker XP + Pokémon Essentials, is set in the brand new region of Liniles and features 160 new species of Pokémon

title: They See Us
description: They See Us is a multiplayer horror game. Work together to find all the anomalies – before they find you!

title: Casual Sport Series: Badminton
description: Casual Sport Series: Badminton delivers fast-paced, energetic gameplay that captures the thrill of this lightning-quick sport.

title: Nightmare Frontier
description: Behold the first-ever Tactical Extraction Looter where you pit your courage and leadership against fears made manifest: the Dreadweavers. Lead a band of scavenger roughnecks into a devastated boom town of the alternative 1900s. Get in, face the monsters, grab what you can carry and get out. Alive.

title: Spectre Vigil
description: Spectre Vigil is an Observation-Duty style horror game with a unique twist: Detecting ghosts! Spot many different abnormalities and handle terrifying entities, all whilst keeping track of what happens and figuring out what ails this location!

title: Corcovado's Night Guard
description: You are Vicente, a night guard that works in Corcovado, taking care of this brazilian tourist spot, christ the redeemer. A first person, singleplayer, walk-simulator experience. Investigate what is happening and try to escape this nightmare.

title: Buggos 2
description: Buggos 2 is a horde-based auto-battler where players command a sentient hivemind to evolve and deploy massive swarms of alien insects against human forces. The game features permanent upgrades, specialized unit types, and strategic control of the battlefield to overwhelm increasingly advanced enemies.

title: MazeSlug
description: This is an immersive first-person single-player horror game. Players will take on the role of an ordinary person returning home late at night, who inexplicably steps into a special space on a familiar path. You must explore and move forward in this space filled with unknown fears.

title: Labyrinthine Dread
description: In this Top-Down Horror game, try to escape from an otherwise abandoned laboratory, armed only with a lantern and the keys strewn about in monster-infested rooms.

title: The Wallway
description: The Wallway is a cooperative first-person horror game for 1-5 players. Explore endless hallways, collect important items and find your way out. Run away from the terrible monster that hears your every sound through the microphone. Can you escape or are you consumed by darkness and fear?

title: Lust Goddess
description: Lust Goddess is a hot and thrilling collectible card game, in which you will assemble your unique squad of sexy mercenary girls. Earn their love and trust, and they will show you their gratitude by bringing your wildest and lewdest fantasies to life!

title: Trainlax: Railway Puzzle Simulator
description: Relax. Build. Solve.

title: Launching Over It
description: Launching Over It is a challenging and emotional journey through levels inspired by the developer’s childhood memories. To reach the end, you’ll need to overcome all kinds of obstacles—by launching a ball. Sounds simple? Think again.

title: Arcade Archives: Super Xevious
description:
"SUPER XEVIOUS" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1984.
Players pilot the SOLVALOU and face off with the XEVIOUS forces.
Defeat airborne enemies with the zapper, and terrestrial enemies with the blaster.
This work has various changes from the previous work, including additional characters and different placement of hidden items.

title: Absurdika: Rebuild
description:
You get to play as a guy, a psychopath, or someone else—who knows? You'll have to use your imagination, complete 10 challenging levels, and defeat the main bosses. You'll be all set with this one weapon that has two different attacks: your CHAINSAW. Let your imagination take you on a journey through the mind of a great author as you play.**

"It's time to overcome your fear of conflict. Every time someone accused you, you kept silent and kept your anger inside. The demon you are about to face represents this fear.

title: Dead by Daylight: Steady Pulse
description: Dead by Daylight’s Steady Pulse includes a new Survivor, Orela Rose onto the scene. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Cosmetic: Black and White Blazer.

title: Under the Streetlights of the Reiche
description: "Under the Streetlights of the Reiche" is an omnibus-style adventure game. Experience one man's last day in the town. A good man who is well-liked by those around him loses his job and is forced to leave the town he has lived in for a long time.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Armored Core Mobile Mission
description: Gear up, customize your mech, and take on high-stakes missions! Simple yet deep—experience the thrill of mech action on the battlefield!

title: Teddy's Haven: A Fantasy Inspired Shop Simulator
description:
An enchanted shop sim at the edge of a magical world.
In Loving Dedication To The Memory Of My Best Friend Teddy Bear.

Teddy’s Haven is a cozy fantasy shop simulator where you run a small, magical store nestled on the outskirts of a mysterious island. Specializing in potions, weapons, and enchanted curios, your humble haven draws in adventurers, wandering mages, and mystical creatures—each seeking something special beneath your warm, glowing lights.

Discover the Isle of Ursa

Your shop rests at the edge of Ursa, a magical island filled with ancient forests, glimmering lakes, and forgotten wonders. The land itself is imbued with quiet magic, responding to your care and growing alongside you as your shop flourishes.

As you nurture your haven, the island’s secrets begin to reveal themselves, with each change you make encouraging the land to unfold new mysteries. Your presence is felt here—this shop is not just a place of business, but a part of the very soul of Ursa.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Three Kingdoms
description: Journey across a thousand years of Chinese history and dive into the epic Romance of the Three Kingdoms with the latest expansion for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - where history and legend collide in a battle for supremacy.

title: Apathy: Danshikou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
She's Leaving
description: Put your forensic skills to the test in this brand new first person survival horror, She's Leaving. Play as Charles Dalton, a blood spatter analyst tasked with the most gruesome crime scene of his life. Can you survive a night in House Haywood?

title: Tsukuyomi: The Divine Hunter
description: A New World from Visionary Creator Kazuma Kaneko. This roguelike card game is the latest work by the legendary creator, known for countless masterpieces.

title: A Night With: Brazilian Waifu
description: A provocative, explicit date-sim visual novel where you'll spend one steamy night seducing Lucia, your confident Brazilian dream girl. Flirt, tease, and charm your way into her heart—and her bed—in this immersive erotic experience.

title: Hey, Girlie!
description: "Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim created by fans of Dimension 20's Fantasy High. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance six sapphic characters: Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.

title: Exovia
description: Free your mind as you mine an asteroid in zero gravity, creating floaters that drift through the oddly satisfying physics-driven supply chains you design to pave humanity's road to the stars.

title: Oil Town
description: OIL TOWN is a worker-sim RPG about scooping and hauling oil. Earn money during the work day, and interact with the town after your shift. But don't let the Oil Barons find out about your secret before you can afford to buy the land it hides on.

title: Minty Fresh Adventure
description: Play the Minty Fresh Adventure game and help Colgate follow her dream to become a dentist! Help her get rid of the magical mark and stay away from dangers!

title: Fantastic Findings Hidden Seasons
description: Get into the coziest Christmas spirit in this highly detailed 3D hidden object game. Explore many varied levels packed with hidden items waiting to be found. Search drawers, unwrap gifts. You can clean off dirt, cobwebs, eat treats, and find hidden cookies in a festive hunt full of surprises.

title: The Whistle
description: a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame based off the Josh Hutcherson whistle meme.

title: The Button Effect
description: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

title: Broken Keyboard Hero
description:
During an intense gaming session, you raged so hard that you broke your keyboard.
You need to go to the repair shop to fix it.
But you can only press each key once! (per life)

Can you still make it to the store?

title: Golden Idol Investigations: The Lemurian Phoenix
description: Amidst the Lemurian aristocracy's extravagant holiday celebrations, a murder ignites a complex conspiracy that reaches back to 1910. Return to the scene of the crime and uncover the truth. Explore themes of deceit, wealth and power in five new scenarios spanning from 1910 to 1950. Your pursuit of the truth will lead you through decadent parties, ancient temples and dangerous rituals.

title: Tank Operations: Diary of the War
description: Experience World War II's defining battles from a new perspective! In Tank Operations: Diary of the War, you command Allied forces through intense, turn-based warfare. Master battlefield tactics, upgrade your troops, and face an expansive campaign.

title: Tactical Battles
description: Tactical Battle is a turn-based RPG where knights, wizards, dragons, and quirky classes like Father Nature clash in strategic combat. Assemble your team, master unique skills and perks, and prepare for an epic showdown against the Devil boss in a world filled with fantasy and challenge.

title: What Happened to Lily?
description: What Happened to Lily? is a Real-Time First Person Horror Game. We Investigate The Mystery Behind The Tragic Event That Happened in a Farmhouse 2 Months Ago.

title: Mamorukun ReCurse!
description:
Descend into The Netherworld in this explosive cute ‘em up, where Curse Bullets let you adjust the challenge as you go!

Embark on an adventure filled with breathtaking environments, bizarre creatures and bullets, to save the Netherworld and seal the gate to the World of Darkness.

title: Gamblers Table
description:
Gamblers Table is an idle automation game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying.

Click a coin to toss it. Every time it lands on Heads, you earn money.

The more coins you own, the more you can flip. Buy upgrades to make them flip faster and yield more money. Discover curious interactions and unexpected synergies between different coin types.

Hire little helpers to take care of all the manual labour for you. They don’t complain, and they never question.

Leave your fortune behind and rise to something greater. Start again with peculiar new talents you didn’t have before.

Admire your riches, lean back, and watch your automated coin-flipping empire grow.

title: DIY Horse Race Thing
description: A small little toy that lets you make small maps with obstacles and walls, and then let little horses run around, until one bumps into the carrot and wins. The idea is to play with friends and bet who will end up winning!

title: Chemistower
description: Learn about Chemistry in this science based Tower Defense game! Purchase atoms to create compounds with properties like explosions, acid, and freezing in an effort to destroy antimatter enemies.

title: Wilderness Edge
description: Wilderness Edge is an open-world survival game set in a remote, untamed wilderness where players must explore, hunt, and gather resources to stay alive. Featuring a dynamic day-night cycle and an evolving ecosystem, the game includes AI-driven wildlife behavior, crafting systems, and character progression through primitive survival skills. Designed for single-player or multiplayer experiences, Wilderness Edge emphasizes environmental immersion and self-reliance in a world without civilization.

title: Landmine Princess
description: Landmine Princess is the sophomoric release for Jeistar that is a spin on the dating simulator genre. It takes the "fast-love" rogue template and interpolates it with the explosive personality of Mina, a "Landmine" girl whose personality is explored deeply. Stats passive aggressively update based on your decisions with important random questions Mina throws at you.

title: Doomy in the Roomy
description: Doomy in the Roomy is a low-poly stealth horror game in which you play as Elisabeth Moore as she traverses various wacky floors to gather collectables in order to power an anomalous lift to keep going. Each floor is like a maze, and has a monster you must avoid. Can you escape the Doom Facility?

title: Tomba! Special Edition: Whoopee Edition
description: In Tomba! Special Edition, leap, bite, and throw your way across stunning 2.5D landscapes in this vastly-enhanced update to a platforming classic!

title: Werthit
description:
You lost a bet and now have to stay the night at the Hide residence, an old Guesthouse with a dark history. But something is amiss here...

Explore a large haunted Japanese guesthouse, where the house itself will do it's best to impede your progress, possessing objects to stun you and scare you.

Four difficulties to choose from, with two endings to discover. Will you run away as soon as the opportunity arises, or will you try to exorcise the house? You may even experience an extension to the story in Nightmare Mode...

title: Tokachi Detective: The Balloon Case
description: In the far south of Tokyo, the Ogasawara Islands. A wealthy individual ascended to high altitudes in a hot air balloon and died from lack of oxygen. At first, she thought it was an accident. There were suspicious elements, however.

title: Dreams on a Pillow
description: Dreams on a Pillow is a pseudo-3D stealth adventure game inspired by a historical Palestinian folk tale set during the ethnic cleansing that was the 1948 Nakba.

title: Sporting Goods Shop
description: Run your sporting goods shop. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, hire workers, expand your store, and run little contests to entertain your customers. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

title: Broken Relic
description: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.

title: Undead Awakens
description: Fight against endless hordes of zombies in this action-packed, round-based survival game inspired by classic zombie shooters! Explore diverse maps, upgrade weapons, deploy automatic turrets, and call in airstrikes. Customize your arsenal with attachments and skins. Play online or in split-screen.

title: Equinox: Homecoming
description: Saddle up with friends and investigate a dark mystery, where each trail leads to wonder and intrigue. A string of events has set the idyllic island on edge. Discover the truth behind your mother’s disappearance and a local's sudden death. For fans of horses, murder mysteries, and cozy exploration!

title: Ven'rif
description: A CASUAL REAL-TIME STRATEGY GAME Summon unique creatures, cast explosive spells, survive the assassination! Ven'rif is a casual real-time strategy card game where you build a deck of collectible cards and fight against another player on the battlefield. Ven'rif simplifies what other real-time strategy games can't all the while retaining the depth of the gameplay at a cheap expense of a shorter playtime.

title: Aerial_Knight's DropShot
description: Aerial_Knight’s Dropshot is a high-speed, stylized FPS / Race where you play as Smoke Wallace. As a kid, he was bitten by a radioactive dragon, turning his skin purple and giving him the power to fire bullets from his fingertips. Thrown into deadly sky battles for revenge, you race rivals, fight dragons, move fast, shoot smart, and look cool when you land.

title: Depression Presented Ludically in the Style of a Videogame
description: Depression Presented Ludically in the Style of a Videogame isn't a hopeful game, but there's something positive to be found in it: if the cognitive distortions that depression brings with it can be so effectively portrayed in such a tiny game, then clearly none of us are alone in those thoughts.

title: Unknown Host
description: It's a short indie horror game where we step into the shoes of Alex, a student who, in search of more comfort, rents an apartment in the city that, at first glance, seems pretty decent - but upon arrival, he realizes something is not right.

title: Midnight Postman
description:
Routine. Dread. How do you escape it? You spend your nights delivering packages through quiet streets, trying to make ends meet. Everyone expects you to keep moving, keep working, keep your head down.

But one delivery feels different. The customer talks too much. The street is too quiet. And something about this night won't let you go. Maybe this is the night everything changes.

title: Due Last Week
description: Due Last Week is a short indie horror experience where you play as Miles Kent, a struggling construction worker who lives in a town called Wickerford, barely scraping by. With no money for streaming services, you find comfort in renting cheap VHS tapes from Reel Time Rentals, a run-down but familiar store you visit often.

title: LostTicket
description: lostticket is a visual novel where you have lost your ticket. Try to convince the ticketer to let you in anyway!

title: Mafia: The Old Country Deluxe Edition
description:
Mafia: The Old Country is a third-person action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. It follows Enzo Favara, a former forced laborer who joins the Torrisi crime family in search of a better life and becomes involved in the violent world of organized crime.

The game follows a linear narrative structure and combines gunfights, knife combat, stealth, and exploration. Enzo travels across Sicilian towns and countryside on foot, horseback, and in period automobiles while carrying out assignments for the Torrisi family.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full base game
• Padrino Pack:
- "Lupara Speciale" shotgun
- "Vendetti Speciale" pistol
- "Immortale" charm
- "Padrino" outfit
- "Stiletto Speciale" knife
- "Eckhart Speciale" limousine
- "Cosimo" horse and accessories
• Gatto Nero Pack:
- "Bodeo Nero" pistol
- "Velocità" charm
- "Gatto Nero" outfit
- "Carozella Nero" race car
• Bonus materials:
- Digital artbook
- Original score

title: Japan to Go, Please!
description: Accompany Tally on her journey through Japan. There she will not only meet friendly Yokai natives but also take part in a competition.

title: Still Waters
description: Exploration game that takes places in a pool environment, but with a different touch than what you usually see.

title: Only Up 3
description: After reaching the heights of the favelas, Jacky embarks on a spaceship that takes him straight to Grekko Island; but as soon as he arrives on this new planet he will have to start an ascent to the skies in this new ONLY UP .

title: Flamecraft
description: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

title: Magical Nut Ikuno
description: This is an action game where you will defeat the stage by collecting Crysnuts that are on the map without bumping into any enemies. Will radiant Fighters Ikuno Hinata and Anami Tsukine be able to destroy the ambitions of the evil empress Hamester!?

title: Pogo Stick: Ultimate Challenge
description: A game that doesn’t believe in you — it tests your patience, stubbornness, and whether you can climb to the top. Think you can?

title: Europa Universalis V
description: Use war, trade or diplomacy to satisfy your grandest ambitions and dominate five centuries of history in the newest version of Europa Universalis, Paradox Interactive's flagship historical grand strategy game.

title: Rinnetenjo
description: A mysterious fog descended upon the town, changing their destinies.

title: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition
description: A new action-horror story set in the iconic Alien universe. Play as rogue Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks, sent to investigate a blacksite on Purdan. Fight and survive using your skill, reflexes, and determination against a deadly Xenomorph incursion in this gripping first chapter of a two-part saga.

title: Obsidian Catalyst
description:
Obsidian Catalyst is a tactics-style strategy RPG inspired by the Shining Force series, with influence from Fire Emblem, Dark Savior, Final Fantasy and Skies of Arcadia.
You will be leading a squad of 12 members, among over 50 hand-crafted playable characters as you discover the secrets behind the Obsidian Catalyst.

title: If Letters Had Pants, Would They Wear Them Like This? What About Numbers? What If They Had Small Shovels and They Dug Stuff Up to Put in a Museum?
description:
Find words in a randomized grid of letters. The used letters will leave empty spaces, which the other letters can bridge, allowing for words that weren't possible before, over larger and larger areas.

Your score depends on both the length of the word, and the size of the area it spans. You want to make longer words over bigger areas to score more points and reach the level's goal before the timer runs out.

If you manage to complete the level, you will be presented with 3 pairs of pants for 3 different letters. Pants give unique bonuses to letters, a letter can be worth more, or maybe it multiplies the whole word’s value, or maybe it gives you bombs or does other things.

As you dig through the letters, you also dig through the dirt. Beneath the earth you will find objects lost to time. (and to their owners) Uncover these sometimes-precious items, sell them, and expand your museum, then place the items in the museum and unlock new gameplay modifiers as the museum’s collection completes.

title: Small World 2
description: Based on the phenomenally successful Small World fantasy board game with over 500,000 copies sold! Take control of insanely fun fantasy race & special power combos, such as Berserk Halflings, Triton Merchants, Alchemist Ratmen and Dragon-master Amazons, to grab all the land you can in a world that is just too small to share with your opponents!

title: Worldwide Rush
description: Worldwide Rush lets you experience passenger transportation and management on a global scale. Expand your company, meet the growing travel demand, compete against other companies, and discover new continents with its unique vehicles. The entire world is yours to control.

title: Still Residue
description: Desperate for cash, after getting fired, you take the only job you can find: cleaning up other people's messes. Simple work, decent pay. You thought you were just cleaning... But something's off. You're not just cleaning up messes. You're stepping into something you don't understand.

title: ER-cade
description: A game for the medically curious! Explore the human heart inside and out, cause heart attacks and other diseases, and complete challenges to unlock abilities. Then use your newfound skills to play challenging arcade-style games and compete in online leaderboards!

title: Relicbound
description: Relicbound is a TPS story rich action adventure game where you play as Jackson an archeologist abducted by a sinister organization to help them find a precious relic which can manipulate the time.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Last Stand
description:
Be hope in times of darkness. Return to the Academy and repel the Banished in Operation: Last Stand, live now through June 10.

The captured AI Iratus has exposed the location of the Spartan Academy. It’s up to you to fend off a Banished onslaught in Firefight: Battle of the Academy, a new linear Firefight experience where securing objectives is tantamount to survival. Can you outlast your foes long enough to enact the Cole Protocol?

The 2025 Summer Update arrives in Halo Infinite with new playlists, a devastating new power weapon, expanded Weapons Bench customization options, and a last stand for some of humanity’s most decorated soldiers.

title: Ethereal Odyssey
description:
Ethereal Odyssey is challenging 2D action-adventure platformer with non-linear exploration, rewarding curiosity and discovery, where secrets in every corner.

A lost boy awakens. The world around him shifts, twisting between the real and the imagined.

The world was once a dream is now a prison, shifting with every step. What waits beyond the veil? A forgotten past, an unseen presence, or something far more dangerous?

title: Delivery & Beyond
description: No packages? No problem! Break in. Scrap everything. Deliver... A chaotic online co-op game for up to 5 players (or 15 if you really want to)!

title: Valiant Villagers
description: Assemble your villagers and defeat the ultimate evil! Valiant Villagers is a roguelike strategy RPG where your choices determine your army's abilities and playstyle as you complete various map objectives.

title: Blast Rush LS
description: Ever played a difficult shmup wishing for just one more bomb? Blast to your heart’s content in Blast Rush LS, a fresh explosive experience with infinite bombs, other powerful abilities, and extra challenges that demand more than just big booms. Escaping an exploding mothership isn't easy, after all!

title: Hollowspire
description: a chill, clicker-inspired game where you dig through blocks of dirt and stone, craft, and upgrade your abilities — all in pursuit of reaching the depths and uncovering its mysteries.

title: Perfect Flow
description: A fast-paced platformer where you control the timing of obstacles. Help Hungry Guy navigate a world filled with various hazards to reach and devour the best kebab in the world.

title: MatchBox Caterpillar Big Dirt Movers
description:
MatchBox Caterpillar Big Dirt Movers is a game which lets you play in a sandbox and on the beach with Matchbox toys. The game lets you play at five different construction and building zones with ten different caterpillar vehicles.

Gameplay modes consist of exploration, beat the clock and task-based play. Completing any of the modes rewards you with a printable certificate of achievement. There are fifteen levels total, which can be played on three difficulty levels.

Objectives range from saving a sandcastle from the tide, clearing car wrecks to make way for a new park and building an airport. You use various vehicles to dig, level, wreck, construct and pave your way to the next level.

The game comes with a CAT encyclopedia that can give you insight in the vehicles the game offers.

title: Portrait on Imagined Horizon
description: a living archive

title: Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle
description: Pip Puzzle is an action puzzle gem game where you flood your opponent’s side with gems by smashing your own gems. Fight through Arcade, or play online against your friends. Find a character with a unique skill that best fits your play style, and battle through stages that evolve while you play!

title: Polygon Survivors
description: Polygon Survivors is a 2D survivors-style roguelite where you fight off waves of enemies using customizable weapons, powerful abilities, summons, and a variety of projectiles. Experiment with endless synergies to survive the polygonal chaos.

title: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
description: Cappy & Tappy is a block-stacking platforming adventure! Help the famous adventuring duo Cappy and Tappy escape the crumbling Temples of Peril! Cappy will leap, bound, and climb to escape the temple, while Tappy stacks blocks to aid in the escape.

title: The Time Intern
description: A bite-sized incremental game about time

title: Contraindication
description: Your end is my beginning. A short psychological visual novel with exploration and puzzle elements... it already lays shattered.

title: Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves - Ina After Story
description: A year after the events of Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves, Abe and Ina have both graduated High School. While Abe struggles to come to terms with his new aimless existence, Ina is plagued by cyclical thought patterns that set her spiraling into dark depths.

title: BallMan
description: A nice challenging old style platform arcade game - MADE IN ITALY!

title: Double Trip
description: Double Trip is a tile-based sokoban game about solving puzzles with the help of two friendly characters. Travel through a beautiful island by learning how its different elements interact with each other.

title: Destiny 2: Renegades
description: Dive into the criminal underworld and take down an evil empire. Venture into a lawless frontier and reveal deeper mysteries about a new Dredgen in Sol. Build your power, credits, and notoriety.

title: Babylon 5 Armada 2
description:
The sequel to the popular Babylon 5: Armada mod for Star Trek Armada, this mod features over 200 vessels in 8 different sides. Included are the Earth Alliance, the Minbari Federation, the Narn Regime, the Centauri Republic, the League of Non-Alligned Worlds, the Rangers, Shadows, and the Vorlons.

This mod is a must for any B5 fan, check it out today, or get Babylon 5 Armada 1 at Armada Fleet Command.

title: Arcade Archives: Punk Shot
description:
"PUNK SHOT" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1990.
Your goal is to defeat the rival team and win in a basketball game where all sorts of interference and attacks are allowed.
There are various gimmicks set up during the game, so you need to be careful not to get too distracted by your opponent and lose the ball to them.

title: Q with VTubers
description: The latest installment of 'Q REMASTERED,' the physics-based puzzle sensation that took off among Japanese streamers in early spring 2023, is now on Steam! It's 'Q ｗith VTubers'!! Challenge the bizarre and difficult puzzles created by over 20 VTubers who mastered Q!

title: Éalú
description:
Éalú is an entirely hand-animated, stop-motion, point & click adventure. A cozy experience... unless the maze takes a darker turn... Guide your wooden mouse through a labyrinth full of puzzles & unknown dangers in search of an exit to a happier place.

Éalú is a 2 to 4 hour long, meditative experience, depending on how deeply you explore the maze, focused on physical craft and reflection - made by a independent team of four artists: Ivan Fisher-Owen (Concept, writing & animation), Ben Orr (Dev/Programming & writing), Will Wood (Musical composition & recording) & JT Paton (Illustrations).

title: PASS Fortress
description: A standalone mod of Team Fortress 2, focused on improving and giving deserved attention to the oft-forgotten PASS Time game mode. Players take on a deadly form of team handball as one of three classes in this movement tech-focused expansion of the classic hero shooter.

title: Elemental Brawl
description: Elemental Brawl is a multiplayer party game for everyone who likes to beat up their friends (in a good way!) with the power of the elements! Compete across interactive arenas, mix and match elements for new and exciting attacks, and use them to bring even more excitement into other players' lives!

title: Pinball FX: Tomb Raider Pinball
description: Relive Lara Croft’s greatest adventures with two action-packed pinball tables. From the legendary halls of Croft Manor to mysterious tombs around the world, test your skills, uncover secrets, and play through iconic moments from the Tomb Raider franchise.

title: Defender's Dynasty
description: A 2D Strategic Base Defender game set in Medieval times. As relentless Waves of enemy forces threaten your Stronghold, you must gather Resources, Fortify your Defenses and lead your Rebellion. Prepare to strengthen your Base and manage your Resources. But beaware of the Storms!

title: The Legend Of Surprisia
description: Surprisia is a freeware Role-Playing Game made with RPG Maker. The game consists of 3 chapters; chapter 1 was released in 2004, chapter 2 in 2006, and united version containing chapter 3 came out in July, 2008.

title: Always: Ill
description: After losing his daughter, a broken detective clings to the sound of her voice — until an accident pulls him into a twisted nightmare. Trapped in haunting echoes of her past, he must solve puzzles and uncover chilling clues to stop a deranged man from sacrificing his child... to bring back his own.

title: Pakinpaks
description: A cozy puzzle game where you go on a journey all around the world packing and organizing all sorts of travel gear. Fulfill your client's request in any way you wish and — as long as everything fits — prepare the neatest bags that you can!

title: Astro Busters
description: Astro busters brings you a fast-paced space shooter game with realistic physics and responsive controls where players can take on missions, upgrade weapons and ships, battle fierce enemies in deep space and combat eachother or cooperate in an upcoming multiplayer version.

title: World of Dogs
description: WORLD OF DOGS is a high-velocity immersive sim where speed isn’t balanced—it’s weaponized. You are the first fully grafted human, stitched together from dead champions, dumped into a collapsing city where every faction is fighting for a future that hates you.

title: Raging Bill
description:
A wild TPS sandbox in a mini open world, inspired by Goat Simulator.
Shooter, melee, racing, loot, exploration, bodycam… all mashed into one!
A love letter to the 80s/90s and pop culture, packed with Easter eggs.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - The Fall at Dawn’s Rise
description:
Version 3.3 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Hyacine and Cypher
• New Trailblaze Mission: "The Fall at Dawn’s Rise"
• New areas: Fortress of Dome and Cloudedge Bastion Ruins
• …and more!

title: Step On It!
description:
A game with similarities to Lode Runner, the player controls a rudimentary stick figure character with the ability to add and remove blocks on the diagnal. The main goal of each level is to avoid enemies and pick up all the items available. This is a good mix of puzzle and platforming.

The game also includes a co-op mode where you can play with a friend on the same keyboard

title: AmoebArena
description:
"Start with a futuristic version of Chinese checkers invented in a biohazard lab, add just a dash of the cantina scene from Star Wars, and you’ll get a pretty good idea of what AmoebArena is all about. This strategy" game’s concept is simple: pit your army of microscopic organisms against your opponents’ microscopic armies in a free-for-all arena battle. Imagine the game of Risk invented by a mad cellular biologist

Your armies are made up of four types of single-cell soldiers: cytozoids, amoeboids, mitoplasts, and blockers. Each type varies in terms of movement, attack power, health, and ability to reproduce. You start the game with a set number of each organism, which you place in your corner, or “home area,” of the board. Your opponents do the same, and then it's a cytoplasmic slugfest as you pilot your pieces in the arena according to their movement allowances, attacking and defending. The winner is the player with pieces left on the hoard at the end of the battle. It took me less than five minutes to get started playing, but I'm still nowhere near mastering the strategies it takes to win.

There are three scenarios from which to choose: a quick, basic game or two more-protracted tournament games. Tournament games cycle players through changing game boards as you fight for control over your opponents’ star systems. Win control over them all (or hold the majority in limited round tournaments) and you get to take a victory lap around the AmoebArena starship. In the more complex scenarios, the hoard and the composition of your pieces change between battles, and so does the strategy. Five computer opponents are available, each with a different style of play. It’s also possible to compete against human opponents, but because the human players have to share the same computer (no network play is available), it’s essentially a oneperson game. If you are shopping for a game to play with your friends, choose another.

Surrounding the game board are windows that contain animated portraits of you and your opponents. I found a cheesy sci-fi charm to these graphics and the background data on each player, but they won’t be to everyone’s taste. The windows come to life as you or your opponents react to the fortunes (good and had) of microscopic combat. These prefab personalities, intended to add flavor to the game, are only moderately successful. But I loved the way my animated cell warriors oozed across the board, accompanied by a disgusting sucking sound.

The Last Word My only real complaints about AmoebArena are that there’s no network option and that you must play it from the CD. This is a simple game, and the movie files that come with it aren't essential. I would have liked to run it from my PowerBook, but there was no option to play without those flics. In the end, though, these are minor quibbles. AmoebArena is an engaging game that’s easy to learn but doesn't lose its slimy charms after just a few games."

Hawn, Matthew. (January 1996). AmoebArena 1.0. Macworld. (pg. 75).

title: Zalis
description: BL fantasy adventure with RPG elements. Manage an alchemical workshop, create potions, and raise your stats. Engage in a fantasy story in the Ukrainian setting.

title: GoofyPlatformer
description: Silly platformer game with custom levels

title: Blocky Blast
description: Stack, match, and blast your way through endless colorful puzzles. Master two exciting modes - Adventure and Infinite - and become the ultimate Blocky Master.

title: Cubyz
description: Voxel sandbox game with a large render distance, procedurally generated content and some cool graphical effects.

title: Risk of Rain 2: Alloyed Collective
description: Lured, enslaved, and left to rust. The Alloyed Collective now stirs from the scrap of their fallen allies, driven by a singular purpose: returning home. Master two new Survivors and descend deep into Petrichor V to take on the Alloyed Collective’s ultimate creation.

title: Reflection of Sin
description: Do you know who Jack is? These corridors, reflecting his past crimes, will show you who Jack is. Face your sins NOW!

title: The Old Woman
description: The Old Woman is a psychological horror game set in Japan. To attend university, the protagonist moved to the countryside. However, after starting to frequent a certain public bathhouse, strange and unsettling things began to happen.

title: Backroom Loop
description: Backroom Loop is a first-person psychological horror (entertainment) game. You are trapped in a familiar-feeling space, exploring and escaping… only to return to the start. Can you break free from the loop?

title: Silent Woods
description: Silent Woods blends survival, open-world exploration and a deep crafting system to create a heart-pounding experience. How long can you survive in a world where death lurks in every shadow?

title: Crowley Hotel: The JH Chronicles
description: Wander through a haunted hotel where three Entities are trapped; solve cryptic clues about their rooms, collect artifacts belonging to them by deciphering their stories, to unravel the three chilling endings.

title: Deep Dark
description: Deep Dark is a linear story game about being stranded alone in deep space, at the end of time. you find yourself isolated, where no one hears you cry.

title: Trump Horror
description: Player control President Trump in fictional horror world, where his only mission is to find death people skulls hidden in big open world in this horror walking simulation

title: Trump Trade War
description: 2.5d Platformer where you control president Trump in fictional world. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and try to get end of level where are money he needs

title: Cursed Station
description: Warning: You are one station away from descending into an endless loop of anomalies, where every decision could trap you in an unending cycle. What appears to be progress may only lead you back to the beginning, testing your perception and resolve with every station you pass.

title: Donuts for Deer Teeth
description: Steal donuts to feed your fat cryptid wife or die trying! Donuts for Deer Teeth is a top-down, roguelite brawler where your only goal is to steal whatever you can get your grubby little raccoon paws on before shoving it in the face of some weird deer-faced skull thing.

title: The Well's Blessing
description: Explore the mystical sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

title: Vampire Prison
description: This game is a escape game from a prison cell ruled by vampires.

title: Dandelions and Me
description: Dandelions and Me is a short psychological horror game about searching for your lost dog in an abandoned dungeon.

title: Job Applications
description:
The difficulties of life are too difficult for a little cat to just meow around.

While riding the train and making phone calls, you finally decide to bite the bullet and fill out some forms...

No matter how little you enjoy the idea of putting out another batch of job applications.

title: Escape the MonStalkers!
description:
Escape the MonStalkers! is an indie action-adventure horror game.

Look for secret passageways while dodging traps and monsters in dark levels.

The player is sent to recover "Memory Fragments" in order to complete a machine to figure out why he keeps having nightmares.

The game's art style is colorful voxels.

title: Rosaline
description:
Step into the world of Rosaline, a kinetic visual novel series by EvoSky Entertainment!

Follow the journey of Rosaline, a strong-willed flower in life's dark garden, as she navigates through treacherous paths and unforgiving hardships. From her tragic childhood to becoming the world's most deadly assassin, Rosaline's story is one of resilience, mystery, and adventure.

title: For the Greater Good
description: For the Greater Good is a violent, story-driven action game where unique characters fight a blood cult hell-bent on world domination.

title: Ookami Okami
description: You're dead. But your love life is just beginning! Reborn in the Spirit Realm, take over a crumbling hot spring inn and partner with a brooding masked god who hides more than his face. Explore secrets, rebuild the inn, and flirt through simmering tension in this point-and-click romance visual novel.

title: Anthill Village
description: Now that ants have evolved thumbs, they're unstoppable! Help them build villages, scour the land for resources and fend off creatures 100 times their size!

title: DanDeLion: Starchild Journey
description: Doujin bullet hell game.

title: Tracking Killer
description: 《Tracking Killer》 is a role-playing game set against the backdrop of modern crime investigation. In the game, you will play the role of a detective, conducting on-site investigations and investigations, sorting out the case, collecting evidence, and apprehending the murderer.

title: Escape From Lava
description: Rising lava, zombies, and a deadly city... Can you escape? In this **single-player survival game**, your mission is simple: CLIMB UP! Lava is rising every second, and zombies are hunting you down. Reach the top and get to the helicopter to survive!

title: Pigface
description: You wake up with an explosive headache in a pool of your own blood. You're Exit, a terrible woman whose awful past has finally caught up to her. Fulfill contracts for the people who drilled into your skull — guns-blazing, slow and tactical — it doesn’t matter. They know you’ll do whatever it takes.

title: Midnight Munchies
description: Midnight Munchies is a first-person horror game where you embark on a journey throughout your house finding various foods to fulfill your midnight cravings. What begins as a simple task, eventually evolves into a deepening horror experience.

title: Chick Defender
description: This is a shooting game in which you play as a funny chicken who shoots corn at bees to protect the chick while trying to collect all the keys before the countdown ends. It's a casual and simple game where you challenge yourself to see how far you can go.

title: Exit Loops: Street 001
description: You are trapped in a never-ending street loop. Observe your surroundings carefully and identify anomalies. Make the right choice at the end of each street and try to escape the loop.

title: Demon Quest
description: A Puzzle-Metroidvania set in an intriguing alien world. Face ruthless bosses, master the art of stealth combat, upgrade your multi-tool set, and use it ingeniously to escape a malevolent spirit holding you captive. One way out: escape.

title: Otaku Survival Horror
description: An otaku trapped in a zombie-infested city. Survive the pixelated apocalypse in this retro-style survival horror.

title: Shiika wo Tashinamu Re
description:
A story told from two points of view.

On one side, the protagonist is one day masturbating to his little sister when his home which was actually sentient but in hibernation wakes up and forcefully ejects him from the premises. He returns only to be ousted once more. This repeats until the building gives up and the two start their lives together. This is a story of boy meets girl.

On the other side, Agnafire, Blizzarto, and Lie Spark are Devices, automaton created to annihilate humanity. Despite no longer receiving messages from above or any other Devices, they continue to search and destroy human settlements. Upon reaching a certain village, the trio split up with Lie Spark searching the nearby forest alone. Within the forest lies an abode with an unexpected inhabitant: a fellow Device who has been coexisting with humans. This fateful encounter begins Lie Spark's questioning about herself and her purpose of existence.

title: Supersonic Dogfighters
description:
Supersonic Dogfighters is a roguelite game about a group of pilots trying to defend the archipelagos of the Peaceful Sea from various factions that are trying to conquer them.

Gather tons of upgrades and new planes as you defeats foes in this colorful roguelite game. Local coop up to 4 players supported!

title: Mini Painter
description:
Mini Painter is a cozy desktop idle game about finding balance between work and rest.
Immerse yourself in a meditative world where a tiny artist paints miniature figures, decorates his home, and learns to take care of himself.

title: Rock and Scroll
description: In Rock and Scroll you follow Sisyphus who is now cursed to be the very boulder he pushed up the mountain, as he tries to outwit the gods one last time in this literal side scroller platform game.

title: Gangan! Junkland Dash
description: 2XXX year. Junkland suffers from enemies. The King of the enemy army boss and the gangs led by him occupy the junk land and it becomes a battlefield. To get Junkland back, residents, stand up! Modify the car, wear weapons, fight!

title: Hugo Classic #4
description:
Hugo Classic 4 includes the following mini games:
Mine Track
Moor
Boulders
Wild River

title: Hotline Miami 2: Her Relentless Crusade
description: 1890, Eastern Europe. Assassinations threaten to collapse the already-unstable Livonian Empire. Princess Tishina and her allies are the nation's last shot at restoring order. Dynamite, clubs, lever-action shotguns, and more will let you lay waste to your enemies. Eleven levels, multiple endings, and plenty of secrets await players. Enough hiding from the monsters terrorizing your home - time to get sweet, sweet revenge.

title: Stray Savior
description: Stray Savior is a 2D action platformer packed full of lethal traps, precise jumps, and powerful bosses. Venture through the dystopian world with weapons and skills, to prove yourself and forge your own path.

title: Redaktorka R.K.
description:
Our story is about the usual liberal arts stuff: literature, editing, and death.

The main heroine is a skilled editor who has to figure out the mysterious suicide of the famous author Stepan Nelyivoda by correcting hyphens into dashes and dashes into commas. Don't be afraid to look in the dictionary, because you'll need it!

title: The Masochistic Ball
description: Roll. Jump. Fall. Repeat. The Masochistic Ball is a precision 2D platformer with a rising difficulty curve. The early levels welcome everyone. The final ones? Pure nightmare fuel. 40 levels. No enemies. Just you, gravity, and your will to endure.

title: Mission Impossible Puzzle
description: A promotional puzzle game by Discord.

title: Adrenalinkick
description:
Feel like Ghost Rider and race across the highways and streets of any regions.

A race in the grey area of the law, because there is no speed limit for you.
But always remember,
every decision could be your last.
You don't have unlimited guardian angels.

title: No Alibi
description:
No Alibi is an online top-down co-op shooter with roguelike elements. Sneak in unseen, take hostages or go in gunning – the choice is yours. Use your cash to buy a range of customizable weapons, from small pistols to massive miniguns and sentry turrets. Add attachments to your weapons at the weapons workbench – but keep in mind that the more you invest in your gear, the more you’ll lose if you can’t make it out.

Your group starts out as a small criminal concern, robbing banks and jewelry stores, but you’ll soon find yourself scoring big on some high-stakes targets. The man you answer to is hard to keep happy, and if you can’t deliver, it’s game over. The relentless action will keep you on your toes, so make sure you come well-equipped. You’ll never be truly ready.

title: Tank Top Nitori
description: Plays as Nitori, a kappa engineer wearing a Tank... on her top. No story, just dumb gameplay where you get to shoot things for no real reason. Plenty of war crimes to be committed!

title: The Long Fall Home
description: THE LONG FALL HOME is a precision puzzle-platformer for 1-4 players. Waking from cryo-sleep decades too late, you must navigate a surreal, shifting space of bizarre obstacles and cosmic oddities. Solve physics-based puzzles, overcome traps, and uncover the truth on your long journey

title: Time Cowboy
description: Time Cowboy is fast paced retro cowboy fps focused on movement and is about a stubborn cowboy named Hank blasting his way through history, trying to figure out who's dragging him through it.

title: Pop Life
description: You’ve made it all the way through the challenges of the great TV show! But this is just the beginning of the path. For you, a whole new adventure is starting. Teachers, new concerts, you’ve everything to discover. And more than ever you need to make friends amoung the teachers and show biz professionals. Will you be up to the task? Welcome to Pop Life! This game allows you to follow the career of the winner of the ‘Pop Life’ contest through a series of concerts throughout the world. You will need to call on teachers to teach you songs, dance steps and stage effects to create your own spectacular concets. You’ll prepare your concerts in a house you build yourself, while making sure to do the max to please your fans. On to fame and glory!

title: Perfect Pitch
description:
A game about music, romance, and the covid-19 pandemic as a convenient plot device.

Perfect Pitch is set in the American Midwest in late summer 2020. Just before the crescendo of covid cases later that year which would mark one of the deadliest winters on record.

You are an up-and-coming multi-instrumentalist (named Miles by default) who is presented with a rather unique opportunity: a full-ride scholarship to the internationally renowned, all-girls music conservatory named Géante Endormie.

But this scholarship is no simple charity... you have a job to do. The future of your classmates, and the future of the Conservatoire, depends on it.

Enjoy your stay at Géante Endormie~

title: It Has My Face
description: Kill your clone before it kills YOU! In this roguelite sandbox horror game, experience true paranoia as you hide, hunt, and try to eliminate your double. Fight to survive as you unravel this terrifying tale of clones and biological horrors!

title: Foodomina
description: Play as two personified food girls- Takoyaki & Tempura- in their cosmic battle against mold people! Explore a food-themed galaxy, rich in flavour, make friends, & engage in absurd pun-fueled combat to save the galaxy from infection! But mold people used to be food people- Maybe there's another way?

title: L8r Sk8r
description: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

title: Pluto
description:
A roguelike deckbuilder where you fight with your fingers, spill some blood, and try to make it to your niece’s birthday on time.

You’re a wizard. A not-so-heroic wizard imprisoned for wizard crime, awoken from your wizard slumber by an invitation from your niece. Escape from jail and traverse a hostile world crawling with danger. Every turn is a frenzy of spell sigils, cracking bones, and desperate gestures as you shred through monstrosities with raw elemental power.

You’re not the chosen one, you’re just trying to be a good uncle.

title: Self Simulated
description: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer for the Game Boy Color. Play as a robotic version of yourself and navigate over 100 handcrafted levels filled with enemies, hazards, and glitch-filled dangers. Uncover your past and master tight, responsive controls designed for fast retries and fluid movement.

title: Mr Farmboy
description: MR FARMBOY is a cute colony farming automation game. Plant, grow, harvest, raise animals, hire workers, gather, craft, automate, and build a beautiful farm for villagers to visit.

title: The Binding of Steve: Minecraft Crossover
description: Play Isaac Afterbirth + with items directly coming from Minecraft !

title: Invincible
description: This mod adds Mark Grayson aka NVINCIBLE as a playable character.

title: Lunatika
description:
New strange minimalistic indie horror quest adventure game with atmospheric dark mood, mystic storyline and pixel art.
Are you brave enough to check that strange sounds?
Are you ready to go up and face monster?
What if monster is you?

title: Tales Beyond the Tomb: White Silence
description: Years after a tragic expedition, investigator Aleksei Morozov returns to the frozen mountains to uncover the truth. But some trails should never be followed...

title: Go! Go! Beetle Roller!
description: The 3D Action Platformer starring the titular superhero BEETLE ROLLER! Collect orbs to grow your ball gadget, blast through walls, and squish foes unworthy of your power in a mad dash to reach the end of each level!

title: Spooky Express
description: Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park! Transport monsters to their destinations — but don’t let them bite the passengers or you’ll have a grave problem.

title: Arcane Dice Wars
description: Welcome, Transient One . Only you, brought forth from another world, unbound from the Elements and the Arcane Gods, can turn the Wheel of Fate. With the help of loyal servants, strategic deployment, and some lucky dice rolls of course!

title: Mouse Arcade
description: Embark on a nostalgic adventure as a daring mouse, climbing arcade machines to master a variety of retro mini-games and beat every high score in Mouse Arcade!

title: Darkflame Survivors
description: A cute action rogue-lite with a focus on incremental meta progression and coop. Set in a fantasy world and played in top-down perspective.

title: Anomaly Seeker: The Diner
description: Step into the world of Anomaly Seeker: The Diner, a thrilling anomaly detection puzzle game that tests your attention to detail and memory! Set in a charming and atmospheric diner, you’ll need to carefully examine the room and identify hidden anomalies. But the challenge doesn’t stop there—on your next visit, the room may look the same, but there’s a twist! You’ll need to recall the details and determine if something’s changed. Only the most observant will be able to find all the anomalies and solve the mysteries lurking within. Featuring 27 anomalies. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Hidden Pandas: Village
description:
100 Hidden Pandas: Village is a hidden object/hidden creature game. The player's task is to find cleverly hidden fluffy pandas in a detailed, hand-drawn scene. The game's aesthetic visuals are accompanied by calming music and sound effects designed to relax the player. There is also a hint system implemented, showing where the player might have missed one of the pandas—some of these cute creatures have found really good hiding places.

Game features:

100 adorable fluffy pandas to find,

a detailed scene depicting life in the village,

calm and pleasant music,

a hint system,

progress saving.

title: SOS: Save Our Sandwiches
description: Point & click aboard a private luxury yacht on a dark and stormy night with funny evil witches and sandwiches Features rain effects, exploration of an entire ship, puzzles, and monsters

title: Big Dig Energy
description: Do you have the Big Dig Energy!? The best co-op mining game with online and split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players! Team up, dig deep, mine energy ore, and upgrade your tools. Reach the planets core to fuel the rocket and leave Earth!

title: Solanis
description: A free-to-play, single-player adventure game that invites players to soar through the remnants of a world scarred by ancient conflict. A thousand years ago, humanity tore the moon from the sky, sealing it within you and chaining you to the earth. Now freed, you must journey into the scorched, war-torn land you once called home and return the moon to the sky.

title: Crazy Golf Party
description: A vibrant and whimsical mini-golf game that transforms traditional crazy golf into an engaging digital experience. Supporting up to 15 players in online or LAN multiplayer, it offers a variety of themed courses—including Funderheim, Elden Forest, Egypt, Windmill Valley, and Haunted Hallows—each filled with unique challenges and surprises. Players can personalize their golf balls with an array of hats and skins, adding a fun twist to the competition. Ideal for casual gaming sessions with friends and family, Crazy Golf Party delivers lighthearted, chaotic fun for players of all ages.

title: Juegue Con Su Amstrad 03: Max
description: You must collect the energy capsules, avoiding contact with the acid pumps or getting caught by the big Simio...

title: The Victims of Lost Sunny Days: Eclipse
description: You accidentally find a game you don't remember having and launch it. There seems to be nothing strange about it: it’s a regular children's game with bright graphics. But in this colorful and friendly world, an ominous eclipse sets in…

title: Delectatio Morosa: A Conclave Visual Novel
description:
The conclave is over: you are still a manager.

Play as Dean Thomas Cardinal Lawrence as he prepares for All Saints' Day. After the conclave, the Vatican only has one week to prepare for the upcoming celebrations, and the responsibility for managing his Curia members, and his growing feelings for them, falls upon you.

title: The Cameraman
description: "The Cameraman" – A Mind-Bending Psychological Thriller. You document a child's memories—but the deeper you go, reality warps, whispers grow, and the past unravels.

title: The Blue Cut Hook
description: The Blue Cut Hook blends cozy tavern management with subtle adventure. You're no hero, just a humble tavern keeper, but your food, gear, and advice quietly shape the adventurers who pass through. They make the choices, take the glory, and face the danger, but your influence might keeps them alive.

title: Mageye
description: In an increasingly oppressive world, a magpie feeds her only remaining child amidst a city of lackluster sightseers. Take their vision and feed your son.

title: Reflections of the Void
description: A sci-fi drama about love, control, and the price of human emotion. Care for your wards, follow every order — or break the rules to discover who you truly are.

title: Risk the Dark
description: Risk the Dark is an action-filled top-down roguelite set in harrowing darkness. Struggle to escape a shadowy, monster-infested cave while battling threat after threat. Using a variety of weapons, melee, as well as interactions with NPCs and items, light your way and Risk the Dark.

title: Kriss' Journey
description: A science-fantasy retro-flavoured textual adventure running in your terminal

title: Urmă
description: The forest is dark and lonely, but you don't have to stay there. Keep moving forward, stay alert, and mind the rabbits.

title: Room Girl Paradise
description: It is an erotic game in the form of sims, and the genre advocated by the production company is "3D life simulation porn game".

title: Red Dove
description:
Have you ever been in love? Devoted yourself to someone so entirely that you let them assist with your home, your happiness, your health? It would be quite a tragedy if they then ended up having... an ulterior motive to their kindness.

Red Dove is a short puzzle-based survival horror game focused on repetition and acting with stealth. Do too much too fast, and you’re likely to be caught by your ever-loving fiancé. Do too little too slowly, and you're sure to miss your window of opportunity for true freedom.

There is only one objective.

Escape the room before Evening Tea.

title: EA Sports College Football 26: Deluxe Edition
description: Bring Glory Home in EA SPORTS College Football 26 and experience the world of college football. Whatever path to greatness you choose, from high school recruit to the Heisman, or as a coach, you can forge your legacy.

title: Ice Cream Together: A Cozy Parlor Simulator
description: Build your dream ice cream parlor with friends online by making different ice cream flavors, serving customers, and managing your stock. Cozy vibes, a multitude of customization options, and 4 player online co-op!

title: They Cannot Hear Me
description: It's the middle of Winter and a lonely man goes for a walk thinking about how sad his life has become.

title: Milk Quest
description: Jeff needs to go buy some milk. What should be a simple task of going to the store and getting some milk ends up turning into a crazy adventure with all kinds of weird occurrences going on including looping areas and people he knows speaking in foreign languages. He and his new friend, Karen work together to figure out just what the heck is going on.

title: Hillthorn
description: A disappearance in a secluded mountain. A village hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

title: Twice Bitten
description: A thrilling supernatural murder mystery in a neon-gothic city!

title: Mimesis
description: A co-op survival horror game. When the cursed rain falls, 'Mimesis' appear, perfectly imitating your teammates, bringing a new level of tension you've never experienced before.

title: Tabletop Game Shop Simulator
description: Build the ultimate tabletop gaming store! Stock shelves with miniatures, rulebooks, and accessories, or crack open mystery packs to collect your own figures and play against your customers. Set prices, hire staff, host epic game nights, and expand your shop to become the go-to hub for hobbyists.

title: Robots and Murder
description:
Human "Reese Urchin" wakes up in an unknown room, unable to contact his partner.

How did Reese get there?

What happened to his robot partner, iBeaux?

And will he seek a way out...?

title: Thesis: Purple Locus
description: Needing an escape from your daily life of a college professor, you decide to join an MMO role playing server. The scenario you were supposed to be playing? A Death Game - a classic. But as the first session ends, you get an anonymous email, which changes the stakes of the game.

title: Toontown Rewritten: Under New Management
description:
Under New Management is Toontown Rewritten's major update that was released as the 4.0.0 update on May 24, 2024, during ToonFest: The Great Fanfair. It was announced on May 26, 2023, during ToonFest: Birthday Bash, with a breaking newscast from COG-TV announcing a management shakeup at Cogs, Incorporated. The update is comprised of four new sinister Supervisor Cogs, revamped Cog facilities, Version 2.0 Cog Disguises, and new cosmetics.

Various observational analyses were conducted by the Cogs throughout February 2024 to monitor and evaluate the performance of the new Supervisor Cogs. Toontown community members were able to playtest the Under New Management update and provide feedback before public launch.

title: Trust Exercise
description:
Inpro is starting the first day of his new job at Common Umbrella. A very odd company with a unique and strange history (and a very mysterious celebrity running it).

Unfortunately, after he signs the paperwork, everything immediately goes wrong.

Now he's stuck in an office room with 3 other people, playing a life-threatening exercise by said celebrity where they must discuss amongst each other. Traverse through various conversations and topics as each character tries to put any form of pieces together before it's too late.

Can he trust these people? Or will it all descend into dysfunctional chaos and even betray them at the very last minute?

Regardless, you have 1 hour.

Good luck.

title: Swipe Stream
description: The game revolves around a mysterious book, De Vermis Mysteriis. What is this book? Why do people want it so badly? How are your dreams connected to it? Is it real, or just a fantasy? So, many questions - can you find out the answers?

title: Dark Origins
description: In the dark and fractured world of Dark Origins, your adventure begins with a mysterious magical box. In Dark Origins, only the most skilled and resourceful will rise to the top. Will you dominate the chaos and become the ultimate ruler of this fractured land?

title: Unchained: Tale of Enra
description: A tactical RPG where trust is your greatest weapon. Build bonds with allies to unlock abilities, negotiate with enemies to recruit them, and shape your journey through choices that blend strategy, diplomacy, and emotional storytelling.

title: Out of the Shadows
description: Out of the Shadows is a cooperative game (up to 4 players) that blends exploration, tension, and coordination. Infiltrate abandoned locations, solve complex puzzles, and survive the unsettling presence of those who still linger there...

title: Earthscaper
description: Discover and shape the real world in this new multiplayer sandbox game! Reimagine famous landmarks, explore cities, create your own minigames, build and challenge the community of fellow builders and explorers. Let's reshape the world together!

title: The Drunken Beard
description: In The Drunken Beard, you take the reins of a lively tavern where every pint tells a story. Brew craft beers, manage orders between thirsty dwarves and impatient adventurers, expand the inn and turn it into a legendary haven. Between secret recipes, rustic furnishings, and demanding customers, only the finest innkeeper will win over hearts and livers. Glory awaits… one beer at a time!

title: Die Trying
description: Plunge into a world ravaged by the dead in this hilarious co-op shooter. Blending silly antics with the extraction shooter genre. Escape with a plethora of loot, or Die Trying!

title: The Cooking Club
description:
The Cooking Club is a Slice-Of-Life // Dating Sim visual novel that is produced in the Ren'Py engine!

Ready to start cooking?

High school can be a drag—especially when you’re stuck in classes you can’t stand. Looking for an easy escape, our protagonist.. YOU! (Yes - You!) stumbles upon the only club with an open spot: The Cooking Club.

What starts as a simple excuse to ditch class quickly turns into something far more delicious. Between chopping, stirring, and whisking up new dishes, unexpected sparks begin to fly. Will you master the recipe for love, or will things boil over? With a cast of charming clubmates, secret ingredients of romance, and just a pinch of chaos, The Cooking Club is serving up a story that’s equal parts heart-warming and hilarious. So grab your apron—because in this kitchen, love is always on the menu!

But remember.. each decision you make comes with a choice and a path - you can't have every girl to yourself!

title: Mole's Quest
description:
In Mole's Quest, the player controls a mole who must navigate moving platforms (similar to elevators) to collect objects and return to the starting point. The game is challenging, with obstacles such as bizarre creatures and platforms that can cause instant failure if jumps are mistimed. Each session is limited to 5 minutes, increasing the game’s difficulty and urgency.

The game features simple, colorful graphics typical of early 1990s PC games. Controls are basic, using the arrow keys to move the mole and jump between platforms.

Mole's Quest was included in the Fast Action Paq compilation released in 1993. This compilation was published by Mallard Software Inc. and developed by The Dreamers Guild. It featured a collection of four retro-style games, including Mole's Quest, BOT, Flak Attack, and Bubble Trouble.

In 2002, the compilation was re-released under the name Retro-Action Paq by Wyrmkeep Entertainment Co., which also handled the development of the re-release. However, the original 1993 release was published by Mallard Software Inc.

title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona - The Jewel in the Skull
description: Embark on a mysterious adventure where the shadows of the past intertwine with the threats of the present. You will venture into the labyrinth ship of the mad genius Mardek in search of a legendary artifact – “The Jewel in the Skull”. Using this artifact, you can enter the Ghost World and uncover the truth about Demagrass, the brother of Queen Aurora, whose fate is enshrouded in mystery and intrigue.

title: Dark Mine
description: Trapped underground after a collapse, you are the sole survivor of a deadly attack. Armed only with a night vision camera, navigate the darkness, avoid the creature, and find a way out in this retro-style survival horror game.

title: Hit Idol
description: Hit Idol is a cozy drag&drop indie puzzle game by Toraka about managing a high school idol band club, featuring twelve character-based story arcs and cute pixel art. Train in various musical mini games to reach Star-Filled Sky Festival and bring justice to Teacher's old enemies!

title: Blue Hill Wendigo
description: Arm yourself with weapons, traps, and supplies in this survival horror FPS. Battle ruthless bandits and a relentless wendigo as you uncover the truth and fight to survive in this open world horror game.

title: Card Streamer Simulator
description: You will play as a live broadcasting room to open card packs anchor, according to customer orders to open card packs live. The profit and loss gain of the live broadcast all depends on your choice and luck, in addition, you can also participate in it yourself to collect the full set of card books.

title: Balls Gone Wild
description: There are also portals that instantly teleport objects to different locations.

title: Moving Forward with Cat
description: Earth turns. Cats turn. And you will turn too. Welcome to the world of inertia, a law of physics. A game of gravity and inertia with unique controls for the hardcore game lovers.

title: Legacy: Reawakening
description: Point-and-click adventure game filled with unique puzzles and atmospheric exploration. Journey deep underground into a mysterious forgotten place and uncover the secrets hidden within.

title: Rod & Ripple
description: A fun fishing game where you catch fish, sell them, meet the weekly quota, upgrade your equipment, and fill out the AquaDex! The further out you adventure, the stranger and more difficult fish you may encounter, but be wary of sharks at night and in deeper waters...

title: Lets Nuke Mars
description: Follow orders. Press buttons. Nuke Mars. A darkly funny SPACEFORCE sim where obedience is optional.

title: DuoQ
description: Squad up with Tala, a mysterious (and flirty!) player you meet in the lobby of a fictional FPS game. Use your real-life voice to talk with Tala over comms, solve puzzles, and outwit enemies. By the end, you’ll answer the most important question: Is she into you?

title: The Deadseat
description: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.

title: Running Out
description: In this fast-paced platformer, every run is a race against time. Push your limits, speed through levels, and go further with upgrades that keep you in the game. Sharpen your skills, optimize your runs, and reach the finish before it's too late. Fast, intense, and addictive, can you beat the clock?

title: Don't Drop the Soap
description: A rage-fueled 2D platformer with dark humor. Play as a bar of soap escaping deadly traps, ghost guards, bullets, and prison floors. Fast, precise, and unforgiving. Packed with achievements. Cheap, weird, and brutally fun. Perfect for fans of indie, meme, and speedrun games.

title: Synthetic Captive
description: Synthetic Captive is a first-person stealth escape game designed to reveal that the most terrifying monsters originate from the human mind. In this dungeon, escape is nearly impossible. You play as the protagonist, exploring the dungeon prison, struggling to survive and escape.

title: Beauty’s Target
description: This is an immersive romance game where you play as the protagonist, exploring diverse settings and meeting unique characters. By chatting, dating, and exchanging gifts, you can build relationships, unlock engaging storylines, and create your own romantic journey. *****Implicit hints in the game

title: Urgent Message
description: "Urgent Message" is a post-apocalyptic survival game that combines text-based exploration with turn-based combat. In this world full of dangers, you will drive a car, navigate through desolate cities, and race against time to reach your destination, seeking a glimmer of hope for survival.

title: House Builder 2
description: In House Builder 2 you build your dream constructions with friends or alone in a vibrant, low-poly open world! Buy materials for work, load it up, and drive to your next job in the ultimate co-op construction adventure!

title: The End of Gameplay
description:
droqen's desperate attempt to explain, or explore, or understand the true meaning of "kill gameplay."

something as mundane as lights
neither of us saying "goodbye"
you following me following you
following me following you...

title: Anime Dream Match: Boys
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool anime boys.

title: Grease Monkey Grand Prix
