Blob is a spherical space traveller. He has only got one eye, which is perhaps why he has crashed his space ship on Blobland - oh no! Blob must find a new rocket to escape... before the Alienblobs catch him!

Blob's Adventure is a tilting maze / labyrinth puzzle game. The game takes you through grassy, rocky, and icy terrains, using pick ups and physics to progress through each level. A "Mario-esque" combination of arcade platform mechanics and puzzle elements.

title: Dodge the Creeps
description: Dodge the Creeps is a fast-paced arcade survival game where your reflexes are your only defense. Control your character using the arrow keys to evade relentless waves of creeps emerging from all sides of the screen.

title: Berty the Giraffe
description: Step into the Shoes of Berty the Giraffe in this 2D Top-Down Dungeon Crawler

title: Battle
description: "B.A.T.T.L.E. is a high-action single-player FPS with realistic gunplay, intense combat, and stunning graphics. Master 64 unique weapons, customize them with 240 skins, and fight against enemies in immersive war zones."

title: Good Luck Crossing
description: A brutal, unforgiving parkour experience with no checkpoints, no second chances, and no hand-holding. Every jump matters. Every slip sends you back to the start. Not for the faint of heart it's rage-inducing, soul-crushing, and almost unfair

title: Strange Shores: Social Desktop Fishing
description: Strange Shores is a 1-4 player online fishing game you play from the corner of your desktop. Catch over 100 fish and unusual items, share catches, send emotes, and unlock new locations. Work, study, chat, watch... FISH!

title: Revolvermen
description: Revolvermen is a local PVP partygame where up to 4 players battle in the wild west. The goal is simple, get to high ground & shoot players below to climb the scoreboard. Aside from your standard revolver, you can also pick up different power-ups in the world to rain hellfire from above!

title: Fruit Wars
description: Fruit Wars is a chaotic multiplayer puzzle game where players throw fruits to create matches and score points! Outplay opponents by landing combos, blocking shots, or stealing points. Aim, throw and match to become the true Fruit Chef.

title: Space Bubbles Must Die!
description: Space Bubbles Must Die! is a tiny, highly-addictive bubble-shooter where you eliminate evil space bubbles to save the planet. Inspired by the classic titles like Peggle, Arkanoid and Space Invaders.

title: Seeking the Guardian
description: 「Seeking The Guardian」is a puzzle adventure game filled with puzzles and “impossible” puzzles. Within the stone cave engraved with legends of the Guardian, read the murals, solve the puzzles, and search for the exit.

title: Carnival Happy Day
description: ( Carnival Happy Day ) This is a casual and Joyous carnival game, There are 18 different game stages in the game! And there will be 5 different ways to play in each game stage! There are 90 ways to play in total.

title: SphereCore Survival
description: A top-down survival action game where you shoot, dodge, and upgrade to survive endless waves of deadly spheres.

title: Endless Robot Dash
description: "Endless Robot Dash" is a fresh and fast-paced endless runner game.

title: Elliot's Show Time
description: Help Elliot light up the stage in a rhythmic adventure featuring 10 original songs.

title: Wumball
description: Wumball is a challenging adventure game. You have no health and no weapons to defend yourself, so tread lightly. Can you make it to the end and save the king?

title: Digital Desktop Cats
description: A cute virtual cat (or two... or three) that lives on your desktop. Feed them, play with them, and enjoy their company while you use your computer.

title: Goddess Scroll: The Last Starlight
description: A short ARPG game of the Tower of Demons genre, You are playing the savior of the goddess world - the Valkyrie Akashii, You need to plan and manage the collected resources, strategically engage in battles, and use various keys, In addition, there are 7 imprisoned goddesses waiting for your rescue

title: Slaughtra
description: Slaughtra is a arcade styled top-down horde shooter where you face off against an ever growing onslaught of enemies seeking nothing but to end you. Fight your way through and maybe somehow you'll find your way out of this nightmare...

title: Decaying Memories
description: Spot the difference in the 3 given photos and survive for six minutes! Take too long to spot enough discrepancies and you lose to the fear meter!

title: Whispers of Wings Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Soar into "Whispers of Wings Jigsaw Puzzles"! Piece together stunning scenes of hawks, owls, and songbirds in vibrant habitats. Unlock bird facts and enjoy customizable puzzles. A delightful avian escape!

title: Wildrise
description: Join Floofi, the forest guardian, on a mission to restore nature's splendor. Match colorful flora and fauna in this charming puzzle adventure to transform barren lands into flourishing wilderness. Will you help Floofi bring the world back to life?

title: Holiday in Europe: Czech Adventure - Collector's Edition
description: Explore Prague and beyond with the Collins family! Solve hidden object challenges, brain teasers, and uncover secrets in stunning locations!

title: Seaquest Find the Difference
description: Dive into the underwater world and find all the differences!Embark on an amazing adventure in the depths of the ocean! In this exciting game, 80 levels await you with images of marine animals—from graceful dolphins to formidable sharks, colorful fish, and other sea creatures.

title: What Could Go Wrong?
description: A one-staff shoestring budget bio-lab management simulation game

title: Restorart: Horizon Bay Collector's Edition
description: Restore damaged masterpieces and uncover hidden stories in the enchanting seaside town of Horizon Bay!

title: Rogue Ninjas
description: In Rogue Ninjas, survival demands cunning and precision. Manage a squad of elite ninjas through twisting dungeons, strengthen your inventory with rare enhancers, and battle ruthless bosses in this dice-driven roguelike adventure.

title: The Piano That Staying Time
description: “Can you play the piano?” Summer vacation starts soon. However, she says that she has rented out the entire music room during the vacation, and instead of postponing the lesson, she proposes one condition.. A full-voices visual novel with a theme of memories with emotional music.

title: Aris
description: Strategically clear your way of enemies to gather points, salvage killed enemies for extra points, all while avoiding and engaging in combat with other different types of enemies. Added effects and game mechanics make for challenging gameplay in a fast paced environment.

title: The Falling Star
description: The Falling Star is a first-person exploration and narrative-driven walking simulator. Following the mother's last wish, the girl embarks on a journey in a dream to uncover the story of her missing aunt's past.

title: Therapy Simulator
description: Step into the chair of a therapist in Therapy Simulator! Guide your patients through emotional journeys with branching dialogue choices. Balance humor, humanity, and the chaos of therapy!

title: Highway to Heal
description: Highway to Heal is a top-down arcade driving adventure game set in an open world solarpunk city. You play as Jakub & Mishra, a paramedic duo, on duty to rescue locals while facing traffic and big weather events. The goal is to bring the patient safe and sound as fast as possible.

title: Dreams: VR
description:
This major update introduced virtual reality to Dreams. Media Molecule released a new collection of short games called "Inside the Box", which included an art gallery, motion-controlled maze puzzles, a speedrun shooter and a puzzle platformer.

Users could design their own creations using a Playstation VR headset and optional Playstation Move controllers. Most dreams could be played in VR, even if they weren't created in it.

title: Steal The Pig
description: STEAL THE PIG — a cooperative platformer where you play as two thieves trying to steal a pig. Be careful, because this pig isn’t one who enjoys traveling! Try not to wake it up or let it escape! Get ready for tons of fun, unexpected situations, and a real test of teamwork.

title: Zoom: Paparazzi in Action
description: Zoom: Paparazzi in Action is a first-person photography game where players act as paparazzi capturing VIPs in compromising moments across 15 levels. Photos earn money, but bodyguards and rival photographers pose obstacles. Players can temporarily blind pursuers with the camera flash and must reach a set income to complete each mission. Levels are scripted, allowing players to memorize events, with optional humorous interactions throughout.

title: Tren
description: A game that puts you in the driving seat of an adorable model engine. Deliver cargo! Solve puzzles! Do big flips! Rack up high scores and become the envy of all your friends! And join Tren on a grand tour of your fondest childhood memories, as you discover a story all about the transformative power of play.

title: Yesterday's Crossroads
description: Yesterday's Crossroads is a choice-driven adult visual novel where every option leads to different outcomes. Meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own personal struggles, and shape their stories along with your own.

title: Vampirates
description:
Vampirates is a wave-based co-op brawler set in a tavern under siege, where the only way to survive is to feed zombies to a terrifying, flying Otter God.

Play as chaotic vampirates in a crumbling tavern overflowing with zombies, weapons, and very questionable decisions. Fling enemies or friends, into the fray using anything you can grab. Yes, literally anything. Rubber Chicken? Check. Barstool? Obviously. Kevin? Especially Kevin.

Slap your way through waves of undead while desperately trying to appease a bloodthirsty otter god who’s watching your every move. You’ll fight. You’ll feed. You’ll probably die. Horribly.

The tavern’s in “otter” chaos, the Otter God is starving, and your squad is screaming in proximity chat. This is fine.

title: Dreams: Dragons, Dungeons & Templates
description:
This update to Dreams included a new game and an overhaul of the creation experience. Media Molecule released "Ancient Dangers: A Bat's Tale", a dungeon-crawling action game featuring orcs and new PlayStation trophies. It couldn't be played in VR, but was one of the few Dreams creations that supported local co-op.

Templates were released that allowed people to quickly created themed dreams. These included mini golf courses, speedrun challenges, 2D platformers, shmups, and a fully featured toolkit to modify their dungeon-crawling game into something new.

title: Spin Royale
description: Spin Royale is a bottom-of-screen idle game where your slot machine spins and earns money automatically. Collect rare symbols, upgrade powerful items, and climb the global leaderboard in this endless progression experience!

title: Rumbral
description: Rumbral is a dark, puzzle platformer set in a seemingly forgotten world. Find your way in this desolated place while trying to recover your memories and find out who you really are.

title: Transport Fever 3
description: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

title: Critical Shift
description: Critical Shift is a hardcore turn-based tactical game with RPG elements and a profound dramatic story. An atmospheric sci-fi mystery imbued with the unknown and featuring the strangest objects awaits you! Every enemy here is a lethal threat, and resources are worth their weight in gold.

title: Shuten Order
description:
"168 remaining until the end of the world..."

Humanity is approaching its end. A sudden dismemberment murder of the leader of a religious nation that advocates an apocalyptic ideology... Five adventure games are combined into one, centered around a suspenseful story full of mystery and intrigue.

title: Castle of Heart: Retold
description: Introducing Castle of Heart: Retold, a completely reworked version of the challenging action platformer that had been exclusive to the Nintendo Switch. The tweaks include rewritten dialog, reworked cutscenes, remixed music, graphics and animation changes, improved gameplay and UI, changed endings, and more.

title: Megadeka
description: At some point, the giant “Her” began living in this country. She crushes parts of the city beneath her feet and shakes the earth with her breathing. We must defend the city from Her. MEGADEKA is a simulation game where you defend your base from a giant woman.

title: Atomfall: Wicked Isle
description:
The Wicked Isle story expansion is set on Midsummer Island. To get there, players must speak to the boat-keeper in Wyndham Village, who provides the first Lead.

Located near the Windscale Atom Plant, Midsummer has higher infection levels and introduces new enemies like pirate bandits and infected druids. Players can find new weapons, including a Blunderbuss, bow, daggers, the Beekeeper’s Staff, unlock new skills and an upgraded metal detector.

Leads found on the island open new story paths and possible alternate endings to Atomfall.

title: Bombardiro Crocodilo: Italian Brainrot Simulator
description: Join Bombardiro Crocodilo, the iconic crocodile-bomber plane, and a roster of absurd meme characters like Bombombini Gusini, Tralalero Tralala, and Lirili Larila in a surreal battle for supremacy across the Croco Nation and beyond!

title: Zombie Outbreak 1942
description: Glowing eyes are seen in the distance, and you start to hear the sounds of the undead approaching your location. You quickly scramble to find your pistol and barricade the windows as quickly as you can, but it's too late. Zombies are approaching. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

title: Run Jump Climb Disarm
description: Run, jump, and climb your way through 20 uniquely themed levels and disarm all bombs before time runs out.

title: Parliament of Hell 1796
description: Parliament of Hell is a horror comedy adventure game set in 18th century England. Young gothic poet Matthew has been forced to serve in Government by his Father. He will get himself kicked out by any means necessary, even if he must call on the Devil himself…

title: Daily Sudoku Together
description: A Discord activity offering daily sudoku puzzles, as well as a number of unlockable puzzles of various difficulty levels.

title: Space Mines
description: SpaceMines takes you on a strategic puzzle adventure through the far reaches of the galaxy. On a grid-based field, carefully uncover tiles while avoiding hidden dangers lurking beneath the alien surface. Use logic and deduction to reveal all safe zones without triggering a single trap. Customize the challenge to your liking — choose from various grid sizes and difficulty levels to suit your play style. Whether you're a casual explorer or a seasoned tactician, SpaceMines delivers a thrilling and addictive puzzle experience for all players.

title: Higgs Boson: Puzzle Collection
description: Higgs Boson Collection is a trilogy of brain-bending puzzle games where every rotation counts and every second matters. Your mission? Guide mysterious spheres through a precise network of pathways — but there's a twist: you don’t move the spheres… you rotate the world around them.

title: Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation
description:
Hoard’s LLC is a cozy, story-driven puzzle game where you play as Barry, a mild-mannered minotaur working deep in the depths of a corporate dungeon. When Barry starts to realize his coworkers are being exploited, he sets out to do something truly radical: help them.

Navigate a maze of departments—like Loot Logistics and Monster Resources—solving puzzles to reconnect isolated coworkers. Along the way, you'll uncover endearing stories, roll your eyes at cheesy corporate puns, and bring together a community that needs each other now more than ever.

title: Breadleg
description: Breadleg is an absurdist, comedy game about running round a scottish village as a piece of bread with legs. Encounter the people of the village and collect socks to help you escape without being eaten, whilst maybe getting involved in a bit of mischief along the way.

title: Broomstick Exorcist
description: Play as Vikka, a street sweeper who hunts demons at night while keeping the street clean. Devour the darkness in a night filled with demons in this unique 2D, hand-drawn, Manga-inspired beat 'em-up horror adventure.

title: All-front Assault
description: This is a game where players manipulate and command a commander from a customized perspective, controlling an entire team to combat alien creatures.

title: Minerva Labyrinth
description: A turn-based dark magical girl dungeon crawler. Create a squad of magical warriors, explore twisted labyrinths, and exterminate the demonic Hate that threaten the city.

title: Chronoquartz
description: In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress. Strategy, critical thinking, and time management will be your allies in this unique temporal adventure. Will you succeed in saving time?

title: Despicable Boss
description: Rise from the depths of hell in Despicable Boss, a third-person action game filled with intense combat, strategic choices, and dark humor. Defeat powerful bosses, navigate treacherous contracts, and climb the infernal hierarchy. Will you outwit the chaos and seize control?

title: Phobic Nightmares
description: Phobic Nightmares is a psychological horror game where you experience nightmarish realities to uncover what happened to your sister. Find notes from your sister and use the sacrifices of those who came before you to uncover what’s hidden and avoid ending up like them.

title: Supersize My Heart
description: Welcome to Flavor City, Crew Member! Slip into some non-slips, cozy up to one of four deliciously dateable mascots and flame broil your way into their heart in the premier fast food mascot dating sim! Because in this crazy town, the most craveable item on the menu...is love.

title: You've Changed
description: You've Changed is an anomaly horror game in which you unravel a mystery behind the anomalies. Imagine "spot the difference" but scary. The game features 8-bit era inspired art and rotoscoped enemy animations.

title: Wasteland Kitchen
description: Run your very own restaurant in the post apocalyptic wasteland! Serve "meat" made from rats (or your customers)

title: Swamp Fellas
description: Swamp Fellas is a cozy multiplayer game up to 8 players where frogs fish, vibe, and cause mild chaos. Explore a chill island, talk with friends via proximity chat with a reactive character, and mess around with weird props in a third space made for silly fun moments.

title: MeowWare
description: A puzzle based clicker time attack game with nostalgic 1990's computer themes and cat culture. Click, type, and navigate through a litany of puzzles and memes to clear all the pop ups on screen!

title: Zhǐjiān Wèndào
description: Path of Dao is a unique match-3 cultivation simulator where Eastern mysticism meets addictive gameplay. Gather resources, cast abilities, and unlock strategies on your journey to immortality. Every match brings you closer to ascension as you master the way of cultivation.

title: Appetité Amor
description: Warrior Girl Fianna stumbles upon a cafe owned by an otherworldly cook and his drool-worthy dishes.

title: Charta Dungeon: Ambidextrous
description: A deck-building Roguelike game! Fuse hundreds of skill cards with poker hands, wield myriad joker cards, and forge an unbreakable legacy. Brave treacherous paths, outsmart relentless foes, and rise as the ultimate card master in a shattered world!

title: Brick Breaker Maker
description: Brick Breaker Maker is a rich, element-based Arkanoid game in which you need to flexibly control the baffle to bounce the ball and break the bricks to win. The game provides level editor that can be shared in the workshop to interact with other players, which is full of fun and competition.

title: Battle Ground Battle Royale
description: FPS/TPS Multiplayer, battle royale - Alpha version

title: Lost in the Grotto: Thievery
description: An FPS game where players navigate dungeon landscapes, unravel mysteries, and master the art of thievery.

title: Forklift Certified: Stacked and Loaded
description: Chaos meets co-op in this fast-paced forklift frenzy! Team up with up to 4 players to stack, crash, and (barely) survive the warehouse floor. Master the forks, dodge disaster, and deliver perfection—kinda. You're not just licensed... you're Forklift Certified!

title: Data Drift
description: Fight through a neon cyberpunk city action in this fast-paced top-down action game! Hack, upgrade, and battle high-tech enemies with a stylish cartoon look and an electrifying synthwave soundtrack.Indie game shooter top down cyberpunk.

title: Boobs Hidden Rio De Janeiro
description: 100 Boobs in all shapes and sizes are waiting for you to be found on the sun-kissed shores of Copacabana Beach in Rio de Janeiro!

title: Technology Market Simulation
description: Run your own tech store in Technology Market Simulation! Buy, sell, and strategize to grow your business. Customize your shop, manage inventory, and build your tech empire!

title: Winoa Wizard's Witchy Quest to Womanhood vs. the Botanical Bitches
description: Winoa Wizard is a new witch! ready to start her quest to become a real witch! Unfortunately for her, the evil Catrina Underwood Nathanial Trotwether, has other plans. Sending evil wizards and witches after Winoa to stop her journey to become a great witch!

title: In a Bit of Tales
description: In a Bit of Tales is a unique horror anthology game featuring seven spine-chilling stories delivered in an omakase-style experience. Explore haunting dreams, mysterious cults, ghostly schools, and more!

title: Cure for Death
description: Cure for Death is a short visual novel that blends 2D and 3D elements. It marks the first chapter of a chilling story set amidst mysterious events in an old mansion. You’ll encounter its peculiar residents — and you won’t just talk to them, you’ll have to live with them.

title: Cat Lab!
description:
The scientist cat is trying to mutate the mice to make them smarter. But something goes wrong and many mice escape. You have to find all the mice to complete the mutation.
This game is suitable for people of all ages. It has more than 70 levels and frequently updated content. We have many new updates planned!

title: DragonLoop
description: The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop. Connect with your partners to travel through a world with strange time changes, continue to become stronger, retrieve memories, and understand the truth. The game is a time loop Metroidvania.

title: Living with My Little Sister
description: Your truant younger sister decided to crash at your place. Improve your relationship by spending time with her while balancing your job as an illustrator. Give her a head pat, cook for her, have a chat, and maybe, over time, she'll open up to you.

title: Toy Escape
description: Toy Escape is a co-op game for up to 4 players where you play as a small toy trying to climb your way through a giant house to reach the rooftop and escape. Jump, climb, and find your way out in this fun, toy-sized adventure!

title: Living Nightmares: False Familiar
description: Carl Williams, a 15-year-old boy, finds himself alone at home one unsettling night. What begins as a quiet evening soon spirals into something far stranger. Shadows shift, silence speaks, and someone—or something—seems to know him better than he knows himself.

title: Heist Royale
description: Heist Royale is a chaotic multiplayer heist game where strategy, sabotage, and speed determine who escapes with the most cash! Race to rob a heavily secured bank, outsmart rivals, and dodge security—all while pulling off hilarious tricks and betrayals. Work together or backstab your way to victory!

title: Action Game Maker
description: Create 2D action games without coding in the latest entry of the Maker (RPG Maker) series! Use an FSM-based visual scripting system to build games across genres with ease. Fully harness Godot Engine’s advanced 2D features in a high-performance tool like no other!

title: Leximorph: Word Merge Game
description: Leximorph is chill Suika-like word puzzle where if two of the same letter touch they morph into the next letter of the alphabet and grow in size - space runs out fast! A variety of games modes suit all types of play styles from relaxed to intense.

title: Everyday Life Fragments
description: Everyday Life Fragments is a first-person psychological horror. Artyom goes to bed and finds himself in an alternate reality, where his familiar surroundings are distorted by his fears. Here he meets the mysterious Anna, a reflection of his subconscious, and seeks answers to his secrets.

title: VertiGhoul
description: In this difficult 3D platformer where precision is key and a single wrong movement could be your death. Master the movements to get the fastest times and fulfill Death's List.

title: Galactic Simulator2: Stargate
description: Galactic Simulator 2: Stargate is a roguelite simulation game inspired by the Fermi Paradox and the Great Filter. Pilot your ship, gather resources, build stargates, and discover other civilizations as you explore an ever-evolving galaxy.

title: Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi
description: Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! This is a relaxing and enjoyable idle fishing game that can sit at the bottom or any corner of your screen, allowing you to enjoy a leisurely sea fishing time in your busy life.

title: Stick and Stack
description: A fresh twist on the familiar block stacking formula where every piece sticks immediately on contact! Master the challenge of arranging tetrominos and strategically growing vines to fill gaps as the pace grows increasingly frantic in this sticky, nature-themed puzzler.

title: WaterMeasure
description: Given a 5-liter cup and a 3-liter cup, how can you measure 4 liters of water? You can fill a cup to the brim, empty it completely, or pour from one cup to the other. The game features 103 carefully designed puzzles of increasing difficulty, challenging your problem-solving skills step by step.

title: Mythos: Book One
description: An "adult" murder mystery urban fantasy comedy visual novel! Lisa Harrison (your ex-girlfriend) is dead, and you have a feeling there's more to it than meets the eye. As you search for answers surrounding Lisa's death, you discover a hidden magical world lurks within modern-day Baltimore.

title: The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back
description: Help Amikaze get his revenge! Run, jump, dodge, bounce and make your way as fast as you can to blast the local hunters! Revenge your family who ended up as tenders! And beat the gold times to become THE legendary duck!

title: Desktop Fishing
description: Desktop Fishing is a cozy idle game that sits in the corner of your screen. Go about your usual desk work (or don't) while your frog buddy catches fish, discovers new outfits, and unlocks fishing spots.

title: Choco Clicker World
description: Embark on a sweet journey with Choco Boy, an engaging idle clicker game. Craft the finest chocolates, maximize choc drops, and expand operations. Upgrade resources and uncover new processes as you tap to chocolate mastery. Enjoy endless fun and mouth-watering excitement!

title: Tiny Kings
description: Tiny Kings is the whimsical medieval base builder where your dreams of building and managing a pint-sized kingdom come true! Unleash your inner ruler and build your kingdom, manage your citizens' tasks, and dominate the siege to become the ultimate ruler.

title: After Inc: Revival
description: Can you rebuild civilisation after a zombie apocalypse? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique blend of strategic simulation, survival city builder and ‘mini 4X’. Build settlements, harvest resources and shape society as you lead Humanity out of the darkness.

title: Itty Bitty Little Kitties
description: Discover tiny little kittens hidden throughout magical forest scenes while enjoying relaxing music in a calming, zen-like atmosphere. Some are easy to find, but others can be real little devils, so be warned! For cat lovers and hidden object game enthusiasts alike ♡♡♡

title: Boobs
description: BOOBS is a uniquely soothing and interactive experience, letting you relax and unwind by engaging with realistic boob physics, calming visuals, and immersive gameplay designed to bring peace and comfort.

title: Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack
description: She’s a princess beloved by ducks. He’s a notorious king of schemes. A romantic fragment from a 3000-year old EPIC, retold as an Otome visual novel… but with ducks somehow added to the mix.

title: Elf Adventure: The Lost Castle
description: Elf Adventure: The Lost Castle is a dark anime-style adventure where you explore a mysterious castle, fight goblins and their leaders, avoid traps, and discover hidden chests with unique illustrations of Freilina.

title: Organic Burger Simulator
description: Organic Burger Simulator invites players to craft delicious burgers using organic ingredients while focusing on customer satisfaction. Harvest fresh produce from the garden, fulfill orders, and grow your business in this fun and engaging simulation game!

title: Combat Master: Battle to Death
description: Combat Master: Battle to DEATH is a roguelite game with souls-like combat. Battle against hordes of various dark fantasy monsters and try to survive as long as possible. The game fully focuses on combat, pick a class from 6 different classes and start SMASHING!

title: Oceanides of the World's End: Legend of the Big-breasted Swimsuit Beauty Guardian
description: "Fast-paced, rogue-like defense action game with simple controls! The Ark of Beauties in Swimsuits, 'GFM Oceanus,' is inhabited solely by stunning women. Neptes must battle the Deep Ones threatening them and unravel the mystery of the 'Great Mother of the Abyss.'"

title: Life of Tabayama
description: A peaceful school life slowly descends into darkness. When a beloved classmate mysteriously disappears, four teenagers find themselves tangled in secrets, betrayals, and hidden desires. Uncover the truth behind the missing girl — and the horrors that lie much closer to home than anyone could imagine

title: Zombie Demolition: Infinite Zombie Shooter
description: Zombie Demolition: Infinite Zombie Shooter is here to scratch your FPS itch! Pick a weapon of your choice and start blasting endless amounts of zombies. The game has 3 game modes and Vampire Survivors mechanics! Solo or multiplayer up to 4 players!

title: Bank Shot
description: Bank Shot is a Bullet Hell on a pool table with Rouge-like elements, where you are the weapon. Ram enemies to send them flying into the pockets or pelt them until they break. Choose upgrades that change the game, and shoot for the high score

title: Zaccaria Pinball: Shooting the Rapids - 2016 Table
description: Shooting The Rapids 2016 Table is an indian themed pinball table.

title: Bloodstone Rising
description: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike where space dwarves battle waves of relentless zombie hordes to reclaim their ancestral kingdom. Mine resources, forge upgrades, and enhance your abilities between waves to survive the onslaught.

title: Chained Beasts
description: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4 - Evolution
description: The Evolution team took Naruto Storm 4, a game with an abundance of content but no future patches, and are providing the players a polished, more unique experience. Through communication, polling, and rigorous testing, we are able to make changes to improve the player experience, add/modify existing content with the help of contributions, and push changes out via updates. Whether you play competitively or for fun, we aim to provide the best experience possible with Evolution!

title: Monsters and Me
description: A chaotic 2D top-down roguelite shooter where you blast through waves of mutant freaks, upgrade ridiculous weapons, and die gloriously. Slime is everywhere. So are the jokes. Survive alone or with a buddy—then do it all again!

title: Fenced In
description: An arcade-puzzle game inspired by Zoo Keeper, Fenced in has you managing 10 different animals into 4 pens, making sure carnivores don't eat herbivores and filling up the pens as much as possible to get the highest score possible!

title: Strip Battle Action Cards
description: Get ready for intense, strategic card battles in STRIP Battle Action Cards! Unleash Physical, Mental, and Magical attacks to strip your opponents and claim their clothes. Customize your deck, unlock outrageous outfits, and climb the difficulty ladder to become the ultimate champion!

title: The Elevator: Beyond the Doors
description: A narrative-driven psychological visual novel where every floor of an elevator reveals a key moment from your past. Face your regrets, uncover forgotten memories, and make choices that shape your future. Will you find closure, or remain trapped in your own mind?

title: The EverFloating Island
description: This is a Sky Island simulation game. To prevent your Sky Island from falling, you need a large amount of float stones to maintain the production of float energy. Trade, missions, robbery—do whatever it takes to survive...

title: Block Plop
description: Pick colors, plop down blocks, and conquer the board! Relax solo or challenge your friends in this delightful puzzle-strategy game. Coming in June. Wishlist to stay updated!

title: Tales of Lyfael
description: Tales of Lyfael is an RPG game with turn-based combat and comedy elements connecting both fantasy and the real world. Choose your avatar, gather new companions, battle fierce enemies, craft mighty artefacts, learn new spells and most importantly... become the hero Lyfael needs!

title: Eternal Siege
description: Eternal Siege is a tower defense game based around resource management, efficient use of spells, upgrading systems, and (hopefully) building some towers. Start in the Ancient Greek era, and develop a strategy to survive the human extinction to battle for the top of the leaderboard.

title: Corgi Conquest
description: Corgi Conquest is a difficult platformer where you're a corgi trying to get back to your owner! Continue to dash your way out of heaven all while trying not to fall back to hell...

title: Dungeon Drops
description: Jump, fight and climb your way out of the ever-changing depths of the Snake Castle in Dungeon Drops!

title: Dracula: End of Days
description: This is a visual novel-style game. The story follows a father gradually turning into a vampire in a frozen zombie apocalypse, who must wield supernatural power to protect his daughter—yet each hunt erodes his remaining humanity. How can this vampiric father uphold his vow to 'never harm humans'?

title: Monmusu Paradise: Visitors
description: Welcome to Monmusu Paradise Island, Where your lewdest memories come true! Start your adventure by exploring the island and getting items and money needed for you to get laid successfully with various girls on the island.

title: Clutchtime: Tournament Edition
description: Shoot threes, slam dunk, block opponent shots and steal the ball. Rebound and run fast breaks. Call timeouts and substitute players. Every basketball action is a card. Manage the time remaining on the game clock. Win 4 games in a row to become a champion!

title: Mini Worlds Dioramas
description: A peaceful sandbox for building tiny worlds. Mini Worlds Dioramas is your digital Zen garden—no goals, no stress, just pure creativity. Mix and match cozy props from different genres to craft your own calming dioramas.

title: Bonfire Barrage
description: Play as a Bonfire Spirit, unleashing flaming bullets to fend off relentless waves of shadowy foes. Master dynamic movement, evolve your powers, and adapt to the ever-shifting chaos. Keep your flame burning in this fast-paced, stylized 2D action-roguelike, where every moment is a fight for survival!

title: Demonfo
description: A girl at the bottom of the ladder with bad luck finds a cleaning job, but she mistakenly enters a cleaning company that is in the business of exorcising ghosts. As the story develops, the girl realizes that there is a reason for her constant bad luck, and gradually her divine power awakens ......

title: Reef Defense
description: Reef Defense is a fast-paced, intense strategy game where relentless waves of crustaceans are coming for your precious eggs! Arm your reef with strategically positioned defenses and hold the line. Can you outlast the swarm, or will your eggs become crab food?

title: Nina
description: NINA is a short, narrative-driven psychological horror game about a girl who keeps forgetting. Guide her through memory, fear, and truth—before it's too late.

title: Infernity: The Devil's Arena
description: Step into the depths of hell in Devil's Arena. Fight as a fallen gladiator in brutal, trap-filled arenas. Customize your warrior and unlock new arenas. Survive the chaos and fight for eternal victory or escape the torment of hell itself!

title: Love Blades and Run
description: Viva la Revolution—tear through a parkour action game where every move is rebellion, every fight is a swift flair, and style rules the streets.

title: Upgrade My Heart
description: Mathew builds an AI robot with stolen tech. As the government closes in, trust, love, and survival collide in this sci-fi visual novel full of choices.

title: Today, I'm Harvesting You
description: Very poor and very tired of being single, you set out for your day with one goal: change both of those things, no matter the cost!!

title: Anathyma
description: Anathyma is a Hero Tower Defense game where you command a powerful Hero and build and upgrade towers to fight back against increasingly powerful waves of enemies.

title: Nobility Simulator
description:
Take a step back to the 17th century and experience life as a true Polish noble. You own land, command peasants, and live by your own rules — but beware: idle workers and the looming Swedish invasion may ruin your day faster than you can say “Wiśta wio!”

Nobility Simulator is a third-person, immersive management game set in the slightly exaggerated but historically-inspired world of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.

title: Sizzle & Stack
description:
Sizzle & Stack is a fast-paced, card-based cooking simulator where deck-building meets restaurant chaos. Inspired by Stacklands, this unique twist on the culinary genre puts you in charge of a growing kitchen where every dish, upgrade, and decision is made with cards.

Every day is a new puzzle. Stack ingredients, combine tools, manage tight spaces, and serve up delicious meals to increasingly demanding customers. Whether you're prepping a simple soup or assembling a gourmet masterpiece, timing, strategy, and resource management are your secret ingredients to success.

title: Escape the Baby Alarm
description: Escape the Baby Alarm is a cozy puzzle adventure about the chaos and love of early parenthood. Solve hand-drawn, escape room-inspired puzzles inside the baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

title: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
description: This is a top-down, auto-shooting roguelike that can be played entirely one-handed. Players take on the role of Pinocchio, fallen into a twisted dreamworld, collecting forbidden Dream Eggs that grant ever-changing offensive and survival abilities. Slaughter mutated fairy tale characters in endless nightmares!

title: A Quiet Place
description: A short, psychological horror experience where you, player, quickly age to see how's your family doing now.

title: Thunderhead
description:
On Friday night, just past midnight, the people of Thunderhead screamed in terror.

Their end began four days earlier, when a strange hill appeared at the edge of the cemetery.

Maybe it began even further back - but our story begins the next morning, when the first light touched a town stained by horror.

What happened in Thunderhead was first told by the man who delivers milk every Friday to towns too quiet to matter.

title: Broken Willow
description: A girl's gone to look for her missing friend. But what will she find when she's out there?

title: Mirror's Edge: Pure Time Trials
description: "Pure Time Trials" DLC for Mirror's Edge, which adds nine new time trial maps.

title: Seventh
description: Seventh is a fast-paced, speedrun-focused FPS with parkour elements, themed around the seven deadly sins.

title: Fourmiworld
description: Carve your own path through Fourmiworld - an "open-world-ant-farm-metroidvania". Play as an interdimensional urban explorer girl, collect gamut to unlock new abilities, and discover the sights, plights, & soundbites of a surreal alien dimension.

title: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
description: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

title: Youtubers Life 3
description: Reach the top of the rankings! Create your dream home with a luxury setup, compete online in real-time with other users by streaming, creating VODs, and editing them in the most epic way… and don't forget to share your photos in the unique and time-limited events on your calendar!

title: Sulo the Sidekick
description: A cozy desktop pet building his own career while you do your thing. Unlike a Tamagotchi, Sulo cares about your well-being too!

title: Teardown: The Greenwash Gambit
description: Stranded far from home after a thruster test gone wrong, a lone Löckonaut must stop E.F.O. Corp's deadly black hole waste system. Explore a strange world, defy gravity, and perform heists against the corrupt corporation.

title: Lunaraxia: Magpie Sings of the World's End
description: Lunaraxia: Magpie Sings of the World’s End is a Soulslike Roguelite inspired by classic arcade games such as Punch-Out!! and Crossed-Swords with narrative and gameplay loop of Hades.

title: 100 Men Vs Gorilla
description: Are 100 men enough to defeat a gorilla?Step into the battlefield and join the internet's most absurd and epic debate. 100 men and one furious gorilla in a chaotic, intense fight where every hit counts. Only you can bring this legendary and eternal question to an end.

title: Puzzledom
description: A comprehensive collection of 3D minimalist puzzle games, including various classic puzzle games such as Sokoban, Unblock, Connect, Ball Sorting, Sudoku, Folding, Line Way, Tile Match, Binairo, Number Chain, Hashi, Shikaku, and more. Each puzzle has 3 difficulty levels: Simple, Medium, and Hard

title: Secrets of Blackrock Manor: Escape Room
description: Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...

title: Sodahazard: Taste Test
description: A struggling content creator goes toe-to-toe with conspiracy and catastrophe in this short, narrative RPG. Adventure to the world of the Soda Kingdom, a plastic paradise that values the brand above all else!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

title: Street Dog Legend
description: Street Dog Legend is a flash-game inspired cooking simulator with a satirical storyline and multiple endings. Manage your street cart, meet interesting characters, play minigames, and more!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Arbites Class
description: You are justice. The Adeptus Arbites enforce the Lex Imperialis – the Imperial Law. Utterly unforgiving, they persecute heretics and traitors throughout the Emperor’s realm. Restore order to Tertium with your Cyber-Mastiff and a devastating array of new weaponry.

title: Truth Scrapper
description: You have a case to solve, your memories reset each day, and two mysterious guides are vying for your attention– who will you decide to remember, and who will you decide to push aside…?

title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Lex Imperialis
description: "Lex Imperialis" is the second story expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, featuring 15 hours of compelling gameplay, a new companion, Familiars, and an entirely new faction: the Adeptus Arbites.

title: Endless Night: The Darkness Within
description: Help Jake survive his inner darkness in Endless Night: The Darkness Within — a psychological action-adventure through surreal dreamworlds and fractured memories. Master fluid platforming, battle twisted manifestations of fear, and uncover the truth buried deep in Jake’s subconscious.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Tides of Torment
description:
The Tides of Torment DLC pack introduces three new Legendary Lords for the High Elves, Slaanesh, and Norsca, playable in Immortal Empires and Custom Battles.
Each Legendary Lord brings unique campaign mechanics, features, and battlefield units inspired by Warhammer lore. Whatever your style – aggressive, decadent, or manipulative – none can escape the Tides of Torment!

title: Scratch the Cat
description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

title: I Checkmate Thee
description:
«I Checkmate Thee!» - this is the inscription the King will see every time he makes a wrong move. But this is not the end of the story, but the start of a new game. The lonely Hero is locked in the body of the King, imprisoned on a chessboard, only a sharp sword that slays the enemy with one blow will help him pass several games against the opponent's chess pieces, playing by the rules of chess. The fading light of the torches will show the countdown of the move, but the thickening darkness will hide the opponents in the darkness; and only their eerie voices and glowing symbols will tell the King how not to get checkmated again, not to see the inscription «I Checkmate Thee!» and start all over again.

On the black and white squares, the King will meet not only animated and beautifully-designed three-dimensional living enemy pieces, but also his own dead ones: pawns, bishops, knights, and the queen. On some of them you can find scrolls, collecting which, you can learn the secret of liberation from the chess trap. You can hide from enemy attacks behind the dead chess pieces, and strike enemy pieces with sword blows, each time creating a new path for the King, where each new move is a step towards death!

«I Checkmate Thee» is an unexpected game combination that combines elements of horror and chess on a chessboard. There are no words in the game, a minimum of text, and everything that is important for passing is shown in the surrounding world. Try to pass this test, seeing the phrase «I Checkmate Thee!» again and again.

title: Blood Bowl III: Season 9
description: Blood Bowl III season 9 introduces the Khorne faction, known for their aggressive playstyle and Frenzy skill specialization. The update brings the Eternal League single-player mode with enhanced AI and themed competitions, along with a new Redraft system that allows teams to reset and rebuild every 20 matches. Players can participate in the Bloodthirst Challenge event to test the Khorne faction and earn rewards, including legendary skins. The game combines tactical strategy with the violent spectacle of fantasy football, as teams compete in both single-player campaigns and online multiplayer matches.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance
description: Type like your life depends on it in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance! Brutally decimate hordes of daemonic scum with every keystroke, in this fast-paced rail shooter. None can stand against the might of your WPM (words-per-minute)!

title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - The Well of Dreams
description: The conclusion of the Verminous Dreams campaign. Race against time through the Warlord’s stronghold, the Skaven-infested temple of Athel Lithri, to stop the verminous scheme and the dangers of what they could do with a Warp Bomb if they manage to make use of the Well of Dreams! If such a thing exists…

title: Supremacy: Warhammer 40,000
description: Tax your brain with deep and engaging grand strategy in Supremacy: Warhammer 40,000, a new mobile game from the creators of the popular Supremacy 1914. This new entry in the Supremacy franchise is designed to challenge both veterans and newcomers alike, navigating the deadly world of the 41st Millennium as one of four factions vying for control of the planet Vigilus.

title: Ferdinand Fox tries Ecoterrorism
description:
A minigame compilation about using any means necessary to save the planet!

Help Ferdinand fight climate change and the government while caring for his mental health in this minigame compilation! Choose actions to take based on your resource need and get ready to mash your keyboard or controller.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector – Deeds of the Fallen
description: Welcome to Warzone Chalnath — a volatile hotspot in the galaxy-wide conflict — where you take the battle to Thorakleo IV. Featuring 12 brand new missions and three new units for the Sisters of Battle.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition
description: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition is the ultimate Dawn of War experience, featuring the original Dawn of War and all its expansions, along with enhanced visuals, an improved camera, and 64-bit platform support.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition
description: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine returns. Enhanced for a new generation! Enjoy quality of life & graphical improvements that take the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine experience to the next level.

title: The Panopticon
description: Welcome to our facility! Here, you’ll experience the thrill of strategic duels – block attacks, acquire ammo, and shoot your opponent. We hope you enjoy your stay with us.

title: Cult of the Child Eater
description: Dive into a terrifying multiplayer, cooperative, survival horror adventure set in the haunted corridors of an Eastern European orphanage in the 1980s. A spine-chilling game for 1-4 players where teamwork, strategy and survival instinct are your only chance against the unspeakable horrors...

title: Find All 7: Japan
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 7: Japan! You will have to explore the unique scenery of an ancient temple and a colorful summer festival. Look for hidden items and color this mysterious painted world.

title: Scytheful
description:
Scytheful is an indie game about 3 kids pulling an extermination on underground monsters (typical activities amirite?)

Play through a vast underworld, where each separate world has its own unique charm and feel to it. Show those monsters from a failed experiment no mercy! (Because, well yk- they aren't human- well, were- bleh nevermind, lore too confusing lol)

title: Code Rapid
description: Code RAPID is a Third-Person Action Mecha game with the focus on real-time high-mobility movement. Fight on the Ondarean front to uncover mysteries of a forgotten planet. Complete missions to earn weapons and parts to build a mech that truly suits your playstyle with deep customization systems.

title: Boll Tower
description: Pizza tower parody of boll deluxe

title: Mainu
description: Mainu is a fast-paced action adventure set inside a mysterious 13-floor mall consumed by energy. When Tonu meets a girl named Venera, he learns that a powerful being named Ormatsu has unknowingly infused his excess magic into ordinary capsule toys—creating living creatures called Mainus. Drawn to the mall’s endless flow of light, food, and movement, Ormatsu spreads through the building like a black hole, splitting himself into thirteen extensions that drain the life of each floor. Tonu’s own force energy allows him to control the awakened Mainus and fight back. Guided by Venera, he must collect, master, and unleash their power to stop Ormatsu before the entire mall—and reality itself—is consumed.

title: Out Fishing
description: Out Fishing is a first-person horror fishing game set around a remote, decaying lake. Players take on the role of a lone angler trying to make a living while unsettling memories and supernatural events gradually surface. Combining slow-paced exploration, psychological horror, and a minimalist survival loop, the game blurs the line between peaceful solitude and creeping dread.

title: Two the Top
description: A simple-to-learn, hard-to-master co-op platformer where the only obstacle is falling. Bring a friend along for free with the Friend's Pass and work together as you face this fair but tough adventure that teaches with every mistake.

title: Dictocracy
description: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

title: Qimen Tower Defense
description: Players take on the role of a patrol officer. By chance, you uncover the monster invasion and get involved in battles to defend against the monsters, you can utilize a variety of strange Qimen mechanisms, Coupled with the unique skills they gradually acquire, can you safeguard this continent?

title: SudokuNexus
description: SudokuNexus is not just a classic Sudoku game – it’s an exciting journey through the world of logical challenges that will test your concentration and skills. With a modern, eye-catching design, adrenaline-pumping music, and smooth gameplay, every puzzle becomes a true test of your logic.

title: Redbeard's Recoil
description: Fire forward. Bounce back. Traverse tricky traps to take treasure. Seek seagull's sagacious skepticism. Discuss deep dilemmas: destiny, desire, despair.

title: Dragons Reef
description: Start sailing adventure by defending the Dragons Reef land from pirates, manage unique artifacts, customize character magic skills, watch out for underwater creatures, admire the beautiful foreign nature, get own dragon, collect loot. Top-down action RPG, tower defense and cartoon ships naval combat

title: Sugar & Rolling Stone
description: "Sugar & Rolling Stone" is a retro style side view puzzle game. Control the explorer Rolling Stone and help Sugar, a girl with a magical key, reach the locked door safely. Use various objects to create paths, solve puzzles, and enjoy their adventure!

title: Menhera & Troll
description: What if the keyboard warriors were actually beautiful girls? Become a psychology graduate student and try to heal their hearts. But don’t forget—they are Menhera and trolls! These girls are anything but ordinary.

title: ScaleBox
description: A sokoban-like game that you and the boxes may occupy more than one grid. You can push boxes as long as their total size does not exceed your own. With portal you can get bigger, smaller, or... make some more imaginative moves.

title: Chess Hunt
description: Chess Hunt is a rogue-like puzzle game. Use your cards to move your character and try to score as many points as possible by collecting matching chess pieces. Build your own deck and play endlessly!

title: Froggie Eggs
description: Match "eggs" and collect frogs! It's a suika-like game where you merge and grow colorful eggs until they contain frogs, then beat the level and collect the frogs!

title: Michelangelo: Stonemason Simulator
description: Shape stone into masterpieces as Michelangelo. Tap away, level up your skills, and create art – from a simple pillar to the world-famous David. A full evening's experience for the price of a cappuccino

title: Infiniclick
description: Combine, automate and upgrade programs to amass a fortune! Infiniclick is a relaxing (or not, it's up to you) incremental game in which your goal is to pay an unfair debt with Fun Corp.

title: Dear Mirror Flower
description: I am here, in this world... A Japanese-style fantasy adventure by Kogado Studio. In this town, strange incidents never cease. Join Satoree Mizuki, a girl who can read others' minds, and uncover the truth behind these supernatural cases.

title: Easy Bubbles
description: Easy Bubbles is a relaxing aquarium simulation filled with cute sea creatures. Manage your aquarium with click and idle mechanics, collect resources and have a pleasant experience in the colorful and peaceful underworld.

title: Later Elevator
description: Unconventional platformer roguelike packed with exploration freedom, action combat and mystery.

title: Melody Ball
description: "Melody Ball" is a high-difficulty rhythm music game.

title: Growmancer
description: A small incremental game about greening the land. Play as the Growmancer, a wizard traveling worlds with his canine companion to transform wastelands into fertile grounds and battle destructive wildfires. Upgrade both via a skill tree. Challenge yourself or just relax.

title: Liminal Trial
description:
Welcome to your first Liminal Trial.
You are tasked with assessing a house to determine whether it remains in its normal state or has entered an abnormal condition. Identify five correctly in a row and your task is complete. Fail, and the Collective will reset your progress again and again until stability is achieved.

Each shift could possibly reveal new changes around you, some are subtle so keep a keen eye, and some... are harder to explain.

There are twelve known deviations. How many will you uncover?

title: The Stick Figure Game
description: The most convoluted game of capture-the-flag we've ever seen! In this turn-based strategy game, make choices to bring new units into play, position forces, fire on the enemy, dig tunnels to avoid enemy line-of-sight, and more. Play solo vs the computer player, or head-to-head against a friend!

title: The Last Dig
description: Dig to the center of the Earth before time runs out. Mine gems to sell on the black market, build up your infrastructure, uncover relics of forgotten civilizations, and upgrade to face the dangers of the deep. Don't get caught by bandits or authorities while you drill into your last dig.

title: Towerdefense Blobsmash
description: Relaxing, casual single-Player Tower Defense Game for breaks in life.

title: Livber: Smoke and Mirrors
description: A short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to your child.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.

title: Shooting Showdown
description: Experience the game that changed the FPS genre forever. Match up against your friends, your enemies, or anyone in the world in the world's first virtual reality shooting range! No headset required!

title: Your Blade, My Heart
description:
Despite being a member of royal family Solstice, you were never destined for greatness. Instead, that honor was given to the next in line for the throne: your brother, Atlas. Feelings of jealously, inferiority, and anxiety grew as years past, until they became too much to bear. Not wanting to be lost to history and feel you've earned your place in your family, you aim to become a soldier in your kingdom's army.

However, with no prior combat experience, your Father assigns the kingdom's best knight to train you: Grand Knight Ramon Dayore. He's a stoic man who's scratched and clawed his way to the top. However, his experiences in the war have made him close off his heart. Will you be able to open the door to his heart, and help him love again?

title: Shooting Showdown 2
description: Experience the game that changed the FPS genre forever. Match up against your friends, your enemies, or anyone in the world in the first virtual reality shooting range!

title: Evoker
description: Join thousands of REAL players in this epic trading card game full of magic and fantasy. Summon powerful creatures. Fight hundreds of glorious adventures. Develop deadly strategies and challenge the world s mightiest players!

title: Goblin Gnome Horn
description: A 2D side-scrolling action game with hand-drawn graphics and a fun, surreal world view.

title: Sweepin' XS
description: A roguelite minesweeper game where you use different tiles, flags and skills to clear multiple boards in a row

title: A Second Chance
description: Inside these woods, which path will you choose to help your group survive ?

title: Crazy Alien
description:
Angry newcomers are going to kidnap animals for their horrible experiments. Fortunately, the small animals have hope of salvation! An alien rabbit from the Galactic Society for the Protection of Animals is in a hurry to help! With his assistant gorilla and bison, he must free the animals in two worlds.

Free the animals on the farm and in the thicket of the jungle in this endless runner with the space bunny. In a difficult situation, his friends will help you. Call the gorilla and bison to destroy any obstacles; use jetpack and upgrades to overcome the long path.

Don't forget to collect the stars, because the rabbit is a great trendy! For the collected stars you can dress him up in stylish hats and glasses. In addition to this, the stars can be spent on upgrades and the buying of additional lives.

title: Bushcraft Survival
description: Bushcraft Survival is an open-world, procedural survival game where you are pitted against the brutalities of nature. It features rogue-lite elements, with permanent skill tree progression. Use your tools and your knowledge to survive in Canada's unforgiving northern wilderness!

title: Coreward
description: Coreward is an incremental game where you use shields to protect yourself from incoming enemies and use their remains to become more powerful.

title: The Apocalypse
description: The Apocalypse is a low-poly sandbox survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge, craft, build, and fight against zombies and mutants. Enjoy fast-paced gunplay and light survival in a fun, open-world adventure with multiple game modes!

title: Terra-7
description: A company management simulation set on an alien planet. Extract, transform, and sell never seen before minerals and plants. Gain the trust of your employees, as you resist the hazards of a complex ecosystem and the requests of a ruthless market.

title: Necro Siege
description: Battle the relentless horde of zombies, demons, and other horrors as you struggle to survive. Will you withstand the madness, or will it consume you?

title: Rotten Sails
description: Sail cursed waters to hunt valuable artifacts from cursed islands. Manage your ship, explore dangerous ruins, and deliver treasures to the Armada Guild before darkness claims you.

title: Superspective
description: Solve mind-bending physics and logic puzzles in Superspective, a first-person puzzle game where gravity is relative, rooms twist and fold back on themselves, and surreal architecture challenges how you think about space. Experience unreality.

title: Napuland
description: Napuland, the video game that will take you on a fascinating adventure through the streets of Naples! Get ready to explore a virtually captivating Naples, full of eccentric characters, rich cultural traditions, and above all, a message of respect for the city.

title: Momo's Revitalization Project!
description: A visual novel featuring VTuber Momo Mitsuki in the leading role! Work alongside your Senior, Momo Mitsuki, to bring life back to a little town!

title: Night to Meet Chu!
description: An ASMR-enhanced visual novel game starring VTuber NightMare herself! What is the secret hidden your encounter and her inability to find eternal peace?

title: Souper Game
description: Souper Game is a fun and spicy clicker where you play as... SOUP! That's right—an irresistible, hot, and aromatic soup that the elven girl Sylvie prepares for the rude and insatiable Troll. Your mission? Not only to become the perfect dish but also to earn her affection!

title: Evolvania
description: Venture into a colossal creature by merging with the environment and enemies. Evolve and acquire new powers. Evolvania is an hand-drawn metroidvania in which you can play a breathtaking adventure or create your own with a special level editor.

title: Buckle Up
description: Buckle Up! is a chaotic 2–6 player party shooter where every round is a new mess. Battle friends across fast-paced gamemodes, upgrade weapons, fight to grab the most points, and show off your style with fun character customization.

title: Quiz Seikai ha Ichinengo presents Atsushi no Meitantei
description:
One day at the TBS studio… immediately after the recording of Quiz Seikai wa Ichingengo, a completely transformed Razor Ramon RG was discovered behind the studio!

“This is a murder case…!” Activating his gray brain cells, Detective Atsushi Tamura sets off on an investigation. Inexplicable testimonies, suspicious activities with no alibi, and co-stars going every which way…

In the name of the MC, he will definitely uncover the truth!

title: Experiment 28
description: Experiment 28 is a PSX-style survival horror game set in a research facility crawling with the undead. Inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill, it features tense exploration, puzzle solving, relentless hordes of the undead and co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Decorum
description: A retro-futuristic stealth adventure set in a grand 19th-century exhibition. Play as a decommissioned worker robot fighting for freedom. Blend in, avoid detection, and uncover the secrets hidden within the mechanical wonders around you…

title: Architect: Land of Exiles
description: "ARCHITECT: LAND OF EXILES" is an MMORPG set in a vast, seamless open world with photorealistic graphics built using Unreal Engine 5. The game focuses on dynamic battle action, a rich storyline, and free exploration with abilities like flying, swimming, and climbing. Players will encounter detailed NPCs and experience a compelling narrative, starting with the journey of an Assassin character. The game also features unique bosses and monsters, with the Unreal Engine 5 engine delivering a visually stunning experience

title: The Last Mile
description: The Last Mile is a narrative-driven action adventure where every decision can change your path. Step into the role of Nick Rieger, a man on the run from his past and the law. Your journey is in your hands – with shifting routes and events that shape a unique story of guilt, redemption, and hope.

title: Center Mass: Streets of Ramadi
description: Experience a faithful and authentic sniper simulation. Step into the boots of an elite SEAL sniper, mastering precision, stealth, and tactics. Featuring realistic weapon handling, intense missions inspired by real events, and cooperative gameplay for unparalleled immersion.

title: Shroom and Gloom
description: Gather and grow cards in Shroom & Gloom, a moody first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder bursting with fungal foes and mountains of mega-combos!

title: Natsume Ryoran: Romance of Hi-Spec Yoko
description: VTuber "Natsume Kamishiro" stars in an ASMR visual novel game! Set out on a monster-slaying adventure with the innocent and carefree fox spirit Natsume!

title: Liha
description: Liha is a zero-gravity action-roguelike shooter that plunges you into forsaken, anomaly-warped derelicts. Navigate in full 360° freedom, scavenge rare tech, and upgrade your ship - but beware: Every descent is a high-stakes gamble between escape and total loss.

title: RMF's Ragdoll Physics Experiments
description: Build absurd contraptions, launch wooden ragdolls, and trigger chaotic chain reactions inside a mysterious testing facility. Switch between first-person building and free-cam mayhem. Complete challenges, unlock gadgets, and discover hidden areas.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.0 - Where Clouds Embrace the Dawn
description:
Marking the start of Zenless Zone Zero's Season 2, Version 2.0 includes:
• New Characters: Yixuan, Ju Fufu, and Pan Yinhu
• New Main Story Quest: Where Clouds Embrace the Dawn
• New region: Waifei Peninsula
• New gameplay mechanics, events, and anniversary celebrations
• ...and more!

title: All Living Things
description: Uncover the secrets of the philosopher’s stone by solving twelve intricately animated puzzles that reveal the mysterious hidden meanings within alchemical images.

title: H9: Origin
description: H9: Origin is a faux-documentary horror adventure game that uncovers the truth behind a mysterious incident at the development studio of a canceled bishoujo game from the late 20th century.

title: Wrack: Reclamation
description: Inspired by classics like DOOM and Quake, Wrack is an arcade-style FPS. Mow down enemies one after another, and become more powerful the more you kill. Amass a deadly arsenal, discover secret powers... and save your world!

title: Sister of a Dragon
description: Sister of a Dragon is a turn-based tactics about a mage who tries to help her friend, but ends up destroying the world. Fight monsters by combining weapons, magic and alchemy on a hex-based matrix. Craft, explore and develop party in the Story Mode. Battle through duels in the Challenge Mode.

title: Stick Knight
description: RPG game Twin stick style top down combat, featuring a timed parry system inspired by Sekiro. Plenty of weapons and armor, as well as enemies with different movesets, and (4) challenging bosses. Game length is short enough to complete in ~3-4 days for someone with average skill playing a handful of hours a day.

title: Variance
description: Variance is an anime styled roguelike platformer RPG. Inspired by games like Dead Cells, Hollow Knight, and Enter the Gungeon, Variance offers an evolving story, deep progression, and endless challenges.

title: Escape Toon Kingdom
description: Escape From Toon Kingdom is a 1–4 player co-op horror game. Play as mascots trapped in a dying theme park. Explore. Solve. Suffer. Every attraction holds a secret—and a piece of your escape.

title: Word Play
description: Spell words, get upgrades, score points, and survive until the end. Every round is different. How far can you make it?

title: Sin and Love
description: "Sin and Love" is a dark narrative roguelike game with a background set in a fantastical version of the Tang Dynasty. You will play as a princess from the ‘Stone' Kingdom, who has been poisoned and rises from the ashes.

title: The Forgotten Apartment
description: A psychological horror experience set in a forgotten apartment filled with dark memories, eerie puzzles, and emotional scars waiting to resurface.

title: Serial Dreams Escape
description: A short walking simulator about dreams.

title: Foodslingers
description: Cook, run, jump, and throw— all in the name of FoodCorp. This chaotic, physics-based spin on the classic cooking formula demands speed, strategy, and just the right amount of panic! Play with up to 4 friends and try to run the restaurant smoothly... or let it all go up in flames.

title: A Night for Flesh and Roses
description: A visual novel by Elliot Rex White where you find yourself in a strange, organic, body-horror castle full of people who are as much of a weirdo as you are, or at least as weird as you will become. In this far future, augmenting and changing the body is so normalized that most look unrecognizable as human. In addition, the body is constantly in flux, allowing people to change their form at will, including you. Learn about this strange place while also having sexual tension with a cast of unfolded and inside out monsters!

title: Path of Light
description: Path of Light is a stealth adventure game following the journey of Lumi, a little robot seeking to reclaim his town's stolen light. Escape enemies, solve puzzles, and navigate obstacles to ascend the Forgotten Chapel.

title: Double Detective
description: Double Detective is a relaxing and peaceful puzzle game! Spot subtle differences between two dioramas, and test your observation skills across 80 unique levels. Can you find them all?

title: Memories With My Kitten
description: Remember the trips with your cute kitten in this beautiful photo album in puzzle format.

title: Grill’d: The Vanishing
description: Grill'd] is a dinner party detective game played from the first-person perspective of a royal investigator. Trapped in a mansion located in the estate of a fallen aristocrat, collect clues about the cases, connect them to one another, and interrogate the suspect to uncover the truth.

title: Blood Mall
description:
Dated November 4th, 1988.

Massacre at Dayton County Mall! Hundreds dead, over 350 injured.

Experts are still investigating what exactly happened, but it appears a... Dinosaur?... Materialised in the mall and went feral...

title: Once Upon an Island
description: You are a famous video blogger, a hunter of mystical stories, and your new project should blow up the internet. Following a fan's tip, you go to the island of Adago, lost in the ocean, where people are rumored to be missing, and the locals are talking about an ancient curse. Your goal is to make a revealing video, to prove that all this is fiction... but from the very first minutes, something goes wrong.

title: Horror Fan House
description: Explore the house and turn on all the lights, if you can...

title: Apollo
description: You can play with gravity in this open-world labyrinthe,open doors, solve puzzles, without any hints or hand-holding option. This early access level showcases the core mechanics and delivers a cool retro nostalgic, and a non-linear experience... because it's not a corridor game.

title: Hollowdeep
description: Hollowdeep is a first person dungeon crawler inspired by oldschool games of the ps1 era. There is a large focus on fast gameplay and parrying mechanics.

title: Talking Santa
description:
This year, Christmas comes early.

Talking Santa is packed with countless hours of holiday fun for the entire family! Speak into your microphone and listen to Santa repeat your special holiday message aloud.

Joined by the lovable characters from the Talking Tom and Friends collection, Talking Santa enables you to create and share joyous 3D video animation greetings and Christmas cards that will warm the hearts of everyone on your wish-list!

title: Hurry Fox
description: When a mother fox's kit becomes sick with a deadly disease, she sets out on a quest for the magic fried tofu that's said to be able to cure it. Hurry Fox is a traditional text adventure game, tasking players with meeting characters and solving problems on their way to saving the young kit. Unlike many other text adventure games, movement in this game is controlled via the arrow keys instead of typing in directions and the available exits are always printed onscreen.

title: Anomaly Bus
description: The year is 1991. You board a rickety bus in a forgotten Soviet village, heading home after another bleak day. But something's wrong. The same station keeps appearing—or does it? The signs are familiar, the streets look identical… yet something lurks behind the veil...

title: Fragile Packages: Handle with Care
description: Leap from package to package in this 'build-your-own' platformer challenge with a daily anomaly challenge. How high will you go and what will you uncover? Collect and open packages to earn cash, then upgrade your stats and items to climb even higher.

title: Gray Planet
description: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

title: BloodBound Knights
description: BloodBound Knights is a fast-paced roguelike shoot 'em up where you battle through procedurally generated levels, unleash powerful spells, and upgrade your gear. Choose your class, master unique abilities, level up, customize your playstyle, and become unstoppable.

title: Ankhway: The Interplanetary Legacy
description: Indie Adventure Sci-fi Videogame ☥𓂀𓂀𓂀𓋹𓁈𓃠𓆃☥𓅓𓆣 IT'S THE TIME, IT'S YOUR DESTINY, ¡ENTER THE ANKHWAY! ☥𓂀𓂀𓂀𓋹𓁈𓃠𓆃☥𓅓𓆣

title: DarkRanger
description: "Dark Ranger" is a light Rogue RPG. Veterans who have retired from the human battlefield have regained their glory in the secondary battlefield against monsters.

title: The Glued
description: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

title: Sera Dion: Survivor
description: Play Sera Dion: Survivor, a hack-and-slash roguelike game. Fight for survival by slaying thousands of monsters, creating your own skill combinations, and facing powerful bosses. Play alone or with friends and challenge yourself for a thrilling experience.

title: Crypts & Curves
description: Explore, Fight, and Fuck your way to victory. Delve into the Crypt of Curves in search of riches, stay for the monstrous maidens.

title: Dreams of Amelia
description: Amelia is very lonely. Working a corporate job leaves you with few chances of getting a boyfriend. And hey, Amelia has her "needs" too! But everything changed when she bought an old book, on the local flea market... with a demon inside! YOU are that demon. Make Dreams of Amelia come true!

title: Jason: Coming of Age
description: Play as a young man of 25 exploring love, temptations, and the mysterious power of attraction he possesses. Dive into an erotic, intense, and unpredictable world where every choice you make will shape your destiny.

title: Island Robot Farm
description: Build a super large island with robots in this relaxing idle farm simulation game. Assign tasks to robots to plant, raise animals and build various buildings to expand your island. Even when you're busy, the game can run quietly at the corner or bottom of the screen and keep developing your farm.

title: The Girl From Gunma Kai
