description: This game is a retro-style 2D side-scrolling shooting game. Easy one-button operation. It is expressed with graphics and sounds (MSX) typical of the Japanese 80's. The overall structure is psychedelic and crazy, but that's the kind of game it is, so don't worry about it.

title: Kauna
description: KAUNA is a Finnish boomer shooter made with 90's retro style graphics.

title: Zombie Must Dead!
description: "Zombie Must Dead!" is a game that combines tower defense and FPS elements. Players must continuously fend off waves of zombies, upgrade their weapons, and strive to survive as long as possible.

title: Sepulcrum
description: A turn based tactics roguelite! Gather a powerful band and defeat the evil that lies within The Sepulcrum...

title: Ninja Ruins
description: Ninja Ruins is a 2D pixel action-platformer with challenging gameplay. Face demons, defeat bosses, collect orbs, and buy skills to become stronger. Test your reflexes against traps and fight to stop hell from consuming Earth!

title: Monkey King: Five Elements Survival
description: "Monkey King: Five Elements Survival" is a puzzle game with a backstory rooted in the Chinese mythical story "Journey to the West". The game machanic is inspired by the ancient Chinese philosophical concept of Wuxing (five elements), where elements promote and suppress each others in cycle.

title: Tanki 2.0
description: Alongside the current “Tanki Online” project, Alternativa Games began the development of a new project called “Tanki Online 2.0”. It was supposed to be a brand new product with more realistic graphics, a more convenient UI, and a huge amount of convenient options and functions (social networks, mobile gaming, etc.). However, after one and a half years, it was decided to scrap that project and gradually transfer most new features from it into the existing version of “Tanki Online”.

title: Unknown: Raven Field
description: Unknown - Raven Field is a mystery adventure game featuring a deep story and intense atmosphere. In the suspicious village of Raven Field, chase the whereabouts of Sofia’s missing younger brother, Noah, and get one step closer to proving Vincent Marlow’s innocence.

title: Antioma
description:
Antioma is a touching adventure game about a kid, who spent almost his whole life in the hospital.

Dive into a touching story

The little boy Kiddo has spent most of his life in the hospital. Little does he know what a complicated and fascinating world lies concealed beyond the hospital walls.

Today, on Kiddo's birthday, his mom wasn't around. Instead of her, the boy met Shadow, who inspired him to escape from a hospital and search for his mom.

Solve puzzles, hide and run from enemies, make friends, and help the boy get home.

Real adventures lie in wait for Kiddo! Now his fate is in your hands…

title: Mold From Outer Space
description: A first person sci fi - horror walking sim

title: 3DTuning: Car Game & Simulator
description:
300+ models with limitless customization options and car parts on 3D Tuning configurator. Good at automotive design? Master your skills by challenging other tuning fans!

3DTuning: Car Game & Simulator App is both a 3D car configurator tool and a game at the same time. 3D tuning App gives you the possibility to customize hundreds of cars, trucks and bikes in unprecedented photorealistic quality and detail. With our huge range of car parts, customization features and design options, you will easily create THE build that perfectly fits your style.

title: Tezzel: The Tilemaker's Tale
description: Tezzel is a cozy, colorful, and crafty puzzle game where every move helps make a masterpiece. Discover mind-bending mechanics across 100 handcrafted levels.

title: Mario Tennis
description:
The version of Mario Tennis (Game Boy Color) released on Nintendo Switch Online as part of Nintendo Classics contains the Transfer Pak exclusive content, which would be only obtained by connecting to a Nintendo 64 with a Mario Tennis (Nintendo 64) game.

This is the first time Nintendo has included this specific content in a re-release of the game, since the Nintendo 3DS Virtual Console version doesn't have it.

title: Marbies Party
description: Marbies Party is a chaotic local party game playable up to 4, in which you play as silly little rounded characters running around mazes. Get in your opponents' way as you play a variety of game modes all the way to victory!

title: Pop Star Academy
description: The PC CD-ROM version of Fame Academy is a life and concert simulation game where you manage the winner of the Fame Academy TV show. Progress from wannabe to international superstar over nine spectacular levels. Choose the way your star looks, and then guide them through their career, learning new skills and making the best choices that will take them to super stardom!

title: Black Zen White
description: Black Zen White is a puzzle platformer where the world flips every 10 seconds between two versions: black and white. Think, time your moves, bend time, and interact with strange creatures in this contemplative, hand-drawn journey inspired by East Asian ink paintings.

title: That's a Thing
description:
Well you will suffer. In this world full of dangerous enemy , the princess of the kingdom was captured by the big bad Cow boy. You control the hero , determined to save the world and the princess too but the world is the most important.

Use the pad for move the character and Y for interact with the environemment

title: My Step Sisters
description: My step sisters - erotic visual novel, which accommodates all the secret dreams of every guy. In the game you can improve your communication, flirting skills and get to know female nature better.

title: Mini Star Quest
description: Mini Star Quest is a turn-based action game. Collect tickets to recruit Questers, assemble multiple powerful parties, and take down massive enemies in style!

title: Network Nodes
description: Connect glowing nodes in this mesmerizing neon puzzle game. Design perfect networks across 30+ challenging levels with increasing complexity.

title: Quantum Threshold
description:
Become the Revolution – From a Cyberpunk Wheelchair.
Game Description: In a dystopian cyberpunk hellscape ruled by rogue AI "Techno Wraiths," you’re no underdog—you’re a wheelchair-bound war machine rewriting the rules of survival. Quantum Threshold thrusts you into relentless, ever-shifting arenas where every run is a fight for upgrades, dominance, and escape. Built from the ground up for seated VR, this isn’t just accessibility—it’s a revolution in motion.

title: Collie Call: Farm of Tomorrow
description: In Collie Call: Farm of Tomorrow, you’re back as the smartest pup on the pasture — but this time, the farm’s gone full sci-fi! With teleporters, conveyor belts, oil slicks, and sneaky holes, you’ll need all your brainpower (and tail-wagging determination) to guide your woolly friends to safety.

title: Brainrot Wars
description: Assemble your squad. Outsmart the world In free to play game Brainrot Wars! Collect, trade, and win prizes — every 3 hours, the game gives you more.

title: Lighthouse of the Souls
description: Lighthouse Of The Souls is a third-person action roguelite with RPG mechanics and realistic graphics. Face the challenges of a dark and supernatural world solo or in multiplayer co-op, where survival depends on your skill and strategy.

title: Ninjas Stars
description: Ninja Stars is an action-packed arcade game where players strategically fire and deflect ninja stars to break down surrounding walls. Use physics-based ricochet mechanics and precision aiming to eliminate obstacles and clear the level. With each wall sequence presenting new challenges, it’s a test of both reflexes and strategy as you work to complete each stage!

title: Untitled Hand Game
description: Play as a frisky hand helping others find what they have lost. Use your mouse and click.

title: Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition
description: Embark on a short journey no hand on a stick has been on until now and never again. Rummage through things, avoid being slapped, and hand stuff out to other hands before they lose their patience.

title: Meow Tower: Doomsguard
description: A defensive game that combines hero collection and base building, focusing on real - time strategy and a thrilling sense of combat. Use your wisdom to repel wave after wave of enemy attacks!

title: Hentai Girls: Lust [18+]
description: Only in this game will you find AAA-quality anime nude pictures, sensual female moans, several characters, various puzzle mechanics, leaderboards, a stylish animated design, romantic music, a gallery, and 100 achievements

title: Defe the Defender
description: There’s no escape, only battle. On a mysterious island, an ancestral refuge withstands an endless attack. Defe must explore, build natural fortifications, and grow stronger to face the danger – with or without allies.

title: Aslimelate
description: Aslimelate is a cozy puzzle game where you merge and evolve your slimes by matching three or more. Earn gold to buy special items to help you. Fill your slime vat to free all the slime, or go for a high score. How far can you evolve your slime?

title: Love Begins with Goodbye
description: As a male exchange student at Norway's University of Bergen, you live with three girls: Chinese student Luo Xue'er, mysterious landlady Laya, and Inora, a Norwegian learning Chinese. Weave your love story with them over six months, starting from a "goodbye."

title: Saints Row Boss Factory
description:
Start from scratch and aim high with thousands of options: from teeth, tans and tattoos to muscles, mouths and make-up, all colours of skin and hair, along with veins, voices and a variety of emotes.

You can choose stylish outfits in a multitude of colors of clothes, the look and glossiness of your hair, decide whether you want scars, what body shape you want and prosthetics for any limb. Dress your Boss how you want; choose your outfit and edit every colour to make it yours, layer it up with jackets, accessories and socks, of course there’s socks!

Plus, for the first time ever, asymmetrical face customization gives you the true freedom to make the left side of your face different from the right side – by how much is up to you. When you’re happy with your masterpiece, save it to the Cloud so you’re ready to start Saints Row with your saved Boss when the full game is released. It doesn’t stop there, in Saints Row, vehicles, weapons and more, will all be customizable.

Boss Factory is where you really become Self Made.

title: Find All 8: The Road to the Maya
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 8: The road to the Maya. You will have to explore colorful city streets, unique jungle views and ancient temples of a lost civilization. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

title: Blacksmith Shop Simulator
description: Run your own blacksmith shop in this immersive simulation game! Craft and sell swords, shields, armor, and more to satisfy your customers, earn profits, and expand your business. Manage your forge with a dynamic day-night cycle and become a legendary blacksmith!

title: Tring!
description: Tring! is a short score-attack game where you bounce balls off enemies and walls to gain scores. Reach the highest score you can, and try to beat and everybody else again!

title: Race Jam
description: Experience the thrill of the 1990s with Race Jam - an action packed arcade-style racing game! Featuring retro-inspired tracks, high speed gameplay and an authentic throwback vibe. Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

title: Bearzerk
description: Unleash plush fury in Bearzerk, a chaotic survivor-like auto-shooter packed with stuffed heroes, wild weapons, loyal pets, and absurd mounts. Survive 20 intense waves or dive into endless mode—stitched madness awaits!

title: Find Cats 4
description: “A cute game for cat lovers of all ages! There are several maps and the opportunity to look for furry ones that are hiding intelligently!”

title: Store Keeper
description: Become a wholesale warehouse manager! Receive shipments, optimize storage, maintain proper conditions, and manage inventory. Streamline logistics and make your warehouse as efficient as possible!

title: Robot Anomaly
description: Your job is to inspect all produced robots. Investigate unauthorized hardware modifications and rogue behavior. And escape the building! You are the only human there, but you are not alone.

title: Squeeze
description: A casual decryption game. Rotate, jet, and control bubbles to rescue small animals! In this world of water and bubbles, rich mechanisms await your exploration, and many small animals await your rescue. You will definitely have fun playing!!

title: Slime Store Simulator
description: Slime Store Simulator is a small casual game where you operate a store that sells cute slimes! Order a variety of different types of slimes, set your own prices, take payments, hire help, and expand the store.

title: Digitalink
description: Uncover the mind of a terrifying creature—one decision at a time. Digitalink blends psychological horror with logic-based gameplay in a uniquely unsettling experience filled with suspense, surprises, and scares.

title: ByteRogue
description: ByteRogue is a minimalist tactical roguelike where you play as a wizard-thief. Use spells to outsmart security robots, manipulate the environment, and steal as much treasure as you can in each daring heist.

title: Russian Survivors
description: Fight versus unlimited hordes of lizards and italian brainrot animals in post-soviet environment.

title: Subroutine
description: Welcome to the Robot Factory: inspect our humanoids, assess their behaviour and report any malfunctions.

title: Kungfu 2
description: This is a fast-paced survivor game. Players will play as martial artists with special skills, and challenge 30 levels in a 30-second violent battle. Each character has its own characteristics, and with a variety of martial arts and props, activate the power of bondage and challenge the final BOSS!

title: AVTale
description: AVTale is a cooperative platformer for two players on one screen or online. Two heroes find themselves in a dark cave full of secrets and dangers. One can only fight, the other can support the ally. Together, solve puzzles, fight monsters and much more!

title: Chick Clicker
description: Hatch chickens, collect eggs, and grow your farm in this addictive idle game. Level up your flock, improve skills, and watch your farm thrive while you relax. Regular updates keep the fun fresh — build your farm, grow your flock, and let the chickens take care of the rest!

title: DreamBreaker
description: Dream Breaker is a turn-based deck-building game with roguelike. Your mission in to seal the Demon Lord again and again. Collect scattered memories in your adventures and search for the truth of the dream world......

title: Hydro
description: Revive a vintage hydro-electric power station and generate power for the local township. Manage both on-site and township power demands, manage your funding levels and perform all manner of maintenance, upgrades and other duties.

title: Third Shift
description: As the lead pharmacist in Third Shift, you are in charge of keeping the Everyday Remedies pharmacy safe through the store's closed hours at night from anything that may want enter the property. Will you survive the night and uncover the truth?

title: Unto the Aurora
description: Scotland, 1597. Escaping a death sentence for witchcraft, you set sail on a lonely and uncharted stretch of ocean - navigating and surviving the treacherous, strange and fantastical passage towards a new life.

title: CyberRhapsody
description: Welcome to Cyber ​​Rhapsody! This is an innovative game that combines rhythm and first-person shooting! Here you will experience an unparalleled super-burning and super-cool gaming experience!

title: Silver Malfeasant
description: Dystopian corporations puppeteer the apathetic citizens of Silver Tree City. Play as a detective living in the city's underbelly and explore a cyberpunk world of corruption, cover-ups, and catastrophes. Currently in development, everything shown is subject to change.

title: Eclipse: Special Forces
description: Step into Eclipse—a bold, choice-driven YURI VN where Butch x Butch takes the spotlight. Play as Haesu of the Special Forces and shape not only her fate, but the future of this UTOPIA. Can you face the truth—amid love, desire, and bloodshed?

title: Hellbrella
description: This is a fast-paced action roguelike where you are a Cat in a Raincoat fighting hordes of demons using an umbrella to survive!

title: The Presidential Assassins
description: Step into the shadows in The Presidential Assassins, a top-down third-person shooter where precision, stealth, and tactics define success. You play as a contract assassin hired to eliminate high-value targets across a range of hostile environments.

title: Once Up
description: Join Cliff Hanger, the elephant with the unique ability to latch on and become weightless! Use drawings from an old fairy tale book to create your own climbing paths, conquer tricky sections, and collect peanuts to unlock new levels.

title: Rescue Heli RH407
description: An arcade game with a retro vibe. Navigate a helicopter in 2.5D and rescue people waiting for transport. Don't overdo the aerial acrobatics -passengers might fall out! Land softly! And be quick -you're running out of fuel. The physical simulation of flight adds a modern twist to the retro gameplay.

title: Survivors SymphonYs
description: Survivors SymphonYs is a hybrid-auto-battler with musical weapons, dash abilities, rogue-lite and tower-defense elements. Explore 5 distinct areas - listening for new musicians - while defending your base from afar: level defenders, sacrifice health, or warp back to protect your base!

title: Shade Silver 2 a Walk in the Darkness
description: Shoot, Fight, Outwit Enemies, Avoid Spikes, Dark Faces, Evil Bunnies, Solve Puzzles, Fight Bosses, Collect Eyes, Blow Up Bombs, And More, Across Multiple Nightmares, In This Dark Sequel Dungeon Crawler.

title: And I'll Never Leave
description: When Cassie gets hopelessly lost in, of all places, the small town she just moved to, she is relieved to meet a friendly stranger who can set her on the right path. Unfortunately, there is something not quite right about the stranger - or her surroundings.

title: Battlement
description: A couch-co-op where you fight your friends with elemental warriors that harness powerful magic. Choose to challenge your friends in the many game modes such as tag or duals, and slaughter them in unique places like PeaceGrounds or Castle's Edge. Fight with Honour!

title: Gothic Clicker
description: Gothic Clicker is a ARPG clicker with an emphasis on combat. Hunt and mine for ore, draw your sword and pray to the gods! Develop combat skills and crafts, upgrade weapons and gain gold. Perform harsh rites of rebirth to become stronger and fight ancient evil.

title: City: Battle Ground
description: A card strategy game inspired by the principles of Auto Chess and roguelike genres. Dive into a criminal beast-metropolis where cops, bikers, gangsters, zombies, and even superheroes battle for control of the streets. Build a crazy deck, combine faction abilities.

title: Mechwarrior 5: Clans - Ghost Bear Flash Storm
description: Mech sim. DLC expansion to Mechwarrior 5 Clans

title: Inkronos
description: Slay blocks in style as you race against the clock in this arena shooter. Coming in the fall. Wishlist to stay updated!

title: Legacy of Defense
description: Become the hero who protects the fantasy world and stop the monster invasion! 'Legacy of Defense' combines defense with deck-building. Build your deck, use powerful skills, gain experience, upgrade, clear stages, and defeat the final boss. Ready to test your strategy and luck?

title: The Shafts of Damnation
description: As an investigative reporter, you uncover the horrifying secrets of an abandoned island. Descend into the dark shafts to unveil the truth behind inhumane experiments, confront mutated horrors, and collect evidence to piece together the chilling story.

title: Pill Fight
description: A minimalist wave-shooter, focusing entirely on the gameplay with 6 different maps.

title: Killer: Rewind
description: Three horror games in one.

title: NubiaPhobia
description: Solve the wacky point & click puzzles filled with horror and humor. Break the witch's curse on your home as you explore five distinct regions, each hiding a sacred key to unlock the village chest.

title: ReLinked 0.26091975
description: Grab your gun, slap on some modules, and get out there to destroy hordes of alien invaders on a procedurally generated and fully destructible map!

title: Beast and Cleaver
description: Beast and Cleaver is an open-world adventure where players hunt and fight rare creatures. Master attack patterns, learn unique monster spawning mechanics, and expand the Hanging City to unlock new potions and customizations. Prepare for the hunt - filled with secrets, strategy, glory, and more!

title: Ondal
description: A colorful and chill pixel-art fishing game where you can collect hundreds of fishes.

title: Sherlock Holmes i el cas d'Arthur Gordon Pym
description: A short puzzle exploration game, with progress based on your knowledge about systems that have been hidden from the very beginning. Uncover what happened to Holmes and Watson’s friend, face a strange cult, and reveal the hidden truth of our reality.

title: Mosaic of the Strange
description: Mosaic of the Strange is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle. Help Special Agents Cullen and Brady investigate a bizarre murder, while discovering 125 real-world paranormal case files.

title: Athyra: Rock, Paper, Scissors
description: Athyra takes Rock, Paper, Scissors and turns it into a psychological horror trial full of puzzles, jumpscares, and cryptic lore. Inspired by Inscryption and Buckshot Roulette, Athyra pits you against disturbing foes in deadly games of Rock, Paper, Scissors...

title: Phantom Demon Siege
description: Team up with friends or play solo in this cooperative multiplayer game, complete challenging objectives and fight hordes of supernatural creatures to save humanity from a demonic threat!

title: Polterquest
description: In Polterquest you play as the "coolcat" exploring haunted places and finding treasures. Game is a 3d action adventure platformer in which you need to solve certain puzzles to progress as well as defeating enemies along your journey.

title: Three Kingdoms: Shu-han Chronicles
description: A traditional turn-based role-playing game depicting the story of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the unification of China. Featuring over 200 characters, players can recruit enemy generals (beyond the Shu Han faction) to build unique battle formations.

title: Creepy Support
description: Save people from terrible paranormal dangers as a support operator of a secret SCP-like organization! Ask questions, give advice and watch the consequences of your choices... 5+ endings in each story ;-)

title: Universal Car Ball
description: Car Soccer eSports meets true team management and game customization! Play the way you enjoy it most and run private leagues/teams/events players can queue directly in game with your organization. Our goal is to build communities that are able to self manage and bring fun back to Car Ball <3

title: Wonderlang Korean
description: Learn Korean through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combats. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering Korean. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey to Korean fluency today!

title: BannerBound
description: Bannerbound is a flag-capturing game where you lead a customized army, combining strategy and action to dominate the battlefield. Organize your troops, adapt your tactics, and fight for victory!

title: TheBoll
description: theBOLL is an arcade platformer with no enemies and no distractions — just intuitive controls and levels built for speedruns or relaxed exploration. It’s you, the ball, and the path you choose. Race to the finish or hunt for hidden secrets!

title: Shadoblitz
description: Absorb enemies and build your own deck! This fast-paced action roguelike with deckbuilding elements lets you create millions of skill and passive combinations for a truly one-of-a-kind experience.

title: Creature Containment
description: Creature Containment is a hybrid Base Builder/Top-Down shooter. As a newly graduated Militia Commander, you're tasked with wiping out a goblin infestation that's taken root in an old-world mega facility. Manage your base, equip your operators, and fight hordes of creatures underground...

title: Oolo
description: OOLO is a modern take on the classic isometric adventure. Embark on a non-linear journey across mysterious forests, haunted catacombs, and magical factories. Solve puzzles to collect keys and discover upgrades that change the way you explore this lush fantasy world.

title: Tides of the Endless
description: This Action RPG is finally here. Dive into intense battles where you can seamlessly switch between different Avatars in real-time, Master the unique abilities of each Avatar and craft your own fighting style as you progress through the game.

title: Sushininjarobot TD
description: sushininjarobot TD is a casual tower defense game with rogue-lite elements. Utilize various strategies to quickly devour the incoming food!

title: Abra-cooking-dabra
description: Abra-Cooking-Dabra is a cooking card game. Manage ingredients and make British dishes to keep toves, borogoves, and mome raths fed. Meet timers and fulfill puzzling orders despite the angry wacky Cat being your boss. You are Wonderland's new chef.

title: Natural Unintelligence: Zueirama 2
description: A rogue AI threatens the world. Your weapons? Pizza, pranks, and pure stupidity. Desinteligência Natural blends roguelike robot fights, goofy deliveries, and NPC trolling into one big, dumb, hilarious adventure. Embrace the chaos!

title: Tarvos Desolation
description: Survive on a hostile moon full of nightmares! Face hordes of monsters, explore mysterious locations, and uncover secrets that may save your life. Will you find a way to escape, or will you be consumed by the darkness of Tarvos?

title: Final District
description: Landing on planet Kepler-11e, You and up to 3 other players are tasked with preventing the planet from complete destruction as a nuclear meltdown is in progress. Upgrade weapons, Eliminate any aliens in your way and enjoy the beautiful sights in this realistic, first-person, sci-fi experience.

title: Dragon Spot
description: Who loves dragons?! This is a meditative strategy game about building dragon islands without timers or stress. Just build and watch as the residents raise their toothy pets.

title: Sub Optimal Co.
description: It's simple. Maneuver your submarine to collect the target and return back to base while not scratching the cave-walls. Invite your friends to take control. Navigate carefully and consider every move while exploring unique cave systems in this slow pace, athmospheric, multiplayer diving experience.

title: Big Loot
description: Roguelike caravan survival game about risk, loot, and smart trading. Every run is a journey of hard choices, clever upgrades, and the eternal question: Do I play it safe... or go for the BIG LOOT?

title: My Own Murder
description: After yet another night of brooding over his wife's murder, Detective Edgar receives a mysterious letter. A music star asks to investigate her own murder. Interrogate the suspects, search for clues and find out what happened. Will you be able to unravel the truth from the lies?

title: Chico's Rebound
description: A mysterious tower full of challenges has appeared. Launch Chico's walnut up at the blocks to break them all! Dash, dive, and tail-whip, while deploying an arsenal of creative power-ups. In between stages explore the Celestial Tower to solve puzzles, earn rewards, and uncover its secrets!

title: Cappu Dungeon
description: Cappu Dungeon is a skill-building 3D action roguelite where you equip skills to wipe out hordes of enemies. Players buy and combine skills to create a powerful combat style. Activate skills at the right moment to overwhelm enemies, clear stages, and conquer challenging dungeons to claim victory.

title: Drakefall
description: Explore the World of Drakefall in this roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, discover powerful items, and journey through swamps and mountain peaks with a familiar playstyle.

title: Alfons World
description: Collect magical creatures called "Papas" in a vast world, have them engage in battles, build structures, farm, and produce industrial goods. This is a brand new open-world survival crafting game.

title: Vheda
description: Dive into the story of Vheda, a 2D hack 'n' slash where Vheda, born from the Light, must restore peace in Cilizam with the help of Smor, her loyal companion. Face dark enemies and uncover secrets on an epic journey.

title: Pixelburg
description: Build your own castle, raise a powerful army, and reclaim the kingdom! Gather resources, defend your realm against enemies, and explore a dangerous world full of treasures and secrets. Will you rise as a ruler or fade into the shadows of history?

title: Sandrail Race
description: Enjoy the dune jumps and the feeling of freedom and adrenaline of the Sandrail type vehicles built exclusively to reach high speeds on the sand. Find your route through the desert, without being limited by the margins of a track or road and decide your best route to be number one.

title: Blade Blitz
description: Blade Blitz is a casual, yet competitive, local multiplayer game to play with your friends. Simply spin, slice, and poke your way through the opponents in a tug-of-war push to score the points for your team. Power ups provide tense matches, evening the odds as each team closes in on victory.

title: Cardstronaut
description: A unique spin on the deckbuilding genre, where you must play cards and use strategy and tactics to activate ceiling mounted flame throwers to defeat the aliens and find out the truth

title: Rana Card
description: "Rana Card" is a roguelite card game where you manage a farm, complete KPI for the Frog. Draw cards in exciting, tense moments, you’ll navigate or exploit time explosion, earn packs and chests, build your deck, and play cards to earn gold. Face strategic choices, disasters, cataclysm along the way.

title: The Occult Detective
description: A new kind of detective game blended with supernatural elements. Play as a rookie investigator, discover clues in every murders, dive into unscripted interrogations and uncover truths that break minds. But with each revelation, the world feels... less human.

title: Randy the Racoon
description: Randy the Raccoon is an open-world action comedy where you're a raccoon in a car. Cruise around a vibrant island, chat with sassy animals and take down the goose gang. Randy reacts to everything you do with sass, humor, or just a lot of yelling. So, try not to crash... or do!

title: My Sleeper
description: Build your car from scratch and customize it with a wide range of performance parts. Participate in thrilling races, work to earn money, and face survival challenges. Repair, assemble, and upgrade your parts to excel on the track and thrive in the game.

title: Diner Simulator
description: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!

title: Pumpkin Restaurant
description: Let pumpkins and cats run the restaurant for you, serving hearty food to adventurers. This is a casual business simulation game at the bottom of the screen that doesn't interfere with you doing other things.

title: Dead Engine
description: Fight to survive against zombies hunting in coordinated hordes through a pixel-art post-apocalyptic city. Loot the abandoned city, merge items to enhance your power, and expand your backpack. Each run tests your tactical skills while trading uncovers haunting survivor stories.

title: AutoBlobber
description: AutoBlobber is a Roguelike Autobattler where you customize your Blob to survive endless waves of enemies. Strategically place upgrades, forge powerful synergies, and adapt your build between waves to push your run as far as possible.

title: Your Story: Games with Death
description: A medieval text quest in the "Choose Your Own Adventure" genre, where each choice could be your last. Create your story with more than 2,000 events, 200 of which will prove fatal. In a world where death plays against you, can you outsmart it and write your own story?

title: Fantasy Hearts
description: FANTASY HEARTS is a new old-school fantasy tactical battler with PvP and PvE hex-based battles. Battle for victory by assembling a squad of 25 unique heroes. Customize your strategy, train in epic multiplayer battles and conquer the top rankings!

title: Strange Block 36
description: "Strange Block 36" is a multiplayer online game in the battle royale genre. Players need to eliminate falling blocks and launch attacks on enemies. 36 people compete on the same screen to compete for the championship!

title: Iris Odyssey
description: Iris Odyssey is a text-based adventure game. In the heart of Shibuya, an orphaned girl searching for her family and a magical crime investigator are brought together by fate. Their journey will challenge them and spark a battle against unimaginable forces. A modern fantasy adventure begins.

title: Mercator
description: Items are more than their sell value in this shopkeeping game. Run shops, hire workers, haggle for profit, and dominate ancient global trade from Muziris to Rome.

title: Lanesplit
description: Push performance bikes to the absolute limit, and weave through traffic where one wrong move can spell disaster.

title: A Simple Ball Game
description: A spherical action platformer where you guide a ball into a goal by... rotating the entire level?!

title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
description: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

title: The King of Beasts
description: Kill enemies to evolve into enemy form. Players will control mutated creatures with this ability, constantly fighting against other mutated creatures to evolve into more powerful creatures. They will survive in terrifying alien experiments and become the king of beasts.

title: Assassin Story
description: This is a roguelite, fictional, martial arts, and punk card-building game. You will play the role of an infiltrator, entering the Qin capital, Xianyang, which is besieged by the rebels, and build your own deck within 72 hours, complete your mission, and uncover the secrets of the city.

title: Watch Where You're Going
description: A multitasking game about texting and walking. Get bombarded with messages, search for answers through the apps on your phone, and send answers back, all while making sure you don't walk into a pole.

title: Bunny Hop Hop
description: Play as Bunny and jump around the sky to color the cubes, avoid enemies or kill them! They are trying to stop you from exploding the cubes! Collect carrots and weapons to help you on your journey!

title: Fear Academy
description: Fear Academy is a psychological horror where you play as the principal of Hillcrest High. Returning to retrieve a forgotten item, you become trapped in a nightmare as an ancient evil takes over the school. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive the lurking horrors to uncover the terrifying truth.

title: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
description: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

title: Star Ash Fleet
description: Star Ash Fleet is a groundbreaking real-time strategy game that transcends tradition. Set against a holographic 2D battlefield simulating interstellar warfare, players assume the role of a newly appointed Federal Fleet Commander, crafting their own war epic across the vast galaxy.

title: Drill to Hell: Clicked Too Deep
description: A clicker where you dig deeper and deeper into mines beneath the surface! Collect gems and automate your mining with the resources obtained. Will you reach the heart of the earth?

title: Ashes of Morgravia
description: Ashes of Morgravia is a dark fantasy tactical deckbuilder where you move, strike, and adapt using dual decks to survive against necrotic horrors. Uncover lost divine secrets and fight for survival in a world swallowed by eternal night.

title: Whiskers and Wizardry
description: Step into the magical paws of an overconfident wizard cat in this action-packed roguelite! Craft unique spells, battle hordes of minions and powerful bosses, cleanse the forest of evil, and rescue your Human Wizard Owner. From the creators of Margoq's Lair, a studio focused on roguelite games.

title: Eternal Link
description: An epic medieval fantasy adventure with exploration and action.

title: I Am Reptile
description: In this 2D action platformer, you'll play as a humanoid reptile and save the planet and your people from an evil corporation! Reach the control center and activate the self-destruct mechanism! It won't be easy, as there are plenty of traps, obstacles, and heavily armed guards in your way!

title: Street Soccer Online
description: Street Soccer Online is a fast-paced multiplayer street soccer game. Use realistic football physics to dribble past opponents, score powerful goals, and dominate intense matches. Experience the energy and excitement of street soccer like never before!

title: Project Horizon
description: Project Horizon is a 1-4 player co-op first-person spaceship simulator where the entire crew needs to work together to carefully maintain the nuclear reactor, take up arms against enemy ships, and repair every leak and faulty electrical panel to survive.

title: Age of Warbots
description: A tactical battle simulator involving cool transforming warbots! Pick your army of shape-shifting droids and command them towards a glorious victory! Build your own warbots in the unit editor and go into battle with them!

title: Shoestrings Story
description: A point-and-click visual novel updating the classic "hero vs. demon king" fantasy into a cynical modern world where you can’t win by force alone. What defines a hero now? Will they be paid, or get any compensation at all?

title: Papercraft Tactics
description: In Papercraft Tactics, your backpack is your lifeline. Navigate branching paths, battle fierce foes, and collect powerful items to craft the ultimate loadout. With a dark, hand-drawn style, every choice matters in this thrilling roguelite adventure. Will you survive?

title: Sekira
description: Dark forces are penetrating our world! Help the humble priestess Anachel crush the heads of the Dark Lord and all his minions!

title: Story 210
description: You arrive home and notice that something very bad has happened to your wife.

title: The Walking Trade
description: Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.

title: Blow-Up: Avenge Humanity
description: BLOW-UP: AVENGE HUMANITY is a single-player fast paced first person shooter campaign where you take control of an industrial robot rewired by the last human being to violently dispatch the alien race accountable for Earth’s destruction. Are you ready to become the ultimate avenger?

title: Shape Warzone
description: Face endless, unpredictable waves of unique geometric enemies by building and customizing a powerful base designed to withstand the chaos. Unleash the Quantum Decimator to obliterate gigantic bosses in this one-of-a-kind top-down tower defense where strategy meets action!

title: Space Grunts: Chrono Shard
description: You have an X amount of turns before all hell breaks loose. Gain experience and new items to find ways to prolong the inevitable while you complete missions on board of space ships, moon bases and other mysterious areas in space. One step at a time in this fast paced but turn based roguelike.

title: Dino Space Station
description: Dino Space Station is a 2D pixel art platformer. Restore power. Evade dinosaurs. Escape the wreckage. A meteor shower has wrecked a station full of resurrected dinosaurs. Navigate dark, perilous corridors, dodge raptors, and survive. Warning: Gameplay maybe anxiety-inducing.

title: Stickility
description: Explore vast and deep interiors of an underground research center Biotec, filled with creative foes, bosses, NPC's, and more. Find the burrowed truth and close this facility for good.

title: The Mirrion
description: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

title: Masters Pool HD
description: Pure 8-ball billiards in stunning 3D.

title: Multigun
description: an fps where you have one gun that shoots multiple ammo types and you must use the ammo in the order that it is collected

title: Synthetic Hopes
description: Synthetic Hopes is a puzzle game with original and systemic mechanics sparkled with a few platforming action sequences. You are an enslaved android with a shot at freedom in a dystopian cyberpunk setting. Learn the ways of the world and maybe you'll have a chance to break the cycle!

title: Arcade Archives: Ryukyu
description: RYUKYU is a 1990 puzzle game where players strategically select and place cards from their hand onto a grid to form poker hands in vertical, horizontal, or diagonal lines. The objective is to maximize scoring by creating the strongest possible poker combinations across the board. The game features a mysterious element involving the Ryukyu card placement in the center square, which unlocks special content upon game completion. This arcade re-release includes the series' standard features such as adjustable difficulty settings and authentic arcade display options.

title: Ice Cream: Super Stacking Slot Machine
Supermarket Anime Collector's Simulator
description: From cashier to legend — in true anime style!

title: Storage Hunter: Bid War Simulator
description: Win auctions, uncover secrets, and become an auction legend.

title: Sniper Warrior Elite
description: Sniper Warrior Elite is a modern warfare sniping game that places players in the role of a skilled marksman. The game features a single-player campaign with open-ended maps, requiring tactical planning and precision. Players can customize their weapons and gear, adapting to various missions across diverse environments. The gameplay emphasizes realistic ballistics, weather effects, and stealth mechanics as players navigate through forests and urban areas to eliminate targets. Sniper Warrior Elite aims to provide a detailed sniping experience, challenging players to use strategy and marksmanship skills to complete their objectives.

title: Fishing Simulator 2025
description: Your Journey to the Perfect Catch Begins Here.

title: Pinchcliffe Grand Prix: Anniversary Edition
description: Experience the magic of Pinchcliffe Grand Prix in this anniversary edition, now with even more exciting features and activities! The expanded version includes 8 extra mini-games from the 2000 edition, which, together with the classic gameplay, provide a complete and memorable gaming experience!

title: The Adventures of Harry: The evidence Under the Underwear
Grav My Balls
description: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must use escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

title: The Initiation
description: The Initiation is a quest mod centered on the idea of doing odd jobs for the Great Khans. Do well enough, and they might let you join up...

title: Headhunting
description: A new quest mod by th3overseer. 30 unique quests for you and your buddies to experience. All fully voice-acted and play-tested, well beyond the bounds of sanity.

title: The North Road Remastered
description: Like the original iteration, The North Road: Remastered is a a fairly open-ended quest/worldspace mod. It features a buttload of new content, stories, NPCs, weapons, quests, and locations to explore. You can meet your new companion in a new building in Westside (which you may want to do first), the North Road proper can be started by speaking with Brandt at Ranger Station Bravo, and there's even some unmarked shenanigans in Jacobstown.

title: The Depths of Depravity
description: The Depths of Depravity is a quest/companion mod that will take players on a journey into the writhing, blood-spattered depths of conspiracy, intrigue, assassination, and degradation. Enjoy (or don't) a series of interconnected quests and missions, all fully voiced and playtested.

title: The High Desert
description: The High Desert is a relatively open-ended quest mod with everything you'd expect from a quest mod I made. A bit of dungeon crawling here, some wanton murder there, and a cast of (mostly insane) characters for you to speak with and/or violently murder. Build a saloon, do drugs with hippie astrologers, punch lots of dudes in a cave, achieve astral enlightenment. Naturally, everything is fully-voiced and lip-synced, and extensive bug-testing has been performed at the cost of my own sanity. You're welcome.

title: Coinflate!!
description: To all balance breakers. A roguelike of destruction and freedom that exploits gaps in the system to generate coins. Start a ruinous economy with a cute cat.

title: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
description: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens is a cozy, Suika-inspired, puzzle game where adorable, dessert-shaped cats fall from the clouds. Unlock power-ups, set up satisfying chains and combos, brave obstacles and cheeky weather twists. Play to relax or compete to leave your pawprint on our leaderboards.

title: Oaken Tower
description: Oaken Tower is a synergy-heavy PvP autobattler where your tower of items fights other players. Build deadly combos and scale exponentially. Every decision matters.

title: Aletheia: Prophecy of Perseus
description: A story-rich, turn-based RPG where you play as Perseus on his quest to slay the gorgon Medusa. Inspired by classic cRPGs like Baldur's Gate and Fallout 1 and 2. The game features choices and consequences, multiple quest solutions, and a faithful portrayal of Greek mythology.

title: Shrouded Aspect
description: The God of Death wakes, unleashing a terrible plague before him. Lead your heroes across a medieval world inspired by Celtic mythology and uncover the source of the blight. Choose your allies, shape your party, and make the tough choices in this turn-based tactical combat RPG.

title: Empty Shell 2
description: Take on the roles of expendable volunteers sent to a forsaken facility on a remote Japanese island. Recover lost data, scavenge for resources, manage your inventory, and endure unspeakable cosmic horrors. In this top-down extraction survival horror, every expedition is a journey back from madness.

title: The Lightning Struck Orphan
description: We combined deckbuilding and spacial puzzles to create The Lightning Struck Orphan. It is Tetris/Patchwork meets Slay the Spire.

title: Death by Scrolling
description: Welcome to Purgatory, now under new management! Death by Scrolling is a rogue-like vertically scrolling RPG where you kill enemies, collect gold, and avoid the Grim Reaper long enough to pay the Ferrymanʼs exorbitant river-crossing fee to the afterlife.

title: World of Warcraft: Assault on Blackwing Lair
description: Patch 1.6.0: Assault on Blackwing Lair is a content patch for World of Warcraft that released on 12 July 2005. Among other changes, it featured the release of the Blackwing Lair raid instance, the introduction of the Darkmoon Faire to Azeroth, Battlemasters in major cities, and revamps of the Warlock and Warrior talent trees.

title: World of Warcraft: Rise of the Blood God
description: Patch 1.7.0: Rise of the Blood God is a content patch for World of Warcraft that released on 13 September 2005.

title: World of Warcraft: The Gates of Ahn'Qiraj
description: Patch 1.9.0: The Gates of Ahn'Qiraj is a content patch for World of Warcraft that released on 3 January 2006. This major content patch introduced the Ahn'Qiraj raid complex and its unprecedented realm-wide launch event as well as giving paladins a talent and balance overhaul. Additional changes included a revamp of the Timbermaw Hold faction, quests and NPCs, Soul Shard bags for warlocks, unification of the Auction Houses for each faction (and the "neutral faction") on each realm, a rework to the raid lockout system, improvements to the guild UI, and reworks of some racial traits, among many others.

title: World of Warcraft: Shadow of the Necropolis
description: Patch 1.11.0: Shadow of the Necropolis is a content patch for World of Warcraft that released on 19 June 2006. It introduced the last significant content to World of Warcraft before its first expansion, The Burning Crusade, making the Naxxramas raid and its ruler Kel'Thuzad the effective "final boss" of the pre-expansion era of the game. Light's Hope Chapel received a corresponding update to serve as the quest hub for the new raid. Mages and Shaman received talent and balance overhauls. Other changes included the addition of keyrings, updates to item cooldown mechanics, balance changes in Ahn'Qiraj raids, quite a few new flight paths, and more UI support for raids and instances.

title: The Devil's Due
description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

title: World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade - The Black Temple
description: Patch 2.1.0, titled Black Temple, is the first content patch for The Burning Crusade which released on 22 May 2007.

title: Circuit Chakula
description:
Circuit Chakula is a Visual Novel Game with a Cozy Feeling and Lo-fi Music.

In this world, where technology and tradition blend seamlessly in a vibrant, futuristic African metropolis. Play a night repairman working in the tallest commercial building(Kubwa Kulu), who is ever ready to listen to the customers: human, humanoid, hologram and alien.

title: Morgenstern
description: Embark on a medieval rogue-like journey, merging Survivor's hack-and-slay with souls-like rigor, in a third-person epic. Navigate dungeons, extract strategically, and inscribe your saga in the chronicles of legend.

title: Schematic Void
description: Point-and-click, an anti-horror adventure with a mashed fourth wall, stylish minimalistic graphics, a relaxing plot and other advantages.

title: My Lord Is Hiring
description: A job interview simulator set in a medieval fantasy world. Hire, reject, and fire townspeople while maintaining your economy. Train and gear up your units to defend your kingdom from invading monsters. Complete quests, craft tools, and try not to get too attached—this world is dangerous!

title: Boardwalk Builders
description: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds. Manage and combine your attractions to create even grander experiences. Host festivals, attract VIPs and stay ahead of shifting demand influenced by local events and rival businesses.

title: Shade Protocol
description: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

title: World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade - The Gods of Zul'Aman
description: Patch 2.3.0, titled The Gods of Zul'Aman, was a content patch that released on 13 November 2007.

title: UnderMire
description: UnderMire is a 1-4 player first person co-op roguelite adventure where you descend into a magical, ever-changing bunker to confront the dark forces that lie within. Battle fear-fueled monsters, SMUSH everyday junk into magical weapons, master evolving tools, complete tasks from a cantankerous spirit cat, and survive the chaos alone or with your friends using proximity voice chat.

title: World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade: Fury of the Sunwell
description: Patch 2.4.0, titled Fury of the Sunwell, was a content patch that released on 25 March 2008.

title: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King: Secrets of Ulduar
description: Patch 3.1.0: Secrets of Ulduar is the first major content patch for World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King. Among the highlights of this patch are the opening of the much anticipated Ulduar raid, the Argent Tournament and many notable class changes.

title: Tossdown
description: Run, jump and dash through chaos, dodging hazards and enemies as you deliver packages. Fight back with wacky power-ups and choose from a variety of perks to improve your chances of survival. It’s Crazy taxi meets Jet Set Radio!

title: Critterrupters
description: Choose your new buddy and set off on a Critter adventure on Holon Island! Capture Critters by fulfilling their conditions and master time based battles by interrupting your opponent's turns. Assemble your team to challenge the Islands Clubs and gain new abilities for your buddy to help you explore.

title: Riziki
description:
In Africa, a couple of things unite us. We thought of three, our music, our rhythm, and our roots we want to explore that in our game Riziki.

Riziki is a rhythm game that immerses players in the vibrant music and dance culture of Africa. The game’s narrative revolves around Riziki, Nabo and Moja, who traverse the roots of Africa, each characterized by different music. As players progress, they unlock new songs and dances that reflect the cultures they came from, each bringing you closer to uniting Africa upon mastery. Riziki offers a unique experience of Africa's music from traditional folk to modern afrobeat, amapiano, rhumba and beyond.

title: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King - Call of the Crusade
description: Patch 3.2.0: Call of the Crusade brought a host of new features for World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King and went live on 4 August 2009.

title: The Last of the Lords of Ice
description: The Last of the Lords of Ice is a visual novel about a young woman who is haunted by her past. Involved in the death of a childhood friend, she is now pursued by his vengeful lover. Will she find refuge in Iscah, the so-called gentle North?

title: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King - Fall of the Lich King
description: Patch 3.3.0: Fall of the Lich King is a content patch that included the Icecrown Citadel raid as well as its three 5-player dungeon wings in the Frozen Halls. Patch 3.3 was the last major patch before the release of World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. Undocumented changes can be found at Patch 3.3.0 (undocumented changes).

title: World of Warcraft: Cataclysm - Rise of the Zandalari
description: Patch 4.1.0: Rise of the Zandalari was the first major content patch for the World of Warcraft: Cataclysm expansion. Among other changes, it featured the return of the Zul'Aman and Zul'Gurub raids as 5-player normal and heroic dungeons.

title: World of Warcraft: Cataclysm - Rage of the Firelands
description: Patch 4.2.0: Rage of the Firelands contains the Firelands raid, and is the end of Arena season 9. It has also added a daily quest hub to Hyjal, as well as two new daily quest zones called the Regrowth and the Molten Front. It will continue Thrall's story. It has also introduced the new Dungeon Journal feature.

title: World of Warcraft: Cataclysm: Hour of Twilight
description: Patch 4.3.0: Hour of Twilight contains the Dragon Soul Raid and three new Caverns of Time 5-man heroics, and is the end of Arena season 10. This is the largest content release since the opening of Cataclysm.

title: Gravebound
description: Survive as long as you can through the waves of magic guardians, level up to heighten your own magical abilities, and unlock game changing weapon upgrades and new arenas as you explore Dark Willow Crypt! Will you escape, or are you bound for the grave...

title: Doomspire
description: Doomspire is a roguelike card game where you play a hero and venture deeper into the Doomspire, a dark and ancient structure. Face terrifying bosses, gather treasures, and strategically build your deck as you descend into the abyss, where doom awaits.

title: World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria - Landfall
description: Patch 5.1.0: Landfall is the first major content patch of Mists of Pandaria, and the beginning of The Pandaria Campaign.

title: World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria: The Thunder King
description:
Patch 5.2.0: The Thunder King is the first World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria patch of 2013 that focuses on the return of the Thunder King. It was targeted to be released February 26, but was delayed for March 5. This patch includes a massive new raid dungeon, a multi-faceted new quest hub, Pet Battle improvements, new world bosses, significant class balance changes, brand new pets and mounts, assorted bug fixes, and more.

Ten client patches all called "Patch 5.2.0" have been released so far, all to fix minor bugs. See the patch list for more information.

title: Gorecore
description: GORECORE is a fast paced atmospheric movement shooter with a high skill ceiling, an arsenal of different weapon combinations, synergies, and an emphasis on parrying.

title: World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria: Escalation
description: Patch 5.3.0: Escalation is the second non-raid patch of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria and focuses on the escalating tensions between Garrosh and Vol'jin's Darkspear Rebellion. The patch includes a new world event in the Barrens, the addition of Heroic Scenarios, a brand new Arena and Battleground, new foes to fight in the Brawler's Guild and much more.

title: World of Warcraft: Mist of Pandaria: Siege of Orgrimmar
description:
Patch 5.4.0: Siege of Orgrimmar is a raid patch of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria and focuses on the Siege of Orgrimmar from the leaders of the Alliance and the Horde to topple the ruthless warchief, Garrosh Hellscream. The patch includes a new raid, the Siege of Orgrimmar, a new area, the Timeless Isle, and much more. It also features the debut of the Proving Grounds, the Flexible Raid difficulty, and the Connected Realms feature.

As another Mists of Pandaria content patch would delay World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor, 5.4 is the last content patch of the expansion.

title: Tollan Survivors
description: Tollan Survivors: A new kind of Horde Survivors game combining Action RPG, Roguelite and Souls-like genres! Fight Mycelium-infested Orcs, cleanse Tollan Peak, craft powerful items, and unlock unique characters with cross-class synergies!

title: World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor - Fury of Hellfire
description: The warlock Gul’dan persuaded the Iron Horde's remaining leaders— who were enduring crushing defeats against the champions of Azeroth—to serve the Burning Legion. Their servitude, they believed, would give them one last chance to turn the tide of battle. Only Grommash Hellscream proved difficult to break, and so Gul’dan imprisoned him, hoping to make an example out of the former warchief. Gul’dan took control of Hellfire Citadel, intending to use it as a staging area for the Legion to invade Draenor. He then proceeded to summon the demon lord Archimonde. Meanwhile, the heroes of Azeroth assaulted the citadel’s gates, invading from both land and sea. Aided by Khadgar, Yrel, Durotan and a freed Grommash, Azeroth’s champions battled their way through the horrors unleashed within Hellfire Citadel. After a harrowing struggle that nearly destroyed Draenor, the heroes were able to cast down Archimonde. Yet, even as he fell, the demon hurled the treacherous Gul’dan through a portal. His pact with the Legion was far from being fulfilled.

title: World of Warcraft: Legion: Return to Karazhan
description:
Patch 7.1.0: Return to Karazhan is Legion's first medium patch. It features Return to Karazhan, a mythic-only dungeon that takes place in Karazhan; the Trial of Valor raid; and a continuation of the Suramar campaign with the "Insurrection" chapter. Opening dates for the Nighthold raid were announced a few months after the patch's release.

The patch was deployed on the Public Test Realm on 14 September 2016. Its release date was announced on 14 October 2016.

title: World of Warcraft: Legion - The Tomb of Sargeras
description:
Patch 7.2.0: The Tomb of Sargeras is the first content patch of Legion, focusing on assaulting the Broken Shore once more and closing the portal within the Tomb of Sargeras.

The patch was deployed on the Public Test Realm on January 19, 2017. Its release date was announced on March 23, 2017 during a Live Developer Q&A with Senior Game Designer Ryan Shwayder.

title: Recovery Dog
description:
When a digital world is plagued by corruption and glitches, a data recovery software is tasked with a critical rescue mission. As files, programs, and beloved characters devolve into chaos, TV DOG must sniff out corrupted data, rescue valuable characters, and navigate hazardous glitches.

Play as TV DOG as you sniff out your favorite characters in this data-salvaging frolic!

title: World of Warcraft: Legion - Shadows of Argus
description: The Argus storyline starts in patch 7.3.0 and deals with the heroes of Azeroth traveling to Argus, the former homeworld of the eredar before their corruption by Sargeras, to end the threat of the Burning Legion once and for all.

title: Rise of Fati
description: Step into the mythical world of "Rise of Fati," an epic adventure game where ancient African folklore and legends come to life. Embark on a journey with Fati, a young and brave warrior destined to restore peace and harmony to her homeland. Explore rich landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and battle formidable foes as you uncover the secrets of your heritage.

title: World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth: Tides of Vengeance
description: Patch 8.1.0: Tides of Vengeance is the first content patch of Battle for Azeroth, first announced in a Developer Live Stream with Ion Hazzikostas on 18 September 2018. Tides of Vengeance features two new raids: Battle of Dazar'alor, an Alliance assault on Zuldazar; and the Crucible of Storms, located beneath the Shrine of the Storm. This patch was released in two parts, the first is listed on this article and released on 11 December 2018 while the second part can be found at patch 8.1.0a and released on 22 January 2019.

title: World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth - Rise of Azshara
description:
Patch 8.2.0: Rise of Azshara is the second content patch of Battle for Azeroth, first announced at BlizzCon 2018. Additional content and information was revealed on April 11, 2019. It was released on June 25, 2019.

The patch was deployed on the Public Test Realm on April 16, 2019.

title: World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth - Visions of N'Zoth
description:
Patch 8.3.0: Visions of N'Zoth is the third content patch of Battle for Azeroth, announced on October 7, 2019. On December 19, 2019, it was announced that it would release on January 14, 2020.

The patch was deployed on the Public Test Realm on October 7, 2019.

title: Broghurt
description: Broghurt is a narrative-driven Adult visual novel and adventure game developed by Mystery Zone Games.

title: Shrine Protectors
description: A casual arrow shooter meets rogue-lite strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine precision shooting with tactical army management in this relentless bullet hell.

title: Why Not Both?
description:
Why Not Both? is a cozy yuri romance kinetic visual novel. Set in a solarpunk future, this story follows Rio, Jen, and Aspen as they navigate love, identity, and connection.

WNB features anime-style characters, painted backgrounds, a chillhop soundtrack, positive polyamorous representation, and a hopeful solarpunk setting.

title: Math Climber
description: Precision platforming mixed with MATH. Answer questions while under perilous conditions. One wrong move and you're sent back to the start of the mountain!

title: Mailstrom
description: A 1-4 player co-op PC game in which teams deliver parcels for the Pan-Galactic Postal Service. Due to a galaxy-spanning outbreak of interdimensional monsters, all cities are on lockdown. But that won't stop your team of parcel carriers from locating the delivery addresses for every parcel in their care, nor will it keep them from braving toxic obstacles and waves of ambulatory brain creatures in their quest to get every precious delivery to its destination! As teams log successful delivery runs, they accrue payments that can be spent in the postal supplies shop for new items to help them take on new challenges!

title: The Pitch
description: The Pitch is a zero-gravity, momentum-based arena 2v2 and 1v1 sport where teams pass, dash, and use teamwork to throw or slam the ball into the goal. With wall and player-based jumps, air dashes, and game-changing stuns, every moment is a fast, fluid test of reflexes and teamwork.

title: Hatsukoi Bloom
description:
Hatsukoi Bloom (初恋ブルーム) is a romance simulation game inspired by the emotional struggles often seen in shoujo and slice-of-life anime and manga. Players take on the role of a student navigating the highs and lows of first love, deep friendships, love triangles, and meaningful choices that shape the outcome of their relationships.

Beyond the classic decision-making elements of visual novels, Hatsukoi Bloom features interactive minigames and unique gameplay mechanics that can strengthen—or completely ruin—entire routes. With multiple endings, memorable characters, and an anime-inspired art style, this is a heartfelt journey designed for fans of romantic Japanese storytelling.

title: Find All 7: Japan - Extra Level
description: This DLC adds another lengthy scene with 200 hidden objects to find.

title: Find All 9: Fantasy
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 9: Fantasy. You will explore the fairytale village, the colorful streets of the city of mages and the unique scenery of the soaring dragon islands. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

title: Hidden Evidence
description: Online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Sneak into a restricted area, uncover evidence tied to conspiracy theories, and try to escape. Stay quiet, avoid threats… and beware – there’s a traitor among you.

title: Schoolboy Escape 2: Village
description: Grandma and grandpa won’t let you have fun? Outsmart them and plan your runaway! Immerse yourself in an incredible adventure, solve puzzles and stay out of sight!

title: Mystic Stickerbook
description:
Say goodbye to a stressful life
Come to the forest and become a cheerful little witch! Caution! Touching a guest’s belly without permission is strictly forbidden! To get close to your guests,you must first craft magical stickers they love and build a bond of trust and friendship!

title: CallMara
description: CallMara is a psychological thriller with elements of horror, set in a gloomy medieval village. The protagonist, waking up in the forest, discovers a devastated village and explores its secrets, gradually realizing that he has become the cause of the evil that has engulfed his village.

title: John Parkour
description: John Parkour is a fast-paced first-person platformer where you chase "John Grandma's" cat through floating obstacles, unlocking new abilities as you climb to new heights.

title: Cozy Forge
description: Cozy Forge is a cozy medieval sim where you run a blacksmith shop. Melt, mold, and forge tools for townsfolk—be it a sickle for a peasant or a sword for a knight. Lose yourself in the relaxing rhythm of your forge.

title: Office Bot Simulator
description: Become the world's first robot secretary and prove that machines can replace humans in the office! You'll face hectic workdays, tight deadlines, the struggle for a paycheck, managing living expenses, and self-improvement.

title: Gun Dream
description: I tihnk my favourite things about this game is just watched the reflections and shadows and things move about. Filling a room with glittery bullets. Trappign furniature mid-air and spinning.

title: BeefArena
description: A 2d platformer sh'mup in a roguelike package. Fight co-op through randomized runs constructed from hundreds of arenas full of secrets and explosive loot!

title: Supermarket Simulator Deluxe
description:
Supermarket Simulator Deluxe is an entertaining and challenging simulation game where you take on the role of a supermarket owner.

To run your supermarket successfully and grow it continuously, you'll need to focus on profitability, customer satisfaction, and efficient workflows at all times.

title: King of Space
description:
'King of Space' is a hypertext-based game in a science-fiction setting. The work was published in 1991 and remains one of a handful of e-lit works that tackle the science fiction genre.

A dark science-fictional ritual of fertility and regeneration, 'King of Space' takes place in an abandoned starship, circling the edges of a plague-ridden and collapsing solar system, where an escaped terrorist meets the last star-captain and his ship's Priestess. Old man and young, young woman and ageless starship meet and meet again as enemies, allies, rapists, and lovers.

title: Amnyam
description: “Aim for the top with your Mouse Aim Skill!” "AMNYAM” is a platform game in which you climb to the top and aim for the summit with your ‘Mouse Aim Skill’. It supports multiplay! With three difficulty settings, it's suitable for everyone from mouse beginners to aiming experts.

title: Gold and Graves
description: Gold and Graves is a roguelite deckbuilder where you can escape mid-dungeon to carry your cards, relics, and mercenaries into the next run. Bribe enemies to fight for you, push deeper for greater rewards.

title: Into the Fold: Nala Junction
description: A fast-paced boomer shooter set in a strange mountain town. Blast through enemies, explore deadly levels, and fight to survive. Inspired by classic '90s games.

title: No Brake No Gain
description: Put your driving skills to the test in no brake no gain, the ultimate arcade driving game packed with wild challenges, chaotic tracks, and endless opportunities to show off your precision and control!

title: Snake Party Extreme
description: The best Snake game ever made. A chaotic, unforgettable, laugh-out-loud 4-player couch battle. An intense test of your arcade gaming skills. Snake Party Extreme is all of these...and so, so much more!

title: Crux Diaries
description: Crux Diaries is a turn-based, isometric, non-linear CRPG inspired by the classics. Set in an alternate-history 1970-s dystopia on the brink of civil war, it invites you to leave your mark on the future of a fractured nation through meaningful choices, skill checks, and survival.

title: Empire of Lust
description: Rise through Roman high society using charm, cunning, and carnal delight. Build a harem, throw decadent feasts, seduce the elite — and turn lust into power. In a world of pleasure and betrayal, will you conquer... or be conquered?

title: The Daily Life of Serving Doll
description: Start a sweet life with the breast-expanding robot [Service Doll Aisha] who was born to serve you！This is the sequel to “Escape from the Room of the Serving Doll”！Uses the same 3D animation for the H scene as its predecessor， and you can't miss the soft and textured breast animation！

title: Tyro: Legend of Whisperwood
description: Play as Tyro, a vengeful field mouse, in this early alpha slice of our consequence-based metroidvania. Explore a hand-drawn 2D world, collect power-ups, battle challenging bosses, discover hidden lore, and experience voice-acted dialogue that brings Whisperwood to life.

title: Xenopurge
description: Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you are a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.

title: Davy X Jones
description: Ascend to the highest fathom of a pirate underworld with the infamous Davy Jones on this action-packed, revenge-driven journey. Control the captain's headless body, stay on pace with his autonomous skull and keep his legend alive.

title: Hole Digging Simulator
description: Dig Your Way Through History, Mystery, and Adventure!

title: Storage Finder
description: Storage Finder is a trade and strategy-focused simulation game where you try to make a profit by bargaining and selling items. We buy and sell products found in the city or retrieved from storage units won at auctions — with every deal, some of us make money, while some of us lose.

title: Cage Girl
description: After opening a mysterious email, beautiful office lady Aiko is pulled into a bizarre, endless maze. Filled with unknown magic and dangers, she must stay calm, search for clues, and solve puzzles to escape this invisible prison.

title: Hidden Post-Apocalyptic 3 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Legacy of Shadows
description: "Legacy of Shadows" is a Wuxia roguelite. From avenging your fallen sect to unraveling the "Eternal Dragon" conspiracy, master fluid builds to cut through a world of intrigue and shatter the eternal scheme.

title: Madame Ro's Curiosity Quiz
description: Madame Ro's Curiosity Quiz is a personality quiz-style visual novel. Players will answer several questions from the titular character, Madame Ro, and at the end are presented a previous visitor who may or may not resemble the player based on their answers. This quiz is purely for fun.

title: Torrent Empire
description: Are you ready to build your own torrent empire? Crack software, manage servers, dive into shady deals, and outsmart the authorities—all in the shadow of the 2000s. Balance risk and reward in this terminal-based strategy sim. Become a digital legend or lose it all!

title: Antivirus Protocol
description: Antivirus PROTOCOL is an incremental game about destroying viruses. Learn and adapt, collect data, upgrade yourself, and eliminate the Virus that has taken over the world.

title: Untitled PlatCard Game
description: A game about a boy trapped in an endless dungeon trying to escape. Strategize with cards and create your own unique deck of cards to defeat different unique enemies and bosses.

title: Minesweeper Together
description: "Minesweeper Together is a puzzle board game about revealing cells and avoiding mines cooperatively."

title: Princess of the Water Lilies
description: A 2D hand-painted cat platformer blending gentle puzzles with heartfelt boss encounters. Play as Princess, a flat-faced cat. Use purr — her softest gift, to heal a world caught between nature and machine.

title: Iron Roland
description: Take part in an historic mission that could finally turn the tides of war in favor of humanity. As a prisoner, you are forced to work in the bowels of the Behemoth-class Assault Walker, the Iron Roland, take care of the machinery, discover what brought you here, and, most importantly, follow orders.

title: OrePlant
description: OrePlant is an idle simulation game where you grow minerals on your farm! Fish, cook, and decorate while exploring a fantasy world centered around the legendary World Tree. Join your adorable companions 'Finn' and 'Aria' on a relaxing and magical journey!

title: Just Cube
description: Get ready for a challenge! Discover 12 unique locations full of obstacles, epic boss fights and dynamic action. Test your skills, reflexes and determination to complete the game in record time!

title: Ward Off Evil
description: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

title: Diablo IV: Belial's Return
description: With Mephisto’s attention turned towards grander goals, Belial seizes the opportunity to make Sanctuary his thrall

title: Upalu Mundi
description: Upalu Mundi is a transport puzzle game set in a fantasy world shaken by the dawn of railways. Lay tracks, build stations and set switches to keep goods moving and profits soaring. Read the news to see how customers, shareholders and the public react as you shape the future of transportation!

title: Horrorillo Brainrotillo
description: When Tralalero turns from Tralala to AAAAAAAA! Brave the haunted Sahur mansion, where shadows hide zombini memini lurking to hunt you. Solve puzzles, escape doom, and beware: they're not just rotting your brain—they're coming for what's left.

title: Ascend the Dome
description: A massive rage parkour game with roguelike power-ups! Connect your game to your Twitch chat! Try to climb your way out of the giant dome and take on some serious skill-based challenges. Perfect for your stream, have fun while your chat tries to mess with you! Developed for Speedrunners.

title: Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days Melon Mix
description:
Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days Melon Mix is a fan-developed project that enhances the original Nintendo DS title, Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days, for a modern PC gameplay experience.

Utilizing a modified version of the melonDS emulator, Melon Mix refines the game by adapting its dual-screen interface into a single-screen display suitable for widescreen monitors. Key improvements include significantly upscaled graphics for a cleaner visual presentation, and reconfigured controls to support standard gamepads, notably enabling right-analog stick camera operation.

title: Kongai
description:
Kongai is a Collectible Card Game where two players duel. It was developed by David Sirlin and is run by Kongregate. The game was in closed beta until July 10th, 2008. Since that date, Kongai has been available to the general public. However, a second closed beta with 40 new cards began on September 17th, 2009. These new cards became available to the public through weekly challenges on April 3rd, 2010.

During 2020, Kongai was bugged with decks, skill rank, wins and losses not displaying properly. Decks could't be built and playing multiplayer didn't work at this time. Attempting to do either displayed an error.
