Thankfully in 2022, a Discord user by the name of Matrix4348, the latter has found a way to play Kongai after Adobe Flash became defunct. This Discord Server hosted by Anonymouselbow and Matrix4348 has instructions on doing so.

title: Bombardino Crocodilo vs. Tung Tung Sahur
description: In this high-flying, heart-pounding runner game, Crocodilo takes to the skies, soaring through dangerous landscapes while being relentlessly pursued by Tung’s Stalkers. It’s a race for survival, but with a twist—because who said memes can't be epic?

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Battle for Brooklyn
description:
Experience a story-driven adventure in iconic Brooklyn. Brooklyn has been relatively peaceful, with civilians working together and thriving while the Dark Zone and hostile factions ravage Manhattan. However, the fate of Brooklyn is at risk now that the Cleaners have moved across the river.

Play single-player or in online co-op, including:
- A mini-campaign about the Battle for Brooklyn.
- The level 40 boost, which allows you to jump right into the Battle for Brooklyn campaign.
- Two new open world named zones.
- New and refreshed skills, gear, and exotics.
- Stash space increase.

title: Rainbow Mosaics 10: Christmas Helper
description:
Your amazing robot helper is back to bring you some Christmas cheer!

When a young couple brings Helper into their home to assist with the holidays preparations, they soon find that this arrangement was more than they bargained for. Helper’s first task seemed simple enough - decorate the Christmas tree and prepare a festive dinner. It’s clear something has gone wrong when Helper hangs sausages from the tree and places ornaments in the soup! It’s most likely a flaw in Helper’s configuration. Solve these delightfully festive mosaics puzzles to get Helper on track.

title: Astball
description:
Fly a spaceship through deep space and survive as long as you can!
Asteroids appear in your path — shoot them to earn points.
Large asteroids break into smaller pieces when hit.
Destroy the smallest ones to score even more!

But be careful: if any asteroid piece crashes into your ship, it’s game over.
Stay alert, keep moving, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced space shooter!

title: Void Resurgence
description: Void Resurgence is a fast-paced top-down bullet hell roguelite shoot 'em up. Combine upgradeable Core Systems and unlock Hyper Power combos to create devastating builds, and survive relentless waves of enemies, bosses, and explosive arcade action.

title: Ataraxia
description:
Ataraxia is a neighbourhood simulator in text adventure form. Inspired by folk horror, mystery and landscape narratives, you play as a newly-arrived traveller on a remote island.

Explore the world. Settle into your new home. Meet the neighbours. Go foraging. Have visions in the night. Grow fruit. Hunt a monster. Fall in love. Solve long-forgotten mysteries. Make contact with a strange and ancient entity in the woods. Fill your bookshelves. Adopt a cat.

title: Sandwich Simulator
description:
Sandwich Simulator is a restaurant simulation game that can be played solo or with up to 4 players in online co-op. Players manage a sandwich shop by taking orders, preparing sandwiches and side items, cleaning the restaurant, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Time management, task coordination, kitchen layout, and restaurant expansion are key elements of the gameplay. The game offers both single-player and cooperative multiplayer.
Ready to create your own world of flavor? Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players, prepare sandwiches with your friends, deliver online orders to the courier and run your sandwich restaurant. Clean, expand, and keep your customers happy!

title: Rogue Snake
description: Rogue Snake is the latest evolution of the classical snake game. We've added combat and roguelite mechanics - earn levels, upgrade your Mecha Snake and defeat bosses while dodging enemy attacks!

title: Lisa: The Heartless
description:
A fan-project driven through pure passion by multiple like-minded developers that connected together to make a tribute for the tragic world of LISA.
Explore Haven Island, a desolate fracture of Olathe far removed from the mainland.

title: Police Border Contraband Patrol
description: Patrol. Inspect. Intercept. Justice starts with you.

title: Isle Frontier
description: Isle Frontier is an isometric point-and-click life simulator where you can build a homestead on your own personal island. Live on your own by utilizing your vast array of skills, such as fishing, hunting, cooking, crafting, and more.

title: Nocturnal Survivors
description: Fight monsters in each night, survive as long as you can! Nocturnal Survivors is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter game in which you simply keep combining your weapons to more powerful versions to kill thousands of monsters at nights.

title: Labyrinth: Dracula's Lair
description: Trapped in Dracula's labyrinth, hunted by monsters, armed only with relics — explore, survive, and uncover the path to eternal life, where beyond the fog lie secrets never meant to be found.

title: Zombie Survivors: Inventory Apocalypse
description: Inventory Apocalypse is a top-down shooter roguelite with a grid based inventory system. Navigate a zombie infested world while keeping your backpack organized. With a variety of tools to collect and upgrades to choose from, each run is unique. Every moment counts as you run, scavenge and fight.

title: Doom Drive
description: **Doom Drive - No Rules. No Mercy**: Drive cars, buses & motorcycles to crush mutant and city zombies. Use powerful weapons and customize your hero as you survive the ultimate apocalypse!

title: Propaganda vs. Zombies
description: Build your deck of Propaganda, Bullets, and Spells to defend your Leader in this Bullet Heaven where you can't move! Use Propaganda to turn Zombies into your Comrades and make them fight for You! Make choices about your people but be careful, they might overthrow you if you choose wrong!

title: Apocalypse Zombie TD
description: 《Apocalypse Zombie TD》is a Tower Defense Game. You will collect resources and build fortifications before the zombies arrive to kill the zombies that invade your home. In the game, you will unlock different defensive buildings, create a unique style, defend your home in a world full of zombies.

title: Byte of the Dead
description: This is a bite sized zombie apocalypse game. Fight hordes of zombies while rescuing survivors. Construct a base, unlock powerful weapons and create useful items to help you survive.

title: Death Infection
description: This is a post-apocalyptic virtual world filled with zombies. Each city can accommodate up to 10,000 virtual avatars from around the globe simultaneously. Here, virtual avatars’ genitalia and sexual interactions are restored for every logged-in player. There are no shops, no top-up points.

title: Vampire Skuf
description: Play as a vampire-skuf living in a castle. Greedy adventurers keep trying to raid it, so summon collectible monsters, build rooms, and defend your castle… but hey, the match won't play itself. The world can wait ;)

title: Zonark
description: Survive the ultimate nightmare in a zombie-infested city! Scavenge weapons, battle relentless undead, and uncover the dark secret behind the outbreak. No escape, no mercy—only the strongest will last!

title: Paws Against the World
description: Welcome to Paws Against the World (PAW), where the last humans are gone, and it’s up to the animals to claw their way through hordes of relentless zombies. Think fast-paced, loot-grabbing action, but with a wild twist—play as cute critters fighting for survival.

title: Idle Zombie Wave: Survivors
description: A thrilling tower defense survival game where you lead a team of survivors against relentless zombie hordes. Deploy unique fighters, strategize with adjutants, and adapt using roguelike upgrades. Defend your home, battle epic bosses, and survive the apocalypse!

title: Cowboy in Space
description: Be THE Cowboy in this top down shooter that allows you to upgrade your health, dash speed, and sword strength, as well as 19 weapons, with the souls you collect from your slain enemies!

title: Zombocalypse
description: Dive into a top-down shooter where you’ll battle relentless waves of zombies, either solo or with friends! Face off against formidable bosses, unlock upgrades through a tech tree, and enjoy a casual gaming experience crafted with passion by an indie developer.

title: Zombiecards
description: ZombieCards is a card-based post-apocalyptic game inspired by Russian Roulette. Set in the zombie-infested city of Travis, embark on a crazy adventure where card battles are key to scavenging supplies, building camp, and outwitting other survivors. Survival is your sole purpose!

title: Soldiers vs. Zombies: Tower Defense
description: Soldiers vs Zombies is a tower defense game where zombies have overrun the world, and humanity’s last hope lies in elite soldiers. Armed from laser rifles to death machine guns, you’ll deploy troops and use special skills to stop waves of mutated zombies!

title: Girl Survivors
description: Girl Survivor is a survival, construction, and role-playing game with a zombie themed background.

title: Doomsday School
description: This is an RPG survival game You will play a human in the zombie world, to survive and fight

title: Survival Odyssey
description: Immerse yourself in this epic survival game teeming with strategy and thrills! Confront relentless attacks, fighting tooth and nail to survive in a world overrun by chaos. Select from a diverse pool of 100 heroes, each boasting unique skills, allowing you to craft endless strategic combinations.

title: Brothel of Darkness
description: A dark fantasy 3D vampire brothel management game for adults with RPG elements. Caterina must manage the brothel to meet her master's demands, which are blood, sacrifice and sex. Can she escape her master, or will she remain a puppet for all eternity?

title: Sanguine 3
description: Stalk humans and drink blood for speed while axing the denizens of the underworld in this stealth-action side scroller.

title: Dead on Your Lawn
description: Prepare for intense action, heart-pounding combat, and a fight for survival where every corner of the dungeon could be your last. Will you have what it takes to reclaim your lawn from the clutches of these parasitic fiends? The challenge is set, and the lawn is yours to protect!

title: El Virus
description: El Virus is a first-person Survival Horror video game where the protagonist (Yara) wakes up alone surrounded by dangerous monsters created by a new strain of COVID-19. In addition to surviving, she must find her beloved pet, Nala, and her partner, Denki.

title: Escape From Vampire Castle: Miss Luna's Diary
description: This game is an escape game about survival from vampires. Hide in the shadows to avoid being found by the vampires and search for effective items in the mansion. To survive, find the items you need to escape.

title: Streamer vs. Zombie
description: A game made for streamers! Zombies emerge in response to comments on YouTube or Twitch! Collect bullets and healing items to defeat zombies through supportive comments and super chats! VRM model compatible! Dive into the game world as your own 3D avatar if you have a model.

title: Kill Them All
description: In this narrative action-adventure game, you play a fearless mercenary deployed on Serenity Island where an infection rages. Fight infected, complete missions, and improve your equipment. Many survivors need assistance, will you be able to help ?

title: Dungeon Destroyer
description: An innovative roguelike puzzle game that changes your fate by reconstructing dungeons. With an auto-navigating hero and floors offering endless retries, each randomly generated dungeon presents fresh challenges. Enjoy a casual yet authentic adventure

title: Run and Gun 2: Opossum City
description: Open world, up to 8 player coop multiplayer, third person, zombie shooter, procedural generation, multiple locations, drivable cars, and oh yeah, flyable helicopters with mini guns. Escape the infested Opossum City streets and uncover dark secrets within Alex Manor in this nostalgic zombie shooter.

title: No More Noise
description: Survivor of a post-apocalyptic world, the dead have returned to life to make you regret still being among the living. Moreover, their hearing has evolved, and every sound they perceive makes them stronger. A small piece of advice: I think you should stay discreet!

title: Zombies & Survivors
description: Embark on a top-down adventure in a sprawling open world. Battle hordes of zombies, rescue desperate survivors, and uncover the secrets lurking in the farthest reaches of this dystopian wasteland.

title: Zombiemachia
description: Zombiemachia offers a mature and intense experience for fans of carnage. Face endless waves of zombies with weapons, traps, and dismemberment, all in a realistic environment.

title: Vampire Receptionist
description: VAMPIRE RECEPTIONIST is a 2D pixel art platformer with resource management. Play as a vampire running a strange hotel, serving eccentric guests to please a demanding demon—all to rescue your beloved dog. Balance resource management and challenging platforming in this dark yet charming adventure.

title: Apocalypse? No!
description: In Apocalypse? No! you play as a survivor accompanied by his faithful dog in a world in ruins, survive against the creatures, help the characters of this world, discover very varied maps: From a peaceful forest, through survivor camps to ruined cities.

title: Broken World: Save Your Children
description: In Broken World: Save Your Children, you play as Josh, a father fighting to keep his kids alive in a zombie apocalypse. Manage resources, build shelters, and set traps as you cross an infested city to reach the airport and reunite with your wife. Every choice matters survive at any cost.

title: Gold Mining Simulator 2
description: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world and become the richest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialized machines, and before all, cooperate with others in Multiplayer mode.

title: Exploring Friscott
description:
Exploring Friscott is styled after the "Choose Your Own Adventure" type games. You are an adventurer going into Friscott Castle to see what treasures you can find within. Explore the castle, meet the residents, find treasure and more. Be mindful though, as the castle isn't normal, and there are things about it that might drive a person to madness. That, or it might spell your demise.

Trek inside either yourself or with one of the 4 pre-made characters and and try to get out with your life with as much treasure as you can find while interacting with a fun cast of characters within!

It does contain mature content (like nudity), but there is no explicit content outside of written text.

Play time can range from 20-30 minutes to a couple of hours depending on how thorough you are.

title: Voima
description: VOIMA wants YOU! Play as a silly bear in wild forests, build buildings to life, explore worlds, and mod universes. Play it, then make it yours.

title: Hexbound
description: Hexbound is a cozy and relaxing experience. Place, rotate, throw shapes onto hex-based boards, solve image puzzles and discover satisfying patterns. With various board layouts and challenges, it’s easy to unwind yet rewarding to complete. Perfect for a peaceful puzzle session.

title: DarkSwitch
description: DarkSwitch is a vertical survival city builder. Build a city on a great tree and defend it against the Fog. Face the challenges of limited real estate, scarce resources, and tough moral choices as you seek to uncover the mystery of the Veil. The Tree Provides! The Tree Protects! The Tree Prevails!

title: Helga the Viking Warrior 6: Beyond Ragnarok
description: Embark on an epic journey through the ruins of the Nine Realms. Engage in match-3 battles infused with post-Ragnarok magic and cosmic distortions.

title: Myths of the World: Under the Surface - Collector's Edition
Fragments of Truth: An MCF Story - Collector's Edition
description: A rookie detective takes on their first big case!

title: Lingkaran
description: You wake up on a beautiful beach... It is a looped space where the same scenery repeats itself no matter where you go. To escape from this place, you must solve the riddle hidden in this beach. A puzzle-solving adventure game where memories and riddles intersect.

title: Car Guys
description: Experience the thrill of Car Guys, a high-octane multiplayer racing game! Represent your nation, compete in explosive races, and climb the global leaderboard. Customize your ride, engage in daily and weekly championships, and enjoy seamless online play with Photon Quantum. Join the race today!

title: Haruko Maniax
description: A fandisc to Muv-Luv Alternative that includes the main story Haruko Maniax and additional side content like Muv-Luv Radio, which are three short non canon stories, and a strategy game.

title: Emotionless: The Last Ticket
description: Liminal cosmic horror - you'll wander in an abandoned amusement park, walk along empty tunnels and crawl through narrow corridors. Join a ride and step into the dark. Explore eerie remains of a world that shouldn't exist. Find clues and discover the truth, but beware, some things should stay buried.

title: Hillshade Farm
description: You’ve got land, time, and a whole lot to figure out. Start small, work hard, earn what you need, and build the kind of farm you’d never want to leave.

title: The Communist Manifesto
description: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style for the first time and fully customize your reading.

title: Railway Empire 2: Bella Italia
description:
From the snow-capped Alps in the north, along the Apennine Mountains, to the sun-soaked Gulf of Taranto, Railway Empire 2 – Bella Italia offers beautiful landscapes and spirited challenges. Uniquely Italian locomotives allow you to steam through any mission, be it economical or more… familial in nature, as you expand your railroad network set against the majestic backdrop of the Colosseum and ancient aqueducts.
Start your railway business in Rome and the Papal State, where waves of tourists await seamless connections to see the wonders of Antiquity. Down south, a different kind of challenge awaits as you discover the many branches of La Famiglia – and work to make yourself a name among them . Meanwhile, the north desperately needs help after a devastating war, with new railways required to fuel its financial recovery.

title: Pump It Up Rise
description: Pump It Up Rise brings the Pump It Up arcade experience at home. This is the first Pump It Up PC release since The PREX 3 in 2003.

title: Hive Blight
description: Hive Blight is a roguelite autobattler where you lead a team of insect warriors against a corrupting Fungal Threat. Build powerful synergies, uncover the source of the plague, and destroy it to save your world!

title: Mad Experiments: Escape Room - Sanctuary
description: First‑person escape‑room puzzler (1-4 players). Unite the Horn of the Fallen One, Scepter of Radiance, and Abbot's Ring to escape a cursed convent in 60-90 minutes.

title: Apt. 407
description: A psychological horror game set in a Korean apartment building. Explore eerie occurrences throughout the complex and uncover the truth behind them.

title: Realization
description: A self-staged arson at a sales center drags you into the murder case of a female sales agent. With both your career and life in shambles, you must find a way to clear your name. The path to the truth is fraught with danger. Can you rise from this abyss and reclaim the reality you once envisioned?

title: Adohiinage
description: A survival horror experience set in a cursed forest. Players must explore, solve puzzles, and evade terrifying creatures lurking in the shadows. With relentless tension, a haunting atmosphere, and monsters hiding within the woods. Survival depends on wit, and instinct.

title: Mountain's Secret
description: This is the sequel to Mountain's Memory. Mountain's Secret is an adventure game where you must escape from mysterious ruins while evading enigmatic dolls. Uncover the secrets left unresolved in the previous story, and reveal the true nature of the mountain.

title: Star Squadron
description: Star Squadron is a next-generation space combat simulator delivering unmatched immersion. With seamless transitions, an interactive narrative, and revolutionary voice synthesis that personalizes dialogue to your actions, your choices, and your name, every journey will feel uniquely yours.

title: Trainfort
description: Trainfort is an open-world co-op survival crafting game. As a dwarf nomad, hit the road of this post-apocalyptic world with your bearded mates. Build a moving steam engine, pack your base with you, and explore the wilderness. The country is big, your legs are short, but you gotta keep moving!

title: Hozy
description: Transform abandoned spaces into cozy havens in Hozy!

title: Lort
description: LORT is a 1–8 player co-op action roguelite. Team up with your friends to battle, loot, and stack ridiculous power-ups across a cursed fantasy world. Fight toward escape, revive your homies, and get absolutely chadded as you evolve from goblin tickler to god slapper.

title: Black Rain
description: black rain is a free fangame of the surrealist 2004 RPG Maker game Yume Nikki. It is a collaborative project led by Murasaki no Yume, and anyone can contribute to it at any time.

title: No Such Place
description: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

title: Incelthread
description: A visual novel about a bunny girl, her boyfriend and a rabbit named Tonya.

title: Social Democracy: Petrograd 1917 - An Alternate History
description:
It is March 1917, and the Russian Empire is entering a whirlwind of change. The unpopular Tsar has just been overthrown. Power now belongs to the Provisional Government on one hand, and the Soviet of Workers' and Soldiers' Deputies on the other. How will the new political order confront the devastation of war and the economic crisis? What is the future for democracy in Russia?

Play as the Mensheviks, Socialist-Revolutionaries, Kadets, or Bolsheviks, and steer the revolution to victory or collapse.

title: Fields of Fortune
description:
In Fields of Fortune, you start out on a small island with just a few tools and the idea of building something from scratch. You plant crops, place buildings, and slowly turn your patch of land into a working little farm.

As you progress, you unlock new things: crafting tools, refining materials, and exploring other islands for rare resources. You can travel to the city to sell your goods or take on small tasks for extra rewards.

Animals are part of your farm too – you feed and water them, build pens, and collect what they produce. Whether you like to play at your own pace or plan things out for maximum efficiency is completely up to you.

title: Spires of Morosith: Gossamer Sundered
description: Spires of Morosith is a tactical tower defense game with a blend of real-time-strategy elements.

title: Bunny Rampage: History of Revenge
description:
Embark on a captivating adventure with Max, a plush rabbit brought to life!

Unfold the secrets hidden within captivating portals, venturing from the bustling streets of New York City to the enigmatic depths of an alien bunker. Face hordes of enemies in exhilarating battles, unravel mind-bending puzzles, and navigate challenging platforming sections.

title: Snoot Runner
description: Chase the burgers to unlock new friends. Experience the world of Puppolonia as a canine running through the capital city of Puppolonia collecting burgers. The player will collect letters to learn to spell various words related to canines. The player will jump and dodge obstacles in the course on the city streets while collecting power ups, letters, and burgers.

title: BMX City Run
description: Embark on an exciting journey, where you will explore various locations on your trusty bike, performing amazing stunts. In each mission, you have to earn points by performing daring stunts, which you can then spend on new bike models with unique designs. Whether you're traveling through urban landscape, an amusement theme park, or radioactive terrain, each trip is a new adventure. Expand your capabilities, demonstrate your skills and leave your mark in the world of extreme cycling. Are you ready to pedal your way to fame?

title: Explosive Odds
description: Gamble with your life in this explosive PvP game for 2-4 players. Cut wires, earn cash, use abilities and avoid the detonators. Test your luck, skills and remember to always bet on the boom!

title: Observer Protocol: The Station - First Shift
description:
Welcome to The Station Observation Protocol — a remote outpost orbiting the edge of deep space, where something has gone very wrong.

You are not the hero. You don’t explore. You don’t fight. You watch.

The Station is a minimalist anomaly-spotting game where you monitor a network of surveillance cameras, flipping between feeds to identify subtle changes. A chair moves. A shadow lingers. A figure appears where no one should be. Your job is to catch these irregularities before they spiral out of control — or worse, before you start doubting what you saw at all.

Inspired by games like I'm on Observation Duty, The Station focuses on quiet tension, pattern recognition, and the eerie feeling of watching something... watch back.

There are no jump scares. No combat. Just you, the cameras, and whatever’s creeping through the corridors.

title: Tree Kingdoms
description: Winter approaches, Great Spirit. Rival Tree Kingdoms peck at your borders... Will you conquer, outlast, or outwit them in this bite-sized turn-based 4X struggle? Command your Treelings, adapt to the seasons, and etch your legend into the bark of history, before the cold claims all.

title: Super Mario Odyssey: Fluffy Bluff Kingdom
description: A mod for Super Mario Odyssey putting the Super Mario Galaxy stage "Fluffy Bluff Galaxy" in the game featuring 50 purple coins and 30 moons to collect across multiple scenarios, just like in the official kingdoms.

title: Garfield Kart 2: All You Can Drift
description: Fire Up Your Engines, Because Garfield Is Waiting for You at the Starting Line! Play as one of the eight cult characters from the Garfield universe, fill up your karts, customize your look, and race away at breakneck speeds.

title: Reaper Hunt: Survivor
description: Reaper Hunt: Survivor is a single-player top-down action roguelike shooter blending dark magic and dynamic combat. Choose your hero, upgrade via card-based perks and a skill tree, brave portals to deadlier realms, and conquer relentless bosses in a world where every second counts.

title: Karts With Chat
description: Stupid++ presents Karts With Chat: A Twitch.tv multiplayer racing game for streamers!

title: PengPong
description: PengPong is a survival roguelike shooter in a vintage cartoon world. Use a hockey stick to deflect pucks and weapons, stop swarms, and test your luck. Spend chips for safe upgrades or risk it at the roulette. New builds and quirky synergies challenge survival every run.

title: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
description: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror is an open world, survival horror experience where you play as a caregiver for the elderly. Navigate the dark streets of Tokyo, choosing where to go and whom to care for. Not everyone can be saved. How many deaths will be on your watch this week?

title: Tactics Returners
description: Tactics Returners, inspired by the golden age of TRPGs, aims to combine modern gameplay mechanics and advanced 2D visuals. Join the struggle for freedom, face decisive tactical challenges against superior forces, and shape the fate of the Returners!

title: Wonder of Blue
description: Delve into Wonderland with Liddell in this Dungeon Crawler Roguelike. Defeat great adversaries in graceful melee combat.

title: Wild West Supermarket Simulator
description: Run a General Store in the Wild West. Customize and expand your shop. Make sure that your customers’ constantly changing needs are satisfied. Work every job yourself or let your employees stack the shelves and work the till. Find out what it feels like to own a Wild West Supermarket.

title: Find All: Bunker - Extra Level
description: This DLC adds another lengthy scene with 270 hidden objects to find.

title: Outhold
description: Outhold is a short, minimalistic incremental game that blends tower defense strategy with a deep meta-progression. Carve your own way through the sprawling skill tree, unlock powerful upgrades, and defend your Holdout from relentless waves of enemies.

title: Guilt
description: Guilt is indie horror game inspired by P.T Guilt contain Jumpscares, Puzzles, Flickering Light, Psychological Atmosphere. Support 32 and 64 bit. Recommend using headphones while playing this game

title: Oku
description: Become a zen monk and embark on a journey towards spiritual growth. Ride the wind across artistic Japanese landscapes as you write Haiku-like poems to capture the beauty of nature and unlock forgotten paths.

title: Piñata Go Boom
description: A small incremental game about smashing piñatas, collecting toys, and climbing the corporate ladder as you unlock a vast upgrade tree.

title: Condemned To Be Free
description: A narrative-driven third/first-person short film with about free will, blending cinematic environments with Killer7 combat.

title: Liar's Dice
description: Liar's Dice is an online realtime casual multiplayer bluffing dice game. Easy to learn, easy to master, always entertaining. Play with other players around the globe or invite and play with family or friends. Liar's Dice, also known as Dudo, Cachito, Perudo, Deception Dice, and Pirate Dice.

title: Precious: Naze Shou ha Kami ni Idonda no ka?
Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 1
description:
The Toaplan Arcade Collection Volume 1 is here with a bang! With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, quick save and other quality-of-life extras, anyone can experience these classic titles. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield!

This collection includes Tiger-Heli, Flying Shark, Twin Cobra, Fire Shark, Out Zone, FixEight, Dogyuun, and Batsugun. It's octuple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past!

Through this re-release, a new generation of players will surely discover what made Toaplan such a special company, and their games timeless masterpieces. Now, let's blast some enemies!

title: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 2
description:
The Toaplan Arcade Collection Volume 2 is here with a bang! With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, quick save and other quality-of-life extras, anyone can experience these classic titles. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield!

This collection includes Slap Fight, Truxton, Hellfire, Twin Hawk, Zero Wing, Vimana, Truxton II and Grind Stormer. It's octuple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past!

Through this re-release, a new generation of players will surely discover what made Toaplan such a special company, and their games timeless masterpieces. Now, let's blast some enemies!

title: Paranormal Torment
description: Paranormal Torment is a psychological horror game in the spirit of P.T., where you're trapped in a loop of memory and guilt, forced to relive a tragedy over and over again. He's still waiting for you to come back...

title: DeadCore Redux
description: DeadCore Redux is a challenging FPS-platformer set in a futuristic universe. Chain precise jumps, manipulate mechanisms with your SwitchGun, hunt hidden collectibles and new shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit as you climb a colossal Tower born from the void. Will you reach the Summit?

title: Vault Hunters
description:
Vault Hunters is an RPG based modpack focusing around the mysteries and dangers of a dimension called The Vault. It features many Vault Hunters specific items and mobs, like armor, weapons, totems, currency and bosses.
Players can develop their own talents and abilities while trying to achieve the goal of collecting all the 25 unique artifacts to unlock the final challenge!

title: CLINK
description: You are a lonely woman, secluded in a house with your cat... and the secrets of the past. What hides within your mind — illness, or something otherworldly? Nightmares and reality intertwine… everything is so foggy. Do you have the courage to remember what happened?

title: Need For Scream
description: The year is 2010. You're going on a study exchange to Russia from the United States. You're also running your own blog, and everything is going great—until 2014... that is, until you learn about the cursed village and decide to go there to film a video for your followers.

title: Techno Prank
description: Techno Prank is a simulator of a techno prankster’s life, where creativity, absurdity, and audio chaos collide. Call random people, use stolen voices, record their reactions, and trick the next victim. Uncover secrets, stream your pranks, earn donations, and grow your cult following. The more phrases you collect, the deeper and more ridiculous your conversations become. But be careful — not everyone enjoys the madness.

title: Grime&Gold
description: Fancy some cards, alchemist ? Mix and stack cards to craft strange recipes, delve into dungeons for new ingredients. But be careful! The streets aren't nice with anyone, and the shadows might not be enough to hide you from angry customers...

title: The Seal Hunter
description:
Very bloody game Seal Hunter, where you will have to act as a defender of the territory from all sorts of sea creatures (and not only). Blood, plenty of weapons and the possibility to play in two make the game worth your attention.
A growing population of seals is destroying all the fish in the sea. The fishermen are left without a catch, and the seals meanwhile continue to multiply and eat all the fish. Two fishermen decide to take control of the situation and get rid of the extra mouths, thus preserving the once fish-rich ocean. Along with the seals, they need to kill penguins, baby seals, and, for some reason, sea turtles and polar bears. In general, armed with a considerable arsenal, fishermen go hunting.
Seal Hunter game at first glance is simple and uncomplicated, but behind all this hides a rather complex timekiller. You can't act on the fly, you won't get far. In the game you need to tactically calculate literally everything. How much ammo is left, and when the boss will appear, what weapon to buy next; what is better to kill a penguin with, and what is better to kill a seal with; how to keep a full horn of ammo in the machine gun to kill a dozen penguins in a few seconds, etc.

title: Swarm Hunter
description:
1985. An Alternate Universe. A Forgotten World Calls for Help.

The International Space Agency (ISA) has just intercepted a desperate, system-wide distress signal from the long-isolated inhabitants of Pluto. In a race against time, the nearby vessel Empress of Discovery is dispatched to respond…but moments after making orbit, the ship’s final transmission crackles through the void: a garbled, static-soaked mayday… then silence.

Now, all eyes turn to you.

Assume the role of Master Commander Lance Johnson, captain of the legendary Gilded Seeker.

Your mission: investigate the Plutonian distress call, uncover the fate of the Empress and its crew, and confront whatever terror has awakened on the planet’s surface. Can you stop the unknown menace before it spreads beyond Pluto’s orbit?

title: MultiEnding Heroes
description: Embark on a hilarious, choice-driven adventure in MultiEnding Heroes! Guide The Priest and The Hero through multiple universes, making decisions that lead to over 50 unique endings. Every choice matters, will you lead them to glory or disaster?

title: Detra
description: DETRA is a story-rich supernatural horror game where you follow the story of Vir and Druxy, a scientist couple who delve into an abandoned laboratory, in search of a cure for an illness that Druxy has got. Follow along as the trip ends up revealing more about their relationship than was intended.

title: Hidden Memories
description:
What happened last night? Dive into your memories to unravel the mystery.

Hidden Memories is the ninth game of the Hidden Town series by Dark Dome.

title: Ruyn HD
description: Ruyn HD is a remake of my minimalist boomer shooter Ruyn, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. It keeps the fast, combo-driven gameplay of the original, but now features modern visuals, smoother controls, updated audio, and tighter gunplay. Ruyn Classic and the 2D and 3D level editors are included.

title: Rushing Beat X: Return of Brawl Brothers
description: The legendary beat ’em up series from Jaleco returns. Master trained fighters take on a rising evil with raw strength and refined technique. Built around easy-to-use auto-combos, the game lets skilled players weave powerful strings for exhilarating combat. Let your fists burn with fury once more.

title: Arcade Boss Simulator
description: Arcade Boss Simulator is an arcade store simulation where you profit from arcade machines and collect coins to expand your store.

title: Shuffle Farm
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where farming meets the arcane. Build powerful synergies, master production chains, explore uncharted lands, and face formidable challenges - all with the help of a mysterious god. Or just chill and plant some crops... you can do that too!

title: Time Sensitive Investigation
description:
Time Sensitive Investigation is a top down escape game in a cassette punk universe !
Play as G-UI, a police robot capable of going back in time!
Take part in a thrilling police investigation and find the culprit behind the journalist's murder!
But be careful, the time rift is only open for 30 minutes!

title: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon
description: The Heavens are done waiting. In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.

title: Sydless
description: Sydless is an ultra-fast movement shooter where your weapon is a chaotic ball that grows deadlier the more you move.

title: Fallen Fates
description: Venture into a vast 2D pixel-art fantasy world, face relentless battles and forge your destiny with vivid companions as you unravel the truth behind the falling crystals.

title: Gangs on New York
description: you must help your gang to take over new york

title: Umami
description: Umami is a cozy 3D food puzzle game where every level is a handcrafted, sensory experience. Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and fantastical cakes, all in a comfy atmosphere, like tidying a bento box for the soul.

title: Pirate Royalty
description: Pirate Royalty is a free-to-play fantasy pirate MMORPG set on Saltbreak Isle. Players choose from four classes, build their own stats and skills, hunt rare gear, forge gems into equipment, and team up for timed dungeons. It includes PvE, PvP, trading, and a cosmetics-only shop—combat power has to be earned.

title: Space Simulation Toolkit
description: Physics sandbox game that uses a graphics card as a supercomputer. Change the laws of physics, design mechanisms, create A-Life worlds and inhabit them with living beings, experiment with evolution and AI.

title: Pity This Busy Monster
description: Pity This Busy Monster is a physics-based narrative game where you experience employment at Spanky’s Donut Fulfillment Warehouse, the least efficient donut factory in the world. Fulfill orders by throwing the correct donuts into boxes, keep your work area clean, and unwind after work.

title: Elmin
description: Elmin is a serene first person platformer where you bring winds back to a forgotten archipelago of islands. Fly between islands in a vibrant open world on the back of a mysterious giant bird, unlock wind routes and do parkour across the interconnected remains of an ancient civilization.

title: Megachess
description: MEGACHESS is a roguelite dungeon crawler with chess elements. Blast through high-paced tactical battles, adapt your army against outnumbering foes, craft and combine your units to form MEGA-PIECES and obliterate the bosses.

title: Barda
description: The mesmerizing inventory management roguelite where keeping your bag tidy means the difference between life and death.

title: Tokyo College Girls: The Nerd & Queen Bees
description: A 30-day romance simulation game where you spend your college life with female students.

title: Homeward in the Roil
description:
by Freyja Katra Erlingsdóttir

Two wars have left humanity licking its wounds. Earth is gone, its fleets becoming nomadic, searching the stars for somewhere to call home. In one of the scattered flotilla, a navy pilot meets a wanderer. Their culture and customs, still human, are foreign.

Perhaps a sign of things to come for another part of humanity.

title: Fireside Feelings
description: Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between real people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.

title: Goya's Inferno
description:
Goya's Inferno is a horizontal Shoot 'em up inspired by Goya's paintings.
Play with different Witches to defeat the evil creatures of your nightmares.

title: Amagami Chotto Omake Gekijou
description: Amagami Fandisc for PC. Consists of 6 parts. Each part contains several scenarios about one or two of the heroines or the sub-heroines.

title: Amagami GS
description:
On Christmas Eve, behind the festivities of the Founder's Festival.
In the background of the Christmas Eve festivities, preparations were being made with an eagle eye for what would become known as the "Backstage Founding Festival".
What is the purpose of this backdoor founding festival?
I was invited by no one, and ended up alone at the campfire.
In the end, the protagonist is left alone to watch the campfire.
He is lonely at heart.
In the end, he was left alone to watch the campfire. The lonely protagonist was greeted by Umehara, who looked as if he had made up his mind. ......

The heroines of "Amagami" are all here.
It's a fully voiced, gorgeous ensemble comedy that finally opens!

title: SOG: Vietnam
description: Head to Vietnam as a lone SOG operative. Gear up, upgrade your skills, and explore the danger-filled jungles. Complete the missions assigned by your country and eliminate enemies using napalm and artillery in a brutal, tactical, turn-based 2D roguelite that does not forgive mistakes!

title: Primland Tale
description: A colorful and adorable 2D side-scrolling action game

title: Frontier Force
description:
Frontier Force is a shoot'em up for the SEGA Master System/Mark III.

The Earth lies in ruins under alien occupation, a harsh reminder of our lost home. A fragile outpost, humanity's last hope, teeters on the brink of collapse.

A hero must rise to defend the outpost against relentless alien invaders. The fate of humanity rests on your actions, and the outcome is far from certain.

title: Coffie Simulator
description: In Coffie Simulator, run your own café, serve 500+ unique customers, and master the art of coffee-making! Customize, upgrade, and manage your shop while handling orders with precision. Every choice matters—your reputation shapes the experience.

title: Alpha Response
description: From Gooseman, creator of the original Counter-Strike mod - Alpha Response delivers intense police action in dynamic, real-world environments. Fight solo or with friends against diverse enemies in high-stakes missions that demand tactical precision and split-second decisions.

title: Beat Ball 2
description: "Beat Ball 2 is the sequel arkanoid / breakout clone also including a level editor." - from the game's itch.io page

title: Bru & Boegie: Episode 1 - Get da Milk!
description: A hand-drawn 2D surrealist comedy point-and-click adventure game.

title: Clickonomy
description: Clickonomy is a cozy sandbox game where you harvest resources from your very own tiny planet just by clicking. Gather, recycle, and find the rarest treasures to expand your collection as you explore a lively world that’s uniquely yours — all at your own pace.

title: Getting Goopy
description: Getting Goopy is a puzzle platformer where you can slide, jump, and shoot goo to solve various puzzles.

title: Super Mario Bros. 0
description: Super Mario Bros 0. is a prequel to the original Super Mario Bros. The princess has supposedly been kidnapped for the very first time, and it's up to Mario and Luigi to save her! Journey through an early Mushroom Kingdom with its strange brick-like ground and eyeless mushrooms in this comfy old-school style episode.

title: Spikeventure
description: SPIKEVENTURE is a SMBX2 episode where you play as a Spike! It features 11 levels packed with action, challenge, and loads of secrets! Master the art of throwing spike balls, discover two power-ups tailor-made for the lean green machine, and pulverize an army of new enemies and bosses!

title: Hero Party Must Fall
description: The demons have risen once again and fight for their ideals, led by the Demon King. You play as Mars, sent by the Demon King as a spy to infiltrate and destroy the Hero's party.

title: Ovorol
description: Solve two simultaneous quick-time puzzles to disable traps and guide a fragile egg to safety in this minimalistic arcade puzzler!

title: Hivecraft
description: Breed bees, collect nectar and make honey! But remember that there may be a bear lurking nearby, who will not miss the opportunity to eat a sweet treat.

title: Ping Profit: Internet Tycoon
description: Launch your hosting company straight from your parent's basement! Buy servers, solve problems, and grow your profits as you climb from startup to tech titan. Keep customers online, boost your reputation, and build the ultimate hosting empire in Ping Profit!

title: Mirrormind
description: Mirrormind is a 3D Puzzle Platformer in a lo-fi dithered style, where you can shift perspective into any person you can see. Journey through a series of worlds to explore different points of view.

title: Lone Voyage
description: You are the last living organism in the galaxy. Adrift and alone in a cold dark world you must scavenge for resources to keep your ship running, and arm your ship to prepare for the swarms arrival.

title: Copter Besieged
description: Copter Besieged is an acrobatic copter survival shooter, an intense hybrid of realistic multi-copter flight with arcade style weapons, items, powerups and escalating monster waves. Dodge incoming attacks, shoot monsters, collect coins, level up your copter and upgrade your items.

title: Cat Rescue Inc.
description: Rescue your customers’ lost feline friends! Explore endless, randomly generated jobs. Be stealthy because the cats are watching! And beware... dangers lurk in the woods!

title: Dreamnest
description: Build cozy settlements in dreams! Solve relaxing puzzles by placing buildings on whimsical and surreal platforms. Explore unique worlds, immerse yourself in strangers' dreams, and enjoy the charm of hand-drawn visuals.

title: Where Is My Hat?
description: Help the forgetful deity find its hat among its sacred relics! Push, kick, search for artifacts, and flee from the god’s whims. In this absurd chaos, the one who best controls their emotions wins. Test yourself and your friend!

title: Buckshot Battlemage
description: Blast, cleave, and telefrag your way through hordes of felonious fellas with shotgun magic in this arcade twin stick shooter. Upgrade your spells to ludicrous levels and ascend to bullet nirvana, unlocking more weapons and stages as you play.

title: Cosmic Miners
description: Explore asteroid fields, trade rare resources, and upgrade your ship in Cosmic Miners. Navigate faction alliances, complete missions, and rise through the ranks in a dynamic space adventure where your choices shape your path to cosmic power.

title: Dark Quest 4
description: A turn based dungeon crawler where you create a party of heroes to go on epic quests.

title: Soul Mirror Relics
description: As a youthful offender, sent to a place called the Soul Mirror Relics, When the mirror reflected past memories, after witnessing a myriad of people and events, whether to let go, whether to live or die, whether to accept or not, are all endings

title: Hemera
description: "Hemera" is a little narrative game blending exploration, symbolic combat, and impactful choices. Immersed in a mysterious forest, you will discover a world where reality and mystery intertwine.

title: Anarchy Road
description: Fast Speeds, Big Explosions, even Bigger Bosses and action throughout! Anarchy Road is a Post-Apocalyptic action driving game where our 4 heroes must race against the clock, battle bosses, while blasting enemies and dodging traps in order to survive to the explosive end!

title: Braindead
description: Step into an adrenaline-fueled, round-based zombie survival FPS—play solo or team up with up to 3 friends online! Mow down endless hordes of the undead, earn cash from every kill, and gear up with powerful weapons, perks, upgrades, and more. The deeper you go, the deadlier it gets!

title: Absolution of the Dead
description: The Soviets have released a hell upon Europe. You wake up in a zombie infested hotel, the only way out is down into the chaos of the undead. Loot, craft, and upgrade your zombie slaughtering arsenal to make it out alive....

title: BroomSweeper
description: BroomSweeper is a Minesweeper-style Roguelike puzzle game. Unmask the evil lurking at TentaTech, Inc. as you ascend through increasingly challenging floors. Assemble winning combinations from over 100 powerful items to defeat the dust bunnies and keep your job until morning!

title: Draggin'
description: Capture Draggins by draggin' the mouse in this casual arcade roguelite! Click-and-drag to cast spells on enemies and get your fill of wave battlin', achievement huntin', upgrade unlockin', rinse-and-repeatin'!

title: Compression
description: A massive underground warehouse has turned into a hostile organism. Every part of it is hunting you. To survive in this action 2D platformer, follow three main rules: run, shoot, think! And find the one behind it all.

title: Ice Cream Simulator
description: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

title: Bite the Crown
description: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

title: Souls End
description: Souls End is an auto-battler roguelike where you'll draft unstoppable armies, placing units and items in just the right way to create awesome synergies! Cast spells while battles unfold and find relics to further elevate builds. Will you defeat life itself-or will you meet a Souls End?

title: SU42: Hired Gun
description: SU42: HIRED GUN is a fast-paced 2D shooter inspired by 80s/90s games! Choose two out of eight mercenaries and switch between them in battle. Enjoy hand-painted graphics, giant robots, a synth-wave soundtrack, explosions, and lasers!

title: Misty Garden
description: Create a peaceful garden. Build a soothing retreat and help the wandering creatures unwind from chaotic lives. Misty Garden is a calm and relaxing base building providing laid-back experience interacting with the creatures living in the Misty forest.

title: Around the World 3: Amazing Countries - Collector's Edition
description: An incredible and amazing journey, again!

title: Nightshade Mysteries: Eternal Moon - Collector's Edition
description: Archaeologist Helena Nightshade gets entangled in the mysteries surrounding an ominous eternal lunar eclipse!

title: OpsCam: Body Cam Shooter
description: Equip weapons and dominate every fight.

title: Match Quest: Numbers
description:
Match the numbers
Smash the high scores
Domineer the global leaderboard

title: Maze: Interim Odyssey
description:
Maze: Interim Odyssey is a sequel spin-off to the hit puzzle adventure game, Maze: Pedestal of Trials. This entry into the TreeFall Studios Maze series brings all new challenges, complex puzzles, and new environments.

Taking place between "Pedestal of Trials" and the upcoming "Rising Trials" this Maze side story can be picked up and played by fans of the series or complete newcomers.

title: Anime Girls: Fantasy Desire
description: Battle, Charm, Conquer

title: Amber Alert Director's Cut
description: Step into the shoes of a policeman in "Amber Alert," a difficult survival horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl.

title: Girl.exe.exe
description: GIRL.EXE.EXE is a psychological horror-puzzle game with unique gameplay and a twisted story where reality blends with code, and bugs become part of the narrative. You return to an abandoned project—a game you once wanted to finish but never could Going back is hard, isn’t it?

title: Caveman Jump Jump
description: Jump, climb, and survive! Help a brave caveman rescue a frozen cavewoman in this challenging prehistoric platformer. Time your jumps, explore 3 unique worlds, and avoid extinction! Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

title: Gloctopus
description: It's you, and 8 glocs, up against the whole ocean - are you up to the task? Gloctopus is a fast paced 2D Roguelike shooter about a gun-wielding octopus on a mission to stop a nuclear warhead from destroying the world.

title: Prison Escape Simulator
description: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats.

title: CorAstral
description: Face countless perils in this challenging fast-paced runner where timing and reflexes are everything. Dodge obstacles or slash them with your sword. Perform aerial acrobatics to overcome more challenging sections. Reach your goal and discover the truth!

title: Dreadline: Net Quota
description: Dreadline: Net Quota is a chaotic co-op game for up to 6 players set on dangerous seas. Catch fish with different rods or spearfishing, keep your boat afloat as systems fail, and survive unpredictable encounters without drowning as everything falls apart.

title: Dodgekill
description: DodgeKill is a minimalist bullet hell arcade game. Your cursor is both your heart and your weapon : dodge enemy waves, then strike back! Will you survive until the end ?

title: Herb Seek Slash
description: Herbs Seek Slash is a 2D top-down scrolling shoot'em up game with fantasy background. An ordinary swordsman, Ethan, sets out to find an ordinary herb to save his sister, Elaine, on an extraordinary and perilous journey.

title: Isekai Mage
description: Protagonist dies in a truck accident, reborn as a Mage Adventurer in an isekai. Explore chests, battle monsters, complete quests, and customize skills via roguelike mechanics. Defeat the Demon King in this blend of RPG, adventure, and light roguelike.

title: Encode Encore!
description: A charming, slice-of-life indie RPG where you earn some sweet cash by trying out various part-time jobs—all in the name of getting your girl the perfect gift! But just when you think you’ve got it all figured out, life throws you an unexpected twist...

title: Bumblebee: Storm of Friendship
description: This game is a story-driven, narrative 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bee on its journey to find a new home.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2: Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition Content:
- Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Main Game
- Character Unlock Keys: Tengen Uzui, Obanai Iguro, Sanemi Shinazugawa, and Gyomei Himejima
- Battle Attire: Tanjiro's Kimono (Entertainment District), Inosuke's Kimono (Entertainment District), and Uzui's Shinobi Attire
- VS Mode System Voice: Upper Rank Demons Set (Akaza, Daki, Gyutaro, Gyokko, Zohakuten)
- Character Unlock Key: Academy Rengoku and Academy Uzui

title: Escape Game The Empty School
description:
An orthodox escape game set in a school building after school.
Solve the riddles in the school and try to escape.

title: Dreamy Hill
description: Village you can only dream of

title: Jumping Ninja Battle
description: 2 Player Ninja Games Play with your friends

title: Lyra and the Echo of the Abyss
description: Join Lyra, a brave mermaid with the power to heal emotions, on a magical adventure to save the ocean from darkness with the help of her playful sea friends.

title: Puff Up
description: Grow the biggest balloon and don't POP!

title: Rolly Rails
description: Ride Fast, Build Big, and Race to Victory

title: Sugoi Girls: Raunchy Rabbit
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Report: Horror Haul
description: Steal stuff. Don’t scream. Easy, right?

title: Wizard's Fortress: Tower Defense
description: Defend your fortress with the power of magic!

title: Pick Race 3D
description: Race, Jump, Crash, Repeat!

title: Phantom Kiosk
description: Something’s Cooking… and It’s Not Just the Food.

title: Nurilogy 1000
description: Decorate the streets with cuteness! You're a future artist! Take on this logic puzzle with simple rules!

title: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner
description: Drive through the wild. Conquer the impossible.

title: Formula 2025: Grand Prix Legends
description: Live the speed. Write your legend.

title: Date Everything!: Lavish DLC
description: Is 100 just simply not enough dateable objects? Are you unsatisfied with lower-priced goods? Do you literally want to fall in love with a micro-transaction?

title: Crime Busters II: Havoc
description: Eliminate terrorists hiding in the labyrinthine city of Hong Kong! Battle from alleyways to skyscrapers on neon-lit streets. Team up in co-op to defend Hong Kong's peace!

title: Another World Series: Slit Mouth Woman vs. Aooni
description: Legendary modern monsters vs. legendary horror games! This is a 3D horror action adventure game where you must escape from an abandoned hospital without being found by the Slit Mouth Woman who lives in another world and AOONI who lives in the real world.

title: Pirate Anime Quest: One Boys' Journey, A Piece of Island Love
description: Sail the seas of desire... and merge forbidden fruits to capture the heart of your ideal pirate.

title: Pirate Anime Quest: One Girls' Journey, A Piece of Island Love
description: Sail the seas of desire… and merge forbidden fruits to capture the heart of your ideal pirate.

title: Call of Glory: Critical Warfare
description: Defeat is not an option—only victory or glory.

title: Digger Simulator: Gold Rush
description: Every man makes his fortune his own way

title: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection
description: Relax and create beautiful pixel art with color-by-number and cross-stitch fun!

title: Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Toddler Coloring Book Draw Paint
description: Puzzles and colouring games for toddlers! Explore fun scenes and educational games! A safe and creative world that encourages logic and imagination.

title: Shadowforge Chronicles & Flames of Damnation
description: Survive the flames. Defeat the shadows. The ultimate challenge awaits!

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening Complete Edition + Collector's Set
description:
"NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening," where players can truly experience the Warring States period with officers who make decisions for themselves, now has a collector's edition that includes various add-on content that has been released, along with an officer artbook and complete soundtrack.

The contents:
In addition to "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Complete Edition" and all its add-on content, the collector's set includes:
- The "Kou Shibusawa's 40th Anniversary Commemorative Officer Data Set,"
- "Digital Officer Artbook," "Digital NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION 40th Anniversary Commemorative Book,"
- "Digital Complete Soundtrack."
For more details about the collector's edition contents, please see the official site (https:///).

title: Lost In Random: The Eternal Die - Wardrobe Expansion
description: Slay your enemies in style with our Wardrobe Expansion, featuring brand-new designs from the Rug Reader herself. Channel your inner motivational speaker with the empowering Death Set or dazzle your foes with the radiant shimmer of the Crystal Set. Either way, you'll look like royalty!

title: Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Savanna Animals
Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Sea Animals
Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Space
Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Halloween
Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Farm Animals
Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Dinosaurs
Puzzles & Colors: Games for Kids - Christmas
Upfall
description:
Upfall is a game about bouncing, dodging, and near death experiences. Burst bubbles to progress upwards, but be careful to dodge the hazards in the depths. How far will your upfall be? A free game for the in betweens.

Escape the depths by bouncing on bubbles and avoid the hazards which slowly present themselves. Glowing red = danger... at least to start with! Each new depth you reach causes the colours to change and the hazards to increase, with enough random generation so each upfall is never the same. It's not easy, it's sometimes mean, but with fast restarts, lots to discover, and quick rounds you'll find yourself coming back over and over.

Can you find your way back to the surface?

title: Hades-Plan
description: Hades, Zeus, and Athena are embroiled in a vortex of emotional power. Identity secrets are exposed, and the relationship between the three is tumultuous.

title: Finger Party
description: Role-play as a regular finger in this short incremental game about plopping and collecting colorful blobs.

title: Mosa Lina: Second Layer
description: With 24 new tools, 180+ new levels and 38 new pieces of Music, this is the biggest update to Mosa Lina yet. A whole second layer, basically. Enjoy.

title: Eyes on the Exam
description: Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.

title: Makine
description: A tactical top-down action roguelike where you pilot a customizable vehicle through intense bullet-hell combat while managing power/heat systems and collecting game-changing relics.

title: 2002XX
description: Embark on an epic journey of space, time, and exploration in 2002XX. Run through shapes until a scene appears, then find the monolith to advance.

title: Eve Online: Legion
description: Legion is Here! The Legion expansion introduces new systems and tools that let capsuleers define their own role in New Eden. From player-created Freelance Jobs that connect individuals to the broader war machine, to powerful warships and nullsec upgrades that shift the balance of power, Legion offers new ways to lead, earn, and fight - regardless of experience or allegiance.

title: Into The Backrooms
description: Explore and survive levels based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level offers various escape routes but also introduces perilous obstacles. Players can immerse themselves in the seemingly boundless and unsettling levels of the backrooms, experiencing the game's eerie and intricate mazes.

title: Catch It
description: Collect the green stars that come from top to bottom. Stay away from the red ones. And never miss a green star!

title: NTR Legend
description: A married woman visits her neighbor for her part time cleaning job, but her neighbor is a notorious homewrecker.

title: Halloween Stories: Black Book
description: When your world and the supernatural realm collide, can you survive?

title: Pep A Pig
description:
Get ready to meet Pep, the cutest little pig you'll ever find.

In this cozy and fun game, you arrive on a charming island where your only mission is simple: meet Pep, hang out with him, and enjoy tons of fun activities together.

No combat. No stress. Just you, a peaceful island, and Pep — your new best friend.

title: Death Ring: Second Impact
description: Death Ring: Second Impact is a turn-based Roguelite strategy game. As the commander of the "Griffin" squadron, you must lead your Mechas and Pilots to resist the threat of mutated monsters and approaching to the secrets hidden behind the Death Ring.

title: Nameless Adventure
description: Nameless Adventure is an action RPG with elements of metroidvania, sandbox, and platforming. You will face a dangerous dungeon that transforms in real time and holds many secrets. Only by reaching its deepest depths will you uncover the truth about what this "dungeon" really is...

title: The Lost Soul
description: The Lost Soul is an arcade difficulty-focused platformer , made in a minimalist style. 13 different levels, each of which contain it’s own unique soundtrack, checkpoint system, as well as many secrets.

title: Ox & Horse Work in Hell
description: Controlling the Ox-Head and Horse-Face, either single-handedly or in pairs, to punish evil spirits in hell and make them drink the soup of Meng Po to reincarnate. However, be cautious of these evil spirits with different abilities.

title: The Herd
description: Herding animals is hard—especially when there are predators, traps, and total mayhem at every turn! Can you guide your herd through the perilous world without losing too many along the way?

title: Chronicles of Veldoria
description: Chronicles of Veldoria is an epic tactical RPG where you’ll meet new allies, convince monsters to join you, do monster fusion, craft items, learn & upgrade skills, and gather strength to battle the malignant forces of an ancient evil, Ogre Muk, to save the majestic land of Veldoria!

title: Rennova: The New Frontier
description: After Earth’s destruction, humanity settled on a planet known as Rennova. A war waged by the planet’s most powerful factions now threatens to tear your new home apart. Fight your way through alien environments and dangerous facilities to uncover the truth behind the war.

title: Ntraholic
description: Chiho and her high-school sweetheart move into a new apartment, but the new landlord is a corruptive influence with powers lent to him by a devil.

title: Hobby Horse
description: Create your own hobby horse and hit the obstacle courses! Slay every ride, win trophies, improve and become the best hobby horse rider!

title: Memory Dimension
description: Memory Dimension is a dynamic Vampire-Like Bullet Hell set in a computer simulation. Experience highly flexible build customization, a vibrant and unique world, and plenty of humor. Help Dave uncover all the secrets of the evil AI!

title: Will the King Escape?
description: A quirky turn-based puzzle game where you help the Gnome King, Shorty, Escape from his own tower! Navigate handmade levels, Kill monsters, Dodge traps, Purify allies, and Teleport on your path to freedom, while meeting a cast of silly characters along the way.

title: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

title: Mailbound
description: The dead linger in the CRT glow, their wails rippling through the screen like disembodied echoes. And now… you’re drifting with them...

title: Nachtschicht
description: Make coffee. Answer the phone. Hope it stays quiet.

title: Samurai Blitz EX
description: Unleash your inner warrior in Samurai Blitz EX, an adrenaline-fueled arcade "Slice 'em Up"! Carve through relentless waves of ferocious demons, chaining together insane air-slicing combos as you dash, slash and rack up sky-high scores.

title: Worn Out
description: A presence lingers in the dark, waiting. It asks. It doubts. It knows. What happened? Why are you here? Do you deserve this? The answers are yours to decide. What you choose matters. Every path leads somewhere. But will you like where it takes you?

title: Ayna: Shattered Truth
description: Become water. Be shapeless, be formless, be fluid. All living things are from water and you can transform water into what it needs to be. Dive into this newly crafted fairytale and take on the journey of finding your place in this Metroidvania fantasy world.

title: Mage Food Truck
description: Use your growing card collection to brave a hangry realm, crafting exotic meals in the face of fantastical beasts and curses from dissatisfied customers. A roguelike deckbuilder from the maker of Space Food Truck.

title: Sweet Slaughter
description: Face endless waves of enemies in this action roguelike! Choose a hero, enhance your stats with Modifiers, and unlock powerful Augments. Can you survive for 15 minutes?

title: Anomaly Runner
description: Observe your surroundings closely in the Anomaly Research Center (ARC) to memorize important details. Detect unsettling anomalies to escape the hazardous areas. Uncover the dark secrets of the ARC organization in this innovative sci-fi horror walking simulator.

title: Super Kingcrab Simulator
description: Destroy it! And liberate it! Until it's all over..Be a delicious and fresh super kingcrab, destroy the city and liberate the kingcrab to join them!

title: Day of Drift
description: DAY OF DRIFT is an arcade - style drifting racing game!

title: Regolith: Viozic Suns
description: A top-down space shooter roguelike set in a handcrafted, procedurally-enriched galaxy. Coming soon.

title: Liquor Love Lady
description: Evelyn inherited the small cocktail bar‘Hyacinth Bar' in her hometown according to her grandfather’s will. However, she is not easy to running a store, becuse she knows nothing about cocktail bars. At that time, five men appeared in front of her!

title: Yokai Art 2: Tales of the Nine-Tails
description: After defeating Fujin and Raijin, Hiro and his allies found peace at his grandfather’s house. One day, Sanbi sensed a distant summon. After tracing the energy, they discovered it came from her true form—the nine-tailed fox. Determined to help, Hiro and his friends set off on a new journey.

title: RelicWar
description: Collect the requested dungeon Relic and escape unharmed. Battle tough dungeon monsters and enemy players along the way. They want to steal your valuable treasure. Run or fight your way out. The choice is yours!

title: Ronin's Way
description: A brutal exploration and survival game for 1-4 players, set on an island archipelago inspired by far Eastern culture. Engage in epic katana duels, build and fortify your settlement, raise your army and forge your own masterless path.

title: RogueCraft
description: Merge, build, and defend in this roguelike tower defense game! Face waves of enemies and epic bosses, evolve your towers, and unlock upgrades for endless replayability and tactical depth.

title: Pocket Oracle
description: Uncover your destiny in this interactive divination game! Explore ancient Eastern wisdom and complete quests to unlock 64 hexagrams that reveal the mysteries of your destiny in love, career, health, wealth, and more. Embrace the timeless power of fortune-telling and find clarity on your life's path!

title: Hexbotica
description: Turn-based strategy on a hex world three layers deep. Dig the underground, hold the surface, take the sky. Pipe gems through a factory that prints your army, terraform the map itself, and outlast a planet that fights back — solo, or in online 1v1.

title: Mighty Miners
description: Mighty Miners is a roguelite survival mining game. Mine more and more mightium, unlock weapons, items, characters, buy upgrades and complete tasks to become completely unstoppable.

title: Kart Evolution 2025
description: The first-ever true MMO kart racing game is here! Play with up to 39 friends!

title: Fashion Shop Simulator
description: "Fashion Shop Simulator" is a 3d store management genre game. Become rich by selling items to customers.

title: YinYang Street: Separate Ways
description: YinYang Street: Separate Ways is a Chinese micro horror game set in 1980s China, combining the story of understanding puzzles and text adventures. In the game, the scroll scene that can be moved by four axes is applied to bring different game experience to the player.

title: League Of Tacticians: Path of Tarkan
description: League of Tacticians is a story-driven tactical game blending turn-based and real-time combat. Follow Tomyris, a young warrior, as she helps her tribe rise in the War League through strategy, skill, and determination.

title: Super Sad Banana
description: Psychological Thriller about a Struggling Banana Testing Your Reflexes

title: Neither Dead nor Alive
description: In Neither Dead or Alive, you awaken as a skeleton brought back to life by a young, overzealous necromancer. But something went wrong—you retained your will, your mind, and your burning desire for freedom. Trapped within the ominous castle of your creator, your journey to escape begins.

title: Embroideryvania
description: You always wanted to visit. Now you have the time and a friend, but no map. Getting lost is highly encouraged.

title: Liczę z Reksiem
description:
"Counting with Reksio" is a game for first-grade elementary school students. The storyline follows Reksio's efforts to rescue his friends from the clutches of the Wolf. It consists of a set of math mini-games.

Counting with Reksio is one of the spin-off games in the main series, designed specifically for first-grade students. The game offers two difficulty levels and two main gameplay modes: mini-games and a form of "story mode." In the latter, Reksio teams up with "The Cat" to rescue missing animals from the grasp of "The Wolf." This mode is endless, featuring elementary-level math mini-games along with some integrated puzzle elements.

title: Dawn of the Abyss
description: 《Dawn of the Abyss》 is an action adventure game based around deep sea exploration. A lone girl dives through the ocean, discovering fragments of civilization, giant creatures, and a strange pulse rising from the abyss. Despite these dangers duty urges the girl to dive deeper down.

title: Flappy Harpy Daddy
description: Control a nearly-naked man flapping giant fans to fly through tough 3D stages! Click left/right to flap each arm. Run out of stamina and you'll fall helplessly! Streaming, Let’s Plays, and monetization are fully welcome!

title: Riseon
description: Riseon is an ultra-challenging jumping action game where the protagonist, trapped deep underground, leaps and climbs toward the open sky! With simple controls but extreme difficulty, every jump tests your skill and patience. Can you overcome the brutal challenge and reach the top?

title: Crit Happens!
description: Take a chance and roll the dice in Crit Happens! a Dice-Building, Turn-Based Roguelike – Know when to roll and when to hold to increase your attack and defeat powerful enemies. Craft your dice and seek out magical trinkets and powerful relics that will change the way you play!

title: Bolt & Wahlington
description: Bolt&Whalington is a Metroidvania game where you play as Bolt, a Siamese cat exploring the floating ruins of Whalington. Reshape abilities and rewrite world rules with the "Setting Machine," switch mecha forms to craft weapons, battle enemies, and uncover the secret of Whalington.

title: CoRoT
description: CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror game. Search for cassettes in a transforming house, unraveling its macabre past. A sinister atmosphere surrounds you as you try to understand what's happening and where you really are. Can you discover the truth hidden in its walls?

title: Eternal Exile: Beneath the Darkness
description: A dark fantasy shooter where the dead know no rest. Journey through nightmarish dimensions where survival hinges on magic and firepower. Every upgrade, spell, and choice leads to salvation or demise. Uncover the truth… or let it consume you.

title: Shape Sender Deluxe
description: Solve physics puzzles with magnets, springs, portals, fans, and more while your new best friend Sendy helps you along the way! But maybe keep an eye on him, he's been acting a little … strange, lately.

title: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
description: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

title: Mannequin Syndrome
description: Investigate mannequin-controlled zones, perform rituals, and survive encounters with corrupted AI entities. Mannequin Syndrome is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror game where every move counts. Explore, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

title: Isles of Sea and Sky: Mysterious Update
description:
For puzzle novices and experts: Isles of Sea and Sky is designed for all skill levels making sure there’s plenty to do, collect, and challenge yourself with if you’re a puzzle expert, but that the game is also approachable for puzzling beginners.
- Immerse yourself in a serene, vibrant world: This vibrant, retro, and atmospheric environment is captivating and offers a chill and ambient soundtrack for deeper gameplay immersion
- Uncover a rich, meaningful story: Isles of Sea and Sky tells a meaningful and memorable story utilizing only images and no text.
- Discover hidden secrets: The game is chock full of hidden items and areas. Getting 100% completion rate is no easy task!

title: PowerWash Simulator: Muckingham Files - Part 6
description: The Muckingham Files is a series of free Bonus Job updates that take you to never-before-seen places from the original universe of PowerWash Simulator, with new characters, locations and stories. Get to know more about your stomping ground and its inhabitants as the most in-demand power washer in town.

title: Strawberry Smoothie
description: You will see cake and dolphins in this sprawling sci-fi city full of noise and activity. You can find portals and stop in them to go to mini-games, most of which require mouse controls and the other stragglers require arrow key control.

title: Pixelands
description:
Pixelands is a 2D MMO sandbox where players can fish, farm, trade, and socialize in a player-driven world. Build and connect with others, grind quests, and have fun!
To play Pixelands, Join the Discord or Download through Itch.io!
