title: Graynold Runner
description: A short shoot 'em up looking game based on atmosphere. I'm not sure how much fun it is, but I was happy with how it felt. I guess it's more like an interactive screensaver type game, one of them types.

title: Dirt Stooge
description: A dull platform shooting game, inspired by the out of bounds background landscapes in other games. I wanted the game to be generally basic and empty, but also tried to make it feel substantial with the audio and visual style.

title: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
description: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

title: Gorilla Vs 100 Men
description: Can one gorilla beat 100 men? Step in, start swinging, and find out. Play as a gorilla in a chaotic ragdoll brawler where you punch, pummel, and try to survive. Go for 100 or push yourself in unlimited mode and see how long you last.

title: Coloring Voxels
description: Bring vibrant worlds to life block by block! This revolutionary blend of Voxel Art and Color-by-Numbers lets you build stunning 3D dioramas from the ground up. As the second entry in ToastieLabs's Coloring genre, this game evolves the relaxing joy of 2D coloring into an immersive 3D experience!

title: Akuma's Bloodrain
description: Blow up hordes of akumas/yokais that are attacking this small japanese village. Shoot, slash, dash, and climb your way through the end of this battle!

title: The Bagman
description: The bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCS, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

title: Swann's Song
description: A boy and an old man stand in front a pond, waiting for a swan's song. Meanwhile, they talk about life, death, and the passage of time.

title: Temne
description: Explore the landscape of the area, search for unique things in this place that can help you find your way out of here and don't die... because this is an adventure into the unknown and who knows what lies up ahead

title: Guard Break
description: A tribute to the golden era of '90s 3D JRPGs. Explore diverse environments, strengthen your party, and battle ruthless foes as you unravel the secrets behind a mysterious threat.

title: SCP: Control Error
description: SCP: CONTROL ERROR is a short psychological horror game where you take part in a live experiment inside a restricted underground facility. The test begins. You're observed.

title: Project BS
description: Project BS is a 3D action RPG that explores a fantasy world. Take on a journey with Sienna, a dragonewt girl, and fight against formidable opponents and rivals.

title: Cloud Storage Botanical Station
description:
Created in a week for the DiscMaster Jam
All assets used are vintage data hosted on the Internet Archive, sourced with the DiscMaster Search Engine.

title: Infinite Alliance
description: Heroes and villains from 13+ Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

title: Blitzstrike
description: Blitzstrike is a fast-paced 2D action-platformer where a pink-haired bounty hunter blazes through waves of robotic enemies with style and fury.

title: Grinville
description: An abandoned park, a forgotten tragedy, and something that should never have been awakened. Years ago, a charming parade turned into a massacre when the animatronics, created to entertain, brutally attacked the audience. Now, you return to this cursed place to uncover the truth. But beware... they are still here, waiting.

title: Third-person Shooter and Platform Jumping and Level-based Adventure
description: An adventure game that combines third person shooter and platform jumping to pass levels

title: Beyond Enemy Lines: Vietnam
description: Take the role of a U.S. Special Forces soldier crashed into the vietnamese jungle on the return of a top secret mission. Adapt to jungle warfare, make your tactics and survive!

title: Dry Bones
description: A mysterious momentum based platformer! Easy to learn hard to master mechanics like wallrunning swinging and even riding a on magical broom! Exchange your head for weird powerups and collect all Skeleton Coins!

title: Aquariums
description: Aquariums is a liminal space horror adventure with elements of thalassophobia and poolrooms. You find yourself in a mysterious facility full of oversized Aquariums and Sea Life. Navigate the flooded rooms to find out the secret behind this sinister place.

title: The Trolley Solution
description: The Trolley Solution is a compilation of point-and-click minigames based on the famous thought experiment originally proposed by Philippa Foot.

title: The Waning of ShadyVale
description: Choose your path: play as Detective Mick, determined to uncover the town’s buried secrets, or survive as Alex, focused only on escaping the horror with their life intact. Make Items, solve puzzles, choose to save or abandon the people of this town. Whatever it takes to see the end of this nightmare.

title: Zerium War: Destiny
description: Battle through waves of invaders in Zerium War: Destiny, a sci-fi Roguelite RPG. As Earth's core guardian, wield auto-shooting skills to grow stronger. Face random challenges and gear up for each victory.

title: NikNaks
description: A Groundbreaking Roguelike Creature Collector. Niknaks, is a deceptively DEEP turn based RPG where your inventory IS your team. Recruit, collect and upgrade a team of ancient relics, in this unique HIGH-OCTANE PVP/PVE adventure!

title: Circle Empires 2
description: CIRCLE EMPIRES returns! Expand your empire, circle by circle, in this fast-paced follow-up to the hit RTS. Gather resources, build armies, and defeat bosses (or your friends) in a world that changes with every game. With unique units and biomes, it's an addictive battle of wits and tactics.

title: Gate Project
description: Gate Project is a party-based, single-player, sci-fi action-adventure - where RPG meet tactical RTS: Lead humanity's space gate travel expeditions, survey alien planets and locations, find artifacts and superior technology, make contact with friendly and hostile civilizations...

title: Test Dummy Takedown
description: Step into Test Dummy Takedown, an action-packed game where you play as an armed crash test dummy. Battle 2 to 8 players in arenas, collect random special powers, and be the last one standing. A fun and frantic game for exciting sessions with friends!

title: Cinderia
description: "Cinderia" is a 2.5D action roguelite game that focuses on the possibilities of combat combinations. Combine their active and passive skills and relics to challenge formidable enemies ranging from the Black Knight to the Evil Mage.

title: Colony X
description: Colony X is a multiplayer space horror game. One player takes on the role of a Xeon, a creature capable of walking on any surface. The other players (2-4) play as colonists, either trying to escape or hunt down the Xeon.

title: Digi-Doll
description: A relaxing dollhouse decorating simulator featuring text-based discovery. Use the retro DIGI-DOLL console to explore the attic, where choice matters! Unlock various dollhouses, befriend characters, and uncover stunning furnishings as you design and decorate with flair!

title: Danger World
description: Explore an epic fantasy world alongside three heroes on a quest to recover a stolen jewel. Guide your party to victory in turn-based battles, make decisions that will determine the events of the story, and uncover the ancient secrets of Eldora as you race to catch the mechanical thief.

title: GalanWarSong
description: A hardcore turn-based strategy game based on chess and with RPG elements. Players will play the role of the "Legendary King" Bordo Dia, summon former mercenary partners, go to Galan Castle, defeat the sin dragon, and save the world.

title: Arcade Archives: Super World Court
description:
"SUPER WORLD COURT" is a sports game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1993.
It is the sequence to "PRO TENNIS WORLD COURT" and adds support for 4-player simultaneous games.
Featuring a roster of numerous distinctive players with their own specialties, this is your chance to pick your favorite and win your way through tournaments!

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Ansan-si
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Siheung-si
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Uiwang-si
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Road to Olympus
description: You have no destination, only the path.

title: Special Strike
description: Nintendo Switch Exclusive! Survive on photorealistic grey sand dunes in your tanks. Join forces with allies to dominate epic battles and claim victory.

title: Squat Life
description: A game that keeps you motivated to do squats, a fun and highly effective exercise, every day

title: Supershot: Valley Warfare Defense
description: Lock. Aim. Defend the valley in style!

title: The Adventures of Lia and the Celestial Compass
description: Join Lia on a magical adventure across floating islands with her enchanted compass, new friends, and evil pirates in her way!

title: They Came for More Pasta
description:
"When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice!"

You're a food delivery guy in this short, comical graphic adventure, determined to stop the monopoly on italian cousine imposed by an alien invasion.

title: The Wizard of Bug
description: Unravel the labyrinth's mysteries with your wits as your weapon! A novel and stimulating brain-bending puzzle adventure!

title: The Lost Garden
description: A group of brave insects embark on an adventure to restore peace to the Lost Garden, now ruled by the Spider Queen.

title: Rune Dice
description: Throw dice, create explosive chain reactions, and defeat waves of enemies in Rune Dice! Collect ancient runes with diverse abilities, add synergies between relics, heroes, and special dice. All combined, this will give you an excellent experience in our roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Yabai Girls: Graceful Girlfriend
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: AnimalDon!
description: Save the Species! Escape Earth Before the Meteor Strikes!

title: Bag Hero
description: Blast through monster hordes with crazy weapons in a wild bullet hell! It’s chaotic, casual, and seriously fun!

title: Balavour
description: Short indie horror game, featuring body horror and a sad and creepy story.

title: Cyber Love Story
description: Reveal the secrets and find out who you can really trust!

title: Date with Devils
description: Being the Lord of Hell is hard. One minute you're judging souls, the next you're speed-dating devils and writing love poems to angels.

title: Digging a Hole: Gold Fever
description: Gold, secrets, and a lot of dirt.

title: Eggconsole Mugen no Shinzou PC-8801
description: Having blasphemed against the gods at the moment of death, the protagonist is cast into the terrifying Mugen Realm. Now, the journey to escape from the Realm begin

title: Fairy Whale
description: Fairy Whale — fairy tales that help a child grow

title: Find It! Brain Training Challenge
description: Spot the Difference! A quick and easy brain game where just one thing is out of place.

title: Ninja Revenger
description: Arcade-style top-down 2D action game. Sacrifice energy as you defeat foes and carve your path forward. As you take risks, adrenaline surges, unleashing Berserk. Keep fighting for revenge as the Cyber Ninja.

title: Anode Heart 2
description: A dungeon crawler creature collector RPG, set in a digital, futuristic environment, with fast-paced combat and 150+ Tama creatures to befriend and raise into lovable monstrosities.

title: Play & Learn Kids' Mini-Game Collection
description: Includes Three Games to Boost Thinking and Learning! A fun and educational mini-game collection for both kids and adults!

title: Cryken Part3
description: Get the crystals!! Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players! 30 stages in total. Normal and hard difficulty levels!

title: Korovany
description: KOROVANY is like a “game of dreams” set in a vacuum. It offers everything from driving a badass vehicle and shooting action to tank battles, medieval RPG elements, and even some space features. And the cherry on top? You can actually rob caravans in this game.

title: Tobot: Action Quiz Heroes
description: Solve Quizzes to Protect Daedo with TOBOT!

title: HoloParade: Deluxe Edition
description: A lively parade with hololive VTubers and mascot characters!

title: Candivity: Under Water DLC
description: Merge coins together and get the biggest treasure under the sea!

title: Hole io: Apocalypse DLC
description: Wear doomsday skins and visit the new Apocalypse map with your friends!

title: Kingdom Rush Vengeance: Pirate Kings Campaign
No Mosaic Girls With Sess-AI 2.0
description: Break Mosaic to Save the Girls! Simulation RPG by Great Think Program!

title: Monster Train Collection
description: This bundle includes Monster Train First Class and Monster Train 2. Monster Train First Class Monster Train First Class is a strategic roguelike deck building game with a twist.

title: Ricochlime
description: Ricochlime is a game where you attack the advancing monsters with your ricocheting projectiles. The game is made with the Flame game engine and Flutter.

title: Pokermon
description: Pokermon is a full content mod for Balatro, adding content based on Pokemon. There are now 250+ Jokers that have been added alongside many other custom additions. There is also an option to only play with Pokemon Jokers if you want to focus on the new content. (Option defaults to off)

title: Ed & Edda: Grand Prix – Racing Champions
description: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fun racing game for the whole family that brings the famous mascots of the Europa-Park to life. Players can - either alone or with their friends - race through several European landmarks to find out who is the fastest!

title: Hordelord
description: Hordelord is a hi-octane arena mobility shooter (horde & endless modes) where you face waves of nasty enemies. Armed with powerful weapons and high-mobility skills, zip around and fight to achieve the highest score on global leaderboards. Hordelord sports tight gunplay, satisfying kills, and meaningful upgrades.

title: Homehead
description:
you are homehead
you live in a home that looks like your head
but you are not weird

title: Gnaughty Gnomes
description: Crush your friends in combat by embodying these adorable yet Gnaughty Gnomes! Throw everything you find along the way, choose cards to upgrade your build, change the rules of the game... whatever it takes to win.

title: Ball x Pit
description: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite where you battle hordes of monstrous enemies with your arsenal of ricocheting balls.

title: Clown Camp
description: First-Person Survival Horror, 90’s style. Hostile clowns lurk the woods. Fight-or-flight to uncover their gruesome secrets throughout a chilling Single-Player Story. Clever inventory management and resourcefulness are your only hopes to escape the Summer of 1999 alive.

title: Garden & Bird
description: GARDEN & BIRD is a 2D game where players can create their own unique garden in a sandbox environment by bringing birds to a deserted island, which then turns it into a garden.

title: Puffin Parcel Post
description: Puffin Parcel Post is a charming roguelite strategy game where players build and manage postal networks using adorable puffin workers. The game combines base-building mechanics with logistics optimization and strategic placement of buildings. Each playthrough offers fresh challenges through unlockable perks and upgrades that change how you approach building your postal empire. Players construct delivery routes, manage resources, and watch their cute puffin team waddle and zip across the map delivering parcels.

title: Supercat Survivors: Meow or Die
description: Meow! This is a cat-themed Survivor-like game where you control an adorable Supercat! Battle monsters to level up, collect items, upgrade weapons, and experiment with strategic builds to fight off invading creatures threatening Meow Star.

title: CragEx-5
description:
You're stationed on a moon far from Earth for 50 days. Use drones to perform work cycles at substations, gathering and managing resources to spend on crafting, tasks, and upgrades to make getting resources more efficient while also selling what you collect to perform research and meet day end requirements, all while managing your energy. And throughout all this, you aren’t alone…

It's intended to be played blind. Every death gives you a hint on how to avoid meeting the same fate next time, but there is an in-game encyclopedia giving information on all anomalies and an overview of the game mechanics that you can read any time.

title: Stray Tekirs
description: Simple, minimal, and sometimes challenging hidden object game where you search for cats hidden in abstract city maps

title: Emergency Lüdenscheid
description: Emergency Lüdenscheid is a modification of the computer game Emergency 5. Experience the fictitious Lüdenscheid fire brigade as the incident commander in a variety of operations that are modelled on real life. Whether fires, accidents or disasters. Your decisions determine success or failure.

title: Fishing Up
description: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

title: Toad's Trees
description: After Toad's appearance in the 1994 NES/SNES classic "Wario's Woods", he has more challenges to complete in this block-type puzzle game! See if you can push, pull and climb your way to the top of these unique levels!

title: Bossfight Tactics
description: A cute and approachable turn-based tactics roguelike, where you become the Bossfight if you win.

title: Nigredo
description: Expand your base by building new rooms, recruiting workers, and assigning them to key workstations. Can your society overcome the forces of Nigredo? Time is of the essence.

title: Pilgrim of Darkness
description: Explore a dark fantasy world, collect crystals, perform rituals, and survive demons before fear consumes you. Survive in the dark where fear makes you visible to demons. Rituals, upgrades, bosses—every step could be your last.

title: Evolit
description: Take charge of the galaxy's defense! With strategic moves, stop waves of cute yet dangerous enemies and prevent them from reaching the end of the road. Enhance your tactics with a variety of cards and unique towers, and stand against Evo! Strategy and infinity await here.

title: The Tower of Eden
description: A roguelite where you play as Izaak, a man with a unique curse on a quest to take down the Astrian King and his court. Become adept at using different weapons and strategies as you battle your way past the closest of the king’s advisors to his chambers.

title: Doorka
description: A dynamic first-person shooter without guns, but with unique mechanics of knocking down and kicking doors in the air, on the ground and in doorways with style.

title: Neon Eclipse: Dominium
description: “Neon Eclipse: Dominium” is a 2D cyberpunk metroidvania where you play as a ninja fighting against mega-corporations. Choose between 2 heroes, use genetic, cybernetic or traditional abilities. Explore interconnected worlds, unlock skills, produce weapons and face biomechanical bosses.

title: Madness of the Science
description: Survive the explosion in the laboratory, prevent the spread of artificial intelligence robots that see us as enemies to the outside world. Get power from past scientists by making improvements from the skill tree. Enjoy science!

title: Fishing Pond Simulator
description: Lucky Scratcher is a scratch-off game with light Rogue elements. You are invited by the mysterious organization "Lucky Club," where anything is possible—provided you can prove yourself favored by the Goddess of Luck. (This game contains no gambling elements.)

title: Juicy Blast
description: Juicy Blast is a game that combines deck-building and bullet hell shooting. Players will build a deck of cards that automatically cycles and plays during battle, summon minions, and utilize the power of relics to take on endless juice-filled bubbles.

title: Galactic Veins
description: Galactic Veins is a groundbreaking survival RPG that seamlessly blends action and RTS. Lost in an uncharted galaxy, you'll explore hostile regions filled with danger and mystery. Harvest resources, salvage technologies, and uncover the secrets of the universe as you fight to find your way back home.

title: Hide 'n Heist
description: 4 Thieves vs. 1 Guardian! A medieval heist game! Play as a thief, disguise yourself among the crowd, and steal the treasure, or take on the role of the guardian and hunt down the thieves! Everyone has a unique role and strategy. Find the right approach and lead your team to victory!

title: Isekat: Crushed by a Computer, My Beloved Kitten is Transported to a Fantasy World where its Typing Skills Save the Kingdom!
description: A typing game where you play the role of an unfortunate kitten from our world who unexpectedly dies and wakes up in a fantasy world of swords, magic and anthromorphic animal people!

title: DanceMela
description:
Get danceMELA, India's first Multiplayer Online Dancing Game. Dance with people from all over India while enjoying the latest Bollywood hits. Create your very own character, choose what they wear right from the hairstyle to the type of shoes. Meet, greet and chat with other players using the in-game Chat tool.

danceMELA is easy to learn, fun to play and the best way to make new friends online. Get In, Get Dancing!

title: AutoParts Simulator
description: AutoParts Simulator puts you in charge of an auto parts store, where every decision you make influences your success. Manage inventory, expand the product range in your warehouse, serve customers and grow your business. Conquer the automotive market with strategy and efficiency!

title: Nymphomania Priestess
description: In this RPG, you play as an adventurer who is paired with a priestess who is modest and ladylike in public, but in private she is a nymphomaniac.

title: Dark Erosion: Endless Siege
description: blends classic RPG progression with roguelike survival mechanics, drawing inspiration from iconic games like Diablo and Path of Exile. Level up, collect gems to enhance your stats, and grow stronger to face escalating challenges. The journey of redemption awaits!

title: Black Hole Fishing
description: Black hole fishing is a completely normal incremental game about fishing. Don't expect to stock the pond with genetically modified fish, discover an infinite cavern full of ponds to consume, or destroy the entire planet by feeding infinite fish to a singularity. Honestly, it's just a fishing game.

title: PC Store Simulator
description: Run your own PC Store! Repair broken computers, buy computer parts, sell products and upgrade your store!

title: Tower of Trample
description: A game about saving all of your friends in the tower from evil villainesses who will stop at nothing to dominate and subjugate all of them (including you) to their oppression. They use femdom-oriented wrestling moves and other attacks to get you to submit, but to climb the tower, you must beat them in combat!

title: Out of the Park Baseball 2007
description: OOTP Baseball 2007 features some user interface improvements that make the game easier and more enjoyable, including: a league creation wizard, a simplified navigation model with intuitive icons, a detailed in-game help system, improved in-game screens, and manager and online league commissioner "portals" that centralize the most commonly-used tasks.

title: Monochromality
description: Monochromality is a multiplayer backrooms horror game, with 10+ levels that can be explored by yourself or in teams of up to 6 explorers. Evade threats, solve puzzles, experience memories and find a way to escape before something "unwarranted" finds you.

title: Dungeon With Girl
description: Conquer dungeons and flirt with girls in this roguelite RPG! You'll need wisdom, courage, and luck to traverse these mysterious depths and secure the best ending for you and your unexpected travel companion Monica.

title: Rock Quest: A Rhythm Adventure
description: Rock Quest: A Rhythm Adventure is a hybrid rhythm-action RPG where battles play out as high-stakes musical showdowns. Hit notes in time to attack, miss and take damage. Lead your rock band through a weird New Orleans teeming with danger and mystery.

title: Food Cart Simulator
description: Cook, hustle, and rise in Food Cart Simulator! Start with a humble food cart, serve up delicious meals, and upgrade your gear to expand. Manage loans, buy supplies, and survive the streets — but be careful who you borrow from! Can you build your street food empire?

title: Don't Fool Me, Beauties!
description: "Get out!!!" Kicked out in the dead of winter, you land a job at a shady hotel. But work’s not the only challenge, there’s the CEO’s cold-hearted granddaughter, a lazy senior, a diva model, and your childhood friend who makes you do her laundry?! Who will you charm in this chaotic love game?

title: Dicey Heroes
description: Dicey Heroes is a Monopoly-based roguelike deck-building casual game. Actions such as attack, reinforcement, and defense are determined according to the squares stopped by rolling dice. Units have only one parameter, a number. The objective of the game is to strengthen this number. Simple, isn't it?

title: Human Heritage
description: A time-travel Adventure RPG where your choices shape the past. Step into the shoes of Ethan, a modern archaeologist, as you unravel ancient mysteries, aid legendary heroes, and stop history from falling apart. Fight, explore, and rewrite fate—because one wrong move could fracture time forever.

title: Tankiro
description: Tankiro is a Souls-like action game with a heavy focus on parrying. Play as a tank and battle alien forces on the ground and in space to defend Earth.

title: The Book of Plagues
description: In a city plagued by a deadly plague, you are the last hope for salvation! You are the Plague Doctor, a mysterious and determined healer whose job it is to stop disease, save lives, and restore order to the city...

title: Cleave
description: A relentless boomer shooter where you shoot and Cleave your way through hordes of twisted creatures, corrupted knights, and eldritch horrors. Master fast-paced combat, chain devastating attacks to push back the encroaching darkness in this adrenaline-fueled homage to the shooters of the '90s.

title: Wuthering Waves: Lightly We Toss the Crown
description:
Version 2.4 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Cartethyia and Lupa
• New areas: Septimont
• New story quests
• New outfits for Chagnli and Carlotta
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Journey of the Garden Rose
description: Lily must explore a fantastic palace and contest with the machinations of a cruel prince to rescue her mother in this Old-School 3D Action-Adventure game!

title: Unboxathon
description: Unboxathon is a cute content-packed incremental game about opening mystery boxes. Find rare items, upgrade your skills, and unlock new boxes & features! Collect shiny items, pop bubble wrap, and materialize artifacts out of thin air. Can you find your lost childhood plush?

title: 9 Trials of Whiskers
description: 9 Trials of Whiskers is a cute 3D precision platformer! Run, jump, and dodge hazards as you race through 9 mystical Trials. Play on Very Easy Difficulty for a relaxed climb or push your limits on Hard. Compete against ghost runs to master every challenge!

title: RitualRX
description: RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-filled shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.

title: Peskit
description: A unique roguelike deckbuilder: grab sushi from the conveyor belt, build boxes, and trigger powerful combos with sauces and dominos.

title: Cargo Simulator
description: Manage your own warehouse. Fit and pack products into boxes of the right size. Deliver them to the correct addresses—safely and on time. Hire staff, train them, and speed up your operations. Partner with brands to expand your warehouse and grow your logistics network by purchasing more vehicles.

title: My Esports Club
description: Build and Manage Your Professional Esports Team – Rise to Glory! Start from scratch and lead your team to the top! Recruit players, devise strategies, and face challenges like financial crises and player departures. Will you achieve championship glory, or find true love?

title: Rogumon
description: Battle, collect and upgrade dozens of Rogumon in this creature-collecting roguelite. Unique items, moves, and abilities ensure that no two attempts will be the same. Enter the fray alongside your team as you together seek to escape from the eternal prison of Torment.

title: My Mom's Bestfriend!
description: "My Mom's Bestfriend!" is a visual novel that follows the story of a young college student returning to his hometown after finishing the semester. The protagonist is excited to reunite with his mother and catch up on all the missed moments. However, a surprising twist awaits as the protagonist's childhood crush, Hanna, who is also his mother's best friend, makes an unexpected visit.​

title: Etiquette Elegance
description: Welcome to Etiquette Elegance – a stylish and atmospheric waiter simulator set in a retro-futuristic restaurant! Your task is to flawlessly set the tables, taking into account all the intricacies of restaurant etiquette and the unique preferences of your guests.

title: Sega Football Club Champions
description:
SEGA Football Club Champions is the latest multiplatform football management simulator from SEGA! Play for free!
Start off with a small club competing locally, and aim to take on the world

title: Death of a Dungslinger
description: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

title: Oiia The Game
description: Play as the oiia cat and Wreak havoc. You have a city to A.

title: Compress(Space)
description: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

title: Triumvora
description: Triumvora is an Indie Action RPG with Survival, Roguelite and Hack 'n Slash elements, set in a surreal world of plants and concrete.

title: Card'em All!
description: Trapped in ages-long slumber, fight trough timelines of nightmares to defeat your fears and assemble a mighty deck to face your ultimate challenge and finally awake! Surviving through each defeat, your deck grows stronger and stronger, bringing you one step closer to victory.

title: Avalone's Adventurers: My Parents were Assassinated so I've Started an Adventuring Party to Avoid a Political Marriage
description: Marianne Avalone just inherited her parent's adventuring business, but she's not suited to adventuring! It's time to sort through the party applications, hire the best, and assign them to profitable quests. She needs to earn gold quickly to cancel her engagement to the duke's son!

title: Pan's Permia
description: Pan's Permia is a planetary city builder survival game, with intricate building mechanics, villager survival, in depth army combat, and tower defense mechanics!

title: Ministry of Truth: False Memory
description: Ministry of Truth: False Memory is a story-driven simulator in a totalitarian society. Become an official, manipulate facts, rewrite history, and provide the ‘truth’ to the public. Choose: obey or fight against the regime. The Great Father is watching you!

title: Bogos Binted?
description: Welcome to a sinful night with the wackiest aliens in the galaxy! In this online game for 2-4 players, you'll engage in various tabletop games, devise brilliant strategies, lie, and do whatever it takes to outplay your opponents. Didn't work out? Well, then your head is going to explode.

title: GrimGraves
description: Run away from the monsters and solve puzzles along the way in this pixelated running-fest, also wish you never meet the red man any time soon.

title: The Heaven
description: The Heaven is a game about Jungwoo Yom's struggle with the South Korean education system.

title: Aquasplendere
description: Nothing is greater than Aquasplendere, and we hear his voices. His blood flows through our world. Embody the descendants of the Great Deaf lineage and lead the epic journey of our civilization.

title: Tracing
description:
A Game by Jungwoo Yom.
Tracing is a game about saving human knowledge. The government is trying to incinerate invaluable materials in order to extend their period of power. You and your team have to save those materials and copy them to optical discs.

title: Drawn Tale
description: After taking a life, a boy is killed and awakens in a twisted, nightmarish Purgatory. Explore a world of horror, solve eerie puzzles, evade lurking monsters, and fight to keep your soul intact before it’s devoured by the Void.

title: Broken Prism
description: 本作为百合向视觉系恋爱游戏，围绕着黑色海洋探索世界的秘密，出场人物均为女性

title: Space Wombat
description:
Space Wombat is a 3D platformer that follows the adventures of the eponymous spacesuit-wearing bipedal wombat. Space Wombat is heading home to Planet Ucliptus when his spaceship receives a distress call from a nearby planet. While landing to investigate, Space Wombat damages his ship; to make matters worse, his cargo—a shipment of the valuable Power Gumnuts—is seized by the evil WomBots, whose ploy it was to lure him to their base. Now, Space Wombat must recover his stolen cargo, repair his ship, and escape.

Gameplay mostly consists of collecting Power Gumnuts while jumping on crates, avoiding obstacles, and dealing with WomBots, some of which can be destroyed while others can only be temporarily disabled. There is a boss fight after every five levels, as well as a bonus level that can be unlocked by collecting the letters "W," "O," "M," "B," "A," and "T," which are strewn around the levels.

Running on Macromedia Shockwave, Space Wombat was originally released as an ad-supported browser-playable game, but was later made available as a paid downloadable version.

title: Bittersweet Blossoms
description: A lesbian romance set in England shortly after WWI. The story centres around Dot, a young maid who begins to work in the crumbling stately home of Bly, and her young mistress: the devious, devilish Patience.

title: Capybara's Happytime
description: Build Your Dream Resort with Furry Friends! Team up with adorable animal buddies to create a one-of-a-kind vacation paradise! Attract all kinds of capybaras to chill, expand your resort, and grow it into a thriving empire.

title: Gelecard: Guerreiros Gelatinosos
description: Gelecard: Gelatinous Warriors is a fun card game featuring the adorable SLIMES! These cute little creatures are ready to wreak havoc on the game boards.

title: Shattered Divinities
description: In Shattered Divinities, embark on an adventure that pits you directly against divinity itself! An ancient War of Gods shattered the world, and their broken power has become the Calamities that consume all life. How will you survive in this land? And how will you uncover the secrets behind the War?

title: Die Die Die
description: The puzzle game for people who like dice... and want to stop. Roll your way around a sprawling, non-linear map solving ever-more perplexing puzzles! Discover dozens of unique puzzle mechanics! Collect dice! Just... maybe don't play it on a laptop near a window if you own either of them...

title: Spaceship Down
description: In Spaceship Down, you’re Noah, a stranded tech patching up a crashed spaceship with whatever you can find. With only a sarcastic narrator and a perky AI for company, survival means thinking fast and jury-rigging your way out of a bad situation. Think you’re up for it?

title: Bad 4 Business
description: Run a small business in a tough town, with 90's vibes in top down and 3rd person. Protect your cash. Drive and deliver your goods. Discover the needs and wants of your customers then craft some 'hot' new products. Decisions matter, play on the shady side or be the business person of the year.

title: American Cars 'n Guns
description: Burn some tires and pull the trigger! Just drive, drive, and shoot, shoot! In beautiful cars inspired by powerful American muscle cars! Race with friends in split screen or LAN/online mode. Reproduce races from various angles and playspeed and create memorable videos.

title: Victor's Test Night: Reves
description: Victor’s Test: a trial of supernatural resistance. Guard the museum at night, spot artifact anomalies, and adapt as doors shift—triggering or erasing them. Welcome to Victor’s Test Night: Rêves.

title: Erz Online
description: ERZ Online is a futuristic MMO sandbox where you command mining robots, explore procedural planets, and build underground bases. Automate tasks with programming, trade in a player-driven economy, and shape the world through alliances, politics, and competition. Your mining empire awaits!

title: Goldfish
description: Embark on a delirious journey in this metroidvania set on a pirate island where all the characters are sea animals.

title: Make My Car
description: Make My Car - will take you into the automotive world. Starting in a small, old factory, you are given a golden opportunity to become a part of somethin big. Sell cars, expand your factory, hire staff, and develop innovative models to dominate the automotive market.

title: Attack on Steel
description: "Attack of Steel" is a mecha battle game from a third-person perspective. When you pilot an advanced mecha to fight the enemy, you not only be familiar with all weapons, but also need to adapt to the skills of aerial combat and effectively destroy the limbs of the enemy mecha to win more easily.

title: Cardburners
description: CardBurners is a chaotic fast-paced solo or online versus card game. You must play you cards quickly before they burn in your hand! Mix and match completely different sets of cards and rules to create unique action packed games,

title: White Cat Stories
description: "White Cat Stories" is a 2D platformer game. In this game, players take on the role of brave knight on a journey that is both dangerous and magical. Our protagonist is a fallen knight, in order to find her purpose in life, she embarks on a journey.

title: Shovelware
description: Dig your way to the bottom in one hundred levels of block digging mayhem. Avoid TNT, collect gems, save kittens, collect potatoes and more in this colourful fun filled game.

title: Dead Reset
description: Trapped in a terrifying death-loop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

title: Riftopia
description: We are a community battle game with a focus on growth and engagement on live service platforms!

title: Scott Whiskers: The Search for the Golden Cat
description: Join Scott Whiskers on his new adventure and plunge into a colorful and family-friendly experience in a class of its own! Sun, beach and sea - sunken pirate treasures, mystical Mayan rites, a bubbling volcano - and lots of puzzles and lovable characters make for the vacation of a lifetime!

title: Heirs of Heaven
description: Heirs of Heaven is a story-driven post-apocalyptic adventure about a young boy searching for his missing father in a world consumed by infection. The virus, created in a failed scientific pursuit of immortality, has turned humanity into the very thing it feared most the undead. As the boy ventures through the ruins of civilization, he unravels the dark truth behind the outbreak and humanity’s fatal desire to defy death.

title: Aatral Origins
description: In 2nd-century Korkai, prince Vallaan rises as king after his father's death in battle. As unknown mythical creatures devastate his land, Vallaan embarks on a quest to uncover the dark force behind the chaos, facing monstrous demons to avenge his people and restore peace.

title: Knight Lobster
description: You will lose everything. You will gain everything. This world will reach peace, At any cost. You must reach the top. You must reach the top. This world will reach peace, at any cost. You must reach the top. You must reach the top. This world will reach peace, at any cost.You must reach the top.

title: Ved: Journey Beyond the Cube
description: Ved is trapped in a strange world, transformed into a cube. Solve puzzles, unlock hidden powers, and explore a shifting reality to find a way back home.

title: Redcrest: 1993
description: Fourteen years ago, a murder occurred in the town of Redcrest. You must deal with the consequences. Working at an arcade, a new game seems to enthrall you with its not so fictional depictions of horror, becoming more and more terrifying each day.

title: Cottonville
description: Create, farm, and style in Cottonville - a cozy dress-up game with farming and sim mechanics!

title: Banisher
description: Banisher is a single player horror ghost hunting game where the player completes tasks to weaken a demon and then attempt to destroy the demon. However, evil cannot be destroyed so easily!

title: My Mates
description: It's a mix of a visual novel, RPG, and mini-games. You'll dive into student life, with all its challenges and new acquaintances. Your choices will determine not only your academic success but also the relationships you build.

title: SpaceHack: Eden
description: A roguelike, deck-building, and team-building space adventure! Play as Bandit Carl, a space pirate captain trapped in the Eden reality show simulator. Recruit crew members, upgrade your ship, and battle alongside your team across uniquely styled universes.

title: That Time I Got Trapped in an Office Dungeon
description: Explore a unique 2nd-person horror puzzle adventure in the corporate world that will put your spatial reasoning to the test. How far are you willing to go to for a job? We're a family here after all.

title: Project Fiend
description: Project Fiend is a first person horror game where you must solve puzzles to gain key items to unlock new areas. Inspired by other horror games of the same genre as well as horror films.

title: Gamba Gun
description: Gamba Gun is the idiotic fusion of top-down shooter and deck building rogue-likes. Experiment with endless ammo combinations, and create powerful synergies to fight against a colorful cast of enemies.

title: SwooshCat
description: 《SwooshCat》is a vibrant precision platform adventure game. Through jumping, dashing, slashing, downward strikes, rolling, and bouncing, help the little cat “Tangyuan” explore, fight, and make new friends in the cute pixel-art world!

title: Bad Janitor
description: Play undercover as a janitor with the objective of getting tenants to move out by discreetly annoying them, so the buildings can be torn down and get rebuilt into office complexes by your actual employer, CityGrind Corp. You must also perform basic janitorial duties to keep your job and cover.

title: Under Kingdom: Scam Centre Simulator
description: Run your own scam centre and pay off your debt. Expand your business by recruiting workers through shady means. Bribe the police, trade with others, and use every strategy to survive in this city. Will you rise to power or fall under the pressure? The choice is yours.

title: Space War Economy Idle
description: A story-driven incremental game with idle and auto-battler mechanics, inspired by Factorio logistics, Path of Exile itemization, and Eve Online's economy

title: Knob
description: Dive into an exciting 3D platforming adventure! Overcome tricky obstacles, solve creative puzzles, and defeat mechanical enemies. Master the unique movement of your ball-shaped hero and discover a world full of surprises

title: Chambers & Crops
description: Farm, fish, build, and craft in the casual aboveground area, or dive into dungeon levels to battle enemies in a bullet hell environment using crafted weapons and unique character upgrades.

title: Moon Maiden: Terror on Planet X
description: An RPG celebrating retro sci-fi and old school point and click games with a unique combat system.

title: Guild & Gals
description: Assume the role of a guild master for adventurer's guild, hire mercenaries to embark on dangerous missions and forge meaningful relationships with a large roster of beautiful women powered by adaptive AI in this fantasy management game with RPG elements.

title: Mole Mayhem
description: Get into the giant drill tank, mole! Enter chaotic arenas with up to 4 players in a free-for-all, where the mission is to poke your opponents with your drill! Use speed boosts to escape or chase, avoid tricky holes, and get ready to poke your way to victory!

title: Survival City
description: Survival in a city affected by nuclear war. Survive by all means!

title: Echoes of Adventure
description: Feel the consequences of your own choices! Solve puzzles by repeating the same level with each character and their special ability. But be careful. What helps you with one character could stop you in the next run.

title: Speedway Challenge 2025
description: Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Combo Critters: Battle Checkers
description: A strategic, combo-driven twist on checkers! Battle quirky ninjas and their overlord bosses, unleash combos, and dominate the board. A completely fresh take on Checkers in a turn-based strategy game. Coming soon to Steam!

title: Sigillvm: Resonance
description: The Long Night is close at hand. The city comes to a standstill in the lead up to the festivities. But a series of strange events forces Asra to seek out the truth she doesn't truly wish to know, and to come face-to-face to those she has long since left behind.

title: Blade of One
description: Blade of One is a methodical 2D swordfighting game with simple controls. Strike down foes in a single hit, before they do the same to you.

title: Npc Simulator: Heroes Need Us
description: NPC Simulator: Heroes Need Us is a game that allows you to immerse yourself in a medieval world in the role of a simple merchant. Trade, give quests, try to help your favorite heroes in their hard adventures and much more!

title: Torn Veil
description: Torn Veil is a psychological horror game that immerses you in a chilling tale of moral decay in a deeply unsettling atmosphere to deliver a haunting experience.

title: Jon's Dog
description: JON'S DOG is a really short horror game with 3 ENDINGS about taking care of your friend's house after he has left to buy some drinks.

title: Man of Nollyn
description: A noir detective game where you can bribe or intimidate suspects for extra clues.

title: Balloon Hater
description: Pop balloons, upgrade your weapons, and boost your rewards in this satisfying idle clicker! Choose from a variety of tools to burst balloons faster and automate your progress.

title: Dad's Monster House 2: Medal
description: Remember the dad's monster house that haunted your dreams? You're back, in a way you'd never expect! A mysterious ■■ leaves you trapped in a creepy, run-down house...

title: The Son of Art
description: Step into an art sanctuary woven from colors, shapes, and puzzles, and embark on an unprecedented journey of the soul. You will become an art seeker, traversing the inner worlds of four 20th-century art masters, unlocking the secrets hidden deep within their works.

title: Fluffy Memories
description: Fluffy Memories is a cozy tile-matching memory game featuring a variety of cute and kinky furry characters who'd love to show off for you when you win a match!

title: Elemental Slime
description: Elemental Slime is a puzzle platformer game where you use the power of the elements to solve puzzles, interact with the world around you and unravel mysteries!

title: Abstractpunk
description: AbstractPunk is a wild, punk, soulslike game featuring unique collage-style graphics. Collect ice from defeated enemies, fight your way through a country engulfed in revolution, and try to find your place in broken future of the year 2004. Use happiness against your enemies. They will be happy.

title: Scarlet Hunt
description: In a dystopian world ruled by vampire lords, an opportunity arises. Participate in a deadly hunt for a chance at freedom... *if* you can outrun your hunters. Will you finally break your chains - or be dragged into the abyss?

title: Sphenoid
description: Sphenoid is a horror escape room that takes place in a prison. You wake up to find that everybody has disappeared. As you explore the prison, you will find clues and puzzles that you will need to solve in order to escape.

title: Hellkind
description: You awaken to whispers of an ancient cult summoning A Santa Compaña. As the veil to the dead unravels, explore, solve puzzles, and escape — before you become part of the ritual.

title: Cubo
description: Cubo is a narrative adventure-puzzle game set on a rotating cube world. Discover the other sides, unlock new areas, and bring the world back together.

title: Shank: Prison Survival
description: Got a tooth brush? Sharpen it because its about time to shank someone. Prisoners have to get crafty because when the riot alarm sounds, its every inmate for themselves. See if you can survive in prison without losing your tight, sweet, precious... pride. Secure loot in your cell and run shit.

title: Gravethorn
description: Gravethorn is a 2D platformer that combines soulslike and metroidvania elements with deep storytelling. The story follows an Inquisitor who has lost his memory, searching for his forgotten past along with his regrets.

title: Cafe New York 9/11
description: In Café New York, Step into the life of Sameer, a Pakistani American living in NYC during the week of 9/11. Sameer must navigate rising tensions, protect his family, and make impossible choices. Decisions that will shape his future and the fate of those around him in a city forever changed.

title: Local Supermarket Tycoon
description: Design the perfect neighbourhood supermarket! Research customer needs, carefully stock your shelves, and plan every aisle to maximize traffic and boost impulse sales

title: Shadow's End
description: Shadow's End is an open-world RPG-RTS hybrid where you must save the fantastical realm of Akaria from the rising threat of the Demon King! Assemble your dream team, trade between bustling cities, and uncover legendary allies, sages, and weapons hidden in the farthest reaches of the land.

title: Nasu-8
description:
The arcade classic, NASU, now available for your fantasy home video game console! Run and catch the eggplants in your mouth! Let them be wasted to the ground and you shall be wasted!

This is a recreation of the Yume Nikki minigame NASU, created originally by KIKIYAMA. The project was originally completed 2020-12-24, with some touching up for this public release in December 2023.

title: Deadly Chance
description: Deadly Chance is a psychological horror where you play as a prisoner in an aristocratic mansion. Explore, find clues, and face tough choices as hidden horrors test your sanity. Every decision matters—survival demands more than strength, but the courage to face the unknown.

title: Pekla
description: Descend into Hell in this horde survival action RPG. Battle through nine relentless circles, slay endless legions, and forge powerful builds in a dark world inspired by Dante's Inferno. Brutal bosses and merciless hordes will break you again and again—only through torment will you endure.

title: Contaminant
description: CONTAMINANT is a third-person action horror set in an alternate post-Soviet reality. As Maria, trapped in her grandfather’s grim factory, you’ll uncover secrets of your family through brutal combat, twisted puzzles, and surreal realms of abominations.

title: Gulltastrophe
description: It's time to cause a Gulltastrophe! Fly, Dash, and Poop on people. Kick all of them out and take back your island.

title: Clicksama
description: Click to earn money, use it to summon powerful anime warrior girls, and battle to destroy your opponent’s base. Simple, strategic, and addictive!

title: Mr. Meat
description: After a long time in isolation, something appears inside your fridge. Satisfy the meat, or resist it.

title: Soultracer
description: You and your friends stumble upon a gateway to another reality, one that harbors horrors beyond human comprehension. Fight through all evil and survive at all costs. There's something special about you, Soultracer, and only you can save your friends from the terror within.

title: Descendant of Night
description: Descendant of Night is a love letter to the 00s era of survival horror. Play as Blake Cage, a sharp-tongued operative of Vector Six - humanity’s last hope against the darkness. Unravel a gripping, lore-rich mystery of ancient immortals, bloodthirsty vampires, and the desperate struggle of mankind.

title: Sacrificio
description: An intense and fast-paced survival horror shooter in a dark fantasy world. Face overwhelming odds in a brutal struggle against evil.

title: Lovecraft Academy
description: Schoolboy dating sim. Also with eldritch abominations.

title: SkullX: Aibohphobia
description: You were hired to extract a bioengineer. Now your team is cut off, your comms are dead, and you're surrounded by something wearing human skin. Hold the line, make the calls, and survive the night in this choice-driven visual novel with turn-based combat.

title: End of Ember
description: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

title: The Lullaby Weaver
description: The Lullaby Weaver is a 1 bit psychological point & click horror game inspired by games like World of Horror, Silent Hill, Junji Ito, & FAITH.

title: Hallow Blade
description: Hallow Blade is a dark fantasy action adventure set in a vast interconnected subterranean kingdom where you form an unbreakable bond with an ancient possessed sword hungry for souls and vengeance.

title: Biomeat Huskworld
description: This is the future, Meat is currency. Nobody is giving you time to think about it. QUICK, CONSUME, MAKE CONNECTIONS AND SHOOT MONSTERS.

title: Mondrayn
description: Mondrayn is a challenging JRPG game with a dark fantasy atmosphere in a surreal dystopian world where you have to survive and become stronger. Find a variety of artifacts, create equipment, and explore locations filled with danger and mystery.

title: Cucu
description: A push-and-slide puzzle game. You win by placing a panel of the same color on the location of a colored sphere. The pushed-out block becomes the next block, so you need to think about the shape when inserting it.

title: Coalescent: Tidal Rapture
description: A hypnagogic 3D swimming/entanglement adventure game about harmonizing and want. Dive into a world of merpeople who are transforming and discovering casual relationships through the eyes of a floater who's just been dumped and refuses to evolve. Told in 3 chapters.

title: CrowHallow
description: Explore and survive these terrifying lands, and uncover the mystery of the Skult. With your companion Crow as your main weapon, charge into the horde of the night and save the souls of the damned with this 90s and early 2000s inspired Halloween shooter.

title: Lest: Deluxe 24
description: Play a Surreal and Abstract game of Hide and Seek across abstract realities watching as your beloved home falls into decay as you try desperately over and over again to hunt down your target through the stages of Denial, Guilt, Depression, Resentment, and Acceptance.

title: Pantheion
description: A single-player deck-building card game where mythologies unite. Construct your deck with deities, followers, artifacts, and blessings from Greek, Norse, and Japanese legends. Overcome each site's threshold through clever strategy, powerful combos, and unique card synergies.

title: G-Astro
description: Play as a hyperintelligent, intergalactic, space Snail on a mission across the universe. Discover wildlife and plantlife to determine whether this world is habitable for snail-kind.

title: World Alone: Dreampools
description: World Alone: Dreampools is a single-player Backrooms experience focused on dreamlike liminal pools. The game features a narrative told through cinematic sequences and immersive environments.

title: Stories and More: Animal Friends
description: Stories and More: Animal Friends is an educational CD ROM game for kids that takes three books "The Gunnywolf", "The Trek", and "Owl and the Moon" and converts them to an interactive format.

title: Havker-Man X
description: Havker-Man X is an open world, post-apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

title: Retro Rewind: Video Store Simulator
description: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

title: Stand-Alone: Ep.0
description: [Stand-Alone: EP.0] is a pixel-art side-scrolling action Roguelite game that tells an unknown prequel story from the main game. Additionally, it will continuously present some interesting test battle content to players!

title: Antidote to Despair
description: An antidote shop simulator in a grimdark setting. Save lives by diagnosing poison types and administering precious cures. Or risk playing executioner in white gloves — save one, slip another a fake cure and watch how your choice echoes through this rotten world.

title: Unfortunate Leaders
description: Conquer the world! In this turn-based strategy game, play as one of the many unfortunate leaders with unique abilities. Build your resources and queue your moves effectively. Play with friends or test yourself online, and discover what kind of leader you will become!

title: GraWe
description: GraWe is a 4-player online co-op gothic horror. The secrets of the village are yours to uncover as you and your team use all available tools to unravel the haunting past and uncover evidence of supernatural or human origin.

title: ChuChu Pancake
description: This is a high-speed puzzle action game for all ages, with a cute world view and stress-free controls.

title: Cubactory
description: Cubactory is the only factory game where you truly build objects freely, transforming, blending, carving and compacting colored cubes into intricate voxel figures while automating your modular factory to meet increasingly complex orders.

title: Ironweld
description: Unleash stylish anime-inspired mech combat in this 2D action RPG! Customize your build, master creative combos, and rise from broken parts to unstoppable legend in a world where every battle tests your skill—and every win is truly earned

title: Terradune
description: Terradune is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG where you battle monsters, discover hidden treasures, and shape your hero’s fate. Explore scorching deserts, moonlit forests, and thrilling dungeons to uncover secrets in this fast-paced, immersive adventure.

title: Animalkind
description: Animalkind is an inviting open-world town-building game where you play as an intelligent, aww-dorable animal who discovers an ancient mech. Use your powerful mech to establish your ideal town and recruit a variety of characters to join you. It's the paw-fect game to play with up to 3 friends!

title: Tomb of Chacal
description: Tomb of Chacal is a first-person horror game with stealth and puzzle mechanics. You are an archeologist who has stumbled upon the discovery of a lifetime - an undiscovered tomb hidden deep in the jungle. But the riches here are being guarded by an ancient evil.

title: Beatdown City Survivors
description: Punch a car so hard it EXPLODES! Dash through flaming gas to create a fire trail burning everything. Destroy a hydrant to douse out the fire. Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox meets survive-em-up with dynamic environments & outrageous lite weapon crafting & team building.

title: Hunted Within: The Walls
description: Dive into a gripping first-person horror Survival game Where you're trapped in a terrifying towering maze. Explore, craft tools and Fight by day, watch out over night when the Darkness hunts you within the walls. Uncover the truth behind the walls and Escape, or become a part of the nightmare.

title: Scrapwings
description: ScrapWings is a classic arcade airplane game. Craft equipment for your ship by recycling scrap metal and take on the space pirate fleet.

title: The Czar Is Dead 2
description: First-person rpg-shooter in the setting of the Russian Empire.

title: Kings of Cratia
description: Kings of Cratia offers an experience that mixes real-time strategy and first-person shooter mechanics. Build your new village and manage your resources efficiently. Be ready to defend your village every day when night falls! RTS or FPS, you are free to protect your village any way you want it.

title: A Day's Work
description: Explore, harvest resources, catch pet rabbits, and help friendly characters as you uncover secrets in this small, wholesome, single-player adventure.

title: Gun Center Simulator
description: Enter the world of a gun shop as a passionate collector who opens his own gun center! Create and manage your own gun center where you trade, customize and sell firearms, from classic pistols to cutting-edge weapons.

title: Hidden Tomatoes 4
description: Explore rivers, old rural houses, and snow-covered areas to find 100 hidden tomatoes. Each scene is packed with details, making the challenge even more exciting. Stay focused, search carefully, and uncover them all!

title: Hidden Tomatoes: Farm Frenzy
description: Find 100 hidden tomatoes in a beautiful and peaceful farm environment with fields, barns, and rustic houses. Enjoy a relaxing, time-free experience with soothing music and a fun challenge for players of all ages.

title: Ekron
description: A first-person myst-like exploration adventure. Awaken on a mysterious island that blends puzzles with an enigmatic narrative waiting to be unraveled. Explore an abandoned civilization and uncover a story that challenges the very fabric of time.

title: Tolom
description: TOLOM is a deckbuilding roguelike with turn-based combat. Equip suits that change your playstyle, fight with consumable cards, and explore at your own pace. Choose your battles, find upgrades, and decide when to face the final challenge. If you fall, come back with a new strategy.

title: Fallen Hunter
description: An action-RPG where two hunters follow intertwined paths through a world ravaged by corruption.

title: Chef Niya
description: Become the owner of the best food cart in chef Niya! Go on a life changing journey to the art district, cook mouth watering dishes, make new friends, and conquer the challenges of being a small business! In this wonderfully cozy, rhythm cooking RPG.

title: DreadMist
description: DreadMist is an open-world role-playing roleplaying sandbox simulation. With the incredible mechanical depth of this fantasy sandbox, you can begin as a lowly beggar and advance to numerous people skilled in crafting, trade, farming, thievery, combat, and many other activities.

title: Liminal City
description: Liminal City is a psychological horror and exploration game based on found footage, set in Backrooms Level 11. Walk through the streets of Level 11, filled with soulless buildings, dynamically moving to different levels and searching for a way out. Once you fall in here will you be able to get out?

title: Dreamless Kingdom
description: A narrative-driven exploration game where you collect hidden objects and help restore villagers' dreams.

title: Le Plan Spectral
description: Le Plan Spectral is a cozy little building game where you help ghosts transition to the afterlife by building castles !

title: Zenzicube: The Power of Six
description: Recruit, train, and manage a team of heroes to vanquish the dastardly Six Stars. In short, round-based sessions, send them on quests that match their skills to maximize rewards. Explore a town of colorful characters and engage in action-based combat.

title: Souls of Chronos Gaiden
description: Souls of Chronos Gaiden is a 2D action-adventure game. Play the role of the sword-wielding girl 'Kolia' and the her partner 'Mika' to embark on an unusual journey of revenge. Strengthen your character, defeat powerful enemies, and witness the flash of light at the end of the journey.

title: U-Boot: The Board Game - Digital Edition
description: A digital version of the iconic U-BOOT The Board Game. Manage the crew of a powerful warship during World War II. Explore enemy territory, win battles using the strength of a steel giant and reliable tactics, and most importantly - overcome the blue abyss.

title: The Prisonbreak
description: Choose your side – cop or criminal! Keep criminals locked up or escape, rob stores, and build your crime empire. Play with friends, create bases, and earn bounties. Action, strategy, and adrenaline-filled gameplay await!

title: Tcg & Duel
description: Come and venture into this collectible card game (TCG) and duel in search of improving your Deck with each victory. Choose your favorite battle card type and build your strategy based on it, with land-type cards, equipment to increase your attack and defense power, and trap cards.

title: Fushigi na Sekai no Kankou Nikki II: Pakuru World to Sejika no Gyakushuu
description: Fushigi na Sekai no Kankou Nikki II: Pakuru World to Sejika no Gyakushuu is a multi-genre game that combines various gameplay elements. It features clicker mechanics, fishing, sushi-themed rhythm segments, quick-time events, car chases, shooting, deduction and memory challenges, slot machine gameplay, character development, RPG elements, ninja-themed sequences, action segments, and bullet hell-style dodging. This diverse mix of game styles aims to provide a varied and engaging experience for players.

title: The Liftboy
description: Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not. Carry luggage, serve guests, and survive the chaos of hotel life. From physics-driven suitcase disasters to questionable VIP requests, this isn’t just a job—it’s a game. And Ted Grady? He’s the last of his kind.

title: Trouble in Cookie Town
description: Disaster has struck Cookie Town! The once-sweet city is being devoured by dancing, cookie-eating monsters! With the town’s legendary Broccoli shattered and scattered, nothing is stopping the crazed horde. As the towns last hope, you must save Cookie Town!

title: Arvis Knock Out!
description: Fight our characters and throw punches like never before with this third-person boxing game. Defeat all of our fighters, and take the fight further with online and local multiplayer.

title: Raccateer
description: Raccateer is a colony sim idle game. Recruit and upgrade raccoons each with unique personalities and stats, manage their equipment and synergize your team to become a Trashilionaire. Go from trash to riches in this tight, narrative-focused idler

title: MindArms
description:
What is Mind Arms?

It is an original 2D game with an emphasis on story.

But the story mode is not yet right.
I hope you can still enjoy it though.

title: Dead Man's Drive
description: Blast through hellish landscapes in Dead Man’s Drive, a high-speed vehicular combat game where survival is the only goal. Arm your ride with deadly weapons, face relentless supernatural foes, and conquer brutal environments. Drive, shoot, and escape—if you can.

title: Book of Abominations
description: Book of Abominations is a Lovecraftian inspired creature collecting RPG. Capture and battle monsters in snappy turn based combat, explore a mysterious, moody yet vibrant world, and unravel the secrets within the book!

title: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
description: A volatile cocktail of action and puzzles, spiced with pitch-black humor and a deliciously sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

title: Tiny Crypts
description: Descend into Tiny Crypts, a roguelike deckbuilding dungeon crawler where every card is a weapon that can be upgraded and enchanted! Wield swords, spells and more as you craft your deck, retrieve loot, and battle unique enemies. Featuring beautiful hand-drawn artwork and hundreds of cards!

title: Den Pain
description: My name is Dan. I lost my job, my money, and my silver spoons.Betrayed, robbed, cast aside.But at night, the city whispers: it's time to take it back.Everything will be Quiet and Standard.

title: Single Spark
description: Rogue-like DBG adventurer guild management game, find the way to victory in the ever-changing contradictions

title: Hardest Game About Jumping
description: Bounce, struggle, and conquer! Use your pogo stick to launch yourself through brutal, precision-based platforming challenges.

title: Transpawt Train
description: Real-time strategy simulation where you become the first railroad designer in the Paw-City! Draw railroad lines between towns and start running your trains. Design railroads for your cute animal residents and grow your Paw_City with efficient routes.

title: Bitgun Survivors
description: The first of its kind open-world vampire-survivors game. Explore a dynamic environment, encounter random events, and adapt to survive a zombie outbreak. With upgrades and challenging gameplay, test your skills and adaptability to increase your chances of survival.

title: Seven Sinners
description: Seven Sinners is a western roguelike with turn-based QTE combat. Guide a band of outlaws from the Wild West. Recruit new sinners into your gang, rob stagecoaches and banks, roam the prairies, and evade the sheriff and his hounds. Will you get rich or will you disappear in the prairies?

title: Hate You
description: Welcome to the polar station, where a mysterious timer counts down every hour! Your task is to decipher and input codes on an old terminal, but beware: the polar night holds many secrets. Can you face the horrors that might become reality?

title: No More Deep
description: Experience survival horror in this first person shooting game - No More Deep. What mysterious force has turned this once-thriving Gothic town into a ghost-ridden ruin? Come and experience this eerie, spine-chilling tale for yourself.

title: Happy Puppy
description: Manage your own cozy garden! Care for playful puppies, clean up, and plant vibrant crops. Provide them with toys and watch their happiness grow. Decorate and expand your space to build your dream garden filled with Happy Puppies!

title: Nemesis Shock
description: Nemesis Shock is a twin stick shooter rogue-lite. Take control of your prototype mech, the Nemesis, and cut though hordes of enemies. Use your quick movements and overwhelming firepower to survive.

title: IndusTree
description: IndusTree is a cozy tree-building game where you have to place the tiles you are dealt as best as you can. React to the challenges nature throws at you and grow into a big and sturdy tree!

title: Dice to Pay
description: Roll the dice, play your cards, and hunt monsters to pay off your crushing mortgage. This is a quirky turn-based strategy game where survival means managing your luck—and your loans. Glory can wait. The bank won't.

title: The Wellmonts Case
description: The Wellmonts Case is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1993, Northern Maine. As a private detective, you explore the abandoned Wellmont farm, search for clues, photograph unsettling evidence, and uncover the truth behind a family's unexplained disappearance.

title: Sip Fisher
description: Have you ever wanted to drink an entire lake through a straw? Well now you can in this cozy incremental fishing game! There's so much to sip in the lake, so upgrade your straw, drink up schools of fish, and maybe find what's at the bottom of the Lake!

title: Sinking the Boats
description: It's a choice-oriented story game. Play as a group of underground workers who fight in the dark, and stage a treacherous spy war story in Nanjing during World War II. How will you respond to identity crises, betrayals, and collapsed beliefs? Loyalty or betrayal, abandon others or be abandoned...

title: Icetwine
description: Icetwine is an ice-age city builder where you drag and combine raw materials to craft tools, machines, and structures! Unite wood, stone, and iron to build cozy huts, thriving farms, and even tame dodos and mammoths as you forge a flourishing prehistoric village!

title: Die Fighter
description: A sci-fi dice-driven roguelike where your dice fuel both your abilities and your enemies’. You'll need strategy and luck to outwit dynamic foes, harness synergistic upgrades, and escape creeping galactic doom before Fate catches up.

title: Cats are Money
description: Cats are Money is a cozy idle game in the "Tamagotchi" genre where you manage a farm and collect unique cats into your inventory. Take care of your pets, feed them, and play with them. Upgrade your farm, unlock new breeds and businesses.

title: Game of Grass
description: Game of Grass is an extremely satisfying incremental game where you cut grass and buy upgrades. Upgrade your tools to cut grass more quickly and efficiently. Grow crops and make juice for passive income. Collect all of the rare Golden Crops, and animals! Experience grass cutting nirvana!

title: Merge Maestro
description: Combine 100's of unique emoji based tokens in this roguelike merge-builder! Find ever more creative combinations and fuse unique strategies to beat this ever more challenging twist on roguelikes and arcadey merge games!

title: Neohell
description: A fast-paced survivors-like shooter with roguelite elements and round-based progression. Blast your way through demonic hordes in a futuristic post-apocalyptic world, fight bosses, upgrade your weapons and abilities, and survive the chaos of the NEOHELL

title: Cozy Market Simulator
description: Cozy Market Simulator is a relaxing shop management game where you run your own store. Stock shelves, serve customers, fulfill orders, and grow your business day by day into the ultimate cozy market.

title: Bioysque
description: A retro-style Action RPG in a dark bio-horror environment, both sci-fi and fantasy motives. You are always alone and they are always many. Fight surreal creatures, get experience, explore and gather upgrades - get stronger before the next big Boss fight, learn the truth.

title: Karaneko
description: Karaneko is a bullet hell JRPG where players explore a pixel art fantasy world, examine objects, discover histories of three countries, and interact with NPCs. Choices impact the game, offering diverse genres like adventure, psychological, puzzle, visual novel, and horror.

title: Meowventure
description: This is a top-down roguelike deck-building game where you can combine a wide variety of cards to unleash unimaginable attack effects. With a high degree of freedom in deck construction, countless powerful combos await your creativity.

title: Solstorm
description: SOLSTORM is a classic hand-crafted arcade bullet hell, skillfully weave, and dodge through 9 stages with waves of projectiles as you persevere and see a space odyssey to the end!

title: Ultra Maze
description: This is the ultimate Maze Game. The mazes are procedurally generated, and so are always unique. There are plenty of options to create an experience to your likings.

title: Radio Ghosts
description: Radio Ghosts is a narrative game about geometry tests, vampire baristas, and camping with your mom.

title: Jackie Hart: Headhunter
description: An urban fantasy 2D point & click adventure set in Taipei, where the supernatural lurks beneath reality. You play as a paranormal investigator with abilities of her own. Unravel a brutal case of human sacrifice, piece together the clues, interview witnesses and try to keep your head—literally.

title: Match-3 Juice Bar
description: This is a three consumption plus management game, where juice is extracted and then sold. By providing timely customer service, customers can earn coins and goodwill in order to successfully reach a five-star juice store. Accumulating coins can unlock upgraded devices and fruit varieties.

title: Aleae
description: Raise, multiply, and battle with dice — a dice deck-building roguelike! Utilize a unique system where all dice on the field roll simultaneously and their outcomes collide to shape the fight. In both battles and events, everything is up to the roll. Embark on a journey where luck meets strategy!

title: Code: Loopbreaker
description: Help Ethan in this first-person puzzle adventure. Immerse yourself in Atlas Technology, a dark tech company brimming with enigmas and an absurd amount of corporate shenanigans. Solve riddles, investigate clues, and uncover hidden secrets in a sci-fi story. Will you escape a fateful ending?

title: Arcadian Days
description: A slice-of-life open-world game about the beauty and nostalgia of childhood. Play as a child in a non-linear sandbox where you can explore at your own pace and partake in wholesome adventures!

title: HoloReversi
