description: Experience a New Twist on Reversi with Hololive Members! Use original stacking mechanics and Hololive member skills to enjoy strategic battles! Take on intense CPU matches or online battles for the ultimate brain challenge!

title: Glow Cubes
description: Glow Cubes is a set of puzzles like Rubik's Cubes, but with different movement rules. Can you solve these never-before-seen challenges? Unlike with physical cubes, you can save your place, and use other features shown below. Wishlist now to be the among first to solve these unique puzzles!

title: Mumagi: Stellar Saviors
description: Mumagi: Stellar Saviors is a co-op horde survivor where you can gather up to 4 players to take down celestial forces. Choose a magical girl, enhance your powers, and restore time and space to their natural order!

title: Arcade Management Simulator
description: Build and manage your dream arcade! Purchase a variety of machines, set prices, maintain them, restock gacha machines, claw machines and vending machines. Collect and trade over 500 unique gachas. Upgrade your arcade, attract customers, and become the best arcade in town.

title: Foglit
description: Brave the cursed lands of Cirilis, in Foglit, a top-down action roguelite. Hack and slash through monsters, and collect powerful runes to customize your build. Unravel a dark story with impactful choices and multiple endings. Can you break the cycle?

title: Tarot Awakening
description: Rise beyond fortune-telling, become a true Tarot master! In Tarot Awakening, train with spreads, flashcards, and memory challenges. Inspired by the Rider–Waite tradition, this is the ultimate test of your intuition and mastery. Will you ascend to Oracle status or wander the mysteries forever?

title: Saints of the Fallen Cross
description: Blast through an intense top-down zombie survival experience. Scavenge, craft, build, and fight endless hordes of the undead. With heroism, deep progression, and dynamic combat, carve your story in a brutal post-apocalypse. Forge alliances or stand alone—how long can you outlast the rising terror?

title: Sea Drillers
description: An isometric Tycoon, where you can control any Worker in First Person. Build an Oil Rig and extract Oil for endless profits. Beware of Greedy Pirates!

title: Snowfall's Mystery
description: A psychological interactive novel about a floppy disk with a mysterious program. Help Elliot cope with his mental issues and uncover the secret of the floppy disk.

title: Dream Night
description: You wake up from a nightmare. You can't count how many times you've had a nightmare this month. But this time, after waking up, you find some strange phenomena in your house. You want to go out to see, but the door is locked...

title: Atura
description: Guide a herd of sheep as a herding dog. Use timing and precision to navigate obstacles and complete each trial. Master the art of sheep herding and adapt to unpredictable animal behavior. Relaxing yet engaging, this game will test your skills and quick thinking in a unique and natural setting.

title: Happy Surprise Garden
description: Grandpa's garden is invaded by strange creatures, and you go to investigate. You can help each other with your friends, collect props, upgrade skills, and repel powerful enemies. You can also turn into a cat, escape the war, and sleep lazily at home every day.

title: The King of Truancy
description: A modern roguelite deck-builder with supernatural combat & light RPG elements. Build diverse decks, face random events, humorous stories, and charming heroines! Play as a descendant of legendary heroes in modern life, battling bullies, gangs, and agents to uncover 'The Shadow' conspiracy.

title: Star Clicker Odyssey
description: Fight off a galactic threat in this idle clicker game. Battle waves of enemy ships, progress actively or passively, and save humanity. With over 200 high-quality ship models and background mode, watch your fleet soar across your desktop while you work!

title: Arabian Gulf
description: Arabian Gulf is a single-player survival action game set in a harsh desert. Face relentless enemies, endure tough conditions, and fight through dangerous terrain using basic tools and weapons. Survive, overcome each challenge, reach the distant castle, and claim the hidden treasure.

title: Way of the Dragons
description: Join the journey of baby dragons who’ve fallen from their nests, climbing back up to find their mothers in a chaotic parkour adventure. Burning or tossing each other off ledges might be fun but don’t let them forget why they’re climbing. Their mothers are waiting above… or are they?

title: Checkmage!
description: A chess-based strategy game with casual deckbuilding elements. Build your deck by trading cards and battling lovable, hand-drawn characters.

title: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul
description: First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people. Travel through unique areas, uncover memories and use them to craft powerful potions. Unlock special abilities and solve puzzles in a mysterious world. Will your soul survive this journey?

title: The Dark Between
description: BETWEEN LIFE AND DEATH. Survive within surreal mazes in this retro first-person horror, where only by reassembling your soul can you escape.

title: Backframes: Escape Together
description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

title: The Last Sanctum
description: A dark fantasy tactical RPG, a forsaken necromancer, raise an army of the damned to reclaim your sanctum. Explore an open, isometric world, conquer cursed dungeons, recruit souls, and master team-based, turn-based combat in a decaying realm.

title: Putt in Parks
description: Step onto the lush greens & unwind in the relaxing world of Putt in Parks, the only relaxing minigolf experience set in stunning, stylized landscapes. Leave your worries behind as you explore whimsical courses and the world around them, designed to be about the journey & the scorecard.

title: Digger: Galactic Treasures
description: Digger: Galactic Treasures is a space adventure where you drill into asteroids to uncover rare resources and hidden treasures. Explore the galaxy, upgrade your gear, and discover the secrets of the universe!

title: Tempoverdose
description: Insane Twin Stick Rythmic shooter. Defeat waves of enemies shooting to the beat. Conquer every genre from chill house to hectic breakbeat.

title: Isoforge
description: Build your dream city on a vast island in Isoforge! Unlock new buildings every in-game day, each influencing others in unique ways. Recruit soldiers to defend against invasions, manage upgrades, and tackle dynamic events like unlocks and challenges. Can you create the ultimate city?

title: Sophistry
description: Play as a famous philosopher, build your deck, write books, and gather synergistic ideas. Engage in philosophical debates, where victory is earned by answering profound questions or captivating the crowd. Improve your philosophers and their books, create questions and lead the debate!

title: Danger in Pompeii
description: Danger in Pompeii is an adventure puzzle game where you relive the city’s final day. Explore its streets, help its people, and solve the mystery of Mercury. Can you escape the eruption of Mount Vesuvius and save your friends?

title: Royal Odyssey
description: Royal Odyssey is a fast-paced, top-down space shooter inspired by classic Shmups. Pilot Prince Zayven’s ship through a deadly asteroid field, upgrade your ship, and navigate the dangers of space to complete his heroic mission.

title: Silence Forest
description: Silent Forest is a card-based roguelike game. It combines straightforward controls with a wealth of gameplay variety. A clean, hand-drawn art style paired with perfectly matched sound effects ushers players into a rich fantasy world beyond the screen.

title: Pool Protocol: Loop
description: You are trapped in a mysterious swimming pool. Observe the surroundings for any abnormalities and find a way to escape.

title: Viceria
description: Viceria is a minimalistic colony simulator. Build cities, develop your economy, build trade, defend your colony from threats and decide the fate of your people. Will you serve the metropolis or will you oppose it? It's up to you!

title: Whispers of the Past
description: Whispers of the Past" is an immersive first-person adventure that combines time manipulation, psychological exploration, and puzzle-solving. Players step into the shoes of Sarah, a young woman struggling with a creative block that hinders her artistic expression

title: Abyssal Blade
description: Abyssal Blade is a 2D, pixel-art "strategic" boss rush inspired by difficult mechanics in high-level MMO raids. You awaken as the Wanderer, now strong enough to confront your sorrow—with only 1 HP, conquer the five stages of grief and escape the abyss.

title: Yokai Hunters
description: You are yokai hunters venturing into cursed lands from which no one returns. Assemble your team, choose your class, and attempt to banish ancient evil in dark feudal Japan. Survive — or become part of the legend.

title: CleanTwin
description: Blast away grime and clutter with your BubbleGun, turning filthy spaces into pristine sanctuaries. Pop muck and debris to earn experience, level up, and upgrade your gear. Hone your skills to uncover hidden stains, track down junk, and savor the soothing satisfaction of restoring beauty and order.

title: Anemorie
description: Anemorie is a visually rich, story-driven adventure game that invites players to step into the life of Anna, a young woman on a journey of self-discovery, love, and resilience.

title: Keep Me Gifted
description: In Keep Me Gifted you will make your career debut as a Gift Shop owner. Be ready to encounter unhinged characters and their requests, try to match those requests with your wrapping skills, manage your item stock, upgrade your shop, and increase your store's popularity. And stay gifted!

title: Cattle Crisis!
description: Cattle Crisis is an arcade shoot 'em up game (Shmup). Pilot your fighter jet to defeat evil aliens and save our precious cows! Cattle Crisis is a short game and currently features one level.

title: Streatham Hill Stories
description: London based Grand Theft Auto Clone

title: Dark Vampires: The Shadows of Dust
description: Dark Vampires: The Shadows of Dust is a singleplayer first-person FPS game developed by Wolfgroup and published by IncaGold

title: Chronicles from the Abyss
description: Chronicles from the Abyss is a collection of 4 twisted Horror & Thriller stories that will play on the darkest corners of your mind, & every choice drips with dread. Twisted plots, haunting art, and chilling secrets await. Ready to uncover what lurks beneath?

title: Evaluation
description:
It is time for your Evalua†ion.

Evaluation is an emulation of an old program that was distributed amongst the Church in the early to mid nineties.

The program was used to evaluate Faith, Self-worth and to Commune with spirits. It was taken out of circulation and banned by the Vatican outright in 1999.

While every attempt has been made to emulate this program exactly, there are some flaws and the program may not respond correctly.

Songs of Praise, a tape of Worship music that was originally included with a purchase of the program, has been transferred to digital and included with the program.

title: General Command
description: General Command is a turn-based Napoleonic war game. Create custom battles and lead your army against enemy generals who set their strategy based on aggression and confidence. In the age of muskets, cavalry charges, and cannon fire, use bold battlefield maneuvers to seize victory.

title: Tale's Edge
description: Tale’s Edge is a third-person action-adventure RPG that combines dynamic parkour with strategic combat, allowing you to approach challenges with cunning, stealth or force. Every decision, from mercy to destruction, shapes Red’s evolution and the future of a dark, ever-shifting world inspired by the original, gritty fables from history.

title: Stand by Me: Otome Isekai Rpg
description: You die, and wake up in another world as a royal sorceress named Ciel Rozenbleu. The catch? You remember your life—not hers.

title: Those Npc's Love Stories
description: Create your own love story with those adorable men who were once just background characters.

title: RGB GlitchGazer
description: A mad and romantic ADV. Unravel a strange world of science and philosophy with a mecha girl, zombie girl, or beastfolk. Some paths may disturb you... or thrill you.

title: Blu-dude in the Quest of Reality in Time
description: In Blu-Dude in the Quest of Reality in Time, you're not just playing—you’re joining Blu-Dude on a profound search for truth. What starts as a lighthearted adventure transforms into an exploration into his reality. What is your purpose?

title: Ashwake
description: Ashwake is a hardcore first person survival experience that takes place inside Ozyorsk, Russia after the Kyshtym Disaster. As a lone traveler, you must scavenge for resources, avoid anomalies, and fend off both hostile factions and creatures to survive.

title: Hubert
description: Step into the paws of a loyal shepherd dog in this atmospheric third-person adventure. Track scents, herd sheep, and navigate the rugged northern wilderness. Face rough weather, natural predators and not so obedient sheeps.

title: Slender: A Crooked Manifestation
description: Slender - A Crooked Manifestation is a single player horror game, in which after surviving the boat crash, you explore eerie islands and dark caves as you try to survive the lurking Slenderman. Can you uncover a secret with the help of a missing companion from your past without becoming HIS victim?

title: The Quest for the Golden Flece
description: The programme will let the player feel what the quest for the Golden Fleece was all about! While playing the game, you can learn to concoct the Soporific, a magic sleep-inducing potion, enter a wind-ball throwing battle or go on a fascinating cruise. It is also worthwhile to prove oneself as the general commanding the team of the Argonauts. The chill of the excitement, the gooseflesh from the exhilaration, the spikes of adrenaline and the explosions... of laughter - guaranteed!

title: A Game About Penguins
description: A Game About Penguins is a cozy, online multiplayer experience where you customize adorable penguins and enjoy relaxing activities with friends. Slide, fish, throw snowballs, and socialize in a charming, snowy world!

title: Honorless!
description: HONORLESS! is a 2D fighting game 1vs1 where trashtalking plays a key role. Insult your friends with custom phrases and then slice them to pieces.

title: Edgefield
description: Edgefield is a mix of the adult visual novel, dating sim and point-and-click adventure genres with a wide and colorful cast of characters to meet, befriend, and romance (in fully animated scenes) as you make your way through your freshman year at Edgefield University.

title: Well of Darkness
description: Well of Darkness is action medieval, dark-fantasy role-playing game. Escape the imprisonment to reach the surface from Raydow giant caves. Fight your way through monsters and mutations with self-made weapons and guts.

title: Moon & the Fractured Reincarnation
description: The land is peaceful, the land is at war. Live a life of comfort and relaxation, one of a builder and construct your home, plant and harvest crops, or delve into the scourge of the land and lay waste to monsters that roam. In this survival sandbox the choice to be the hero is yours to make or forgo.

title: [Afantasia]
description: Guided by a mysterious voice called “Intrusion,” play as a boy who wakes with no memories and explore a strange yet beautiful town in search of fragments of his lost past. Uncover who you are, and decide who you will become, before your identity vanishes entirely.

title: Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild
description: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

title: Hate.net
description: hate.net is....a minimalistic FPS movement shooter. An energy drink-sized time capsule of endless fighting. A micro-world of bots in a perpetual state of meaningless conversation with each other. Stay as long as you like - they've fought long before you, and they'll fight long after you're gone.

title: Numinous
description: Investigate a missing content creator in an abandoned kampong in this atmospheric horror game. Explore haunted ruins, uncover dark secrets, and evade the lurking presence of the Pontianak. Will you uncover the truth or become part of the legend?

title: Everstead: Origins
description: Everstead: Origins is a unique idle simulation experience that allows you to watch a self-sustaining village evolve over time. Without direct control, you observe the settlers’ daily routines, social bonds, and the consequences of their decisions in a fully autonomous world.

title: Dual Shadows
description: Dual Shadows is a combat-focused action game set in Pulsanh, a neon-drenched city powered by the imprisoned energy of two divine beings: the Phoenix and the Dragon. You play as Linh, a synthetic lifeform forged by the tech conglomerate Harmoni —spliced from fragments of the beasts she’s sent to destroy.

title: Acrodrift: FPV Drone Simulator
description: A high-speed FPV drone simulator that challenges your skills with precision flying, time attack races, and freestyle exploration. Customize your drone, tune flight dynamics, and master the art of acro flying across immersive environments.

title: Very Unserious Game
description:
Very Unserious Game is a short narrative game (approximately twenty minutes), playable only with a mouse.

A parody of serious games and a satire of the wonderful world of business, this game takes you on a unique job interview to join Innovality, an innovation startup that innovates (well... in theory).

Through a series of absurd e-learning quizzes and situations as familiar as they are uncomfortable, you'll discover the joys of corporate jargon, vague objectives, and "inspiring" corporate values.

title: Terminal Outbreak
description: The only speed game where you want to slow down, as you infinitely accelerate and race to save the Internet from a Horrible Super Virus infecting computers worldwide! Launch, Crash, and Slam on the Breaks through Multiple Nostalgic Worlds, Tricky Levels, and Brutal Boss Fights.

title: Pit of Fears
description: Pit of Fears is an atmospheric horror, mystery, 2D platform, puzzle, action and adventure game, face all the challenges and dangers of the Pit of Fears, survive the bizarre creatures and solve the mysteries of this distorted alternative dimension to the real world.

title: Guardian Chicken
description: Build towers, grow crops, and stop a mad scientist's undead army in this chaotic, comedy-filled tower defense game.

title: Fusion Mage
description: Fusion Mage is a whimsical action-roguelike about casting spells. Combine elements to create a variety of magics. Slay monsters, gather gems, and build your strategy in a colorful adventure.

title: Calix
description: Calix is a frenetic platform game where you control two characters with unique powers and gameplay styles. Delve into the story of Gilda and Viola and decide who will complete their objective.

title: A Bottled Up Island
description: A Bottled Up Island is a short 3D-Platformer built around momentum, speed and exploration. Break bottles that contain chunks of a floating island to complete the game world, either solo or with friends.

title: Kick and Hide
description: A nostalgic multiplayer action game inspired by children's outdoors game, kick the can.

title: Codename Cure II
description: Codename CURE II is an upcoming co-operative first person shooter set in the aftermath of a zombie apocalypse. Create an elite military squad with up to five players and fight your way through hordes of zombies in a variety of dynamic objective missions.

title: Othello: Battle Royale
description: Rogue Hunt & Deadly Reversal . BR meets roguelike! Swap roles when the Bell rings: Hunt as Black (dash/kill White) or flee as White (use traps/terrain). Every cycle reverses predator & prey. Survive endless role-flips in this lethal cat-and-mouse battle. Last alive wins!

title: Dragons Frolic!
description: Dragons Frolic! is a cozy and relaxing idle game with a cute racing platformer on top! Buy or breed dragons, sell them for profit or send them into races. Discover new dragon types and color variants. Unlock new race tracks or decorations. Enjoy cute dragons frolicking around you!

title: Marblous Worlds
description: Marblous Worlds is a toylike 3D Platformer. Explore a series of worlds collecting meebstars, and flower medals to customise your marble to your hearts content.

title: Unsound Love
description: An open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained. You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car. Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

title: Raptors vs. Goblins
description: When two unorthodox worlds collide, you get RAPTORS VS. GOBLINS. Fight of hordes of goblins and defend your kingdom! Reclaim what's yours and keep fighting to get stronger. Throw the Goblin King out of the ranks and save the Island in this top-down tower defense!

title: Shuttered
description: You're trapped in the dark with only the flash of your camera to defend yourself against the monsters hunting you down. Can you make it out alive?

title: Super Airline Tycoon
description: You are the captain of your own airline and will face the challenge of transforming a small business into a global empire. Take full control of every aspect of your fleet management, from purchasing aircraft and planning routes to managing airports and onboard services.

title: Little Hoarder
description:
Betrayed and shipwrecked, Fred finds himself marooned on a mysterious island after a devastating betrayal by his wife.

Grief-stricken and with nothing left, he spirals into a manic obsession: collecting EVERYTHING. His island prison, surprisingly, possesses regenerative structures, seemingly designed to fuel his insatiable hoarding. Explore this bizarre paradise, uncovering its secrets and the strange mechanisms that replenish its seemingly endless resources. Unravel the mystery behind your solitary confinement and the bizarre technology that sustains it.

Discover the island's hidden depths, from sun-drenched beaches to dark, unexplored caverns, each brimming with potential treasures to add to your ever-growing collection. Will you find solace in your obsessive collecting, or will the island's secrets drive you further into madness? Will you uncover the truth behind your abandonment?

title: Sinker Sound
description: a Fishing game with Musical Rhythm gimmick! Explore a Strange Fantastical lake and find many strange fishes with its own unique original music!

title: Reframe
description: You may have what it takes to survive. But do you have what it takes to live?

title: Matchstone
description: Matchstone reinvents the classic memory game from your childhood. Match strange stones to gain an ever increasing score and push your memory to its limits. Leave no stone unturned!

title: Rise of the Vanguard
description: Dive into Rise of the Vanguard! Team up with up to 7 players in thrilling PvE missions, where every challenge is unique thanks to our Dynamic Mission Generation system. Choose your class, battle fierce foes, and join scheduled playtests now! Are you ready to rise?

title: The Gretlow Tapes
description: Armed with nothing but your camera, investigate the abandoned Gretlow House in this short, atmospheric horror game. Uncover a chilling mystery through a realistic found-footage lens.

title: Insanitation
description: It’s Chaos VS Order in this fast-paced battle against family & friends. Will you create Chaos as a Cat - spreading fur, mayhem, & hairballs everywhere? Or restore Order as a Keeper - cleaning & mopping up the muck before Chaos takes over? Pick a side & grab your kibble or gear, & claim victory.

title: Unspoken Echoes
description: A gothic horror role-playing game with three playable protagonists thrust into a murder mystery. Explore an old manor. Interrogate suspects. Try not to go insane.

title: Radventure: The Rise of Ryle
description: Ryle, a half-elf, is in search of the grave of Dwemmit, his old adventuring partner, in order to pee on it. That sentence used a lot of commas... is it grammatically correct? Probably not. Based on a true story that I made up.

title: Insect Dude! Underground Roots
description: Insect Dude! Underground Roots is a 2D-3D hybrid story-driven top-down shooter where the protagonist is trapped underground at the size of a bug and has to battle other insects while trying to find a way to return to normal.

title: Service Please
description: Service Please is an engaging restaurant management simulation. Welcome your customers, manage your staff, expand your menu, and oversee the flow behind the kitchen. In this journey from a small eatery to a prestigious restaurant, every decision matters.

title: Metal Genesis: Rogue Regime
description: Rise up against the Iron Legion. Play as rebel mech pilots and battle giant robots in this twin-stick shooter boss rush game!

title: Late Shift: Midnight Burger
description: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a burger shop. Prepare burger, serve customers, and survive the midnight nightmare.

title: Void Tech
description: A story-driven sci-fi adventure where you repair satellites in Earth's orbit while unraveling corporate secrets. Navigate dangerous space debris, manage resources, and banter with mission control in a game packed with humor, mystery, and tough choices.

title: Operation Sour Power
description: Rebel with a jetpack. Charge, slash, and defy gravity in a platformer that punches back. Built in blood, blasted with speed. The jetpack hits different in OSP; A hand-drawn 2D platformer with punk energy and surgical flow.

title: Echomnesia
description: In the mysterious sci-fi visual novel "Echomnesia", two brilliant scientists - Morpheus and Crona, experiment with a suspicious Cube, but something goes wrong.

title: Draw World
description: A new kind of real-time RPG fused with card game mechanics! Join the hero Cade on an epic journey to save the world from an unknown threat. Team up with unique allies, and collect powerful cards and badges to build your ultimate deck.

title: Balatro Multiplayer Mod
description: A multiplayer mod for Balatro, allowing players to compete with each other.

title: Freezer Pops 2: Little Blo's Party
description: Freezer Pops 2: Little Blo's Party is a visual novel sequel of Freezer Pops. It's a story about Alexandre participating in a famous blogger named Little Blo while he can date other men. It's a product inspired by Brazilian pop culture, especially memes.

title: Wiz-herd
description: Wiz-Herd is a local and online party game where 2-4 players compete in fast-paced minigames. Herd sheep, cast spells, and sabotage your friends to claim victory!

title: Mana Smack
description: Select a character, build your fighting style, combo your skills, unleash your ultimate. Overpower your opponents, or outlast them in fast-paced, turn-based, rogue-lite combat.

title: Remote Position
description:
Remote Position is a story-driven horror mystery about obedience, secrets, and the unseen forces pulling the strings.

A remote supervisor issues you strange, unnerving tasks. Each one drags you deeper into a puzzle of hidden motives and fractured truths. Explore a richly interactive environment, solve logic-based challenges woven into the world itself, and uncover the secret legacy your father left behind.

title: Bar Soviet
description: Bar Soviet is a narrative-driven bar management sim set in a dystopian republic. Mix drinks, talk to patrons, and manage your finances while navigating life under an authoritarian regime.

title: Deep Space Exploitation
description: Deep Space Exploitation is a space mining game featuring 2D physics, fully destructible asteroids, and a story of survival under an exploitative corporation. Use your equipment wisely, upgrade your ship, and make difficult decisions to secure your future!

title: Extermination Ship
description: Try to survive on a deserted ship drifting in a foggy ocean. Complete daily tasks, keep your sanity, and uncover the secrets of the missing crew. But be careful—nothing is as simple as it seems. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Dead Oil
description: Defend your armored rig against ruthless raiders in this intense roguelike survival driller. Extract precious Oil, scavenge resources, and upgrade your rig. Is there enough time to drill a little deeper and reinforce your rig before the raiders launch their next attack?

title: Chess of Doom
description: Chess of doom is a chess-based roguelike where you're outnumbered at every turn. Harness the dungeon's power to battle enemy hordes, familiar and strange. Die, learn, master, conquer!

title: Hardwired
description: Enter the terminal and jack into a retro-cyberpunk world. Hardwired is a hacker simulation where you explore networks, uncover secrets, and manipulate systems through command-line interfaces. Discover hidden logs, tap into surveillance feeds, and unravel story a set in a fractured dystopia.

title: Unreal Zombies
description: From Phoenix Limit Studios (the creators of The Multiverse Trilogy, Alternate Universe and more) comes Unreal Zombies, a fast-paced FPS zombies horror game that brings you into a post-apocalyptic world.

title: General Idler
description: General Idler is an idle conquest game set on a parallel Earth — 195 nations, real borders, and one objective: total world domination. You start with a single home country and nothing but ambition. Build industries to generate cash. Fund military units to generate Army Power. Accumulate enough AP, declare war on a neighbor, and add their flag to your wall. Then do it again. And again. Across every continent on the globe.

title: Isles of Rain
description: Melancholy Islands where it always rains. A 3rd Person adventure.

title: Organized Inside
description: A slow-paced life simulation and tidying up game about a cat, passion, transformation and growth. Categorizing cluttered everyday household items, navigating ever-changing life experiences, while gradually uncovering the joys and meaning of life through methodical space organization.

title: Synthesis of Corruption
description: Emergency Protocol activated: Dark Energy Particle Synthesis failed. Now you — late and alone — must navigate a facility where science and sanity have collapsed. Face entities born from dark energy corruption in this atmospheric FPS-horror hybrid where human ambition meets primal terror.

title: Shmooblin Blaster
description: Shmooblin Blaster is a hardcore, bullet hell boss rush game where you fight outlandish superbosses, featuring a bright and stylized pixel art design.

title: Bound by Bones
description: In Bound by Bones, a supernatural horror experience, you are trapped in the space between life and death—forced to uncover and destroy the cursed remains of violent spirits before they consume you. The only way to survive is to find their scattered bones… and burn them.

title: School Bathroom
description: A first-person escape horror game, 'School Bathroom'.You've found yourself penned in an eerie stall.What is the source of the fear you feel in this inescapable space...

title: Dream Abyss: Survivors
description: A stylish roguelike action RPG set in a dreamworld! Join Lily on a mysterious journey to save her sister trapped in a nightmare. Hunt down endless waves of nightmare creatures, clear stages, and conquer the abyss with powerful skills and beautiful characters!

title: Country Hero
description: A turn-based strategy game where you recruit heroes in an ever-changing world. Forge your path by mixing management, training, and alchemy gameplay, equip unique artifacts and emblems to liberate Demon King-occupied towns. Will you rise as the world's most legendary guild?

title: BugSquash
description: You are a professional Bug Squasher. Clients reach out to you with their pest problems, and you'll respond to increasingly challenging infestations. With each successful job, you'll earn money to upgrade and expand your equipment and take on bigger, badder bugs.

title: Distant Flux: System Initializing
description: A magitech, post-apocalyptic, turn-based RPG. Assist your faction with exploration, resource gathering, construction, research, item fabrication, and monster extermination, while absorbing ambient mana and leveling up your System drone.

title: The Fruit Game
description: A casual cute game about merging fruits and getting the highest score! You can also care and level up pets and in return they'll power up your runs! You can buy fruit skins, music, and backgrounds to customize your experience.

title: Liuyin's World
description: A 3D cyber-fantasy ARPG with metroidvania levels & multiple endings. Combat rewards aggression – hesitation means defeat. In a world where the Wheel of Reincarnation, corrupted by tainted energy, became an AI that merged flesh, souls, and machines to create new life, survivors reject this evolution.

title: Rewrite the Romance: The Golden Lotus
description: Romance: The Golden Lotus is a text-based adventure game based on the classical Chinese novel Jin Ping Mei. Set in the Song Dynasty, players take the role of Ximen Qing, a wealthy merchant, making choices that can alter the historical narrative. As the reincarnated protagonist, players navigate through social interactions, business dealings, and personal relationships in medieval China, with their decisions shaping an alternate path through this classic tale.

title: Jack the Ripper: Hunter Clan
description: A tough 2D top-down shooter inspired by 《Enter the Gungeon》 and 《Hunt: Showdown》. Cleanse the fog-shrouded streets of Whitechapel, 19th-century London—Jack the Ripper’s old hunting ground—by tracking and eliminating the nightmarish creatures that roam there.

title: Three Legions: Erosion of the Abyss
description: You awaken in a space eroded by the abyss. Protect the light and press forward. Defeat the monsters within the abyss!

title: Sons of Odin
description: Sons of Odin is a tactical multiplayer card game with fast matches and shifting rules. Choose your hero, unleash godlike powers, and adapt to runes and trickster’s coins to outsmart rivals in tense and unpredictable duels

title: Tree's Love Crossing Above
description: This is a BL-themed FMV game where players will control the protagonist "Xiaoshu" make choices for him, and experience four completely different love stories. Will they lead to a sweet ending or end in regret? Every choice you make will determine the protagonist's ultimate romantic destination.

title: Re:leap-future City and Futureless
description: This is a text adventure game about time travel, developed and published by the Scorched Heaven Community. The total text volume of this work is approximately 250,000 words. It also includes more than 30 scenes. This work advances the story through mouse clicks.

title: Swing Boy
description: Swing Boy is a platformer that takes swinging to a new level. Use your grappling hook to navigate your way out of the sewers and back to the surface. What has changed since you were gone? What is left?

title: Enter the Nemesis: Blood Portal
description: In this 2.5D hack and slash shooter platformer enemy bodies will become your platform. Kill enemies to activate the portals, and build a platform of bodies to reach the exits. Stomp the bodies, crush the heads, collect blood, and snatch their weapons. Find and free the girl, then defeat the nemesis

title: One More Experiment
description: Control fire and water. Use elements, switches and the environment to solve puzzles in this futuristic puzzle-platformer!

title: Gloamryn
description: A mystical strategy game set in a world of eternal twilight.

title: Why Do Boys Play Games?
description: A 2D turn-based tactical strategy game where you create a character, join a fantasy football league, draft a team, and compete for the league championship. Make friends with your league-mates and defeat those same friends in battle to earn upgrades for your team as you also solve a greater mystery.

title: Writer Tycoon
description: Become a bestselling author in Writer Tycoon! Write books, grow your fanbase, and dominate the publishing industry. Track sales, manage multiple books at once, and adapt to trends. Will you create literary masterpieces or chase quick cash? Become a bestselling author and leave your mark!

title: Rice & Rest
description: Rice & Rest is a cozy narrative game where running a food truck leads to unexpected friendships. Cook meals and chat with quirky, heartfelt, and weird characters in a modern-fantasy city. Stuck far from home, you’ll soon find that food has a way of bringing people together.

title: Football Career Mode 26
description: Football Career Mode 26 is a straightforward football manager game. Choose a club, choose a sponsor and start your football manager career! Lead your club to the top through transfers, scouting, infrastructure updates and much more and win as many titles as possible!

title: The Witch's Realm
description: Escape and explore a mystery puzzle adventure where you must manage sanity, solve challenges, and uncover the dark secrets of a cursed town. Navigate eerie environments, find hidden objects, and survive the witch's realm.

title: Baspetball
description: When the tutors leave, the house turns into a basketball court, and the ultimate showdown begins: Cats vs. Dogs. Take control of basketball-playing cats, move, pass, and shoot a yarn ball to score baskets while outsmarting dog opponents. Explore creative strategies and make that swish!

title: Viking Breaker
description: Break through the walls of Hell and crush hordes of infernal creatures aboard your drakkar! Viking Breaker is an arcade roguelite mixing brick-breaker and bullet hell mechanics. Launch your shields, activate runes, and survive the trials of the Norse gods!

title: Ultima Chess VR
description: Ultima Chess VR – chess as you've never seen before! Battle on the chessboard in virtual reality, where every piece comes to life and engages in a fantasy duel!

title: Out of Stock!
description: Team up with your friends in this frantic 4-player co-op party game! Order, restock, scrub the floor, but most importantly, keep your customers happy, or bad reviews will pile up fast!

title: Legacy of Ancestors
description: From the primitive age to the modern era, experience nine cycles of life. Make choices through card-based events, shaping your character’s stats, relationships, and fate. A strategy-driven life simulation wrapped in satire, tracing the absurd evolution of civilization.

title: Noon Stone
description: Quick runs, endless challenges. Noon Stone is a tactical adventure with RPG elements blending procedural exploration, strategic upgrades, and dice-driven combat.

title: Iron Rain
description: Iron Rain is a race to carnage! As an AI Tank Commander you battle the Nirvana AI and her robot hordes, in this Speedy Twin-Stick Roguelike. Grow overpowered with a vast range of upgrades against a varied and unique army of enemies!

title: Figurine Shop Simulator
description: Run your own figurine shop! Order, paint, and display collectible figures, set your own prices, manage sales, and expand your store. Tournaments, mystery boxes, rare drops, and community events are just the beginning!

title: Lighting Lanterns
description: A cozy puzzly platformer about friendship, light, and small acts of kindness. Switch between three characters, light magical lanterns, and explore a gentle, narrated world.

title: Agent of Veil
description: Spies. Secrets. Puzzles. Office gossip? Puzzle your way into the covert world of espionage as a potential recruit for an elusive spy agency in Agent of Veil, a puzzle adventure. Pass an unconventional spy interview, solve puzzles, answer quirky questions and uncover the agency's secrets.

title: Qubicks
description: Qubicks is where tower defense meets roguelike as you venture across procedurally generated levels where you strategically position towers, balancing immediate survival with long-term growth. Upgrade your towers and heroes to adapt to difficult waves and ensure victory against alien inhabitants.

title: Wanderlust: The Magnificent Journey
description: See the World! Embark on a journey spanning the entire globe accompanying a group of best friends as they attempt to fulfill the lifelong dream of one of their own. A miraculous journey is set to begin, will you be accompanying them?

title: Kitty Loves Birds
description: Play as a curious cat exploring a colorful world in nature. Jump, catch birds, evade obstacles and animals, and solve simple puzzles in this charming adventure!

title: Nemorsys
description:
Nemorsys is a punishing stealth-action RPG where frontal assaults are fatal.

Forge a dark pact with an ancient wraith and hunt down the corrupted King Murab. But be warned: the power to kill comes at the cost of your humanity.

Outwit relentless enemies, manipulate light sources to create your path, and manage scarce resources in a world where every mistake is fatal.

Your light is fading. Can you master the darkness before it consumes you?

title: Lucipurr
description: Lucipurr is a multiplayer horror game. Players(1-5) try to disrupt a cult’s ritual aimed at harnessing the captivating power of cats. Meanwhile, another player controls a demonic cat and hunts them down.

title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
description: A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, ushering in a new era of mysticism.

title: Aesop Rock's Black Hole Superette Experience
description: A surreal first-person exploration game where you roam a fictional convenience store, collect hidden audio fragments, and unlock cryptic wisdom. Sample the full Black Hole Superette album, discover hidden easter eggs, and dive into a twisted soundscape of interactive hip-hop absurdity.

title: IT Specialist Simulator
description: Step into the world of IT! Diagnose network issues, manage servers, and repair devices while handling tasks under strict SLAs. Choose your career path, from HelpDesk to IT Project Manager. Develop real IT knowledge and climb the ranks in this realistic IT simulation!

title: Bearstone Campsite
description: Bearstone Campsite, a tourism project launched by the state, closed its doors shortly after a mysterious incident occurred. Now, this abandoned facility is transforming into a world filled with unknown dangers and forgotten secrets, far beyond its former glory.

title: The Land of Rest 1
description: The Lands of Rest 1: Part 1 is a story-driven game that narrates the life of Bipara in the Underground Realm.

title: Tiny Eden
description: Tiny Eden is a cozy first-person farming simulation set in a futuristic city. Players grow flowers, berries, and vegetables inside an apartment, selecting planters and soil mixtures and managing light, temperature, watering, and weeds. Harvests can be sold or used to cook meals for the building's residents. Earnings unlock additional rooms, balconies, and a rooftop greenhouse, while furniture, decorations, and a pet cat help make the expanding garden feel like home.

title: Game
description: A journey through the life of a champion player of a cryptic and bizarre sport. The dialogue choices you make will determine the path your life takes, and the ultimate conclusion to your story.

title: Beasties' Shelter
description: In **Beasties Shelter**, care for adorable pets like Golden Retrievers and other dog breeds. Feed them, give them medicine, and keep them happy. Also, look after cute stray cats and kittens. Build your shelter, rescue new animals, and create a loving home for your furry friends!

title: Flan's BN
description: 《Flan's BN》is the prequel to 《Flan's MS》, which combines JRPG and deckbuilder mechanics. Experience Flan's story of self-discovery

title: ApocaShift
description: ApocaShift is a dynamic roguelite extraction looter set in a constantly evolving apocalyptic world. The environment shifts based on in-game events and decisions, offering fresh challenges and opportunities with each playthrough.

title: Pixelegend
description: In this fantasy world, you will become an adventurer, gradually understanding the world, becoming stronger through weapons and equipment, and gradually resolving various crises.

title: Super Movie Tycoon
description: Become a movie mogul in Super Movie Tycoon! From script to screen, build your dream team and create blockbusters to conquer Hollywood!

title: Multi Deck Hero
description: Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command three unique decks to create powerful synergies. Strategically combine cards, unlock game-changing charms, and battle against increasingly powerful enemies. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the challenge?

title: Pas's restaurant
description: In a fantasy world, become magical cat Pas. Run your restaurant, serve creatures, make friends. Explore mazes, map them, find hidden food to enrich your menu. Meet friends, hear their stories. Pas's Restaurant eagerly awaits you to co-write this warm fantasy chapter.

title: Letters of Longing
description: It's a first-person game in which you'll have to find your way around a decaying building to find the information you've been sent to find. But along the way you might find something else.

title: Mushroom Hunter World
description: Go to the forest to collect as many mushrooms as possible! Will you be able to fill your basket to the brim? Develop your attentiveness, collect a variety of mushrooms and compete for the title of the best mushroom picker.

title: Prism Warriors DX
description: The Prism Warriors return for another helping of retro-styled bullet hell action. Face off against the sinister Twilight Four, and fight to save more than just your friends...

title: Elemental Labyrinth
description: Build your own maze, summon random elemental Spirits, and fuse them into powerful forms to stop relentless enemy waves.

title: Oddli: A Satisfying Game
description: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

title: Zima
description: A cozy pixel art RPG in a winter setting about a young woman who discovers her true purpose and combats a growing threat... Protect the Sacred Grotto and ensure that you are not overcome by the relentless cold!

title: Arcadie II: Cold Lands
description: You are the Monarch. Protect your rule and your kingdom. Pursue the heart of your chosen lover, manage fragile alliances, or bring the world to heel, no matter the cost, in this character-driven interactive tale. The choice, and the crown, are yours.

title: The Vineyard
description: The Vineyard is a psychological survival horror game set in a cursed wine estate. Escape the twisted halls of the Sangnoire Mansion, solve vintage mechanical puzzles, and survive the hunt of a deranged vineyard master whose madness taints reality itself.

title: Survivesmith
description: Reverse bullet-hell game with a crafting twist. Shoot hails of bullets, missiles, nails, lasers and whatever is at your disposal at your enemies and make tactical choices to overcome all obstacles. You are here to find and extract the 'Life Essence', and you're not leaving without it!

title: Gumshoe Detective Agency: The First Case
description: Use a 90s computer interface to search online articles, collect clues, and navigate office politics in a police procedural-style investigation to solve the case of a missing heiress in Gumshoe Detective Agency: The First Case.

title: Vampires Die
description: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

title: Path to the Void
description: Path to the Void is a “Diablo-like” gear-driven loot game with slight roguelike component. Fight and survive, uncover bizarre and wondrous gear and embrace the endless challenge. Dominate the ever-shifting chaos with your own unique builds and try to get yourself shown on the leaderboard!

title: Mech Assembler: Model Kit Builder Simulator
description: Welcome to Mech Assembler, a relaxing puzzle game inspired by model kit (Gunpla) construction. You'll experience the relaxing process of building a model. Once assembled, you can paint it with Spry. Earn points based on your accuracy and unlock new elements.

title: Void Protocol
description: Void Protocol is a single-player horror adventure game set in the eerie future. Solve interesting puzzles, while hiding from insidious horrors waiting for you in the shadows.

title: Strike & Resist
description: Explore randomly generated thrilling Souls-like levels. Strike and resist powerful enemies with rich combat mechanisms. Make full use of any loot you happen to get. Start over if you die.

title: After Juice: Animal Disco Mafia
description: Welcome to this graphic adventure! You play as a little hamster named Tofu. You will join him on a series of adventures trough university nights, in a city full of parties and mistery, tons of humor and bad jokes, but above all..... Dru.... i mean, SUGAR!

title: The Blessing of Airon
description: The Blessing of Airon is a First Person Story Adventure (Walking Sim) telling the story of a society which has lost access to all electronic devices capable of processing a neural network due to demon infestation. It is a horror game which focuses on exploration and uncovering mysterious events through a large variety of inspectable items with story text, custom sounds and vfx.

title: Total Fucking Psychopath
description:
A freeware faux retro arcade game that plays like the earlier GTA games (minus automobiles) and has similar satirical themeing like Postal and Hatred.

Your main weapon is a knife, but you can also find other power-ups such as steroids to increase stabbing damage, painkillers to recover health, and pipe bombs to kill a large number of people at once (added in version 2.0). You have a "psychosis meter" that decreases all the time, and if it reaches zero it dawns upon you what horrible deeds you have done and you end your own life. The only way to increase it is to kill. The more people you kill, the more police officers are sent after you to take you out.

title: Es Un Día Normal y Eso Es Casi Milagroso
description: Mom has been at the dentist for too long, so Little Girl and Boy go looking for her.

title: Loot Profit
description: Merchant Simulator. It seems simple enough — buy low, sell high. But in this world, almost everyone’s out to swindle each other...

title: Boba Cafe Simulator
description: Reborn at my venture's start. Last life, poor management got my milk tea shop crushed by rivals. At the door, sweet milk scent hit me, fired me up. Now, "Frost Citadel" aims to haunt the milk tea world. With my friend, we’ll set up to rule this street.

title: No Man's Home
description: You wander into the dangerous Asran Exclusion Zone. You will have to survive hunger, thirst, dangerous factions, radioactive emissions and the wild life. Remember, this is no man's home and you are not the hero.

title: Amalgoom
description: Amalgoom is a megawad project based on the theme of making brand new levels by combining together maps from Doom & Doom II. The project is a homage to the original games and its creators.

title: Walk of Life
description: Walk of Life is a competitive life simulator for up to 6 players! Choose from a cast of unique roles and duke it out with your friends, bots, or by yourself, in this wacky and ever-surprising party game!

title: Perfect Circle: Stand Alone
description:
Millie thinks her mom must be dying.

A short collection of scenes following three mothers and their children as they grow up through the years.

title: Exit Ways
description: Test your luck in the extraction shooter with survival elements. Build your camp, exterminate the contaminated and evacuate the civilians.

title: Hero Stickman
description: Hero Stickman is an action-packed fighting game where players take on the role of a powerful stickman warrior, battling through intense levels filled with enemies, challenges, and epic boss fights.

title: Idle Awakening: Mages Path
description: Embark on a journey of a fledgling mage. Start with nothing. Improve yourself, develop your skills through a vast tree, unlock upgrades, learn spells, gather resources, and craft unique items. Your progress never stops – it continues even while you're offline.

title: Lotus: Lost Memories
description: Step into the richly woven tale of Atsushi, a young samurai bound by duty to his ailing father. Undertake a journey of purpose as he faces skilled adversaries and uncovers the echoes of a legacy that will shape his destiny. Realized in a pixel art visual novel with turn based combat.

title: Tombers
description: A immersive plataform game

title: JRoguePG
description: A Roguelike JRPG. Fight progressively harder battles, unlock classes, engage with an deep and finely-balanced battle system, explore 25 unique biomes, and slowly earn power and knowledge. How many generations of heroes will you sacrifice to rid the world of evil? Perfect for the Steam Deck!

title: Beacon of Hope
description: Hope Inc is a narrative platformer set in a frozen post-apocalyptic world. Explore crumbling buildings, fight against marauders, and unite with those who uphold morality.

title: Twenty Six
description: Twenty Six is an arcade action game where you play the same game across the multiverse! Move between different verses and see how things change, and reach the final verse!

title: Milly's Meadow
description: A relaxing idle game that lives on your desktop. Watch Milly tend to her meadow by raking leaves, taking cozy naps, enjoying activities and having a peaceful life. Customise Milly’s world and enjoy the calming ambience right on your screen, whether you’re working or unwinding.

title: Cendovia Uprising
description: A sci-fi turn-based strategy game where you battle to conquer Cendovia. Choose your faction and combat style. Grow your army as you expand your territory. Customize your decks for each encounter as you adapt to the ever changing terrain. Put your troops to work or bring them into battle.

title: Lazy Writer
description: A story-driven simulator of a writer who is too lazy to work. Find motivation to write, make friends, and overcome endless challenges.

title: Days with My Lonely Teacher
description: Study Miss Si’s routine and create "chance" encounters with her! As a student failing in all subjects and having rent and credit card bills due every week, you have to do everything you can to win over the beautiful teacher before graduation, making her leave her boyfriend and become your lover!

title: Deck of Destiny: Battleforge
description: "Deck of Destiny: Battleforge calls you to write your own legend in an endless battle! In this game that combines strategy, action, and roguelike deck-building elements, survive on the thin line between chance and strategy, shape your destiny, and become a legendary warrior!"

title: Doom 64 Reloaded
description:
Doom 64 Reloaded Remaster is a fully enhanced version of the Night Dive Remaster of Doom 64 for PC.

Reloaded strives to show what Doom 64 would have looked like on the N64 if it had not been restricted to an 8meg cart. Reloaded would need a 75meg cart.
The main campaign now has 44 levels.
With the addition of a 4 level speed-run challenge that replaces the 'Lost Levels'
There's heaps of new structural detailing and new textures. Sector based lighting has been used to cast shadows and to make horizontal soft lighting.
No additional lighting filters are used. This is everything the original engine could have shown you on the N64.

title: AV Director Life!
description: AV production simulation game you can freely film, edit, and sell your creations! Work with charming heroines to produce top-tier masterpieces, boost your reputation, and grow your sales. Striving to pay off your debts, take on the fiery challenge of reaching the top of the industry as a director!

title: The Dance of Maple Leaves
description: The Dance of Maple Leaves Single-player role-playing combat game Gameplay 1: Open-world exploration map, dungeon maps, and world boss battles. Gameplay 2: Equipment upgrade system, equipment identification system. Gameplay 3: Quest system

title: Pentaloop
description: “PENTALOOP” is, a GM-less Murder Mystery game for 4 players. Play with family, friends, and like-minded people, Play together with your family, friends, or other like-minded people.

title: Love Mansion
description: As Akari's private tutor, manage her lessons and prepare her for success—all while uncovering the secrets of four captivating women in her family's luxurious mansion.

title: Backyard Digger
description: A chill game about digging in the backyard of your home. Find precious metals, explore caves, avoid dangers, and upgrade your equipment as you dig deeper and deeper.

title: The Hundred Youkai Master
description: No shikigami. No spells. Only wit—and a hundred yokai. Sei, a girl without onmyo powers, ends up leading a legion of yokai she once saved by chance. Assemble your Hyakki Yagyō and face terrifying foes with strategy alone. A punishing, high-difficulty command-based RPG awaits!

title: Tretrais
description: In the near future, our player passes by Mars, the shuttle malfunctions and the player falls to Mars in an escape pod. Immediately after the crash you realize that something extraordinary is happening on Mars and you start the great Tretrais mission.

title: Fire Burning City
description: Turn-Based + Survivor-Like?Play as a agent in a burning cyberpunk city! Strategize grid-by-grid, unleash skills to clear waves of enemies, and survive escalating challenges. Uncover secrets behind the chaos with simple, tactical moves. Can you outsmart the flames?

title: Doomclock
description: Doomclock is a roguelite, top-down arena shooter with deckbuilding elements. Bathe in blood of the damned, unlock new cards, and craft your deck of heavenly and hellish powers to survive the apocalypse. Be quick or be dead — there’s no time to rest.

title: Bumble Rumble
description: Gather bees to fight hordes of enemies in this RogueLike TowerDefense, collecting various relics to become the most powerful and defeat all those who get in your way.

title: Success in Progress
description: Become a brave tomato soldier on a quest to invade salads! In this challenging precision platformer, falling isn’t the end—it’s part of the journey. Each splash you make clears your path to victory. Remember: failure is just Success In Progress!

title: Nietzsche's Shadow
description: A philosophical horror experience in the Alps: As Friedrich Nietzsche confronts his own shadow, he becomes lost between layers of reality.

title: Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start
description: Sweet Start is the perfect introduction to the world of Candy Shop Simulator, designed for players who want to dive into the sweet universe of the game and get familiar with its foundations before experiencing the full version

title: Fantasy Monster Hunt
description: Ultra-massive hordes of monsters are invading! Select heroes, choose upgrades, collect relics, and strategically deploy skills to prevent the monsters from reaching the defensive line. Each match lasts 10 minutes.

title: Cleaner Company
description: You have officially joined the elite team of "Star Wipers"! Your mission? Cleaning! Alongside your trusted crew, you will embark on exciting expeditions to abandoned space stations, ruined restaurants in the cosmos, and unexplored planets.

title: Lustful Butler and Charming Sisters
description: Lustful Butler And Charming Sisters is a narrative and casual card game. In this game, all charming girls hope to come to this nightclub for vacation and enjoy the unique massage service. Enjoy this sweet time with them!

title: Cosy Company Puzzle
description: In this colorful 2D puzzle game, you take care of the employees in your small company by placing them on the grid according to their shape — and their specific preferences. The story of Cosy Company Puzzle will unfold gradually across 90 handcrafted levels.

title: Fuck Fest
description: Explore the steamy world of "Fuck Fest," a find 5 differences game with 10,000+ levels. Spot differences in seductive scenes, unlock sizzling Kamasutra stickers, and indulge in endless tropical fantasies.

title: Corridor Exit 8
description: A first-person psychological horror game based on tension and perception testing. You walk through an endless corridor, noticing anomalies around you and trying to make the right decision at every step. Escape is possible with eight correct choices, but one mistake will start everything over.

title: Broken Paradox
description: The mad man watches, waits and never lets his prey go free.

title: Doll INC
description: Sort, decide, and obey. Doll Inc is a haunting job simulator where your judgment determines the fate of every product. Are you precise… or replaceable?

title: Dillo's Dilemma
description: Play as Dillo, a clever armadillo with pinball contraptions, in this thrilling 3D physics collectathon! Roll through vivid, expansive worlds, conquer dynamic puzzles, and smash the Rat King’s mighty forts. Rally your brave firefly friends to overcome challenges and save the day!

title: Keepers of the Keep
description: When a thief comes to The Keep, only to be captured and forced to work off their debt, they must now make a new life for themselves in a strange new town.

title: Stamps ‘n Papers
description: A Game about Falsifying Documents: create forgeries by assembling collages from vintage newspaper clippings to match your client’s specifications (IDs, passports, driver’s licenses). Stamps 'n Papers was a Crossing Latitudes 2025 Game Jam submission.

title: Fire in the Dark
description: Online duel isometric arena-shooter where the best witch wins! Use the power of fire and ice, navigate the shadows and hidings to defeat your opponent in a duel in the darkness. Use the light, hide in a bush, and show your friend who's the best witch in town!

title: Up to Divine
description: You - our best test driver. And this - the latest development, the legendary Niva, which we have brought to perfection. The car turned out to be such that God himself ordered it from us. Your task is to pass the final test and deliver it to the gates of heaven. Only then will it become truly divine.

title: Village Tale
description: A relaxing idle village-building simulator nestled in the corner of your screen! Build, Craft, and Trade to guide your village from humble beginnings to a thriving trading hub, it's time to write your own Village Tale!

title: You Sure Wanna Drink This?
description: Dive into a whimsical turn-based RPG where logic meets alchemy! When a mysterious force steals all potion-making knowledge, you’ll master remedies on the fly! Analyze bizarre ingredients, reverse-engineer their effects, and craft tactical potions to outsmart enemies.

title: Diner Bros 2
description: The Diner Bros are back! With the same hectic cooking and serving, and now customization of your bustling restaurant! Serve quirky customers, earn cash to buy equipment, and discover new recipes in Diner Bros 2. Team up for 4 player local co-operative fun. No friends? Hire servers!

title: Lakeside Bar
description: A cozy management sim where the jazz is smooth, the cocktails are cooler than the evening breeze, and the lake reflects your perfect escape.

title: Ghost Shock
description: Switch roles between heroes and monsters to fight, become the embodiment of justice or let evil rule, everything is possible.

title: Grapple Car
description: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

title: Escape Roomble
description: Sabotage, Set traps, Sneak through secret passages and lie to avoid expulsion, while up to other 3-11 players try to collaborate to solve the Escape Room challenges in this first person, multiplayer online, coop, Social Deduction game set in a procedurally generated Pyramid.

title: Robot Rhapsody
description: A futurist fairytale exploring AI themes, technology, existentialism, and strange transformations in a suffering world. A retro-inspired JRPG presentation of a modernist, character-driven drama.

title: The 18th Attic
description: The 18th Attic is a psychological horror game where you play as a man trapped in a loop, armed with an instant picture camera. Hunt down paranormal anomalies lurking around by taking their pictures and detecting their presence to unravel secrets of your past. Each photo unlocks a new memory.

title: Parable Academy
description: A one-button fighter that'll have you hitting the books! Legends from classic fiction clash in 3 vs 3 tag battles. Unlock fighters in single-player skill challenges, then put your combos to the test in online play. Simple enough for newcomers to pick up, but plenty of strategic depth to be found!

title: Fresh Catch!
description:
Can you become a master diver and catch legendary fish?

Dive into the depths and prove you can get the freshest of catches!

title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
description: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

title: Photographer's Life Simulator
description: Photographer's Life Simulator lets players manage their own photography business, from selecting equipment to fulfilling client requests. Players handle every aspect of running a photo studio, including portrait sessions, themed photoshoots, print services, and album creation, while expanding their business through both in-person and online orders.

title: Harmony in the Wild
description: Nature's balance lies in the paws of a transforming fox pup. During a magical open-world adventure, you learn abilities from animal friends and glide, swim and leap across diverse landscapes uncovering the mystery of dying nature. As you progress, storybook pages turn, revealing your destiny.

title: Landlord
description: "Landlord Chess" turns the ever-changing strategies in card games into visual scenarios, makes it more like playing chess or Sudoku. It includes a single-player mode and a multiplayer online mode, while also integrating a leaderboard and an achievement system.

title: Moving Simulator
description: Dive into the ultimate moving experience in Moving Simulator! Manage chaotic house moves, carefully pack belongings, load trucks, and navigate through hilarious disasters. Precision, speed, and creativity will make you a moving master!

title: Uno: Arcade Edition
description: Uno ported to Apple Arcade.

title: Numbra
description: In a desolate and ominous world, a young girl faces dark creatures that lurk in every shadow. With each step, the danger grows. But there is only one rule: stay awake.

title: Gas Station Simulator: RV Camp
description: Step into the shoes of a campground manager in the brand-new RV Camp DLC for Gas Station Simulator. Rent out spots to travelers and complete diverse minigames to help them while away the hours. Expand your campsite, tackle various challenges, and help Ruby create the best resort the world has ever seen.

title: Crab Hunt
description: You’re an alien octopus who crash landed on Crab Island, where you discover your taste for crabs and hip clothing. Your goal is to find your spaceship but juicy crabs are in the way.

title: The Fortress
description: The Fortress is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler with turn-based combat, mixing strategy and risk. Choose a class, delve into cursed chambers, roll dice to fight brutal enemies, and grab loot. Face tough choices, survive epic bosses, and fight to escape... or fall to the shadows

title: Biogenesis
description: Detective Jodie follows the trail of Madeline to the enigmatic Ravenwood Hotel, a place full of secrets. Solve puzzles, manage a classic inventory, and face deadly enemies and bosses. Explore side missions to gain combat advantages. Every corner brings you closer to the truth.

title: After Lights Out
description: After Lights Out is a first person psychological horror game. Players will explore a terrifying house that keeps changing in the dark. Use the lights to solve the puzzles and uncover the hidden truth in the room.

title: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
description: Run a meatball restaurant in this high energy comedic cooking game. Meet quirky locals and cook their wild orders, upgrade and customize your restaurant, win thrilling cooking battles, and become the town’s top eatery!

title: Forbidden Offering
description: Forbidden Offering is an isometric roguelite survivor game. Stop the dark ritual, carve your path through hordes of monsters, and save the girl. Can you survive the ordeal?

title: Sips and Sonnets
description: Run a tea shop in the British countryside and enkindle your love for poetry in this heartfelt visual novel. Play as Ms Meadows, retired journalist and tea enthusiast, as she prepares for her best friend’s long-awaited visit. Listen to customers’ stories, brew tea, and craft wholehearted poems.

title: Alter Psycho
description: No one ever listened to you. Because they never truly knew you. Now the forest whispers, the fire rises, and they all watch you. Could you be innocent, or are you merely a well-hidden disaster?

title: Love Me
description: Kimino sneaks into her highschool late at night under the pretense that there, she can finally find happiness through love. What she finds instead, is a labyrinthine assortment of lockers sprawling with inexplicable horrors.

title: Dwarf Digger
description: Dig, discover, and survive! In Dwarf Digger, you build your own underground empire, unearth precious treasures, battle hidden dangers, and trade with fellow dwarves. Will you carve your legend deep beneath the earth?

title: Pegshot: Vendetta
description: Pegshot: Vendetta blends peggle, roguelike, and turn-based combat in a thrilling underworld of crime. Acquire powerful bullets and unique gear with distinct abilities that can alter the game’s physics. Ready for a journey of revenge against formidable gangsters!

title: Whispers of the Hourglass
description: After your mysterious death, you awaken as a ghost, drawn to the relics of a forgotten war between thieves and pirates. Shift between timelines and uncover the truth behind the war and death.

title: Deck of Stabs
description: Every card is a weapon. Every decision matters. Battle through strange worlds and dangerous dungeons. Discover exotic weapons, powerful gear, and deadly skills. Burn, curse, explode, and smash your way to victory. Every run is different—just bring your best blades.

title: Deeper You Go
description: You control a camera that goes down into a deep hole. More horrors you'll face, the deeper you go.

title: Air Master Hanemaru
description: Control Hanemaru, a round creature with small wings, and jump across floating platforms! Use jumps, glides, and various actions to clear thrilling obstacles. Precision and skill are key—can you overcome every challenge?

title: Proxy Adventure: Simulation Room
description: Simulation Room is a fast-paced 2D auto-battler with deck-building mechanics. Unleash powerful program combos, upgrade abilities, summon allies, and equip weapons. Control the battlefield by altering terrain and weather, using gadgets to outsmart enemies. Every move counts—strategize and dominate!

title: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition
description:
Edition includes:
• Stellar Blade
• Planet Diving Suit (Captain) for EVE
• Fluffy Bear Pack for the Drone

Bonus content:
• Stargazer Suit for EVE
• Half-rim Glasses for EVE
• Quadruple Rectangle Earrings for EVE
• Stargazer Coat for Lily
• Stargazer Wear for Adam
• Stargazer Pack for the Drone
• 2,000 SP EXP
• 5,000 Gold in-game currency

Stellar Blade: Twin Expansion Pack:
• Stellar Blade x NieR:Automata
• Stellar Blade x GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE

• Outfit CD-KEY to redeem time-limited Stellar Blade costume in GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE free-to-play mobile game from Shift Up

title: Cube Mind
description: Cube Mind is a challenging first-person puzzle game with a futuristic and minimalist aesthetic. Solve interconnected rooms using logic, precision, and creativity in a world where every action matters.

title: Blind Touch
description: Blind Simulator, offering a new perspective and immersive sensory experience. Step into a world of darkness using your guide cane.

title: No Gods of Men
description: Rebuild a towering citadel, manage your disciples, and slash through waves of enemies in a hand-drawn world that combines roguelike metroidvania gameplay with base-building & colony management.

title: Bank
description: A block-pushing puzzle game that mixes levels of both long term strategic planning and of timing and skill. Collect money and bombs, blow up walls, situate bombs in chain reactions, block monsters, and make your way to the finish.

title: Ex Sanguis
description: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

title: Jackplot
description:
Jackplot was born during an internal game jam at Typing Monke. The idea was simple but captivating, and after validating the concept, we decided to expand it into a full-fledged project.

However, just a week into development, a game eerily similar to ours surfaced. Instead of competing with an existing title, we chose to pivot to a fresh idea. But rather than let the work we’d done go to waste, we’re sharing Jackplot here on Itch.io as a snapshot of our creative journey.

title: Pirate Parakeet
description: Pirate Parakeet is a daring pirate themed 3D platformer. Navigate the ocean using Pirate Parakeet's ship, the Daring Feather. Slash your way through multiple islands to find treasure. Are you ready to face the challenges of the sea?

title: Last Guest
description: Last Guest is a first-person psychological horror game. You are a tired traveler who stops at a creepy roadside motel. The motel on the highway seems normal at first glance, but only at first glance. Strange staff and rumors about room 8 will make you question the reality of what is happening.

title: A Super Mario Bros X. Level Collection
description: Join Mario and explore 20+ imaginative levels! From boiling factories to celestial canyons, frozen peaks to haunted casinos, you'll discover something new in every level! Run, jump & collect Power Stars in this SMBX Level Collection, out now!

title: Clown Is Hungry
description: Clown Is Hungry is a comedy horror game about delivering a pizza to a hungry clown.

title: Minecraft Backrooms Found Footage
description: Minecraft Found Footage is a mod that aims to bring the feeling and aesthetic of "Found Footage" videos to Minecraft

title: Time Sliper
description: A platformer game that includes time sliping and pogo.

title: Lustra: Lachea’s Tale
description:
LUSTRA: Lachea’s Tale is a story-rich RPG that combines real-time spellcasting, exploration, and settlement building, set in a fractured floating island realm where ancient magic and mystery intertwine.

Play as Lachea, a young mage shaped by the world around her, learning to lead, grow, and take control of her path in a land suspended between ruin and renewal.

Lustra invites players to see the world through multiple perspectives, to reflect on morality, empathy, and responsibility, and to shape not just the outcome of a magical world, but the kind of person Lachea becomes along the way.

title: Bleb
description: Bleb is a platformer in which you will have to think, jump and die! You'll encounter a variety of levels, ranging from simple platforms to epic boss battles. Immerse yourself in a black and white adventure that will break your brain.

title: Outta Hell
description: OUTTA HELL is an action-packed FPS set in haunting and stunning dimensions of the afterlife. Explore and fight for your life. Redeem your past.

title: No Way Home: Blammo!
description: No Way Home: BLAMMO! is a tactical arcade roguelite that's all about fast-paced twin stick space combat. Every run is a new adventure!

title: Fill Up the Hole
description: Fill Up The Hole is a short incremental game where you help peons create as much garbage as possible and toss it into a hole. Watch your village grow and evolve as you unlock visual upgrades and new features.

title: Roguecraft DX
description: The modern Amiga hit, winner of the Retro World Award at the 2025 Debug Indie Game Awards, comes to Evercade in an all-new expanded, enhanced form!

title: Phantom Streets
description:
Located in the west of the city, Hialeon is one of Vesper City's most bustling districts. With its dense residential areas, local businesses, industrial zones, and underground connections, Hialeon holds a significant place in the city's criminal underworld.
While ordinary city life prevails during the day, street races, illicit dealings, and criminal organizations reveal Hialeon's true face at night.

title: Dog Gone Cats: Tail of 300 Days (Pawlike Edition)
description: "Roguelike inspired puzzle adventure! Help Cosmo the dog protect Stella from catnappers across 300 deadly levels. Avoid traps in hidden grids, use magic yarn balls, and survive with just 30 lives!"

title: Palette Cleanser
description: Palette Cleanser is a free, short, Action-Adventure experience, featuring exploration and a quick, paint-boosting moveset. Explore a once-colorful garden, restoring its stolen hues by stopping the color-hungry invaders!

title: Shadows of Teotihuacan
description: Explore ancient megalith of Teotihuacan as the detective tasked with finding a missing person.

title: Card Shop Simulator Multiplayer
description: You and your friends are going to compete to see whose card shop can earn more money! Starting from a humble little shop, decorate your store, hire staff, formulate marketing strategies. Finally, use the coolest cards to engage in card battles, and win away your friend's precious cards!

title: Desk Garden
