description: Relax and grow! A laid-back idle game where you nurture mysterious plants (some even human-like!), watch them flourish, then sell them to expand your magical garden. Design your own unique oasis at your own pace.

title: Stu the Fisherman
description: Stu the fisherman is a fishing rogue-lite experience like no other. Buy mysterious items from a hooded figure that enhance the value of your haul, help to fix the town and discover the mysteries of the sky fish, the sea fish and the people who just might know it all.

title: Blitzkrieg Express
description: Survive and defend your land against the armored train in this arcade achievement-attack puzzle. Think smart, find the right sequence to create combos by destroying wagons with different bonuses to speed up and boost your cannon, and stop the train before it stops you.

title: Battle Against the Acolytes of Science
description: A story-driven 2D bullet hell shooter set in the afterlife. An emotional journey of young heroines as they confront the science worshippers known as "Chemistians" Vibrant pixel art vividly portrays the world and narrative. "Welcome to 'The Crystal Palace'..."

title: Space Fighter: Code 1999
description: It's a shooting game with a space background. Destroy a certain number of enemies and clear the level until you clear it. Enemies appear randomly, and each time you play it has a different experience. Welcome to discover more secrets in the game.

title: Rebirth: I Became the Emperor of America by Creating Toktik
description: In my past life, I was a broke, repressed code monkey—laid off, heartbroken, a full-on loser. My life was a running joke. In this life, I started as a dishwasher, created FakeTok, ran for president, and rose to become the Emperor of America!

title: Walk of Fire
description: Maneuver your way through the "Trial of Embers", "Path of Flames" and the "Tower of Fire" without touching any flames --- or suffer an fiery fate!

title: Rumble Burst
description: Smash your limits. The infinite chain-reaction battle begins! Blast away waves of enemies in this exhilarating hack & smash action! Chain your attacks, unleash unstoppable combos, and dive into wave-based survival with randomized skill builds and ever-changing strategies!

title: Three Days After the Murderer
description: Play the ghost of the protagonist Sun Shuling and, within the last 72 hours of your "life", keep getting closer to the murderer's hideout by entering dreams, eavesdropping, peeping, and guiding your beloved cat to collect clues.

title: Fugue Shot: Minigame Roguelike
description:
Trapped in an ever-shifting dream, you must face a gauntlet of distorted arcade challenges, from frantic combat to puzzling trials. Conquer the Omens, break the cycle, and escape this place.

Each run in Fugue Shot presents a dreamscape filled with difficult encounters, puzzles, and challenges. Face the Omens and collect synergistic items to shift the dreamscape and your playstyle. Can you overcome the unstable terrain of this liminal world, or will you be consumed by it?

title: Bon's Origins
description:
"There was surprisingly a lot to do today... I'm exhausted."

This short game is the beginning of everything. It tells the story of a lonely man whose evening would turn into a catastrophe if it wasn't for one thing. The events that occurred would not only change his mood, but the life he has been living up until now. Play the game to find out more about his fate.

title: Soviet Survival
description: Soviet Survival is an isometric, open-world survival game where you must find your place in the ruined Soviet Union.

title: Room 808
description: Room 808 is a surreal horror game where you wander endless hotel halls in search of your room. Something feels off. Spot the anomalies, and try to get to your room before the hotel halls trap you forever.

title: Pandas Contrast
description: A relaxing game of spot-the-difference with adorable pandas.

title: Apocalypse of the Universe
description: In Apocalypse of Universe, players step into the shoes of an elf hero on a mission to save his homeland from a demonic invasion.

title: Fary's Cabin in the Tangled Woods
description: A short game about untangling puzzles

title: Fingerdance
description: The game that simply confuses your fingers.

title: Empire Game
description: Strategic game inspired by "Heroes of Might and Magic" & "Hero's Hour" with auto-battler combat. Multiple races embody real-world civilizations (China, France, etc.). Randomly generated maps ensure unique playthroughs. Adapt, expand, and conquer in a dynamic world!

title: Questwood
description: Fight, loot, and explore procedurally generated forests, alone or with friends in splitscreen co-op! Play as the Archer, Bomber, Spartan, or Wizard, find powerful weapons, and build a deck of modifier cards. Can you survive the forest and defeat the cursed tree?

title: Fishtopia
description: FISHTOPIA is a pixel art style casual game blending idle gameplay with card collection. Discover 12 card types with special effects, featuring 300+ unique creatures and 100+ decorative items. Mix and match vibrant themes to craft your cyberpunk aquatic world.

title: Hunter Roulette
description: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the underground survivor's showdown! All you need is a locked-and-loaded gun and the guts to stare death in the face to have the time of your life. Ready or not, this isn’t just any gamble—it’s your one shot at survival and rebirth. The hunt starts now！Good luck!

title: Capsoul
description: Capsy - a cheeky capsule with a moustache and stylish shower cap - faces ruthless Thornark in a fateful showdown. In this hardcore platformer with scarce lives, master diverse weapons and slick abilities to overcome relentless challenges.

title: Bestia Forge
description: idle RPG blending monster taming, sect management, and Nine Realms cultivation. Features lifespan countdown survival, Five Elements forging, Evolution Tower mechanics, dynamic storytelling with permanent NPC deaths, and strategic ecosystem building

title: Yokai Tales
description: A Roguelite JRPG set in Japanese folklore, where you can transform into your enemies!

title: Bobbies Evolution
description: Can you manage a civilisation with taxes, political wars, race wars and pandemics?

title: Congruence
description: A simple, yet difficult puzzle game. Manipulate two pairs of pentominoes to form combined shapes with the same outline. There are 513 different solutions.

title: Galactic Prospectors
description: Galactic Prospectors is a 2D Space Survival Sandbox set 200 years in the future when all planets in the solar system were destroyed by a rogue AI (you can play as the Rogue AI, or as a regular Astronaut out in the universe). Take on the universe against rogue AIs, other humans and other life forms, all while trying to stay alive. Even as an AI if you wish to play as such, you too must survive the harsh elements of Space. Resources are still needed, requiring you to build factories, upgrade and maintain your ships and stations, and to live.

title: XWVM
description: XWVM is a facilitator app to play Star Wars: X-Wing from LucasArts and Totally Games. It is a recreation of the infrastructure that runs the original missions, campaigns and cutscenes, and 3D models from scratch, (atop of the Unity game engine). At the same time, XWVM aims to rework, refine, restore, or reimagine some components of the original to make the game more appropriate for contemporary times.

title: Pomegranate Housing Complex
description: Take on the role of a daytime security guard in a cursed apartment complex. Monitor residents, greet guests, and handle strange incidents—just make sure to follow the rules.

title: Excoverse
description: A story-driven action RPG where you play as a noble lord torn between rescuing his lost daughter and leading a dying nation. fast combat, stealth, moral choices, and anime-style intensity await.

title: Dreamscape Island
description: Dreamscape Island is a cozy game that combines simple survival elements, exploring mysterious islands, fixing ruined villages, and helping those greedy unicorns. Yes... We have unicorns and they care only about money.

title: Rolly
description: Rolly: Is a 3D physics platformer, Balance the tiny ball and jump between platforms while having a little adventure.

title: The Yard of Solace
description: "The Yard of Solace." is an exploration and life-simulation story-based adventure game. Experience the girl's life and growth across four seasons in an underground sanatorium. Through your choices and actions, witness the different futures that unfold for her.

title: Love to Live
description: Trapped in a game of dreams, where the price of failing to escape is eternal slumber. Across shifting worlds, you meet 'him.' Is he merely a kindred spirit born of crisis, or a forgotten soul from your distant memories? A heart-pounding romance adventure across the dreamscape—begins now!

title: Obliterator-x
description: A chaotic tower defense roguelike where scavenging is survival and death is just the beginning. Build, blast, and upgrade your way through mutant hordes, unlock new weapons, and assign combat drones to adapt your strategy every run.

title: Manalia Notes: A Memory of Innocence
description: 2D Shooting Game × A Brick Breaker! Embark on an adventure with the wizards Phurl, Eire, and Till!

title: Emojis Battle
description: Emojis Battle is a Tower Defense game where you build your army of Yellow Emojis to match your strategy. Strengthen them to fight Bluemojis, who grow stronger each round, requiring you to adjust to new types of Bluemojis and battle locations. Develop strategies, enhance your army, and make history!

title: Tank Core
description: "Tank Core" is a 2D top-down shooter game infused with Roguelike elements. Players will collect various random tank components in levels, including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores, to assemble unique tanks that will protect base and defeat all enemies encountered.

title: Sky Dreamer
description: Sky Dreamer blends sci-fi adventure with relaxed productivity. Use a customizable Pomodoro timer and to-do lists to stay on task as floating cities grow and futuristic landscapes inspire you. Discover soothing sounds and dynamic challenges to keep you focused and motivated!

title: Followers of Krow
description: Possess yourself an adventurer in this roguelike autobattler! Train their bodies, teach them powerful abilities, explore the world of fantasy to find them powerful equipment, ancient runes and relics. Seek out your enemies and... whether they die is up to Krow.

title: Auridia
description: Explore an interconnected world full of platforming challenges in this short metroidvania. Unlock biomes by combining abilities you've learned, including climb, grapple, throw, and parry. Examine dozens of artifacts, commune with forgotten gods, and piece together what happened to Auridia.

title: Cult of Flies
description: After the death of your grandmother, you start to uncover the reason behind the strange nature of her passing as well as her plans of resurrection.

title: COVID-29
description: A third person, action-adventure game with a medieval and biology style. Explore inside the human body as a COVID-virus fighting your way past enemy white blood cells and immune proteins. Find and infect cells to score points.

title: Mahjong Solitaire Pro
description: Mahjong Solitaire Pro offers a relaxing yet engaging experience, where every match brings a sense of satisfaction and focus. With each cleared board, you'll feel a mix of calm and accomplishment, making it the perfect way to unwind after a hard day at work.

title: Deadly Swag
description: A co-op horror shooter set in the Zone. Explore dangerous locations, collect artifacts, fight mutants, and avoid deadly anomalies. Survive together, sell your loot, and return for more challenges. In the Zone, every step is a fight for survival.

title: Demonic Mahjong
description: Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!

title: Sherlocat Nonogram Rio
description: Explore Rio de Janeiro through nonogram puzzles! Challenge your logical skills with challenges inspired by the iconic landscapes of Rio, charming graphics, and a touch of mystery. SherloCat Nonogram Rio is perfect for puzzle lovers of all levels.

title: The Four Money Bears: Berryville
description: Learn to Make Millions in this Cozy Merchant Sim. Build a business and beat the competition to become the biggest merchant in the world by learning smart financial habits, behaviors and traits. Craft pies & jams from tons of different berries. Have fun running your shop & helping your community!

title: Cyber Farmer
description: Cyber Farmer is a crazy farming simulator where old meets new! Take over your grandpa Kazimierz's farm in a post-apocalyptic world, using cyber tech, modified plants, and even cyber pigs. It’s full of laughs, weird surprises, and quirky farming fun. Farm the future, laugh through the past!

title: Tiny Bomber
description: Tiny Bomber is a 2D vertical scrolling action game blending roguelike elements with bullet-hell dodging. Players control a tiny bomber, navigating procedurally generated levels, avoiding bullets, and bombing enemies. With a countdown system and random upgrades, each run is a thrilling challenge.

title: Dream Runner
description: On the eve of their big ceremony, Soma and Nigel are ripped from one another by an unexpected disaster. Now, Soma has to learn to overcome his toughest challenges on his own. Master new abilities, overcome platforming challenges, and solve puzzles as you work to reunite with your best friend!

title: Marble Run Maker
description: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions and cozy vibes.

title: Spaceship Idle: Design, Build, Explore & Battle
description: Spaceship Idle is an idle/incremental game that allows you to build your own modular spaceship and battle with other commanders. Explore the vast tech tree, unlock unique weapons, design your own spaceship layout, trade with global players, and win epic space (auto)battles!

title: Apocalypse Survivors
description: As the savior of the apocalypse, take up your weapons and unleash your powers. Rescue survivors, confront waves of zombies, and through relentless searching, become an immortal warrior. Write your own glorious legend in this plague-ridden hell.

title: Mini Dungeons
description: Mini Dungeons is a Top Down RPG where you take control of Jimmy an adventurous Mouse looking for treasure deep within the depths of the dungeons. Along the journey in the depths - recruit various companions along the way, unlock new abilities, and get that sweet loot!

title: Zopharion
description: Will you risk everything to stop the Zopharion virus? Will the truth you discover prove too frightening? Explore a hostile world, face unknown threats, uncover secrets, solve puzzles and fight to save the research station from a pandemic.

title: Chaos of Destiny Remake
description: Collect, craft, explore, defeat powerful enemies, forge your own weapons, customize your equipment, complete dungeons, solve puzzles and dominate the terrain in this grand open world RPG focused on a retro yet innovative experience.

title: H.A.D.E.S Zero
description: Survival horror where you explore collapsed facilities, face biotechnological horrors, and survive with limited resources.

title: Hollow Drive
description: In that world, simply being alive was enough to bear the weight of sin. To prevent the depletion of energy that grants supernatural powers, those who fail to prove their "worth of existence" are eliminated. …In this desolate world, I awoke with no memories, not even knowing my own name.

title: Mystic Tesserae
description: 2.5D Falling sand game. Collect Rare Items and discover new Elements. Use Elements to make Powerful Spells. Build and Destroy at your will.

title: Fecal Freighter
description: Become a sewage truck operator and survive the foul dangers: drive your ZIL, battle sludge demons, complete tasks, explore a grim world, and uncover the mystery of an alien conspiracy.

title: The Dancer's Lullaby
description: Explore, survive, decide and find the dancer. In this new survival horror experience every single decision you take matters. Each decision, each item you use and every door you open will have everlasting consequences bringing you a unique experience each time.

title: Shock
description: In SHOCK, you play as a disabled war veteran, hunted by a cybernetic creature. With only a wheelchair for mobility, use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape. Survive the horror and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

title: Dino Girls
description: Discover and collect cute Dino Girls, organize their activities, and expand your resort while going about your daily stuff.

title: Hallway Shot
description: Hallway Shot is a condensed survival horror about a looping hallway

title: Mess
description: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

title: Together in Forgotten Lands
description: Two souls, one destiny. Embark on a co-op adventure through a forgotten land, where teamwork and wit are the only way to navigate the wonders and dangers of a magical cave.

title: Amazon Animals
description: Amazonia Animals is a jigsaw puzzle featuring animals from the Amazon rainforest. Embark on a journey to the world's largest forest and meet endangered animals in beautiful hand-drawn 2D artwork

title: Storm Mined
description: Minestorm reimagined with modern gameplay! Blast through waves of deadly mines, gear up with powerful upgrades between levels, and dive into intense rhythm-based stages set to an original soundtrack !

title: Secret Seeker
description: Explore forgotten dimensions, find forbidden objects, and reveal hidden secrets. Beware - time is your enemy, and something is watching you. A mix of roguelite, horror, stealth, pressure, and secrets best left alone.

title: Momenta
description: Momenta is a arcade game to chill out and play for a half hour. Chase the leaderboards, upgrade your runs, and become a shooting star.

title: Whotfire
description: This is a simple but yet complex turn-based shedding card game to which players are shared with some number of cards at the start of the game and a card is dropped at the center. This is based on some of the Whot Card game rules but much similar to a 2d fighting game.

title: Music Producer Tycoon
description: Music Producer Tycoon is a music industry simulation game where you write, produce, and release songs across decades. Use AI tools, manage your studio, collaborate with legends, and build your legacy from a garage to global fame.

title: The Binding Hour
description: The Binding Hour is a first-person psychological horror game set in a forgotten house lost deep in the woods. Explore shifting spaces, confront haunting echoes, and uncover a truth that refuses to stay buried. Every hour binds you tighter—will you break the loop, or become part of it?

title: Void Miner
description: Mine the void. Call the eclipse. Consume everything. Void Miner is a flashy, relaxed, self-paced idle-roguelite hybrid built around 30-60 minute runs, full of powerful builds and bizarre weapons.

title: Block Basher 3D
description: A clean, modern 3D twist on the classic brick-breaker. Smash through block patterns, switch camera angles, and use power-ups in this stripped-down arcade experience. Buy now and get the future expanded sequel for free.

title: Microfisher
description: Put on your overalls and grab your fishing rod, those fishes are waiting for you! Explore the island while catching as many as you can. Get ready to document over a thousand specimens in your book and prepare for a long journey. Meanwhile, search for upgrades to improve your fishing technique.

title: Train Jumble
description: Travel Europe in your self-furnished train while making sure all passengers are happy with their seats.

title: Loot Shop Simulator
description: Run the coziest shop in the realm by cracking cursed crates, selling enchanted junk, and helping weird customers with weirder problems.

title: Sfera
description: SFERA - Action platformer. A mix of 3D and retro 2D graphics. You are an assassin for the SFERA corporation. You are tasked with destroying a gang of robots.

title: Gem Miner TD
description: Mine. Maze. Merge. Survive. Dig for powerful gems, merge them into game-breaking towers, and pick roguelike perks to build wild synergies in this vibrant 2D pixel art roguelike tower defense. Do not let enemies drag your miner to the lava!

title: Collisions: Cosmic Geometry
description: Test your limits in this frantic Arcade Survival Neon Challenge! Dodge and survive dangerous red geometric enemies with random movements, unleash power-ups to boost your chances, collect stars to score, and reach the top of the global leaderboard. Are your reflexes ready?

title: The Swordsman
description: The Swordsman is a fast-paced 2.5D hack and slash game set in a dark fantasy world. Master fluid combat, choose skills through card-based progression, and craft powerful gear. Face relentless enemy waves and challenging bosses. Each run makes you stronger—adapt, and become the ultimate swordsman!

title: The Final Breath
description: A 3D side-scrolling adventure game, you will dive into a bizarre dark world and unlock the secrets hidden in it. Use the props you've earned to fight against a variety of sanity-shattering monsters and bosses, challenge creative decryption, explore chilling truths, and reveal your ultimate destiny..

title: Aspis
description: ASPIS is an atmospheric mystical thriller set in an alternative USSR of the late 80s. You play as a scientist who has lost his family and is involved in a dangerous experiment to create a reality simulation. Explore the cybernetics institute, travel between worlds and encounter a distorted reality

title: The Null Hypothesis
description: You play as a mutant who is given refuge and enrolled into a school of mutants by Charles Xavier. At the school you meet other mutants and live amongst them, growing your powers, learning, and developing budding relationships with others.

title: Biathlon Challenge
description: Master precision shooting while performing stunts to boost your score and beat the clock. Customize your loadout for speed, control, or style. Explore the courses to uncover secrets, gear, and meet the locals.

title: Roadside Research
description: Roadside Research is a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.

title: Soulmask: The Golden Legend
description: Soulmask - The Golden Legend now alive!

title: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
description: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

title: Wingspan: Asia Expansion
description: Explore the wonders of Asia in Wingspan: Asia Expansion! Discover new birds and bonus cards, compete in Duet Mode, and immerse yourself in rich landscapes with stunning art and soothing music. Compete in fresh challenges, and experience a serene journey with Asia's avian marvels!

title: Never's End
description: Never's End is a turn-based tactical RPG where you return from death into the midst of a global cataclysm. Possess townsfolk to use them as living weapons, wield the forces of nature to reshape the battlefield, and lead mankind back from the brink of extinction.

title: Monsters Are Coming!
description: Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

title: Dead Finger Dice: A Billionaire Killing Game
description: Play a sinister game of poker dice against blood-thirsty demon billionaires who’ve trapped you on their mega yacht in this rogue-like dice builder.

title: Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked
description: A cooperative tactical RPG set in the D&D universe. Embark on a fantasy tabletop adventure. Your quest, on your schedule.

title: Dragon Lands
description: Dragon Lands is an incremental game about creature collection, farming, crafting and automation! Gather and manage resources, expand your lands and upgrade your skills. Collect Dragons to automate your production. Join in this adventure and explore a vibrant world!

title: Road Food Simulator
description: Run a roadside Pizza restaurant with your friends. Play solo or in Co-op with other players. Make pizzas fast and fill orders. Keep your customers happy and get more orders. Improve your restaurant as your income increases.

title: Bakudo
description: Bakudo is a sci‑fi boss‑rush action game fusing high‑octane ball‑sport mechanics with exhilarating combat. Enroll at an elite Bakudo academy and clash with formidable opponents as you uncover a major conspiracy. When determination is put to the ultimate test, you must tip the scales of destiny.

title: Dark Cards of Candlewood
description: Candlewood is a solo collectible card game with the soul of a classic JRPG. Embark on replayable dungeon runs with deceptively deep, two-choice card combat. Draft items for your backpack, master chain attacks, and even crack a few card packs...then save the world from eternal darkness!

title: Scrubbin' Trubble
description: Scrubbin' Trubble is a cooperative roguelike where you go solo or team up with up to four players in local or online multiplayer to slash, smash, and scrub your way through dangerously dirty stages. Use strategy and teamwork to clean up Nasties, and take down the Four Filths of the Apocalypse.

title: Cow Carries
description: Limp-wristed story about what it means to be a cowboy or something. Talk to people, get talked to, carry around some objects, carry around some knowledge, make bulls kiss each other, enter the wrong kind of salon, couple other things to do too. Don't get heatstroke out in the dessert! (don't worry you can't get heatstroke, and there's no dessert)

title: Hairy Eyeballs.
description: Shave your eyeballs while you discover some girls' thoughts on this desolate island. Tackle nationhood, transness and what it means to be a woman.

title: Exark
description: Exark is an engine builder about building a city aboard a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, staff them with crew members, and maximise your ark's resource production by exploiting powerful synergies. Lead your Great House to safety at the rim of the world.

title: Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust
description: "Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust" is a single-player game that combines text adventure with turn-based combat and exploration. As someone aspiring to become a great hero, your journey through the martial arts world will not always be a solo endeavor.

title: Run Quad Run
description: Run Quad Run is a top-down skill based parkour game where you escape from the evil shapes to recover the lost artifacts of Cubicland. Navigate through various worlds with different enemies and master your reflex skills in the world of cubes.

title: Glimvale: My Mini Overworld
description: Manage and customize your little fantasy village, make your adventurers happy with cute and varied shops and decorate their environment as you please. After all, you are the master of the game !

title: Monuments to Ruin
description: Build defences, explore an all-encompassing fog and pray you can fight off the massive hordes of Ruin. Engage with an expansive unlock system and survive in a world that changes with your decisions. ‘Monuments to Ruin’ is a roguelite, tower defense game set in a world ravaged by a suffocating fog.

title: Origament: A Paper Adventure
description: Tiny paper - Big adventure! Soar, sail, and roll to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and imagination

title: My Friend was Dehydrated
description: Find your way through a rave while your friend is rapidly losing moisture. You got twenty seconds left and a face to remember.

title: Escalating Duel
description:
Escalating Duel is local-multiplayer 1v1 2D-Arena-Shooter with deck-building elements.
After each round the contestants add a card to their deck of upgrades. As the match goes on the madness escalates as the decks get thicker.

title: Mind the Dragon
description: Venture into this dungeon extraction crawler adventure in the depths of a legendary Dungeon to steal treasures, gold and powerful artifacts! Just be careful with the monsters inside, rotating dungeons where the deeper you go the harder it is to escape! And don’t forget to... Mind the Dragon!

title: Angel x Demon: Cultural Exchange
description: A deliberately bad visual novel

title: Automatic Kingdom
description: Build the perfect kingdom in this turn-based city builder, arranging synergies of Citizens and Constructions to generate valuable resources. Keep your kingdom happy, endure hostile Challenges, and unlock new cards as your kingdom becomes more prosperous.

title: Deadline Savior
description: This idle RPG adventure is based on the "Pomodoro Technique." Complete focused work sessions to advance your character's exploration. To reclaim the Goddess's Hourglass and restore peace, the hero must defeat the evil dragon "Procrastination" and its minions. The world’s fate is in your hands!

title: Wolf of Stock Street
description: New gameplay, fresh style, unique stock market themes, so you can't stop playing! How to combine financial games with adult content? Invite you to experience the unprecedented, ridiculous but unstoppable way of lewd wolves in the stock market!

title: Forsaker: DingDing&Blade
description: A visual novel/roguelike hybrid where a simple mission spirals into a cannibalistic odyssey. You'll struggle as a fragile human, blood-soaked knight, or flesh-devouring Forsaker. Devour or be devoured—yet your fate dangles by unseen strings. Choose: cling to this broken world... or forsake it.

title: Castle Cab
description: Castle Cab is a hilariously chaotic action sandbox game that puts you in the horseshoes of a majestic, yet slightly unhinged, steed. Hitched to your trusty cart, you’ll gallop, drift, and crash your way through a bustling medieval world where rules are more of a suggestion.

title: Drifters & Demons
description: As the leader of a small settlement in a demon-infested wilderness, you will have to shelter survivors and protect them with a variety of guns and abilities. Build homes, turrets, weapons, and traps, and when you're ready to face the horde, take out your guns and sound the klaxon!

title: Montabi
description: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

title: The Legend Returns
description: Can you survive the return of the legend? A relentless killer is stalking you, and no one believes your story. The only way out? Perform the ritual… or become the next victim. Run, hide, and fight for your life in this brutal PS1-inspired slasher horror experience!

title: Cardrottini
description: Cardrottini is a chaotic Italian meme-fueled card battler where brainrot meets strategy. Build absurd decks, outwit your opponents, and embrace the madness. No context needed. If you know, you know.

title: Dead Take
description: Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.

title: Psycho-Sleuth
description: Psycho-Sleuth is a psychological mystery where cognitive disorders twist the logic of murder. 13 afflicted participants — each bound by strange rules like “no lying,” “no left side,” or “no faces” — are trapped in a deadly game where the sickness spreads and truth itself becomes unreliable.

title: Memory Holder: The Alphabet
description: A memory game dedicated to the letters that guide us through the day.

title: Bacrush
description: Bacrush is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a small green square. Your goal is to collect as many coins as possible while dodging dangerous gray cubes. You can shoot projectiles to push back the cubes, but be careful — shooting too much will cause your square to overheat! Gather as many coins as you can and survive as long as possible to set a new high score.

title: Sheep Running
description: In this charming and challenging game, you play as a shepherd with a critical mission — guide your flock safely into the barn without letting any sheep fall off cliffs or drown in the water. Use fear wisely to steer the sheep, but be careful — push them too hard, and they might panic and run to their doom! The more sheep you safely herd into the barn, the higher your score. Master the delicate balance between control and chaos in this fun and strategic herding adventure!

title: Breaker Brick Smashing
description: Breaker Brick Smashing is an endless brick breaker challenge where new bricks constantly appear and only the sharpest shots survive. Smash your way through tougher bricks that need multiple hits, collect power-ups like extra balls and safe zones, and climb through the waves as difficulty rises. How long can you last?

title: Dark Angels
description: Control a shadowy, winged angel in Dark Angels as you ram through rocks, crystals, and cursed barriers, absorbing dark energy along the way. With a blend of dark fantasy and arcade action, each level challenges you to clear obstacles and harness the power of darkness.

title: Mop'n Spark
description:
MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer where you place actions on a timeline and build the moves of two characters, almost like writing a program.

Bepp cleans up monsters, while Gola restores the power. Control them at the same time and solve puzzles! Combine their actions and timing to build the sequence that clears the stage! If it doesn't work, rewind time and rebuild your plan!

title: ChainKit Builder
description: Build, paint, and customize model kits in this immersive virtual workshop. Snap parts together, apply decals, paint with precision, and even kitbash for unique creations. Experience the satisfaction of model kit building without the mess.

title: Zombie Liminal Fishing
description: Eliminate zombies. Collect zombie meat for bait. Fish and harvest crabs. Sell your catch for money. Upgrade weapons, robots, transport devices, and fishing gear. Unlock new areas. Repeat.

title: Rosemary Village
description:
Play as Ferdinand, a young adventurer in search of a new journey. In Rosemary Village, even the simplest adventure can put a lot at stake, and in it, Ferdinand's will and power will be his main weapons.

Turn-based combat, varied environments, optional activities and interesting characters are just a few examples of what you can expect from the game, as well as mechanics that will make you replay Rosemary Village over and over again...

title: Ventomori
description: In this asymmetrical multiplayer co-op puzzle game, brave the treacherous unknown and endeavour on a deadly, desolate planet. Be the eyes from above or the scout on the ground and work together with a friend to uncover the mysteries and escape from the planet Xanahspati.

title: The Shadow Beneath
description: The Shadow Beneath is an action roguelike where you must fulfill an ancient prophecy and rise against the demonic forces that have taken over the world. You will battle relentless waves of enemies, master powerful abilities and reclaim what humanity lost since the Demon Lords reign began - freedom

title: PhantomRider
description: This is a role-playing game, the protagonist has four magic, the enemy has heroes, ordinary monsters, the enemy's heroes have powerful magic. Dropped weapons have a rank. Ordinary monsters will cause you trouble. The protagonist conquers an expedition to destroy the enemy's castle.

title: Next Business Trip
description: You will be spending a horror filled 3 nights at the hotel. Your room this time around, is a rather large one complete with a bed and bath.

title: Yoshi's Archipelago
description: Yoshi’s Archipelago is a community collab game made in SMBX. It was created under strict pretenses in an effort to make it one of the most solid Mario episodes imaginable. Whether we succeeded or not, well, that's up to you now, isn't it?

title: Struggler
description: This is a dark game that includes regular monster killing, treasure dropping, gem setting, strategy matching skills and talents, collecting special items, battle flags, destructible environments, and other elements. It can also be played in city strongholds to eliminate crime and police.

title: BlackVein
description: A Retro Survival-Horror Mining Game, mine for resources, survive horrors and descend deeper in to BlackVein mine.

title: Escape From Benjamin's Room
description: Crack challenging puzzles to escape the room and recover Benjamin's memories.

title: The Prisoner
description: Stuck in a prison you don't remember being sent to, you must find a way to escape. Using the guards and the other prisoners as tools to guarantee your escape requires strategizing your movement to successfully maneuver them to solve the puzzling challenges ahead.

title: Cyber Car Seller Simulator
description:
Cyber Car Seller Simulator – Enter the Future of Automotive Trade!
In a neon-lit world where technology reigns, uncover hidden gems in the cyber car market
and build a thriving dealership. Scout futuristic vehicles, negotiate the best deals, enhance
them with cutting-edge modifications, and sell them for a massive profit. Will you become
the ultimate cyber car mogul, or will the digital underworld outmaneuver you?

title: Supernova: Galactic Wars
description: A shoot'em up with a strategic component. Place your ship on a galactic chessboard. Try to use all your arcade skills to win when 2 ships encounter.

title: Piece Out: Avatarland
description: Avatarland is a jigsaw puzzle game with a twist. Solve puzzles to unlock new levels, then discover and collect your favorite avatars from the in-game store. Join the weekly challenge, race to complete puzzles faster than players around the world, and climb the global leaderboard. With fresh puzzles and avatars added regularly, there's always a reason to Piece Out!

title: Dig & Deal
description: Dig & Deal is a game where you dig underground to find valuable items and bargain with customers to sell what you find. Upgrade your tools, grow your shop, and make the best deals to build your fortune.

title: Starbug Troopers: The 4 Horseflies of the Apocalypse
description: Starbug Troopers is a cute and colorful action game blending turn-based strategy and shoot 'em up elements, set in the cute world of insects. Using your Starbugs, insect-like ships, face off against the four horseflies of the apocalypse who want to pollute your environment and destroy their armies

title: No Man's Sky: Beacon
description: Expand your planetary empire in No Man's Sky BEACON. Become Overseer of multiple planetary settlements, and discover the townships of the secretive robotic Autophage. Introducing improved settlement balance, more variety of management decisions, building upgrades, infestations, new base parts and more.

title: Monster Pub: Chapter 3
description: Monster Pub is an episodic narrative game about finding new friends in a new town, but, uh, also everyone is a monster, including you! Be a good friend, or a bad friend! Play cards and crush your opponent! Or maybe just try to have a nice time, I'm not your boss.

title: The Dark Legacy
description: The Dark Legacy is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore an abandoned surgeon's estate. Uncover hidden memories, solve narrative-driven puzzles, and face the chilling consequences of forbidden experiments. The game emphasizes atmospheric storytelling over jump scares.

title: Dustwind: Resistance
description: Dustwind: Resistance is a single-player tactical game. Lead your squad—including your dog—against a brutal raider army. Pause to plan tactics. Use brutal firepower, stealth, traps, turrets, or an armored car to outmaneuver enemies. Protect your home and freedom. No surrender!

title: Medieval StartUp
description: Medieval StartUp is a unique mix of tavern management, crafting, and exploration set in a rich medieval world. Manage your tavern, craft unique items, recruit staff, and explore a mysterious marsh full of hidden secrets and rare resources.

title: Hounded
description: You are Duke, a determined young Border Collie who is searching for their lost master, the leader of The Rebellion. Hounded by a cunning hunter, can you track the scent, unearth the power of The Tide and find your way home?

title: Criminally Yours
description:
You're the next generation of heroes—"Oracle," given to your mother and you for your ability to see glimpses into the future.

The only thing that stands in your way of keeping peace in the city is the supervillain "Chronos".

When you aren't protecting the city from Chronos, you're just an average everyday civilian working as a project manager with your long-time crush, Nikolaos.

Little do you know that Nikolaos knows your secret, but you don't know his—that he and Chronos are one and the same.

title: Rescue the Girl
description: Ex-cop's life shatters when kidnappers take his daughter, implant a bomb, and force him on lethal missions. With enigmatic allies, his choices rewrite destinies while unraveling a conspiratorial web.

title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel Trilogy Box
description: A collector edition of Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3, that includes the games for switch, an artbook, the soundtrack and a metal figure of the taranis. (early bonus: 3 novels)

title: Block King Demands Red Squares
description: Automate a network of towns producing the required shapes for the ever fickle Block King while keeping the citizens happy. Remember, if you fail, you will get fired.

title: Doom Spiral
description: DOOM SPIRAL is an intense first person shooter where your health is the integrity of your consciousness.

title: Prism Shift
description: A minimalist, grid-based puzzle game where you merge colored blocks using additive color mixing. Clear connected blocks and interact with special blocks to progress through each level.

title: Pirate's Gambit
description: Pirate's Gambit takes you on an unpredictable voyage, blending deck-building with Yacht Dice mechanics. Roll the dice in the dimly lit cabin, where fate shifts with every turn. Are you closing in on treasure or something far more sinister?

title: Arcade Archives: Ridge Racer
description:
A port of Ridge Racer, a racing game released by Bandai in 1993. It was originally released in arcades for the Namco System 22 hardware.

The game has four modes to choose from, including three difficulty levels – Novice, Intermediate, and Advanced - as well as T. T. (Time Trial), where players compete one-on-one against a rival car to achieve the best time.

Additionally, a DX version featuring support for an H-shifter and clutch is also included.

title: Bubbles in the Air
description: Bubbles in the Air is a grid-free real-time matching game. In a dog's dream, colorful soap bubbles float and collide… The task is simple! Shoot bubbles, merge matching ones, and let them burst—creating even more bubbles. Can you make it to the end of the dream?

title: Touhou Dream Duel
description: Battle your way through Gensokyo in this fan-work inspired by classic Touhou Project fighting games.

title: Guardian of the Rebellion
description: A classic war-chronicle fantasy SRPG set on the continent of Falnea, where beings known as “Guardians” wield power beyond mortals. Lead Arzes—the son of a Guardian—against the Ruzeroa Empire’s bid for unification and the shadowy forces stoking the war.

title: Rogue Rollers
description: A pinball roguelike where you battle through chaotic arenas and cursed dungeons, unlock powerful upgrades, and choose branching paths as you bounce, bash, and roll your way through an ever-changing world.

title: Sketch Magician
description: A sketch action game where you fight with your drawings. You are a Sketch Magician. From arrow-like attacks to shields that block enemy attacks, everything is created from your sketches. Fight in the world of the sketchbook!

title: Racing Rebels Mud Clash
description: Racing Rebels Mud Clash is a muddy, high-speed racing challenge where players unlock new maps and buy better cars by winning races. Earn cash based on your finishing position, upgrade your garage, and blast past rivals with powerful nitro boosts.

title: Super Worms
description:
A kart racing game with segmented "worms" in different colors instead of karts.
Similar to older kart racing games, the game features a pseudo-3D view made up of flat sprites.
The game has a racing mode where you can race against AI opponents or against another player and a battle mode for two players.

title: Postal: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze
description: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze isn’t “just a DLC” - it’s a tropical serotonin collapse packed with juicy carnage, alleged jokes, overbaked new levels, even less appropriate enemies and unhinged guns. This is another mag of SPF-free mockery fired point-blank at modern life.

title: Gunstoppable
description: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

title: A Planet Full of Cats
description: A Planet Full of Cats is a hidden object adventure with metroidvania-style exploration — in true Devcats fashion. Explore diverse biomes, unlock new powers and uncover ancient secrets!

title: Dishventory
description:
You will take a job as a Dishwasher manager, figuring out the most effective way to wash dishes. Are you up for the challenge?

Wash dirty dishes that keep on piling on the board. Put dirty dishes on the Dishwasher board in the most efficient order and earn Golden Bubbles. The Store that appears every couple of rounds will allow you to purchase some awesome upgrades!

Survive 5 days and get a dishwasher with a new card to play with in your next run.

title: La Vuelta al Mundo con Vascolet
description: This third game made for Nestlé's Vascolet features Alejandro and his friends kart racing around the world. But beware! Evil Malmark and his lackeys are out there trying to ruin the races!

title: Pip Pepper Park Planner
description:
Pip Pepper Park Planner is a cozy, strategy game in which you play as Pip, a tiny bird with a giant job: to design parks for animals to enjoy. Explore different habitats, discover the needs of diverse animals and fully customize your parks. Can you build a park that all the animals will love?‎

Create your own customizable park choosing different structures for each park area. With hundreds possible combinations, you get to decide what happens next.

Interact with a variety of objects and animal species. Learn about their unique needs and interests through engaging and fun dialogue sequences.

Explore a playground of possibilities. Did anything change after building your park? Take your time to reflect on your design decisions. You can always try a new combination!

title: Felt That: Boxing
description: Felt That: Boxing is a comedic boxing game set in a world where the charm of furry puppets collides with the fury of boxing. Step into the shoes of Ezra "Fuzz-E" Wright, an unlikely hero with a big heart. His quest? Battle his way through the Tournament of a Million Punches to save an orphanage!

title: Lumines Arise
description: A mind-blowing, fiendishly addictive reinvention of the puzzle classic Lumines from the creators of Tetris Effect: Connected, where sound pulses through your body, mind, and every block you place, triggering dazzling visuals synched to the driving beat of an infectious, eclectic soundtrack.

title: Romeo is a Dead Man
description:
Latest ultra-violent sci-fi action title from Grasshopper Manufacture and Suda51.

Step into the blood-soaked boots of Romeo Stargazer, a man pulled back from the brink of death by a time paradox gone wrong. Now reborn as Agent Dead Man of the FBI Space-Time Division, and armed with the mysterious Dead Gear mask, Romeo must chase the universe’s most dangerous fugitives across alternate realities.

Blending high-octane gunplay, brutal sword combat, and over-the-top sci-fi insanity, Romeo Is a Dead Man is GhM’s bloodiest action game yet. Players can expect mind-bending twists, outrageous gimmicks, and a deeply cathartic combat system that turns enemies’ powers against them in universe-shattering battles.

As Romeo tears through the multiverse, he’s also on a desperate quest to find Juliet, his mysteriously vanished girlfriend. With a narrative that fuses love, loss, and metaphysical chaos, Romeo Is a Dead Man offers a stylish and unpredictable journey through the very fabric of time itself.

Can you survive the bleeding edge of space-time? Or will you become just another ghost in the paradox?

title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
description: Unravel the dark history of the Bloodstained universe and explore a hauntingly immersive 16th-century England steeped in a 2.5D gothic atmosphere, enthralling players in strategic battles, crafting, and exploration across a sprawling, cursed land.

title: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles
description: This dramatic tale of ambition, betrayal, and honor comes to life again with an updated and enriched script with fully voiced dialogue, alongside improved graphics that bring a new level of immersion and playability to the battlefield. Additionally, the enhanced version brings quality-of-life updates like new difficulties, a revamped UI, auto save, and more that make the game more accessible to newcomers.

title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection
description:
Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection includes all the essential games from Mortal Kombat's early years. Experience the legendary origins of the franchise with the iconic arcade classics that started it all—alongside a curated selection of most-loved home versions for the Super NES and Sega Genesis. Dive deeper with rare and fan-favorite releases across the Game Boy, Game Gear, Sega 32X, Game Boy Advance, and more—a celebration of the franchise’s groundbreaking legacy.

Digital Eclipse's interactive documentary format explores how Mortal Kombat changed the way society perceived video games. By using digitized humans as player sprites in an over-the-top, martial-arts fighter, the game thrilled players, shocked critics, and laid the foundation for a franchise that has thrived for more than 30 years. Hear firsthand from the original dev team of Ed Boon, John Tobias, John Vogel, and Dan Forden, along with other exclusive interviews, rare concept art, vintage marketing materials, and archival video footage.

Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection also lets players explore Mortal Kombat lore, with a timeline of the original series' storyline and comprehensive character histories that offer stories, secrets, and glimpses behind the scenes at their creation.

title: Nioh 3
description: In the latest game in the dark samurai action RPG series "Nioh," you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open world.

title: Deus Ex: The Conspiracy
description: The year is 2052 and the world is a dangerous and chaotic place. Terrorists operate openly - killing thousands; drugs, disease and pollution kill even more. The world's economies are close to collapse and the gap between the insanely wealthy and the desperately poor grows ever wider. Worst of all, an ages old conspiracy bent on world domination has decided that the time is right to emerge from the shadows and take control.

title: Twisted Metal III
description: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal III, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Twisted Metal 4
description: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal 4, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
description:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

title: Planet of the Ants
description: Planet of the Ants is a fast-paced, action-packed real-time strategy game with evolution mechanics. Grow your colony of ants from scratch and conquer your enemies through evolving eras of civilization. Your reflexes, decision making and micromanagement skills will be put to the ultimate test.

title: My Time With Dee Dee volume 0
description: My Time With Dee Dee is a series of short visual novels staring the mascot of DigitallyDownloaded.net, Danica, or Dee Dee. This is a very short introduction, to give you a first look at Dee Dee, and how she came to meet you, the protagonist.

title: Prison Escape io
description: Dash through traps, tunnels, and glass bridges in fast-paced multiplayer! Team up or compete to escape first. Survive wild maps and become the ultimate escape master!

title: Necromancer Nonsense
description:
It's the blood moon! Time to take over the world... or it would be if every other half baked necromancer and vampire wasn't trying the same thing.

Capture buildings and locations full of bits and bobs you can use to build your army, and conquer all!

Made in 1 month for the "Games for Blind Gamers" game jam! So should be fully blind accessible.

title: Coming Home
description: A retro slasher horror game, with a focus on home defense. In the dead of night, you hear someone lurking outside - but you are not defenseless. Watch the cameras, barricade your doors, and have your gun at the ready - anything to keep the Sundown Rippers from claiming their next victim.

title: CoopRooms
description: CoopRooms is a co-op survival horror game for up to 5 players, set in the endless Backrooms. Take photos and videos to progress—and maybe survive. Just don’t scream... the Entities are listening.

title: Project: Fractured Reality
description: A failed toxic weapon experiment left you alone in an abandoned village… or so you think. Craft, explore, uncover dark secrets, and help the last survivors—if they’re still human.

title: Hybrid Blood
description: Step into the role of a Vampire-Human Hybrid, imprisoned for longer than you can remember. Explore a Open-world RPG and expand your Vampiric Domain. Defeat the local Vampire Lord to claim his territory and begin your quest to dominate—or liberate—the lands.

title: Art Together
description: Art Together is a multiplayer drawing game where creativity meets chaos. Gather people online and experience the hilarious results of collaborative art creation!

title: Fallout 76: Gone Fission
description:
Grab your tackle box and your waders and head for the water, because the Gone Fission update reels in a huge new feature: Fishing!

This peaceful wasteland activity lets players catch fish in any water where they can swim. Now you can chill out with your friends at your favorite radioactive body of water in any region of Appalachia and catch more than 30 new fish. Players can even collect and cook a batch of nutritious new recipes with the fish they catch.

title: Legion Was Here
description: You are Legion, a secret agent who can change his appearance at will. Use your investigative and chameleon skills to infiltrate enemy ranks!

title: AFK Shift
description: Streamer has gone AFK. What could go wrong? Tune in to abandoned livestreams, watch for unexpected changes and sinister anomalies, and report them for remediation before they can permanently corrupt reality!

title: Volontés
description: Volontés is an Dark Fantasy × Suspense otome game in which the main character, who has lost everything, finds her way of life while facing tragedy.

title: Grumblemoor
description: Explore a colorful haunted world, fight and befriend its bizarre inhabitants, unlock game changing upgrades, and unravel a story of epic proportions.

title: Quadrofriend
description: Ethan goes to a psychiatric hospital to visit an old friend. Upon arrival, he discovers that the staff has disappeared and his friend has gone mad. Now, Ethan must endure brutal trials to survive and escape this nightmare.

title: Vox Populi: Canada 2025
description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for many alternative Canadian elections! In "Vox Populi: Canada 2025", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

title: Waving Around
description: Jump, stomp and create dangerous waves to defeat up to 4 of your friends in this cute competitive arena. May the best stomper win!

title: The Stairwell
description: You've been hired to keep watch in a mysterious building with an infinite stairwell. Your task is simple: investigate each floor for strange phenomena. If you find an anomaly, be careful. Test your skills on the global leaderboard and in the weekly challenge event.

title: Silent Hill f: Deluxe Edition
description:
Silent Hill f is a survival horror game published by Konami as part of the Silent Hill series.
It is set in rural Japan during the 1960s, marking a departure from the franchise’s traditional Western settings. The story is written by Ryukishi07 and focuses on psychological horror, social pressure, and transformation.

The Deluxe Edition includes the full game along with a digital artbook, a digital soundtrack, and the Pink Rabbit costume. Pre-order bonuses for the Deluxe Edition consisted of the White Sailor School Uniform, the Omamori (Peony), an item pack, and 48-hour early access.

title: The Elementalist Typing
description: A tactical typing role-playing game to sharpen your typing skills! Featuring colorful hand-drawn pixel art and a unique mad-lib engine for endless typing variety! Upgrade your wizard and play tactically to defeat mighty foes and collect fabulous home decorations. Make typing practice fun!

title: Operius DX
description: Blast off into Operius DX, a high-speed arcade shooter where you navigate twisting polygonal tunnels, battle waves of enemies, and confront formidable bosses in an endless amount of procedurally-generated levels. How far can you get?

title: Deep Pixel Melancholy
description: Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

title: There Will Be Light
description: There Will Be Light is a top-down puzzle adventure in a gloomy but cozy environment. To progress, you have to solve tricky logic puzzles, while defending yourself against enemies. Dive into this cozy but challenging puzzle adventure as you solve riddles and fight your way back to the light.

title: Doug The Digger
description: Doug The Digger is a casual, single-player mining and crafting game where you aim to escape a crash landing by crafting a rocket. The gameplay is simple but addictive—play at your own risk!

title: Empower Your Intent
description: Built for those who want to better themselves. A unique rhythm game designed to help reclaim your motivation and attention. Focus the timing and direction of your movements to burst projectiles into a mesmerizing eruption of flower petals.

title: Orbit Maze
description: Orbit Maze is a unique maze game set on various surfaces. Control gravity, navigate through platforms, and solve mind-bending puzzles!

title: Pro Cycling Manager 25
description: New graphics for an even more realistic simulation. Become a team manager and lead your riders to the top. Choosing sponsors, recruiting riders, managing the race, it's all up to you.

title: The Tavern In the Woods
description: "Tavern in the Woods" is a first person, single-player interactive fiction story that blends mystery, storytelling, and supernatural horror. Players explore and investigate an isolated environment as the narrative slowly unfolds, gradually uncovering the truth behind the eerie emptiness.

title: The Liquid Jet
description: A slimy, psychedelic adventure about a girl attending a forest warehouse rave party with her friends, where she'll go to experience a long, profound bad (?) trip.

title: Fantasy Kommander: Fascination of Evil
description: Command armies of knights, orcs, and dragons in epic battles! Conquer lands, collect items, and lead Marcus III to victory in this strategic turn-based RPG set in a world of fantasy warfare.

title: Black Dungeon: Draw A Card
description: Once a lowly servant of the Arcane Illustration Society, you triggered a portal while reading the forbidden Codex Obscura and were cast into the Devourer Dungeon. Branded by its core, you gained scrollbinding powers. Explore, collect lost cards, and seal the Demon Devourer: Taotie.

title: Pair Master
description: A challenging matching game that requires quick reflexes and memory skills. It includes both single-player and multiplayer modes, with various difficulty levels and objectives to choose from in competitive play.

title: Uni-Code
description: A 2D platformer where you play as a magical unicorn battling through a world of alpha characters, symbols, and emojis! See if you can survive through all 26 levels of absolute unicorn madness!

title: World Tree Inferno
description: 操控你的角色与团队，在芬布尔之冬的末日世界中进行探索，遇见各种各样的朋友和敌人，进行解谜与回合制战斗，为神明带去诸神黄昏！

title: Idle Dangers
description: In a world where dark forces threaten to consume all, a magical continent is under siege by monstrous invaders. As a hero in this dark fantasy realm, you must rise to the challenge. Strengthen your skills, and lead your team through endless battles to protect the world from destruction.

title: Hentai Girls: DJ Romance
description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

title: Molehill Empire 2
description: Lively gnomes, gardening and research - your garden plot is the place to be!

title: Wet City
description: Welcome to Wet City the city of sin and opportunity, where you rise as an adult film producer. Meet the hottest girls, uncover their secrets, and build your very own entertainment empire. Money, romance, dangerit's all waiting for you!

title: AlphaFurry
description: The story of Maggie, a 25-year-old girl who ventured into a dark forest, where not only dangerous werewolfs awaited her but also unexpected passions. The full moon is strong, and the werewolves are truly out of control. However, Maggie knew what awaited her, and she paid no heed to the warnings

title: Dark PGT
description: Dark PGT – A Souls-like game in an alternate universe of future USSR on Unreal Engine 5. You will play the role of alcoholic-schizophrenic experiencing psychological disorders and hallucinations. Travel to a village in 2030 to unravel all its secrets and solve all its problems.

title: Turbo Balls

description: Engage in competitive combat, either alongside or against fellow players, as you strive to elevate your character's prowess and amass the most coveted and rare items available within the game world.

title: Necrofane

title: Coffee & Boobs
description: Coffee & Boobs is a 2D visual novel about a cozy coffee shop where the staff serves hot espresso in the morning. Help the hero achieve his dream: to become the best barista and brew the kind of coffee that will make any date a success!

title: Law School
description: A 3D adult visual novel where your choices shape relationships, rivalries, and a gripping story. Dive into drama, humor, mini-games, romance and a fully interactive social app in the journey of a young law student at Stocklinburg College.

description: Action RPG: Battle, level up, enhance gear & challenge foes, dungeons, and players. Based on Chinese myths, ancient tribes warred. Five tribes unite against the mighty Chiyou. Nuwa plans to create humans using Wuxing power, but Chiyou attacks. Your adventure starts now!

description: In this short horror game, you take on the role of the ship’s mechanic, recruited for an expedition led by an ambitious archaeologist who claims to have found a map to a forgotten island.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening - Set of 6 Scenarios
description: This set consists of 6 scenarios, with 3 historical scenarios including "Birth of Nobunaga," the scenario with the earliest possible starting point in the game, and 3 fictional scenarios including "Absence of Great Conflict," the scenario about how history would have played out if the Onin War had not occurred. In addition, the scenario "Battle of Nagashino," which was released as a bonus for the Asian version for the game,

title: Favela Defender
description: Favela Defender is a tower defense game where players protect their Brazilian urban settlement from waves of attackers. Players deploy defenses across various maps while developing strategic approaches to safeguard their territory, with performance rankings tracked through global leaderboards.

title: Super Gorilla Quest 2: A Space Chimpanzee
description: Super Gorilla Quest 2: A Space Chimpanzee is a surreal comedy-filled RPG about four primates attempting to stop humans from destroying the universe.

title: Flappy Bat 3
description: It's a Halloween night and Flappy Bat is trying to make his way home. Can you help the Flappy Bat navigate through numerous procedurally generated obstacles. Flap your way past enemies and obstacles and compete on the global leader board for the ultimate top score!

title: The Tower of Shadows
description: Tower of Shadows is a turn-based strategy game where every decision counts. Climb the levels one by one, face formidable opponents, and perfect your tactics to reach the top. Your ultimate challenge? The Master of Shadows himself.

title: Demonk
description:
Demonk is a cooperative horror experience for 1–4 players, where you take on the sacred role of Slavic monks — trained in the forgotten art of dealing with the dead.

Your mission: communicate with ancient spirits, uncover their stories, and choose whether to banish them... or negotiate for peace.

Set in a world deeply rooted in Slavic mythology, every encounter is a test of faith, logic, and trust between players.

Success brings reward — money, relics, and reputation. But failure? That may cost your soul.

Will you find harmony with the beyond… or will the darkness consume you?

title: Mexican Ninja
description: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

title: TurretGirls
description: Grody extraterrestrials are pouring through a space-time rift, and only one girl and her turret stand in their way! Lock, load, and blast them to oblivion—because if she doesn’t survive today, there’s no ‘omurice’ tomorrow! Earth depends on her!

title: Return to Ash
description: “The hospital was empty. Quiet, and brighter than usual... like waking up on a snow day. But I didn't feel cold. I didn't feel much of anything.”

title: Dancing Wings: The Aerobatic Simulator
description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

title: Deltarune Sakuya Battle
description: This is a demo of the a Deltarune and Touhou fan game. Kris finds himself a new enemy that can control time! The Scarlet Devil Mansion chief maid Sakuya Izayoi.

title: Who's at the Door?
description: You are trapped in a small house with psychosis, having lost your memory. Carefully observe your surroundings, distinguish between reality and hallucinations, and take the medication provided by visitors on time to overcome your illness.

title: Sisyphe's Backspace
description: A 5 minutes game about love and hesitation. Use Backspace to play. Hope you will never experience this hesitation.

title: Trine 4: Definitive Edition
description: Trine 4: Definitive Edition includes Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince and the Trine 4: Melody of Mystery DLC campaign.

title: Glyphs
description:
GLYPHS is a difficult puzzle-platformer about exploration and persistence.

Traverse the depths of the Tomb of Forbidden Knowledge; a sentient labyrinth containing traces of the past in the form of glyphs. Formidable bosses, platforming, and puzzles stand in the way of discovery - GLYPHS fulfills the extent that one willingly searches for true knowledge.

EPILEPSY WARNING - This game has occasional drastic color flashes/sudden color changes

title: Noble Legacy
description:
After returning from war you claim your inheritance: Greenwood—a neglected realm on the brink of collapse. As its new Lord, you must guide your kingdom to greatness, not from a distant throne, but by walking its cobbled streets and verdant fields. In this third-person kingdom builder, you must raise your realm from rubble with a builder’s touch—every hall, heath, and castle wall crafted to your design.

Attract skilled settlers to your realm and keep their spirits high by ensuring their homes are furnished and their needs well met. Rule wisely over your land’s resources and build a thriving economy through careful management of trade and labor. Prepare in the times of plenty as harsh weather, plague, and roaming bandits can stall your progress. From the ashes of ruin, reclaim your land, guide your people, and uncover your past as you forge a Noble Legacy worthy of song and steel.

title: Skull Hotel
description: A first-person horror game where you clean haunted hotel rooms while evading deadly entities. Inspect hiding spots carefully, listen for warning sounds, and spot subtle clues left by monsters. Your vigilance is your only weapon in this terrifying housekeeping shift.

title: Pure Pool Pro
description: Welcome to Pure Pool Pro; the ultimate pool simulation. Play solo or online, master every game type, and compete in high-stakes tournaments in immersive venues. Experience breathtaking 8K native visuals, lifelike physics, and pinpoint-precise controls.

title: Gunny Ascend
description: A Roguelite Block-Stacking Adventure — Stack, Adapt, Escape! Gunny Ascend is a high-speed puzzle game where every falling block is a chance to escape. Build clever loadouts, adapt to ever-changing hazards, and outsmart the Collectors in this chaotic, dimension-hopping adventure.

title: Greasemnk++
description: a short rpg by heaven's guard with characters by Mariken set in the 10,000 arses world.

description:
NOW HIRING: Station Manager! (Interim)
Run a totally legitimate space business, in Sector 7-G.
Farm totally legal alien crops, refuel legally acquired ships** of 100% reputable clientele, and sell technically edible snacks and other consumables.

Perks: justification of your species' continued existence, "gloves", oxygen insurance, and mild recognition.

No exp needed.
Apply today!

title: Cyberspace Defender
description:
Welcome to the CyberSpace Defender Program.

CyberSpace Defender has detected 24 data duplication bugs in the cyberspace. You have been tasked with removing the bugs, to stop the Cyberspace from collapsing under the ever increasing weight of meaningless bits and bytes.

description: The meaning of life already has been discovered but was lost a long time ago. You explore an ancient organic computer to restore this lost knowledge. But be aware... You are not welcome! Be ready to fight for your life!

description: See dazzling 4K images and 60FPS animations, and unravel an epic story in the visual novel Past Mistakes! Experience the story of Cyrus, a regular guy with a lot to answer for in his past, as he gets a rare second chance to heal and repair his past mistakes!

description: An online co-op horror for 1-4 players. Travel across the Old World on the Engine Eternal and explore randomly generated dungeons to locate fuel and upgrades for the last train to Paradise.

description: Help the tetras find the exit.

description: Left for dead on Mutiny Island by a traitorous first mate, you must survive and reclaim your lost ship, the Red Dawn. In this 3D open‑world pirate adventure.

description: On the Path of Success you will meet Despicable Dwarf, who tells you how to become successful and, perhaps, shares wisdom about methods of catching gnomes. A long motivational monologue of very controversial content awaits you. There is nothing else to do in the DLC. You can't catch gnomes either.

description: Loot and roguelike thrills await. Begin your epic action RPG adventure!

title: Spy Guy Hidden Objects: Spy Guy Indonesia
Time Jump
description:
A casual 3rd person action-adventure

Play as William Roger in this 3rd person comedy adventure. It's 1994. You're late for school! No sleep. No Breakfast. You "accidentally" activate your professors “Camera” and get sucked into the past.

Lost and alone in this strange place with your wits and no knowledge of where to go next, uncover the many mysteries of why you are here and at all costs, find your way back home before time runs out.

title: Shrine of Haunts
description: In the summer of 1990, you return to the secluded mountain village of Iwao as your grandfather falls critically ill. The village shrine is said to seal the yokai "Tsuchigumo." As the "Mushi Okuri Festival" nears, its ritual flames may awaken a thousand-year-old curse…

title: HR: Human Remains
description: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

title: Five Heads
description: Five prisoners each have a visible-to-others card on their forehead. Across three rounds, they logically deduce and rank their cards from lowest to highest. On the final round, each guesses their exact card, using every prior guess as a clue. A single mistake can doom them—can you solve it?

title: Mind Over Monarchy
description: Command your army in a turn-based strategy game where every move matters. Each round represents new challenges in randomly generated battles, but be careful because when your king dies your attempt is over!

title: Match App!
description: MATCH APP! is a visual novel game based on a Japanese dating app. Players take on the role of the protagonist and experience a story of new encounters through the dating app.

title: Beach Invasion 1915: Gallipoli
description: Beach Invasion 1915: Gallipoli is a first-person shooter set during the WWI Gallipoli campaign where players defend fortified coastlines against allied forces. Players use period-accurate weapons and defensive tactics, including mines and explosives, to repel waves of infantry, armored vehicles, aircraft, and naval vessels attempting to breach their position.

title: Vow
description: Vow is a mystical game about a cursed village frozen between sunset and night. Explore abandoned houses, read birch bark letters, and observe ancient rituals to uncover the mystery of the disappearance of its inhabitants — and your own fate.

title: Jail Dice: Roll to Break
description: As the last pilot aboard the dice-shaped combat machine [ Dice-Rover ], destroy threatening objects with exhilarating action. Power up your Dice-Rover enough to find and destroy the ultimate target, [ JAIL DICE ].

title: Children of Mare
description: Venture into the host's mind and extracts all its fears to feed Mare. Build, explore, mine and conquer ruins to please the goddess of nightmares.

title: Furry Company
description: This is an idle-style casual game that appears at the bottom of your screen. In the game, you'll hire adorable animals to work at the company you've founded. You be the boss and make sure they don't slack off. The earnings can be used to renovate or expand your cozy office.

title: Santa's Hitlist CEO Edition
description: Santa's Hitlist: CEO Edition is a single-player, top-down shooter rogue-lite game where you play as Santa, avenging average workers by taking down their CEOs. Armed with a vast arsenal of weapons, you'll face off against epic bosses from the business world in your quest for justice.

title: TreeTale
description: TreeTale is a HACK&SLASH RPG that combines limitless customization with strategic combat. Players can freely build their characters using an extensive Passive Tree, while the Skill Customization System allows them to refine their combat style to perfection.
