description: Bandeirantes invites the player to experience the life of one of the bandeirantes who explored Brazil in the 17th century. Come to the first historicly correct game of it's kind. Survival Crafting placed in the Brazilian Rain Forest.

title: The Garden of Hermeneus
description: Step into the role of 'Me,' a linguist, and decipher the words of 'Him,' a beastman. With only 90 days, can 'Me' connect with 'Him' heart to heart within this limited time?

title: Sokobos 2
description: A puzzle game about pushing vases into a cart, but you can push the cart too!

title: Rusty Foodies
description: Rusty Foodies is a puzzle game where you must strategically place various food blocks according to specific rules to achieve the target score. As you progress through the stages, you'll face an increasing number of obstacles, making placement more challenging.

title: Spring's Finale: Tales of Love
description: This spring, your campus life is quietly changing. You start to ponder what the relationships between you all really mean. The throbbing of youth, the intimate bonds, and the hidden feelings are intertwined, waiting for your choices.

title: Lavender Field
description: An atmospheric visual novel with puzzle elements and a nonlinear storyline.

title: Swimmer Away
description: Brave storm-lashed seas as a Coast Guard swimmer. Plunge from choppers, swim through swells, search sinking ships, strategize rescues, and ultimately decide who lives and who dies in the dark, icy, unforgiving ocean.

title: Beach Bar Simulator
description: Run your own beach bar on the shores of Miami Beach! Serve drinks, manage customers, and grow your business. Play solo or co-op, customize your bar, and create the ultimate summer hotspot! ️

title: Blossom Breeze
description: Blossom Breeze, take a breath and calmly clear some petals.

title: Toy Smash Kaboom!
description: Toy Warfare, Physics Collisions, Auto Chess, Space Management, Item Crafting, Trap Setting, Countless Playstyles—Every Combo is a Brand-New Adventure!​

title: Chronominion Idler
description: Manage your party, develop skills, and shape the fate of a living world in this strategy-driven RPG.

title: The Creator
description: The Creator is a peaceful meditative game-simulator where you create unique designs for locations and territories. Enjoy the creative process without searching for resources or fear of making mistakes, as you design stunning interiors and exteriors in picturesque corners of the world.

title: Robots and Planets
description: It is time, the planets have been invaded and need saved from infinite destruction. The enemies must be stopped from causing any more chaos. Go through challenging space puzzles and seek to be the hero and save the planets within your solar system!

title: Tainted Pools
description: Tainted Pools is a first-person survival horror set in the eerie poolrooms of Backrooms Level 130. A stalking entity lurks in the shadows, drawn to every sound. Scavenge for resources and survive long enough to find your way out.

title: The Airflow Trials
description: In the simulated world, the drone tries to cope with tasks that sometimes defy gravity and at other times, common sense. Loads, buttons, levers, and amusing fails in a physics puzzle where every mistake is almost an experiment.

title: Anura
description: Join Don Rano in his adventure! A platformer in which you will have to use the bubbles of the stage, and the ones you create, in order to reach the most difficult platforms. Will you try to go as fast as possible? Or will you take it at your own pace? You decide!

title: Off-world Prospecting
description: Off-World Prospecting is a game about mining for valuable resources, recovering long lost artifacts and resources left by a mysteriously vanished colony. Upgrade your tools, get rich, and unravel the stories of an alien planet as you delve deeper.

title: Shadows of Midnight: They Watch Me Sleep
description: The game is a narrative-driven horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill and Fears to Fathom franchises. Live through two terrifying stories: a man’s summer getaway turns into a nightmare at a shady hotel, and a child grows up knowing something watches from the forest—always waiting.

title: Haxrail
description: A fast-paced roguelite shooter in a decaying star system trapped in a time loop. Fight, adapt, and break the cycle... before it breaks you.

title: Hope & Elpis
description: Hope & Elpis is a deck-builder roguelike where you play as a magical girl with two souls. Transform into the ancient mage Elpis, wielding Orbs to battle enemies. Learn diverse spells, unleash the Orbs' power, and seal calamities in Eden.

title: Welcome, Sharehouse!
description: Living in a share house with three pretty girls

title: Bacterian
description: Ever wanted to reach deep within yourself? Now you can. Fight off filthy diseases and germs in Bacterian - new take on a classic Sokoban - style game.

title: Realm Watch
description: Realm Watch is a cooperative Top-Down Dark Fantasy defense game where you choose your hero, fortify your defenses, and battle to survive relentless enemy waves. The sky weeps glowing pus—are you ready to defend the realm?

title: Icoptic Journey
description: Grapple, bounce, and fly through vibrant challenging levels. Build momentum and use precision to reach the goal as quickly as possible.

title: AI-deal-Rays
description: "Spring into action, supersonic Sylpheed." Become the owner of the female android "AI-deal", and prepare for high-stakes drama and high-speed action, all rendered in real-time 3D.

title: Punch to Glory
description: Start your journey as a boxer from the ground up, fighting your way to glory. Develop your character, collect fight cards, and face the challenges life throws your way. Train hard, manage stress, and give everything you've got to turn your championship dreams into reality.

title: Chicken Brother Guardian
description: An exciting top-down dodge shooter.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Deokjeok-do
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Gnom
description: Build and defend a settlement with an increasing number of gnomes. Gnomes chop wood, build things, and fight. Some become giants. Some become nanognomes. There are 52 buildings and 900 tech tree perks. The gnomes have options.

title: The Town of Nie Iromusubi
description: A strange tale, weaved like the petals of a flower.

title: Hentai Sexy Girls: Splashes and Water
description: Solve the puzzle, reveal the beauty!

title: Fashion Passion Puzzle
description: Dress your brain in style and puzzle your way to fashion fame!

title: Aery: Peace of Mind 3
description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

title: Tamagorudo: Floor O
description: TAMAGORUDO - Floor 0 - is an atmospheric psychological horror game. You will find yourself stuck in a parallel floor of the Backrooms, trying to break out of the loop of a chicken-or-the-egg paradox. Will you find the answer to this endless question ?

title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
description: This is a romance simulation game. In this game, there are no naive, overly-sweet girls—you'll need genuine charm and flirting skills to win a girl's heart.

title: Brotank
description: "BROTANK" is a top-down action roguelike game that combines retro RPG elements. Players will adventure in a post-apocalyptic world, recruit companions, acquire powerful tanks and equipment, capture wanted criminals, and ultimately become legendary hunters!

title: Land of Anima: The Research of Artificer
description: Isometric tower defense game where you can change the map routes to create your own strategy. Collect resources, craft towers, and upgrade your equipment to unravel the mysteries of the Land of Anima.

title: Jolly Land Adventure
description: Love the golden age of 2D platformers? Jolly Land Adventure brings back the joy of smooth jumps, colorful worlds, and creative levels in a fresh and accessible way. Whether you're a longtime platformer fan or new to the genre, there’s plenty to enjoy!

title: Equate 8
description: Equate 8 is an innovative and addicting new math puzzle game by the creator of The Devil's Calculator. Rearrange numbers in a 3x3 grid to solve eight equations (3 across, 3 down, and 2 diagonal) in the fewest moves possible. Challenges involve a variety of operators and difficulty levels!

title: Life in the Janitor's Room with a JK Girl
description: I returned to the janitor's room and found that a JK had suddenly barged in... As I got used to her presence, our relationship grew closer.

title: My Desktop Sister
description: My Desktop Sister is a computer desktop companion. Experience the love and kindness from My Desktop Sister.

title: Maximus Mouse's Manic Mayhem
description: Maximus Mouse is back! Experience Manic Mayhem across Story, Arcade & Trial modes. Or grab some friends for party mode!

title: The Existence Theory of the No.13 High School
description: This is a text-based adventure game about a Chinese high school, where you will experience the joys or pains, the richness or meaninglessness of high school life by rolling dice and making choices.

title: No Time for Pants
description: Compact, tactical, rogue-lite, 2d action with pixelized graphics with a dark, gritty tone. Gather all the resources you can and customize your loadout- you must evolve with every death to fight through the horrors that await you. This is No Time For Pants!

title: Rogue Shapes
description: Rogue Shapes is a fast-paced roguelike bullet hell where you battle waves of deadly shapes, level up, and choose powerful upgrades. Complete challenges to unlock new playable shapes, each with unique weapons. How long can you survive the chaos?

title: Lost Ground
description: 3x3 grid turn-based battle and the exquisite encounter of the rogue-lite deck building! Place multiple heroes on the 3x3 grid to strategically defeat your enemies. Customize and grow your heroes with various combinations of gears, cards, and relics. Defeat the demons to reclaim lost ground!

title: Astral Dusk
description: Astral Dusk is a first-person, crafting horror survival game following a lone astronaut marooned on the edge of a deep, dark moon crater. Scavenge various resources, debris, and alien plant life to craft tools to venture further into the void, to fix your damaged rocket, and blast off into space.

title: Prototype Juan: A Tale of Two Mundos
description: Juan's been banished to the prototype version of his game! He's gone from a colorful 16-bit hero to a tiny 1-bit homie. Help him platform his way back in this narrative action-platformer—with Juan himself teaching you how to control him through this mini-metroidvania!

title: Roach Post
description: Restore an abandoned post office by order of the Royal Postal Academy! Welcome customers, send packages, hire cute little roach-workers and pass Inspectors’ checks in an incredibly addictive roguelite puzzle Roach Post!

title: Magecraft: Spellbuilding
description: Craft spell cards, collect new effects, and build the perfect deck as you fight through rounds of turn-based combat. Survive randomly-generated dungeon layouts by countering enemy attacks with your own spells, and make the most of the powers and scrolls you pick up along the way.

title: Rise of the Penguins 2: Penguin's Dark Ascent
description: Dive into 'Rise of the Penguins 2: Penguin's Dark Ascent' a thrilling 2D action-platformer where you battle bosses, throw snowballs, and challenge the Crimson Star cult in a world shrouded in Eternal Dusk.

title: Royal Vermin
description: Climb, throw, and survive in this chaotic 2-4 player physics-based party game! As your preferred critter caught in a sudden flood, you must fight in a massive trash pile to claim your crown as the true "Royal Vermin."

title: Hope Harrison
description: Hope Harrison takes a twist on the survival horror genre and remixes it with Hand Crafted RNG, Nightmarish Monsters and Permadeath. Can you find hope?

title: Mythic Isle
description: "Create your mini fantasy island in the corner of your Windows desktop! Tired from work or study? Just click casually and watch adorable pets farm, mine, and build automatically for you~ From a deserted isle to a thriving paradise - all thanks to these little creatures with superpowers!"

title: Nina’s Sugar Cage
description: Alone with your adorable girlfriend. A perfect home. A perfect routine. A perfect love. Sweet, happy, and flawless in every way. …Except for one thing: you can’t leave. A loop of love and madness— An exploration-based 3D psycho horror featuring a beautiful girl.

title: SnaPaul 2: Anomalies
description: After a prank gone horribly wrong, you're ensnared in a nightmarish loop crafted by your own mother. As you delve into her twisted past, the boundaries between reality and madness blur. Unravel the sinister secrets and confront the malevolent forces that bind you.

title: Regex Game
description: Regular Expressions (Regex) are a powerful text pattern-matching tool used for searching, replacing, and validating strings. The game wraps Regex into text-based puzzle, allowing players to gradually master regular expressions as they progress through levels.

title: Vanguard Galaxy
description: A relaxing game about space exploration that lives at the bottom of your screen. Trade, fight, mine and salvage your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Let the game idle while your autopilot handles business and builds your fortune.

title: Only Dance!
description: You are a little fairy born from a girl's tears. Let's dance to make her smile!

title: Military Logistics Simulator
description: Drive real military vehicles, deliver critical cargo, and master first-person logistics solo or with friends. Rescue survivors, provide infrastructure, and rebuild a war-torn region!

title: SourceWorld
description: SourceWorld is a Dungeon Crawler Half-Life 2 mod with Immersive Sim elements. Be an indebted explorer doing raids on procedurally-generated parallel dimensions. Your job is Multiverse Research, but the curiosity comes with putting everything in danger of something lurking in far universes.

title: Strangers of the Power: Trancevania
description: New addon character and a small dungeon with brand new gameplay functions

title: Hop n' Hook
description: Hop N Hook is a platforming-fishing game set across three distinct zones, built around movement, exploration, and collection. Swing with your rod, explore open-ended zones, and catch over 50 unique fish—some of which fight back in reactive boss encounters.

title: Room Football: Shipyard
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Room Football: Dark Place
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Yosei Wars
description: Defeat the Junk Food and Rescue the Tooth Fairies! Platforming game inspired by many arcade classics. 9 out of 10 dentists recommend wishlisting this game!

title: A Simple Job
description: A simple task: Don't press the red button. Sounds easy? Featuring an annoying voice, absurd endings, and too many achievements. Free. Pointless. Glorious.

title: Painted Echoes
description: Painted Echoes is a relaxing puzzle game where you absorb and shoot colors to repaint mismatched rooms.

title: Trolley Dash
description: Trolley Dash is a fast-paced, endless arcade game where you race to grab items, fill orders, and deliver them before time runs out! You must dodge rogue trolleys, navigate shifting shelves, and react fast to keep up with the chaos. Can you get to the top of the leaderboards? Good luck!

title: The Mountain and the Moron
description: The Mountain and The Moron is a 3D Rage Platformer about a Uncle who is down on his luck, and watches a podcast telling him to "Climb a mountain to become Enlightened".

title: Arcane Archer
description: Arcane Archer is a 3D platforming FPS speedrun game where you must use explosive arrows to blast yourself across gaps and up walls to reach the goal! Use the power of your explosive arrows to parkour your way through an assortment of stages, and shoot for the top of the leaderboard!

title: Riftseekers
description: Use your abilities to defeat enemies, avoid traps, collect gems, and score enough points to summon bosses. Defeat these bosses to open rifts to randomized biomes. Collect upgrades in-between stages to ensure survival. In this endless arcade-style roguelike, how many points can you get?

title: On Donuts and Holes
description: A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?

title: Reverie in the Moonlight
description: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

title: All Aboard! The Twilight Train
description: All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a first-person narrative-adventure set on an interdimensional train. Explore the train, talk to the passengers, drink carrot juice, and help fellow passengers make it to their destination off this weird train.

title: La Galerie des Toilettes
description: Explore a museum containing the word's greatest collection of toilet art.

title: Velocity Riders
description: Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping 3D bike racing adventure! Zoom through stunning environments with ultra-realistic graphics and smooth controls.

title: Grim Trials
description: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

title: Four Directions
description: Four Directions is a turn-based strategy game that incorporates mechanical tasks and card skills based on the war chess game. Players will control 15 heroes, with different professions, use a variety of card skills, open mechanical devices on the chessboard map and confront the enemy head-on.

title: Guardian Grids 2
description: A super casual and relaxing tower defense game, fully upgraded from the previous generation! Light roguelike elements — click to choose your card each round!

title: Sable's Grimoire 2
description: Sable's Grimoire 2 is a visual novel featuring monster girls in a magic academy setting. This is a sequel to the original Sable's Grimoire game. It follows Sable's studies of magic and his budding friendships with his demi-human classmates and teachers.

title: Pixel Dash: Toast of Destiny
description: Haruka Ran is a high school girl who runs with a piece of bread in her mouth. She is searching for her fated encounter in a side-scrolling, furious JK anime action game! Let's go meet the man of your dreams with the anime-style story and slapstick sprinting action!

title: Dicey Words
description: The wordy roguelike. Dicey Words is a clever dice-based word builder where you roll letters, reroll like Yahtzee, and craft five-letter words for big points. Earn powerful badges that twist the rules, boost your score, and transform each run into a strategic puzzle.

title: Tiny Circuits
description: Solve bite-sized circuit board puzzles as a tiny robot! Connect components, become employee of the month in this logic puzzler with randomized layouts and handcrafted charm.

title: The Demon Queen's Dire Dilemma
description: A cute and comedic yuri visual novel about a demon queen who just can't catch a break.

title: Lots of Cats on an Adventure
description: “Lots of Cats on an Adventure” is a game where you find hidden cats in comic strips, meow!

title: Lots of Cats on an Adventure: Alien Showdown
description: “Lots of Cats on an Adventure: Alien Showdown” is an expansion pack that contains the latter part of the story from the base game, meow!

title: Paper Pusher
description: A short atmospheric psychological horror game. Locked in a corporate contract, you must decide who lives and who dies based only on details that can be written down about them. How will you justify your choices?

title: Branch Collector
description: Challenge the cold in this cozy, rogue-like survival game. Collect branches to keep your fire lit, choose shop items and upgrades to increase your chances of survival with dozens of ways to modify your game play. Remember, the cold always wins.

title: Dhadoom!
description: High-speed parkour obstacle racing with wild courses, fierce rivals, and nonstop action!

title: Topiopolis
description: Topiopolis is a medieval world-building game based on accumulating and arranging tiles in the right places. You unlock new tiles when you place them next to others.

title: Alien Evolution
description: Alien Evolution is a Minecraft mod that overhauls hostile mobs with evolutionary variants and new behaviors, introducing mutated creatures, tiered life stages, and evolving biomes that alter combat and exploration.

title: Astral Lodge
description: A short 2D point-and-click room escape game in the spirit of flash games of the early internet. Explore a surreal, dreamlike room, using objects and clues to interact with the environment and escape.

title: 100 Barcelona Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Lisbon Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: Alice in Disguise
description: Help Alice rescue her friends to save Wonderland! Alice in Disguise is a stealth puzzle game where you disguise yourself as chess pieces and move like them to solve sneaky challenges. Use potions, magic mirrors, and quick thinking to stay hidden — all wrapped in a charming and colorful art style.

title: Software CEO
description: Build your own software empire from scratch. Manage projects, recruit staff, design components, and grow from a garage startup to a tech giant. Create SaaS platforms, sell software, or fulfill contracts. Balance quality, deadlines, and innovation in this relaxing yet deep business simulation game.

title: Goblin Vyke: The Thief Tycoon
description: At night, you're a thief, sneaking into dungeons to steal goods. By day, you're a cunning merchant, haggle to sell at high prices. Master the art of stealth, steal the Demon Lord's hidden treasures. Recruit employees, expand your business. Grow from a penniless goblin to a black market tycoon!

title: Bad NPCs
description: A Minecraft mod that enhances NPC behavior by making villagers and other humanoid mobs hostile and unpredictable. Expect aggressive dialogue, opportunistic attacks, and new AI patterns that turn settlements into dangerous, reactive environments, forcing players to adapt defenses, tactics, and interactions.

title: Naja Medjai
description: Naja Medjai is a family-friendly Souls-lite 3D platformer set in a mythical Ancient Egypt. Play as Rosetta, a Medjai warrior blessed by Apophis and Anubis, as she battles corrupted gods to save humanity.

title: Star-Coat
description: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

title: Sniffin for Bones
description: Sniffin for Bones is a cozy game about finding little hidden bones and solving some relaxing puzzles. Unwind with a game that doesn't force you to have fast reaction times, complex inputs or be a puzzle wizard.

title: Terra Pit
description: Dig, explore, and survive in procedurally generated mines. Collect ore, avoid traps, upgrade your gear, and go deeper for greater rewards — or lose everything.

title: Mine Safety
description: A fast-paced, highscore-driven game where you operate a mining platform with speed, precision, and zero workplace accidents.

title: Wake Explorer
description: Explore, map, and survive a vast alien ocean. Upgrade your fleet, follow cryptic orders, and uncover secrets in this atmospheric corporate exploration game.

title: Enemy Expansion
description: Is a mod that aims to make combat encounters in Minecraft more varied and interesting with the introduction of several new mobs. The mod is in continual development, consistently being updated by Nekomaster with all manner of creature to freshen up your combat experience.

title: Legendary Armory
description:
Legendary Armory is a mod all about integrating the Legend of Zelda series as seamlessly as possible into the base game experience. With a wide variety of items carefully integrated into the Minecraft experience. All with a focus on looking and feeling like they belong in the game. Inspired by Zelda Sword Skills of old, this mod aims to include the function of every Zelda item into the vanilla style of Minecraft. It's features are made to be fully functional, intuitive to the Vanilla experience, and most importantly fun to use.

Most of the items are not craftable, only a handful of things are able to be crafted. Instead you are meant to explore and obtain the items from structures already present in the game. There are multiple ways to achieve items, such as fishing, archeology, Villager trades, Piglin bartering, unique interactions with mobs, and structures! Most items have at least two ways of obtaining them so try your best. Most items are upgradable so, you will want to begin collecting Master Upgrade Templates! Upgrade Templates can be found from structures, archeology, and even fishing as they're vital to the mod's progression.

If you find yourself stuck, you will want to check in the advancements in game. There are over 40 designed to act as hints or push you towards achieving certain goals.

I've handcrafted everything in this mod myself to be something that ultimately I would want to play. From the over 318 hand made textures, ~30,000 lines of code, and all kinds of mental labor that's to say all of this goes together to create the ULTIMATE Zelda mod!

title: Legendary Creatures
description: It adds new creatures to the world. Those creatures are supposed to be aggressive and make the game more challenging.

title: Legendary Monsters
description: Legendary Monsters is a mod that adds 9 new challenging mobs to the game. for each mob there is a reward, for example unique weapon (for each weapon from this mod there is an unique ability) this mod also add some new structures to the game. There are also Friendly Creatures which you can ride or tame or even recolour by holding shift and right clicking with valuable items!

title: Occultism
description:
A ritual magic system centered around summonable spirits allows you to automate various tasks, store vast amounts of items, let demons mine in void dimensions, create powerful enchanted tools and jewelry, get support from familiars, and much much more.

Begin your journey by crafting the Dictionary of Spirits, and following that in-game guide, discover the secrets of the spirit world,
find otherworld groves hidden in plain sight by gaining the "Third Eye", and finally summon your first spirit.

title: Do You Even Forklift?
description: Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Ghibli and Japan car culture! Use your forklift skills in logic puzzles with many unexpected outcomes!

title: Maltese's Fluffy Onsen
description: Run a bathhouse visited by animals! Maltese's Fluffy Onsen is a relaxing simulation game that you can enjoy while doing other tasks, as it sits at the bottom of your screen. Place baths with different temperatures and rest areas to help a variety of animal friends unwind.

title: Cursed Digilens
description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Use a digital camera to take photos of ghosts. Get chased by monsters. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

title: Tower of Pestilence
description: In this survival/roguelite with a fanciful and monstrous art style, explore a dungeon where vampiric creatures and pestilence demons coexist. Play as adventurers with simple and accessible controls, improve your gear, and survive the hordes lurking in the tower !

title: Tantei Jinguji Saburo: Prism of Eyes - Toki no Sugiyuku Mama ni
Idle Cave Miner 2
description: Idle Cave Miner 2 is an idle incremental game about mining resources, crafting items, and improving your team of miners. Discover unique worlds, battle monsters, and strengthen your team on your quest to explore the mines, and find out what secrets lay at the bottom.

title: Sushi vs. Burger Race
description: It's time for a gourmet race battle like no other! Who will claim the top spot: Sushi or Burger?

title: Stip
description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

title: Song of Morus: Limbo Express
description: Third-Person On-Rail Shoot 'em up, where a young Taoist priestess and a deity of Death escort a spiritual train through the underworld. Nonlinear space, physics-defying action, and relentless speed await.

title: Lucky Drop
description: Lucky Drop is a fun game of chance where you release balls and watch where they land. The path through obstacles is always different, and each launch brings excitement and the challenge to score as many points as possible. A perfect game to relax and test your luck – simple, fast, and addictive!

title: Burger Bounce
description: Burger Bounce is a fast-paced game where you control a jet-powered burger, bouncing through levels filled with platforms, gaps, and food-themed enemies. Smash obstacles, collect ketchup coins, and upgrade your condiments to travel farther and achieve the highest score!

title: The Jumping Spaghetti
description: From the makers of the Jumping Food Games comes the next whirling adventure on the plate. In "The Jumping Spaghetti" you control an elastic noodle through 28 varied levels full of obstacles, rotating platforms and surprising twists and turns.

title: Tralalero Tralala Jumper
description: A shark. A wall. A dodge. A meme. Swipe, switch, and laugh as the viral "Tralalero Tralala" sound follows your every move. No pressure. Just pure meme-powered chaos.

title: Entry Denied
description: A 2D point-and-click investigation game where you play as an undercover agent checking guest documents and appearances to uncover a criminal conspiracy.

title: Context Catacombs
description: Shift between first-person and text mode at will, allowing you to manipulate the 3D world with text commands and dungeon-delve into the text world using first-person movement!

title: Ready, Set, Block!
description: "Ready, Set, Block!" is a fast-paced PvP board game where players race to reach the opposite side first. Place blocks to slow opponents, use character abilities and items to outwit rivals, and plan your moves carefully in this turn-based, tactical race. Play locally, online, or vs AI.

title: Crystal Keeper
description: Mine crystals and defend your wall in this idle defense game. Balance resource gathering with combat as you upgrade your way through endless enemy waves.

title: Cryptid Keeper
description: Become the Cryptid Keeper. Track, catch, and collect cryptids, monsters, and aliens. Manage your own Cryptid Zoo, care for your creatures, and attract visitors while exploring the wild to discover new and mysterious Cryptid species to add to your Index.

title: They Call It Gravity
description: They Call It Gravity is a fast-paced single-player air combat game where you pilot a highly agile drone through handcrafted arenas in push-forward tactical action — dodge air defenses, expand your zone of control and destroy enemy swarms.

title: Can't Stop Rory
description: By day, grow and decorate your cozy post-apocalyptic farm to meet government quotas, unlock new decorations and scale your farm. But beware, when night falls, the Unfed will try to take away everything that you've built. Lay traps, build turrets and deploy mechs to defend the last sustainable haven.

title: CryptidCam
description: Head out into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

title: Succubus Roulette
description: Play Succubus Roulette with a deck of 8 cards. Two enter. One comes out. Bet your ass to roll the dice. Good luck.

title: The Gentle Golem
description: The Gentle Golem is a relaxing open world exploration game inspired by Zelda and PowerWash Simulator! Clean up the corruption that's encroaching on your home! Grow plants to help you traverse, or just grow pretty ones! Explore the Cloudlands at your own pace. Can you uncover its mysteries?

title: Powerfall
description: Powerfall, a 3D dystopian platformer set in the year 2500. Your task? Return the power (literally speaking) to the people by parkouring your way to the top of the skyscraper that withholds it all.

title: Ultra Core Dive
description: SHOOT AND DODGE your way through the underground arenas in this Dark Chaotic Arcade Twinstick Shooter! Don't get consumed by the noise!

title: Idle Reincarnator
description: An incremental RPG where you reincarnate through lifetimes, mastering professions, unlocking skills, and exploring mystical realms.

title: Blessed
description: Blessed is a fast‑paced, 2D top‑down co-op arena shooter where you and your friends team up as "blessed" heroes to battle endless waves across elemental realms, and more in intense action.

title: Frontline Command
description: Frontline Command is a tactical auto-battler where you control a squad of soldiers through intense missions in a modern military setting. Use strategy and combat skills to outsmart tough opponents as you navigate challenging battlefield scenarios.

title: Underfishing
description: You just arrived in hell. Nothing left to to do but contemplate the life you lived, and fish. Fish out ancient treasures, upgrade your fishing abilities, and face your biggest regrets in this narrative fishing game! Will you manage to fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life?

title: Abyssborne
description: Abyssborne is a dark fantasy roguelite that thrusts you into a shadowed, ever-changing dungeon, teeming with enemies, upgrades, and untold power.

title: Across the Obelisk: The Sunken Temple
description: Lost beneath Aquarfall, an ancient temple has been uncovered. But its final guardian is never the same. The deeper you go, the more the past reveals itself — secrets of amphibious races, forbidden rituals, and dangerous relics await.

title: Fofumia
description: Welcome to Fofumia! Clean up the mess left by the adorable Fofunos - playful, hyperactive one-eyed kittens who love scattering toys and objects everywhere. It's up to you to set everything straight...

title: Shape Blast
description: Shape Blast is a short, arcade roguelike where you bounce a ball between two paddles and blast waves of shapes. Unlock tons of upgrades and customize your build. Keep the flow and find new strategies every game.

title: Inverta
description: Defy gravity in Inverta, a 2.5D puzzle-platformer set in a ruined world. Flip between surfaces, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover apocalyptic secrets. A unique challenge awaits!

title: PuppetShow: Lost Town
description: After discovering a new system of caves, the entire town is excited to explore, until Suzy is kidnapped by a mechanical beast! Emerging from the darkness and startling the townfolk, the creature causes a cave-in behind him, leaving no trail to follow. Track the creature down and explore the mysterious caves in PuppetShow: Lost Town.

title: Untamed Ehizia
description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with multiple experimental game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

title: Idle Tree Keeper
description: Idle Tree Keeper is a relaxing idle/incremental game where you care for a mystical tree. Generate resources, unlock upgrades, evolve, and progress even while offline. Free to play with optional in-game purchases.

title: Beastopia
description: A strategy game that combines resource management and auction mechanics, where players compete for financial dominance in the Animal Kingdom through clever investments and bidding.

title: Vegetables of Mass Destruction
description: An action hack 'n' slash roguelite where you play as a feisty raccoon tasked with saving the farm animals from evil robots by his master, Sensei Cow. Use the destructive power of vegetables and team up with your trusty chicken and pig pals to rescue farm animals and destroy the robot invaders!

title: Apothecary of City X
description: Run a warm, cosy apothecary in a cold, dark city. Grim-cosy management sim with card combat and loveable weirdos.

title: Corebound
description: Corebound combines automation and deckbuilding into a unique strategic experience. Battle mysterious constructs as you build production lines to generate the cards you need. Optimize your decks and factories, expand and fight your way to the mountain’s core.

title: Broom and Boom
description: Blast goblins with gunpowder and magic as you ride your assortment of broom and broom-like apparatuses in this twin stick arcade shooter. Customize your witch and cackle for Victory!

title: Lunatix
description: Enter the twisted dreamworld of Lunatix in this first-person psychological horror experience. As a test subject you'll navigate a distorted and ever-changing landscape, where reality blurs with nightmare. Solve interactive puzzles to unravel the mysteries of your subconscious and the forces at play.

title: Beetleball
description: Score goals with dungballs in Beetleball, the Greatest Online Multiplayer Class-based Dung Beetle Soccer Game to ever exist.

title: Cats & Pandas
description: Hidden Cats & Pandas is a hidden object game. The player's task is to find all the cats and pandas that are hidden in different parts of the map.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas Stories Los Santos
description:
Total conversion mod for GTA San Andreas that tries to recreate a "San Andreas Stories" faithful to what Rockstar could have done after the launch of LCS and VCS (based on these) and also taking into account the limitations of the PSP.

Immerse yourself in the character of Ralph Pendelbury, a police officer with a certain code of honor and principles that will be pushed to the limit when he is recruited to go to Los Santos and confront the growing problem of criminal gangs.
It's 1987, and tensions between the Los Santos gangs and the police department have reached alarming levels. Police brutality, extrajudicial killings, disappearances, officers killed during shootouts between the two factions, and large human, material, and economic losses have been the result of the constant struggle to gain control of the city's streets.

title: Wars Across The World: Angola 1988
description: Angola 1988 covers the last year of the war in Angola. To win, both sides must either eradicate the enemy from the filed, or take control of all cities and keu location. Otherwise, Peace negotiations will end the game and victory will come to the one ahead in VP.

title: Bound in Time
description: A two player, co-op horde shooter with a sci-fi, futuristic twist – play as two heroes, a cyborg and a samurai, working together to defend worlds across space and time from invasions of creatures. As levels are explored, upgrade each character’s abilities in order to take on enemies and a boss!

title: Gravitee
description: Gravitee is the platformer with a twist! Rotate your character in order to change the direction of gravity. Navigate your way through each level in order to reach the goal. Solve puzzles, face off against deadly spikes and bombs, and more.

title: Jaleco Sports: Goal!
description: Experience the ultimate soccer showdown! Featuring 24 different teams and intense arcade-style gameplay, these original NES & SNES favorites are back to deliver fast-paced football fun. Play a quick match or complete for the Cup—don your kit and step onto the pitch today!

title: Genshin Impact: A Space and Time for You
description:
Version 5.7 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Skirk and Dahlia
• New main story quest: "A Space and Time for You"
• New story quest for Skirk
• New endgame mode: Stygian Onslaught
• New main event: Battle of Imagined Arrays
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Deep Room
description: An anti escape room game where you explore the depths of a mysterious room.

title: Halcyon Days at Taoyuan
description: Welcome to Taoyuan Village to heal your loneliness. Here, you can lead a carefree, self-sufficient life: farm, tame animals, raise livestock, fish, and build a prosperous homestead. Or, immerse in village life, meet kindred spirits, find love, and influence their destinies with your choices.

title: Section Six Requiem
description: You are assigned by the organization to hunt down the escaped test subjects. Every action unfolds through turn-based card battles— persuasion or reconciliation, conflict or closure, the power of choice is in your hands!

title: PayGame
description: 《PayGame》is a black-and-white hand-drawn dungeon exploration game.You must race against time through randomly generated rooms, combining items and bills to pay massive amounts of money in order to stay alive.Each run offers a brand-new challenge and a completely different experience

title: Inferno Pathways
description: Descend into the abandoned metro in Inferno Pathways, a first-person psychological horror game. Navigate dark tunnels, solve puzzles, and uncover sinister secrets. Confront your deepest fears and piece together the haunting story of Mike Collins. Can you escape the darkness?

title: Balloomia: Sky Playground
description: Control your gasha ball through differents plataforms in 60 seconds, collect your coins and reach the checkpoint! Are you ready to face low gravity, spikes and much more in this sky playground?

title: Knight of the Dungeon
description: A fast-paced 2D Rogue-Like game with Bullet-Hell elements and procedural level generation.

title: Will O Wisp
description: This is a platform action game in which you control light in a world shrouded in complete darkness and rely on it to progress. Use the light to travel from place to place and illuminate the buried truth.

title: Royal's Gambit
description: Royal’s Gambit is a retro-style, turn-based card strategy game. Battle through 80+ stages of face card patterns by playing cards equal to their health, build your deck, boost your score with smart plays, and survive multiple modes—or start over from the beginning.

title: Dustoria
description: Shape a quiet settlement in a forgotten desert. Keep your people comfortable, manage scarce resources, and slowly expand your city.

title: Paradox Protocol
description: Paradox Protocol is a 1-6 player co-op horror experience. Either alone or as a team you find yourselves in a procedurally generated map filled with mystery, puzzles and danger lurking within. Scavenge the map for resources and gear to help you complete puzzles and try to escape.

title: Ranch Farm and Store Simulator
description: Design, build, and manage your own ranch and store from the ground up. Grow crops, raise livestock, and keep your shelves stocked with fresh products for customer to buy. Expand your business, hire employees, and transform your humble ranch into a thriving marketplace.

title: Show Quiz
description: Show Quiz is a dynamic quiz game that tests your knowledge and reflexes! Chain together questions, climb levels and improve your rank to impress Jack Pot, your supercharged presenter.Over 5000 questions await you in this game!

title: Departure of Darkness
description: This is a throwback to the golden age of survival-horror games. Set in a parasite-infected airport, the player is tasked with finding their brother by solving puzzles, sneaking past threats, and not making a sound… they’re always listening.

title: Holoidle
description: A relaxing Hololive idle game. Unlock upgrades, complete your card collection and take care of your idol to increase your influence!

title: Hop to It!
description: Hop your way through a colorful level filled with various challenges and obstacles, master the state-of-the-art pogo stick controls, and try not to fall...

title: Trauma Record
description: 夜を歩く、血だまりの上を走る、永遠を断ち切る。 復讐のための翼は折れない。

title: Gacha Idle
description: Gacha Idle is a casual idle RPG featuring comic-style visuals. Assemble elemental heroes, explore dynamic maps, and engage in turn-based battles.

title: Vartio
description: Patrol a haunted forest as a lone medieval guard in this short psychological horror experience. Leave the safety of your watchtower, listen for threats in the dark, and uncover what's lurking beyond the trees—before paranoia consumes you.

title: Randomlife Reborn
description:
A fangame that I am making about the youtuber RANDOMLIFE. It is like "terroro", his release will be soon. This is a Horror game in which you have to repair a car to escape, this game could have a second part in the future.
Many streamers are in this game like "miguelillo_rl" or "zapatos27"

title: False Title
description: Tenji was transported to another world, it's a different world compared to his place where he usually lives. Things are rather very complicated in this world there are conflicts, demon invasion etc.

title: Gauntlet Force: Rise of the Machines
description: Gauntlet Force: RotM is a metroidvania-lite action-brawler platformer. Fight brutally against an army of silly robots while ascending the interconnected Fortress of Doom. Collect upgrades and evolve your weapon to slay your way through bizzarre and evil villains.

title: Journey to the Center of the Lost Waterpark
description: In this first-person experience you visit a waterpark unlike any others you have seen before. Your adventure leads you through eerie and beautiful surroundings with puzzles and obstacles while you uncover the secrets of the lost waterpark.

title: Nonplace
description: You find yourself in the nonplace. Nonlinear, uncanny, maybe in between worlds or time itself. What is your purpose here? Are you just passing through, or are you an intruder surveying a reality that isn't even real?

title: Clocking In to Fight a Lich in Another Realm
description: It's finally time to start your new job at The Company! Time to clock in and see what's on the other side of The Company's newly developed portal technology. Fight undead, defeat bosses, and prevent the invasion of a lich's undead army.

title: Heart of Mycelium
description: A cozy autumn adventure with horrors waiting beneath the surface! Explore a vibrant pixel art world filled with unique creatures and tight platforming. Let the mycelium guide you on your journey to uncover mysteries deep below.

title: I Hate Robots
description: I Hate Robots is a fast-paced first-person action shooter. Play as a scientist battling robots on a mysterious planet. Explore dangerous portals, collect samples, and use an arsenal of weapons against dozens of enemy types. Atmospheric and intense levels await!

title: Drywall Eating Simulator
description: Drywall Eating Simulator is a physics-based 3D adventure game where you are pushed to the limits of human (or nonhuman) tolerance by the people you encounter in our world, and the only pressure release that you have is in the name of the game (eating drywall)

title: My Money Grows On Trees
description: Click. Water. Grow. Harvest. Explore. Upgrade. Profit. An incremental clicker farming game about growing your own farm full of money trees! Ever wondered what it'd be like if money grew on trees?

title: One Last Clip
description: You are locked inside a cinema. Your only way to escape is to follow the instructions of your task: Watch the same film clip repeatedly and search for flaws to break free. But this may sound easier than it is, every wrong decision or death will set you back. So be careful!

title: Wide Load
description: PARK. THAT. THING.Welcome to WIDE LOAD, the precision parking chaos simulator you never asked for—but absolutely need. Take control of an 18-wheeler and try to wedge, slide, drift, or pray into parking spaces that definitely weren't built with you in mind.

title: Please, Watch the Artwork
description: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

title: Spinner: Rogueblade
description: Blaze through brutal roguelike arenas with your customizable spinner. Face other spinners, evolve fast, and let the sparks fly!

title: Star Ores Inc.
description: Take over an abandoned space station and run your own ore mine. Carve your way through the asteroid with your laser, sell ore, and create an automated network of robot helpers to maximize your profit.

title: Crystal Gaiden Origins
description: Crystal Gaiden Origins is a hardcore 8-bit action platformer inspired by the brutal edge of NES-era classics. Slash through rebels, ex-allies, dark ancient technology, and a crumbling empire in chiptune-fueled missions. Inspired by Ninja Gaiden, Shatterhand, and Castlevania.

title: Mortal Shell II
description: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

title: Chronicles: Medieval
description: Chronicles: Medieval lets you step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox. Create your character and forge your path from rags to riches. Engage in intense combat, fight for land, glory, and legacy, and lead massive armies into epic, large-scale battles.

title: Code Vein II
description:
Code Vein II is an action role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world where Revenants are being transformed into hostile "Horrors." A Revenant Hunter must partner with a time-manipulating companion named Lou.
Gameplay features third-person action combat and deep RPG progression, emphasizing specialized Blood-based mechanics and character customization. An evolved Partner System enhances tactical cooperation with AI companions during exploration and high-difficulty boss encounters. Success depends on mastering diverse weaponry and temporal abilities to survive a world defined by memory and ruin.

title: End of Abyss
description: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
description: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or in treacherous free-for-all multiplayer. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm. Do you have the strength to seize the Iron Throne?

title: Atomic Heart II
description: The Atomic Heart sequel brings you back to the retrofuturistic universe, full of new characters and dangers. The game immerses you in events on a global scale and raises the bar for what an open-world action RPG can do.

title: Killer Inn
description: A corpse has been found... and everyone is a suspect. You have been chosen to participate in a one-night-only game of death, deceit, and deduction. Will you be a wolf? Or perhaps a lamb with the means to fight back... In deception we trust.

title: Out of Words
description: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

title: LEGO Voyagers
description: From the makers of LEGO Builder's Journey comes a new 2-player co-op adventure about friendship and play. When two friends make it their mission to rescue an abandoned spaceship, they embark on a journey beyond their wildest dreams.

title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
description: Bring iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy and real-time RPG action. Throw the dice and dive into a wild, action-packed adventure with a selection of Nickelodeon characters. Featuring epic battles, dynamic environments, it's an engaging gameplay experience for players of all ages.

title: Fractured Blooms
description: Tend your garden, cook your meals, and build your home in this time loop life sim. Tend your garden, the days are repeating, and something has started to bloom.

title: Blade & Soul Heroes
description: This thrilling free-to-play Collectible Action MMORPG offers the duality of turn-based strategy & real-time action. Experience exciting cross-platform play and embark on an epic quest where numerous stories are waiting to be discovered alongside your five member team. Unite your heroes!

title: Jurassic World Evolution 3
description: Build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

title: Kalit
description: A unique survival adventure, animated in a 1930s rubber hose style! Fight to survive: capture creatures, farm, mine, and craft everything you need—from gear and vehicles to your base. Explore lands and underwater depths with their shipwrecks, amidst dangers and wonders.

title: Owl Lights
description: Owl Lights is a first-person psychological horror game. You play as 16-year-old Paul, who lives in a small town. Your parents are away, leaving you to spend the night alone—or so you think. There is something in the wind that night, something unpleasantly quiet.

title: Coldwake
description: Explore an abandoned facility in this narrative-driven terminal adventure. Unlock hidden files, solve text-based puzzles, and piece together a fragmented AI as you uncover the truth behind a failed salvation and a buried past in this cold, atmospheric mystery.

title: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
description: In this Roguelite set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

title: Scott Pilgrim EX
description: Join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers in a brand-new brawling adventure across space, time, and the streets of Toronto!

title: The First Descendant: Season 3
description: Hoverbikes, 8-player Field Colossus Raids, and brand-new Descendants throughout this new season to experience.

title: LEGO Party!
description: LEGO(R) Party! is a 4-player party game that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO and more. Play your way! Join your friends no matter their platform locally or online!

title: Blighted
description: Battle your way through a psychedelic western nightmare to reclaim the memories of your people in this action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! Harness the power of the deadly, reality-altering Blight and unravel the mysteries of a twisted world.

title: Into The Unwell
description: Dive into The Unwell as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits in this delightfully despondent third-person roguelite game, playing alone or with up to two friends.

title: Fairy Massage
description: Fairy Massage - is a fairy massage simulator for adults. You are an ordinary guy, to whom a fairy flies by mistake and asks you to give her a massage so that she can calmly collect pollen from flowers. You have a unique opportunity to massage her well.

title: Last Flag
description: Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

title: Wu-Tang: Rise of the Deceiver
description: Wu-Tang: Rise of the Deceiver is a co-op action RPG with anime-style fighting and afro-surrealist aesthetic. Players will face increasingly challenging battle Chambers to the tune of reimagined Wu-Tang Clan tracks while decking out their own custom fighters.

title: Mongil: Star Dive
description:
Dive into a world of wonder!
A dazzling monster-taming Action RPG!

title: Resident Evil Requiem
description: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

title: Snap & Grab
description: Do crimes using only your camera and your crew! In Snap & Grab, any photo you take could be the key to cool crime success. Travel to exotic sandbox locations, photograph treasures and reveal threats, then combine your photos in unique ways to create a rad heist plan.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 Character Pass
description: Year 3 Character Pass - 4 additional characters (Sagat, C. Viper, Alex, Ingrid) - 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10 - Bonus: 3,000 Drive Tickets

title: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

title: Star Wars: Hunters - Season 4: Survival Instinct
description: Unleash your inner assassin with Nox, the new Damage Hunter in Star Wars: Hunters Season 4. The former Night Wind assassin hails from a remote village on Iridonia, and has joined the Arena to use the spotlight to generate leads about her long lost sister. This Zabrak Archer is deadly from range thanks to her Composite Bow, making her ready to fight on an Endor-inspired battlefield where the forest is reclaiming the planet.

title: Relooted
description: Reclaim real African artifacts from Western museums in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.

title: Spellcaster University: Gears and Gobelins
description: Dive into an epic new chapter of Spellcaster University's magical world with the "Steam Age" expansion!

title: Star Wars: Hunters - Season 5: Scum & Villainy
description: Master thief Glikkin enters the Arena and he’s here to steal the spotlight! This new Damage Class Hunter uses his stealthy abilities to sneak around battlefields before unleashing fury with a pair of devastating vibroblades. A new battlefield, Coruscant Underworld, is also coming to the Arena in Season 5. All Hunters can now equip Mods, which modify their stats!

title: Bones: Wandering Soul
description: Sneak past the living. Speak for the dead. Solve your way through a strange city, limb by limb, as a skeleton with no memory in a story-rich puzzle adventure full of mystery and meaning.

title: Oh, Bugger!
description: ‘Oh, Bugger!’ is a first-person shooter set in a luxury space hotel overrun by alien hordes. As a professional alien exterminator, pilot your mech to blast aliens and destroy their eggs, ending the infestation for good!

title: Tire Boy
description: Tire Boy is a fast, playful action-adventure platformer about a tire person. Leap, roll & battle your way through a lush, unfamiliar world and uncover your mysterious origins.

title: Reytrieve Odyssey
description: Reytrieve Odyssey is a vibrant 3D platformer starring a feisty android girl on a quest to retrieve mysterious data disks! Switch between powerful cartridges, explore giant colorful islands, and uncover the secrets of a broken world!

title: Journey Through the Nightmare Realm II
description: Retro pixel-art bullet hell meets arcade action. Collect cards, spin slots, and blast through enemies in this nostalgic roguelite with local co-op

title: Pocket Boss
description: Who says that work and play don’t mix? Not us! Play Pocket Boss, the game where you handle lots of fun data and one not-so-fun boss.

title: End Them, Soldier!
description: Near future. You are humanity's last hope for salvation. You must destroy everyone who stands in your way.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 - Sagat
description: Sagat is the first DLC character in the Street Fighter 6: Year 3 Character/Ultimate Pass. The Emperor of Muay Thai. He was once one of the highest ranking members of Shadaloo, but has since left the criminal organization. He currently lives deep in the mountains, focusing only on his training.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 - C. Viper
description: An operative belonging to a certain intelligence organization. A cold, hard realist. She complements her fighting abilities using a number of gadgets hidden in her outfit.

title: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Alex
description: A DLC adding the character Alex to Street Fighter 6's roster.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 - Ingrid
description: Ingrid, the extradimensional woman of mystery, will bring her sunlight to Street Fighter 6

title: Tekken 8: Season 1 Character & Stage Pass
description: The Season 1 Character & Stage Pass includes 4 Additional playable characters: Eddy Gordo, Lidia Sobieska, Heihachi Mishima, and Clive Rosfield. It also includes 2 Additional battle stages: GENMAJI TEMPLE and PHOENIX GATE. Additionally, it also includes the Character Costume: Gold Suit Pack, 1 costume per each playable character (32 total), Avatar Costume: Classic TEKKEN T-Shirt Set, 32 designs, and Avatar Skins: Kazuya Mishima, Jin Kazama, Jun Kazama, and Kinjin

title: Hitman World of Assassination: 25th Anniversary Edition
description:
Celebrate 25 years of Hitman with the Anniversary Box of Hitman World of Assassination, featuring exclusive collectibles:
- “Chess Master” 3D Shadowbox. No one is out of reach for Agent 47. With the iconic ICA19 Silverballer in his hands, he awaits his next assignment in this exclusive Shadowbox.
- “25 Years of Hitman" Lenticular card. From Hitman: Codename 47 to Hitman World of Assassination, this art card pays tribute to the evolution of Agent 47.
- Hitman World of Assassination (25th Anniversary graphics). Includes the best of Hitman, Hitman 2, and Hitman 3, featuring the main campaign, contracts mode escalations, freelancer mode, and live content.
- Celebrity Elusive Target DLCs. Includes The Undying, The Drop, The Splitter, The Banker packs that unlock a series of cosmetics inspired by the Elusive Targets and give permanent access to the missions.

title: Tekken 8: Season 2 Character & Stage Pass
description: The Season 2 Character & Stage Pass includes the following content: 4 Additional playable characters and 2 Additional battle stages

title: Homepage
description: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

title: Lands of Achra
description: Lands of Achra is a dark fantasy strategy game of a lost age. Build a customized force as a hero, monster or nation, fight your enemies in brutal autobattles and strive to vanquish the procedurally generated world. Seek glory, against all who struggle upon the distorted earth...

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Console Arcs
description:
A mod that ports the console arcs from different versions of Higurashi When They Cry made by the 07th-Mod staff.
These arcs are exclusive to the PS2, DS, PS3, and Switch versions of different Higurashi When They Cry ports, and this is the only way to play it on PC.

Taraimawashi
Tsukiotoshi

Yoigoshi

Hajisarashi

title: Pereelous
description: Spin your way to victory in this slotmachine-driven dungeon crawler. Battle monsters, collect loot and unleash the power of the random reels!

title: Alternative Alliance Alpha
description: Alternative Alliance Alpha is a short and gentle sci-fi post-apocalyptic adventure set in the distant future. Take control of the young man Jinovika as you explore the world beyond the colony—gathering resources, meeting new people, and enjoying everyday life in this strange world.

title: Pragma Twice
description: You've awoken deep within a research facility in a new, programmable robot body. You have holes in your memories. At least you no longer have that hole in your head...

title: Dream Boundary
description: Craft your deck before venturing forth. Strategically navigate the map, strengthen your abilities with talents and relics, and confront relentless enemies as you journey toward the unexplored frontiers of the Dream Boundary.

title: Mind Reader: Ghost Trip
description: Mind Reader: Ghost Trip is a Chinese horror mystery puzzle game. The story takes place on a remote southern island, where a former detective and current game daily reporter comes to visit, only to be caught up in the murder of a well-known game producer. As the investigation deepens......

title: Pizza Deathlivery
description: Alone or up to 6 players, deliver pizzas to the survivors of a city where an oppressive mist has turned almost everyone into monstrous creatures.

title: Astra Quest
description: Astra Quest is a retro-futuristic bullet hell shooter. Design modular starships with unique cores, bases, and devices. Survive intense battles, earn Evolution Points, and unlock upgrades in Adventure and Evolution modes to dominate the neon-lit cosmos.

title: Fast Food Manager 2
description: Fast Food Manager 2 is a realistic and multifaceted simulator where you will build and grow your own fast food restaurant chain from scratch!

title: Somewhere in Time and Space
description: Step into Farra’s shoes and begin a journey only you can understand. Collect topics, connect with others, and try to stop them from falling into the unknown. In a seemingly endless loop, move toward a fate waiting to be understood — and find yourself again.

title: Coastal Kitchen Simulator
description: Cook and serve dishes as you run your own seafood restaurant! Unlock new recipes, grow your kitchen with the help of employees, and satisfy every customer’s craving. Expand your reputation, manage resources wisely, and build a seafood restaurant that becomes the talk of the town.

title: Catch Flex
description:
Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide trails to the end, and dodge obstacles by ducking, leaning or stepping over. Vol. 1 holds ten hand-charted original tracks from 96 to 150 BPM, house, electro and techno, all charted within reach of a real body with no jumping needed. An optional no-fail mode lets you move through a whole song without chasing a score.

Beyond the solo run there is local split-screen Versus for two players, global leaderboards and ten achievements. Custom levels are made in Catch Flex Editor, a free browser editor, and loaded into the game over Wi-Fi. The game also reads charts saved in other common level formats.

title: SwooshMania
description: SwooshMania is a fast-paced 3D time trial racing game where every second counts. Run, jump, dodge and hurtle through tracks filled with dynamic obstacles and explosive hazards. Dominate each level, improve your time and climb the global leaderboard.

title: Warbound
description: Build your ultimate battle deck and lead your armies in epic strategic warfare. Collect powerful cards, conquer rival kingdoms, and rise to become the greatest ruler in WARBOUND!

title: Machine of the Wasteland
description: High-octane vehicular combat action game set in a chaotic, post-apocalyptic world where survival hinges on your ability to outmaneuver and outgun your enemies.

title: Magic Scavenger
description: 《Magic Scavenger》 is a light Rogue-like spell-building looting and extraction game. To earn money, you embark on an adventure—scavenging valuable items, crafting your spells, and fending off waves of enemies before extracting with your haul. How much treasure can you escape with?

title: Bully Ball Brigade
description: Simple mini games for all, roguelike for the experienced.

title: Stealer
description: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

title: Illusion Pathology
description: "Illusion Pathology" is a suspenseful and slightly scary B female love game. You will wake up as a doctor in a mental hospital, and become entangled with three suspicious "patients" around you, and your life and memory will be gradually revealed.

title: People of Mine
description: A psychological horror where you play as a former agent hunting a cult—only to uncover a disturbing truth about your identity, memories, and the monsters you thought you were fighting.

title: Gourmet Steak Odyssey
description: A resource management platformer where you play as Sweet Baby Jesus on a quest to make the perfect steak. Use your gun to propel yourself through levels and use your feet viciously to crush your foes.

title: Hole War: The Abyss
description: 「今こそ語りましょう。『もしも』の物語を……！」本作は、「職」と「食」から力を得て戦う長編RPGの体験版です。時には職業を変えて新たなスキルや能力を得て、時には料理を食べて一時的なバフを得て冒険しましょう。

title: Jewel Spirits
description: "Jewel Spirits" is a new type of game that combines turn-based strategy (strategic simulation RPG) with party-building roguelite elements. Build a party of jewel spirits with unique abilities and kick demons to the curb with your own unique composition!

title: Idol to Stalker: Tashika ni Kimi ga Suki Deshita
Dracs After Dusk
description: "Dracs After Dusk" is an arcade, top-down shooter. Blast through bloodsuckers as the sharp shootin’ sheriff of a wild west town. Battle the deadliest bosses, claim weapons from the Armory to fuel your leaderboard topping run. It's an old school quarter muncher but luckily you have unlimited credits!

title: Yabai Otoko ni Nanpa Sareru Game
description: Enjoy a conversation with a totally-not-suspicious handsome younger man.

title: Hexora
description: Hexora is a unique and innovative strategy puzzle game that combines the classic mine-sweeping gameplay with a godly perspective and city-building elements. Embark on an exciting adventure to unveil the unknown and guide your people to prosperity.

title: Anatomy of the Terrible
description: Experience a tale of horror driven by its intense and oppressive atmosphere. Take control of Andrew - an EMT convinced that the occupant of 623 Lumber Lane is dead. Explore the decrepit domicile, discover its secrets and unravel a depraved tale of creation.

title: Goblin Journal
description: Goblin Journal is a narrative-driven adventure with turn-based strategic auto-battles. Translate ancient goblin journals, uncover their lost history, and guide them through dangerous battles and decisions that will shape their fate. Will you unlock the mysteries of the goblins?

title: Unfound Footage
description: Unfound Footage is a short, atmospheric psychological horror game where you must survive inside a mysterious mansion after a strange disappearance.

title: Bake Until Done
description: You are a muffin. A wholesome little guy trying to navigate a baker's kitchen full of traps, tricks, and devious desserts. But those sweet treats are out for crumbs. Beat them back and get past the obstacles using only your muffin’s morsels. Just don't lose too much of yourself in the process.

title: Voidcutter Fuzor
description: Battle through waves of enemies, taking their power for your own in this retro-styled arcade shoot'em up.

title: Vending Machine Co.
description: Run your kawaii vending machine company! A relaxing sim where you run your own vending machine company across a charming Japanese city. Pick neighborhoods, stock up on snacks, and set the perfect price. Upgrade your machines and keep them stocked, one soda at a time!

title: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
description: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

title: Gyre
description: Gyre is a unique space-themed puzzle game! Strategically place planets and enhancements onto dynamic orbits to gain millions of points in combinations.

title: 100 Witch Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Candy Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all?

title: 100 Astro Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

title: 100 Ruin Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all? ️

title: My Lil Afterlife
description: Become the new ruler of the afterlife. Summon spooky friends to reside in your unearthly realm and decorate it however you like with items you can craft, buy and find. Unravel the mysteries of the afterlife by taking on the reapers tower using spine-tingling spells to smite your enemies.

title: Pebble Knights
description: Chew on weapons, chomp on poop, and devour your friends' graves in this chaotic co-op action roguelike! Eat shiny items to ascend your traits and stack team synergies as your squad snowballs into an unstoppable force. Play solo or team up with up to 5 players!

title: Nonogram Desserts
description: Use your logic to paint beautiful images in this relaxing puzzle. The gorgeous visuals and relaxing soundtrack will help you forget all your problems and have a great time!

title: Sweet Toys Simulator
description: Start your sweet store from scratch!. Pick and price your own toys and candies. Unlock new licenses with every sale, expand your shop, hire staff, and build the most colorful toy & candy empire ever! Manage shelves, set prices, and make your customers smile!

title: Seoul Exorcist 1111
description: Think Fast, Strike Faster! As the ultimate exorcist, choose your attacks wisely, upgrade combat deck, combine traits and items, and save the cursed souls—before death finds you.

title: Amalgun
description: Embark on an action roguelite adventure where you power up by taming and melding with enemies. Discover a diverse cast of creatures, uncover upgrades and unlocks hidden through the world, and build an unstoppable blob as you untangle the mysteries of the Amalgun. With 2-4 player co-op.

title: Bound Between Desks
description: A mystical visual novel where ordinary school life intertwines with mysterious phenomena. Every decision you make could lead to uncovering secrets... or plunge you into even greater uncertainty.

title: Novath
description: Slay. Spare. Subjugate. Novath is a single-player, story-rich turn-based RPG set in a fractured medieval world. Assemble your party from enemies and allies alike. Shape the story through choices that echo across the continent. Your path is yours to forge.

title: Eternal Affairs
description: Recover a stolen artifact and lose your heart as a secret magical agent! Can you uncover an arcane conspiracy before the clock runs out? An interactive, text-based magical romance novel.

title: Hentai Furry Bunny
description: Hentai Furry Bunny is a seductive hentai puzzle game set in a luxurious casino with a sexy bunny dealer!

title: Hentai Furry Unicorny
description: Hentai Furry Unicorny is a sensual hentai puzzle game that welcomes you into a cozy bar where a graceful unicorn girl with deep eyes and a charming smile awaits you…

title: ReDrop
description: DIE, REDROP, REPEAT. In this Platformer, every Death leaves a platform behind; Climb your mistakes! RAGE, CRY, ADAPT. Then do it all again. Try now and prove you're only *mostly* bad.

title: Heavy Spoilers RPG: The True Identity of the Final Enemy is the Hero's Father
description: People across the kingdom are vanishing. Young hero Harold Sageblood is ordered by the king to defeat the mastermind behind it all. Joined by the loyal mage Martha Bethraeor, the hero sets out—seeking answers about his missing father and the truth behind the disappearances.

title: The Final Print
description: You're a journalist investigating a suspicious case during the Harlem riots. Take pictures of evidence, gather information by interrogating people, and put it all together in an article to show people the truth.

title: Lord of the Click 5
description: Open a new chapter of epic battles! In "Lord of the Click 5" you will find a strategic deployment of troops, army upgrades and battles with powerful bosses. Evolve, use magic, and protect your kingdom from impending threats!

title: Astral Savior
description: The official sequel to Astral Stairways by Firedog Studio, now making its debut on PC! Fend off endless waves of Void monsters with simple controls and over 20 unique Followers, each offering a distinct playstyle!

title: Lucky Hand: Roguelike Deck Builder
description: Lucky Hand is a roguelike deckbuilding game where every card drawn shapes your fate. Build powerful decks, strategize against challenging enemies, and explore dangerous places. With each battle, unlock new cards to help you in your adventure!
