title: Stickman Adventures
description: Stickman Adventures is a 2D Stickman Action Shooter. Fight your way through various levels and dimensions, defeating challenging bosses and enemies along the way! This game is very hard.

title: Deckbane
description: Embark on a strategic roguelike quest to save the World in Deckbane, a tactical blend of turn-based deckbuilding and poker-powered combat. Collect cards, forge explosive bonds with pets, and play winning hands to unleash devastating attacks!

title: Coded Black
description: A narrative-driven social justice game exploring the suppressed histories of anti-Blackness in the US and UK. Confront racial injustice and discover moments of Black resilience and humanity through storytelling and historical evidence.

title: Phase Cross
description: A fan-made nonogram/picross puzzle game centering around Phase Connect: Origins talent Iori Hakushika. Solve nonogram puzzles and enjoy a relaxed ambiance!

title: Nildigo
description: Spicy-zen puzzle roguelite with dangerous money grids and hundreds of Perks and Powers.

title: Gambling Forever
description: Gamble with your friends in a game of dice! Bet on the total number of dice with a specific value on the table, while you can only see your dice. Using various items and magic dice, outluck your friends or figure out an impossible-to-lose strategy!

title: If We Make It Home
description: Snipping. Pruning. Eating. At what point are you no longer human? IF WE MAKE IT HOME. is a short narrative space thriller, about an advanced space suit ensuring survival at all costs. Inspired by 'The Suit', by Scott Base.

title: Doll Parts
description: Play as a doll trying to help her owner through puberty. Solve puzzles, navigate your environment, and discover journal pages to survive the horrors of growing up.

title: Underpacked!
description: Welcome to the galaxy´s biggest delivery company! Dive into a space odyssey as a delivery crew, alone or with your comrades. Dodge threats, survive the harsh realities of labor exploitation and deliver packages. Prove you’re the best employees in the universe!

title: CrimeBloc
description: Free-to-Play Text-Based Mafia MMO Set in the Eastern Bloc. A gritty text-based MMO where you rise through the ranks of organized crime in the Bloc. For 18 years, players have forged criminal empires, fought brutal turf wars, and survived in a world where betrayal is currency.

title: Slugtrip
description: Sometimes you just gotta take a break from that busy city life and get back to nature, you know? Just you, your best buds, and a giant slug bus foraging for mushrooms. Some of these ‘shrooms look real tricky to get though…

title: Highway Hopper
description: Jump over guardrails, dodge obstacles, and chase the high score - welcome to Highway Hopper!

title: Morituria
description: Explore an ancient underground city in this 80s-inspired dungeon crawler.

title: Blightened
description: Blightened is a 2.5D action platformer where corruption fuels your strength. Unleash powerful abilities, survive collapsing realms, and fight your way through a broken world shaped by blight.

title: I'm Not Spider
description: A 2D platform game, by dragging the character's corner to climb upward, the character's feet can be glued to some platforms, intended to test the player's ability to control the mouse

title: Zoomers Versus Boomers
description: Ever wanted to explode your friends as a wheel chair bound old man? Now you can! In Zoomers Versus Boomers, the Zoomers try to avoid getting blown up for as long as possible. Hurl phones at your friends! Run as they converge on your position in a vast tidal wave of old men! Try not to explode!

title: Dreamcards
description: Build your deck during the day and at night fight the monster that haunts your dreams. Will you be able to escape the nightmare in this roguelike deckbuilder that combines strategy, occultism and psychology?

title: Silly's Gameshow
description: Silly's Gameshow is a co-op animatronic horror game. Only one player needs to own the game.

title: Snogbert
description: One-room 2D platformer that combines arcade run-and-jump gameplay with roguelike progression. Roll the dice and challenge random missions to help Snogbert find his missing shards and get back home! Ready to roll?

title: Islantiles
description: Islantiles is a cozy, minimalistic city-builder where you raise your civilization from adorable settlers to ridiculously effective explorers. Unlock groundbreaking technologies as you venture across a chain of unknown islands and discover over-the-top synergies.

title: The Joker's Game
description: "The Joker's Game" is an FMV crime battle royale. Jack, drowning in debt, joins a lethal game. Critical choices, even small ones, shape outcomes. Outwit rivals, uncover truths, or perish? Every move decides survival... or the deadly prize.

title: Burden Street Station
description:
Burden Street Station is a surreal narrative game set in a liminal train station about helping a cast of unusual creatures and spirits move on with their lives.

Collect personality traits through talking and exploration, and wear them to unlock dialogue options and advance their stories.

You will come to know these spirits very well. You will learn a lot about them.

title: Belle Citique
description: Belle Citique is a cozy city builder and design game. Use the joyfully simple building system to make riverside hamlets, alpine castles, bustling cities, and everything in between. No major objectives or obstacles, just sit back and create something beautiful.

title: F-1 Drive
description: F-1 Drive is a 3D racing mini game. The goal is simple, to run the best laps you can. The game has a unique feature that transfers the computer control to study the behavior of bots and then come up with the best tactics for overtaking. Features: 7 car rivals, 5 racetracks, system damage, original music.

title: Legend of Saha
description: Legend of Saha is a Flash isometric platformer game developed by Cai Haoyu, later co-founder of miHoYo. The story centers on the adventure of Misei Nanatsuki as she travels the Heavens in order to gather the 13 missing pieces of her soul.

title: Yuusha no Sentakushi ga Okashii
description: Yuusha no Sentakushi ga Okashii is an independent gag text adventure game. The complete version was released by Minatonezumi, on PC in 2025.

title: Pin-Kod. Poluchi patent pervym!
description: The twenty-third computer game based on the Smeshariki franchise and the second one that is part of the Pin-Code project. "Get a patent first!" gives everyone the opportunity to be an inventor and create an ingenious device themselves. The whole game is a continuous experiment; before each experiment there is a quiz, then a historical background, and then the experiment itself. You need to arrange the objects so that the experiment is successful, and after each experiment, a patent is issued.

title: Leaf Blower Co.
description: Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

title: Gourdlets Together
description: A relaxing multiplayer building and fishing game. Design and decorate your own island, and level up your fishing while you hang out with your friends! Visit your pals’ islands online, and just enjoy Gourd vibes!

title: All will Rise
description: The river is a god, and they killed it. It’s time for ordinary people to hold them to account. Manage your team. Mix with ecoterrorists and godmen. Build your deck, follow leads and find allies. Make your case, and win the battle for the future.

title: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
description: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.

title: Anxiety Puppy
description: Anxiety Puppy is a 2D interactive narrative game that focuses on anxiety. In the game, anxiety is personified as a little puppy. Players will explore its story and try to coexist with it. Go find its traces and give it a hug.

title: Mafate
description: In MAFATE, play as a mail carrier in the remote Cirque de Mafate in the Indian Ocean. Take photos and deliver letters while exploring this picturesque spot. Help Luna, sent back in time as a camera, touch the locals' lives and uncover the area's charm.

title: Townbox
description: Townbox is a single player sandbox town building game with an emphasis on creativity and self expression! Take on the role of trainee town planner and expand your teeny-tiny starting island into a bustling town of your own design.

title: Shiba Sweet
description: Woof! You step into the paws of a novice Shiba chef who inherits a dessert shop from your retired grandma. You'll buy ingredients, bake desserts, and sell them in bento boxes. Use your earnings to upgrade the kitchen, decorate the shop, and unlock new recipes to create the best bakery ever!

title: Puni the Florist
description: Puni the Florist is a cozy flower shop simulation game that highlights creative expressions. Manage the shop, design unique bouquets, and join Puni on a silly, wholesome, and relatable journey of self-discovery.

title: Pawsta
description: Join Rigatoni the mouse on the cozy cooking adventure of a lifteime! Cook up claymation-style food from scratch. Set off on a globe-trotting adventure and serve cute animal guests!???

title: On-Together
description: A social chatroom game to work, play games and hang out with your friends. Stay connected while you work, then use breaktimes to chat, chill, chew bubblegum and more!

title: Nano Neighbors
description: An online idle game that brings life to the bottom of your screen with friendly androids called NANOs. Customise your NANOs, choose their occupation, build and design their perfect home, and invite your friends' NANOs over to hang out, join mini-activities, and interact.

title: A Heavy Morning
description: You know the feeling of struggling to get out of bed? In A Heavy Morning, you will play as a young girl battling with her own mind. Your only objective? Get out of bed and get to work on time.

title: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
description: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

title: Grid Empire
description: Grid Empire is a free Sandbox MMO where you can build whatever your creativity desires. Craft various items to decorate your world and style yourself, and play with friends or the community for the best experience!

title: Teeko
description: Platformer meets tower defense in this story-rich game inspired by the Costa Rican Día de Las Mascaradas festival. One day, grandma Tita's kids get possessed by the spirits of the gigantes and begin to wreak havoc upon the land. It's now up to her pet sloth, Teeko, to save their town.

title: Block Block Block
description: Design your dream space! In this tiny cozy building game, stack and arrange uniquely shaped wooden blocks to craft charming dioramas. Design cozy bakeries, elegant living rooms or quirkiy studios, create beautiful spaces filled with warm and personality.

title: PancitoMerge
description: Drop, merge, and stack colorful pan dulce to create bigger, tastier treats. Master the art of sweet combos while avoiding a crumbling mess! With charming visuals and simple gameplay, this cozy puzzle adventure celebrates the joy of Mexican baking. Perfect for quick sessions or beating high scores.

title: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
description: Immerse yourself in a grim survival horror game where you investigate the secrets of an ancient monastery, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that haunt its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

title: Teios' Journey
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure through a vibrant world teeming with challenges and mysteries. Traverse diverse landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and engage in epic battles as you unravel the secrets hidden within the land.

title: Colorbound
description: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

title: Lost Vulcan
description: Lost Vulcan is a platform game that combines the adrenaline of roguelites with the spirit of classic arcade titles. Play as a brave treasure hunter and enter 'Vulcan', an abandoned interstellar ship said to be filled with legendary riches... and mortal dangers.

title: Chunky Jump!
description: Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting.

title: Leap Galaxy
description: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

title: Ledgerbound
description: The world may end, but more importantly: your job is on the line. Step onto the battlefield, befriend (and fall in love with) a ragtag crew of heroes, and go head-to-head against an immortal foe to protect the bureaucratic kingdom you love in this hilarious narrative-driven tactics RPG.

title: Cats Around Us: Black Cat
description: We've hidden a bunch of cats in a silent comic about a black cat that always blends into the shadows. Can you find them all?

title: GigaBash: MechaJuras
description: This free DLC adds “MechaJURAS”, an original character from GigaBash to the game. Equipped with a unique moveset featuring its massive Rocket Drill to decimate Titans, and a Grapple Claw to grab foes from afar, MechaJURAS is ready to roll out!

title: Friday Night
description: Investigate a family’s gruesome fate, communicate using your microphone to uncover the truth, and hide from the spirit. Film the whole experience in your camcorder for the world to see.

title: American Truck Simulator: South Dakota
description: Welcome to the Mount Rushmore State! From the wide-rolling plains to the rugged beauty of the Badlands and the forested peaks of the Black Hills, South Dakota’s landscapes are as diverse as they are breathtaking.

title: BraveCart
description: A narrative turn-based puzzle adventure about an abandoned shopping cart who defies two empires and sparks a revolution!

title: My Wife is a Spy?!
description: In this otome isekai visual novel you're thrown into an arranged marriage with the cold Duke of the North. Explore political tension, shifting loyalties, and two routes: romance or rebellion. Support your husband or betray him like a true villainess and take control of your fate.

title: Upin & Ipin Universe
description: Explore the vibrant world of Upin & Ipin Universe—an open-world adventure inspired by kampung life, full of local charm, culture, and heartwarming stories from Malaysia.

title: No Straight Roads 2
description: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

title: Whispers in the Fog
description: Whispers in the fog is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious forest with haunted locations that will give you a terrifying experience. With realistic atmosphere, scary encounters and only a flashlight to light your way, unravel the mystery that is beyond the forest.

title: Escape Dash Journey
description:
Get ready for a thrilling adventure in Escape Dash Journey! In this action-packed platformer, you’ll run, jump, and dash your way through challenging levels filled with traps, obstacles, and exciting surprises.

With intuitive controls, stylish visuals, and creative level design, Escape Dash Journey delivers a fun and addictive experience for players of all ages.

title: Warp Bot
description:
Explore a mysterious world among the stars with a small robot lost in space.

With no memory of how he got there, he must use his intelligence, energy blaster, and a unique teleportation mechanic to survive deadly traps and challenging platforming.

The game focuses on precision and puzzle-solving, encouraging creative movement and logical thinking.

title: Moontouched
description: Moontouched follows the experience of a human protagonist as they prepare body, heart, and mind for a deeply erotic and spiritual ritual that will see them transforming into a 'werewolf', a great and sacred honor in the world they are a part of.

title: Bool Capture
description:
Trapped in a glitching program, your mission in Bool Capture is simple: clear the field of menacing red system balls.

Use physics-based arcade action to hit the red balls and capture the yellow ones.
The COREDROM system is recovering – can you finish before it’s too late?

title: Call of the Elder Gods
description: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

title: Art of Solitaire
description: Level up your chill time with Art of Solitaire. Forget boring card decks – we’re teaming up with real indie artists to design every card, bringing you gorgeous, original artwork. Build your ultimate card collection as you flick through Patience, Pyramid, and Spider. De-stress with a good FLICK!

title: The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs
description: The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs is a comedic first-person narrative adventure. As an inspector at the Bureau, the fate of this fable is in your hands. Do your job, fix the shambled story — or, don’t. When you're done, step into the hero’s boots and see what sort of tale your work wrought.

title: Fading Echo
description: Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption.

title: Joe & Mac: Retro Collection
description:
Grab your club/hammer, the Stone Age is back and bigger than ever!

For the first time, three legendary adventures from the Joe & Mac universe are united in a single collection. Step back in time and join your favorite cavemen in their wildest escapades through jungle mayhem, fighting dinos, and stone-age fun.

Joe & Mac Caveman Ninja: The original arcade hit that started it all. Rescue the village’s women from a gang of Neanderthals and face off against deadly dinos.

Congo’s Caper: A wacky spin-off full of high-flying action, mischievous monkeys and even more prehistoric madness.

Joe & Mac Lost in the Tropics: A tropical sequel where our heroes get new weapons, face new enemies and must defend the Tiki Village

Three full games, one epic Stone Age experience. Whether you are a nostalgic fan or a curious newcomer, this collection is your ticket to relive or discover the colorful chaos of Joe & Mac.

Welcome to the pre-hysterical jungle!

title: House Flipper 2: Scooby-Doo
description: Pinnacove needs your help! The once peaceful town has become witness to supernatural events. So let's do what you do best, Flipper, clean up the mess! Luckily, you’re not alone. With the help of Scooby, Shaggy and the rest of the Mystery Inc. gang follow the clues and discover an old mystery.

title: Guardians of the Wild Sky
description: Survive, build, craft and explore a vast magical world as you capture and bond with powerful Guardians. Captain your own airship and sail the cloud seas. Build everything from cozy homes to flying castles. Explore this world solo or with friends; the skies are yours to conquer!

title: Hope in the City
description: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

title: Dead Watch
description: You're stuck in a time loop. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing

title: Milano’s Odd Job Collection
description: Milano is on her own for summer vacation, and she’s ready to live her best life! Take on part-time jobs, personalize your home, or spend the day eating popcorn at the park. Experience this retro classic for the first time outside of Japan, now with modern improvements.

title: Reaprieve
description: Death Is Our Beginning

title: Burger Bois
description: A food truck simulator about flavor, not labor. As chief burger designer, craft perfect sandwiches and turn your customers’ most vague requests into culinary masterpieces - or disasterpieces! No recipe, no 'one-right-answer': just let your tastebuds take you to the top.

title: Match & Mastery
description: Match & Mastery is a Turn-Based Tactics game with a Match-3 twist. Master your Magic, unleash powerful spells, and face challenging foes to free the land from a deadly magical blight.

title: Parasensor
description: When Marisol starts a new life as a telecom technician, she finds herself out of her depth in a mutating city. Connect with strangers, confront grotesque creatures, and unravel a conspiracy at the heart of the metamorphosis.

title: Picture Everything: Puzzle Cross Galaxy
description: A chilled out & stimulating nonogram puzzle game with endless logic puzzles to solve. Uncover a huge variety of 3D objects, and discover new puzzles - never run out of fun!

title: Winnie the Pooh's Book Writing Speedrunner
description: Write the complete 10 chapters of the original 1926 Winni-the-Pooh's book as fast as you can and compete for the first place in the leaderboards.

title: A Game About Cutting A Tree
description: A minimalist game about reclaiming an overgrown forest or an abandoned city. Chop down trees, gather Wood, sell it, upgrade your axe, and uncover secrets hidden beneath the roots.

title: Outcity
description: Tired of big city life, you move to Outcity to start fresh in the countryside. Build your farm your way in a cozy sandbox where imagination has no limits and friendly villagers help your homestead grow into a thriving village. Gather your determination, your creativity, and get to work!

title: Sandloop
description: Help Hura save her village from invaders by exploring the intricate lands of Iman and gaining ancient skills that will enhance her mobility!

title: Beavageddon
description: Fire up your bulldozer and set out for vengeance in Beavageddon! Reduce cities to rubble while fighting off hordes of enemies trying to stop your rampage. Upgrade your bulldozer, enhance your arsenal, and unlock new animal pilots with unique skillsets in this roguelike auto-shooter.

title: Putt It in Orbit
description: Play golf now with this super fun and cute orbital golf! Explore different planets, annoy the neighbors, and see how many levels you can make par on. Launch the ball into orbit and see if you can chip the ball in with Putt It In Orbit!

title: Finding Cool Sticks
description: Explore to find cool sticks and pretend they are swords and guns and other weapons and you can name them and you can discover secrets in the forest using your sticks and also fight against skeleton monsters.

title: PhiloDeka
description: In a serene, immersive world, strategically craft your path to turn every multiple of 10 into a rewarding harvest. Unlock the powerful interplay of numbers and strategy, and savor the satisfaction of perfect alignment and numerical zen.

title: Eridani Survivors
description: Can you survive the Empire's onslaught? Avoid the attacking enemies and upgrade your ship to last long enough to escape in this space survivorslike.

title: Blood Storm: Alien Purge
description: In this intense first-person rail shooter, you play as Aiden Cross, an agent of the Federal Bureau of Anomalies (FBA). Sent to investigate alien sightings at a remote desert facility in Nevada, what began as a routine mission quickly spirals into a deadly battle against unknown creatures...

title: Interstellar Sentinel 2
description: A thrilling sci-fi cyberpunk shmup / shoot'em up with epic boss battles and a vast arsenal of futuristic weapons! Battle through the Ecumenopolis, restore the cosmic balance, and save the universe! Flow state gaming to unleash your inner hero! Feel your skills grow on your way to 1CC S+ tier rank!

title: Single Forever
description: "This is not a dating sim."You play as Red, an intern Cupid on the verge of losing both your job and your life. Your mission? Help Lia, a 29-year-old romance rookie, find her first love. Can you survive this near-impossible challenge?

title: Fortnite: Chapter 6 - Season 3: Super
description: While Mask Maker Daigo siphons energy from beneath the Island’s bedrock, the next generation of heroes rise up at Supernova Academy. Brimming with unbridled power, these brave recruits must master their abilities to deny Daigo’s drain. So, lock in! Train. Give it everything you’ve got. Reach your prime. It’s time for a superhero crash course in Fortnite BR Chapter 6 Season 3: Super!

title: Isles & Tiles
description: Isles & Tiles is a turn-based colony builder with terraforming and deck-builder elements. Balance resource production and demands while raising your island, growing a colony, and providing for the needs of your settlers.

title: Greed Grid
description: Puzzle your way out of complex challenges as you hack through the servers of a major corporation. Discover the story of real-life inspired characters, unwillingly involved in a struggle against oppression and exploitation. Maybe it really is time to eat the rich!

title: Sometimes Toast Is O.K.
description: Sometimes Toast is O.K. is a chaotic point-and-click sandbox where you explore your kitchen and make toast! Throw around bread, spill jam, burn the house down, or feed the cabinet demon. Whatever you decide to do, this hilarious breakfast adventure has endless comedy in store.

title: Necromance
description: A brave hero and a bound lich rescue a legendary warrior from a forgotten tomb and put the romance back in necromancy. Necromance is a dark fantasy comedy visual novel with light puzzle elements, 3 endings, and 15 ways to die!

title: Ordinary Heroes
description: Ordinary Heroes is a hand-drawn 2D hack-and-slash strategy game where you lead a ragtag group of villagers in the fight of their lives. Monsters have overrun the once-peaceful village of Hillscrest, and only by banding together can the villagers hope to survive.

title: Mechanoid
description: In a world where machines have claimed dominion over Earth, survival means never standing still. Mechanoid throws players into a relentless battle against robotic forces across diverse and treacherous terrain where mechanical monstrosities lurk behind every corner.

title: Suizokukan Project
description: Turn your desktop into an aquarium! Fish, collect, earn, and decorate your aquarium. Suizokukan Project makes for the perfect companion while you do menial work in your computer.

title: Squiggle Football
description: Squiggle Football is a deck-building football management roguelike, where you create a team and form powerful combinations of players, coaches, tactics and culture. Recruit, trade & innovate through nail-biting matches to reach & conquer the National League. Inspired by Australian Rules Football.

title: Seedovia
description: Seedovia is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you traverse room after room, fighting challenging monsters. Chain your weapons, collect game-changing passive upgrades, and equip items to create unique builds and become increasingly more powerful.

title: Underside: The Lift
description: A single-player survival roguelike horror game with randomly generated locations and permanent death. A mysterious labyrinth of post-Soviet apartments draws you into an atmosphere of solitude and plunges you into the darkness of the unknown.

title: Quack & Hatch
description: Breed, hatch, and level up ducks of all rarities on your incremental duck farm! Make your ducks work for food to level them up to unlock rarer breeds with unique traits. Can you hatch the rarest ducks? Start farming now!

title: Palette: Cards & Chaos
description: Bullet hell meets deckbuilder. Stack cards, blend colors, and break everything with screen-shattering chaos as you descend into an endless, shifting labyrinth.

title: Concerto on White: Cajon Story
description: Rhythm + Dating Sim. You play as a new student in Concordia Academy of Music, facing a crisis on your first day joining the Cajon Club. Music dueling, jamming with your partners, or even play with a real cajon!

title: Putt Down
description: Putt down is a first person mini-golf horror game, where you use a shotgun as a putter. Keep your shotgun in good condition and your stress levels in check while battling both randomized golf courses and horrific monsters. Will you survive or will you be putt down.

title: Unwanted Dungeon
description: A tactical survivorslike with classic RPG essence: unique builds, dual combat styles per class, rare loot, and semi-procedural level generation. Fast-paced action meets progression freedom and permadeath in a dark fantasy roguelike. Welcome to Unwanted Dungeon.

title: Falling Thingies
description: Gameplay you simply won't be able to put down! The thingies keep fallin' and the thangies keep callin'. Uncover limitless difficulty scaling and tons of variety!

title: Ace Overheat
description: Battle in exciting 2D Roguelike air combat. Choose your plane, face enemies and bosses. Manage heat levels to keep it performing well. Buy items and upgrade skills to make your plane stronger. Explore beautiful maps and tackle challenges. Fly high, stay cool, and become the air combat elite!

title: Border Base
description: Set in a gritty, fictional 1960s universe, it’s a colony sim & base-building hybrid where you rebuild a war-ravaged region, fortify your defenses, and control key trade routes that every convoy depends on.

title: Red's Ascent
description: Red's Ascent will take you on a challenging journey with an action-packed roguelike loop. Every death is an opportunity to respawn and try again, stronger than before. As you battle various enemies in different environments, you'll uncover the reasons behind your actions.

title: Good Luck
description: You're late for a meeting, and the entire city seems designed to stop you. Then you remember Murphy's Laws; "Anything that can go wrong, will go wrong". Good Luck.

title: A Package for Space
description: A real race against time, your priorities will be the key to success..

title: Alternis
description: "Alternis is a hack and slash combat game in first and third person, for single player and multiplayer, still in the early stages of development."

title: No Other Alchemists Here
description: NO OTHER ALCHEMISTS HERE is a sandbox simulation merging roguelite about a world within a desktop computer. Combine elements, manage resources, and defend your digital paradise by using the power of alchemy.

title: Gamer Stop Simulator
description: Gamer Stop Simulator is a simulation game where you manage a video game store. Buy games and consoles from customers, repair broken devices, test games, and add rare items to your collection. Negotiate prices, expand your store, and grow your business in this exciting retail experience!

title: Sanity Loops
description: Caught in a strange series of events, you find yourself stuck in a job you never expected. What started as a simple way to earn money for a gift soon spirals into something much darker. As you navigate your new reality, the boundaries between what’s real and what’s not become harder to distinguish.

title: Galactic Outlaws
description: "Galactic Outlaws" is a side-scrolling space shooter where you lead an elite squad on high-risk missions. Customize and upgrade unique ships, master devastating weapons, and battle waves of enemies in a galaxy plunged into chaos. Victory depends on your strategy and skill!

title: The Adventures of Candle Boy
description: Missing the golden era of action platformers? Candle Boy is here to ignite your nostalgia with a fiery punch! Dive into this action-packed adventure from an indie studio that delivers classic thrills with a modern twist

title: Hyper Mice Rescue
description: A missile's coming and your kids are trapped! You’ve got just seconds to save them! Run, jump, and climb to rescue your family before it’s too late!

title: Barks and Bytes
description: Barks & Bytes is a frantic multiplayer game where Robots bluff, swap, and outsmart each other to dodge the dreaded Dog Card. Plunge into different game modes where deception is the key to survival. Draw, deceive, outplay, and pray you don’t end up as dog food...

title: Esc4pe!
description: ESC4PE! is a 1-4 player action-thriller, horror and survival game. Navigate deadly traps, solve the codes, and escape through maps with unique themes. But be careful… the creature’s hungry, and you might just be dinner. CHOMP!

title: Electoral Empire: All Lies Trump Truth
description: You start as a president, but why stop there? Twist the system, bribe the courts, unleash the military — and turn democracy into your empire. You don't need to understand politics — just learn how to win.

title: Friends' Kitchen
description: Friends' Kitchen is a collaborative cooking and serving game designed for one to four players. As a team, you and your friends must prepare, cook, and serve various delicious orders before the shouting customers storm out in anger.

title: Reap and Rush
description: Reap and Rush is an absurdly addictive action roguelike. Step into the role of an underworld envoy thrust into a chaotic underworld. Fight through hordes of Yaoguai, leveling-up skills to become a soul-harvesting reaper and unravel a shocking conspiracy across endless cycles...

title: Broken Epoch
description: "Broken Epoch" is a strategic battle game combining card-building and auto chess. Collect over 300 unique cards to craft your tactics, strategize in fast-paced 6-player battles, and experience the clash of multiple playstyles in 10-minute matches. Use your wisdom to emerge as the ultimate victor!

title: It's Time, Your Majesty
description: This is a DBG Game! By choosing various cards to add to the deck, your majesty needs to make wise decisions to cope with the effects of different years and dynastic changes. This huge and beautiful country is on your shoulder. Long live your majesty!

title: BlackDog
description: A dark themed pixel-art game of exploration, where you will have to find clues and solve puzzles to move forward in the story.

title: Let It Chill
description: Manage a tiny ice cream business, organize and upgrade your inventory, discover favorite flavors of each new location, buy new ice-cream carts.

title: Blades for Hire
description: Blades for Hire is a captivating strategy game where you lead a mercenary guild. Dive into the story of a man fighting for survival, facing daily choices between morality and pragmatism. Guide your guild to prosperity—or ruin—as you navigate the harsh realities of a mercenary’s life.

title: Rainbow Cloud: A Gay RPG
description: This is an action role-playing game set in a medieval world, where you can complete quests, defeat monsters, discover new lands and romance many handsome male NPCs, including characters such as humans, demons, angels, giants, orcs, bearfolk, tigerfolk, werewolves, elves, and more.

title: Relics: The Card Game
description: Relics is a fast-paced, accessible collectible card game with a rougelite twist. In this game, you will lead a group of explorers, competing against others for ancient treasures called Relics. Play against bots or compete against real players; it is up to you.

title: Mighty Meow
description: Mighty Meow is an action RPG with base-building. Rescue adorable animals from dungeons overrun by evil AI robots. While you are fighting relentless foes, your furry friends will be crafting powerful gear for you back at your base. Explore dangerous dungeons, manage resources and expand your base.

title: Contract of Zerg Hunter
description: In this survival game, players become contractors bound by mysterious forces, tasked with hunting dangerous Swarm. Battle to upgrade attributes, unlock contract powers, and buy weapons to craft your fighting style.

title: Siren's Well
description: "The shadows of Broken Paradise hide more than secrets... They hide you, Sophia."

title: Distractor
description: Distractor is a roguelike bullet hell where you choose your own destruction. Fight an arms race against a strange entity, where every ability offered, both yours and the entity's, is influenced by your actions. Choose your favourite way to lose!

title: Bumper Blitz TD
description: Bumper Blitz TD redefines tower defense with gravity-powered physics and dynamic gameplay. Build, upgrade, and bounce enemies away in this thrilling fusion of strategy and action!

title: Refighter
description: Refighter is a lightweight Rogue-like flight shooting and strategy game where players will control spacecraft to engage in battles in space, equipping various bullets and upgrading their levels. Face off against a diverse array of enemies and Bosses.

title: Cats Catching Mice: The Black and White World
description: In the black-and-white world, it's all up to you whether to explore the map, solve puzzles or catch mice. You can freely choose your route and obtain props. Give play to your wild imagination and combine the props. As long as you can catch the mice, you will be the coolest cat in the night.

title: Red Crucible: Assault
description: Fight in the wars engulfing the world using the world’s deadliest weapons and combat vehicles, rank your way up by building your reputation from being a simple soldier to become an elite PMC operator.

title: War Flavor
description: War Flavor is a side-scrolling platform game, which is part of a rather arcade gameplay style comparable to the Contra series.

title: Planes of Fear
description: Planes of Fear is a psychological horror game that takes you through ever-intensifying layers of fear. Each level, inspired by a different phobia, features unique mechanics. In couch multiplayer mode, the game randomly selects the next player after each level. How long can you endure the terror?

title: Sheva
description: Sheva is a card-based fighting game where both players act simultaneously in strategic 1v1 battles. Predict your opponent, adapt your deck, and master the chakras as you sharpen your skills with every run.

title: Law 56
description: LAW 56 is a 4-player PVP game that takes you to the future of professional ice hockey. Expanded movement capabilities and a complete disregard for player safety allows players to traverse arenas and smash into opponents at will. Do you have enough grit to be crowned the ICHA Champion?

title: Axe & Bow Land
description: Axe & Bow Land is a retro platformer and puzzle game where brothers Axel and Bowie battle an ancient darkness in Aztec lands. With their magical weapons and unique abilities, they must overcome challenges in pixel art worlds and restore peace to their home.

title: Liminophobia
description: Walking and Swimming Simulator. No monsters. Explore liminal spaces where each level reflects different aspects of your mind. Savor the atmosphere and let your feelings guide you. Relax or feel anxious as you dive underwater. Overcome your fears in uncanny, unnerving, and eerie spaces.

title: Requiem of Reuinis
description: In "Requiem of Reuinis", you'll explore lost ruins, cleverly choose equipment and skills, collect resources to enhance yourself through alchemy and research, and strategically defeat various enemies. As you get deeper, you'll gradually uncover the truth of the"Calamity".

title: Towars
description: This is a Roguelike tower defense game. Enemies will come from all directions. Through your wisdom, freely choose the enemies to challenge, place towers, select rewards, and protect your crystal. Ultimately, you need to withstand the surging and increasingly powerful army.

title: Drone: Modern Warfare
description: "Drone: Modern Warfare" is a tactical simulation shooting game where players control various types of drones to execute reconnaissance and strike missions.The game realistically simulating the use of drones and AI technology in modern warfare, delivering an intense and thrilling combat experience.

title: Eggstraordinary Goose Chase
description: Not your everyday goose chase—this time, the goose is on the hunt! Sprint through vibrant levels, dodge obstacles, collect berries, stomp enemies, and take bold risks! Keep running, push your limits, and reclaim what’s yours!

title: Click for Humanity
description: Generate energy, and colonize the entire universe! Click for Humanity is an idle game. Start from Earth and take control of the entire solar system!

title: Wholesaler Simulator
description: Build your own wholesale business in Wholesaler Simulator! Negotiate with producers, stock products in your warehouse, and fulfill online orders. Upgrade your warehouse, hire workers, and buy new vehicles. Manage deliveries and grow your business in this realistic trading simulation!

title: Mr Donald
description: MR DONALD — the game of the decade. You’re the hero, the hope of gamers and the entire world. Defeat every enemy with your partner and make gamedev great again!

title: A Difficult Game About Wheelchair
description: Overcome the obstacle course while sitting in a wheelchair, using unique controls.

title: Deadswitch Combat
description: Deadswitch Combat is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer shooter. Experience action-packed combat with hundreds of weapons, vehicle combat, and plenty of team-based game modes.

title: Cult Trials: Incarnation
description: A third-person horror adventure game set in a future corrupted world, sci-fi cult punk. Protagonist Amelia finds herself in a mysterious world, strange things are happening around her, and where our god already left us. Is She ready to face the trials and uncover the truth?

title: Legends of Gems
description: 400+ gems, 40+ combos & relics offer endless builds! Collect elemental gems, fuse them strategically, and counter unique enemy mechanics to forge world-shattering combat styles.

title: Kingdom Savannah
description: Your cozy expedition awaits! Get ready to set up camp and wander the beautiful landscape, helping animals find their way home during your creature-collecting sandbox adventure. Craft useful items, build your base, there’s so much to do here.

title: Drillmaster 9000
description: Dig, collect resources, upgrade your drill and multitool, go deep underground and find a powerful shiny object.

title: Slap 'em Up!
description:
Slap ’em UP! is a fast-paced competitive game where players enter intense slap battles using skill, timing, and pure nerve.
No weapons. No mercy. Just one hand… and one chance.

Get in on the casual party card game where every hand is a chance to roast your friends! Slap them down with the higher cards, blast them with mocking stickers, or drop emotes they won’t forget. Dress to impress and make your way to the crown. Who’s the real king now?

title: Fullsenders
description: Fullsenders is a 1-4 player co-op movement FPS based in a beautiful procedurally generated world that is fighting an AI threat, the only way to discover the secrets and loot is to full send and find out.

title: PolySouls
description: Polysouls is an open-world action RPG with deep, skill-based combat. Every enemy is deadly, every fight a test of patience and precision. Explore massive world full of hidden paths, powerful enemies, and secret places.

title: Fallstruktur
description: It takes a while to go back to sleep, but inevitably, you return. To dream of the Fallstruktur.

title: Mahou Shoujo Escape
description: Let's escape the room before the countdown ends, or☆……?

title: Standoffish
description: Standoffish is a turn-based social strategy game for 3-12 cowboys. Strategize, negotiate, lie and backstab in order to complete your hidden objectives. Plan your next move carefully, then watch the chaos unfold!

title: For Blood and Glory
description: Step into the ever-changing arena as you go head to head with your friends locally or online in a brutally hilarious mix of physics and skill based combat.

title: Tower Arena Survive
description: Tower Arena Survive (TAS) is a dynamic mix of roguelike and tower defense, where your castle becomes an impregnable fortress. Use 80+ weapons and 88 upgrades to balance income, damage, and defense against up to 7 foes. Buy monsters to disrupt enemy waves and change the tide of battle!

title: Sitter
description: Investigating the mysterious death of his grandmother, a detective breaks into her home to discover the truth, but the dwelling begins to play tricks on him. The space breaks, fears become flesh, and there is still no way out. Every step, every new room, every cycle is a chance to go mad.

title: Blockremental
description: Blockremental is an incremental game mixing management, exploration, and strategy. Control a drilling platform, dig through a mysterious island, face powerful golems, and challenge a legendary dragon in a calm and captivating adventure.

title: Perished Truth
description: Inspired by classic "Resident Evil" and "Saw", prepare for an adrenaline-fueled survival horror following the story of Shinji Ueda, a struggling father who finds himself the subject of a twisted series of life-or-death trials. Fend off ravenous zombies, solve puzzles, and escape the trials...alive.

title: Don’tGetCaught
description: An overlooking angle battle game, operate characters to avoid constant enemy attacks, collect gold coins and experience, choose different combinations from a variety of random weapons, and defeat the final enemy

title: Backyard Baseball '01
description:
Backyard Baseball 2001 is the second Backyard Baseball game, and the fourth overall game, in the Backyard Sports franchise. Build your roster from iconic Backyard athletes and legendary MLB players. Strike out opponents, hit homers, and earn hilarious Power-ups. Play ball!

This version replaces three players (Barry Bonds, Frank Thomas and Ken Griffey Jr.) with generic characters with similar stats, as well as changes the Cleveland Indians to the Cleveland Guardians, removes "Oakland" from the Athletics' name, and removes the digital scans of the professionals' trading cards and online play.

title: Kamata
description: Join Nia in a cozy adventure to save the future of her island! Clean up the tropical paradise of Zimzemba by recycling, composting, and uncovering hidden secrets. Upgrade your gear, make friends, and solve the mystery behind the island's pollution.

title: Palia: The Elderwood
description: Welcome to the Elderwood! Step into an ancient overgrown forest teeming with magic in the Elderwood Expansion — Palia’s biggest update to date! Explore the new Adventure Zone and discover powerful artifacts and relics, complete exciting new quests, meet mischievous (but cute!) critters, find loads of new collectibles, decor, and so much more!

title: Galactic Coffee Shop
description: Grow your coffee enterprise from a single stand to an empire stretching across the stars! Go from grinding beans to hiring employees to buying buildings to consuming planets! Bring the gift of coffee to the stars!

title: The Organized Capy God
description: Help Capy God organize all his creations. Sort, stack and group items in this relaxing and chill game!

title: Toon Siege
description: Call the banners. Prepare your army. The siege has begun. Toon Siege is a minimalist action strategy game about building an army and attacking castles. Guide your battering ram and soldiers through the maze of obstacles and fortifications to reach the enemy castle and become its new King

title: Soul of the Dungeon
description: Survive against hordes of ninjas, upgrade your character with coins dropped from enemies, get unique skills with cards from chests, and face powerful bosses in this fast-paced, top-down shooter with rogue-lite mechanics.

title: Viral Reload EX
description: Viral Reload EX is a sci-fi shoot-em-up with a unique dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom before he destroys the moon?

title: Duskmarch
description: Create a hero, explore, fight, and unravel stories in Duskmarch RPG!

title: Golgalian
description: Pilot the tank Golgalian in an endless micro shoot 'em up inspired by arcades old and new. Blast mechs, dodge bullets, and compete on the global leaderboard!

title: Wanderburg
description: Drive your Castle on Wheels into battle in this minimalist medieval roguelike of roaming fortresses! Devour entire villages, build your modular arsenal of siege weapons and arcane machinery as you grow with every stronghold you crush.

title: Dreamship Sugarcube
description: This is a gamejam work developed by a team of four people within ten days. It is a third-person 3D space adventure game. Its core gameplay involves simulating jumping and flying under the gravitational force of planets.

title: Playomoji
description: Playomoji is a chaotic and fun 2D platformer you can play with up to 16 friends. Jump, slide, and take the weirdest paths to move forward, or sabotage your rivals and knock them off course!

title: Future Cowboy
description: A single-player narrative game where you play as a quirky wannabe cowboy exploring the dystopian futuristic world for his own revenge.

title: Popit Game
description: Play Popit Game — a massively multiplayer roguelike card game. Сlimb a tower of Blocks. Use game-breaking Popits to defeat other players. Chain strategic combos to boost your score and sabotage your rivals on the live leaderboard.

title: Action Game Course
description: This action-packed game is the result of the Action Game Course by UNF Games—a complete beginner-to-pro game development training using Unreal Engine 5. This project showcases exactly what you'll build step by step in the course.

title: DSS 2: War Industry
description: In this real-time grand strategy game, command armies, build cities, and manage a dynamic economy. Establish automated supply routes within your territory to streamline production. Fortify your defenses and brace for intense battles.

title: Moonlight Traveler
description: This is an action game focused on combat, where a girl returns from the abyss to explore her own secrets and redemption, trapped in a cycle of battles.

title: Dracamar
description: Join Caliu, Foc, and Espurna on a journey full of adventures in the magical island world of Dracamar. Run, jump, and fight to free the Okis. Collect all the Moki-balls to rebuild the bridges and reconnect the islands. Get ready to fight the evil King Crad and save the world with your friends!

title: Dino Quake
description: Join Mina and Kiwi to stop an alien invasion from outer space! Dino Quake is a platformer arcade game where you hit the ground to create quakes, stun enemies, then kick them to trigger epic avalanches. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op!

title: Break Shot Hero
description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

title: Love x Crotch x Gym
description: With a well-toned physique, opportunities for romantic encounters will come knocking on their own. Just imagine, if one day you could spend two months in an all-female fitness center, serving as the exclusive one-on-one personal trainer for these VIP members. How wonderful would that be?

title: Vampire's Best Friend
description: Vampire hunters are after a mischievous vampire girl, and it's up to her pet bat to save the day. Flap through peril in this open-ended precision “batformer” with a unique control scheme that re-contextualizes precision platformer trappings and flips them upside-down!

title: Acornia of the Stars
description: You must sprint, jump and homing attack your way through the different worlds that you encounter along the way, are you up for the task of saving Acorn kind?

title: Worker: 7549
description: 7549 was one of the worker class servants. That was until this mine turned from a peaceful workplace into a headquarters of rebellion. This place is now filled with the remnants of the relentless war between humanity and robots. Illuminate your path through the darkness and dust.

title: Mighty 1990
description: A hilarious retro game mixing text-based adventures with point-and-click mechanics! Solve puzzles, roll the dice, and shape your story with multiple endings in a pixel-perfect 16-color world. Relive the charm of classic games with a modern twist!

title: Drill Beat
description: Drill Beat is a puzzle-rhythm game where you control an animated bit that moves to the beat. Navigate through its puzzling landscape, and collect golden cogs to progress. Explore deeper into this mysterious mechanical world and uncover what lies at the bottom.

title: Master of Balance
description: Are sudden promotions and superpowers a blessing or a curse? After an accident, your fate has been changed. Faced with eccentric bosses, difficult colleagues and relatives, the only way to keep the balance of life is to make careful choices so as to reclaim the initiative of your destiny.

title: Beyond the Red Door
description: A first-person walking simulator horror (60 mins). As a desperate father, explore a nightmare hospital to retrieve the red skull—the only key to breaking the barrier trapping your daughter's soul. But the building remembers you... and your dead wife walks here.

title: Shirohebi and the Tower of Mercy
description: In this roguelite RPG, Nemesis climbs the Tower of Mercy and discovers its secrets. He can meet and team up with other characters, and learn their reasons for climbing the tower. However, he needs to be cautious as he continues, since an entity is taking his strength away.

title: Complex 629
description: Narrative psychological horror in vivid colour. Explore a surreal Icelandic apartment block built by the Devil. Shovel through snow with your bare hands and Converse with other residents while navigating between non-euclidean apartments and gathering money to escape the violence of Grandfather

title: Shrooms! Tower Defence
description: You can’t spell ‘Fungus’ without ‘Fun’! Shrooms TD is a quirky 3D tower defence game with procedurally generated islands, endless replayability, and a cast of mushroom defenders you command to fight off invading lumberjacks.

title: Lap of the Gods
description: When the sun shines on the Lap of the Gods, it is blood red. And when it rains, the sky sobs. Explore a strange world populated by even stranger beings in this story-driven adventure as Marion attempts to undo a mistake on a universal level, before everything she has ever known becomes Undone.

title: The Triminals
description: The Triminals is a fantasy roguelike blending squad tactics & deckbuilding. Lead 3 heroes through randomized adventures, collecting cards and making strategic choices in turn-based combat to unravel mysteries of time & space.

title: The Broken Clock
description: A Japanese fantasy role-playing game in the pure style of the SNES classics. Join Ray, Eliza, Lera and Nets in an exciting adventure where human ingenuity and obsession cause all kinds of problems that they will have to fight to save their world.

title: Roam0120
description: A point and click horror game linked to Feldup's AT Connect ARG

title: U4iA: Season 1
description: What could be better than restart your new life at an exotic Caribbean island nicknamed Euphoria?

title: Rust and Patina
description: A story about transience and acknowledging needs

title: Orbital Mechanic
description: Master spaceflight and progress through realistic orbital mechanics challenges of increasing complexity. Plot maneuvers to coordinate transfer orbits, gravity assists, and high-stakes rendezvous.

title: Mau Squared
description: Mau² is a deck builder Roguelite based on classic games such as Mau-Mau and Uno. Get as many points as possible to guarantee your victory even if you don't clear your hand, and upgrade your deck to make sure you always stay on top.

title: Plague Genesis
description: In Plague Genesis, Peter wakes up in a secret laboratory after a failed experiment. Surrounded by monsters and soldiers, he fights to survive while a deadly infection transforms him into the perfect biological weapon... or into the nightmare no one anticipated.

title: Dying with Thyself
description:
In the abnormal land known only as DFW Texas, strange and exciting things occur on an almost daily basis...

Unless you live there and are used to it.

Mark Goodrich, a junior in high school, tries to find excitement in his life yet continuously fails to do so. Instead, he has to deal with the everyday bores of being resurrected from the dead, preventing a nuclear launch at school, fighting alongside robot maids from the Soviet Union, and going up against one of the most dangerous weapons ever created: a cardboard box.

Join him and his group of friends as they go through their boring high school life while looking for excitement.

title: Mysteries of FangClaw
description: An immersive horror-adventure game. Betrayed by a trusted friend, Baxter finds himself trapped in an abandoned gold mine. Set traps, gather creature samples, and make life-or-death decisions to survive. Can you face the horrors lurking in the darkness of the night?

title: Pigkaboo
description: Survive by getting dirty! You’ve been captured by a pig-like creature. Escape this nightmare alone or with up to 4 friends in co-op mode. Leave trails, distract the monster, solve puzzles, and find your way to freedom. But beware—the pig will find you, and when it does, there’s no mercy!

title: Strife Lords
description: In this epic turn-based multiplayer board game adventure with Strife Lords! Play in 2, 4, 6, or 8 player modes, commanding footmen, spearmen, and a powerful king. Capture farm and mine tiles for gold, control major sites, and outmaneuver your rivals. Strategize to become the ultimate Strife Lord.

title: Game of Fitna Vol. 1
description: Game of Fitna Vol. 1: A thrilling death game visual novel set in 2030. Play as Zayn, a high school student thrown into sinister survival games known as "TEST." Fight for your life, uncover shocking truths, and face intense moral dilemmas in this mature, thought-provoking experience.

title: Konjie
description: A fast-paced 3D third-person combat game featuring dynamic weapon combos, wave-based challenges, and character customization. Adapt, fight, and conquer!

title: Undead Fortress
description: Undead fortress is a simple and pure first-person shooter game that tests players' shooting reflexes and upgrade combinations.Players take on the role of a survivor in a post-apocalyptic world, constantly fighting against the pursuit of bio-armies and zombie waves.

title: Sery: Into the World of Myths
description: Dive into the mythical dream world of Sery for an epic adventure. In this precision 2D platformer, Sery must restore balance between the real world and the dream world, battling malevolent figures that invade her dreams.

title: One & Done
description: Explore dungeons and fight monsters using four unique weapons in One & Done. Switch weapons strategically, face powerful enemies, and conquer labyrinth-like dungeons with dynamic strategies for victory!

title: Asterix & Obelix: Searching for the Black Gold
description: An adventure game only released in Germany but comes in German, French and English. It is essentially a digital version of the comic book “Asterix and the Black Gold” with voice acting, several minigames and an encyclopedia about Asterix and various things mentioned in the comic.

title: Sense Cook
description: Have you ever cooked like this? Try to rule the kitchen with three characters who can't see, hear or speak! Sense Cook is a chaotic and fun cooking game for co-op play with friends. With teamwork, manage the chaos and prepare delicious meals!

title: Niskala: Sacred Knowledge of Leyak
description: "Niskala: Sacred Knowledge of Leyak", inspired by Balinese culture, local wisdom, Balinese folklore, as well as diversity in Bali and of course with the help of sources to dig up information about "leak/leyak".

title: Auto Dungeon
description: Conquer the Astral Plane, Summoner! In this roguelite autobattler, build a powerful army in a vast, procedurally generated world. Collect cards, defeat foes and rival summoners, and equip, enchant, and mutate your creatures. Defeat the five champions and recover your stolen rings!

title: The Uncultured
description: The Uncultured is an art museum management game where you turn visitors into artists. Manage your museum, introduce people to art, nurture their talent, and display their creations. Can you transform the uncultured into creators and build the museum of your dreams?

title: Bally Fears: The Paradox
description: In Bally Fears: The Paradox, you play as Reyes, a young child. Your mother recently passed away, but Reyes does not know yet. As a result, your father keeps you in his office. The game starts when you receive a call from your father, warning you about something...

title: Ultimate Golf Battle
description: Multiplayer Golf Game with up to 12 players. Different modes, play turn-based or simultaneously. Choose from over 50 holes you want to play or play randomly selected holes. Choose a new item before each hole to help you get to the finish faster or to hinder the others.

title: Phantom House
description: Phantom House is a third-person survival horror game that plunges you into an abandoned house once home to dark rituals. Explore eerie halls, face unspeakable horrors, and rely on your wits and weapon to survive the unknown.

title: Starfall: Inferno of Worlds
description: Are you ready to embrace the challenge? In "Starfall: Inferno of Worlds" you will experience an adventure like never before, crafting your own legendary tale!

title: Super Golden Odyssey: 3d Platformer World
description: Super Golden Odyssey takes you on a thrilling 3D adventure through vibrant fantasy worlds! Discover hidden secrets, conquer moving platforms and explore twisting tubes. Experience breathtaking landscapes filled with surprises and endless fun!

title: Soulbound Roguelike
description: As heir to the fallen Divine Beast Sect, restore your clan by exploring procedurally generated Jianghu realms, forging pacts with mythical beasts, and combining Martial Skills × Blessings × Enchantments to craft your ultimate combat style—experience intense, satisfying roguelite action!

title: Cardrunners
description: Cardrunners is a fast-paced roguelike card deck-building game set in a gritty cyberpunk world. Build your deck, equip powerful trinkets, and engage in tactical grid-based combat to outwit your enemies.

title: Disappeared
description: Disappeared is a horror game, whose central aspect is exploration and stealth progression. You are Axel, camping with your wife, Deb, in a forest. She suddenly disappears. You need to make sense of what happened and find a way to save her, while being attacked and chased by powerful beings.

title: Lord of Metal
description:
Lord of Metal is a single player story-driven management simulator game about organizing Rock music festivals bringing a dystopian world back to life. Gather your crew, book bands, sign sponsors, claim festival grounds and bring some Rock to the masses!

In Lord of Metal, you're a disciple of the almighty Metal God, tasked with reviving the world's passion for hard rock and metal. To achieve your goal, you need to host festivals going from small roadside gigs to mega events for thousands of fans.

Get ‘under the hood’ of heavy music industry: gather your crew, book bands, land sponsors, build & manage fests and make decisions that matter. Travel the vibrant world of the game and enjoy the stories and mechanics based on real music industry experience brought to you by pros.

title: UltraGirl Alters
description: In this SRPG game, you work for the internet giant INFI-X and become the manager of the virtual combat idol group Alters. you will command five giant girls in rubber suits to fight monsters on the new tokusatsu stage,Uncover the company's secrets…accompany the girls to grow into true idol legends.

title: A Song in Elyel Nalore
description: "A Song in Elyel Nalore" is a 2D Metroidvania adventure set in a world of swords and magic. Accept a dangerous guild mission that leads you into a deadly journey. Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets, and face tough challenges in this dark fantasy action RPG.

title: Dichotomy Illusion: The Coser Disassembly Incident
description: "Dichotomy Illusion" is a Shin Honkaku mystery visual novel that combines real-world entertainment elements with physical locations, utilizing ACGN (Anime, Comics, Games, Novels) subculture knowledge to solve criminal cases and uncover the truth.

title: Tactical Ghost
description: Tactical Ghost is a thrilling, realistic tactical game where you eliminate threats with precision and flair. Master your abilities for high scores and epic combos. Can you devastate your enemies with the biggest combos possible?

title: Tricks, Treats and Mirrors: An EoG Side Story
description: "Trick-or-Treat" doesn't always get you a treat.

title: Anomalous Railroad Crossing
description: "Anomalous Railroad Crossing" is an escape game where you search for strange happenings, set at Japan's most famous railroad crossing. - You suddenly realize that you're standing on a road leading to a railroad crossing with an ocean view. Escape from a world invaded by strange happenings!

title: Greedy Darts
description: Darts roguelike game. Greedy Darts is a deckbuilder where you clear various darts games using enhanced darts and modified rules.

title: The Sintonia Chronicles
description: Join Maria on an unforgettable journey through the world of Sintonia to rescue her beloved pups. Forge unlikely alliances, face epic bosses, and outsmart every challenge in a universe brimming with magic and adventure.

title: Idle Critter Adventure
description: Pick your first Critter and head off on an adventure, even if that's away from your PC! Choose an area in the Dorma region and leave Alfa to battle trainers and capture new Critters. Unlock areas filled with new Critters and defeat Clubs on the way to becoming a Critter Champion!

title: Burial of Shortcake
description: "The Burial of Shortcake" is an unpredictable story. It is a new visual novel with characters which are created/designed by voice actor Nozomi Sasaki, whose "expressiveness" shines throughout her career as a performer.

title: Hell and Back
description: Climb up the layers of hell, bring chaos by disturbing each one. Work together with a once-fallen demon to reach your salvation.

title: Neoclassical: Chromaticist
description: Playing Classical Music and Classical gameplay in a new way. An alternative aesthetic and classical Feeling. A great chance to reach the first step of classical music. Rotate the falling blocks, and master the color and music. By the way, it could save your neck somehow!

title: Two Sides: Voyage to the Mainland
description: Two Sides: Voyage to the Mainland is a management game where you play as a divine being who guides his people using his incredible powers. Will they be cute, overly benevolent people, or a people who live from day to day with no respect for anything?

title: Judah Knight: Knights & Demons - Chapter 1
description: Judah Knight: Knights & Demons is a visceral single-player action-adventure slasher that plunges you into a dark, demon-infested world. Wield your blade and unleash brutal combos against relentless enemies in a fight for survival.

title: Clicker Kingdom
description: In Clicker Kingdom, manage and expand your kingdom by collecting resources with every click. Unlock upgrades, build structures, and recruit allies to automate tasks and enhance your realm. Aim to create the most powerful kingdom in this fun and engaging incremental adventure!

title: MultiPlanetary
description: In the sci fi world of MultiPlanetary you Jump, Shoot, and Explore your way through a solar system controlled entirely by a corporation! Thwart the robot uprising in this adventure inspired by the PS2 era Ratchet And Clank games!

title: Sleep Herd
description: Explore, collect, fight, and light your way through a dark and dreamy wonderland in this 2-4 player resource management campaign!

title: Rag Doll
description: Fighting based on physics. Rag Doll is a 2D game with cartoon graphics, where you control the character's head, and the body moves according to the laws of physics! Play Story Mode, fight in multiplayer or local battle 1 vs 1!

title: Grorb: Grow the Orb
description: Expand. Gather. Evolve. Shape a simple sphere into a boundless force by harvesting energy and unlocking powerful upgrades. Discover hidden synergies, optimize your growth, and push beyond every limit. How far will you go?

title: Smuggler City Simulator
description: Build, expand, and customize your own office. In unique worlds blending Cyberpunk and Middle Eastern themes, sell your products, smuggle them through customs, and boost your profits. Use your wit and creativity to become the best in this exciting world!

title: My Last 20
description: Your goal on this mission is to survive for 20 seconds on the space anomaly zone avoiding asteroids, cows [MOOOOW] and all kind of stuff and extract as many Space Tokens as possible and adquire unique and crazy astronauts (spoiler, there is a wiener).

title: Spark Quest
description: Get ready for a race against the clock where you'll control a team of bulbs with unique abilities! In each level, you'll help these fragile bulbs overcome obstacles, rescue their companions, and finally light up in their sockets before time runs out.

title: The Forest of Black Eden
description: Stranded on an island crawling with terrifying creatures, you must survive, build, and uncover its dark secrets. Escape or be one of them with lost dream.

title: Outlawyer
description: An upcoming visual novel set in Purgatory during World War 1. Take the role of Ned Kelly, former Australian outlaw turned lawyer, and the fallen angel Azazel, his partner and apprentice, as you help save souls from eternal damnation, while uncovering a mystery of biblical proportions!

title: Fishing Alone
description: Fishing Alone is a game where you play as an automata service robot, endlessly fishing in a tranquil, post-apocalyptic world, uncovering fragments of the lost human past.

title: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator
description: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator is a fun real-time strategy game with ragdoll physics. Protect your tower and destroy the enemy's.

title: NecroMerc
description: Play as X a mercenary whose job is being replaced by robots and is reskilling into necromancy.

title: Guns and Spookies
description: Fast-paced, wave based arena shooter roguelike with hand-drawn 2D art. Unlock new weapons, items and characters with unique abilities to move through five distinct stages full of enemies and bosses.

title: Basketball Simulator
description: Basketball Simulator delivers a true-to-life basketball shooting experience with intuitive controls. Step onto the court, sink impossible shots, and feel the crowd roar as you chase greatness. Will you become the ultimate three-point legend in your city?

title: Futuralia
description: Futuralia is a simple mining simulator with the old "flash games" look. It features a red smiling male vessel, which the player can use to collect ores, experience and get stronger with him. The game also has a "rebirth" system, which is often seen in grindy games.

title: Pixel Fortress: Tower Defense
description: Pixel Fortress is a retro-inspired tower defense game packed with fast-paced real-time strategy. Build your defenses, command powerful abilities, and unleash devastating energy blasts to hold off relentless enemy waves. Can you master the battlefield?

title: Blademancer
description: Blademancer is a brutal and bloody JRPG where every choice shapes the fate of the realm. Explore a vast world, descend into treacherous dungeons, and endure relentless battles. Will you become the savior the world needs, or the scourge that brings its downfall?

title: Heat Retreat
description: Your home town is forced to evacuate: assemble your party, choose a vehicle and grab supplies before hitting the road in search of refuge. Manage your resources and barter, scavenge, hunt or steal along the way to survive in a rapidly warming world filled with hard choices, danger and dysentery.

title: Gangster Boss Simulator
description: Conquer the city in Gangster Boss Simulator! Build your criminal empire by producing drugs, crafting weapons, and trading illegal goods. Rise from a small-time gangster to a feared gang boss in this thrilling open-world experience. Seize power, dominate territories, and rule the streets!

title: Silent Express
description: In this 4-player online co-op horror game, you embark on an adventure by summoning a mysterious train. You must find and defuse bombs in an 8-carriage train. However, beware, there's a blind conductor and dangerous creatures chasing you. Race against time, find the bombs, and survive!

title: Keebee
description: A first-person shooter where you have 45 seconds to massacre fleeing ragdolls. Pile up bodies, earn points, and dominate the global leaderboard. The more brutal you are, the higher you score. Happy massacre!!

title: Soul Cards
description: Soul Cards is a retro single-player deckbuilder roguelite. Customize your deck, recruit powerful characters, modify your cards, and defeat the devil and his minions to get your soul back!

title: Pokertown: Cheater's Paradise
description: Step into Pokertown, a seedy underworld run by gangs and mobs filled with loan sharks, laundered money, and Texas Hold'em Poker. Learn to cheat your opponents by marking cards, stacking the deck, and other underhanded techniques. Just don't get caught...

title: Dark Labyrinth
description: You have stumbled into a world shrouded in darkness, where your body has transformed into that of a strange creature. Using your ability to dispel the darkness, you must explore and learn within this mysterious realm, uncovering the truth of this world while seeking a way to return to your own.

title: High on Life 2
description: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

title: Golf Pro Simulator
description: Golf Pro Simulator lets you step onto the green, line up your shot, and feel the thrill of a perfect swing. Enjoy a relaxing day under the sun, challenge friends in local multiplayer, and master different clubs to climb the leaderboard. Time to hit the fairway!

title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
description: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

title: Fatal Grounds
description: Fatal Grounds is a tough 2D precision platformer with a minimalistic dark artstyle.

title: Bullet Coven
description: This is a side-scrolling Rouge shooting adventure game. You'll become one of the Bullet Witches and explore the abyss in search of a variety of abilities and power-ups to defeat the monsters of the abyss. The game contains hundreds of gun and bullet abilities and magic。

title: Fire Hop
description: A platform shooter game with following fireballs, various enemies, parkour & more!

title: Fishing Pro Simulator
description: From quiet waters to rare trophies.

title: Super Meat Boy 3D
description: Super Meat Boy 3D is a tough as nails platformer where you play as an animated cube of meat who's trying to save his girlfriend (who happens to be made of bandages) from an evil fetus in a jar wearing a tux – IN 3D!

title: Academy: Become a Hero
description: Time-based challenges, precise jumps, and special abilities in an immersive academy to become the next hero.

title: Drone Warfare: Global Ops
description: At the forefront of aerial combat and at the heart of modern warfare, Drone Warfare: Global Ops places you in the cockpit of a TB2 unmanned aerial vehicle. This game offers a realistic and thrilling combat experience that only a drone pilot can truly experience.

title: Astroplanet
description: You have damaged the ship and ended up on a mysterious planet where the air is unsuitable for breathing. You have to save yourself by creating an atmosphere suitable for life. Build a base, master resource management, terraform the planet, and grow food so you don't starve to death.

title: Dragon March
description: Dragon March is a modern and challenging spin on the classic game of Snake. Guide Cereal, The Metal Dragon, through levels full of obstacles while rescuing other Metal Dragons along your path. As your line increases, so does the danger. Bumping into almost anything causes a game over. Reach the exit and you win the level!

title: Beast of Reincarnation
description: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

title: Gold for Retirement
description: You are a knight, albeit not young anymore. You still prefer your vocation: saving pretty and not really princesses, fighting mighty and tiny monsters. Nevertheless, you love gold much more! So it's time for you to hit the road and earn enough gold for retirement.

title: Xenna: The Invasion
description: Face endless hordes of zombies and monsters in this intense shooter, where you can play in first-person, third-person, or top-down view. Unlock new weapons, recruit powerful allies, explore new maps, and take on increasingly challenging enemies.

title: Clowntown
