description: Strategize, discover new cards, control risk, gather followers and increase your power. You are the leader of your own cult!

title: Blocky's Short Quest
description: Play as Blocky with super high jumping height in this 2D adventure platformer. Discover new worlds where Blocky's abilities change.

title: Command Deck
description: A sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where you explore the galaxy, face hostile aliens, and upgrade your starship. It will take adaptability and strategic thinking to survive and uncover the secret your enemies want to keep hidden.

title: Feeding the Velociraptors
description: Feeding the Velociraptors is a point-and-click interactive escape game where you wander corridors, trying to escape both the blame for your past actions—and the scientifically realistic raptors who cast no blame upon you for said past actions, but will still eat you regardless.

title: Uncanny Tales: 1992
description: Autumn, 1992. Anton, a 14-year-old boy, moves with his parents to a small town and is left alone in his grandmother's apartment. Meanwhile, children are disappearing across the town — the police are powerless, and no one knows who's behind it…

title: Small Bird Poem
description: Fly from hideout to hideout, dodge gentle dangers, and watch your poem change with each choice. small bird poem is a short, interactive journey through natural and urban bird habitats. Play it with your youngest — or alone, for a quiet evening or bedtime moment.

title: One King Is Enough
description: High-speed territory control battle! Build structures, earn money, and grow your army to expand your territory. One King Is Enough is a strategy roguelike deck-building game where you compete against players worldwide in asynchronous battles. Outsmart your rivals with your own powerful builds.

title: Limb Driver
description: While tasked with disposing of bodies for the mafia, you carry a mutilated corpse without question. However, as time passes, the secrets of the body you carry slowly begin to surface.

title: Bandido Rush
description: Trapped deep in a collapsing gold mine, a fearless Mexican bandido needs your help to escape. Use his trusty six-shooter to master airborne movement, navigate treacherous worlds with unique mechanics, and conquer hardcore platforming levels. Can you save him before the mine caves in?

title: Museum Magnate
description: Museum Magnate is a 3D museum tycoon game which gives you all the freedom you would expect from a tycoon game. Show your skills as a manager and builder and watch your museum grow and prosper.

title: Bitbird
description: Bitbird is a 2D platformer where players manipulate gravity to overcome challenging levels. The game starts with monochrome pixel-art and evolves through 4-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit styles inspired by different gaming eras.

title: Aetherfall
description: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.

title: Lost World Survivor
description: In this lost world, fight against thousands of monsters, learn new skills and enhance one's own abilities from dozens of techniques, and strive to survive. Step by step unlock new abilities and ultimately challenge the Hell Dragon.

title: Awrak
description: Build combos with your characters and cards to reach MASSIVE numbers! Choose from unique characters, stack powerful synergies, and unleash a storm of projectiles in this roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Aether Delight
description:
Aether Delight is an add-on for Farmer's Delight that adds compatibility with The Aether (and addons: Deep Aether, Redux, Lost Content)
It's recommended to play with JEI and Appleskin to view recipes and food stats in-game.

title: Deadly Deals
description: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...

title: The Seven Enchantments
description: Play as Józef of Místov a conman exorcist. Discover the unique story through clues about what dark mysteries fell upon the denizens of a remote village of Pradonin, all while trying to survive the Horrors along the way.

title: Mechaconda
description: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while collecting cards that add unique ability upgrades to the body of a small snake Mechaconda.

title: Cultural Delights
description: A Farmer's Delight addon that adds food systems from around the world.

title: Light Up the Town
description: Light Up The Town is a cozy, casual holiday game for all ages. Play as Bean, a precocious young ferret, and explore the town of Bellflower, Colorado as you hang up festive string lights around to spread holiday cheer. Click to throw a light or decoration; the only limit is your imagination.

title: Miner's Delight +
description:
Miner's delight is an addon for Farmer's Delight that adds culinary content focused on Caves, including a new and mysterious meat-flavored crop that grows in caves!

Experiment with new and unique ingredients to prepare delicious or unusual meals to share with your friends!!

This Addon Mod for Farmer's Delight focuses on making gastronomic content more accessible to mining!!!

title: Gobber Delight
description:
Gobber Delight is an add-on for Farmer's Delight that adds compatibility with Gobber.
It's recommended to play with JEI and Appleskin to view recipes and food stats in-game.

Main Features
Whole new food tier for the End in style of Gobber Mod.
Expanded Gobber and Nether Gobber food tiers.
New knives for all three sets of items.
New cutting board recipes for more efficient processing of gooey meat.
Additional alternative recipes for gooey beewstew.
Lightweight and compatible with most mods via forge tags.

title: Large Meals
description:
A Farmer's Delight addon that adds new and creative recipes to the game.
This mod currently adds 5 types of food: Soup, Plated food, Feast, Sweets and Pie.
Forge support.

title: Ocean's Delight
description:
Ocean's Delight is an addon mod for Farmer's Delight based around adding culinary content to the ocean!

Using your culinary skills, you can prepare a myriad of hearty meals made with creatures of the ocean!

This Addon Mod for Farmer's Delight focuses on giving more content to the Ocean to satisfy our desire to eat those creatures from the depths!!!

title: Slime Delight
description:
Slime Delight is a lightweight add-on mod for Farmer's Delight, that adds a handful of food items made using Slimeball or Magma Cream, and - a large bowl of lava. You can drink this bowl of lava directly.

Most Slimeball food give jump boost effect, and most Magma Cream food give Fire Resistance effect.

title: Spanish Delight
description:
Spanish Delight is a mod that expands upon the cooking system from Farmer's Delight introducing spanish cuisine's traditional plates such as Spanish Tortilla, Gazpacho and more.

Find new ingredients spawned in the world and cook delicious new meals!

⚙️ Dependencies:

You will need Farmers Delight and Forge to run this mod, and optionally but highly recommended JEI !

title: Vintage Delight
description:
Vintage Delight is a culinary-focused mod that enriches your farming and cooking experience in the game. As an addon to the Farmer's Delight mod, it introduces a variety of new crops, foods, and crafting processes mainly centered around the new block, the Fermenting Jar.

Fermenting Jar: The centerpiece of Vintage Delight. Use this innovative block to pickle various foods and experiment with fermentation. Displaying the items inside, it can be used also as a decorative block

title: Naturalist Delight
description:
This mod creates compatibility between Farmer's Delight and Naturalist

Currently adds 9 food items in game. It also adds tags and recipes for the other meats and drops from naturalist so that they can be used in standard Farmer's Delight recipes.

title: Nether's Delight
description:
Nether's Delight is an addon mod for Farmer's Delight based around adding culinary content to the nether!

Using advanced hunting techniques and culinary skills, you can manage to prepare a myriad of disgusting meals and moss-covered snacks, and even survive a little longer in the Nether!

This Addon Mod for Farmer's Delight focuses on giving more content to the Nether to satisfy our desire to eat the infernal creatures!!!

title: Veggies Delight
description:
Veggies Delight is an add-on for Farmer's Delight that introduces a variety of new vegetables and dishes to the game.

Adds 4 new vegetables: Bell Peppers 🫑, Cauliflowers 🥦, Garlic 🧄, and Sweet Potatoes .
Adds Dandelion Leaf (Foraging food).
Seed Pouches : a convenient new way to store your seeds (basically like crates).
Adds Depot Houses to village: a new structure where it serves as a storage area for various goods.
The mod is also fully compatible with Botany, Create, CreateAdditions, Diet, and Serene Seasons (and a lot of other mods)

Use JEI and Appleskin for a better experience.

title: More Delight
description:
Embark on an expanded culinary journey with More Delight, a mod for Farmer's Delight designed to improve your cooking experience!

Expand your menu with new meals and ingredients.
Craft sandwiches effortlessly using bread slices.
Enjoy crispy toasts made from bread slices.
Equip yourself with wooden and stone knives for culinary precision.

title: Domino Galaxy
description: Domino Galaxy is a minimalist puzzle that uses domino pieces combined with a galaxy theme. Arrange the dominoes to connect like numbers and form a complete sequence, while basking at the dazzling stars of the universe.

title: Rouletum
description: Roulette-based rogue-like with a bit of supernatural. Place your bets, use under-the-table chips and mystical sigils to claim your prize. Using your wits, a TON of luck and some help from strange places you can rise to the top of the Rouletum Casino!

title: Void Stalkers
description: As the pilot of a Void Rig, it's your job to transport dangerous creatures to various research facilities across the system. Use your ship's security cameras, drone, and other systems to solve problems and stay alive as you travel through The Void.

title: Cotard
description: A 4-part psychological horror adventure that will plunge you into the dark delusions of Cotard Syndrome. Shape your fate through crucial choices and unlock 7 different endings. Each playthrough unveils new secrets and chilling confrontations.

title: Wisp Gunner
description: "Wisp Gunner" is an immersive first-person shooter that combines core gameplay elements of stealth, tactical shooting, and resource management.

title: Ghost In The Grid
description: A short cyberpunk story about a security technician investigating a system outage in a city sector cut off from the network. The deeper he ventures into the digital underworld, the darker the truths he uncovers...

title: Death Row Escape
description: What started as a routine repair job becomes a fight for survival. Trapped in an abandoned prison controlled by a powerful AI, mercenaries, and deadly experiments, you must solve puzzles, break time loops, and escape!

title: Qume: Echoes of Sand
description: The world has been buried in dust. For those left behind, the sand is quieter than death. Become one of the survivors in Qume and uncover the secrets hidden behind the silence.

title: Dungeons of Uhr
description: "Dungeons of Uhr" – A gripping first-person RPG where you explore treacherous dungeons filled with ancient secrets, deadly creatures, and hidden treasures. Craft gear, master survival skills, and uncover the dark mystery buried deep within the labyrinthine depths.

title: Backrooms Bodycam
description: These are still the same yellow corridors and rooms inhabited by dangerous entities, but now you can fight them back!

title: Backrooms Bodycam 2
description: Enter the Mysterious World of the Backrooms! Find weapons left behind by other wanderers, fight off dangerous entities, and make your way to the exit!

title: Trigger of Time
description: A vanished expedition. A forgotten underground city. Explore the echoes of a lost civilization in this short first-person adventure, and bend time to solve intricate puzzles woven into the ruins.

title: BrainRooms: Brainrot Backrooms
description: BRAINROOMS is a grotesque horror born from a twisted internet: rotten memes, entities laughing at you, rooms that feel all wrong. A trashy, surreal nightmare where you scream, laugh, and lose your mind. Survive… if you can even grasp what's happening.

title: MoonMiners
description: MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator of miners in space, in an alternative dystopian future. You take on the role of space miners working for an evil corporation far from home, and it will be much easier for you to die than to do your job.

title: Discreet Mission
description: Game of infiltration and action. You have to complete the assigned mission.

title: No Customers Left
description: Andy, a night shift security guard at a game console store, expected a quiet shift in the nearly empty mall. But as the hours passed, an unsettling presence made itself known. Flickering lights, and distant echoes—something was watching. Little did he know, the night was just beginning.

title: Dawn Break
description: In 2039, tsunamis of varying degrees occurred all over the world, and multiple small black holes inexplicably appeared in the sky, ruthlessly devouring the world. At first, scientists believed that this phenomenon was a common natural disaster, until one day, a test report shocked the world.

title: Console Shop Simulator
description: Run your own game store business. Design your shelves with consoles and games, set prices, manage communication with companies, handle customer support, and grow your brand. Online sales, rival companies, marketing strategies, and tech upgrades are coming soon.

title: Toey Weedz Forreal
description: "Toey Weedz Forreal" Is a challenging, sleek and compact action game. A Comediac retro inspired Side Scrolling Shooter with a 3D Twist. Become Toey Weedz once again and raise your flag forreal!

title: Doki Doki Relapse
description: What if you knew about something horrible and had the power to prevent it from happening? Doki Doki Relapse is a story filled with humor and emotion, following a semi-sentient protagonist as he attempts to prevent a horrible event from occuring. All the while, he is faced and impeded with numerous other situations involving everybody's favorite literature club! Romance, comedy, and bitter elements all serve to make Relapse's lengthy story a rollercoaster of an experience.

title: Carefully Stamped
description: Craft and sell charming postcards to your customers in a relaxing sandbox full of color and creativity. Carefully Stamped is a cozy job simulator where you are a postcard designer. Take on new orders, craft the cutest mail, write a wholesome note and collect stamps to send your postcards ️

title: Adventure of Samsara
description: A hero resurrected. A new Adventure. With stunning, 2D pixel art, Adventure of Samsara combines classic gameplay, a deeply connected world, and a heady, twisting narrative of death, rebirth and memory. Become the Solar Champion and restore balance to the multiverse.

title: Dogwalk
description: Play as a big adorable dog and explore a hand-crafted winter forest with a little kid in tow. A short, free, open source project brought to you by Blender Studio.

title: Star Razer
description: Star Razer is a shooter game inspired by the Vectrex game Asteroids, with a hint of Geometry Wars. You must face successive waves of enemies and achieve the highest score (online). The game is exclusively played with mouse and keyboard (for now).

title: Sync or Sink
description: Trapped in a sinking submarine, two players must communicate through walkie-talkies to solve puzzles, complete tasks, navigate the depths, and escape before time runs out.

title: Vector Horizon
description: Take flight in Vector Horizon where you guide a thruster-powered car through wild obstacle courses built for timing, precision, and control. Vector Horizon is all about the joy of movement and the thrill of pulling it off.

title: Puffer Bounce
description: Puffer bounces is an old style arcade game. The pufferfish doesn't stop and there's always a bounce on the ground. Help him move on safely with your reaction speed and proper controls.

title: Otters and Stones
description: Build up thriving habitats in this otter kind of clicker.

title: Don't Turn Back
description: Don't Turn Back is a first-person, single-player psychological horror game. You play Bethany, A young woman who has just inherited her grandfather's mansion. Get immersed in the deeply emotional story of Bethany's family, and experience everything there is inside this home...good and evil.

title: My Sleeping Girlfriend
description: Your girlfriend’s sleepwalking is getting worse each night. Find her and bring her back to bed safely.

title: Under the Ruin
description: Lead a squad deep into the ruins of the city. Scavenge for resources atop the remnants of the old civilization, and use the ruins to fend off the Swarm. In this unique salvage-and-defend strategy game, you will gradually uncover the source of the Calamity and rebuild human civilization.

title: Demonbyte
description: fast-paced, retro-inspired boomer shooter where you blast through hordes of cyber-demons using outrageous weapons — including a husky puppy handgun. Inspired by classics from the 90's, every level drips with pixelated carnage, over-the-top firepower, and secrets to uncover.

title: Seen Before
description: Seen Before is a psychological horror game where you are trapped in a looping environment, trying to detect inconsistencies and escape the cycle.

title: Whispering Fog
description: Whispering Fog is a first person psychological horror game set in an ever-changing forest shrouded in fog. A quiet getaway becomes a sinister nightmare as the illusion of safety and solitude slowly crumbles around you.

title: Iona's Island
description: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

title: ESA Shield
description: Join the European Space Agency's S.H.I.E.L.D. mission and discover why aliens aren't the biggest threat to us! In this science-based Earth defense simulator, you fight real cosmic hazards. Build, Monitor, Protect! Become Earth's Last Defense.

title: Dragon Riddler
description: A turn-based puzzle adventure with a simple concept: Find dragon's lair → defeat dragon → grab treasure → upgrade → next. But with words.

title: Beyond the Space Wall
description: Beyond The Space Wall is a story-driven brick-breaking action game, enriched with RPG elements and other original features. In addition to the usual brickbreaking, you’ll face plenty of choices and side quests that directly influence the direction of the main story. Can you find the path to victory?

title: The Anomaly Protocol
description: The Anomaly Protocol - Something is wrong with the building. Floors repeat, reality shifts, and you've been assigned to investigate. Use your checklist to track anomalies—but the deeper you go, the more the truth slips away.

title: Miner Crysis
description: Miner Crysis is a 2D sci-fi mining adventure where you pilot a drill-ship to explore a collapsing moon held together by a mysterious crystal machine. Mine resources, battle alien threats, find secret rooms, defeat bosses, and buy powerful upgrades to grow stronger and progress.

title: The Grafted Gear
description: 《The Grafted Gear》is an auto chess game that focuses on engine building. In each game, you will get a large number of equipment with unique entries and designs, facing enemies with unique designs. In the rest between each battle, you will build your equipment, and build a unique equipment engine.

title: Numina: Construct
description: Dodge, defend, and destroy! Engage in a frenetic shoot 'em up, facing relentless bullet streams that test your reflexes. Experience dynamic shifts between vertical and horizontal views as you fend off endless enemy waves. Use polarity shields for defense and strike back fiercely. Conquer the chaos!

title: Beebo & Luna
description: Start a healing journey with Beebo and Luna on your desktop! When you are with Beebo and Luna, the melody of time turns into the light of stars. Change outfits for Beebo and Luna, decorate the warm Dream Oracle House, meet mysterious travelers and start an incredible adventure.

title: Gaslighters
description: A mysterious fog has fallen over Rock Valley. Strangers speak half-truth over the radio. Expose the lies, or remain silent forever.

title: RoboSoul: Chariot
description: 《RoboSoul: Chariot》 Retro pixel co-op adventure! Control Blue & Red piloting a transforming chariot (driver + 4 gunner seats) with slick morphing animations. Battle the Resistron Army - just don't fling your teammate off!

title: Ender Chariot
description: Ender Chariot is a relic-building roguelite game. You will choose one of four heroes to start a new adventure. Gather resources in battles, purchase relics, summon members, and form your unique chariot team. Charge through randomly areas with three different styles until victory.

title: Night Shift at the Museum
description: Watch the cameras. Catch the anomalies. Report every irregularity. Repair the malfunctioning systems. While trying to meet your hourly reporting quota, various incidents may force you to move around the museum. When your reflection starts moving on its own, it's no longer just another night shift.

title: Apokerlypse
description: Apokerlypse is a strategic deckbuilding Roguelike where classic poker game gets a demonic twist. Step into a post-apocalyptic tavern as a skilled cardsharp. Wield demonic chips to bend the rules of play, outwit players across the globe, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate master of the deck!

title: Shadow Cocoon
description: "shadowcocoon": A Chinese horror puzzle game. As cop Chen Han, enter a surreal reality-nightmare world. Hunt clues in decaying settings, solve puzzles to uncover secrets. Choices shape the truth. Uncover the chilling truth?

title: Parking Together!
description: "Parking Together!" is a chaotic two-player "parking" game. Players must cooperate to park a car that will explode on the slightest impact. Grab a friend and challenge yourselves with this intense and hilarious gameplay now!

title: Trials of the Forest Kingdom
description: “Trials of the Forest Kingdom” is a cross - border RPG integrating creature collection, turn - based strategy and exploration. Players can enjoy solo adventures, form teams, and explore the kingdom tactically.

title: Pact Warden
description: A roaming Marchwarden, you travel along roads to defend strange travelers and pious pilgrims. They'll say you're altruistic, but in truth you seek something personal. A place to call home. The waystation Gheimgarth, tucked beneath the Threshold of the Gheim, might just be the place.

title: Under the Disco Lights: 80's Bar Simulator
description: Step into a neon-lit 1980s disco! Under the Disco Lights lets you manage the bar, serve drinks, read customers, and uncover secrets - all in first-person. Featuring stylized visuals, reactive characters, and a fully original 1980s-inspired soundtrack that keeps the night alive.

title: Palmora
description: From street scavenger to production tycoon, collect, craft, and trade your way to the top in the bustling city of Palmora. Build your empire with workshops, vehicles, licenses, and more.

title: Tale of Excalibun
description: Wield the Excalibun and found a kingdom for the rabbit kind by rescuing bunnies of different specializations from different environments and worlds.

title: Quaso Studio: The Liven Collection
description: Quaso Studio: The Liven Collection is a compilation of two horror games: The To-Do List: Complete tasks, face the killer, escape. Rouge Carmin: Explore the depths of your subconscious, confront your regrets, and find a way out.

title: Hidden Bananas
description: Find hidden bananas across tropical islands! Relaxing point-and-click gameplay with beautiful ocean views and soothing music. Can you spot them all? ️

title: Lick Roll
description: A casual game blending light racing and puzzle-solving adventure. Its warm art style takes you back to a sweet, candy-colored childhood.

title: Reposition Defense
description: A tactical Tower Defense with the ability to reposition your troops! Deploy your available warriors to hold back the forces of darkness engulfing the kingdom.

title: Purr-suit of Happiness
description: Hoomanity’s last hope, delivered by cats. One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As the Cat Courier, it’s your job to navigate a charming little town, drop off packages to humans and collect parts for the ultimate Escape Crate. And spread smiles along the way.

title: Car Dealership Simulator 2
description: Take charge of the car trade with Car Dealership Simulator 2! Buy, modify, and grow your dealership with strategic sales. Every opportunity will take you closer to the top of the automotive market!

title: Continuum Keeper
description: Monitor unstable realities through surveillance cameras, spot and report Fractures—distortions in space, time, and logic—and prevent the collapse of the multiverse in this psychological horror puzzle game.

title: Roofgrown Life
description: Roofgrown Life is a cozy idle farming game. You can collect fruits in various regions, plant and harvest them, complete customer orders, upgrade your vehicles and house, and explore to unlock new points of interest on the map.

title: Doctor Viscera
description: Trapped in an abandoned asylum with the sinister Doctor Viscera, who will stop at nothing to keep you there as his test subject for cruel experiments. Explore the old GrimmHaus Asylum in this PSX-style survival horror game.

title: City Supermarket Simulator
description: Buy in bulk, set prices, and sell to customers. Hire staff, manage inventory, and keep your customers happy. Expand your store and increase profits. Can you become the city’s top merchant and build a business empire? What are you waiting for?

title: Neko Neko Love
description: Have you ever wanted to be a cat? To eat, sleep and play without a care in the world? Well, wish granted! There's just a tiny catch - you have to get adopted before a deadly Magic Storm.. Fortunately, you're the cutest. Unfortunately... you're also the meanest.

title: The Archaic: Unauthorized
description: A story-driven 3D action platformer set in a post-immortal future, where the last organic human awakens. Explore levels with metroidvania progression, momentum-based traversal, and tactical combat. Uncover the ruins of a world that chose immortality over humanity.

title: Escape the Desert
description: So you're stuck in a middle of a desert with a single flask of water... how do you escape? Do you stare at the sun long enough for it to stare at you back? Well, that might not be the worst idea. Try it out in Escape the Desert, a strand-type roguelike strategy game!

title: Yollen
description: Before Megaloot, there was Yollen - a brutally minimalist game by solo dev axilirate. Your peaceful life is gone. Now it’s all about the grind. Climb every skill tree, master every craft, and turn the grind into pure payback.

title: Hell's 8th Avenue: Miori's Mysterious Notebook
description: In this adventure game, play as Miori, a young detective tasked with finding a missing person and purifying the ominous 'Illusory 8th Street.' Challenge your dexterity with fun Quick Time Events and push forward... or get punished for being too slow.

title: Gutfarm
description: Gutfarm is a top-down 2D pixel art game that blends farming, tower defense, and survival elements. On this alien island, you will expand and grow your farm by planting crops, unlocking genetically mutated varieties, defending against waves of monster attacks, collecting relics, and more!

title: Chasing Her Light
description: Chasing Her Light is a survival-adventure game about a grieving man who ventures into a snowy forest to find his missing dog, battling the cold and chopping through obstacles with his axe.

title: Mara
description: The modern world is awash with materialism, vanity and the overwhelming impulse to excessively consume. You are a boy monk traversing through the world filled with urban dangers trying to find himself.

title: Bloodface
description: Unable to endure the ruthless tyranny of the Lord, the people rise in rebellion, plunging the entire country into civil war. As the Lord and his family abandon the throne and flee, a bloody battle erupts across the lands.

title: Italian Brainrot: Arena
description: Italian Brainrot: Arena is a multiplayer shooter in Unreal Engine 5 based on popular meme characters. Battle across multiple game modes with unique heroes and their special abilities. Customize loadouts and engage in fast-paced combat on various maps.

title: Idlequarium
description: Idlequarium is a casual simulation game where you raise adorable little fish to earn coins, purchase decorations, and build a fully customized aquarium.The game sits anywhere on your desktop, letting you interact with your live aquarium during work or study breaks.

title: Sky Fields: Goober Gardens
description: Sky Fields Goober Gardens is a Voxel, Creature Collector, Idler. Raise, trade, breed Goobers and watch them grow! Don’t forget to pet your Goobers! Use your Goobers to turn your Island into a luscious haven, building an environment for them to flourish.

title: Subjugation
description: Nobody knows where it came from. But it's here. And you can't let it escape. In Subjugation you're put in charge of a containment chamber for one hour, housing a horror unknown to mankind. Maintain it's oxygen, hunger, and anger, to keep it calm and complacent. Escape means the end.

title: Lumara
description: Descend into a corrupted abyss as a lone anglerfish in this atmospheric puzzle-adventure. Solve physics-based puzzles, uncover forgotten knowledge, face mutated creatures, and use your light to push back shadows and restore what was lost.

title: Divine Academy
description:
Become a Greek god!
Cast miracles! Make people worship you! All these things are now possible with the release of a brand new sim game Divine Academy.

Become a student of the university for young gods. Study from the likes of Hercules, Zeus and Athena. Learn to cast fun and impressive miracles that will make you feel really powerful.

Build your prosperous metropolis
Build a safe and prosperous metropolis to get your friends to envy your success. Give your worshipers gifts of knowledge and technology. Oversee their happiness and gain their love and adoration in return.

All this fun will take place on a painstakingly beautiful southern island – your own sandbox where everything goes according to your plan. In Divine Academy you rule, you awe and inspire!

title: Let's Freeze Some Penguins
description: Walnut the Walrus sets out to save his friends, and all of Northern Bear, from the dreaded Emperor Penguin. Luckily, his chilly Walrus Wind is ice cold. Now let's freeze some penguins!

title: Loot of Baal
description: "Loot of Baal" is an idle game nestled right on your screen's sidebar. Multitask your way to glory by sending your hireling crew out to explore, fight demons, and collect loot while you focus on other things! With hundreds of uniquely skilled hirelings, over 1000 distinct items, and a wealth of randomized battle stages, there’s always something to discover. Craft items and upgrade them to Immortal levels, and trade items online with other players to create the perfect team of heroes.

title: Keytamine
description: Keytamine is a satisfying action game where you click unique keycap enemies in a fast-paced, rhythmic battle! It supports both engaging survivor-like and relaxed modes. Basically a video game ASMR !

title: Mr. Billion
description: Mr. Billion is an idle life and economic simulator where you'll rise from a homeless nobody to a wealthy tycoon! Make smart choices, climb the career ladder, and build your luxury life. Tap your way to billions and live like a true money king!

title: Astronook
description: An astronomy game where you can explore space from your cozy office. Map out constellations, photograph planets and discover the hidden wonders of space.

title: Fishing the Sky
description: "Launch the hook to the sky! Capture the unknown!"Use a specially designed anti-gravity fishing rod to fish for strange flying creatures in the mutated clouds, establish a new era of Earth's ecological atlas, and explore the oddities of civilization in the joy of picking up trash.

title: Chroma Blasters
description: Blast your way through 120+ dynamic music-driven levels in this twin-stick arcade shooter. Defend against waves of color-coded enemies that spawn to the beat and use tight reflexes and precision color-matching to score big against the chaotic audio-fueled spirals.

title: Dem Tanks
description: Blast your way to victory in this fast-paced top-down shooter party game! Pilot futuristic hover tanks, unleash incredible turrets and get ready to wreak havoc in chaotic destructible local multiplayer arenas. But most importantly - destroy DEM TANKS!

title: Anomaly Protocol
description: Anomaly Exit Together is a cooperative horror and exploration game where you explore unknown anomalies together with your friends online, with each game offering different scenarios.

title: Arcane Seekers
description: The game cleverly blends Minesweeper mechanics with RPG progression. Call a team of unique adventurers, each with powerful abilities, and collect magical energy across the field. As characters level up, you'll draw random skills, unlocking endless tactics and strategies in every playthrough.

title: Train Your Fingers: Lab
description: Unleash your speed, cast powerful spells! Master both spells and keyboard skills in a story-driven game where every word brings you closer to magical mastery.

title: Bloxiti
description: Bloxiti is a photorealistic builder where you snap and stack blocks to craft cozy cabins, massive megastructures, or peaceful dioramas.

title: Quadra Break Tetris
description: Take a break with Quadra Break, a Tetris-like game that reimagines a classic with exciting new modes. Whether you prefer competitive or cooperative gameplay, get ready for the ultimate brain massage!

title: Overpower RPG - Capítulo 1: A Saga de Bulgar
description:
Overpower is a Brazilian game developed on RPG Maker 2000, originally released in 2002 and developed by E.F.N. Most of its assets come from the Runtime Package (RTP), and its sense of humour is typical of the early 2000s Brazilian internet. Despite that, the game had high narrative and gameplay ambitions.

You start the game by choosing one out of four characters. Each character has its own narrative line, and their stories eventually cross each other. The game also has an alignment system that, although simple, can have surprising consequences. For example, depending on the circumstances of your death, instead of a game over your party can be sent to either heaven or hell, where there's an opportunity to be brought back to life, for a price. The game also features an extensive magic system, with 11 different Schools of Magic.

According to the "LEIA-ME!!!" file, Overpower: A Saga de Bulgar was supposed to be the first of at least three chapters. The other two were tentatively titled "A Saga de Dark Elf" and "A Vingança do Rei Dragão". There were also plans to let players transfer their save files between chapters. Despite its ambitions, Overpower has yet to receive a sequel.

title: Dungeon Gems
description: Choose your element and sharpen your mind in an epic thrilling RPG-style game with fast-paced PUZZLE gameplay. With hundreds of Heroes to choose from, battle through dungeons of fire and ice and hunt down the dragons, all in gorgeous 3D!

title: Heaven's Gambler
description: High-stakes gambling amidst fast-paced combat! Play it safe with meticulous builds, or risk it all for a one-hit to kill. Explore the Cyber-Gospelic Heaven City, glimpsed the legendary demon.Anyway,Good Luck！

title: Breaker of Fatalism
description: You were originally an ordinary young man, but due to an accident, you awakened the ancient artifact that was sleeping inside your body and became the "Lord of Destiny" focused on the three realms. All of this is written by your own hands with a unique destiny ending.

title: Jellyfish Egg
description: A dark fantasy RPG with procedural spherical worlds, dynamic narration, and rich roleplay possibilities. Create unique characters, grow from childhood to old age, master hundreds of skills. Become a poet or a knight, a judge or an assassin, an astronomer or a peasant, or someone entirely your own.

title: Warag
description: Old-school boomer shooter in a world where Slavic myths have merged with technocult. Cut, shoot and survive among cultists, cyber-mutants and traitors in armor. Restore the glory of the Varangian Guard - through blood, steel and ancient wrath.

title: You Found a Hole in the Ground
description:
You bought an ancient map from an old man in a tavern. He said it would show you the location of a colossal dungeon, at the bottom of which would lay what your heart most desired.
With your last money you buy some supplies and head onward towards adventure.

A small incremental game about finding your own fortune and maybe that of others too.

title: Mighty Arms
description: Mighty Arms is a unique physics-based movement brawler where you smash robots, upgrade your talents, and battle through a busted construction site after tech genius Elon Fusk loses control.

title: Desktop Fisher
description: "Work too exhausting? Go fishing instead!" This is a desktop idle fishing game made just for office warriors, letting you enjoy the joy of "paid fishing" right at your desk!

title: Surge Runner
description: Run, jump, and dash through various challenging stages. Surge Runner is easy to pick up, but hard to master. Try to beat levels quickly and overcome your personal high score. Compete for a top spot in the global leaderboards, and prove yourself as a Surge Runner Master!

title: Tribes
description: Kill, Build, Explore. On an abandoned Island with a rival tribe threatening you, your only choice is to fight back! Build your Base, Train your army, Explore the Island for its natural resources, Find its hidden secrets and beat the other Tribes!

title: Gamble Lair
description: You died, but the stakes are higher now...gamble your soul, or lose it for eternity

title: Box Stocks
description: Box Stocks is a Sokoban game about a robot in space solving puzzles with boxes with unique and peculiar interactions. Sort your way through the galaxy while uncovering the secrets of the mysterious yet inept company that left you and the boxes behind.

title: ZCurse
description: ZCurse is a roguelite survival game where endless undead waves besiege your last shelter. Build defenses, fight tactically, and collect resources to grow stronger with every run. Stand your ground—or fall to the curse.

title: My Silly Science Summer in the Past
description: A visual novel for girls: Experience a fun time travel adventure and make friends with some quirky girls at a science camp. Will you solve the mysteries and find your way back to your time? Your choices make your own story! Full with challenging puzzle games, and unique endings.

title: The Wizards Arena
description: Fight in an arena build for wizards to duel against each other. Use your mouse like a wand and do some qool magic. You are basicly a gladiator but instead of swords, you use wands and spells.

title: Donut Shop Simulator
description: Choose the right products, make your own donuts, work as a cashier, hire cashiers, handle deliveries and make your small shop a big success by keeping your customers happy!

title: Lunhowl: Co-op Horror
description: Lunhowl: Coop Horror is a chilling first-person survival horror game. Team up online, explore a haunting factory, and cook for eerie mascots to keep them calm. Manage energy, survive the night, and unlock skills to face escalating nightmares. Can you endure the darkness?

title: Stuck in the Present
description: Stuck in the Present is a 3D side-scrolling psychological horror title where two friends relive painful memories within the uncanny depths of twisting subway stations in a large, unfamiliar city.

title: Underworld Tycoon
description: Build your gang, recruit members, plan precise crimes, and seize territory through drug dealing, theft, and other illegal activities that impact the city's operations. Face off against rival gangs and outsmart the police to establish a new order in the city.

title: Legends Esport Manager
description: Take control of a top-tier eSports team. Manage your players, optimize champion picks, and aim for one goal: winning the world championship.

title: Game of Hearts
description: An erotic visual novel where dark forces struggle for power in a fierce war of succession. Use your ability to read minds to seduce women into joining your harem of loyal followers.

title: Graphic Tower Defense
description: This is a minimalist-style tower defense game that is easy-going and relaxing, with a moderate level of difficulty. Build your tower formations to fend off enemies. It also supports online multiplayer, allowing you to team up and experience an unprecedented level of tower defense fun!

title: Runway 66
description: A mind trapped in a looping simulation. A black box holding the truth. Experience psychological horror where your voice bends reality and memories lie.

title: The Soul of Cosmos
description: "The Soul of Cosmos"is an adventure game about souls that combines card strategy, bullet screen shooting, and role-playing. But please remember, the most important thing in the game is always your choice! The various choices and experiences in the game world will ultimately reflect your soul.

title: M.E.C.H.A.: Memory Erasure Control of Hover Attractor
description: The android girl spends her time in four walls, afraid to leave her apartment, but one day her patience runs out and she decides to go out the door.

title: Covenant of Anubis
description: A newly unearthed pyramid draws explorers from around the world. As a seasoned tomb raider, you join the race for its hidden treasures. But something ancient stirs in the dark. Will you claim the prize—or be buried with the curse?

title: Fragmented 6th
description: "Fragmented 6th" invites players to experience a captivating blend of psychological tension and chilling exploration. Will Oliver decipher the cryptic messages hidden within his dreams, or will he succumb to the darkness that lurks in the fragmented corners of his subconscious?

title: Lastbane
description: Lastbane is a 1-4 player co-op horror game that offers a unique fear experience beyond the clichés of classic horror titles, set in a semi-open world map. Survive with courage and wit in a world where the prophecies of Gog and Magog have come true—or wait for death like the rest of humanity.

title: Serious Survivors
description: Serious Survivors is a roguelike first-person shooter that blends retro-style combat with modern progression mechanics. Players face waves of enemies while collecting perks and unlockables across procedurally generated levels. The game features permadeath mechanics where each run provides opportunities to discover new combinations of weapons and abilities, incorporating classic shooter gameplay with persistent progression elements.

title: Monster Tower
description: Monster Tower is a high-octane retro platformer where you must ascend a deadly tower filled with beasts and traps. Jump, blast enemies and use your energy shield to survive the auto-scrolling madness. Can you reach the top... or survive the descent?

title: War Pigeons
description: War Pigeons is a chaotic 2.5D platform fighter where heavily armed pigeons battle it out with over-the-top weapons and aerial antics. Jump, fly, and blast your way through explosive arenas — Play online with up to 4 friends, perfect for party brawls and online chaos.

title: Elarienne
description: ELARIENNE is a luck-driven defense game where every summon can change your fate. Defend the mystical core of ELARIENNE by building an army to hold back relentless waves of monsters. But beware—if more than 100 enemies breach your defenses, ELARIENNE will fall.

title: Naughty
description: Get ready to experience the most unsettling Christmas Eve of your life in Naughty a puzzle horror game that mixes holiday cheer with spine-chilling terror.

title: Finalloop
description: 《FINALLOOP》 is a roguelike game that combines real-time combat with deckbuilding mechanics. Engage in fast-paced battles where every decision matters, face ever-changing enemies and challenges, and build unique decks to craft your ultimate tactical playstyle!

title: Star Gun
description: A terror is about to arrive in the 3rd system. Its name is the STAR GUN. But all is not lost. A worker robot can still save us.

title: Internet Entrepreneurship Simulator
description: In the context of the first Internet wave sweeping the world, can the player play the role of an entrepreneur who has failed many times but never gives up, and become the world's number one Internet company in this great era?

title: Whatnever
description: An interactive comic about depression, creativity, a Deer mask and eyes-guys.

title: 100 Cats Lost in World Find & Color
description: ️ Grab your pastels and find over 1,000 cats across maps set in more than 10 countries, alone or with a friend. Once you find them all, color and bring the black-and-white maps to life!

title: Survive the Swarm
description: Dodge, dash, and destroy bugs with your squad in a fast-paced fight against a relentless insect invasion. Choose from a roster of elite exterminators, each armed with powerful weapons and elemental powers. Evolve your squad mid-run and unlock lasting upgrades to stand against the ever-growing swarm.

title: SoulWander
description: Soul Wander is a moving journey to restore lost colors and light to a dark world. Can you find the light in this darkness? Each region has its own story. Grow stronger with weapons and soul powers. Your choices shape the world’s fate. Begin your quest to reclaim lost colors now!

title: Annunaki Clicker
description: Mine the Planets. Feed The Annunaki. Rewrite the fate of humanity. Anunnaki Clicker is a clicker cosmic idle game inspired by ancient Sumerian mythology.

title: To the Bridge
description: Your orders are simple: walk to the bridge at the end of the corridor. But something isn’t right. Can you make the right choices to finally make it 'To The Bridge'?

title: Starflower Inc.
description: Command your robotic farmhands from the comfort of home. Assign tasks like tilling, planting, watering, harvesting, and building. Complete orders efficiently to power up your bots and expand your farm into a thriving source of crops.

title: Wandrill
description: It is a Warriors and Action Game from the Third Person Perspective. The player controls a dog as a drill alien and his objective is to defeat his enemy, the Antenna Alien. The Antenna aliens attack by controlling animals. Can you restore peace to the Drill Aliens?

title: Love Is All Around 2
description: Intiny proudly presents the official sequel to the Love is All Around series—making a spectacular return! This time, we invite you to step into the treacherous yet enchanting world of ancient martial arts and imperial courts, experiencing an unprecedented, immersive romantic adventure.

title: Wail
description: Stranded in a cursed forest, you must find four sacred relics to break the Banshee’s hold. Use a cross to keep her at bay, a hammer to clear obstacles, and a GPS to navigate the darkness. Survive until midnight, or become her next victim.

title: Fate's Reflection Tthe Case of Detective Kotomu
description: This is a furry-themed 2D mystery puzzle game. On the eve of the Spirit Sending Festival, the police chief of Kotomu Town is mysteriously murdered. As a special investigator, KERIT and his partner HUSK assist in uncovering a five-year-old hidden truth under eerie local legends……

title: Bloomon
description: As the Agriculture Department's chosen (unlucky) one, you dreamed of graduating through farming. Instead, you're put in charge of a magical farm that attracts wild Bloomon raves. Now farming, fending off creatures, and handling quirky NPCs is your new normal.

title: Mr Right Simulator
description: A youth to his student era,, 、awakening a Temporal Love System. With wingman Tong Jincheng, he navigates campus innocence and corporate battles using future intel. Bonds with 7 girls across timelines—witness you from bike to AMG. Can spacetime's equation balance love and ambition?

title: Feng Shui: Meowjong
description: Feng Shui: Meowjong is a roguelike Mahjong puzzle game with mystical treasures and strategic tile-building. Arrange 14 tiles, trigger powerful synergies, and master Feng Shui to beat target points!

title: Scrap Wars: Td
description: Scrap Wars: TD is a Post-Apocalyptic Tower Defence game where strategy meets chaos! Build and Upgrade powerful Towers, Customize their Strengths, and Defend your Base against relentless waves of Enemy Vehicles across three unique Scenarios or Battle for as long as you can in Endless Mode!

title: Synthopolis
description: Face off and claim the Color at all costs — the life-saving resource of humanity hidden in the mysterious city of Synthopolis. Outplay your opponent in this competitive and visually groundbreaking game.

title: In the Mood for Youth
description: I am Pancake. On the last day of college, I met her – How are you my dear?

title: Hideous
description: Hideous is a dark fantasy boomer shooter mixing Heretic-style action with Diablo 1’s grim atmosphere. Blast through undead hordes with fire staves, lightning rods, and arcane fury as you face zombie warriors, evil mages, and grotesque bosses.

title: Star Aquarium
description: This is a group of cute little fish swimming leisurely at the bottom of the screen while you work. The fish swim, grow and earn stars for you. Use them to buy other cute little fish until the bottom of the screen becomes a colorful ocean world! Start a leisure desktop fish farming journey!

title: Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales
description: A cozy card-merging farm game. Drag, stack, and combine crops, animals, and recipes to grow your farm, fulfill orders, and build a thriving countryside business.

title: Bad Teams
description: You can race with your friends, fight on the tracks and have fun. All you have to do is show that you are better than everyone else. Bad luck.

title: Kleptomaniacs
description: A co-op dungeon crawler for up to 4 players on PC and VR. Choose your magical role and scour haunted ruins for powerful artifacts to please your wizard overlord or sell the extras on the Goblin Black Market.

title: Witchlight
description: Witchlight invites you into the world of Alderwick Valley. Craft candles to aid villagers, harvest ingredients and discover what secrets the Valley holds. Witchlight invites you to slow down and find meaning in the little things—because even the smallest light can change everything.

title: Find the Differences 3D
description: A game of finding differences in 3D environments. In 30+ levels with 6 different themes you can find: Hidden object, colour, size, rotation and location differences. Also Find the same objects in different environments. Control with the mouse and navigate with the free camera. Have fun!

title: Tokiros
description: In Tokiros, explore a vast world full of unique creatures to capture and train! Build your team, face enemies in challenging tactical battles. Discover secrets, complete epic quests, and prove you're the best summoner in this exciting capture and combat game!

title: Kickback Clicker
description: Mutants are flooding the planets! Destroy them all! Improve your technology, upgrade weapons and turn dangerous worlds into safe havens. Every click is a step towards the future of mankind!

title: Rules of Nature
description: An open-world post-apocalyptic survival game set during a zombie outbreak. As one of the few survivors, you must explore towns to scavenge supplies, remain vigilant against zombie attacks, recruit fellow survivors, and build your survivor base. Stay alive!

title: Olderiada
description: Olderiada is a strategy/action fantasy RPG with real-time battles and kingdom building. You are the leader. Train your troops, lead them into battle, complete quests, and expand your kingdom. Fight on open fields or besiege enemy castles. Win not by numbers, but through cunning and perfect timing.

title: Evil Origin
description: Evil Origin is a dark fantasy, gothic horror JRPG with blood pumping turn-based combat.

title: Yokai Onsen
description: Yokai Onsen is a cozy idle onsen management game that sits at the side of your screen. When the human world sleeps, weary yokai and spirits visit your bathhouse to cleanse their burdens.As the mysterious owner, you’ll welcome guests, renovate rooms, earn gold, and grow your steamy business.

title: Hidden Things Forest Elves
description: Travel to In this cozy hidden object game, you will explore 2 settlements of forest elves who are engaged in all sorts of cool activities. There are many cute and funny stories happening in the forest, you just need to look closely.

title: Phero
description: Phero is a small-scale nature simulation game where you grow flowers, gather nectar and balance an ecosystem. Introduce different insects species, observe them interact and stay on top of the food chain to prepare your plants for infestations.

title: Stella
description: A deckbuilder roguelike where you journey through space. Use star, planet, and moon cards to raise your score and harness the power of elements to reach even further. Discover synergies and combos to reach scores that are out of this world.

title: Tiny Monster Haven
description: A cozy idle creature collector that sits on your desktop as you go about your day. Grow crops, care for and level-up your companions and put them to the test in wild monster battles!

title: One Step Further
description: I know, another climbing game that nobody asked for, but this time, you'll control a drunk bald man who wants to find his purpose in life. Climb the ''Mountain of Wishes'', always taking one step at a time.

title: Pizza Shop Simulator
description: Choose your ingredients, prepare the orders, sabotage rival pizza joints. The streets are crawling with crime, and the cops are on your tail... In this neighborhood, you either make pizza… or you get thrown into the oven. Are you ready to become the world’s most dangerous pizzaiolo?

title: Between Sky and Earth
description: Germany, 1933, a hypnotist's performance fails, leading him to swap fates with an audience member. Realizing he has less than ten hours to live, he must solve riddles and harness his hypnosis and mind-reading abilities to restore things. Can he gain time in his battle against death?

title: Finnigan Fox
description: Join Finnigan Fox on a journey into a magical land. Take up your sword and crossbow to defeat enemies! Master the seasons with your magic to solve puzzles. Collect treasure to upgrade your equipment and abilities. Find all the special tree seeds to help your friends rescue the forest!

title: Wizzo PopOut
description: Wizzo Popout is a fast-paced, 3D top-down arena shooter for up to 4 players. Play as an arcane wizzo riding a bouncing magic bubble! Cast cool spells, dodge enemy blasts, and knock your rivals out of the arena in hilariously chaotic battles.

title: Infinite Origin
description: The story of Infinite Origin revolves around the escalating battle for the Core of Creation. Each faction and hero have their own vision of the new universe they wish to create: Which will you choose.

title: Fuzz & Dizzy: Part-time Heroes
description: Fuzz and Dizzy is a quirky turn-based RPG inspired by the charm of vintage cartoons. With its retro art style and lively animations, the game brings the world of these half-sibling mail carriers to life as they navigate their biggest challenge yet: saving their kingdom from the chaos caused by imps.

title: Lana: Queen of Ancient Egypt
description: Dive into a world of mystery, face diverse foes and unleash the power of ancient gods in this action-puzzle adventure. Upgrade your abilities, solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets!

title: To Get There
description: To Get There is a turn-based puzzle. Manage a group of robots, plan your moves, collect energy sources, and avoid traps. Simple and intuitive mechanics, but truly challenging levels that require attention and strategic planning.

title: Future War Tactics: SOF vs. Alien Invasion - Turn-based Strategy
description: Future War Tactics: SOF vs Alien Invasion - a turn-based strategy where you command SOF forces against an alien threat. Investigate disappearances, fight the invaders, and uncover the mystery. Every decision affects the fate of humanity.

title: Gat Rat
description: A rat with a massive arsenal. Cook up your favorite combination of guns, spells, and perks to casually annihilate your enemies throughout the realms.

title: StandOff
description: A stylized third-person action RPG where you fight waves of enemies, gather loot, upgrade gear, and unlock powerful abilities through fast, responsive combat.

title: Space Bross
description: Your chicken has been kidnapped, and that's all it takes to send a retired astronaut into full galactic mayhem. Space Bross is a hand-drawn 2.5D tower defense & action roguelite where you'll build bases, fend off alien hordes, and blast your way across planets to bring your feathery friend back.

title: Heroes & Dice
description: Roll your dice and take action. Lead two heroes (and possibly a companion) as you face diverse enemies and challenging bosses in various dungeons. Progress through levels to unlock new, unique heroes

title: Desktop Aquarium
description: A relaxing mini aquarium that stays on your desktop corner while you do other stuff — collect fish, upgrade tanks, and enjoy a cozy idle experience.

title: Cubic Cosmos
description: Cubic Cosmos is a roguelike deckbuilder which combines fast-paced card battles with unique tower-defense gameplay. Build up your deck, construct your strategy, unlock heroes, and encounter random events. Forge your unique path ahead with every step you take!

title: Saunageddon
description: Investigate the FInnish top-secret project to end all life by proving to the Finns that you are no german spy, but a real local! Featuring 12 Sauna levels, meticulously crafted on real cottages and public saunas. Physics based Löyly throwing mechanics, and locals to meet!

title: Secret Paws: Cozy Offices
description: Secret Paws - Cozy Offices is a game where you need to find all the hidden cats in the offices. Open furniture, move objects, and uncover all the hiding spots. Are you ready to become the master at finding cats?

title: ReWire
description: ReWire is a grid based puzzle game set in the near future. Splice wire blocks together to solve increasingly complicated circuits before they overload. Join the Agrifront and do your part for the folks back home.

title: Freakshow
description: Welcome to the FreakShow! A twisted FPS and tower defense game show set in the aftermath of the apocalypse where post-modern gladiatorial combat, an ever-changing arena, and your own zombies horde all meet and struggle in a chaotic team vs team showdown! Will you survive the arena?

title: Great Personality: Guardians
description: The Great Personality Games are designed to be a different kind of dating sim, where you can get to know the characters and find out a little bit more about why you're attracted to them. The game was built with the idea that attraction is deeper than good looks and a sense of humor. There are 32 diverse characters in the Great Personality game that inhabit the world -- where you can play as any gender, date any person, and explore what it's like to get to know (and fall in love) with people with a wide array of backgrounds, abilities, and personalities.

title: Dungeon Weiqi
description: Dungeon Weiqi is a card roguelike strategy game. In this game, the player assume the role of a kingdom's lord. Through your journey, you'll collect cards, construct decks, progressively empower your capabilities, and confront escalating challenges."

title: Shuruka Boxing
description: Shuruka BoxingExperience the most realistic first-person boxing game ever! Dodge, block, and throw powerful punches in intense fights against dynamic AI or real players. Train, rise through the ranks, and become the undisputed champion. Do you have what it takes to win?

title: Marty's Funducational Tour!
description: Go on a (mostly) factual tour of a rural American Town with your guide Marty the Robot in this cozy puzzle adventure. Identify anything that looks out of place while listening to Marty regale you with carefully researched anecdotes and stories about Humans.

title: Feitu Huiguniang
description:
"Feitu Tonghua" Second Chapter.

Stories that take place in a wasteland world following a nuclear war.

title: Dwarven Village: Dark Siege Td
description: Dwarven Village Dark Siege is a game that you need to defend your crystals from orcs and goblins, Place Allies on paths, Place towers to the sides and make upgrades in the village

title: Backrooms Blackmarket
description: A survival horror and management game where you scavenge forbidden artifacts from the Backrooms and sell them on the dark web—if you can escape the lurking horrors in time.

title: Idle Land of Exile
description: An idle game focused on builds

title: 16 Cyber-personalities: Survivors
description: Inspired by MBTI, this is a fast-paced, top-down arena shooter roguelite where your inner world becomes the battleground. Harness the power of four elemental sprites to fend off the sinister forces lurking in your mind. No matter what your personalities are, you can conquer your darkest thoughts!

title: Abyss Eschaton Survivors
description: Conquer layered dreams, battle the Abyssal Lord's minions, gather Dream Essence! In this roguelike action game, forge heroes in the Dream Sanctuary by collecting gear, upgrading skills, confronting the Abyssal Lord. "Even fate won't deter you, My Lord? Break the cursed cycle. I'll light your path.”

title: 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor
description: Every corner of this manor holds secrets. You inherit not just the estate, but scattered letters and an intricately designed puzzle. Eyepieces transcending spacetime plunge you into others' memories. Traverse 16 themed chambers, unravel nested mechanisms, until you unveil the buried past...

title: Outlanders: Hunt and Survive
description: Outlanders: Hunt and Survive – A sci-fi survival shoot'em up where you battle agains alien monsters as a stranded bounty hunter. Armed with deadly weapons, you must fight, adapt, and dominate in explosive solo battles. No backup. No mercy. Just survival!

title: Fèitǔ Báixuěgōngzhǔ
description:
"Feitu Tonghua" Third Chapter.

Stories that take place in a wasteland world following a nuclear war.

title: Greedy Squad
description: Greed Squad is a game that combines roguelike elements, strategic extraction timing, and party management. Balance your gold expenditures to maximize loot extraction at minimal cost. Strengthen and optimize your team to overcome impossible odds!

title: Caller of the Crows
description: A horror survival game where you roam cornfields with a flamethrower, burning scarecrows to claim the land for your crows. Set everything on fire, stay one step ahead, and clear the way so your crows can enjoy the sweet corn. The scarecrows: guardians of the field, won’t go down easy.

title: Cloudtop Chaos
description: Help Cloudi and friends conjure colorfully chaotic magic in this cozy collection of infinitely-replayable puzzle games!

title: Another Game About Clicking
description: Expand your farm, get more animals, more coins and start all over again.The first clicker with fishing mini-game!

title: Forsaken Valley
description: A narrative RPG where your emotions are not stats. They are your story. Explore, create things, communicate with tribes and solve all the mysteries of this strange place. Thousands of enemies stand in your way, whether you can crush them is up to you.

title: Cryptid Engine
description: A realistic paranormal simulator

title: Gambler’s Loop
description: 2D pixel strategy: roll dice as a demon-bound Gambler. Navigate gold/health/demon events with 22 Tarot cards to rewrite rules. HP decides soul freedom or defeat. Luck meets strategy—every roll bets on fate or choice.

title: Embers of the Night
description: In the game, day and night alternate. Zombies will not be active during the day, so you can build your home with confidence. But at night you have to resist hordes of zombies and guard your camp!

title: The Drawstring Dungeon
description: Forge insane decks, stack powerful charms, battle pun-fueled monsters, and build your own final boss in this chaotic roguelike deckbuilder packed with evolving cards, extractions, and endless combos.

title: Remembering Emily
description: Relive Thomas’s memories in this mystery-filled visual novel. What really happened to Emily? Make choices, explore different versions of events, and uncover two complementary endings that reveal the full truth.

title: Spinning My Wheel
description: Build a physics‑powered hamster‑wheel, master rocket‑boosted moves, to lead a brain chipped enhanced hamster through puzzles, mining, and laboratory‑runner mayhem.

title: No Retreat! the Russian Front
description: This game is a Strategic game on the Eastern Front of World War II.It is a digital port from the famous and eponym boardgame, No Retreat!, designed by Carl Paradis.

title: DarkBlood: Reverse
description: A turn-based RPG with simple rules for building card decks, a dark fantasy with beautiful dot-drawings. Nearly 20 characters can be selected by solving various quests. Customize your fighting style and armor to suit your personality and challenge unexplored dungeons where vicious monsters lurk.

title: What a Shitty Job
description: "Last P Class" is a 2D top-down survival action game with simple, easy and refreshing gameplay, containing a small amount of Roguelite elements.

title: Grappling Bagel
description: Grappling Bagel is a precision platformer where you must clear challenging levels by using the hole of a bagel as a grappling hook. Feel the pleasure of smooth swinging through tight momentum and responsive controls.

title: The Shadow of the Warring States Period
description: This is a RPG game, you can operate a team of 5 people to explore together. Combat is real-time, but allows players to pause the game mid-game to give orders to their team members.

title: Road to Wealth
description: Embark on a text-based RPG in a brutal fantasy world. Make choices, manage gear, and battle enemies through a non-linear story. Explore diverse landscapes with immersive art and sounds. Enjoy mini-games like dice and lockpicking. Survive or save often in this challenging game.

title: Spell Magic
description: Craft, cast, and master magical spells using mathematical concepts. Explore, battle, and solve puzzles in a thrilling adventure that combines arithmetic, geometry, and algebra with fast-paced action and strategy.

title: Food Truck Monopoly
description: Food Truck Monopoly is a simulation game where you step into the shoes of a food truck worker on a mission to manage a business. Navigate bustling city streets, take orders from demanding customers, cook up delicious meals under pressure, and keep your food truck rolling.

title: Cold Boot
description: COLD BOOT is a 2D roguelite game blending platforming with fast-paced slashing. In procedurally generated levels, players rely on quick reflexes and smart strategies to evade attacks and traps while defeating enemies. It only takes one hit for the player to kill or be killed.

title: Urban Project
description: Urban Project is an exciting urban planning simulator. Here you will not meet complex mechanic. Just expand your city in attempts to achieve maximum profit.

title: Rotorsim: Helicopter Simulator
description: Retro-style helicopter simulation built with love and focused on easy to pick up mechanics. Fly around and test your skills with 3 different aircraft in a dynamic, mission-filled world.

title: Bottomless Pitfall
description: Bottomless Pitfall is a casual arcade game. Where you avoid pillars as you fall thru a bottomless pit. get coins avoid obstacles, break high scores and unlock secret levels. How far can you survive?

title: Date or Destiny: Kiss or Miss
description: In Date or Destiny: Kiss or Miss, guide Kaan through his love-filled adventure. Meet different girls, make your choices, and shape the course of the story. The right decisions may lead you to a happy ending, but every wrong step brings you closer to a bitter fate.

title: Slime Guy
description: Slime Guy is a 2D rogue-lite dungeon-crawler where you enter as Puddles. A seemingly weak slime whose family has been kidnapped and taken into the I-Valley. Do you have what it takes to save your family?

title: Nora & Magic That Does Not Turn Back Time
description: “Don’t use formal speech. Please.” That was the first thing she asked of me when I woke up. I couldn’t remember anything—not who she was, with her amber eyes, nor how I ended up here. Nothing. And yet, she told me to call her Nora.

title: Desk Paws
description: Collect over 100 stylish little pets on your desktop! They can freely move along the bottom of your screen, or live in the little houses you've carefully decorated for them. Hmm... or perhaps send them on adventures to earn treats?

title: Invisible Wall
description: An interactive horror story based on a reality everyone eventually faces. Make choices to confront someone trying to enter your home - and uncover who they are.

title: Fairy Tale TD 2
description: This is a 3D cartoon style tower defense game

title: Chubby Cats
description: Welcome to Chubby Cats, a relaxing yet strategic island game! Place islands, grow ingredients, and feed hungry cats in time. Use rotation and combos to maximize your score. Every choice matters—can you become a legendary feline master chef?

title: Banpo's Bridge Wondrous Worlds
description: A relaxing and expansive catalog of hashi puzzles where players connect beautiful islands together with bridges.

title: Recyclic
description: A deceptively demanding experience of a humble recycling plant worker. Shred, crush, and sort your way through a menial job while trying to keep track of the ever convoluted company policy. Clock in, recycle, get paid, repeat.

title: The Flower Inspector
description: It's time to return that favor. You must inspect flowers and decide where you'll ship them to. There's a long night ahead and some of your choices may haunt you.If you feel you're being watched, turn off the lights and hide.

title: Mango's Fisharium
description: Mango’s Fisharium is a short incremental game about catching unique fishes and displaying them in the Fish Aquarium. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

title: Trials of Proelium Remastered
description: Experience a colorful world full of vibrant characters through the eyes of Letha, a young warrior on the hunt for district masters in her pursuit to become Proeliums new emperor in this remastered anime style turn-based RPG.

title: Goblomite
description: Submerge yourself in the goblin lifestyle and propel yourself through the world of Goblomite! Set new records with the speedrun mode and explore the world in this challenging physics-based platformer!

title: Jewel Match Solitaire Fantasy: Collector's Edition
description: Experience a fresh take on solitaire — in an epic adventure, where magic and strategy intertwine. Complete fantasy village quests by solving creative puzzles with super-polished card play. Restore castles and meet a cast of charming characters across 1,000+ levels of beautifully crafted adventure.

title: Space Orcs Brawl
description: It's time to BRAWL! Pick a wacky spaceship, each with its own crazy powers, and smash your friends in fast-paced local battles! Control the arena, dodge your opponents, and blast your rivals to the scrapyard—only one pilot gets the bag!

title: Escape From Kiss
description: You awaken to find yourself in a bizarre village. ﻿An obsessive suitor is pursuing you, desperate to claim a kiss! ﻿You must determine if every hut in the village is completely identical to the first one in order to obtain the key to escape. ﻿Only one chance awaits!

title: Assassins Arena
description: Assassins Arena is a stealth-based multiplayer party game where you blend in with NPCs, subdue your targets, and deceive your opponents! Outsmart others in fast-paced, action-packed matches, either single player or online with 2-8 players.

title: Yoram: Question Arc
description: A mansion drenched in heavy rain. Heirs gathered, each eyeing the family fortune. And you—who committed a murder in their midst. As a chain of killings begins, YORAM follows Irene Lindbergh, a murderer hiding her crime, as she searches for the truth buried deep within the estate.

title: The Good, the Bad & the Monkey
description: Create your own deck with 5 different fun cards in the game and shape your lies. Be careful! There is also a murderer in the game. Will you be able to deceive both the murderer and your friends with your lies at this 5-person table and achieve victory? Anyone who is confident can try!

title: Computer Manufacturer
description: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

title: PigUp
description: The pig rebelled against the Heavenly Court and gathered its companions to climb up to the clouds.

title: Record Rewind Repeat
description: Record Rewind Repeat is a time-bending puzzle-platformer where every move counts. Solve 50 challenging levels using a unique time-recording mechanic to create duplicates of yourself. Plan, strategize, and master timing to overcome intricate puzzles and platforming obstacles!

title: Gun Dealer
description: Gun Dealer – buy and sell weapons, handle risky deals, avoid the law, and grow your own powerful arms empire.

title: Karim and the 60 Thieves
description: Your Granny's retirement fund has been stolen! Do you have what it takes to get it back? Fight through waves of enemies and three unique stages to bring the notorious Hackerguy to justice and get Granny's money back!

title: Village Defenders
description: Village Defenders – A thrilling pixel art 2D roguelike game where you strategize to protect your village from relentless waves of undead. Gain experience, unlock powerful abilities, and defend your home from monstrous invaders! Can you hold the line and save the village?

title: Monkey King Simulator Special Edition
description: This is an Action game that features the Sparring & Suppression combat. The Suppression-OVERTAKE system will give you an unique interaction experience. Beat powerful enemies and loot your reward after the tense combat.

title: Stranded in Starlight
description: Stranded in Starlight is a top-down roguelite where you pilot a spaceship armed with a variety of unique weapons and utilities. Battle relentless enemy hordes and powerful bosses as you upgrade your ship, adapting to each challenge in an ever-changing fight for survival.

title: Axima
description: Welcome to the world of Axima, a Monster Taming RPG! Befriend and battle alongside over a hundred different Axi, while you explore the fully open world by yourself - or with your friends in multiplayer!

title: What Happens After Midnight?
description: An action-survival horror FPS where you are sent to investigate the small town of Nightvale and quickly find out an interdimensional force is invading our world. Hop between worlds, meet strange characters and survive cosmic horrors once you find out… What Happens After Midnight?

title: Shadows of Memory Ll
description: Go home, Alice. The past awaits you.

title: A Tale of Misery
description: Run, hide, and solve puzzles in this psychological, first-person mystery thriller where the player must use limited abilities to search and locate lost memories while navigating dangerous environments in which dark entities are hunting them down.

title: The Great Hatch
description: Lead an army of goblins in a quest to break a giant floating Egg. Build your village and manage hordes of goblins in a chaotic journey to uncover the mysteries of the giant Egg.

title: 3 Hell
description: 3 Hell is a close-combat arena game where aggression is the only survival strategy.The arena doesn’t wait. Enemies don’t hesitate.Power comes at a price — and time is never on your side.

title: LabyrAInth
description:
LABYRAINTH is a sci-fi fps game set in an alien world made of labyrinths. Avoid traps, shoot aliens, collect resources, upgrade weapons, activate powers, and most importantly escape the labyrinth, racing against time.

Race against time and other players in a roguelite, arcade-fps, maze-running game, a game unique in its genre. LABYRAINTH features many game modes to be played: follow the Story of the AI of LABYRAINTH an alien AI that captured in its world, of play online in a Infinite mode with infinite procedural labyrinths, or compete against other players in Ranked modes, or create you own custom labyrinths ready to play as you like and share them to the community or even play in a Survival mode with constant wave of aliens and compete against other players.

LABYRAINTH is mostly a single player game with a asynchronous multiplayer online game modes where other players will run on the same or similar labyrinths and score a time on live leaderboards.

title: Serk: Chaos City Delivery
description: Are you from a city with no traffic? Do you feel that pain? Yes? I built this game for you — it simulates how a chaotic city with no traffic rules makes people suffer. No? Then it’s your time to find out what the other side of the world feels like!

title: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard
description: A romantic fairy tale set in a fantasy medieval Rus'. Play as Ivan, a young bard with a gusli in hand, on a quest to win the love of the elusive Novgorod princess. Learn tunes, make choices!

title: Lecture Me Later
description: Just having a pleasant chat with one of the most popular guys in the University. Nothing weird about that, right? So why is he kinda... different than you've imagined?

title: Monkaru Fanta: Yuusha to Suishou no Shoujo
description: Monkaru is an orthodox, retro-inspired turn-based fantasy RPG where you travel to defeat The Demon Lord with the help of a girl who was sealed in a crystal. The game is by Experience with character designs by Yuji Himukai and monster designs by Akifumi Yamamoto.

title: Zeppelin Rush
