description: Uh oh. Winnie-the-Pooh ate all of the honey that Christopher Robin set aside for the annual Honey Festival! It's up to Winnie to set things right and prove that his heart is bigger than his stomach by adventuring into the Hundred Acre Wood to collect enough honey to save the festival!

title: The Symbiant II
description: The Symbiant II is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

title: Crafty Crasher
description: Craft and trigger contraptions to perfection or glorious chaos! Smash cars, rescue heroes, and create hilarious scenes with your own interactive systems! From giant hammers to epic chain reactions, anything is possible!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Necropolis, Part 4
description:
As the gates of death open, the Black Abbot beckons Stormreach’s finest to witness the birth of a god. The hour of ascension is upon us! Can Eberron’s newest deity be defeated?

This adventure collection includes several dungeons, a large wilderness area and a raid. It is some of the most challenging content in the game and requires great teamwork.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Dreaming Dark
description: For thousands of years the Dreaming Dark have watched and waited in our dreams. Now at long last they strike. Horrific creatures from the Plane of Nightmares threaten to overrun Xen’drik and it’s up to you to defeat them. Explore five new dungeons that will send you back in time, explain ancient mysteries of the Giants, and take you to the Plane of Nightmares itself.

title: Pinball Arcade: Star Trek - The Next Generation
Pinball Arcade: No Fear - Dangerous Sports
Pinball Arcade: The Getaway - High Speed II
Greed's Grub
description: Greed's Grub is a first-person horror game where you must craft burgers for nightmarish and goofy customers in a hellish diner, facing terrifying challenges for five days in order to survive. Made by a solo dev in 3-4 months, and is still actively being updated.

title: Bombun
description: High above the clouds, Bombun, a bomb-throwing rabbit, defends her floating fortress from her former friend turned foe, Robombun.

title: Average Human Ball Game
description: A Fighting game and a sports game merged together to create a high energy point based fighting game

title: Boxstacker
description: Welcome to Boxstacker, a game where you pilot your brave ship around obstacles, stack boxes below yourself and close portals with them! Maneuver around meteors, defeat patrolling enemies, stack boxes and close portals below. Try to beat your high score!

title: Moor Rail
description: 《Moor Rail》 is a strategic lateral scroll shooting action game set in diesel funk. As you strengthen your train, you can increase your load, speed up, and install vehicles that assist or attack your battles.

title: Dungeons & Desserts
description: Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also manage a pastry shop. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell in your cosy bakery, all while balancing the pressures of a greedy landlord constantly increasing your rent.

title: Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest
description: Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings.

title: Above the Snow
description: Join the shelter crew, and let’s create the best Alpine resort around! Enjoy rich character stories, customize your shelter, attract and rescue alpinists, dive into hotel management, and map out trails! Grab your map, zip up your jacket, fill your thermos, and brace for the worst winter of the ’60s!

title: Indies' Lies: Desires Flowing
description: This content requires the base game Indies' Lies on Steam in order to play. A new class, new mechanics, new challenges, and more replayability!

title: Yoyo Punk
description: Swing, Fight & Crush your opponents in intense PvP combat arenas in this unique, fast-paced rope-physics fighter.

title: Kaido Genkai
description: Kaido Genkai is an open-world racing exploration game that blends the excitement of high-speed races with the charm of anime-style graphics and RPG elements, set in a nostalgic 90's fictional Japanese countryside. Come explore the open world and see who you meet along the way!

title: Emirati Tales
description: Dive into Emirati Tales, a family-friendly 3D platformer where players explore the rich folklore of the UAE while learning essential life lessons. Journey through diverse levels, face unique challenges and mythical creatures, and enjoy adaptive difficulty that suits all play styles and ages.

title: Fangtopia
description: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

title: Attrax
description: Opposites attract and likes repel. Enter the mysterious world of Attrax in this captivating single-player experience. Solve logic puzzles based on attraction and repulsion, and uncover the origins of the institute. Enjoy hours of gameplay that will redefine your understanding of physics and logic.

title: Haut
description: Haut is an adventure puzzle climbing game where you journey to find your brother. Traverse ancient landmarks, uncover treasures, and experience breathtaking landscapes.

title: Choppy Cuts
description: Welcome to Choppy Cuts! In this light-hearted multiplayer co-op game, you'll become hair salon employees, working together to meet the diverse needs of various customers. Through teamwork, you'll complete a series of hairdressing tasks, earn bonuses, and challenge your skills.

title: Paratopic: Overdub
description: Paratopic: Overdub revives the award-winning 2018 liminal horror classic: a twisting 3-in-1 remaster, remix, and sequel to the original.

title: Resurrection of Santiago
description: Hunt for the notorious and unrelenting outlaw Santiago known for his reign over the dystopian city of Dorai. Endure the dangerous desert pushing your way through GDI officers and marauders as you fight for Caloria’s survival.

title: Gladiato Potato
description: Play as a brave potato in this challenging roguelike, facing off against enemies. Ready to be the hero of your own adventure?

title: Dyebreaker
description: Score goals to paint the arena in the "air hockey platformer" inspired by screen print poster art! Slam and sling dye-soaked pucks in fast-paced arcade competition, drive your color to victory and print a poster unique to your team. First art wins!

title: Seedborne Soldiers
description: An auto battler roguelike made by obsessive fans of both genres. Draft fighters with matching Traits to power up your team. A massive content pool enables a large variety of builds. Weigh risk vs. reward every round as you carve a path toward each boss.

title: Toy Voyage
description: Begin an adventure in the world of humans! This is the story of you, a toy bear, escaping from your room and begin an adventure to find your new owner. Climb on chairs, cross over beds, run through the human world, and overcome various obstacles to reach your destination.

title: Radium Lux
description: Radium Lux is a physics-based skill game with puzzle elements. The sphere that the player must navigate to the target is attracted by two tractor beams and gravity. Using these three forces from different directions enables the player to maneuver the sphere very organically through the level.

title: Black Paradox Reloaded
description: Experience chaos in this remastered, hyper-stylized roguelite. As bounty hunter Black Paradox, travel through space to defeat the Hellraisers – now with enhanced pixel art, rebalanced gameplay, new synthwave tracks, and an intense boss rush mode.

title: The Shame of a Daydreamer
description: Shame & choices = possible apocalypse. You need to figure out what’s causing the apocalypse to happen, so that you can prevent it. 2 playable characters with different relations to shame → 2 unique perspectives of the same story. Complicated families, branching choices and unforgiving consequences.

title: Ant Guardians
description: It’s a defense game where you create your own strategy, grow your units, and defend against enemies.

title: PowerCharge
description: Take to the stars in PowerCharge, a revolutionary new card game. Assemble your crew of over 100 possible cards. Position your workers strategically on the board to combo with beacons you place. Increase your power and deal massive damage to your enemy all at once. Will your crew rule the galaxy?

title: Glyphscape
description: A retro turn-based RPG with souls-like and metroidvania elements. Craft spells by combining magical glyphs, dispatch enemies through turn-based combat, discover the secrets and rich history in a deeply interconnected open world!

title: EggGarden
description: Control adorable animals and start running a bustling café! As you manage the ever-increasing number of customers, your café will expand and new menus will keep appearing! Get ready to enjoy a new kind of 3D action game featuring cooking mini-games and serving challenges!

title: LightRay
description: LightRay is a top down logic puzzle game in a peaceful setting, that features a plenty of Puzzles that utilize Lasers, the behavior of light and it's colors to create problems to be solved by you.

title: Satisfrustration
description: Satisfrustration is a trippy first-person puzzle game with directional gravity. Complete satisfying and disorientating puzzles made by The Taskmaster that become more frustratingly difficult to find solutions.

title: Sculplings
description: Welcome to the world of Sculplings! Here, trainers collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion! Sculplings is a mashup of roguelikes with traditional monster fighter games!

title: Lonesome Road
description: "Lonesome Road" is a vanilla compatible set of 8 levels for Doom 2 Created by Tourniquet,

title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
description: Rescue Ops: Wildfire is an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game where you can battle unpredictable, dynamic mega-fires solo or in co-op, using ground and aerial vehicles, fire hose systems, tactical support and more.

title: Ctesiphon
description: A retrowave/mecha-inspired sci-fi first-person shooter featuring fast-paced combat in old-school style open-plan levels packed with pickups, keys, and secrets.

title: Only Tung Tung Sahur Up
description: Up, up, and never give up!

title: Minos Dungeon
description: Help Ferdinando find treasures in a labyrinth full of puzzles!

title: Only Sky Parkour: Island Up!
description: Every jump is a step closer to the top!

title: Baseball Card Shop Simulator
description: Collect, trade, dominate the market and outsmart the competition.

title: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
description:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

title: Perimbó
description:
Jaime was just playing in the forest when, attracted by a beautiful red bird, he ended up falling into a deep and mysterious cave. Now, he must find a way to escape and, at the same time, unravel the forgotten secrets of this ancient place. In an underground world full of dangers and lost stories, you embark on an exciting adventure, solving puzzles, exploring secret passages and helping spirits that need to be freed.

This cave was once home to a tribe that worshipped the god Guaracy, creator of light and protector of nature. They lived in harmony until foreigners invaded and destroyed the sacred tree that brought sunlight into the caves. The magical Ybá fruit, the last reminder of this ancient power, now shines in the depths, waiting to be collected. Use the power of the sacred necklace given by the bird to create blocks of light and climb impossible heights, revealing hidden paths and overcoming obstacles.

At every turn, you’ll uncover pieces of this ancient puzzle. Help them, solve complex challenges, and recover lost tools like Jaime’s hoe to clear a path through the corrupted roots that block your progress. Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative that weaves legend, mystery, and resilience as you uncover the truth about the tribe’s fate and fight to escape back to the surface.

With an immersive atmosphere, unique soundtrack, and creative exploration mechanics, this game promises an unforgettable adventure. Explore, solve, collect, and climb as you guide Jaime on his journey back home and help restore peace to the souls trapped in the depths. Are you ready to unravel the mysteries of the cave and free your people?

title: Postal 2 Redux
description: A ground‑up overhaul of 2003’s infamous open‑world shooter. Part modernization, part love‑letter, POSTAL 2 Redux will hoist every original asset out of the creaking Unreal 1.5 engine and slam it into today’s Unity—delivering the same familiar week in the POSTAL Dude’s life with a merciless glow‑up and a bucket of new toys.

title: Neko Ningen Eugene
description:
The year is 2020, and it is off the coast of the Sea of ​​Okhotsk.

A "portal" suddenly appears on the bottom of the sea, leading to a different space-time.
The unknown wilderness beyond it is called the "Demon World."

title: Tears of the Maker
description: Tears of the Maker is a roguelike deck builder in which tears flow to the chambers to determine who attacks. Use your cards to manipulate the game and change your fate. Collect cards and build your stats in story mode or go for a more hardcore endless mode where you risk it all to go farther.

title: Fight-Quest
description: The first-person melee roguelite. Fight-Quest is a brutally satisfying deckbuilder where you fight thousands of fantasy foes, discover game-changing enchantments, and extract with your hard-earned gold.

title: Kathana
description:
Embark on an epic journey in Kathana and immerse yourself in a world brimming with adventure!

Join forces with friends and connect with adventurers from around the globe in this captivating classic MMO. Set out on shared quests, overcome formidable challenges, and experience everything Kathana has to offer.

title: Hellsprint
description: A hyper-focused, first-person speedrunner with a focus on pure adrenaline, frame-perfect execution, and the very pinnacle of competitive grinding.

title: DepthLess
description: A surreal first-person platformer horror game where you descend into nightmarish architecture, solve spatial puzzles, and survive grotesque creatures.

title: Altruistic
description: This is a pixel-style casual puzzle game set against a fresh backdrop of snowy mountains and pine forests, creating a playful winter atmosphere filled with childlike wonder.

title: Emotitron
description: Guide twin spinning orbs through lethal neon mazes in a precision arcade speedrunner with instant restarts and global leaderboards.

title: Unhinged Pet Store Simulator
description: Run your own crazy pet store! Buy wares, stock shelves, raise crabs, defend the store from the local thieving animals, hire workers and try to keep your store tidy while taking payment from impatient customers.

title: Kasama: The Awakening
description: Dive into this magical journey and join Orion The Orange in the adventure of a lifetime through dreams and nightmares. Uncover the secrets, face your fears, and restore the balance in the land of Kasamas! Will you dare to dream and face the night with them?

title: Beast Unleashed
description: Drawn breaks and the hunt begins... Beast Unleashed is a turn-based, one-vs-many multiplayer game of deadly hide-and-seek, where every move counts.

title: Humblets
description: Humblets is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you explore a charming procedural world. Pack your tent and embark on a journey as you craft, decorate, befriend magical creatures and solve challenges with the magic of cards. No pressure, just peaceful exploration and fireside stories!

title: Pathogenic
description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

title: Noroi no Kegareuta: Narumi Tatsuya no Kaikiroku
description: You have lost your memory and wake up in an unpopular Japanese house. Strange phenomena occur. Eerie singing voices coming from inside the house. Uncover the mystery of the cursed house with your partner.

title: Ascendora
description: A first person horror game where you play as Harper, the child of an infamous scientist. You must explore his abandoned laboratory to find the answers you have been looking for. Unravel the secrets of your parents, but be aware, you might not be alone...

title: Artis Impact: Meiji Spa
description: Soak in hot springs, explore a snowy town, uncover secrets, and maybe even... save the world?! This pixel JRPG blends humor and adventure. Meet fun characters, enjoy relaxed turn-based combat, and defend the resort from mysterious AI threats. A journey full of surprises awaits!

title: Girl Frame
description: Girl Frame: A sci-fi meat-and-pigeon survival shooting game, control mechas to fight against the mutant tide of Crusus, manage your own space base, cultivate beautiful girl pilots, fast-paced mowing × dynamic strategic choices, and experience interstellar survival under the collapse of san value.

title: Whimsy Bake ＆ Craft
description: Whimsy Bake ＆ Craft is a relaxing and therapeutic idle game where you can craft adorable desserts while freely designing your home’s aesthetics. Embark on this sweet dual-healing journey to enjoy the perfect blend of creativity and cozy charm!

title: Kalma
description:
You're a mythical Finnish warrior, descending to the depths of the crypts to show Kalman Väki who's the boss. Swing that axe at the ghosts of Kalma.

You advance to next level when you have cleaned the dungeon from all enemies.

5 levels of dungeon crawling sweetness!

title: Cute Star Heroes
description: "Cute Star Heroes" is a game inspired by the Klonoa series and 8-bit games on the NES. Play as one of the two titular "Cute Star Heroes" -Pami, a brave blue-loving rabbit, or Lumi, a girly pink-loving cat. Travel through eight different worlds and stop Lord Hades from taking control of the universe.

title: Fish 'n Ships
description: Take to the seas on your little boat and catch some fish in this 2D cozy fishing experience! Explore the drizzly coastline, upgrade your boat, and bring home the big one! How many fish can you catch?

title: Countryballs: Power Protocol
description: Incarne un Countryball et conquiers le monde – par la force, les accords ou les ruses. Développe ton économie, construis ton armée, fais-toi des alliés ou des ennemis, et règne sur les 195 pays. Une domination mondiale, plus ronde et plus drôle.

title: A Regular Pinball Game
description: You know Pinball, that's it... kinda.

title: Farm Chicken
description: Simulate a chicken on a farm recklessly destroying and exploring, or fulfilling someone else's wish to feel the warmth and healing of the farm.

title: Hidden Portals: Eternal Balance - Collector's Edition
description: As time unravels, Alice Lofton must journey into the mystical realm of Luminaria to confront her father's dangerous mission and prevent the collapse of reality. Will she be able to stop him before it's too late?

title: FloofCorp.
description: A single-player idle sticker game where white-collar workers escape to stress-free farms, collect ancient resources, process magical goods, and build personalized, ever-expanding dreamlands.

title: Castle Rodok
description: Castle Rodok is an action-RPG game with heavy emphasis on adventure and PSX style retro graphics. In Castle Rodok, you create your own character from five different races, and try to survive at least 8 levels of it's procedurally generated dungeons. There are three levels which the dungeons can occur in: Wintery forest, castle dungeons and the castle itself. After the 8 levels, you have a chance to find the final bossfight...

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X
description: Rainbow Six Siege X is the reference in tactical team shooters, where elite strategy and execution triumph. Enjoy free access to Quick Match, Unranked and Dual Front game modes with a selection of operators.

title: Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Syng, Leg Og Lær
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Hønsefødder Og Gulerødder
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Der Bor En Bager
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Mæh, Siger Det Lille Monster
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Kan Du Alfabetet?
Silke, Pixelines Lillesøster: Kan Du Klokken?
Portal for TIC-80
description: Demake of Portal for the Tiny Computer game engine

title: Nebs' Island Adventure
description:
Nebs' Island Adventure is a 3D platformer where you play as a leopard gecko girl Nebs. Her goal is to reach the top of a mountain in a small island to find the golden cricket and prove leopard geckos are great climbers too.

While exploring the island Nebs can also collect normal crickets. Can she find them all?

title: Monster and Snakes 1.1
description: "Monster and Snakes 1.1" is a captivating story about a brave monster who encounters a series of snakes in a mysterious jungle. The monster, initially scared, quickly learns to face its fears and discovers that some snakes are friendly and helpful, while others are dangerous. Through a series of adventures, the monster navigates the jungle, making new friends and overcoming obstacles, ultimately understanding the importance of courage, wisdom, and kindness in overcoming fears and challenges.

title: Away Team
description: Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included adventure. Take control of a Duplicant and harness a new world where every tile is simulated.

title: Ffff You Machine
description: Time-stressed arena FPS. Everybody wants to FFFF you - FFFF them instead, gain time and feed the FFFF Machine until the world ends. Or time.

title: Memory Of Psycho
description: A game to relive the memories of a young man.

title: BouleMan
description: BouleMan is a fun, family‑friendly game for all ages! With up to 5 save slots, each family member can follow their own adventure and resume where they left off. Simple, charming, and customisable—perfect for both young and old players.

title: Crabs
description:
Key Features
Care for Your Crab – It’s simple. Get a crab, bring it home, and keep its food and water topped up for a few days. Take it out for a backyard adventure. When you are done spending time with your crab you can ALT-F4. The Crab will survive will the game is off as long as it has food and water. Make sure to check in before it runs out and refill as needed. Keep your crab alive as long as possible. Train it to improve its skills and discover new abilities along the way.

Real-Time Gameplay – The game continues even when you are not playing, so there is no need to keep it open between visits.

Backyard Adventure – Take control of your crab and explore the backyard. Discover secrets, face threats, and solve puzzles to discover new traits and abilities for your crabs!

Tank Variety and Customization – Unlock larger tank designs and customize them with decorations to create the perfect environment for your crab. (Coming soon)

Perfect for anyone looking for a low-pressure gameplay experience, Crabs captures the simple joy of caring for a hermit crab. Whether you are a longtime hermit crab enthusiast or just curious about these fascinating creatures, this game invites you to slow down and enjoy life’s tiny wonders.

Crabs is in early access and does not represent the final product. I will do my best at regular updates to improve the experience and add new features. Some content is still a work in progress. Please visit the Discord to report any bugs and share your feedback.

title: Grey Wake
description: In an intimate narrative-driven exploration game, wake up on a forgotten island between life and death equipped with only a compass, a telescope, and a weathered sailboat. Chart the haunted archipelago, relive faded memories, and uncover the truth about what, and who, you came here to find.

title: Beyond the Pitch
description: Dig beneath the pitch and uncover secrets no one was meant to find.

title: Born as a Pirate
description: Born as a Pirate - Multiplayer PVP game where you explore and fight!

title: Skaldsong
description: A free-to-play, singleplayer/multiplayer RPG reminiscent of TTRPGs mixed with MUD games but with content generated by an AI Game Master.

title: Biofall: Survival
description: Open-world survival horror game based in 2030, two years after the "cure". Build, survive, and find the truth of the horrors unknown.

title: Become Barista!
description: Become Barista is a charming café life-sim game. Run a café by stocking your shelves, preparing fresh ingredients, welcoming customers, expertly crafting coffee☕ and bread, upgrading your equipment and shop. Buy and decorate your dream house.

title: Lovebyte.exe
description: A parasocial VTuber dating chatsim where you join a friendly degen discord group to chat about your oshis together, but is your kamioshi actually one of your new friends? Chat, uncover irl identities, & romance a fellow fan - or maybe a VTuber. Inspired by Mystic Messenger, online communities, and internet spam

title: Dust Walkers
description: Recruit DUST WALKERS to go on dangerous expeditions to extract Dust, the most valuable resource in the galaxy! Collect resources, build defenses, acquire weapons, and choose upgrades to collect and deploy the most powerful Dust Walkers you can.

title: Still Wakes the Deep: Siren's Rest
description: 1986. Over a decade has passed since the Beira D incident. A specialist dive team journeys to the North Sea to uncover the truth.

title: Peak
description: hit bag..crank lever..upgrade moves..Hit Bag...Crank Lever...Upgrade Moves...HIT BAG....CRANK LEVER....UPGRADE MOVES....THIS... IS...PEAK... GAMEPLAY !

title: Emma's Umbrella
description: Emma's Umbrella is a challenging 2D precision platformer where you guide Emma through dangerous obstacles. Use her umbrella to create platforms, master precise movements, run, float, and wall-jump. Overcome tricky levels and help Emma find her way home!

title: Really Fast Rat
description: Really Fast Rat is a cute 2D platformer where you play as a Really Fast Rat! Dash into several unique levels and collect some adorable hats!

title: Irbet Tong
description: In this pixel adventure, Ürgel walks through a village crumbling with byllars, guided by the cosmology of the Sakha people and the memory of his ancestors, the Öbüge. As the permafrost collapses and the Earth warms, he searches for meaning on a quiet journey for jam.

title: Crimson Horn
description: Forge an unstoppable army in this thrilling auto battler experience! Strategically recruit and command diverse warriors, each with unique abilities, to form the ultimate force. Customize your squad with powerful weapons, crafted gear, and inspiring banners to turn the tide of battle!

title: Simultree
description: Simultree is an incremental game about running a life simulation. Unlock new entity, items, food and upgrade inside a big tech tree. Compete in an online leaderboard.

title: You Were Just Selling Lemonade
description: You Were Just Selling Lemonade is a strategy simulation game about selling lemonade in a capitalist society and the consequences that your actions may bring.

title: Choose
description:
A puzzle game where you collect offerings in a world where heaven and earth are connected to each other.
Stepping on clouds high in the sky, you look up at the earth you've been walking on.
In the mysterious world of Mobius, you can only rely on your inspiration.

title: Evergreen Tavern
description: A Medieval Tavern and Farming Simulator with Dungeon Crawling.

title: Koarabyss
description: This is a one-button action game where you slide down the wall while being subjected to two forces: wind and gravity.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Harbinger of Madness
description: Mysterious disappearances have the entire city on edge. Investigate the fates of the missing, dare to face hidden horrors that have broken the sanity of so many others, and destroy the monstrous perpetrator before it consumes your mind. Contains 4 hand-crafted adventures in the streets of Stormreach.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Mines of Tethyamar
description: The Dwarves have returned to the Mines of Tethyamar to seek fabulous treasure, only to find the Drow of the Underdark are after it as well. This DLC contains five adventures with an appearance by one of the Forgotten Realms' most intriguing villains.

title: Norm: A Serial Killer RPG
description:
It is not a story about love. It is a story about survival. It is a story about what is considered "normal" - and the actual truths of the universe that send people screaming from their beds in the night. It is a story about the lies we are told. It is a story about the lies we tell ourselves. It is a story about murder, debauchery, cannibalism, fraud, extortion, torture, Stockholm Syndrome, drugs, war, heresy and black magic. It is a story about tedium... it is a story about entropy... and there will be no happy endings.

But there will be plenty of macaroni and cheese...

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Haunted Halls of Eveningstar
description: Rumors say treasures still await those brave enough to delve into the depths of the Haunted Halls. A classic D&D module brought to life narrated by Forgotten Realms creator Ed Greenwood. This is an enormous dungeon with dozens of side objectives. It can be replayed in an extended mode with new content and developer commentary.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Devils of Shavarath
description: The time has come to battle the devil armies of Shavarath on their own ground. Journey to Shavarath to end once and for all the invasion of Xen'drik! Avoid the lethal traps set for you along the way, wage war against the devil army, and thwart the strategies of their most powerful commanders. Contains several challenging quest dungeons, an adventure area and a raid.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X: Elite Edition
description:
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X is the undisputed reference in tactical team shooters, where elite strategy and execution triumph.

Siege X marks the biggest evolution in its history and deepens the game’s tactical core.

The Elite Edition grants access to all game modes including Ranked playlists and the Siege Cup, and 16 additional operators.

title: Arisen Force: Life Devotee
description: A challenging action combat experience on Journey to the West with your companions!

title: Cats Visiting Wild West
description: Explore charming Wild West scenes and find hidden cats hiding in saloons, canyons, and steam trains. Relax, search, and collect them all!

title: Cozy Fields
description: Wander. Wonder. Relax.

title: Only Up! Remaster
description: The sky’s the limit - climb higher than ever before!

title: Shadowframe
description: Freeze time. Analyze the battlefield. Then make your move. In SHADOWFRAME, reflexes alone won’t save you — you’ll need precision, patience, and planning to survive.

title: Tekken 8: Anna Williams
description:
Lightning Scarlet: The breathtakingly beautiful and deadly ex-assassin Anna Williams is joining the fight!

Fueled once again by the thirst for vengeance, Anna is armed with not only a new secret weapon, but also a new fighting style so she can finally take Nina down.

title: Anime Girls: Naughty Neko
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Arcade Archives: Spinal Breakers
description:
“SPINAL BREAKERS” is an action shooting game released by VIDEO SYSTEM in 1991.
Players take control of Colonel WAFFLE and battle through stages by defeating enemies infected by the artificial lifeform known as “HILDROID.”
Dodge enemy attacks using the rotation button while aiming precisely to take them down. The game features three different endings, which vary depending on your performance throughout the playthrough.

title: Bee Flowers: Save the Garden
description:
n the third chapter of the Bee Flowers series, you’ll guide bees through stunning environments while solving logic puzzles on a hexagonal grid. The goal is simple: connect paths to deliver pollen to the flowers. The gameplay is accessible, but the challenges increase as you progress.

With 30 carefully designed levels, the game features three distinct biomes:
Green Fields: A peaceful green field, perfect for learning the mechanics and getting used to the game’s rhythm.

Autumn Grove: An autumn scene with leaves covering the paths and winds affecting the bees' movement.
Winter Hollow: A cold, serene environment where puzzles require more planning and attention.

Bee Flowers: Save the Garden combines minimalist visuals, a relaxing soundtrack, and thoughtful mechanics to offer an engaging experience, perfect for puzzle lovers with a touch of personality.

Time to save the garden — one path at a time.

title: Block Party DX!
description: Welcome to block party puzzle game, offering a relaxing yet challenging experience for all ages.

title: Bodycam Stray Kitty
description: Furry, fun, and full of surprises.

title: Cat Tricks
description: A fun and practical guide to help you bond with your cat through 20 easy and entertaining tricks.

title: Coloring Pixels: Collection 6
description: A relaxing coloring-by-numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with differing themes, complexity, and sizes.

title: Cornhole
description: Toss beanbags onto the board or into the hole to score in this fun party game!

title: Eggconsole Tritorn MSX
description: In this masterpiece action RPG, the brave warrior Triton rises to restore peace to Luwanda Island. The MSX version features different strategies!

title: Tungrooms: Escape Sahur
description: Can you escape Sahur? Beware the Tung Tung Tung...

title: The World of Japanese Tea Through the Way of Tea
description: In every quiet cup, a deep tradition lives on. This guide explores the world of Japanese tea—from its varieties and flavors to the rich cultural practice of the tea ceremony.

title: Rally Drive Championship Car Racing Game
description:
Push the Limits.
Chase the Clock.
Own the Road.

title: Pirate Trails: Tentacles and Treasures
description: Arrr you ready for more puzzlin', plunderin' and perilous tentacles?

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Yangpyeong-gun
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Icheon-si
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Gwangju-si
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Merge World Alchemist
description: Merge items to develop the ultimate alchemy

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Digital Deluxe Edition
Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Super Digital Deluxe Edition
D.S. al Fine
description:
A mysterious parcel. An absent friend. When did you buy a radio?

An experimental game inspired by the audio-drama Malevolent and is based on its pre-show events, but knowledge of it is not required to play (no spoilers past season 2 if you are familiar.)

title: Not Not 2: A Brain Challenge - Complete Edition
Rage Swarm: Rapid Fire Edition
description:
Armed with powerful weapons, blast through waves of fierce enemies to reach the ultimate boss. Collect upgrades along the way to power up and make every shot count!

Features:
- Get lots of premium equipment and supplies including weapons, armor, and designs!
- 2500 extra gems to spend on loot boxes
- Navigate through various landscapes
- Defend yourself from the fierce invaders
- Pick up upgrades to get stronger
- Level up and buy awesome talents
- Complete quests for useful loot
- Open epic loot boxes and enhance your gear

title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
With the SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition, you can play the game three days early and receive the Ghost Outfit, Medic Lite Amulet, in-game currency, digital artbook and soundtrack, and the SEGA Villains Stage, featuring bosses based on iconic SEGA villains.

It includes:
• Base Game
• Play the game 3 days early
• Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o Starter Pack: the Ghost Outfit, the Medic Lite Amulet, and In-Game Currency
o SEGA Villains Stage (Coming Early 2026)
o Digital Art Book + Soundtrack

The iconic SHINOBI returns in an all-new 2D action platformer with a unique hand-drawn look created by the team behind the hit brawler Streets of Rage 4.

title: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree: Deluxe Edition
description:
Pre-order to receive the Guardians' Vestments Costume Set, which grants additional costumes for Towa and all 8 Guardians.

Content includes:
- Towa Outfit: Blacksmith's Clothes
- Rekka Outfit: Lady Towa's Personal Guard
- Shigin Outfit: Traditional Attire of Jinkai
- Akazu Outfit: Researcher's Uniform
- Origami Outfit: Traditional Attire of Musuhi
- Nishiki Outfit: Chargrilled Nishiki
- Mutsumi Outfit: Sakura Kimono
- Korou Outfit: Village Hero Regalia
- Banpuku Outfit: Black & Beige Fur

*The Guardians' Vestments Costume Set can be changed by visiting the Residence which unlocks after completing the tutorial.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
- Digital Artbook & Soundtrack

In this Roguelite adventure set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description: Pop Bubbles, Master Chaos!

title: Bubble Trouble 3
description: Burst Bubbles, Share the Fun!

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Special Equipment Set
description: Dive into the world of Daemon X Machina with this collection of special equipment!

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Special SFX Weapon Set
description: Spice up your battles with these special weapons with original sound effects!

title: Venue
description: The world is in pieces... this is your responsibility now. The process will be excruciating, beautiful, and you will tolerate it entirely without question.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Magic of Myth Drannor
Fixer Park-er
description:
You've been thinking about your childhood park a lot recently: it was closed some years ago after the original contributor paying for it's maintenance died and it has since been left to fall into disrepair, now overgrown and abandoned. You've been trying to find a way to help out the old neighborhood for a while now and this might be a 2 for 1 opportunity.

Time to get to work and restore the park to it's former glory.

Take your time exploring the park, using tools to break open new pathways and finding items to fix up broken structures and machines. All on the back of the charity of others gained by selling lemonade to the locals!

title: Common Grounds
description:
In this heartfelt barista simulator, you'll serve not just drinks, but warmth, comfort, and inspiration!

Listen to your customers' stories, serve their drink just the way they like, and hand-decorate each cup with stickers, drawings and personal messages to uplift not just their day, but life! We hope you enjoy!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Eladrin
description: Unleash the Eladrin’s seasonal magic with this character race. Master versatile combat styles and elemental spells that shift with the seasons, bringing the Feywild's power to your fingertips.

title: Bytecollector
description: Bytecollector is a short, incremental game where you draw loops to collect bytes. Spend them on a skill tree with over 40 upgrades to unlock new mechanics.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Eladrin Chaosmancer
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Epic Destiny - Machrotechnic
description:
This is an arcane epic destiny that can be purchased in the in-game store, or included with some editions of the Vecna Unleashed expansion.

The Machrotechnic wields the devastating power of both the lightning strike and the destructive sonic boom that follows. With mastery over arcane and mechanical devices, the Machrotechnic can wield a variety of devices to enhance themselves and their allies against harm or interfere with their foes.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Tabaxi Trailblazer
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Universal Tree - Inquisitive
description:
Inquisitives are investigators who specialize in solving mysteries and shedding light on the darkest secrets. They gain skills that focus on Diplomacy, Law/Chaos damage, finding hidden things, and a new Dual-Crossbow combat style.

Any Light or Heavy (non-repeating) Crossbow you equip splits into two smaller hand-crossbows in your hands, each firing a shot every time you attack. Both of these shots use the stats of your single (equipped) Crossbow. Get ready to hit the streets of Sharn and solve some mysteries!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Tiefling Scoundrel
Dungeons & Dragons Online: Universal Tree - Horizon Walker
description:
This is a universal enhancement tree that can be purchased in the in-game store, or included with some editions of the Sinister Secrets of Saltmarsh expansion.

Horizon Walker primarily features enhancements focused on dealing force damage and on marking & debuffing a single enemy. It can be very useful for characters who fight with a bow.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Iconic Race - Aasimar Scourge
description:
Aasimar Scourge are imbued with a divine energy that blazes intensely within them. It feeds a powerful desire to destroy evil-a desire that is, at its best, unflinching and, at its worst, all-consuming.

This content was previously available in the Mists of Ravenloft expansion bundles, but now has to be purchased in the in-game store.

title: Pikachu Volleyball
description: An unofficial free Pokemon game starring Pikachu. Made in 1997, the game was popular in South Korea

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Universal Tree - Vistani Knife Fighter
description:
Deadly Vistani Knife fighters use their blades to fight both in melee and at range. This universal enhancement tree can be used by all character classes, but is primarily focused on fighting with a dagger.

This content was previously available in the Mists of Ravenloft expansion bundles. It can now be purchased in the in-game store. Vistani Knife Fighter can also be obtained for free per character after completing all expansion quests at the highest difficulty levels.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Race - Aasimar
description:
Carrying the blood of a celestial, an Aasimar is usually good-aligned and fights against evil in the world.

This content was previously available in the Mists of Ravenloft expansion bundles, but now has to be purchased in the in-game store.

title: Factory Planner
description: Factory Planner is a card-based simulation/strategy game that lets you build a factory using cards. The main goal of the game is to make combinations with different cards so that each player can build different factories and feel the sandbox experience to the fullest.

title: Grow Wild
description: Grow Wild is a cosy, wholesome nature game where you create and nurture beautiful wildlife habitats

title: Ironscale
description: Ironscale is an old-school styled FPS, where you play as Ironscale, a cyborg anthro lizard-dude. Your mission is simple: Clean up the city from all the corporate scum.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Class - Alchemist
description:
Alchemists mix magical components to create powerful arcane effects and coat their weapons in vile toxins. Alchemists are an arcane caster class that can be used to melee, range, or spellcast effectively.

This character class is only available in the in-game store and cannot be unlocked for free.

title: ARPventure
description:
Embark on a fun and educational 2D adventure with Network Quest, a game developed in Unity designed to teach the fundamentals of computer networking in an engaging and accessible way. Ideal for beginners and students in the early years of computer science, this game turns complex concepts into interactive challenges.

Explore a colorful digital world where each character represents a key component of a network. Talk to routers, switches, servers, and more to uncover the knowledge you need to advance. Learn while you play, and master the basics of how computers communicate — all while having fun!

Are you ready to connect the dots? Dive into Network Quest and become a networking hero!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Class - Artificer
description:
Artificers use a mix of magic and technology to augment items and blast foes. Wielding rapid-fire crossbows and magical rune arms, they have a fighting style unlike any other class. They also can build their own Iron Defender, a customizable pet that aids them in battle. Artificers are a blend of Rogue and Arcane classes, and can also play a supporting role as a party healer.

This character class can be purchased in the in-game store. Artificer can also be obtained for free after earning a large amount of House Cannith favor on a server.

title: Luddite Rampage
description: Welcome to your next contract. The client wants this office ruined — machines wrecked, data wiped, and those smug AI bots turned into scrap. No questions asked. Just you, your tools, and a building full of overpriced tech begging to be smashed.

title: Crypt of Darne
description: Crypt of Darne is a free roguelike-ish dungeon delving game, where you make a character out of few race-class combinations and explore a crypt, trying to find a specific gem. You'll know it when you see it, but it is hidden deeply in the crypt. Good luck!

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Premium Class - Favored Soul
description:
Favored Souls draw on divine magic to both heal and destroy. Like clerics, Favored Souls have access to powerful healing spells, but they are also more skilled with weapons than any other spell caster. Like sorcerers, they get a larger number of spell points than other spell casters but cannot freely switch spells at taverns or rest shrines.

This character class can be purchased in the in-game store. Favored Soul can also be obtained for free after earning a large amount of favor across all quests on a server.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Secrets of the Artificers
description: Home of the Artificers, House Cannith is an area where magic and mechanics converge. Born in war, forged in fury, Stormreach faces its most terrible foe yet as the Lord of Blades attacks the Cannith Manufactury. This is a premium quest pack featuring an adventure zone, 3 dungeons, and 2 raids.

title: CrossTheRidge Evolution
description:
CrossTheRidge Evolution is a 2014 touge racing game for Windows PC made by the doujin group "ACCELERATE".

It's succeeded by CrossTheRidge R in 2016.

title: Spacecaps
description: In this puzzling space capsule, you can only move left and right, but any direction could be your left and right!

title: Endless Arena
description: Endless Arena is a mysterious place full of AngryGuys who really want to kill you. They will keep spawning, forever and forever, and the more you kill them, the faster they spawn. How long can you survive?

title: A Snail's Tale
description: A retro jRPG with a twist. Have you heard the one about the million dollars and the immortal snail? A Snail's Tale will let you play out the story and answer the question once and for all - can he be stopped?

title: Quadphos
description:
Quadphos is a grid-based rule deduction logic puzzle game.
Each puzzle consists of a grid and several numerical clues. Your goal is to light up the cells to satisfy all the numerical clues.
The symbols next to the numbers represent the specific rules that these clues follow. For example, a number might indicate the number of lit cells within its range.
The game doesn't directly tell you these rules. You'll need to deduce and verify their meanings through a series of levels. As you solve puzzles, you'll continually refine your guesses, or even discard them entirely, until you discover a more exciting perspective.

title: Ruya: Ascension
description:
Ruya: Ascension is a meditative puzzle game and sequel to the original award-winning game.
Caught in a time loop, Ruya visits different universes freeing lost souls by giving parts of herself away in order to attempt to unlock her past memories.
Ruya: Ascension presents a brand-new adventure set in a surreal plane of existence, featuring numerous new puzzles that build upon the experience of the original hit game.

title: Ash and Flame
description: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

title: Diacritic
description: Decode a layered narrative as you complete the work assignment of a Diacritic: to fit shapes into orthogonally projected outlines and provide answers to inscrutable questions.

title: GoodMan
description: A 2D action game where you can play on various maps and defeat unique enemies, overcome challenging platforms, and create and share your own maps with the community.

title: Without a Clear Path
description:
Without a Clear Path is a collaborative English Yume Nikki parody fangame originally started and managed by Doc Saturn in 2018 and then later managed by Calci Soya and assisted by JPiggs. The protagonist was designed by Saibibi.

The game's concept is that it is a fangame where every single world is a maze. It features contributions from many different developers, and a full list of credits can be found in the game's folder.

title: Spells Enhanced
description:
This mod adds 20 brand-new spells to Hogwarts Legacy, expanding your magical toolkit with a mix of offensive, defensive, utility, and enemy exclusive abilities. From channeling AoE spells and elemental attacks to teleportation, healing, and crowd control, each spell is carefully crafted to feel lore friendly and blend naturally with the game's combat and casting system for a seamless experience.

Spells can also be enhanced through talent upgrades, transforming their visuals, behavior, and overall power to better suit your combat style. If you are using multiple mods with talents, use the mod "TALENT UI FIX". For the talents to take effect, fast travel or save and load the game.

Spells are locked behind specific quests to maintain balance and immersion. You will unlock them naturally as you progress through the game. Alternatively, for those who want instant access, you can open the built-in widget by pressing "F6". There, you can unlock spells manually and view information about which quest unlocks each one.

title: Murkid
description: A video game published by the Delegación de Turismo de la Región de Murcia in which the young superhero Murkid needs to stop Doctor Maladrín from dirtying down some of Murcia's most iconic tourist spots.

title: Brainrot: Fighting
description: This ain’t eSports. This is memeSports

title: Forza Horizon 3: Car Pass
description: The Car Pass brings you six monthly car packs (7 cars each) beginning in October 2016, ending March 2017. That’s 42 amazing new cars total, all waiting to be collected, customized, and raced, for one low price.

title: SkyFactory 5
description: Guess who's back?! Back again for it's 5th installment! That's right, it's SkyFactory 5! View the world in a way you never have before with all new, unprecedented, handmade modpack progression. Your goal is to paint the world one color at a time with whatever happy accidents happen along the way! Filled with tech, magic, chaos, and imagination you'll create your magnum opus that will leave an everlasting impression.

title: Forza Horizon 3: VIP
description: Forza Horizon 3 VIP members receive five exclusive VIP cars, the 2016 Lamborghini Aventador LP750-4 SV, 2016 Koenigsegg Regera, 2015 Ferrari F12tdf, 2015 Ultima Evolution Coupe 1020, and 2015 Ford Falcon GT F 351. VIPs will receive additional benefits, including double Wheelspin earnings, access to exclusive online events, community gifts, and more.

title: Ice Block Slide Rush
description: Ice Block Slide Rush is a fast paced endless challenge where timing and precision are everything. Press to charge and release to slide. The harder you squash the ice block, the farther it slides. Smash into other blocks and try to land perfectly in the glowing zone. Miss the mark and your block gets chopped down. The smaller the block, the harder it is to push the next one. With only 3 lives, how far can you go on this slippery ride?

title: Liminal Border Part IV
description: The conclusion of the Liminal Border visual novel series. After the countless twists and turns of Part III, Itsuki's business is now a massive success, but all he can see is the need for revenge. Standing on the border between justice and evil, which way will Itsuki fall?

title: Asonde Chess ga Tsuyoku Naru! Ginsei Chess DX
The Adventures of Commander Shepard
description: A short point and click adventure Mass Effect fan game.

title: Dino Strike
description: ZX Spectrum styled demake of the classic PS1 game 'Dino Crisis'. Navigate each area, eliminating rogue dinos and staying alive. Find door cards to access new areas, deactivate force-fields and find useful pick-ups.

title: Espirito Delusion
description: Embark on an adventure to explore the corrupted school, solve puzzles, and battles evil monsters in turn-based combat with the power of FAITH.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: War on Hoxxes
description: WAR ON HOXXES is a fangame based on the critically acclaimed indie game "Deep Rock Galactic" by Ghost Ship Games. It is a hybrid between the insanity of Deep Rock's swarms, with the arcade themed structure and gameplay style of Mario Bros.

title: Rebel Core: Awakens
description: Rebel Core: Awakens is a sci-fi action platformer where players can jump, shoot, slash, and shield their way through the 8 Core Robotics and their domains. Conquer levels and bosses in any order and defeat them all to reach the The Citadel - along with the robotic Council that has conquered humanity.

title: Fire in the Frost
description: Take on the role of fire bearer and escort the only remnants of warmth deep into the wilderness to restore life to the frozen wasteland. With the power of the flames you can power up your snow mobile to dash and weave through the thickets and discover the secrets within the woods.

title: Kernelbay
description: A cozy idle fishing game that lives on your desktop. Explore handcrafted islands, unlock new species, upgrade gear and customize each island’s look as you uncover the stories hidden beneath the waves while your fisher works quietly in the background.

title: Spend It Like You Hate It
description: A game where you blow through your boss’s money.

title: Triumvirate
description: Triumvirate is a fast-paced 3-6 player cooperative city-management strategy game. Work together to meet the demands of a rapidly growing metropolis to avoid the inevitability of overextension.

title: Netherwake
description: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.

title: Alterchase
description: Race your way to the finish! Alterchase is a fast paced parkour game with the essential parkour mechanics like wall running, wall bouncing, sliding and double jumping! Alterchase also includes a campaign, and don't forget the katanas!

title: Finally a Florist
description: Finally a Florist is a cozy, slice-of-life game where you gather flowers to arrange beautiful bouquets. Explore peaceful landscapes, befriend animals, and fill heartfelt requests from the local villagers as you finally become a florist.

title: Nuclear Crawler
description: Build a massive Ice Crawler powered by a nuclear power plant on a distant planet where you need to generate energy to survive and rescue other survivors. Your crawler base can accommodate dozens of survivors and have dozens of floors. Learn how to build a nuclear power plant to survive.

title: Wasteland Bites
description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.

title: Matter of Factory
description: Matter of Factory is competitive chaos, packed with adventure! Compete against and sabotage your friends in a race to build more toys and make money!

title: Pixel Par
description: Putt your way through unique courses across a variety of modes, using upgraded abilities to assist you and overcome tricky challenges your way.

title: Ashfield Hollow
description: Ten years after the outbreak, you’re found unconscious and taken in by a camp of survivors. Learn to fight, scavenge, farm, and craft as you rebuild your life, form bonds, and maybe even find love in this post-apocalyptic life sim RPG.

title: Observer Protocol: The Station - Second Shift
description: Observe. Record. Report. A fresh assignment on the same failing station. New anomalies. Same quiet dread.

title: Goo Goo Grapplers
description: Goo Goo Grapplers is a chaotic 1v1 couch party brawler, mixing MOBA-style strategy with baby-powered mayhem. Grab a controller and smack down your friend face-to-face!

title: Dog Forest
description: This is a game about a hero’s journey of a tiny little dog who can split into parts. Safe travel!

title: Aperture Dating Simulator
description: After a missing employee leaves a maintenance position vacant, Aperture swoops you out of manufacturing to take his place. Will you stay true to your contract, or fall for your subordinates?

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Ruins of Gianthold
description:
The Stormreaver has returned to the seat of his empire's power, and Xen'drik's most powerful creatures rally to his call. Can you unravel the mystery and quell this gathering storm before the Stormreaver and his minions fulfill the Prophecy?

Gianthold is one of the largest & most popular premium quest collections in Dungeons & Dragons Online. It contains a big adventure area, 10 dungeons, and 2 raids.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Vale of Twilight
description:
Vale of Twilight is the largest premium quest collection in Dungeons & Dragons Online. It features two adventure areas, seven dungeons, and three raids, including "The Shroud."

This was the most popular endgame content in Dungeons & Dragons Online for over five years. The Shroud allows players to customize every major type of equipment with its green steel crafting system.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: White Plume Mountain and Other Tales
description:
An eccentric wizard has hidden three famous Sentient weapons inside of a volcano, and challenged all comers to try to retrieve them. Can you make it through fiendish obstacles and deadly traps?

The featured "White Plume Mountain" adventure is adapted from a classic D&D module. Four other short dungeons are included in this premium quest collection. The five quests are not part of a narrative arc, but instead tie thematically around wizards run amok.

title: Nightpyre
description: Dive into the Eternal Night and break through by using your magic synergies. Will they be enough? Bring back the light in this narrative roguelite and live in your own flesh the consequences of your choices.

title: Femboy Streamer
description: A life sim where you play as a moderator in your son's stream and help protect him from bullies in chat.

title: Atollo
description: Set sail across a shifting sea in this colorful pixel-art adventure. Battle enemy ships, meet goofy islanders, collect magical eggs and awaken the kraken. A compact, handcrafted, free-to-play game.

title: Magician Impossible
description: A first-person, spell-casting, adventure about a second rate, self taught magician who's on an impossible mission. Draw shapes with your wand to cast spells, solve puzzles, swing over chasms, and steal anything that isn't nailed down!

title: Boku wo Sodatete! Nyanda Seijin
description: A free raising simulator about raising an alien boy.

title: Witch of Eclipse
description: Travel the world as a witch and help the people by defeating threats, going to dungeons in search of materials, and granting other special favors.

title: VoltRhythm
description:
VoltRhythm is a retro-futuristic four-key rhythm game where rhythm play generates power. Accurate rhythm play emits a large amount of "rhythm energy," which can be converted to usable electricity with surprising efficiency. Your goal is to fill the energy reserves by playing as many songs as possible with as much accuracy as possible.

Though, what is the reason for gathering this much energy...?

title: Obgob
description: An auto-chess roguelike, Obgob is a ecstatic auto battler where your units synergize with the artifacts you select to make outrageous builds. Experiment, adapt, and develop new strategies as you craft powerful combos and play the game your way.

title: The Pale Deep
description: Descend into the depths of Neptune's atmosphere, discovering what lies below and how to survive in the aerial depths. See how much you can discover before your equipment, or your knowledge fails you.

title: Elf Clash
description: Lead your team to delve into the Three Realms, rescue the abducted detective, retrieve the Energy Spirit Stone, and punish the nefarious forces hiding in the shadows. Each realm presents unique challenges and secrets, and your decisions will sway the course of the battle.

title: Aestheta
description: A roguelike royalelike about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of Aestheta. Strategize your tactics, enhance your troops, and outwit your opponents to rise to the top!

title: Grotesqueresque
description: 10 grotesque stories

title: Drawn to Power
description: A tactical deckbuilding game where you fight enemies, unlock cards, and build your deck before each battle—discard cards to generate energy and control the flow of every fight.

title: KrvVR
description: A fast-paced martial arts VR game where you battle enemies in stunning spiritual locations. Wield weapons, exploit abilities and burn calories through intense physical exercise.

title: Junkyard Universe
description: Junkyard Universe is a 2D Galaxy Cleaner: Dissolve space trash or repair it. Find the right tactis when using the upgrades and game mechanics to collect enough points for your own junk eraser ship. Follow space pilot Meredith on her search for her lost mother.

title: Nrem
description: A 2D puzzle platformer where you navigate surreal dreamlike environments using a unique, reflection mechanic. Shift perspective, uncover hidden paths, and explore a world shaped by memory and movement.

title: In Full Bloom
description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

title: Tiny Delivery
description: It’s a cozy adventure about a small delivery robot on a short but unforgettable journey. Deliver your package through a vibrant town, meet new people, stumble upon both funny and touching moments, discover hidden treasures, and soak in the world around you.

title: Viewport: The A.R.K. Protocol
description: Congratulations, Commander! You've been prematurely awakened from cryosleep to fix everything. Hope you like impossible odds, and pressing glowing buttons to decide who lives, dies, or gets spaced. Keep the ship running, the crew alive-ish, and the existential dread manageable.

title: Project Nevada
description: Project Nevada is a mod aiming to make Fallout: New Vegas a more interesting - eventually more challenging - but surely more fun experience for you.

title: Down the Rabbit Hole Flattened
description: Down the Rabbit Hole is an adventure set in Wonderland prior to Alice's arrival. You will guide a girl who is looking for her lost pet by solving puzzles, uncovering secrets and making choices about the story along the way.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Three-Barrel Cove
description: A former pirate haven, Three-Barrel Cove is still a very rowdy outpost town on an island north of Stormreach. There are many dangerous adventures that await characters brave enough to explore Three-Barrel Cove. This premium quest collection contains an adventure area and 10 pirate-themed dungeons.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Iceland
description: Explore the Land of Fire and Ice! Iceland stands apart as one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth, an incredibly unique landscape with completely unmatched rugged nature. Now, you have the chance to experience it all from a truly unique perspective - behind the wheel of your truck.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Phiarlan Carnival
description: The freaks are all about when the Phiarlan Carnival hits town! It’s a circus of depravity and danger, and you have front-row seats for the show. But the lights and the glitter hide a terrible darkness, and you’re acting without a net when you confront the Phiarlan Carnival. This premium quest collection contains 4 short dungeons.

title: Jelliet the Slime Girl
description: The Jelliet mod, The Slime Girl introduces an original character for Don't Starve Together with a set of simple but eye-catching advantages like the generation of small slimes when Jelliet suffers damage. These function as items on the ground that he can pick up to recover. Each slime has 2-3 health points, and they usually disappear after a few seconds.

title: Ballotoro
description: Ballotoro is a snappy incremental roguelike where every roll counts. Launch satisfying combos, chain synergies, and watch the numbers explode. Optimize your build, reach the goal faster, and when it all clicks, it feels like you’ve cracked the code.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Against the Slave Lords
description: A short set of premium dungeons adapted from the classic "Scourge of the Slave Lords" D&D modules, with narration by Travis Willingham.

title: Womp The Abyssal
description:
Adds a new character to play as in DST.
Womp includes a custom speech file, art, sound effects and unique perks.

- Womp constantly generates wetness over time.
- Womp has a much higher drying threshold, so he will not dry normally unless he is too hot, near a fire, on fire, etc.
- Womp does not lose sanity for using wet equipment.

title: 2Deez
description: A simple fighting game distilling the core essence of 3D fighting games! And yet, it's 2D...? Fight through a story mode featuring a cursed rat, a cotton candy monster, and evil wizards. Customise your characters with HATS!!!1!!1 and play against your friends in online lobbies with Rollback Netcode!

title: Cryptbound
description: Cryptbound is an asymmetrical horror game where you and two other explorers venture into a mysterious dungeon in search of powerful energy crystals. But something ominous guards its domain. Work together, evade deadly traps, and run for your life.

title: StrangeDream
description: You had a dream, but you found that you couldn't wake up, and the content of the dream was very strange. Everything reasonable but unreasonable will happen here. You can only explore step by step, and finally choose to return to that restless urban era Do you really want to go back?

title: Wuzzy The Buzzy
description:
Wuzzy The Buzzy It is a “bee master” type character, with sprites and theme strongly inspired by bees and beehives.

Wuzzy combines bee management, honey production and follower-supported combat.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Demon Sands
description: The sprawling dunes of Menechtarun hide deadly secrets and are home to powerful enemies. This premium quest pack is one of the largest in Dungeons & Dragons Online. It contains an enormous adventure area, 10 dungeons, and a raid boss battle versus the Demon Queen Lailat. The Sands of Menechtarun includes the popular "Wiz King" dungeon, which is a giant tomb filled with mummies, traps and a lich.

title: Whemy the Witch
description: Whemy prepares potions using different types of mushrooms: they can heal, put enemies to sleep or function as magical “grenades”, depending on the mushroom used.

title: De Schippers van de Kameleon
description: Promotional game that was included for free with jars of Calvé peanut butter.

title: Samurai Jack
description: Samurai Jack has arrived to join the misery. It's not his first time to survive in an unknown world, let's hope it's not his last time either.

title: Reasons
description:
Reasons is a story unfolding in the mosaic of the 20th century, where the line between the known and the unknown becomes blurred.
You are about to embark on a journey through a world that feels familiar on the surface — yet is laced with shadows of the inexplicable, where reality does not always follow the laws of logic.

This is a narrative about those who seek answers — people faced with questions that don’t always have a single correct response. About how subtle encounters, events, and choices intertwine — even when their meaning remains hidden.

Observe. Choose. Feel.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Coaches
description: Trade cargo for passengers in a whole new ETS2 journey! Take a seat behind the wheel – not of a truck, but of a coach. The Coaches DLC brings a new dimension to the ETS2 experience by introducing scheduled passenger transport across Europe.

title: My Tiny Landscape
description: My Tiny Landscape is a minimalist colorful landscape builder. Bring procedural archipelagos back to life by placing biomes and regrowing a vibrant landscape tile by tile. Strategize to leverage placement rules and maximize your score, or simply enjoy a relaxing peaceful experience.

title: Slimy Harvest
description: Harvest Slime Monster eggs for the Alchemists. Buy equipment to automate the process and combine Slimes into new types for more profit and to explore deeper into the dungeon.

title: Fish and Chill
description: A cozy idle fishing game where your fisherman catches fish automatically while you relax. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and enjoy the calming sea in a transparent, borderless overlay that floats on any desktop.

title: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo
description: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo is the definitive animated carpark chaotic parking simulator!!! Park cars before its too late!

title: The Lady Knight and The Three Princes
description: Choose your fairytale prince and go on an adventure to win his hand in marriage!

title: Yunodream
description: After the loss of her family, Yuno begins to see nightmares in broad daylight. In order to save herself, she must find happy memories in this distorted world. But will she be able to accept what has happened?

title: Glitch: Dead Loop Horror
description: Code the game. Survive the night.

title: Snakes and Ladders Championship
description: 3D Snakes and Ladders is a visually enhanced digital version of the classic board game, set in a dynamic 3D environment. Players move across a 3D board filled with animated snakes and ladders.

title: Bus Sim 25: City Simulator
description: Drive the city. Master the route. Rule the road.

title: Legends: Saint George
description: Discover the legend of Saint George or rewrite history!

title: One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 2
description:
Challenge yourself with these 5 one-button fast-paced games.

D Pistols - You are constantly moving up and down. You goal is to shoot all the enemies that are coming from the sides of the screen. When the enemies reach the middle of the screen they will go up or down depending on your current position. Press a button to change your direction and shoot sideways. Hold a button to charge and shoot in all four directions.

Embattled - You are constantly moving up and down while enemies on both sides are shooting at you and approaching your position. To change your direction, press a button or hit the top or the bottom of the screen. Hold a button to stay still and put up shields to protect yourself from enemy shots. But when you have the shields up enemies shoot faster and move towards you. Try to avoid enemy shots and make them hit each other to score points.

Totoge - You control a chicken that is constantly falling down towards one of the sides of the screen. Your goal is to avoid landing on the randomly appearing spikes. Press a button to jump in the air and you will score additional points for jumping depending on the distance passed. You will turn around when you hit the sides of the screen.

Bomb Up - You are constantly falling down. Press a button to fire a bomb and press it again to explode it. Score points by destroying all the red squares within the radius of its explosion. The explosion will bounce you up and to the side and you will turn around when you hit a wall.

Tappump - You control a circle. Your goal is to move forward while avoiding hitting the mines and going beyond the horizontal borders of the screen. Press a button to jump and hold a button to increase your radius. Collect coins to score points.

title: Marshmallow Marvin: Timberfall
description: Marshmallow Marvin: Timberfall is a 2D pixel art platformer where Marvin explores the moonlit Timberfall Woods, dodging bears, owls, traps, and wild dangers while mastering precision platforming to survive the night and uncover hidden forest secrets.

title: The Adventures of Ally The Alligator
Solitaire Dreamscapes
description: Drift away into a world of cards and dreams.

title: Crafters Heaven
description: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox adventure blending survival, crafting, and exploration. Build your base, fight wild creatures, and discover an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

title: Gatekeeper's Week
description: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

title: Soul Astray
description: Jump, dash and use abilities granted by your immortal soul to outjump damnation in this challenging, yet whimsical, puzzle-precision platformer. Flex your creativity and precision as you overcome hand-crafted trials with minimal instruction.

title: 60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger
description: In the atomic wasteland there is but one god: SOUP. Run fast, jump high, and scavenge like crazy, or there will be no soup for you. Survive the dangers of the postapocalypse, bring back all the soup you can find, and become the SOUPER SCAVENGER.

title: Duncrush
description: Duncrush is a clicker RPG where you defeat monsters by clicking and conquer a variety of dungeons. Collect gold, weapons, shields, and accessories to power up your hero and create your own strategy with the skill tree. Battle stronger enemies and clear challenging dungeons!

title: Cozy Crunch
description: Crunch leaves, chase upgrades, and unleash your inner forest beast in this cozy adventure where you guide a curious cat by moving your mouse. Simple controls, satisfying progression, and autumn vibes make this the most relaxing rampage you didn’t know you needed.

title: Bleu Bayou
description: A lonesome crawdad sets out to destroy the bayou’s vicious syndicate of loan sharks and robber barons—and erase his debts once and for all.

title: NeverHome: Tower of Vanity
description: NeverHome - Tower of Vanity is the second chapter of the NeverHome horror anthology. Explore an abstract new world and use your wits to solve its mysteries and find a way out.

title: Meat Without Master
description: A failed experiment on the run. Ooze through vents, skulk in shadows, or tear through flesh—adapt, mutate, and break free.

title: Ioretin
description: Ioretin is a survival horror game inspired by the classics of Playstation 2. You are a young fisher that must save your brother stuck in sea while fighting abyssal monsters. Explore a city inspired by the real city of Rio de Janeiro and fight for survival.

title: Cattlieb
description: Pinball meets roguelike. A mysterious adventure of strategy and luck, where the path of the ball changes the battle and board events with both risks and rewards shake the player’s choices.

title: Plush Shop Simulator
description: Run your own cozy plushie shop in this management simulation game. Buy, price, and sell adorable plush toys, stationery, and mystery blind boxes!

title: Meat Room
description: Meat Room is a first-person horror survival game set in 1980s Eastern Europe. You play as Dimitry, a night shift worker at a meat packing facility. At first, everything seems normal—just another night on the job. But soon, strange things begin to happen. Something’s wrong in the Meat Room.

title: Chroam
description: Chroam is an Escape Room style adventure game, where you will be asked to try your hand at numerous and original puzzles. Explore the rooms, look for clues, solve the puzzles until you reach the flag at the top. It won't be easy!

title: Dread Not
description: Avoid your watery grave in this asymmetrical co-op horror game where you and a friend take the roles of a submarine Pilot and Mechanic. Work together to repair the ship, solve puzzles, avoid a deadly creature, and make it back to the surface before time runs out! It's time to Sync or Swim.

title: Slapstick Bosses
description: A wacky boss fighting game with a charming and unique style, where the only goal is to beat them all! Collect Bits to unlock cool cosmetics! Can you master each boss on their hardest difficultys?

title: Free Strategy Chess Game
