description: 1.It is The Strategy Chess Game. 2.All operations are performed using the left mouse button. 3.In the world map, left-click to move the character. If the character is not visible, click the second and third buttons below to locate them.

title: Jade Spring
description: Relax, potter, and build in Jade Spring, a small Guild Wars 2 decorating and homesteading fan game.

title: Japanese Love
description: Japanese Love is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Furry Tits
description: Furry Tits is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Sexy Glasses
description: Sexy Glasses is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Keykode
description: Keykode is a game where you can clear the stage by pressing the key code on the keyboard

title: Sex Dorm
description: Sex Dorm – A visual novel where you play as a student from Japan who moves to the U.S. to experience college life. Explore new cultures, build relationships, work part-time, and dive into your hidden desires in the world of university life.

title: Bonjin: An Ordinary Man
description: When your beloved wants to abandon his personality and become an absolutely ordinary person, what do you do? Bonjin ~ An Ordinary Man is an young adult romantic story about transgender identity, exploration of masculinity, and mutual understanding.

title: Kwalasha
description: Kwalasha is a turn-based tactical RPG with a roguelite soul. Recruit the most ruthless, dive into the oceanic abyss, and loot the Empire's wreckage while surviving mutant horrors and deadly decisions.

title: Line Hopper
description: In this unique game, you get to see what a two-dimensional world composed of multicolored lines looks like from the perspective of the main character, Linus. Whereas you and I see our 3D world as a series of 2D images, Linus sees his 2D world in one dimension: as a single vertical line!

title: Cube Foundry
description: Classic Incremental Gameplay: Easy to start, with a depth that will keep you hooked as you optimize your strategy. Satisfying Progression: Feel the power grow as your production numbers explode. Mastery System: Long-term rewards for your dedication and total production.

title: Bass Harrier
description: Bass Harrier is a rhythm-fueled shoot 'em up. This world is powered by the Riddim of the music—enemy spawns, environments, and even the lights shift dynamically to the stage's soundtrack. No need for prior experience—just follow the beat, dodge threats, and fire away!

title: Exterminium
description: It is a multiplayer space battle game, the human team vs. the alien team, the human team tries to avoid the Exterminium of the planets and cities by facing the aliens.

title: 100 Men vs 1 Gorilla
description: 100 Men, 1 Gorilla. Who will win? It's time to settle the debate once and for all… Drop into the ultimate 100-player online showdown and find out who really reigns supreme.

title: The Missing Part
description:
You are a man who has lost what was most important to him. In the prologue, learn all about the events that led you to the current point in your life.

Then decide for yourself how to deal with your grief. Will you find a way out of your pain, or will you trade one emptiness for another?

Meet your potential love interests who can accompany you on your way out or watch you as you continue your descent.

title: Comet Tycoon
description: Build and automate your way to cosmic riches in this satirical tycoon sim. Harvest comets, entertain space tourists, recycle the broke ones, and let COMTEC help you replace humanity… one drone at a time.

title: Turbo OutRun Reimagined
description: Pseudo-3D cannonball rally

title: The Devil Rais’d the Storm
description: The Devil rais'd the storm is a mysterious science fiction visual novel with point-and-click elements. Unravel a tense and moody story as you navigate your new role stationed at a strange outpost on a remote planet.

title: Dreadtome
description: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this short Action-Adventure FPS made by a team of third-year university students.

title: Day of the Rising Dead
description: Step into a gritty, analog film-style world where three survivors must battle their way through a planet overrun by the undead. From the dark alleys of a crumbling city to eerie forests, an abandoned military outpost, and a blood-soaked shopping mall, every step is a fight for survival.

title: Light Followers: Blinded by the Dark
description: Dive deep in a deep dark realm filled with dangerous monsters, following the path where the light leads you to.

title: Shooty Shooty Robot Invasion
description: An absurdist FPS/interactive fiction game where you murder stupid robots, chat with idiot people, and explore a painstakingly hand-drawn and highly animated world!

title: Minetic
description: An isometric turn-based roguelike game based on minecraft for the Tiny Computer engine.

title: Another Crab's Treasure: Year of the Crab
description: Year of the Crab is a free update for Another Crab’s Treasure, released on April 21, 2025, to mark the game's one-year anniversary. It introduces several new features, including: New Game +, Museum/Bestiary, Boss Rush, Sigils, New Boss Fights and more.

title: FastFly
description: FastFly is a musical rhythm game set in a space setting. Your task is to complete each level without hitting any obstacles. The spaceship flies along a spline and can rotate around it. Some obstacles need to be broken. Feel the music.

title: Old Thiess: The Werewolf’s Trial
description:
Old Thiess: The Werewolf’s Trial combines exploration, combat, and the intensity of a 2D platformer with the interactivity of a narrative game where the player's actions influence the outcome of the story.

Inspired by a historical event, the game tells the story of the trial of Old Thiess, a 17th-century Livonian peasant accused of being a werewolf by the Church and authorities. Through his testimony during the trial, relive his exploits in Hell as he battles demons and witches serving a diabolical cult to protect the villagers of Jürgensburg.

Depending on how well you perform, the villagers will either side with you or turn against you during the trial.

title: Never7: Kurumi Cure
description: Fan-made rewrite of the Kurumi Route of Never7: The End of Infinity

title: Space Quest 0: Replicated
description: A prequel to Space Quest 2, but set before Space Quest 1, it is written in AGI and uses a parser input system similar to that of Space Quest 1 and 2.

title: UVAO Forever
description: A short novel that originated from a story on the Russian imageboard IIchan. On December 29, 2007, a thread was created there where a certain Moscow anonymous user shared how they met a "certain someone"—specifically, a catgirl—at a McDonald's on Pushkinskaya and took her home to Kuzminki, located in the South-Eastern Administrative District of Moscow. The story, beloved by anons for its "warm and cozy vibe," achieved the status of a "classic copypasta," and the catgirl was nicknamed UVAO-tan, became one of the mascots, and inspired many creative works. UVAO Forever is a Christmas card-style novella that serves as a "prequel" to the original story.

title: Brainrot Kart
description: Brainrot Kart is a 1-8 player kart racing game. Race with the homies through chaotic maps like "Gooning Gateway" and "The Backrooms," and launch Hawk Tuahs at your rivals to throw them off course. Expect nonstop brainrot that’ll keep you on edge.

title: Buddies in a Ball
description: Trapped inside of a giant rolling ball, you and your friends must roll, bounce, and scream your way through diverse levels. Solo or co-op, try to beat every level in the fastest time.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Andy Bogard
description:
DLC Character 1 "ANDY BOGARD"

Human weapon. Master of Shiranui ninjutsu. This legendary South Town shinobi currently works with Mai in her clan’s village, where he helps train its youth. Now that his pupil Hokutomaru has come into his own, Andy longs for the day when the two can square up in a real bout—not only as master and apprentice, but also man-to-man. At the same time, he knows that a separate battle yet remains: A contest he has always yearned for. A man he was born to fight.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Joe Higashi
description:
Grants access to the following in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves.
- DLC character "Joe Higashi"

title: Heroes of Anirea
description: Heroes of Anirea blends turn-based tactics with roguelite progression in a character-driven strategy experience. Assemble your squad from a diverse cast of heroes, each with unique skills, and evolve your approach as new challenges arise.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Mr. Big
description: DLC Character 5 "Mr. BIG" (Scheduled for: Early 2026)

title: HellPunk: Purgatorium
description: HellPunk is a 2D action gore roguelite game. You play as the main character Asher Drake, who must help Leviathan conquer the Tower and solve the mystery of his family's vanishing.

title: Against Twilight
description: Survive the all-consuming darkness! Against Twilight is a casual game where your choices can make you stronger to finish off thousands of creatures that appear in the twilight.

title: Keep on Mining!
description: Keep on Mining! is a short incremental mining game. Mine rocks, gather material, find artifact, craft pickaxes and spend your materials on permanent upgrades inside the big skill tree!

title: Pullstation
description: Pullstation is an incremental tower defence about saving your space station from the ever-growing horde of UNKNOWN origin.

title: Hot Shot Monkey
description: Embark into a wild west themed bullet hell, where you play as Clyde, a monkey gunslinger, on a quest to defeat steampunk mechanical monstrosities, and utilize powerful weapons, and useful gear to assure you return peace to the west.

title: Whooshy Dragon
description: Play as Whooshy, an adorable little dragon. Avoid enemies, defy gravity, and go further and further to get the highest scores. With its vivid graphics, intuitive gameplay and dynamic soundtrack, Whooshy Dragon offers an adventure that's accessible to young and old alike.

title: Hill Defender
description: You’ve claimed the best spot on Earth, but invaders want it. Defend your camp from waves of enemies trying to destroy your base or throw you off the cliff. Use ballistas, catapults, and spells to stop them. Earn rewards, upgrade your defenses, and survive stronger waves. Never let your camp fall!

title: Condo
description: Condo is a short, moody experience about wandering, distracting yourself, and getting lost. Unable to sleep, you navigate a quiet condo complex. There's no rush - just you, the building, its inhabitants, and the stories they hold.

title: Last Summer at Camp Apocalypse Blood: 101 Ways to Not Capture Bigfoot
description: A surreal dark comedy visual novel about monster camp politics, childhood trauma, and a bribe-prone Bigfoot. Battle rival camp Wonderfang during what could be the last summer at Camp Apocalypse Blood!

title: Red Rust Pioneers
description:
Your story begins stranded in the unforgiving wilderness of the Wild West.

Your one goal: to survive.

Endure scorching days and freezing nights as you battle hunger, thirst, and the elements. Forage for food, hunt wildlife, and fish to stay alive. Scavenge the land to gather vital resources and craft the tools and weapons you’ll need to stand a chance in this brutal but breathtaking frontier.

Can you master the elements and withstand blistering heat, violent rainstorms and freezing cold winters?

Should you beat the odds and live, alone or with up to three friends, you’ll find yourself in a gorgeous, rugged, vibrant land. Will you be able to not only survive, but thrive?

Build and grow your camp your way with easy to use base building mechanics. Fish in the lakes and rivers, or hunt in the atmospheric woodlands and open prairies. Farm and harvest a variety of crops to establish a self-sufficient camp. Adventure high into the mountains to mine resources, and craft better weapons and tools.

Explore a beautifully realized, open world, fictionalized Wild West frontier and become the first to discover the untamed wilderness of Red Rust Valley.

If you can overcome the threat of extreme hunger, brutal weather conditions and lethal wildlife you may just live to appreciate it.

title: Giant’s Heart
description: Giant`s Heart — roguelike dungeon crawler with gardening elements. Discover powerful artifacts, make critical path choices - time is your most precious currency. A Giant marches toward the castle... You have just 5 minutes to descend into the dungeons, find and destroy its heart!

title: Flatlands
description: Animals trapped in the magical book and transformed into cards. They need to defeat the enemies in the plane world to escape! Card battles, resource management, production line construction, RTS-style free exploration.

title: FishOnMC
description: A dedicated fishing server for Minecraft.

title: Puppet Seed
description: Puppet Seed is a Sandbox CRPG created by a Solo Developer using Unreal Engine 5. Collect humanoid and monster companions from 8 races, each with their own regions, settlements and elemental affinities. Spend stat and skill points to gain new abilities for your team and player character. Mix different squad compositions in real-time combat while exploring on foot or by vehicle.

title: Hentai World Bunny
description: Hentai World Bunny is an arcade-style game where you challenge your focus and perseverance by finding and matching pairs of identical images for endless fun.

title: Liminal Lane
description: Welcome to Liminal Lane. A short, single player, first person, atmospheric walking simulator. A nostalgic, surreal experience exploring Liminal Spaces. Uncover the secrets of Liminal Lane and escape the Lucid Dreams and Haunting Nightmares.

title: Grasshopper Collection
description: Grasshopper Collection Collect more than 30+ grasshoppers and decorate your profile! Will be updated soon

title: Sugary Spire: Exhibition Night
description: Sugary Spire: Exhibition Night is the demo for the delightfully sweet platformer Sugary Spire! Help return the Painter's missing ink across 4 radical levels. Only by diving into each painting and finding their secrets will you be able to save the Exhibition Night!

title: Sky Die
description: Sky Die is a 2D brawl that drops two-to-four players from tall heights, quickly approaching the bottom. Will you be the first to reach the finish line? Or will you succumb to traps scattered around the skies?

title: Virtual Frenzy: Nexus Corps
description: Virtual Frenzy: Nexus Corps is a free-to-play card game that fuses VTuber culture with strategy. Players build VTuber teams and battle in real-time using collectible card mechanics.

title: PhantomZone SemiDeus
description: "A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times." That's what she called herself. Mysterious, bizarre biographical tales unfold in a retro-futuristic world.

title: Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover hidden secrets in a haunted medieval park! Solve puzzles, find clues, and escape a ghostly knight in this thrilling hidden object adventure.

title: Kissed by a Star
description: Embark on a journey through catastrophic disasters, supernatural horrors, and ominous occurrences in this turn-based RPG meets modern fantasy novel.

title: Lobstar: Arcade Version
description: Punch through the cosmos! An arcade-inspired shoot-em-up where you play as an immortal lobster speeding through space.

title: Stardream
description: Stardream is a story-driven investigation game set in a retro 60s-inspired space ark. As Darlene, a taxi driver turned into a reluctant investigator, uncover a hidden truth that could shatter a perfect society.

title: Echoes of Night: The Exodus of the Stars
description: In this world consumed by darkness, where aberrant creatures lurk in the shadows... Prometheus is the only hope. In this action-platformer, you must find lost star fragments and rebuild the constellations to restore light to the universe.

title: Unforgettable
description: A game about drinking and talking. After dying in a car accident, you are reborn in a bar and are greeted by the bartender. Talk to the bartender and try to understand more about your situation while enjoying a few drinks.

title: Escape Memoirs: Bank Heist
description: "Escape Memoirs: Bank Heist" is a co-operative reverse escape-room puzzle game. You are a member of a burglar gang which is planning on pulling off a bank heist. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the puzzles that stand in your way?

title: Boss, Blind, Brandy
description: A two-player game using blind and brandy glass controllers.

title: Moshi Monsters
description:
A revival of Moshi Monsters by the original developers, Mind Candy, after the 2020 closure of Flash.

Playing as one of the six original Moshi Monsters, return to a post-catastrophe Monstro City and explore the world like never before.

Complete quests, find and rescue the lost Moshlings, and help rebuild Monstro City.

title: Eighth Day Kishimoto-kun
description: Coming-of-age romance visual novel following a cynical high school student as he discovers the secret eighth day of the week.

title: SolCycle
description: Enter the 3D sci-fi world of SolCycle! Play as a robot cat archaeologist, explore a post-human community rebuilt by plant-fueled robots, and barter with the locals in card-based gameplay! Learn to navigate the citizens’ requests while under the spell of a time-loop. Don’t forget to watch the clock!

title: Delving The Depths
description: Escape imprisonment by delving into the caverns below your cell and exploring until your group reaches the surface in this first-person grid-based dungeon crawler.

title: Ever War
description: Ever War is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. This game combines empire-building, resource management and large-scale tactical turn-based battles.

title: Blade and Madness
description: Blade and Madness, a roguelite deckbuilder where turns play out simultaneously and every choice matters. As madness creeps in, your cards change, the battlefield twists, and enemies grow more unpredictable. Adaptation isn’t optional, it’s the only way to survive… or give in to the dark.

title: Blood Soaked Bastard!
description: Blood Soaked Bastard! Is an RPG set in a dreary medieval fantasy setting. Become a much abhorred Blood Knight and kill monsters in turn based combat, alongside a cast of freakish companions. Draw the blood of wretched monsters, you Bastard!

title: Lucid Blocks
description: Explore, build, and survive in a liminal voxel expanse oozing with surreal landscapes and esoteric critters.

title: The Prophecy of Horn
description: Defeat the legions of darkness and kill their ruler, the Demon God Horn. The game tells the story of the feat of three heroes in a dark flexible world in an RPG with an original hybrid turn-based combat system and other well-known game mechanics.

title: Anima Mundi
description: Welcome to Anima mundi! Build an ecosystem, populate your planet, & immerse in the lives of its creatures as they grow and evolve. Each planet holds unique species. Will you be able to uncover the mysteries of each one?

title: MassEve
description: The quantum world is on the edge of revolution, and only neutrinos can shift its fate. Mass-Eve is a fast-paced roguelike twin-stick shooter diving deep into the mysteries of modern physics. The future of the universe depends on your choices, are you ready to reshape it?

title: Mascot Mayhem
description: Mascot Mayhem is a 4-player local multiplayer brawling game with zany fighters and ultra powerful Mayhem attacks. Fill the screen with Mayhem and have a party! Easy to learn with simple controls, meaning anyone can join in on the fun.

title: Steam & Clicks
description: Build, upgrade, and fight! In a steampunk world overrun by the undead, Rose Mary uses her workshop to craft weapons and armor in this strategic clicker. Forge powerful gear and face turn-based battles to save her city!

title: Lost Galaxy: Echoes of War
description: Build. Defend. Survive. Expand. A sci-fi base-building game on a hostile alien world. Gather resources, build a sprawling high-tech colony, and defend against relentless alien threats—then unlock new planets, new challenges, and the secrets of humanity’s last frontier.

title: The Night Is Long
description: The Night Is Long is a short first-person horror game where a grieving man follows a ghostly vision into an abandoned mansion. Uncover dark secrets, survive atmospheric horrors, and face your past through exploration, puzzles, and subtle scares.

title: The Roast: Coffee Shop Simulator
description: Enjoy the thrill of managing your own coffee shop! Fill the counter with coffee beans, craft your menu and set prices to your liking, take customer orders, and whip up tasty coffees. Decorate and expand your shop.

title: Deep Space Corridor
description: In a mysterious space station, you, as a tester, will inspect designated areas to determine if everything is normal. If you detect any anomalies, do your utmost to reach the correct door.

title: Lekker Weertje Koekepeertje: Lente
description: Play, sing, and listen your way through spring and get to know the village, the house, and the garden of Iris and Michiel. Based on the books by Carry Slee and Dagmar Stam.

title: Paper Bleed
description: Paper Bleed is a creepy and grotesque point-and-click adventure, made with a raw art style and disturbingly gory hand-drawn animations. You find yourself in a horrible yet familiar place, facing your deepest fears and darkest thoughts. Nothing really dies here and you are all alone...

title: Voodoo Fishin'
description: Voodoo Fishin is an online co-op horror game featuring fishing, proximity voice, and scary monsters. You and up to 3 friends can venture into the swamp to find the best fishing spots holding the rarest fish. BEWARE: Die along the way, and you will lose your catch!

title: Marquee Candle
description: While avoiding the attacks of ghosts in the space, let's regain the story of important memories of the past and another person.

title: In Hope Voiden
description: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

title: Berserker's Domain
description: BERSERKER'S DOMAIN is a fast-paced, unhinged retro FPS freakshow with a roguelike loop, inspired by classics like Blood, Quake 1-3, and Doom, as well as modern shooters like Dusk, ULTRAKILL, and Doom Eternal.

title: Veil of Ashes
description: Veil of Ashes is a real-time strategy game set in a dark universe with steam-powered war machines. Command infantry, tanks, and colossal behemoths across destructible battlefields. Build your army from a variety of units, and experience immersive single-player and multiplayer battles.

title: Brain Hack Squad
description: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

title: Lady Dracula
description: An evolution of the Classicvania genre and a return to the glory days of precision platforming, retro challenge and gothic atmosphere. Transform yourself into a wraith, a spider and a bat to fly, climb and blast your way across Transylvania to do battle with Lady Dracula at her castle keep.

title: Dead by Daylight: Five Nights at Freddy's
description: Dead by Daylight's Five Nights at Freddy's includes a new Killer, Springtrap. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Stack of Pizzas badge and the Vent Crawl banner.

title: Someone Knocks The Door
description:
A crazy man has escaped the asylum.
Police warns you not to let anyone in.
Someone knocks the door.

This is a very short horror game made in 1 day for the Rhomita Game Jam.

title: Nightfall Cafe
description: Ana only needs six seeds from the depths of the forest. That’s all. Then she can go home.

title: The Odyssey of Commander Cookie
description: Take command of the PSS, Paw Space Squadron, and catfight your way through relentless swarms of cybermice. Scavenge their tech. Upgrade your ship and weapons and unlock a fleet of fellow cat heroes, as you claw your way to victory in this intense roguelite twin-stick shooter.

title: Beholgar II
description: The barbarian warrior Beholgar returns — and this time, his enemies are otherworldly! Deep beneath the earth, the mighty Djinn King stirs. To prevent his rise and save the world from eternal darkness, Beholgar embarks on a quest for a legendary, ancient sword.

title: Astro Burn
description: A retro-inspired, side-scrolling bullet hell shoot-’em-up, where you play as a feline space pilot blasting through waves of strange machines to uncover Earth’s mysterious downfall.

title: Travis, the Frog
description: travis, the frog is a lightning fast speedrunning platformer in which you are a frog on a skateboard.

title: This Game is Ground Breaking
description: This Game is Ground Breaking - aims to bring back the fun of wanting to smash your friend in the head with a controller!

title: Electoral Carnage
description: Electoral Carnage is an absurd 2D fighting game featuring America's most famous (and infamous) politicians. If you don't download it you hate America. Also JFK can assassinate himself. What more do you need to know?

title: Kingless Dungeon
description: 《Kingless Dungeon》 is a 2D hack and slash platformer where you control the Shadow Prince, a warrior with no memory. Fight undead enemies, discover your skills, and explore this deep dungeons filled with traps and secrets. Can you reclaim your memories and escape?

title: Narb Fortunii
description: Narb Fortunii is a short, story driven adventure. Move through the environment and read the characters dialogue while you enjoy the music. Complete a platforming challenge to reach the final conversation of this whimsical adventure.

title: Craball
description: Bop the ball. Collect coins. Don't let it touch the ground! Easy to play. Hard to play well. (This game is deceptively difficult. You've been warned.)

title: Mr. Photographer: Into The Light
description: Dive into the captivating world of "Mr. Photographer - Into the Light", an action-packed platformer where every moment challenges your wit, strategy, and skill. With no paywalls or in-game purchases, this is a pure test of talent, patience, and wisdom. Every game is a fresh start, and every adventure demands a unique approach. Are you ready to rise from an intern to a master photographer?

title: Ending the Happy Route
description: A visual novel depicting a protagonist who desperately struggles to change their fate of despair.

title: Alterna Vvelt: Blue Exorcist Another Story
description:
Show me... Show me a new story only you can create.

Experience the world of the popular dark fantasy Blue Exorcist in a brand-new 3D Action RPG!
Become an Exorcist and explore True Cross Academy Town!
So, what do you think? Care to take a journey?

title: Lordship
description: Lordship is a turn-based 4x strategy where your objective is to be the first to obtain the set victory points (Fame). Explore, find treasure, build and expand cities, battle creeps and opponents, and interact with various objects on the map that automatically resolve.

title: Care of Gongon
description:
Enter Gongon’s Daycare in search of your missing child. As the child's mother, you must explore the abandoned establishment and uncover the secrets within. But be wary, as you are not alone, and you are not safe.

Gongon and Friends:

Gongon’s Daycare is one of the best daycares in the world thanks to Gongon and Friends. They ensure that every child who attends this daycare is safe and sound, and that nobody ever feels lonely!

Gongon’s Daycare, the best daycare ever built:

Gongon’s Daycare was once an immensely popular daycare for children, filled to the brim with children from all over… until one fateful day. Everyone within the place vanished on what seemed to be a normal day, and you must find out what happened

title: Schedule I: Mafia Empire
description: Every second a choice. Every choice a consequence.

title: Cozy Gardener Simulator
description: Cozy Gardener Simulator - a peaceful life where every flower you plant brings joy. Clean streets, grow gardens, help neighbors, and create beauty one task at a time. No stress, just cozy vibes.

title: House Renovator Simulator
description: Every broken house deserves a second chance – build your dream home.

title: Sleepy Meadow
description: Wander, unwind, and let the meadow carry you away.

title: Reply All
description: A single-player roguelike deck builder, where email is turn-based combat. Use your cards to compose emails, create combos, and defeat the hordes of middle managers. Climb the corporate ranks by building your deck and strategically navigating your calendar to uncover the corporate conspiracies.

title: Tumbles
description:
Tumbles (Previously Silk Soar) is a Physics Flinging, Rage-Bringing Narrative 2D Platformer (Foddian), where you take on life as a newborn caterpillar attempting to meet the challenges of flinging yourself from the rainforest floor to the top of the canopy.

Launch your caterpillar around using a catapult-like motion to bounce off walls and flowers, be pushed by the wind, slide across wet leaves and avoid obstacles.

As you reach higher into the canopy, you will face more difficult jumps and a variety of obstacles to go further through the layers of the rainforest in search of the top of the canopy.

Explore the poetic narrative of the struggles of reaching from the depths of darkness in search of freedom and light.

Each time you choose to build your cocoon there is an increasing chance of evolutions affecting your next caterpillar. Will you be a different colour, have a more bouncy body, or have tunnel vision? What combinations will you have and will they help or hinder your next climb?

In Tumbles, every climb can bring you further through the climb you have faced before or challenge you with a combination of evolutions. Will you make it out from the forest floor and into the light or will this climb be cut short as another cocoon in the darkness?

Can you make it to freedom?

title: Bam Bam Boom
description: Fight your way to glory in this intense platform fighter. Master the manoeuvres of a unique roster of characters and utilise strategies to strike your opponent like Bam. Bam. Boom!

title: Blood Oath
description: BloodOath is a Souls-like game in a world ruled by enslaving gods. You play as a martial arts master, trained since childhood, who vows to save humanity. Battle god-forged monsters across your journey. Master skills, wield diverse weapons, and destroy all foes. Achieve deicide to liberate the world.

title: Chainer
description: Chainer is a 2D action game in which heroines "Yua" and "Maki" cooperate to reach the goal using the technique "Chain" that throws a partner forward.

title: Hidden Cats in Rio de Janeiro
description: The Hidden Cats continue their world trip and have now arrived in RIO! So let's search for them again. A cozy and relaxing experience to enjoy with your friends and family! Start with a beautiful monochromatic scene, relax, and find all the cats to reveal the final colored art.

title: Logistical 3: Portugal
description: LOGistICAL 3 - Portugal is a DLC for LOGistICAL 3, taking you on a strategic journey across Portugal. Solve puzzles, fix complex road systems, and upgrade industries as you transport cargo through cities and islands. Tackle new challenges in this historically rich and diverse landscape!

title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma - Sakuna DLC
description: Invite Princess Sakuna and Tama from Sakuna: Of Rice of Ruin to the lands of Azuma with this free DLC!

title: Cipheur: Uncommon Words 2
description: A pack of 100 uncommon words with their definitions.

title: Leaving Home
description:
An adventure filled with quirky challenges, surreal surprises and moody tunes...

It’s 7:00 AM, the alarm rings. Some mornings feel heavier than others...

From puzzle maestro Bart Bonte comes a point-and-click adventure filled with quirky challenges, surreal surprises and moody tunes.

Undo the knots in your mind, one click at a time...

title: Doomvile Brainrot
description: In this game, the player collects wood, energy, metal and a good mood to build buildings, fight off creatures and save resources for the portal

title: Sweetland Slumber Party
description: Ready, Set, Slumberparty! Play as one of the many pajama-clad characters as they try to wake up on time for school!

title: Comfort and Warmth
description: A sweet and spicy 18+ otome VN, exploring the appeal of a caring partner.

title: Steel Swarm: Invasion
description: SSI is a visceral, story-driven action RPG. Tear through swarms in a destructible world, switching between brutal on-foot combat and devastating vehicle warfare. Construct and upgrade your war machine. Master an innovative character system. Explore a war-torn world, uncovering its secrets.

title: Astro Protocol
description: Space strategy in a nutshell. Astro Protocol is a fast-paced space 4X where each run takes 1 to 2 hours. Explore the galaxy, colonize new worlds, research powerful technologies and command deadly fleets. No diplomacy, pure conquest. Turn based strategy at its core.

title: Nested
description: Nested is a cute grid-based puzzle game made around the concept of russian nesting dolls. Come twist your brain as you stack, push and interact with the various objects you'll find in each levels. Let's see if you can reach the right combination of nesting dolls to solve every one of them!

title: Unlockers
description: Noah wakes up to find himself in an unknown hotel-like bedroom. Team up with Sally, a girl with supernatural powers, to solve the mystery of the room and escape from this strange facility!

title: Unknown: Foggins
description: Unknown - Foggins is a mystery game that combines puzzle-solving, adventure, and point-and-click elements. Follow an main storyline in pursuit of a hidden truth and interact with distinctive NPCs and uncover the secrets behind their mysterious stories.

title: Friend of a Slime
description: Friend of a Slime is a horde survivor game in which your best weapon is your slime companion. Fight against hordes of enemies in short 10-minute dungeons, collect coins and fruits to unlock new weapons and purchase powerful artifacts for yourself and your slime companion.

title: KiSS Kisekae Set System
description: KiSS, the Kisekae Set system, is a fun and easy paper doll game for computer users. KiSS takes its name from the Japanese term kisekae ningyou which refers to playing dress-up with dolls.

title: CipherMind
description: Explore the eerie ruins, complete missions to obtain clues, deduce one's own and others' identities, and finally escape.

title: Yolo Space Hacker 2: Mission Bahamas
description: Alternate between infiltration and hacking of cameras and servers, using real tools. Sharpen your OSInt skills, prepare a trojan, and launch a targeted phishing attack to hack in total discretion...

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EGCC Airport
description: Manchester Airport (IATA: MAN, ICAO: EGCC); Major airport in the UK, 4th busiest in terms of passenger numbers and the busiest airport in the UK, located at Ringway in the City of Manchester within Greater Manchester, UK developed for Tower! Simulator 3.

title: Biodetention
description: BIODETENTION is a VR stealth-adventure where you sneak, solve, and survive. Outsmart monsters using environmental traps, free fellow captives, and explore an eerie underground facility in a tense, story-driven escape experience—no jump scares.

title: Voden's Job
description: Voden's Job is a small roguelike deckbuilding game where you have 7 rounds of experiments to collect enough DNA to evolve your specimen. Between each experiment, you can upgrade your deck with new cards, combos, and strange tools. The catch? Upgrading costs DNA, so you'll need to carefully balance how much you're willing to spend each round.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: Money Fronts
description: Work your way into the good graces of an elusive underground financier managing wealth for a network of high-value clients. Set up your front at the Hands On Car Wash in Strawberry, then branch out legitimate local businesses masking a web of laundering schemes.

title: Lottery vs. Aliens
description: Lottery vs Aliens is a highscore deckbuilder about winning lottery money to pay for defense satellites against aggressive aliens. You can manipulate the machine and every ball to skyrocket the output. This game contains neither real-world money nor any microtransactions.

title: Xeno Swarm
description: "Xeno Swarm" is a hardcore side-scrolling shoot-'em-up game. Team up with your allies to battle overwhelming swarms of alien creatures, engage in life-or-death showdowns with colossal bosses on extraterrestrial battlefields, and relive the exhilarating thrill of bullet-hell mayhem!

title: Automon Arena
description: Capture creatures with trash bags and scrap your way to the top! Automon Arena is a fast auto-battler where you bag wild animals and fight other kids until only one survives!

title: Pocket Dictator
description: Pocket Dictator is a first-person puzzle game set in a distant future. An abandoned prison is inhabited by many robots. Friendly and not so much.

title: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs
description: Sobakistan — the land of dogs, is a darkly satirical narrative immersion in a closed-off totalitarian dog state — where any step could send you to prison. Deep story, choices with consequences, bureaucratic card battles, text-based soulslike.

title: Lab LVL
description: LAB LVL is a sci-fi horror adventure where you, as agent Flywheel, must rescue a girl from a frozen capsule using science in a laboratory while trying to survive on Earth-3's orbital station against relentless attacks from the "Ancients," who have hunted her for generations.

title: Onomatopeya
description: Onomatopeya is a puzzle game where you will discover the fun side of Japanese onomatopoeia while managing a strange little shop.

title: Skull Horde
description: Skull Horde is an auto battler dungeon crawler where you play as a flying skull necromancer. Find powerful loot and create overpowered builds. Summon a horde of skeletons in a battle of bone versus flesh!

title: Triumph! War 2099
description: Triumph! WAR 2099 is a game of full-scale army vs army warfare. But this time man vs alien. Triumph! is a different than normal combat game, in the sense that your army does most of the grunt work. Instead of taking on the whole army single-handed, you must concentrate on gathering reinforcements, staying alive and taking on enemies in a more strategic method.

title: Yume Nikki Online Project
description: Yume Nikki Online Project is a project that aims to make the original Yume Nikki, and several of its fangames have an ability to play in multiplayer. It is achieved via EasyRPG engine.

title: 7 Jobs at the Same Time
description: A Point and Click work simulator where you juggle 7 jobs to pay your debt. Start by doing simple spreadsheet and progress to more important job like overseeing a nuclear bomb.

title: Polyrose
description: A rotation puzzle game. You rotate cubes to connect colors.

title: The Bunny Graveyard II
description: Help Skye the Bunny find her lost brother Claudio in this action-packed horror adventure with charming pixel graphics. Hop like a bunny and get ready to explore the haunted streets of Carrot Town!

title: Desire For Power: Council Intrigues
description: A text-based, choice-driven adventure. Intrigue, trust, loyalty, luck, reflex... How high a position can you achieve in this medieval world?

title: Joe Adventure
description: Keep moving or explode! Control multiple Joes to solve puzzles in order to save your siblings and Joe Mama from the grasps of the food factory!

title: Care of Gongon: Chapter 2
description: After the events of Chapter 1, you are stuck below the surface of Gongon's Daycare. You must continue through the dark corridors in search of your missing child. This time, however, the monsters are even more dangerous than before...

title: Unreturning
description: An adventure where the journey matters more than the destination. Everyone who ventures into the depths always returns... but what if this time was different? Descend into the abyss, uncover its secrets, and make your journey unforgettable.

title: Drop Point
description: Open-world survival PvPvE game that caters to a variety of playstyles. Whether you're a farmer, a fearless bandit, or a resourceful survivor, the game's sandbox environment gives you the freedom to forge your own path. It's a blend of open-world exploration, survival, RPG, military-sim, action, looters, shooters, and farming elements

title: Tuoni
description: A turn-based roguelite RPG set in a mythic northern wilderness. Explore procedurally generated lands, battle eerie folkloric creatures, and craft powerful builds on your journey to the land of the dead. Experiment with diverse playstyles in a richly tactical, old-school inspired adventure.

title: Scorchwalkers
description: Pilot your own Scorchwalker in this deck-building roguelite adventure! Choose your own destiny as you pick which comrades to save, which cards to craft, which Kaijus to battle, and ultimately, which path to take.

title: Veil: Mirages
description: Veil: Mirages is a short, dreamlike experience that blends psychological horror with an introspective narrative and philosophical themes. Chase, a 19 year old boy in search of meaning, is haunted by memories of what he once had. Will he overcome his internal struggles, opening the door to reconciliation?

title: Autothysis
description: Autothysis is a first-person tower defense game where strategy meets precision. Deploy turrets, manage resources, and fight swarms of insectoid enemies. Target weak points to shatter foes while upgrading defenses to survive escalating waves. Can you withstand the oncoming horde?

title: Summoners War: Rush
description:
Strategic Defense meets Convenient Idle Growth!
Enjoy the unique experience of both genres in Summoners War: Rush!ios

Collect Monsters from the Summoners War universe, beloved by over 230 million fans around the world!

Watch your Monsters grow, even when offline.
Building powerful decks has never been easier!

title: Re:Memento - White Shadow: When the Cadella Blooms Again
description:
Version 1.4 of ReMemento - White Shadow has been released, which includes:
• New Nemonics (characters)
• New skins
• New main story quest: "When the Cadella Blooms Again"
• New limited-time events
• Shop renewal
• Global servers opened
• Supported languages added
• ...and more!

title: Battle Shadow Arena
description: A skill-based 1v1 action game where you combine weapons and elements to build custom combos and take on ever-stronger bosses in your own style.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - For the Sun is Set to Die
description:
Version 3.4 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Phainon, Saber, and Archer
• New Trailblaze Mission: "For the Sun is Set to Die"
• New areas: Aedes Elysiae
• New collaboration-themed event
• ...and more!

title: Poker Adventurers
description: Forge permanent combos and conquer freely! Build outrageous poker hands × insane multipliers to defeat each realm's Guardian. Collect Mythic Fantasy Joker cards as loot and blast through psychedelic dimensions. — Dive in now and rack up sky-high scores on your thrilling journey!

title: ScreeIn
description: ScreeIn is a psychological horror experience about isolation, memory, and self-deception — a fragmented journey into a mind on the edge.

title: Dealer's Choice
description: Dealer's Choice is a cross-platform, networked multiplayer poker game that supports various draw and stud variants, including optional wild cards. The deal rotates between players, and each new game allows a different player to choose the variant.

title: That Sausage Museum Game
description: Flip-flop, roll and fling your way through a wacky art museum as a clumsy sausage on the run. Dodge weird obstacles, pull off ridiculous stunts, and try not to fall all the way down as you escape.

title: Yukiko no Kuni
description:
The story takes place in a picturesque provincial town, where a series of mysterious incidents begin to unfold.

A young girl’s ghost climbing onto rooftops every night.
Foxfire flickering in the shrine.
A demon lurking in the mountain pass, luring people in.
Disappearances tied to a fifty-year-old mystery.
All these mysteries converge into a single message:

“Let’s solve all these mysteries together!”

Join Haruta, a boy from Tokyo, and Yukiko, a tengu girl, in this heartwarming coming-of-age love comedy mixed with small-town mystery!

The coming winter will be their last.
This is the story of a boy and a girl, racing through their final moments together, living vividly in the present.

title: Servant of the Lake
description: Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

title: Nobunaga Shinsen
description:
"Nobunaga Shinsen" is a brand new work created by the production team of "
Sangokushi Tactics" authorized by "Nobunaga's Ambition: New Life".
In the game, you can experience the strategic confrontation of the Warring States Period, which brings you a more extreme strategic experience and rich and interesting personal development gameplay. You will play the role of the lord of a city in the Japanese Warring States Period when many heroes emerged, practice personal abilities, form the strongest retainers, and create a force with friends... until the world is full of military power and the troubled times end!

title: StarSavior
description: When stars begin to fade, a new RPG arises to nurture the light to shine the cosmos once more. StarSavior: Guide your Saviors through the star-kissed Journey.

title: Hayate the Battle: Hyper Real Battle Action
description: Hayate the Battle is a fighting game released in Japan for the NEC PC9801. The Game is set in the same universe and features the characters from Jikū Sōsakan: Hayate

title: Jikuu Sasatsukan Hayate: Inspector
description:
In the future, after the latest World War, various nations of the Earth joined forces and built a super-powerful computer knows as "Juno", which would be able to preserve peace and to help scientists in their researches. Every four years, a fighting tournament is held by the company that built the computer. The rules of the tournament are strange: female fighters who lose agree to perform services of sexual nature. The Time and Space Investigation office decides to find out what really happens there, and sends a young employee named Hayate to participate in the tournament...
Jikuu Sasatsukan Hayate: Inspector is a one-on-one fighting game. There is an exercise mode, but it only allows to fight one opponent on an easier difficulty level. In the "normal mode", the difficulty is higher, and all the fights are dictated by the story; it's impossible to choose player-controlled fighters, opponents, scenario, etc. Every battle has just one round. The fighters can use various punches and kicks, jump, and execute powerful special attacks, which deplete their "spirit bars". Scenes with nudity appear between the fights.

title: Marmot Fight Club
description: Be the champion of Marmot Island!

title: Log Away
description: Build a cozy cabin that feels like home. Travel to peaceful Retreats in changing seasons and weather, decorate at your own pace, and collect Keepsakes with gentle backstories. No grind. No pressure. Just nature, animals, and time to breathe.

title: I Commissioned Some Dogs 5
description: I paid more artists to hide dogs and bones in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: RavenStar
description: RavenStar is a mini-metroidvania where making friends unlocks new abilities! Discover hidden secrets, traverse an interconnected world, and cultivate friendships with a charming cast of characters in this heartfelt platformer.

title: The Prior Challenge
description:
Prove that you are ready for the real challenges by solving this game first.
You have been studying all night for a big test. When it is time to leave to take the test you find out that you are locked in the library.
In this casual point-and-click adventure you need to find and solve a series of puzzles to find the key to escape the library.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

Get to know the escape room games of Esciri with this teaser escape room. The Prior Challenge takes place before “the Magician’s Challenge” and “the Knight’s Challenge”.

title: Aeternum Grand Plaza
description:
Aeternum Grand Plaza is an anomaly-seeking game set in a hotel with different scenarios and inspired by "The Exit 8". In this game, the player must progress through the various floors of the hotel, trying to reach the exit while observing the details of the hallways they walk through, looking for strange elements that might indicate it’s not the correct hallway.
The procedure is simple: if the hallway contains no anomalies, the player must continue forward to advance through the floors. But if the hallway contains strange elements, you must turn back and keep ascending floors to try to reach the exit.

title: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek
description: Enter the chilling world of Goosebumps in Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek! Unravel eerie mysteries, confront sinister monsters, and navigate haunted locations inspired by R.L. Stine’s legendary books —all while experiencing the Goosebumps signature blend of spooky adventure and playful twists

title: Tsarevna: Age of Tales
description:
Third-person action-adventure game centered on ballet-inspired hack-and-slash combat in a dark fantasy world based on Slavic folklore. Players control Swan, chaining melee combos, building combat ranks, dodging attacks, and using a transforming magical weapon alongside special dances that can heal, control enemies, or alter the flow of battle.

The game combines boss encounters and exploration across locations such as the island of Buyan and the realm of Iriy, with environments and creatures inspired by Slavic myths and fairy tales. Swan is accompanied by Cat Bayun, who can participate in tag-team attacks.

title: Mythic Manor
description: Mythic Manor is a free interactive visual novel game that offers stimulating new experiences set in an explorable modern fantasy world. Delve deep into your fantasies and experience the day-to-day life of sharing a manor with six gorgeous “mythic girls”.

title: Potato Cop
description: An action game, where you avoid flying projectiles like spring onions. Get ready to smash your keyboard whilst you peel potatoes over and over.

title: Hollow Host
description: Hollow Host is a horror game with roguelike elements where you are chased by an intelligent creature. Explore the dangerous hellscape, control corpses with special abilities and do try escaping damnation.

title: Pocket Lint
description: A deceptively hard little game of deduction. I’m now thinking of a specific combination of pocket items. If I give you hints about what you’ve got wrong, can you guess it in as few guesses as possible?

title: Yeti Ski
description: Old-school snow sports inspired by SkiFree. Have fun on the slopes, but watch out for the yeti!

title: Double Barrel Desperado
description: Double Barrel Desperado is a roguelike deckbuilder where you wield a double-barrel shotgun fueled by chance. Strengthen it with powerful synergies to unleash devastating blasts, mowing down ever-tougher enemies with a single, well-aimed shot.

title: Ars Demonium Invocatum
description: The greatest book on demonology has fallen into your hands. Decipher the secret names of demons and subjugate them to your will.

title: Misty Puzzle
description: Misty Puzzle is a Serene Mind-Bending Puzzle Experience

title: Static Memory
description: Haruto, a 28-year-old reporter, hires a special team to solve his sister’s death from 9 years ago. But after his father dies mysteriously, he suspects both cases are connected. Explore a haunted mansion, uncover the truth, and face the past in Static Memory.

title: Turn Back The Powers Of Darkness
description: This game is an action oriented 3D fighting and shooting game. Players need to eliminate terrorists within a specified time frame, which belongs to the team death competition game mode. The team that destroys the most enemies wins. This game is a challenging third person shooter game.

title: Money Theft 2: Heist
description: Terlander gangster is back. He needs more money and he has 6 places to rob money and avoid enemies like zombies and soldiers

title: Archon Soul
description: Roll the dice but make your own luck in this 2D dicebuilding roguelike. Customize your dice using swappable faces, runes, and bodies with unique effects. ​Draft spells, create powerful synergies, defeat challenging enemies, and conquer the Archon's palace.

title: Butter Side Down
description: Butter Side Down is a bizarro choose-your-own-choice game. Starring Basil Bonser, Adam Spargo, Grey Michael, Beatrice, Jeep Johnson, and Rotten Ruggerio. Answer questions, take calls, play card games, and solve one hell of a mystery.

title: Simpwalk
description: A very short, 2D side-scroller collect-a-thon game that lets you play as the cute HOLORO mascots!

title: Do Not Disturb
description: A short horror walking simulator where you traverse through the endless hallways of a strange hotel, searching for a way out.

title: Ascension of the Dead
description: Kick, yeet, and explode your way through undead chaos in this fast-paced zombie shooter with brutal physics and over-the-top action.

title: Order: The New Dawn
description: Order: The New Dawn is a colony sim with space adventure. As a legendary captain from the United Stellar, build a base on the desert planet New Terra and face the perils of the Wastespace—how will you shape the destiny of the stars?

title: Mommy’s Slipper
description: You can run, you can hide… but you can't dodge Mommy's slipper. A hilarious stealth-escape game where one wrong move ends in a bonk!

title: A-kun to Matsuri no Mukou
description: There's a strange legend at this school. One day, our protagonist went astray in the world they spoke of. You will meet both humans and monsters in this world. While the protagonist gets mixed up in the story, he remembers what he lost and regains it. A traditionally japanese-styled horror fantasy that takes place in a school. A bromance kind of story. The game takes around 7 hours to play.

title: Chaos Zero Nightmare
description: Chaos Zero Nightmare is a cosmic loop RPG. The official has announced that Chaos Zero Nightmare will come to us soon. Some glimpses of character animations were shown in the teaser, evoking a similar 2D art and animation style to Epic Seven.

title: Gunjou no Sora wo Koete
description:
You start off as Yashiro, one of the two first rank students in a flight combat school maintained by the army. Japan is split into two factions and the situation is tense, with small battles being held here and there.
His father was the one who caused the entire splitting up and tense situation, with the proposal of some yen economic plan.
Life isn’t exactly as easy as normal school life over there, with it’s hardcore training. Still, he still manages to talk with friends and just act like a somewhat normal guy of his age should act.
But things never go right. Rumors have that a war is starting. That means he’ll have to go out to the frontlines as a pilot killing people. Can he save what his father has caused or can he even survive till the end of the war?

title: Entering Host
description: Take control of a robotic parasite caught in a massive conflict between man and machine. Use its unique abilities to solve challenging puzzles and outsmart dangerous enemies in this bug-infested platformer.

title: The Evil Inside
description: A single player Horror adventure, asks you to enter various haunted locations and face evil creatures. Using just your lantern, you will face peril in every room and around every corner to complete your task.

title: CosmoKnytes
description: After his ship breaks down, Cosmonaut RWN-043 is forced to explore a new, unknown world with numerous creatures. Fortunately, he is met with many others who crashed into the planet, who help him with his journey.

title: Kiloton: Black Company
description: Run a mercenary company scrounging for scraps, unearth manmade horrors, and try not to die or worse -- get fired!

title: Hide From Papaku
description: Can you keep your cool, solve the puzzles, and make your escape? Or will you fall to fear and be captured? Papaku is already listening… can you escape before it's too late? Download now and face the challenge of Hide from Papaku!

title: Mayday Trials
description: A short psychological thriller visual novel where you guide Sora through twisted interrogations, moral dilemmas, and unraveling memories...

title: Blightspire
description: Blightspire is a fast-paced, wave-based survival shooter. Battle through a cursed graveyard as undead abominations rise in endless waves. With only your reflexes and firepower, survive the darkness in a world where death is never the end.

title: Protect the Hangar: From Zombies
description: Survive the undead apocalypse in this fast-paced first-person shooter where every bullet counts and every second could be your last.

title: Luck and Fear
description: A tense survival horror game where you must explore a dark, ever-changing hotel, solve puzzles, and evade a relentless killer. Every playthrough is unique, with randomized environments and unpredictable dangers.

title: Fear Night Tales: Brothers Kebab Saloon
description: You are the person who looks after the kebab shop because your brother is sick. You learn how to make kebabs and get to know the customers. But there seems to be something strange here...

title: Bloodrise
description: Face nightmarish demons and zombies in a randomly generated, blood-soaked asylum. As a roguelike shooter, you'll fight through relentless hordes, using firearms to find the key to the next floor. Explore the terrifying environment for money, and earn more by defeating enemies.

title: The House Below
description: The House Below is a first-person psychological horror game where you navigate dark, shifting corridors with no weapons or clear escape. Tension builds through eerie sounds, subtle puzzles, and unsettling surprises, as you unravel a haunting story told entirely through the environment.

title: Bodypanic
description: In BodyPanic, survive in an abandoned house with friends or alone. Every night you will be attacked by unique monsters and you will have to find different strategies to fight them. Learn from mistakes, adapt to situations and immerse yourself in the creepy atmosphere.

title: Station 0
description: Deep beneath Riyadh lies a forgotten metro station hiding terrifying anomalies. Explore, document, and survive a psychological horror experience that blurs the line between reality and illusion. Welcome to Station 0.

title: Combo Overload
description: Fight enemies and upgrade yourself in Combo Overload, a short incremental game, with a huge skill tree. After becoming strong enough you'll unlock the combo. Are you able to overload your combo?

title: Finding Annie
description: A Open-World based Horror game in a deserted world where a small girl named Annie is missing, you need to find her and be careful not to trigger teleportation that moves her elsewhere, and have to search for her again in location you had left. it is a FPS game that has scary figures and monsters.

title: Deep Hell
description: Immerse yourself in a dark dense forest in which terrible inexplicable things happen. You will have to find the missing people's belongings by following the coordinates left in the notes of the missing brother. Someone or something lives in the forest and changes everyone who goes there.

title: Nightfall Secrets
description: Nightfall Secrets is a 4v1 co-op horror game where up to 4 players must complete randomized objectives and escape—while being hunted by an AI-controlled supernatural entity that reacts to sound. Every match is a tense battle of strategy, stealth, and survival.

title: Don't Breathe In!
description: "Don't Breathe In" is a psychological horror game where you must survive in an abandoned laboratory. Solve puzzles, find an escape route, and be careful—every breath you take brings you closer to death in a toxic gas-filled environment. ✔ Horror & Thriller | ✔ Puzzle & Exploration | ✔ Survival

title: Forsaken Manor
description: Forsaken Manor is an exhilarating 3D horror game where you must explore an abandoned and grim house filled with secrets and dangers. Your task is to find all the key items hidden in the dark corners of this sinister place to unveil its dark secrets and survive.

title: One Day at a Time
description: This is a short 3 level horror game made by one person.

title: OopsFixers Company
description: OopsFixers Company is a cooperative action game for up to 4 players where you work in a team to fix extreme situations that other companies avoid. Control unique characters. Collaborate with your teammates. Improve your team to be ready for the impossible.

title: Agnostiko VS
description: the sequel to Agnostiko ORIGINS in fighting game pinoy style fighting game, with user friendly controls for beginners

title: Ayala: Forgotten Realms
description: Awakened by a mysterious light, Yang is thrust into a relentless adventure through mysterious realms. Confront monstrous foes and colossal bosses in this thrilling hack-and-slash adventure.

title: Cozy Cove
description: Uncover the Secrets of a Lost Pirate Paradise

title: Flower Shop: The Complete Story
description: ~ Flower Shop: Summer In Fairbrook + Flower Shop: Winter In Fairbrook ~

title: Pro Blackjack
description: Master the table. Beat the dealer. Play like a pro.

title: Hentai Games Collection Vol. 1
description: Three stories. Three secrets. One unforgettable bundle.

title: Pro Roulette
description: Spin the Wheel. Feel the Thrill.

title: The Original Moorhuhn Hunt
description: Celebrate 25 years of The Original Moorhuhn Hunt! Play the iconic game that started it all and unlock the classic Moorhuhn Remake as a bonus.

title: Maze of Perdition
description: Survive in a cursed island filled with dangers and mysteries. Face various shadowy creatures, fight in brutal arenas, and collect mystical keys to escape. Use strategy, exploration, and intense combat to defeat ancient beings and uncover the secrets of a relentless hunting game.

title: Pipeworks Puzzle
description: Pipeworks puzzle adds a new twist to the classic sliding-tile puzzle! Connect pipes as you move them in a grid-based arena to match the blueprint. You can only move the pieces into empty tiles, so plan your next move carefully.

title: Sangokushi III
description:
The PC-Engine CD-ROM version of Sangokushi III (Romance of the Three Kingdoms III) includes an additional scenario:

The Yellow Turban Rebellion (AD 184)
After choosing the scenario, players determine which warlord(s) they will control. Custom characters may be inserted into territories unoccupied by other forces. A total of 46 different cities exist, as well as hundreds of unique characters. Each character has several statistics: War Ability, Intelligence, Politics, Charisma, Army Command, Naval Command.

The player wins the game by conquering all territories in China. This is accomplished by being in control of every city on the map.

title: Backrooms: Final Exam
description: Backrooms: Final Exam is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players, Where you will explore this complex and intricate dimension with your friends or alone, trying to figure out what to do, wandering around and being scared by every sound, you will need to pass your final exam!

title: Walls That Watch
description: Use your radar device to explore strange labyrinths in a challenging game of cat-and-mouse with a unique cast of monsters.

title: A Journey Through Shadow, to Reach the Light.
description: Survive a dark world full of creatures and deadly machines. Explore creepy places, uncover secrets, and fight to escape, all while every word spoken is a poem. Will you break free or be lost in the darkness?

title: Gold and Bricks
description: Gold and Bricks is a small game that mixes elements of city builder, roguelite, strategy and tower defense. Plan the layout, manage your economy and invest your gold in defensive towers to protect yourself from the hordes of enemies invading your village.

title: Don't Go Out
description: Don’t Go Out is a short, card-based, turn-based horror RPG developed by Secret Cow Level. It’s part of the first Dread X Collection anthology released on May 26, 2020, which featured ten indie horror games by different creators.

title: Graduation Game
description: An online collaborative competitive 3D game.

title: Potionworm
description: The game offers the role of a herbalist to collect different plants and bones from monsters. To make potions according to recipes and sell them to the villagers. Monsters can kill you, so hire warriors as guards. Warriors will kill monsters, and you must collect money to leave the village.

title: The Puppy
description: It's just one week of work: watching over a sweet baby in a quiet, cozy house. Don't worry about my little dog, i love him, and he loves the baby. Seems like an easy job… until night falls.

title: Dark Cross
description: A third-person survival horror game where players navigate a dark, nonlinear facility, using light, sound, and limited tools to avoid deadly threats and uncover hidden experimental data.

title: Little Town Secrets
description: Uncover the dark secrets of an abandoned village in this tense, atmospheric horror adventure. Explore shadowy streets, solve eerie mysteries, and fight to stay alive.

title: Some: The House
description: SOME: The House is a horror house escape video game where your primary goal is to escape the House. Your goal is simple, find the keys to the door and do not get caught doing it. Escape the House at all cost!

title: Whispered Secrets: Purrfect Horror - Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop a forgotten god before it's too late?

title: Return of the Soul
description: A 2D horror and combat game where you can explore spaces while solving poozle and facing enemies and traps.

title: Paranormal Tape: Karak
description: A psychological horror puzzle game set inside a locked car. Uncover the truth, manage strange occurrences, and survive the haunted night on Malaysia's infamous Karak Highway.

title: Abyss Defence
description: As darkness falls, monstrous Abyss creatures emerge. Command your units, gather resources from plants, and survive each night. Defend the Crystal from increasingly powerful enemies in this pixel art RTS defense game.

title: Nezori
description: Embark on a cute action RPG adventure as a fox girl searching for the legendary hot springs in a land of fox and wolf girls!

title: NightBreak
description: What started as a simple urbex quickly turns into a nightmare: locked sewers, a trapped castle, a ruined village, and a procedural maze swarming with zombies. In co-op, search, loot, dodge, and survive together—before the undead find you first.

title: Unknowz
description: Unknowz is a cooperative platformer where two pirates, one alive, the other undead, must combine their unique abilities to solve puzzles, avoid traps, and escape from a skeleton-infested island. Work together... or sink!

title: Zekertune
description: Zekertune is the music rhythm game that will put your reflexes and sense of rhythm to the ultimate test! Dive into an immersive world of music where every tap counts.

title: BallStack
description: BallStack is a vibrant match-3 game where you stack and match colorful red, blue, purple, green, and yellow balls to clear levels, unlock power-ups, and compete on global leaderboards!

title: 101 Cats in Prague
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Prague landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Venice
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Venice landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Mouse Shooter
description: Retro shooter with simple controls Intuitive mouse controls

title: Super Star Battle
description: Place exactly 1 Star in each Row, Column and Area. Stars are not allowed to touch each other.

title: Evacuate
description: A first-person survival horror puzzle game where you wake up in a zombie-infested research facility. Solve environmental puzzles, manage resources, and escape while evading enemies that hunt by sound and movement.

title: Retro Rugby
description: Step onto the pixelated pitch in Retro Rugby—a fast-paced 2D rugby game with smart AI, physics-based collisions, and smooth controls. Build your dream team in Career Mode, compete in global tournaments, and experience dynamic, strategic gameplay. Relive rugby's golden era—game on!

title: Drones of Destruction
description: A fast-paced drone warfare gamePilot advanced drones, hunt enemies, and dominate the skies in intense battles. Play online or offline, with AI opponents in both modes. Master your weapons, outmaneuver rivals, and claim supremacy in this action-packed experience!

title: Sinister Sodies
description: Sinister Sodies is a bite-sized arcade puzzle game where you must strategically box in mischievous frooblies to cleanse your carbonated concoction before time runs out.

title: Teddy War II
description: In this FPS, cute teddy bears fight between themselves with fireballs !! You must shoot other players with your fireballs. Each time you kill someone, you gain one frag. The first player to obtain 10 frags wins.

title: Speedrun Simulator
description: Secure the best time for silly runs in this 3D platformer. Master all the routes. Gotta go fast though

title: Space Memory: Horses
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool horses in space

title: We Are Busy Digging a Hole
description: A relaxing cooperative digging adventure where you explore colorful underground worlds with friends. Team up to dig deeper, find valuable ores, upgrade your equipment, and collect rare dragons together.

title: Crabageddon
description: Defend your tower as a battle-hardened crab in a hostile underwater world! Collect powerful artifacts, grow stronger, and survive relentless waves of sea creatures

title: Sad Virus Winter
description: Second part of sad virus game series. Now mission to find beer bottles in winter themed maps and by collecting beer bottles level finished

title: The Legend of Nezha
description: "The Legend of Nezha" is a casual business simulation game. Players will take on the role of the owner of an inn. They will have a complete and rich set of service functions. The game will meticulously simulate various massage techniques,It can enable players to be more immersed in the game.

title: Brawl Me Blues
description: Brawl Me Blues is a fast-paced chaotic party game about filling the screen with projectiles to eliminate one player.

title: Calm the Storm
description: A free narrative experiment in accessible gaming.

title: Hollowing
description: Play as a student who is alone outside. He is constantly under academic and social pressure. As anxiety and loneliness accumulated, he began to notice something unusual. In this inescapable fear, he must find the answer... or be consumed by it.

title: FSKN
description: From an agent embedded in a group of Russian mafia, serving the drug cartels, the FDCN of Russia receives information about the supply of heroin by sea. The agent gives the approximate coordinates of the place of the goods, which should take place near an labor camp on the Pacific coast of Russia.

title: Elysian Inferno
description: A Hack and Slash Top-Down ARPG, where you must fight your way through Sanctus and Malum, the Realms of the Afterlife. Simultaneously play as the Mage and the Warrior, split from a soul torn between the two worlds, as you attempt to relink your soul back together and escape death.

title: Whispers of the Village
description: You arrive in a small village as a fortune-teller who reads the future in tea leaves. But an apocalyptic vision leads you to question its tranquillity. What if you had a part to play in this? Ready your cups and tea leaves, as the future of this village will be shaped by four unusual visitors.

title: Mitos.is: OG
description: Absorb, split, survive—the 2016 cell-devouring classic is back! Battle in Free-for-All, Random Teams, Guild War & Tournaments. Reach level 59, open unlimited accounts, and dominate the arena in Mitos.is: The Game OG.

title: May Sky
description: Mizoguchi Haruki, a newly-minted salaryman who doesn't care for those around him, and Kamiake Minori, a world-weary young shrine maiden who isn't interested in her peers. However, one chance enoucnter brings them together...

title: Spectral Protocol
description: Spectral Protocol is a psychological horror game where you’re trapped in a mysterious facility. Play solo or in two-player co-op, find hidden buttons, and escape terrifying creatures. Danger is everywhere ! will you survive or become another lost test subject?

title: Tofu Run: Remastered
description: Deliver Tofu

title: Shelter of Sursur
description:
No one visits Sursur's Shelter anymore...

Take a look at the dark shelter near your house to find your missing child.

title: The Magician's Challenge
description:
It will be a real challenge to escape from this magical room full of puzzles!
Can you solve the biggest-kept secret of the magicians? You are a magician in training about to take your final test.
In this relaxed point-and-click adventure you will discover a magical room. In this room a series of puzzles can be found that need to be solved to find the key, which opens the door so you can escape.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

title: The Knight's Challenge
description:
You are locked in a tower room of a castle.
Get ready for a point-and-click adventure about knights and castles. In this casual escape room game you have to find all the clues to solve a series of puzzles. Only if you solve all the puzzles will you be able to escape the tower room.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

title: Show Yourself
description: A psychological horror where Charlie will have to deal with his memories and his demons... but are they really demons? Who can Charlie trust? The flying brain or the mysterious voice? Every choice matters and will lead you to a different ending

title: Abyss Knights
description: Abyss Knights is an upcoming action RPG currently under development.

title: LumiBus
description:
LumiBus is a small, cozy game about everyday moments, simple encounters, and the little stories that unfold along the way

Three people and a dog are waiting for the bus made of light.
Their wish to turn their lives around attracts a myriad of fireflies...

title: Path of Exile: Secrets of the Atlas
description:
In Path of Exile: Secrets of the Atlas, tears have begun to appear in the Atlas leading to different realities. The Originator of these realities has entangled themselves within the very fabric of the Atlas and they’re now trapped! Track down the source of the tears and uncover the secrets within.

The new expansion introduces an additive endgame storyline, a new type of endgame crafting mechanic, three new endgame bosses, a new challenge league, dozens of new unique items and much more.

title: Mortgage Me Daddy
description: A single-screen satirical game where you press a button to request a mortgage… and you're always told no. There is no ending. No progress. Just despair — for the price of a coffee.

title: Climate Station
description:
Designed for the power of PlayStation 5 consoles, and enhanced for PS VR2, this free, immersive experience puts you in the middle of Earth’s most critical story: our own.

Over 90 minutes of interactive content - narrated by climate advocate Laura Tobin - takes you through rising seas, shifting temperatures, and stark climate futures, all built from real-world data by NASA, NOAA, and the IPCC.

Explore three main zones: Weather Year (a time-lapse of planetary change), Observations (where we are), and Projections (where we could go).

title: Câi & Darren: Code Calamity
description: A charming 2.5D turn-based RPG starring two college professors—Darren, a master of "Swipe" code, and Câi, a wizard of "Brew" language—who team up to descend into the mysterious depths of the MAD program building and confront the unleashed Calamity Virus. Players switch between the duo to reprogram terminals, solve programming puzzles, and battle rogue errors using a deck-based chip combat system that rewards combo strategies. Your goal: debug the virus and stop it from crashing everything before it’s too late.

title: Unmurk
description: You only see the outer edges of the puzzle. Put the puzzles back into place to reveal a hidden voxel object.

title: Dicey Hacker 1999
description: Dicey Hacker 1999 is a cyberpunk roguelite driven by dice-based strategy. As a hacker in a post-1999 parallel world, gather resources, hack programs, manipulate probabilities via bizarre devices. Each dice rewrites reality's code, every roll destabilizes the digital abyss.

title: Fate And Destiny: The Elonia Chronicles
description: A heroic fantasy RPG inspired by dungeon‑crawling board games. It delivers a 15‑chapter, isometric adventure campaign where you assemble a party of six unique warriors, delve into colorful dungeons and mysterious forests, battle tactical turn‑based combat on grid‑based maps, gear up between missions, and meet a diverse cast of characters—all wrapped in a narrative shaped by your choices and culminating in multiple possible endings.

title: Rival Species
description: In the far distant future of the 40th millennium behind the stars there is only war. Enter the universe of WARHAMMER 40,000 and play a mighty warrior for one out of an ever growing list of rival species.
