A large PvP team multiplayer mod for Half-Life that plays similary to Battlefield/Battlefront, based on the Game's Workshop property. Eventually Exterminatus, A sequel for the Source Engine would be made

title: Ghost Deliverer
description: One day, A girl accidentally gets involved with the 'KEA (Korean Exorcist Association)' and the evil organization 'Lunacide'... Will be able to stop Lunacide's plot and be reborn as a proper exorcist?

title: Exterminatus: Rival Species 2
description: set in Games Workshop's, great Warhammer 40,000 ( 40k ) universe, Exterminatus is the sequel to the large PvP team based Half-Life mod "Rival Species", Now on the Source engine.

title: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense
description: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense is a real-time tactical tower defense game. As Princess Lua, defend the demon realm against the hero alliance. Build unique towers, manage unit morale, and use tactical pauses to repel invasions. Your strategy decides the demon realm's fate.

title: No End
description: Explore a seamless endless universe with an uncountable number of galaxies, stars, planets, and moons. Make friends or enemies with unique alien civilizations. Research upgrades for your vessel with scientific phenomena and alien tech that you've acquired.

title: Serial Experiments L-If-e
description: This is a derivative work of the 1990s anime game [Serial Experiments Lain]. It was created using RPG Maker MZ and based on the official guidelines "Lain Time to Live".The game is about exploring dungeons and reading the scenario.

title: Impping!
description: Impping is the imp rocketing community project. Built for Doom II this mod contains 32 levels made by various doomworld members who sought to make the perfect imp rocketing experience

title: Age of Respair
description: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom.

title: Mesorift Survival
description: Mesorift Survival is a classic survival game with PvP and PvE elements, set in a tropical open world with three islands. Gather resources, build a base, craft weapons, and survive deadly dinosaurs and rival players — solo or with friends.

title: Desktop Wooden Fish
description: Desktop electronic wooden fish, a unique casual decompression game. In the game, by tapping on the wooden fish and listening to realistic sound effects, it feels like being in a serene and elegant environment. It supports automatic tapping and has customization options, allowing users to set words.

title: Rumor Raiders
description: Solve riddles, arrange residents to build a town, and use your raiders to push-your-luck through lethal dungeons in a puzzle strategy game inspired by various tabletop games.

title: Super Smash Bros Ultimate: Martial Artist Gi and Wig
description: This DLC contains the Martial Artist Gi and Wig.

title: Numachina
description: Minimalist automation puzzle game where you build physics-based machines to manipulate the flow of numbers.

title: A Wake Between Worlds
description:
In this action-roguelite you play as the spirit of a fisherman named Theo, who died at sea and desires to go back to his old life on the other side of the ocean.

Since you are stuck in the Drift, the land between the living and the dead, you will encounter other restless spirits who've been dwelling and manifesting into abominations, preventing you from reaching your home.

Using your harpoon, you must fight your way from island to island with your fishing boat to collect resources, so you can craft upgrades according to your play style and be able to defeat the restless abominations.

title: Dream Hollow
description: A cozy-horror adventure game where choices matter. Manage your resources each day to delve deeper into an eerie storybook forest. Gather items, aid the frightened denizens, and make it back to your cottage before your RESOLVE runs out.

title: Rocket League: Season 19
description: Celebrate 10 Years of Aerials and Epic Saves in Rocket League Season 19!

title: Siren Sands
description: Build the cozy merfolk life of your dreams in the quirky underwater village of Siren Sands. Manage an animal sanctuary, care for 50+ unlockable creatures, embrace local traditions, find love, and explore dangerous caverns to uncover ancient mysteries.

title: Dark Adelita
description: Dark Adelita is a brutal, 2D action platformer rooted in Mexican folklore. As Angela, a fearless Adelita, fight your way through mythic horrors, dodge deadly traps, and face legendary bosses from Mexico’s past—all while uncovering a supernatural threat born from revolution.

title: Dwarfs Descent
description: Dwarfs Descent is a 3rd person, procedurally generated, casual roguelike, with RPG Elements in a stylized graphic!

title: Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor
description: This is exactly what you came for. Experience high-octane sci-fi adventure! Slay fierce monsters, explore alien worlds, craft deadly compounds, and upgrade your AI body to survive. Master high-speed melee and drone warfare to uncover the secrets of a galaxy on the edge of collapse!

title: 10.000 Pizzas Please
description: Build and automate your own pizza factory to feedwaves of hungry aliens! Manage resources, optimize machines, and design the ultimate production line in this delightfully chaotic automation & cooking sim packed with cheese, conveyor belts, and cosmic mayhem.

title: Alaska: An Endless Night
description: Alaska is a third-person investigation and exploration game. Play as Clarence, a former bounty hunter chasing Enyeto, accused of your brother’s death. Explore snowy Alaskan landscapes, uncover clues, and decide your target’s fate.

title: The Last Mage
description: The Last Mage: Trials of Vahrkesh is a story-rich action RPG where Aelena, pulled from the modern world into a medieval realm, gains forbidden magic and joins a rebellion. Battle, solve puzzles, and face epic trials to stop a tyrant in a world of danger, mystery, and magic.

title: Sanctale
description: You'll open a potion shop in Sacred Heart City and learn about the reasons for the decline of Sacred Heart City by meeting a wide variety of customers. This is a story-based business simulation game, the main gameplay is that the customer asks you to make the right potion according to the request.

title: Observer Protocol: The Station - Final Shift
description: Familiar feeds. New rooms. The end of your watch—unless the station has other plans.

title: Starfall Defenders
description: Starfall Defenders is a classic tower defense game that features unique towers and enemies. It also has an in-game shop system that allows players to purchase better towers, upgrade existing ones, and buy special items like the Atom Bomb, Splash Bomb, and Air Supply.

title: The Incident at Galley House
description: In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery.

title: Bleak Haven
description: Bleak Haven is a cinematic survival horror where faith is twisted, every shot matters, and survival hangs on what you can build. Explore haunted ruins, abandoned villages, and face a cult preparing the world for a god no one should ever witness.

title: Frog Folding Simulator
description: Fold frogs and give them hats! Frog Folding Simulator is a cute and cozy origami simulation where you create a herd of origami frogs to watch over you as you fold more! Customize your frogs with colored paper, hats, bows, mustaches, and stickers! Just enjoy the music, and let the frogs take over.

title: The Troll & The Witch's House
description: The Troll & The Witch’s House is a point-and-click adventure game set in a strange house filled with mysteries. Piece together fragments of the past, uncover secrets and find the key to your escape.

title: Foundlings
description: Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this real-time spellcasting RPG. Forge spells by combining conduits, perfectly time your inputs, level up your Liberal Arts learning and keep your Humours in check as you help them find their purpose.

title: Packed Lair
description: You are an evil lord with a hero problem and not nearly enough floor space. Draft buildings, pack them into your cramped lair, toil to earn money to expand, create powerful monster synergies, and send your chaotic army of minions to repel wave after wave of heroic do-gooder pests.

title: Arcane Coven
description: A roguelite 1-8 player Co-op top-down dungeon crawler. Slay mobs, loot chests, explore the map, craft wands and upgrade spells in a team attempt to escape from the magical dimension by conquering all 4 seasons.

title: Angler's Journey
description: Idle Clicker fishing game where you attack with different weapons to catch fishes, sell them to upgrade your equipment, unlock new skills. Explore diverse fishing spots, challenge mighty boss fishes, and strive to complete your massive fish collection.

title: Loophole
description: A time-bending puzzle game about working with - and against - your past selves. Subvert the rules of time travel, dodge paradoxes, and find a way to escape the loop.

title: Parcel Dash
description: Parcel Dash is a fast paced, arcade like time trial. Plan the most efficient route to deliver packages as fast as you can and compete in online leaderboards.

title: The Wizard’s Beans Or: A Short Period of Unplanned Internment
description: Solve puzzles, enlist magic beans, eat soap, plan your escape, and confront the menacing mage who keeps you confined in his tower. Will you keep cracking jokes or learn from your mistakes? Your choices matter.

title: Road Trip to the End of the World
description: Road Trip to the End of the World is a visual novel about the death of a friendship. When Andy and her imaginary friend Fishy set off on a road trip to crash their ex-best friend’s wedding, will they know when to hit the brakes?

title: The Sovereign
description: A tactical roguelike RPG where you face fragments of an immortal king’s soul in high-stakes turn-based battles. Every decision you make directly impacts your future, with bosses reacting in real-time to your choices and playstyle. Learn their preferences as well as their triggers to survive.

title: Setup Savior
description: Set out on a creative journey, organize, decorate, and level up clients setups as you chase your dreams and build your business as the “Setup Savior”. Tidy up and refurnish rooms, decorate surroundings, and sell old furniture to purchase new, unleash your creativity and achieve your vision!

title: Brian's Redemption
description: Brian’s Redemption is a survival roguelite where you play as a cute magical feline to fight off hordes of cosmic monstrosities. Choose from a vast array of items to craft game-breaking builds and survive until all foes perish.

title: One Last Journey
description: One Last Journey is a story-driven 2D platformer set in the Veil. Play as two silent souls — Selene and Aurel — as they journey through haunting ruins, fading memories, and creeping danger in search of reunion and peace.

title: Book of Myko
description: Help Myko complete her mushroom foraging journal and get into the Royal Academy in this cozy, self-paced adventure game. Meet a colorful cast of characters in calm natural spaces as you uncover the gentle puzzle of mycology.

title: Super Woden: Rally Edge
description: The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

title: Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams
description: 11 world-renowned experts are trapped together and must cooperate to survive... until conflicts arise, and they discover the greatest threat to their lives isn't the system they're resisting: it's each other! Discover the truth of who's living a lie in this fully voiced murder mystery adventure.

title: Cross World: Mishiranu Sora no Etatia
description: Enter Kuros, an average high school student who gets sent into another world after getting into a car accident. Losing his memory and forgetting his name, he became known as the Cross Sword hero. In search of a way to open up the Cross Gate to return his own world, Kuros and one of three heroines partner up to travel across the world of Etatia in search of clues. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked figure seems intent on disrupting their journey of getting Kuros back to his own world...

title: Golden Tee Arcade Classics
description: Tee up the old-school fun with six classic Golden Tee arcade games, plus more!

title: Scary Together
description: Scary Together is a 4-player co-op horror game. Explore terrifying levels filled with jump scares, solve puzzles, and experience the thrill of being scared together. Perfect for players who love screaming—and laughing—with friends. Screams turn into laughter as you watch your friends freak out

title: Sector Force
description: One pilot, thirty stranded workers, hundreds of asteroids heading their way.

title: XDM
description: XDM is an Unreal Tournament style mod for Half-Life 1. It features Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture The Flag, Domination, Co-Op, Last Man Standing and even has a Single Player component. It has tons of new weapons, maps, models, and special effects.

title: The Ruin Wanderer
description: Somewhere in the Great Desert, an ancient tomb awaits an eager explorer. Can you make it past the traps and escape with the treasure in this short episodic single-player adventure?

title: FallingBattle
description: FallingBattle is a 2D action party game that supports 1 to 32 players. The rules are simple: keep descending, dodge obstacles, and survive! Grab items to sabotage your opponents and show them who the true King of the Fall really is!

title: Parking in Tight Spaces
description: Test your skills in this relaxing parking game! Park cars, trailers, and buses in tight spaces. Each level pushes your precision and control – can you master every tricky spot?

title: À La Mine
description: À la Mine is a strategy game where dwarves compete to become owners... or end up exploited! Dominate territories by winning auctions or using dynamite to eliminate your rivals in this ruthless struggle.

title: Dungeon Raid
description: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

title: Decklings
description: Tame magical creatures called Decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this resource management, deckbuilding card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft items to build your base and raise your Decklings as you shape your path to become the Deckling Champion.

title: Scrapocalypse
description: Scrapocalypse is an open-world survival RPG set in a harsh post-apocalyptic desert wasteland. The year is 2150. You are a lone scavenger, covered in dust and driven by survival instinct. Roam the ruins of a decaying world, gather resources, craft tools and weapons and battle mutated the infected.

title: Mahouteq!
description: A story about an unemployed girl named Luna, who wanted to buy her favorite figure so much that she had to get a job.

title: Keytron
description: Test your reflexes and typing speed in KEYTRON: Typer & Shooter—type words at lightning pace before time runs out and shatter your own high scores! Jump in now and dive into the neon-fueled action that makes every keystroke pulse with excitement.

title: Final Fantasy XV: King's Knight Sticker Set
description: A custom decal set based on the underground hit app, King's Knight. Ride around and pretend you're Ray Jack!

title: Shuttle Mining
description: Shuttle Mining is a Noita- and Terraria-inspired cozy & chaotic mining game. Craft your own unique lasers, burn, taze, and make things explode. The goal is to craft new batteries so you can use stronger lasers and dig deeper...

title: Fever Meme
description: Fever Meme is a comedy/parody game that pivots between multiple genres as it spits in the face of traditional game design. The game is self-aware of your actions as you play, your past mistakes, and so much more. And the further you make it into the game, the more the dynamic between player and creator is explored as the fourth wall is completely stripped away.

title: Super Rising Ball
description: Super Rising Ball is a challenging game where you rotate objects with precision to make the ball rise to its next target and reach the top. Unlock 30 unique skins and complete your collectible album!

title: My Dear Can't Speak
description: The player takes on the role of Kikkawa Kaede, who, after years of effort, achieves their lifelong dream—only to be overwhelmed by emptiness and numbness. One day, drowning in alcohol, they find a mysterious girl at the train station...

title: Deal With the Devil Chapter: 2 - From Tuonela to Hell
description: Point-and-click adventure featuring eerie scenes

title: Tezcatlipoca
description: Tezcatlipoca is inspired by classic retro horror games with tank controls, like Alone in the Dark, Silent Hill, and Resident Evil. However, unlike those titles, while the game features enemies, combat is not a central feature.

title: Ai Painter: Painting Simulator
description: This is a painting simulator unlike any other. Here, AI is not a cold tool, but the brush in your hand, your partner in inspiration. No artistic skill is required; with a simple doodle, the AI can generate a unique piece of art for you in real time.

title: Festival Journey: Venetian Masquerade - Collector's Edition
description: Explore Venice through puzzles and hidden objects in this festive journey — light on story, rich in fun!

title: Rent a Girl
description: After a humiliating disappointment, a shy student turns to a girlfriend rental service to practice social skills — and discovers that even fake relationships can reveal real truths.

title: Dumpster Baby
description: Dumpster Baby is a game about being queer and homeless, and the importance of community and friendship in hard times. You play as Bandit, an optimistic racoon meeting new friends as he tries to find people to be roommates with. A narrative focused single player experience.

title: Treasure Forest Clicker
description: Welcome to Treasure Forest Clicker, a relaxing yet addictive clicker game where your goal is to tidy up a messy yard by clicking on trash and debris.

title: Crystal Calamity
description: Crystal Calamity is a roguelike deck-building tactics game where you wield card-based powers and protect spirits from another realm—your living draw and discard piles. Build your deck, fight alongside spirits, and save the world in a land ruled by crystals and cards.

title: Path to Serenity
description: Guide Jim on a heartfelt journey to find peace and balance amidst life's struggles. In Path to Serenity, a cozy walking simulator, explore levels with interactive and soothing elements, accompanied by calming sounds. Walk alongside Jim as he begins a new path towards calm and serenity.

title: Final Fantasy XV: King's Knight Tee
description: An exclusive T-shirt highlighting the heroes of the mobile game that took Eos by storm.

title: Half-Life: Retrograde
description: You play a member of the maintenance team. You're current job is to reactivate the decommissioned generator to provide the Lambda team enough power for their next experiment.

title: Blood Message
description:
Blood Message is a narrative-driven, linear action-adventure single-player game based on the true historical event of "Dunhuang's Uprising".

Set in the late Tang Dynasty in 848 AD, players take on the role of Dunhuang, a messager who embarks on a perilous eastward journey to deliver a message that holds the fate of his homeland.

Alongside his son, they must survive relentless enemy sieges and a treacherous three-thousand-li odyssey, fighting against impossible odds to return to the heart of the Tang: Chang'an. Amidst the desert sands, they etch the final tale of loyalty in the Great Tang.

The world has heard too many stories of emperors and generals—Blood Message is an ode to the unsung heroes.

title: Roguebots Arena
description: A pvp arena shooter featuring roguelike progressions within a match! Pick a class and jump into a chaotic fight! Combine skills and abilities for (stonk) synergies Combo, snipe, assassinate, troll, throw people off a cliff, give handicap, do whatever you want to have fun!

title: Fish Season
description: A small casual fishing game where every round is bite-sized, and the competition is fierce for every fish. On the dock, you can use the fish you've collected to buy upgrades and repair your damaged vessel. And in desperate times, you can even fire your fish at your rivals. Good luck !

title: R.A.T.: Human Error – Episode One
description: The world ended. Now the real nightmare begins. Deep underground, a child wakes in a infected facility. Minds are breaking. Bodies are changing. Crawl through vents, follow echoes, and escape before it’s too late. Your mother is waiting.

title: Relaxing Fishing
description: A simple cozy game where you fish with friendly characters, upgrade, discover and decorate.

title: GunOre
description: In GunOre, your gun is your ultimate tool - use it for movement, collecting resources, purchasing upgrades, robots, and defending your mine! Automate your operations and build your defenses as you master the art of movement. Have a cozy time in this active idler mining ore and fighting monsters!

title: Zombies and Strangers
description: A fast-paced top-down 2D Zombie Shooter with arcade elements. You control a lone survivor lost in a world full of zombies and strange creatures trying to uncover the mastermind behind all of it.

title: Desktop Clicker
description: Desktop Clicker is an idle clicker game that runs in a small window, letting you click monsters while working or gaming. Battle 90+ unique pixel creatures, upgrade passive damage, and unlock powerful prestige rewards. Enjoy incremental progression without interrupting your workflow!

title: Enoch Never Dies
description: story-driven horror game

title: Wind Fantasy II: Alive
description:
Shuilan is a land that hovers above the ocean. Recently, a demon lord appeared nearby. The people of Shuilan know that the demon lord's plan is to invade and to conquer their country. The wise teacher Wentini builds a special unit of fighters, called the Fate Travel Group. She knows that the only one who can help the people of Shuilan is a girl with special powers, named Li Fu. She sends a young fighter named Ares to find Li Fu, but meanwhile Shuilan is invaded by a hostile army. The battles for survival begins...

Fengse Huanxiang 2, also known as Wind Fantasy II, is set in a fantasy world, unlike most Chinese RPGs, which prefer concrete historical setting in China. The game is more close to Japanese RPGs in style, being heavily influenced by anime art. Unlike other games in the series, it has no elements of strategy/tactical RPG. You navigate your party from location to location, fighting random enemies and bosses on the way. The game uses Final Fantasy-like third-person perspective in battles, yet the battle engine is not active time, but turn-based.

title: Eden's Prison
description: climb the tower of God

title: Tilescapes
description: Rebuild the universe, one tile at a time!

title: Fēngsè Huànxiǎng III: Zuì Yǔ Fá de Zhènhúngē
description: Wind Fantasy 3: The Soul Song Of Sin & Punishment is a strategic role-playing game developed by Hongyu Technology, released on November 17, 2004.

title: Fiend Exile
description: Will you get exiled?

title: Vaporwave Battler
description: A Turn Based Trip Back In Time

title: Stargazing 64
description: Gaze at the stars while experiencing Astromegalophobia first-hand in this N64 styled cosmic horror game.

title: Invertinator
description: Invertinator is a platform game about inverting space and flipping gravity.

title: Still It Runs
description: Still It Runs is a stealth adventure where you play as a cat, alone in a strangely silent house. Collect scattered memories, uncover what once happened here—and try to stay unseen.

title: Chronos Shift
description: Chronos Shift is a puzzle-platformer as a young adventurer who stumbles into a time-twisting adventure. Solve puzzles, fight enemies, and navigate dangerous environments.Find your way home and escape a reality warping time paradox!

title: Ark: Ragnarok Ascended
description: Journey through an expansive 144 sq. kilometer environment where elements from The Island, Scorched Earth, and all new biomes are combined to bring the ultimate survivor experience.

title: Housekeeper: Anomaly
description: Scavenge abandoned apartments, cut on broken glass, fight anomalies, trade with the merchants, deceive them into buying bad products and most importantly - try to stay alive and care about yourself!

title: Snake Princess
description: Snake Princess is a short snake-inspired puzzle game in an NES style. Originally created for the NES Jam 2025, with the theme of 'Save the Princess'.

title: Food Truck Shop Simulator
description: Build your dream food truck from scratch in this Early Access game! Master street food, navigate traffic, serve customers, and upgrade your business. Join festivals and help shape the future of the game as you rise to become a street food legend!

title: Vaulting Over It
description: Physics based climbing game. You use a tall tree branch to climb and vault over obstacles. Inspired by Getting Over İt.

title: AMR is for amour and also for the 12.7MM anti-material rifle + Planet X
description: Double feature for the flesh

title: She Keeps Me Damn Alive
description:
Do you think you have the power to protect others?
What gives you this power?
Are you excited to hold the gun?
Will the gun make you feel powerful?
All they do is let you take power from others…

title: Mathigo
description: A casual set of arcade-style mini games for kids where you answer math questions to gain points and win. Includes progression though the four basic arithmetic types: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

title: Deltarune: Wilter's Wonderland
description:
This is a Deltarune fangame about the character, Wilter

A secret boss interpretation for Deltarune Chapter 3, based off of the flowers in Toriel's trashcan.

Wilter is a funny little flower clown, who loves to play games with his best friend, you!

Doesn’t that sound Wonderfull?

This fangame contains both the battle and Wilter’s sidequest!

title: Chains of Lukomorye
description: A WWI soldier journeys into Slavic folklore to reclaim his lost love. Third-person action, dark mythology, and a story of love and fate in a fractured world.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: The Promise of Tomorrow
description: The Patch 7.3 series update includes: New Main Scenario Quests, a new Dungeon, a new 24-man Raid, a new Trial, a new Deep Dungeon, New Allied Society Quests, and PvP Updates

title: Menace from the Deep: The Rift of Sanity
description: The Rift of Sanity features a new playable character with a unique deck, a fourth game act called "The Outer World", tons of new inventory items, enemies, and encounters.

title: Blast Processed
description: Blast Processed is a first-person platformer built around an infamous movement quirk of early FPS games: Rocket Jumping.

title: The Regreening
description: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug all the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.

title: SteelFront
description: A sandbox battle-sim with a strategic edge. Orchestrate tactical engagements, deploying your forces with keen attention to terrain and mutually-supporting assets, or throw mobs of troops, tanks, and mechs at one-another with reckless abandon in large-scale, futuristic combined-arms warfare.

title: Mycocosm
description: MYCOCOSM is a casual arcade shooter and resource manager where you take the role of a newly sprouted seedling. Fight off waves of soil-borne enemies using antimicrobial chemicals, and trade for precious nutrients with wandering fungal spores - but beware their deceitful dealings.

title: Rumour
description: Curiosity can bring darkness. Rumours of an alternate world bring two brothers to an university, where a mysterious lens will make them part ways. Clinging to the hope of finding your brother, embody Bichito and fight what observes in the dark.

title: Keiji J.B. Harold no Jikenbo: Manhattan Requiem
description: The mobile version of Manhattan Requiem, and one of the few versions with an English localization.

title: Modern Sonic Adventure 2: The Trial
description: This isn't just some simple character and texture swaps, Modern Sonic Adventure 2 revamps everything, level geometry and props, character animations, new remixed music, new in-game and dynamic voice acting, new level design, physics, even the ranking system.

title: RigorZ
description: RigorZ is an online multiplayer survival FPS game set in a post-apocalyptic zombie world. Players must scavenge for supplies, fight off both the undead and other survivors, and survive in a harsh, open-world environment. With realistic hunger, thirst, and PvP systems, RigorZ offers an immersive survival experience.

title: MobOS
description: mobOS is a game that updates in real time and takes place exploring an alternate universe's operating system and its internet in the year 2005.

title: Jiàn Xiá Qíngyuán Wàizhuàn: Yuè Yǐng Chuánshuō
description:
The moon's reflection ripples in the water. No one knows what lies behind that gentle reflection, nor what stories unfold beneath it...

Throughout the land, countless martial artists have devoted their lives to mastering the martial arts, striving to create their own techniques and reach the realm of the greatest masters. For them, nothing is more enticing than the title of "The Best in Martial Arts."

Just imagine—when every martial artist speaks your name with awe and reverence, acknowledging you as the supreme being—how exhilarating that would be!

It is said that two peerless martial artists once fought to the death atop Lingjue Peak for this title. But in the end, all that remained was the heart-wrenching cries of two children who had just lost their parents...

Ten years have passed. The children from Lingjue Peak have grown up. One embarks on a long journey through the martial world to fulfill his father’s dying wish of becoming the best. The other, consumed by the desire for vengeance, has spent years training in secret, plotting every move with painstaking care...

It is said that a legendary manual, The Dao of Martial Arts, contains peerless techniques passed down through generations. Some people lose sleep over it, obsessively scheming to obtain it; others, for its sake, forsake their loved ones and are cast out by all; still others risk everything and ultimately lose their lives. But no one has ever truly seen it.

As grudges and rivalries slowly unravel like silken threads, places like the Beimo Manor, the Cangjian Villa, and the Feilong Fortress come into play. A massive and horrifying conspiracy begins to emerge...

The state of asking for nothing is a realm few can reach. Even Confucius, who traveled from state to state not for profit but for fame, could not escape worldly desires.

When faced with the choice between "The Best in Martial Arts" and a love bound by life and death—what would you choose?

title: Parkour Fortress: Redux
description: Parkour Fortress: Redux adds Mirror's Edge-style parkour movement mechanics into Team Fortress 2. Its maps are prefixed by pf_. The mod is a from-scratch, backward-compatible recreation of Jonas Kaerlev's Parkour Fortress mod from 2011. A standalone version of the mod known by the name of "Parkour Forever" is currently undergoing crowdfunding.

title: Hidden Cats: Rome
description: Explore this mysterious Ancient Rome world in the new game Hidden Cats: Rome finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints.

title: Teikyuu wo Koete
description:
"Do you know the rumors about that mansion?
In the wake of a certain incident in the past, all the families who lived there,
He passed away.

That's right, an incident in the heart.

Then, if you enter the mansion with your family or lover, you will never be able to come out again. Such a rumor.

Why don't you go?'

The main character "Momiji" wakes up in an abandoned house.
It was once a place where families were in their hearts.

Tsubaki is frightened by the inexplicable event, but while being supported by his beloved dog "San-chan" by his side,
Back at home: Find a way to get back to your daily routine.

Take that step so you don't lose anything important.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Armored Core Mobile 2
description:
Build it. Master it. Win with pure will.
Forge the ultimate ARMORED CORE with your own hands.

ARMORED CORE MOBILE 2 is a port of the classic title originally released in 2005 for feature phones, part of FromSoftware acclaimed 3D mech action series, ARMORED CORE.

title: The Joycare
description: The Joycare is a psychological horror game where you investigate the abandoned facilities of a forgotten childcare company. What was once a joyful place now hides disturbing secrets, twisted experiments, and something that never left…

title: Sweet Calamity
description:
This mod will take us to a new dimension entirely made of candy and sugar. But be careful, don't be fooled by its bright colors…

To access this dimension, you must find a Chef! A new hermit villager who lives in the cherry forests. Get his recipe book and complete the recipes! And then you can open the portal to the Sweetlands.

In this world, four new biomes await you, each with its own challenges and creatures made of candy. There you must collect the 5 special runes and then gather them in the magic cauldron… Who knows what will happen next?

This is an experimental version of the mod, as there are plans to expand it into something much bigger in the future.

title: Whiskerwood Vale
description: Whiskerwood Vale is an open world expressive platformer starring a fox knight who wields a magic greatsword! Using this sword, you'll soar through the skies and explore the floating islands of the Shattered Lands, battling evil foes, collecting acorns, and rescuing villagers along the way!

title: Loan Shark
description: The loan shark is coming for you. Catch enough fish to repay your debt before it is too late. Go fish.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Flickers of a Spacetime Warp
description:
Version 8.3 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter IX: If Destiny Concludes Today
• New Part 2 Open World: Dragon Ruins
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime (Helia)
• New Featured Event: Bon Voyage! Toward Blessings and Wishes!
• ...and more!

title: Spookitchen
description: Run a haunted delivery restaurant in the Halloween world of Spookitchen! Explore the wild Poltergeist Forest for ingredients and serve dishes so delicious they’d wake the dead. Face quirky ghostly customers and win the showdown against the witch. Play solo or with up to 4 players for fun and chaos!

title: Cloud Dwellers
description: Cloud Dwellers is a 2D simulation and city-building game set in a world of scattered floating islands. Guide your settlers to harness technology, optimize production, and transform fragmented skies into a thriving, beautifully crafted aerial haven.

title: Blue Delta
description: Blue Delta is a visual novel about adventures in a strange world.

title: Shinai Naru Kodoku to Kunou e
description:
Uchida Kisaki, Nako Ryuusuke, and Tomiya Umi—three college students trying to make sense of modern life.
They were stuck.
Dreams, goals, jobs, relationships, family…
And then there were their own personalities, their thoughts, their very selves.
The present felt out of reach, and the future even more so.
At the end of a desperate internet search for "counselor," on the 39th page of results, they stumbled onto something.
A painfully simple website, but with bold, confident claims.
And for some reason, it was free.
This was how they met Tachibana Makoto, a counselor who went by simply "Mako."
What would change in their hearts? What choices would they make? Where would they end up?
Let’s see where it all leads.

title: LightPoint
description: A real-time strategy based tower defense game Gather resources, build defenses, and hold out against the enemy until victory is achieved! Rich building mix, challenging boss waiting for you to challenge!

title: Oxidus Tales
description: Embrace a new adventure in this post apocalyptic world. Investigate, defeat bosses and clear the different dungeons in this turn based roguelike with 3 different battle systems.

title: Don't Mess With Bober
description: First-person game with a touch of 80s horror movies, where you face the Beaver, who’s out for revenge.

title: Number Machine
description: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

title: Shelter of Sursur 2
description:
Take a look at the dark shelter opposite your house to find your missing child…

Solve all the puzzles while avoiding being chased by the monsters inside Sursur's shelter.

title: Wars Across The World: Tryphon 104
description: Tryphon 104 B.C., the sotry of the second slave war. The slaves of Sicily revolt again because of unfulfilled Roman promises of freedom.

title: Wars Across the World: Bulgaria 1913
description: Bulgaria 1913 covers the second Balkan war, where the Kingdom of Bulgaria attacks by surprise its neighbors in order to preserve its conquests achieved in 1912, while its opponent has to repel the assault and try to win over the Romanians and Turks.

title: Discard All Hope
description: Investigate an eldritch mystery in a town under siege, collect and upgrade powerful spells, fight grotesque cultists, twisted creatures, and bio-mechanical invaders in this twin-stick-shooter / Action RPG hybrid.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 17 - Powered Up!
description: Unleash chaos in Aatlis, the Moroccan Flashpoint map debuting in Core, and take control with Map Voting and Stadium Forge—your personal loadout lab. Stadium expands with reworked arenas and the addition of Sigma, Junkrat and Zenyatta. Unlock the dual Mythic drop at launch—Mythic Horang D.Va Hero Skin and Reaper's Mythic Steel Death Weapon Skin—, and dive into Hacks & Hijinx, a limited-time 6v6 mode where match modifiers rotate every round. Whether you're honing your prowess in Stadium, casting your map vote, or unlocking Mythics like it’s your job, this season will get you Powered Up!

title: Minecraft: Deluxe Collection for PC
description:
Experience all the different ways to explore, survive, and build in Minecraft with Minecraft: Deluxe Collection for PC!

Create, explore, survive, repeat. Get Minecraft: Java Edition and Bedrock Edition as a package deal for Windows! With Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition for Windows, you can easily switch between games using the unified launcher and cross-play with any current edition of Minecraft.

Browse endless community created content in the Minecraft Marketplace, discover new play styles through different maps, and express yourself with Character Creator items and emotes. Gather your friends or gear up for a solo mission, you’re ready for all the many ways to play Minecraft!

title: Floral Gutter
description: Fairly broken game

title: Knight On The Moon
description: This is a top down adventure game involving exploration, delving into dungeons, solving puzzles, and engaging in combat with various enemies. Players control a protagonist who must gather items, such as weapons, tools, and upgrades, to progress through increasingly challenging areas. Exploration and discovery are key, as players uncover hidden secrets, navigate mazes, and complete objectives to advance the story. This game is a balance of action, problem-solving.

title: A Small Encounter
description: A short, m/m visual novel about a butterfly meeting a spider

title: Lust Arcanum
description: Join Kyra, a half-dragon maiden cursed with endless lust, in this heartwarming slice-of-life adventure! Explore enchanted realms with a circle of unique maidens, each with their own ambition. Help satisfy their desires as you search for the bond Kyra desperately seeks!

title: Eclipse Below
description: A co-op submarine piloting horror game with asymmetrical elements where your survival is dependent on the effectiveness of communication between your crew and the efficient management of resources left behind by the old world.

title: Climber Girl
description: Play as the young adventurer Vera Jones and uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization whose legacy threatens the entire human race.

title: 20th Century Beauties
description:
20th Century Beauties is a jigsaw puzzle game where each completed picture reveals a different icon of feminine flair - decked out in the stunning looks of her decade. From jazz lounges to power suits and hairspray, each puzzle peels back another layer of vintage charm.
Drag, drop, and take your time. Make it a challenge or do it with no rush. Just good company and better curves, wrapped in eras that knew how to make an entrance.

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - 2025 Monster Energy Supercross Championship
description: Step into the spotlight and write your own story in the 2025 Monster Energy Supercross Championship DLC for MX vs ATV Legends. Tear through the full 2025 season—from the roar of Anaheim’s opener to the legendary Pittsburgh —across 17 official tracks. New tracks roll out over time— starting with 6 tracks on launch

title: Broken Dimensions
description:
In Broken Dimensions, no two puzzles are alike. Instead, two simple mechanics of rotating the world in 3 dimensions and freezing individual objects in time combine to unlock a whole universe of exciting physics-based puzzles.

Broken Dimensions is a Unity powered game developed in just 5 weeks by an interdisciplinary team of 13 students at the Danish Academy of Digital Interactive Entertainment (DADIU).

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - Slayground
description: Throw insane whips like Freestyle phenomenon Axell “Slay” Hodges on his very own Slayground! Rip up the course you see Axell ride every day in his videos! The Slayground track pack includes two Nationals plus one massive Freestyle environment.

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - Supercross World Tour
description:
Compete on six huge and challenging tracks in Japan, Australia, and Italy!
Featuring indoor and outdoor sections PLUS Joker Lanes for the first time in MX vs ATV!

title: MX vs. ATV Legends: Track Pass
description: The Track Pass grants you access to 22 tracks scheduled for release in 2022!

title: Astral Fantasy
description: Astral Fantasy is an indie RPG created by EpsilonEagle. It's a space fantasy adventure that would fit right along side games like the Phantasy Star series.

title: Bebshoru Lodbuka
description: Turn-based combat game where you will fight against the demons of Bebshoru Lodbuka's hell until you reach Trekim Gogzokk's lair, and thus banish the darkness from the land of Abunouzeppan. You can make combat strategies by throwing cards that are sold in the Marketplace.

title: Battle Live! School of idols
description:
You play as Ayane/Akiomi, as you through the idol school of Pride Park Secondary. There are two main routes to the game for each wing of the school showing everything it has to offer, as well as a bonus epilogue for seeing both routes.

The game is very linear and should take about an hour to see it to completion.

title: Tails & Talons
description: Tails & Talons is a roguelite deckbuilder where spell-casting cards and card-matching combos intertwine to create a addicting and strategic experience! Join a colorful cast of furry adventurers, unleash powerful spells, and chain devastating combos as you descend down a mysterious tower..

title: A Game About Mining Rocks
description: A Game About Mining Rocks is a single-player survival game where you mine rocks, gather minerals, sell them, and upgrade your gear to explore deeper. Reach the bottom to find a legendary crystal, but be careful something down there is waiting for you.

title: Big Winner
description: In a future where the financial system has collapsed, the lottery becomes a lifeline for survival, with luck as the only currency. As an ordinary person in this predestined world, can you leverage the "Luck System" with courage and wit to rise from obscurity and attain the wealth others covet?

title: Boxboyman
description: This is an experimental game in which you deliver packages to residents in a procedurally generated town.

title: Twistingo: Blue Moon - Collector's Edition
description: Twistingo: Blue Moon is a captivating hidden-object adventure where you solve puzzles, manage resources, and rescue animals to restore the frosty island of Lunara. Uncover secrets, collect moonstones, and break the Blue Moon's icy spell in this heartwarming conservation journey.

title: Session: Skate Sim - Paris
description: Hop on your deck and cruise to Paris to check out the local skate scene! Shred in front of the Eiffel Tower and hit up Place du Trocadéro, Place de la République, and the spot by Mairie d'Ivry town hall to give your tricks some French flair.

title: Session: Skate Sim - Prague
description: Roll into Prague and hit up the city's most insane square, where locals have transformed a former mythical monument into a world-class skate mecca.

title: Flowerbud
description: A narrative-driven flower shop management and relationship sim where YOUR choices shape the town’s future. Customize your flower shop, craft unique items, and unlock different outcomes through branching dialogue and evolving relationships.

title: CLTRS
description: Sometimes to reach the climax you just need to explore...

title: The Grey Road
description: Enter a world of road trip horror in this procedurally generated driving adventure. Face hazardous environments, deadly weather, and gigantic monsters. Scavenge for supplies, navigate obstacles, and search for safehouses - but remember: you are never truly safe.

title: Little Aviary
description: Little Aviary is a relaxing idle bird collector that sits at the bottom of your screen! Hatch unique birds, sell them, decorate, then watch them fly around your screen and perch on top of your other windows!

title: Gravebind
description: Gravebind is a classic isometric (2.5d) open world adventure RPG that will take you back to 1990s nostalgia. Enjoy customizable characters, scalable difficulties, a deep story, quests, a large number of growing skills and many planned features including Multiplayer and MMO game modes.

title: UwU Hunter
description: Jump and shoot your way through challenging levels, battle formidable bosses, and unlock all the UwUs to win the heart of your Catgirl. Explore the Gallery to enjoy all the UwUs you've collected.

title: Die to Play
description: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

title: Sonic Robo Smash
description: A mod for SRB2 that converts it into a platforming fighter.

title: Mr. Ashfish's Distant Rehab
description: Mr. Ashfish's Distant Rehab is a classic Point & Click FMV adventure—straight out of the ‘90s. Live-action actors, 3D-rendered backgrounds using the latest technology available in 1995, traditional mechanics, and a gripping, irony-laced story—all come together in a game that lets players fully immerse themselves in the nostalgic world of early PC gaming. Runs on virtually any hardware!

title: Hexalith
description: Hexalith is a casual sci-fi city-building game with dynamic twists. Collect resources, complete missions, discover new city blueprints, and expand your civilization in this tile-based space odyssey.

title: Dreamlocked
description: A psychological horror game that centers on exploration, puzzle-solving, and terrifying entity encounters

title: YetiParty
description: A first-person parody horror. College goofballs are partying hard in the great outdoors - booze, boobs, and bad decisions. What's gonna kill 'em first? Cheap vodka, ancient memes, dirty jokes… or a bloodthirsty Yeti from the woods?

title: Gatebreakers
description: Gatebreakers is a Roguelike strategy card game. Lead your troops through a treacherous, ever-changing fantasy realm—recruit units, uncover artifacts, master spells, and face the ultimate battle against evil!

title: Vacuous Sugar Quest
description:
Vacuous Sugar Quest is a platformer featuring climbing and gliding mechanics.

Play as Vac, an adventurer trying to climb Sugar Mountain to prove her sugar gliding abilities!

title: The Pinkman Files
description: The Pinkman Files is a mini-game rich, fast paced, turn based combat game with a side of visual novel, that will challenge your detective skills and allow you to uncover the secrets of a peculiar town.

title: Unicycle Rage
description: A physics-based unicycle game inspired by trial bike games.

title: Endless Days Z
description: Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where you face a variety of enemies, save what is left of this world. Endless Days Z is an intense and immersive survival experience.

title: Milo's Dream
description: Milo’s Dream is an adventure game in 2D top-down perspective about a doggy called Milo who sets out on a mission to save the fairy world from the evil King Big Flea and his army of giant insects.

title: Under The Crisis: Dárlia Island Remaster
description: In the control of Nilgo, a ranger responsible for guarding the region, you will need to escape the chaos that has taken hold of the island while surviving by battling creatures that are beyond the rational comprehension of science.

title: Alien Breakout
description: Alien Breakout is a precision platformer where you control an alien that has been captured and must escape from the laboratory.

title: Super Yapori Minigames
description: Super Yapori Minigames is a singleplayer game with several minigames, different game modes, several playable characters and much more!

title: Coloring Cats: Sports With Friends
description: Help Buddy and Lucky develop their sports photos! Paint each character, color by color, pixel by pixel, in a relaxing experience full of friendship, fun, and sports!

title: Capote
description:
Capote is an online card game for 2 to 6 players that mixes classic trick-taking rules with bold bets and chaotic special cards. Each match is set around a casual card table full of colorful characters—and in Capote, no win is guaranteed, and any card can flip the game.

Players bet how many tricks they think they’ll win, then play their cards round by round to hit that number exactly. If you win more or fewer tricks than you bet, you’ll take a virtual shot for each one off. Hit four shots and… you’re out. Capotado!

If the cards aren’t in your favor, don’t worry—messing with your friends is also a valid strategy. Play your special cards at the right time to twist the odds, sabotage their bets, or turn a sure win into chaos.

title: Ghost Golfing
description: Swing on to Ghost Golfing. Build haunting mini golf courses to ricochet, blow, burn or teleport the ball right in to the hole!

title: BloodLoop
description: BloodLoop is a third-person multiplayer Hero-Shooter set in a dark, dystopian future where humanity lives across interstellar colonies following Earth's catastrophic destruction.

title: A Game About Typing The Alphabet
description: Type the alphabet as fast as possible. Even the slightest mistake will reset the game, and you have to start over. Climb the leaderboard and become the master of typing. How fast can you type?

title: April 18st
description: A short collection of interviews of the Horse Race Tests winning horses.

title: Suissinho: A Mais Louca Corrida
description:
A small game that came with a yogurt brand for the PC.

It is a simple racing game, where the player only needs to switch lanes to avoid obstacles and collect yogurts. The yogurts act as fuel, increasing how long the player has to finish the race. There are no opponents, and 8 levels.

title: Carmageddon TDR 2000: Rage-o-Rama! Special Edition
description: A standalone mod for Carmageddon 3 with a large amount of new vehicles, maps, and missions.

title: Dead on Delivery
description: Dead on Delivery is a frantic action game where a pizza delivery guy battles zombie hordes to fulfill orders in an apocalyptic world. Wield improvised weapons, dodge hazards, and race against time to avoid becoming zombie food… and keep the pizza piping hot!

title: Parkour Rewrite
description:
Parkour is a game created in 2024, the rewrite version got rewritten in mid 2025.
Climb asteroids, create maps, explore maps, shop in the item shop and more!

title: Sealubbers
description: Set sail in Sealubbers, a pirate RPG. Command your pirate ship, recruit a crew, battle and board enemy vessels, and hunt for buried treasure. Embark on quests, meet intriguing characters, and forge your legend as the most famous pirate on the high seas.

title: Death Stranding 2: On The Beach - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Death Stranding 2: On The Beach full game for PS5
• 48h early access
• Machine Gun [MP] (Lv.1) early unlock
• Patch 70: Quokka
• Patch 71: Chiral Cat
• Patch 72: Why Me?
• Battle Skeleton: Gold (Lv.1)(Lv.2)(Lv.3)
• Boost Skeleton: Gold (Lv.1)(Lv.2)(Lv.3)
• Bokka Skeleton: Gold (Lv.1)(Lv.2)(Lv.3)

title: Girth
description:
~~ It's Time To Get Girthy ~~

Girth is a parody RPG Maker turn-based adventure game where you, along with a cast of various characters from all sorts of games, embark on an adventure to save your "friend" from God's casino before he loses everything.

title: Trepang
description: Trepang is the story of Wopley the Sea Cucumber, out on an adventure to escape the endless cave. Sadly sea cucumbers aren't that smart, so Wopley doesn't realize the cave is endless. In order to "complete" his quest, Wopley must bypass countless evil Starfish, Squids, and Jellyfish blocking his path. But if he can't escape them, how can he defeat them? BY EJECTING HIS OWN ORGANS OF COURSE! Sea Cucumbers actually do that.

title: Choppy Waters
description: Sail through pirate-infested waters in this unconventional roguelike deckbuilder. Collect ingredients, craft your own sushi cards, and feed them to hungry pirates in tactical turn-based encounters. Combine active, passive, and reactive abilities to satisfy unruly customers and maximize profits.

title: The Amazing Digital Circus: Fan VN Game
description: A fangame Visual Novel adapting the pilot episode of the animated show 'The Amazing Digital Circus'.

title: Block By Block: The Amulet
description: Block By Block is an minecraft-animated series adaption of Telltale's Minecraft Story Mode video game. It'll be taking the narrative of the point-and-click adventure game, and putting it into a new medium in the form of an action-adventure, fantasy animation series! Characters, plotlines, and worlds will be reimagined into a new story that's aiming to be fresh, unique, and different to the original game in order to create a new experience for lifelong fans and newcomers alike to enjoy.

title: Tales of Meadows
description: XIII century. Eastern Europe is torn between new beliefs and old rites. Learn about the events that will change Philip - once a kind and naive young man - and turn his path into a story of pain and bitterness.

title: Robbing Time
description: An online co-op horror heist game for up to 5 players. Play as Robbers, sneak around evading Superheroes and pull off the ultimate heist! Use the loot to buy gadgets and face even stronger enemies!

title: We Have To Let You Go
description: We Have To Let You Go is a puzzle RPG game created from the ground up using the RPG Maker engine. Players will traverse several vibrant worlds interconnected by an engrossing character-driven storyline, and a strategic battle system.

title: Brainfuck Challenge
description: A minimalist programming puzzle game based on the esoteric language Brainfuck. Learn its rules, solve clever challenges, and even run your code in an external terminal.

title: The Lost Crucible
description: Race against the clock to craft and sell items for needy adventurers. Use and upgrade equipment to navigate the dozens of levels located in the unique environments of the Crucible, a forgotten arcane workshop. Craft all you can solo, or with up to four friends - local or online.

title: Fractal Odyssey
description: Fractal Odyssey is a tactical RPG about forging freedom. Guide a party of rebels to slay a dragon god and topple a tyrannical Decree. They will cross frozen wastes, enter ephemeral dreams, and face unbreakable foes. They will fall, and they will die. You must carve their future.

title: Maroxyn Drarea
description: Wield limited spells in a dead, dreamlike realm. Explore vast ruins, echoing caves, and hostile terrain. Every death resets your place in the world. No combat - just survival, exploration, and the creeping sense you're being watched.

title: Flowers and Deities
description: Flowers and Deities is a roguelite auto battler where you command a blood-soaked lizardman army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to earn the favor of the Gods.

title: Mavericks 2: Resurrection of the Repliforce:
description: A sequel to the first Mavericks game that takes place 2 years after it

title: Mavericks 3: Zero's Revenge
description: The third game in the Mavericks series

title: Berserk Boy: Collector's Edition
description:
Berserk Boy Switch Collector’s Edition Includes:

Collector’s Edition Box.
Switch Game.
Steelbook.
Double-Sided Collector Poster.

In the distant future, a mad scientist and his army of darkness seek to enslave the people of Earth. Hope for all humanity rests with The Resistance, but are they enough? Enter Kei, a rookie hero who is transformed by mysterious Orb energy into Berserk Boy!

With high-speed action and the power to defeat evil, Berserk Boy must face off against the diabolical Dr. Genos and his army of Dark Energy minions. Can he save the world before it’s too late? It’s time to go Berserk!

Features:

Unleash your ultimate form: with the power of the Berserk Orbs - Lightning, Fire, Earth, Air, and Ice - and become a force to be reckoned with.
Go Berserk! Become a master of speed and skill as you chain together combos to fill your Berserk Meter and unleash devastating special attacks! Upgrade your abilities and become an unstoppable force.
Explore the sprawling world of New Hope City and beyond, unlock hidden missions along the way.
Jump, dash, slam, and slide through multiple stages with Metroidvania elements as you discover alternate paths and hidden collectibles.
Berserk Boy brings retro gaming: into the modern age with slick and stylish platforming action. Inspired by the genre greats, you’ll be able to play for big scores and fast times in this modern adventure with a retro feel.

title: A Tiny Sticker Tale: Magic Book Edition
description:
A Tiny Sticker Tale is a cozy miniature adventure about changing the world, using the power of stickers!

In A Tiny Sticker Tale, take anything from the world around you, turn it into a sticker, and use your creativity to stick it back in different places, solving puzzles, and helping your new friends!

Magic Book Edition includes:

Base game
Artbook
Sticker set

title: Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Edition
Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition
description:
Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition - Switch - Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition Includes: the Physical Game, Anniversary Collector’s Box, Instruction Booklet, Steelbook, Double CD Original Soundtrack, Serialised Certificate of Authenticity and 3 Alternative Inlays.

Step into the enchanting world of Touhou Luna Nights! Experience a Metroidvania adventure that combines the captivating universe of the Touhou Project with unique gameplay mechanics. As Sakuya Izayoi, the time-stopping maid, explore a mysterious world filled with danger and secrets. Utilise the innovative time stop ability, master the graze system, and uncover the mysteries behind Remilia Scarlet's strange new world. With stunning pixel art and fluid animations, this game offers both fans and newcomers a thrilling 2D action experience that’s as beautiful as it is challenging.

title: Block 17
description: Block 17 is a sci-fi action game in pixel art style with many different and unique enemies, and an oppressive atmosphere of a terrible prison for especially dangerous criminals. What happened here? How do you get out? Try to answer these questions yourself.

title: Graveyard Keeper: Undead Edition
description:
Graveyard Keeper is a darkly humorous medieval cemetery management simulation where you build and manage a graveyard, while balancing business growth with ethical dilemmas. As the "Graveyard Keeper," you'll gather resources, craft items, and explore the land for new opportunities, all while facing tough decisions, like whether to sell organs to the butcher or spend money on a festival. The game also features dungeon exploration and a quirky love story.

The Undead Edition includes several DLCs:

Breaking Dead: Automate tasks by creating an army of undead workers to gather materials, craft items, and run logistics chains for profit.

Game of Crone: Help escaped prisoners survive and build a camp, protect them from a vampire, and uncover ancient secrets. Offers 6-12 hours of extra gameplay.

Stranger Sins: Dive into the backstory of NPCs, run your own tavern, and unlock new quests and mechanics. Features 4-8 hours of extra gameplay.

The game combines resource management, ethical choices, quirky characters, and unexpected twists, with a touch of dark humor and a lot of capitalism.

title: Gris: Deluxe Edition
description:
GRIS Devolver Deluxe Edition Contents:
• Physical Nintendo Switch or PlayStation 5 game
• 100+ page artbook
• Official soundtrack CD
• Collectible box

GRIS is a narrative-driven platformer about a young girl processing emotional pain. As she journeys through a stylized world, her dress grants new abilities that help her navigate and understand her experience. The game offers a peaceful, artistic exploration with light puzzles and platforming, designed to be accessible to all players regardless of language. The experience focuses on emotional growth and discovery without traditional game challenges like death or frustration.

title: Stickforge
description: Stickforge is a fun, physics-based 2D sandbox moddable stickman game. Create your own maps, items, and skins; challenge and build with other players.

title: Legacy of Kain Soul Reaver 1&2 Remastered - Deluxe Edition
description:
Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered is a collection of remastered versions of Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver and Soul Reaver 2. The games follow the vampire-turned-wraith Raziel and his conflict with his former master Kain, combining exploration, combat, environmental puzzles, and the ability to shift between the Material and Spectral Realms.

The collection features higher-resolution textures, updated character and environment models, improved visual effects, an upgraded camera, new control options, a map and compass, photo mode, and the ability to switch between the original and remastered graphics. It also includes bonus materials such as concept art, lore, soundtracks, and explorable areas cut from the original Soul Reaver.

The Deluxe Edition includes the following exclusive items:
• Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
• Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
• Steelbook with some of the game’s motifs.
• A soft-bound artbook highlighting the game’s remastered gothic environments, architecture, characters, enemies, weapons, and concept & key art.
• The official soundtrack on a physical CD.
• A collectible tuck-in box housing all the contents.

title: The Cub: Back to Earth Edition
description:
The Cub is a challenging platformer inspired by classic ’90s SEGA games, blending nostalgic gameplay with modern twists. Set in a post-apocalyptic Earth, players navigate parkour-style through the ruins of humanity, outsmarting evolved wildlife, solving clever environmental puzzles, and evading relentless human hunters in a deadly safari chase.

The Cub: Back to Earth Edition Includes: Special Case, Nintendo Switch Game, Artbook and Digital Soundtrack.

title: The Lingering: Graveyard Visit
description: (The Lingering) Graveyard Visit is a horror, walking sim game where you play as Eki, an 11-year-old boy who visits his late father’s grave with his mother while finding out the truth about her and the rumor about child sacrificial ritual. Should Eki trust his mother? You decide.

title: Disc Golf City
description: Sling discs through stylized cityscapes in this casual, physics-based disc golf game. Aim for the basket or rack up trick shots by bouncing discs off rooftops, signs, and benches in colorful urban environments.

title: The Silent Witness
description: You’re a detective tracking a brutal murder. The forest holds the documents. The warehouse hides the body. Evidence in hand, you head back—but the forest has changed. The path is gone. Something’s watching. And it doesn’t want you to leave.

title: Extreme Delivery
description: This is why your packages are always late! Run and jump your way to a job well done by delivering items as fast as possible. Dodge falling objects, explosions, and gigantic hammers along the way. Proceed with caution though... losing any items may result in an unhappy customer!

title: QuackSquad
description: Join our fearless feathered hero on an epic adventure to defend their pond from an invasion of zombie chickens spawned by sinister fast-food joints lurking nearby. In this thrilling top-down shooter, arm yourself to the beak with an arsenal of weapons as you face off against relentless waves of undead poultry and formidable bosses. But fear not, for you are not alone! Level up your duck, recruit loyal companions, and engage in exciting minigames to bolster your forces.

title: Incident X
description: Face the end in a high-intensity cinematic sci-fi shooter. Engage a colossal threat, rescue civilians, and survive relentless enemy waves in a city collapsing under the weight of the unknown. Your squad is the last line between humanity and total annihilation.

title: Stranger Saga: Stranger Bach and Iskiyeld's Ambition
description: Stranger Saga is a turn-based SRPG where you lead a resistance army against a mighty enemy force. Raise citizens into elite warriors and conquer challenging strategy battles!

title: Still Space
description: Still Space is a 2D action Metroidvania with resource management, circuit-based systems, and tactical gunfights. Explore a decaying research facility, restore power to key systems, and stay alive long enough to uncover what went wrong.

title: Ohayou, Shiramura-san!
description:
It's another ordinary day of your life.

Your kids go to school and leave you alone again. As you tidy up their room, you wonder why they spend so much time playing games. What fun can there be in sitting all day? That's when a fairy appears and decides to show you why, sucking you into one of your daughter's games!

title: Space Domination
description: Space Domination is a 2D online tick-based multiplayer strategy game. Based on the 2000's Hit Star Dart from Fred's Friends.

title: Rusty Heights
description:
You play as the last functional robot of your kind. Equipped only with your grappling hook, you will have to overcome the obstacles of a dying world and reach the summit. Remember : The higher you go, the greater the fall !

Rusty Heights is an experimental 2D platformer meant for hardcore players and speedrunners. It is playable with the mouse only and is made of a single very high level to be climbed without ever falling down. Get ready for a very challenging experience and great replayability thanks to the world leaderboard and the shareable ghost demo files !

Be brave little robot ! Every fall will only make you stronger !

title: Arcade Archives: Strategy X
description: Will you go for the aggressive approach or the cautious approach?

title: Giant Flee
description: Run for your life and never look back!

title: Knight Quest: Goblins Raid
description: An epic adventure that will test your courage

title: Medieval Escape
description: Medieval Escape is a third-person adventure game. The protagonist is a young woman trapped in an ancient medieval labyrinth. To survive, she must avoid deadly traps and find a way out.

title: Pixicharm: Gravenguard
description:
Slay skeletons and goblins in nonstop action!
In this fast-paced 2D action game, you control a fearless knight battling endless enemies across shifting platforms. Time your strikes, stay on the move, and see how long you can survive the onslaught!

title: Supermarket Manager 2025
description: Full carts, zero patience.

title: Dark Dolls
description: Many slightly dark and troubled, yet cute idols appear! An easy puzzle game anyone can play!

title: Mind & Sight Spot the Difference Workout
description: Challenge your eyes and brain with a slightly tricky spot-the-difference game!

title: Eggconsole Mado Monogatari 1-2-3 MSX2
description: A comical 3D RPG featuring a unique worldview and system. Join Arle Nadja, a girl aspiring to become a sorceress, as she adventures through three scenarios!

title: Fast Striker EX
description: Fast Striker EX is a 2D CGI arcade shooting game with emphasis on scoring.

title: 3 Card Poker
description: Experience Casino Thrills Anytime, Anywhere!

title: CarsWheels
description: Wreck the house in some seriously mad racing!

title: Aery: Titans of the Future
description: Soar through a futuristic world, glide past robots, and explore high-tech landscapes in Aery - Titans of the Future!

title: Hentai Girls: Charming Chef
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Stuff It!
description: Colorful dolls with voluptuous bodies can come to life, don't you know? All they need to do is meet their Maker. Are you ready?

title: Train Plus
description: The ultimate railway driving game has arrived! Experience mind-blowing speeds over 1000km/h or enjoy complete freedom in Free Drive!

title: Tralalero Tralala: Rage Bait!
description: Lose your mind and maybe even your voice in this brutally challenging 2D platformer featuring an unusually emotional shark with a short fuse and a long jump.

title: My Cozy Room: Mediterranean
description: Design and decorate your dream space in this relaxing sandbox game! Choose from multiple room layouts, arrange over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, and craft the perfect cozy atmosphere that matches your style.

title: My Cozy Room All in one
Crayon Dino
description: A creative coloring experience for everyone from children to adults. Show off your completed masterpieces to your family.

title: My Cozy Room: Cottagecore
description: Design and decorate your dream space in this relaxing sandbox game! Choose from multiple room layouts, arrange over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, and craft the perfect cozy atmosphere that matches your style.

title: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku - "Too Real"
description: Face your demons with the official Rhythm Rift for "Too Real" by Danny Baranowky feat. Hatsune Miku! This track is part of the Hatsune Miku Music Pack.

title: Regarding Sasha
description:
Sasha leads a quiet, love-filled life, cherishing each day with her child. But her peaceful routine is suddenly disrupted.
Unsettling memories from the past begin to resurface, and Sasha’s perfect world starts to crack. Strange visits. Unanswered questions. A growing sense of something being wrong...

title: Scratch Inc.
description:
Build an Empire, From Scratch.
Scratch cards, earn points, and grow your empire in this idle/incremental game. Upgrade your cards, unlock automation, prestige across industries, and climb the leaderboards.

title: Desktop Waifu
description: This is an idle game. By idling in the game, you can unlock new outfits—and once unlocked, you can switch to them anytime.

title: Break-a-Bot
description: Defend your spaceship in Break-a-Bot, a vibrant roguelike where you battle cyborg raiders and customize your playstyle by scavenging enemy parts. Swap body parts in fast-paced combat to adapt and survive. Protect your home and become the galaxy’s most fearsome little robot!

title: Katharsi
description: Katharsi is a puzzle adventure set in a corrupted Byzantine cathedral. With the help of your companion, cleanse and illuminate the path in front of you by harnessing the power of the light. Solve the puzzles that block your path and reveal the truth behind this story.

title: Mindsight
description: Mindsight is a minimalistic evolution of a match-3 game. The goal of the game is to find all sets of three adjacent symbols whose characteristics either match or differ. Each symbol has three characteristics: Color, Shape, and Shading. The color can be blue, green, or red. The shape can be a triangle, a circle, or a square. And the shading can be solid, striped, or empty. Each of these characteristics either need to be the same or different for three consecutive horizontal or vertical symbols to make a set. You beat the level when you've found all possible sets on the board.

title: Pera Coda
description: Pera Coda is a narrative mystery adventure about a man trapped between life and death. To escape, he must face his past, confront buried traumas, and stand trial for the life he lived. Set in Istanbul, it blends psychological drama, branching dialogue, and puzzles in a journey of self-discovery.

title: Chinchón
description: Enjoy the classic Chinchón card game with the Spanish deck. Play solo or with friends, online or offline. HD graphics, multiple game modes, customizable rules, and a full tutorial to learn or improve your strategy.

title: Heist.exe
description: A sci-fi stealth game in which you must infiltrate digital facilities, steal back the possessions within, and escape without being seen. Along the way, you'll find switches that alter your path through the facility. Activate them on your own or with the stolen possession!

title: Vegas Craps by Pokerist
description: Play real casino craps in 3D and enjoy realistic physics and multiplayer mode. Feel the thrill of competition, immerse yourself in the casino atmosphere and try your luck!

title: Baccarat Online: Baccarist
description: Favored by the highest of high rollers, baccarat is one of the world's oldest and most popular card games. The aim of the game is to guess who will hit the highest hand value, which in this game is 9. Feel the risk as you dive into the casino atmosphere and hit the big time!

title: Lil' Snot: Moon Escape
description: Lil' Snot: Moon Escape is a difficult, minimalist, precision-platformer. Sling yourself with mouse controls through 5 levels with unique mechanics each to test your capabilities. Try to beat my fastest finish time of 2:39!

title: The Solitude Project
description: The Solitude Project is a complete rework of A Liminal Place Legacy (also known as Remastered). Find your way to the next level, do whatever you want! But remember... you will never find the exit.

title: Midnight Riff
description: Unlike anything seen before, Midnight Riff is a true rhythm roguelike. Vibe to the rhythm and jam out to deal damage and win battles with the unique active-time rhythm battle system. Can you become the rhythm of the night?

title: To Grant a Wish
description: In 'To Grant A Wish' you play as a Minor Deity, whose presence has been fading due to a lack of worship. One day, you receive an offering on your shrine that grants you more power than you have had in a century, and you set out, determined to grant their wish...

title: Rioo
description: The goddess of water who summoned you is nowhere to be found. Facing a tidal wave of monsters, you must join forces with other brave people who were summoned like you to repel them! Find the best combination of various strange weapons to survive the waves of attacks!

title: Rake In: Scoring Big With Monster Girls!
description: For generations, a legend has been passed down about the mysterious Treasure Island. The island is home to a vast amount of gold... and it could be yours for the taking! Embark on a Monster Girl-catching escapade as you uncover secrets in a riveting search for riches!

title: Ultimate Sonic Smackdown
description: Fight as Sonic and his friends in epic 3-vs-3 tag team battles in ULTIMATE SONIC SMACKDOWN, a FREE fan-made fighter by passionate fans of the series. Also includes Rollback Netcode!

title: Hungry for Applez
description: Click apples, trade up, and grow your orchard! Collect apples by tapping, then exchange or trade with other players to unlock higher-tier apples. Simple, addictive, and full of juicy rewards!

title: Nitro Battle Racing
description: Overtake and blast away your opponents in Nitro Battle Racing! In this arcade action racer, you will compete in exhilarating races using a variety of powerups and abilities to surpass the competition. Unlock new maps through your accomplishments and become the ultimate racer.

title: Sounds of Her Love 2
description: A cute romance visual novel set at an international school in Japan. As you approach the final hours of your school years together, help your sweet but shy girlfriend Ceri overcome her fears to be able to play the harp at the school's graduation ceremony. A tender, wholesome love story awaits.

title: Nyxerion
description: In Nyxerion, the gods have chosen you, not for their glory but for their amusement. Fight for your survival, wielding mystical powers in ruthless arenas. Challenge friends and foes in epic battles under the gods' cruel gaze. Will you fall, or will you rise to triumph?

title: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition
description:
Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

The Enhanced Edition improves upon the original release by supporting 4K resolution at 60 FPS and enhancing visual effects, including RTX reflections, improved water effects, additional particles, and volumetric lighting.

It also offers players the option to choose between Quality Mode or Performance Mode, allowing them to prioritize either visual fidelity or frame rate based on their preferences.

title: Hope: A Potato Story
description: Nice, simple and cute top down shooter action. Save the kingdom from the all consuming curse you are not the first to try and will not be the last.
