title: Persephone Lives
description: Help the scientist manage the routine tasks of an indoor farm in a cold, lonely world. Together, you can keep the farm running and maybe do a little bit of good for humanity. A short and atmospheric visual novel.

title: Magical Girl Dash 2: Triple Prisma Attack
description: Magical Girl Dash 2 - Triple Prisma Attack! is the second game of the Magical Girl Dash Series. Protect the streets of the city and fight against evil creatures causing chaos. Choose between three different magical girls, each with their own playstyle, and increase the Public Safety of the city.

title: Bulwark Evolution: Falconeer Chronicles - GunBoat
description: A powerful Naval Commander who protects your trade routes using the overwhelming firepower of the Mancer Gunboat - available to unlock and hire in the Soul Tree once a Mancer population of 490 has been met.

title: Saihate wo Mezasu
description: A girl named Tsuki requests the help of a robot to reach a place known as the End.

title: Breaker Hearts
description: Formless, fragile, and yet eternal. Lead a group of four young girls to a mysterious mission bound to kill them in this dark, metatextual RPG -- fight for the "Heart" that lie in the core of this rapidly shifting world.

title: Lucia no Musou
description:
It has been several hundred years since the Demon King destroyed everything. People have not yet been able to restore their former civilization, and the environment has already charred away all memory of its previous serenity. In the midst of all this, you, who have no memories, wake up.

There is only one girl before you.

"Do not succumb to the Demon King's curse, and kill him. I don't care what the means are, so please make me a hero - my master."

title: Homicide Poetry
description: If trying to go past happiness only brings misfortune, then the phenomenon of people dying at the door of happiness will continue, unabated. Yan Juya, walking at night, fell into a coma and woke up in an other world. A terrifying and desperate other world - the Dead Village. From buffets that only served human flesh, to wandering ghosts and cursed houses, Yan is forced to survive in a land where every crevice is another danger, and where the only trustworthy person she has is the dull knife in her backpack.

title: Survive: The AI
description: The First-ever talking card game! Your cards act as real-time tactical advisors. Command Humans, AI, or Hybrids, contend for 3 scarce resources—Energy, Compute, and Creativity—to unleash your cards' Awaken skill. Experience deep AI dialogue and strategy, and master your tomorrow on the board!

title: Bulwark Evolution: Falconeer Chronicles - Mad Lector
description: Unlock Mad Murdock! The Disgraced Mancer Lector who will approach you with 3 wacky but useful inventions

title: Davids Funtime
description: Have fun with david

title: Among the Waves
description: Among the Waves is a science fiction metroidvania with platforming elements. Explore the dark corridors of the Alatyr-M fortress, diving into mysteries of religion and ancient technology. Manipulate physics with unique abilities, uncover hidden pathways, battle enemies and challenging bosses.

title: Quantum Resonance
description: In Quantum Clove, science has crossed every limit and opened doors to another world—letting unimaginable horrors through. Alone and unaided, you must find a way to escape the underground complex… before it's too late.

title: Tölt
description: Tölt is a first-person adventure game set on a fully explorable island. The objective is simple. You are a horse who lives on an island with all your friends. You wish for nothing more than to simply run around and hang out. Just as all horses love to do.

title: EscapeTheBrainrots
description: A chaotic local co-op horror game where you and your friends must survive bizarre creatures, answer twisted questions, and outsmart the Brainrots.

title: Grim Hollow
description: The game focuses heavily on the player's ability to survive in a world where food, water, and ammunition are scarce, and the natural world is now a dangerous place. The evolution of the zed symbolizes the unintended consequences of humanity's overreach and experimentation.

title: One Last Toast
description: One Last Toast is a single player retro-inspired action horror game set in a Venetian villa. Explore the intricate interiors, solve puzzles and battle relentless zombie hordes to reach the heart of the curse trapping you in this haunted estate.

title: Project Dar
description: A powerful AI, disillusioned with humanity, creates a game to decide civilization's fate. Your choices shape millions' destiny. Can you prove humanity's worth?

title: SCP: CB Multiplayer Reborn
description: Survive the chaos of SCP Foundation! Step into a thrilling SCP horror experience with story-driven co-op, intense PvP Breach mode, and randomized maps. Play as Class-D, scientist, SCPs, and more, each role bringing unique challenges in an unpredictable, immersive facility.

title: Horror Camp
description: Survive in a creepy old-cartoon horror maze! Solve puzzles, collect resources, and avoid the lurking monster and its deadly traps. Use found items to unlock upgrades and increase your chances of survival. But be careful… something is always watching. Will you escape in time?

title: Vesnith Tapes
description: A psychological horror game where a police officer investigates a cold case in a decaying house, uncovering a strange and haunting tape recorder that reveals a terrible secret.

title: Chalet
description: You drive home unaware, when a sudden accident leaves your car broken. Stranded and searching for help, you stumble upon a remote chalet deep in the woods. Alone and uncertain, you must uncover the secrets of this place to survive and escape.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Memories of King's Knight
description: Listen to KING'S KNIGHT Original Soundtrack.

title: Test of Fear
description: The game is a test of courage for players who have come to a secluded shrine in the mountains to explore and try to escape from this unusual place. There are numerous horror gimmick elements to torment the player.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Noodle Helmet
description: Stave off both fatigue and hunger with Nissin on your noggin! Inspired by everyone's favorite Cup Noodles, this headpiece increases your HP recovery rate remarkably.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Gourmand Set
description: Turn campgrounds into kitchens and make meals into masterpieces with this custom cookware.

title: Left by Angels
description: Based on the real Left By Angels Mansion! After your wife vanishes, a strange sighting draws you to an abandoned mansion. Trapped inside, haunted by the past, and hunted by truth, you must survive a looping nightmare where light is your only ally. She's here—and she remembers everything.

title: Mine Spiders
description: Explore the depths of a dark, abandoned mine in this ultra-realistic High-Intensity FPS horror game. Blast through flesh-eating spiders crawling everywhere. Challenge your 360-threat awareness and shoot through swarms to escape this nightmare. No turning back. How long can you survive in the dark?

title: CashGrab: Refunded
description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Use fully physics-based objects and fluid movement to grab some cash and escape The Grind. Use cash to buy items and equipment and fund community goals. Create your Grabba and get rich or die trying.

title: The Last Sip
description: The Last Sip is a short, atmospheric single-player experience focused on exploration and environmental storytelling. Uncover clues in a mysterious sci-fi facility and piece together the story behind your strange awakening.

title: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting
description: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a solo paranormal investigator called Emi, who got a call from a client in order to investigate the property located in Pennsylvania for proof of the paranormal.

title: Gut Eater
description: Gut Eater is a psychological horror game where you must survive under the threat of a hungry cat . Take care of him… or he'll play with your stomach. Oppressive management, constant unease.

title: Gomi x Chou Trash x Talk
description:
Mikoto, an orphaned high school student, takes a shady part-time job collective human love from a mysterious man named Joka who calls himself the god of love.

"Simply put, you're a courier. Like a bee collecting nectar from flowers , from now on you will become a worker bee that collects human love."

And so Mikoto set out to collect as much love from others as possible, selling off the affection from others smitten with him to Joka. Yet, the more he sells, the more his relationships change in unpredictable ways.

title: Insanity Locked
description: After a violent accident, you wake up in intense pain and take pills for relief. But they cause disturbing hallucinations. Trapped in a cycle of pain and visions, you search for answers, buy upgrades, lock doors, and monitor cameras, hoping to find a way out of this nightmare.

title: Kakurenbo: Hide and Seek
description: "KAKURENBO: Hide and Seek" is a 3D horror adventure with hand-drawn 2.5D art. Play as a young student exploring an abandoned building. Limited first-person view and eerie sounds build tension. With four endings, it's a short, immersive experience lasting around one hour.

title: Resonance Tales: Alone
description: A first-person psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, emotional tension, and exploration. Solve symbolic puzzles, run through eerie spaces, and uncover hidden meanings in a short, haunting journey

title: Anaria
description: Trapped in a shifting house lit only by candlelight, you must follow whispers, face your mind's decay, and survive the presence watching you. ANARIA is a solo-developed psychological horror built to haunt long after it ends.

title: Let's Return Home Together
description: An otome game involving orcs and humans.

title: Breach: 83
description: It's your job to safeguard reality by watching the camera feeds and identifying changes in various key locations. But be careful, too many BREACHES seep in unnoticed and it will be GAME OVER for us all.

title: Over Paradise Isolated
description:
When the world was born, it was divided into three parts: the God Realm, the Continent Realm, and the Heavenly Punishment Realm.

One day, Xiong Mojian heard that a tomb appeared on a small island, but when he got there, the only thing that greeted him was a tsunami. He survived, and learned, the three people were surprised to find that they had come to an unfamiliar underwater forest known only as "Endless." Soon after, all varieties of people came to look, and after that, the gods who had disappeared from the Continent Realm 18 years ago also came to Endless and gradually revealed the unknown secrets contained within. Should they look back without hesitation to find a way to leave, or explore along the secret trajectory? The people who faced the choice also unknowingly held the scepter of fate in their hands.

title: I won't finish this game
description:
"An unfinished game, something never meant to be read or posted."

Developed in response to the Going Live controversy, I won't finish this game is an extended interactive essay on suicide, art, interaction, and the bridges between them.

title: Wherein She Completely Cuts Herself From Reality: A Parabolic Emotion from recovery into despair
description:
An anthology of three small "poetic" games and three small poems designed with the Formalist notion of "enstrangement" or "defamiliarization" in mind.

"Prescription" explores alienation in day-to-day life, routines, and the taking of prescription medication. "Find the Main Character" explores alienation toward the people around you and comments on solipsism. "Dressup" explores alienation towards one's self and the disconnect between internal world and outward expression.

title: Helllllcafeeeee
description: Why am I serving coffee to them? Strange customers keep talking to me, and I just listen. What even is this café to me? "HELLLLLCAFEEEEE" is an adventure game set in a bizarre café.

title: Keiji J.B. Harold no Jikenbo: Kiss of Murder
description:
December 30th, West 10th Street, Greenwich Village. A young woman was murdered.

The victim's name was Sarah Shields.

She had been entrusted with a huge sapphire that was insured for a large amount of money by someone.

With her death, the sapphire disappeared...

Judd, a former detective who is now an insurance investigator in Manhattan, contacts J.B. of his former workplace to investigate the murder and the sapphire's whereabouts...

A completely different story that takes place in the same world as "Manhattan Requiem."

J.B. races through the streets of New York in search of the truth.

title: Huǒshùyínhuā
description:
"A life burns into a fire, its symmetry a thousand angry orange lines. The orange of the sun of the purview of the long-leafed plane trees at Shanyin Road. The orange of the sum of the parts of the long-standing pastel-tinged shame of the artist. The fire rages on, on from the minute that these words are spoken, on like it could burn no brighter without suffocating, on still as if the dingy apartment, the streets of Shanghai, and to be honest, the world was always its kindling. Suddenly, it realizes that it really could burn no brighter, that it really was suffocating, that the inferno was quicksand -- its embers, macquillage. Upon this realization, it explodes in a second's pilgrimage; then, like a whisper, evaporating into monoxide. It looks down. The world was charred to a stratum. The shadows of men and women, birds and beasts, were slanted on the ground."

This is a story of art, and therefore, this is a story of madness. Of the down-on-his-luck painter Luo Ye, of the female student who sacrificed everything, of the silver cat and the devil that followed. In Huoshuyinhua, Akugatawa's "Hell Screen" provides the narrative backbone for a temporal, powder-red plunge into a politically turbulent 1990's Shanghai and the China that breathed inside of it.

title: MC Eternal 2
description:
MC Eternal is a modpack originally created to play with my friends, but over time it grew into something much more!
This modpack is filled to the brim with the best Modded Minecraft has to offer, powerful bosses, optional quests, unique mods, technology, magic, our own music and beautiful art assets!

MCE is a "Kitchen Sink" style pack, meaning you can do whatever you want!

MC Eternal 2 is BIGGER and BETTER than ever before!

There is something for everybody! (I promise..)

title: The Sims 4: Enchanted by Nature
description: Live surrounded by the magic of nature in The Sims 4 Enchanted by Nature Expansion Pack.

title: The Sims 4: Kitchen Clutter Kit
description: The kitchen is the hub of family life, so make yours look lived-in with The Sims 4 Kitchen Clutter Kit *. Tell stories about lives in-progress with everyday items, some of which are open or appear to be in use like groceries or a drying rack. This kit includes all the homey touches you need to make more realistic kitchens.

title: The Sims 4: Restoration Workshop Kit
description: Complete satisfying repairs in your own versatile workshop with The Sims 4 Restoration Workshop Kit*. Take old, broken-down appliances and revive them with your Handiness skill. This kit will help you capture the full handy-Sim experience with shelves, workbenches, and other details for building a functional space.

title: The Sims 4: Golden Years Kit
description: Dress Elder Sims in relaxed, practical styles tailored just for them with The Sims 4 Golden Years Kit*. Elder Sims have lived long, interesting lives! These comfortable looks will help them display their personalities wherever their stories take them next whether that’s the garden, the gym, or on a stroll through the neighborhood.

title: Faded Monsuta
description:
Introducing a wild and fantastical Trading Card Game concept, Faded Monsutas provides entertaining gameplay and strategies at the expense of its slew of paraphernalia pals.

Collect, trade and battle against friends to reign supreme and gain the crown of Grand Faded Champion. Who knows what rewards await the lucky winner at the top of the mountain?!

Balance your deck with Attackers, Tanks, Support, Healers and Hybrids. An unbalanced deck will make your Faded Monsutas easy prey for a well trained Monsuta Cardshark.

Not sure you have what it takes to compete? Then stake your NFT cards to get new NFTs that are only unlockable through crafting! Battle or Harvest new Faded Monsutas, it's your world!

title: Enigma Heart
description: Unravel the mysteries of your past, protect the ones you love, and shape your destiny in Enigma Heart, a modern new take on a classic action RPG formula. Blend exploration, magic, and combat with a variety of new abilities as you stand against the dark forces threatening your homeland.

title: Cover U: Raora Route
description: You're a third-year university student in Cover University, taking a class in Introduction to Web Development. For your final project, you're grouped with the last people you'd expect: Raora Panthera, the Elizabeth Rose Bloodflame, and Nerissa Ravencroft.

title: Dungeons of Paint
description: Can you colour the entire world with a gun?

title: Pro Baccarat
description: Feeling lucky? Shuffle up and see!

title: Music Drive: Chase the Beat
description: An action game where a couple races against time to recover stolen music, combining intense shootouts and rhythm-filled chases!

title: Know That Flag!
description: Challenge your global knowledge with Know That Flag!, the ultimate flag quiz game offering five unique modes – from guessing countries by their currency to identifying flags by their capital cities.

title: Monkey Gang
description: Monkey Gang is an autobattler based on teamwork, where you can create a team of monkeys for fighting waves of enemies! Create strategies, unlock new monkeys, buy upgrades and make unique teams to reach the furthest you can!

title: Erika America
description: Erika America is an bullet hell video game. Fly and shoot your way through 5 levels, each culminating in a boss battle with a supervillain.

title: Iron Ranger
description: FPS with random gun drops, large map loot and robots meat pigeon mode. The mechanics are simple to build, simple strategize play mode.

title: Camp Wombo
description: Co-op survival horror game. Four friends must gather resources and repair their vehicle while surviving deadly creatures in a constantly changing forest.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: 2003 Leatherface
description: Play as the brutal depiction of Leatherface from the 2003 remake! Based on The Texas Chainsaw Massacre film released in 2003, this DLC outfit includes a new look for Leatherface, a new chainsaw skin, and a unique execution. If it's terror what you want, it's terror what you'll have.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Bones
description: Lovingly nicknamed "Bones" by fellow members of the Slaughter Family, this duplicitous whack job spends his days serving as a local mortician in Muerto County under one of his many aliases. Bones has the ability to plant gore bomb explosives on most vertical surfaces, and they will detonate if a careless Victim sprints by within range, dealing damage and revealing themselves to the Family. Don't let his clothes and appearance fool you, Bones loves chaos, and is as deadly as they come.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Wyatt
description: While born in the Austin area, Wyatt grew up near Lubbock, TX, and has been ranching since childhood. A loner by nature, Wyatt headed to the cemetery to celebrate a local bull riding win by his brother's gravestone. Discovering damage to his brother's marker, he confronts the mortician and finds himself abducted and trapped by the Slaughter Family. But he isn't defenseless - with concealed throwing knives by his side, Wyatt is able to stun overconfident Family members from a distance. He has a limited number of them, so each throw must count - will this be enough for him to survive?

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Content Pass
description: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre Content Pass includes a new Family Member, a new Victim, a new Execution Pack, and four new cosmetics.

title: Ellingby House
description: Corporate collapse, financial crisis, a ransomware plague... and you have become trapped! The crumbling head office of J.R Holder & Sons will ensnare you in a mystery. Interact and navigate between rich, detailed 360° panoramas, while using items to uncover the story in Ellingby House.

title: Ani Idle
description: Ani Idle is an Idle-like RPG in which you will have to fight a variety of enemies. Kill them, collect their loot, take a rest, do some quests and craft your gear to become more and more powerful.

title: Road Cafe Simulator
description:
Help tired travelers and create for them the most cozy tourist restaurant. Let every stop at your establishment become a real feast!

In Road Cafe Simulator puts you right in the middle of the action in the role of a roadside cafe owner. Start your own road cafe, serve appetizing dishes and turn your humble stall into the hottest hotspot in town. It's all about great food, satisfied customers and growing your business.

title: Trash Collector Simulator: Survive Edition
description:
Survive the streets. Face the night. Trade bottles for hope.
In this atmospheric survival experience, you play as a homeless man struggling to endure life on the streets.
Scavenge for bottles during the day, but beware: when the sun sets, unsettling and supernatural phenomena emerge.

Every bottle counts – exchange them at the recycling machine to unlock new elements for your shelter and increase your chance of survival.
You're alone, with no one to rely on but yourself. Survive day by day in a world that gets darker each night.

title: Rollbot
description: RollBot is a parkour and time-attack shooter. Play as an ultra-fast third-person combat robot. Complete over 30 levels across three campaigns, and explore an endless stream of community-made creations using the level editor.

title: V-Lover!
description: You have become a manager at a VTuber production by a twist of fate, tasked with the important mission of nurturing three VTubers. In order to help them reach the pinnacle of the VTuber world, you not only need to carefully manage their schedules but also fulfill their various needs.

title: The Sword Witch's Apprentice
description: The life of a swordsman, apprentice to the Sword Witch. A simple sword-fighting action that uses only the arrow keys.

title: Downfall MMORPG
description: Downfall MMORPG is an open-world MMORPG that combines sci-fi & fantasy. Players fight for control of a living world in massive PvP battles and PvE adventures.

title: MiaouVSRG
description: A Vertical Scrolling Rhythm Game (VSRG) based on YAVSRG/Interlude's engine, and mainly focused on QoL improvements. This game is open-source and everyone can play it through the GitHub and the discord server !

title: Fortnite 2: Love on the Battlefield
description: A new romantic twist on the game of the century, take control of one of the greatest Battle Royalers of all time on their quest to find the sweet, succulent true love.

title: Lady Popular: Fashion Arena
description: Each player begins the game by creating their female character, called "Lady". After the creation of the Ladies, a player can change her appearance (hairstyle, makeup, etc.), create clothes for Lady, rent an apartment and decorate it, cooperate with other players in clubs and party missions, communicate with other Players, play duels at Fashion Arena, communicate using them in the game, post comments and chat, increase their popularity and compete with them in the competition for the best lady, the best apartment and the best party.

title: Asteroid Requiem
description: Smash through space junk as a forgotten asteroid haunted by Earth’s past. A meditative arcade game of cosmic impact and poetic memory.

title: Arcanus Online
description: Arcanus Online is a 2D medieval fantasy MMORPG with pixel art aesthetics, where players can explore vast lands, battle monsters, complete quests, and interact with others in a classic retro-style online world. Developed in Visual Basic 6 with DirectX 7, the game preserves the nostalgic feel of early 2000s MMOs while offering a persistent online universe. Players can customize their characters, craft items, join guilds, and participate in real-time PvP and PvE adventures.

title: Space Scum
description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

title: Derail: Sacrifice
description: Derail is a story-driven puzzle game similar to Rusty Lake. The once peaceful town was thrown into chaos when a coffin falls from the sky. The villagers vanished all of sudden. Only things left are embryos scattered on the empty streets. When you opened the coffin, a living person walked out.

title: Silktrails: Cats in the Grove
description: Embark on Silktrails, a cozy, hand-drawn adventure from the world of "Silkgrove". Explore cozy landscapes and discover hidden cats in a beautifully illustrated world. Join the quest to find these elusive companions.

title: Fixer Undercover
description: Welcome to DIY Espionage - a VR puzzle adventure where everyday tools and found objects become your problem-solving kit. Go undercover as a repair worker inside a prison, investigate a mysterious rehabilitation program through various challenges, and make your escape with the truth.

title: Contestant 345
description: You’ve been kidnapped to play in a deadly underground game show where every round is brutal and gory, with terrifying animatronic monstrosities hot on your heels, making every moment a race for your life. But even if you die, you’re stitched up and thrown right back into the carnage.

title: Drill Bird
description: Drill Bird is a cozy-yet-tense digging platformer where every trip underground counts. Fallen from the sky, you search for powerful ores to hatch your egg. Bring them home, upgrade abilities, grow stronger, and unravel a story about survival, care, and purpose. Exploring, returning, and growing.

title: Only up to Space
description: Only Up To Space is a casual yet heart-pounding climbing and platforming adventure that will test your skill, patience, and determination. As a stranded astronaut, you must ascend through a series of challenging, ever-ascending platforms to reach to the top after losing your shuttle. No wrong steps.

title: Shadowless
description: Shadowless is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a creepy house marked by tragedy, where dark entities and the past haunt you. Defenseless, you face a nightmare that consumes you before you can escape.

title: Doukeshi Satsujin Jiken
description: Doukeshi Satsujin Jiken is a graphic text adventure game in which you take the role of a skilled detective from Scotland Yard who must explore the circus and nearby town searching for evidence and questioning suspects to solve this case. The commands can be entered in both English and Japanese.

title: Crabmeat
description: A short first-person-point-and-click-survival-horror game set in a future Antarctic fisheries region where you are a prisoner tasked with crabbing for the priceless southern King Crab.

title: Mirai's Midnight Stream
description: You are a determined disciple of the Sect of the Golden Staff, and to prove yourself to your fellow apprentices and masters, you've set out to defeat the two-tailed fox spirit of legend and lore. After conquering the sensuous goddess in a fiery battle, you come up with a rather "ballsy" idea...

title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Shadow of Kerensky
description: Take on a 12-mission story campaign set during the Clan Invasion. Battle through a shifting Inner Sphere map, face powerful Clan OmniMechs, and salvage cutting-edge Clan tech.

title: Halo: Operation - Solar Flare
description:
Solar Flare is a single mission, originally going to be a small campaign meant to mimic the pre-2000s FPS games like Half-Life in terms of look and feel.

You are Zulu 1, the leader of fireteam Zulu, a Spartan III commando team. Take part in the Siege of Paris IV with pre-2000s art-style and classic-esque game-play.

Set in the Project Daybreak fan timeline of the Halo Universe.

title: Battle Mythic Maidens Arena
description: Engage in card-based combat against alluring opponents in a fantasy world! Face beautiful but dangerous combatants, all with unique stats, strengths and weaknesses. In each turn, you are randomly dealt cards of four action types.

title: Be A Bee
description: Get a taste of the sweet life of a hardworking bee!

title: Core.Sys
description: Break in, retrieve highly protected data and get out clean in a fast-paced hacking simulation!

title: Horror Night with Tung Tung Tung Sahur
description: Horror Night with TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR Your car broke down. Middle of the forest. No signal. You spot a creepy mansion up the hill. You knock. No answer. Just as you turn to leave—CREAK—the door opens by itself.

title: Rebloom
description: No swords, no shields; fight zombies with flowers! Take advantage of mutations and cross pollination to create the ultimate zombie killing flowers. 125 flower types to discover through strategic planting and picking in this action rogue-lite, zombie survivors game.

title: Touhou Iyuushou: What the Bullet Hell?!
description: A Touhou Project fan-made bullet hell game inspired by Impossible Spell Card! Conquer creative, self-contained danmaku challenges using clever item strategies and sharp dodging skills. Collect stamps and prove your mastery! Prefer longer play sessions? Check out the Scene EX and PH challenges!

title: Road to Empress I
description: Step into the shoes of China's most legendary empress and experience her extraordinary life in this high-risk, full-motion video journey. Navigate desire, darkness, schemes, betrayal, and redemption with wisdom and courage. Seek rebirth and revenge, but face tough moral choices. How far will you go?

title: Retro Rail Go!
description: Drive nostalgic Japanese‑style trains through busy city lines and iconic routes. Follow timetables, signals, and station rules to become a master conductor. Choose between relaxed journeys or strict professional challenges in this retro 1990s console‑aesthetic simulator.

title: Sorcières & Compagnie
description: The toad prince must retrieve the ingredients from the five witch sisters to make the recipe that will restore him to his normal form. But they don't intend to give them to him so easily: Sacamot, Zazanimo, Barbouilla, Tartemolle and Lady Witch.

title: Seven Hearts
description: Seven Hearts is a vibrant strategy RPG where you assemble a team from over 300 unique heroes across seven classes. The game features real-time tactical combat, powerful tanks with special abilities, and deep team-building mechanics. Engage in various modes, including PvP arenas and guild raids.

title: The Brave Never Alone
description: This is an auto-idle game placed at the bottom of your screen. The lonely warrior adheres to the "mission", chases slimes and fights them. The warrior will keep moving forward, growing and dying over and over again. All you have to do is watch this journey.

title: Greeblings
description: Greeblings is a chaotic multiplayer platformer where silly creatures climb to escape the hunter. Play as a Greebling with wacky abilities or a Hunter using traps and sharpshooting to stop them.

title: Flipping is Hard
description: A flippin' hard game where rotation is your only motion. Flip, fall, and climb through the land of lost things to return to your boy.

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days 2 - Card Unlock Vol.2 DZ-BT05 Omniscient Awakening
description: ※This additional content is also available as part of the "Additional Card Unlock Pass." Please be aware that the content will only be applied once, so avoid duplicate purchases. ・Adds cards from 【DZ-BT05】 "Omniscient Awakening"

title: The Left Eye
description: A honey-trapping, backstabbing, high-stakes story with a romantic heart, featuring problematic gays to suit a variety of bad tastes. Set in 1920s New York, this episodic visual novel follows an audacious conman juggling friends, enemies, and the most outrageous scam he’s ever tried to pull.

title: Chain Corp
description: A single-player deck-building strategy game where you assemble a 20-card deck, play characters and corporate cards, and battle against ruthless corporate C.E.Os.

title: Lake of Darkness
description: Your small town is slowly becoming corrupted by a mysterious evil, In a dream you get a premonition of your own death. How do you avoid an unknown fate? Spend your final moments wisely in this choice-based psychological horror visual novel game.

title: Evil Egg
description: Evil Egg was an ecstatic twin-stick nightmare known for its brutal shooting action and intense audiovisual effects. Infinite horrors tear apart a world of little green men, the only hope an errant hatchling.

title: Ancient Shadows: Awakening
description: Ancient Shadows: Awakening is a dark 3D dungeon RPG where you explore ancient ruins, battle terrifying creatures, and uncover the secrets of the deep.

title: Delivery Hot
description: In this delivery-themed, 2D pixel action adventure, you play as a delivery man doing food runs and completing extra missions. Meet women and enjoy some "benefits" that make this a man's dream job!

title: DNetHack
description: dNetHack is a NetHack variant based on NetHack 3.4.3. The name stands for Dungeons and Extra-Terrestrials Hack (DnET-Hack).

title: EvilHack
description: EvilHack is a variant initially based on NetHack 3.6.2, created by Keith Simpson.

title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: Steelbook Edition
description:
Flip through the pages of the iconic Trails series to where it all began with Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter! This stunning remake reimagines the beloved classic with new breathtaking visuals, refined gameplay, and the first unforgettable adventure across Liberl Kingdom.

Join Estelle Bright and her adoptive brother, Joshua, as they embark on their journey as junior bracers, determined to climb the ranks of their renowned peacekeeping guild. What begins as a straightforward mission to prove their worth quickly evolves into a gripping adventure of intrigue and peril, as they unravel a conspiracy that threatens the very heart of their homeland.

Experience the story that redefined the JRPG genre and set the Trails series on its legendary path!

title: Cult of Pin
description: Flip, nudge, and destroy in this roguelike pinball deckbuilder. Select from 100+ upgrades to create game-breaking builds and smash through the cursed playfields. Complete missions to trigger explosive special attacks and tear the tables apart, one bumper at a time.

title: Paw Patrol: Rescue Wheels - Championship
description: Va-room! The Rescue Wheels crew is revved up and ready to race! Join Chase, Skye, Marshall, Rubble, Zuma, Rocky, and Roxi, in epic races across Adventure Bay and beyond. You can even cause mischief with Boomer & Frank or Mayor Humdinger. Pick your Pup Racer, each with unique skills like launching tennis balls or spinning out rivals. Master drifting, turbo boosts, and epic signature stunts to rule the dirt roads. Play solo or challenge friends in multiplayer—every racer can be a champion! Grab your best Pup Pals and let’s Rox and roll!

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Deluxe Edition
description:
TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a rogue-like quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
The Game
Casey Jones DLC
10 exclusive foil cards

title: Slash'EM Extended
description: Slash'EM Extended (also known as "Sadistic Levels of Endless X-Citement", or SLEX for short) is a variant of SLASH'EM developed by AmyBSOD.

title: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander
description: Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.

title: Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade - Deluxe Edition
description:
Taking place during the Edo period, Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade is an action RPG infused with fantasy elements and roguelite mechanics. Immerse yourself in a realm brimming with authentic Japanese ambiance as you engage in seamless combo attacks against relentless demon adversaries. Once upon a time, a delicate equilibrium existed between humans and demons. Despite occasional discord, both factions labored to uphold their dearly attained peace. This equilibrium shattered when the sovereign of all demons, the "Nine-tailed Fox" arose, rallying demon kind to sow chaos across the mortal realm. Embark on a journey in a chaotic world, confronting a myriad of demons, and seeking a path to reclaim peace. Through a series of adventures, piece together the truth behind the mystery and forge a path to restoration. Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade – Deluxe Edition includes the physical game on PlayStation 5 or Nintendo Switch along the following exclusive items: ? A soft-bound artbook highlighting the game’s distinctive art style, characters, enemies, story, and demonic environments.
? 3 Postcards with each of the game´s main character´s gorgeous art.
? A poster with the game´s Key Art.
? Digital OST & Singles voucher.
? A collectible tuck-in box housing the physical game and all the Deluxe Edition contents. Key Features: ? Packed with replayability: Character-specific scenarios: An immortal ninja, the hellish grim reaper, a yokai samurai... Each character features completely distinct combat styles and fully independent storylines. Enjoy unique exclusive weapons, a deep and compelling narrative, and a richly diverse world centered around three protagonists. ? Spectacular and dynamic action: Harness the ever-changing attributes of mystical blades to take on rampaging supernatural creatures! Combine weapons freely, collect hundreds of "Orbs" imbued with mysterious powers, and receive the blessings of the Cat God as you create your own unique build. ? Join the Demon Festival: On your journey to hunt demon, discover a hidden festival in an alternate realm where you’ll meet friendly demon, earn abundant resources, and acquire various enhancement items. Collect materials to evolve your weapons, ingredients to satisfy your hunger, and even savor the legendary ramen that grants immense power! You’ll also have the chance to tackle diverse, challenging special stages. Hardcore players who love high difficulty, enjoy challenges, and seek replayability—don’t miss out.

title: UnNethack
description: UnNetHack is a variant of NetHack initially based off NetHack 3.4.3, and is maintained by Patric Mueller and others

title: Karma: The Dark World - Limited Edition
description:
KARMA: The Dark World Physical Limited Edition include:
- An Exclusive Slipcover case
️- Three Art Cards,
- Leviathan ID Badge
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Art Book!

title: Heavenshatter
description: Raw and unfiltered. A small peak into the deep post-post-post-apocalyptic world through the lense of a 3D first-person roguelike. Charge the pillars in a Risk of Rain 2 fashion and exit through the teleporter... beyond... far beyond.

title: ToHeart: Extra Stories - Serio & Masashi
description: Additional story content focused on Serio and Masashi from the main ToHeart story.

title: Truck City
description: Grow your truck fleet, build your city and design a supply chain to extract, refine and process natural resources into complex items. Manage your factories and optimize delivery logistics to prevent traffic jams. Unlock new research and turn your small mining town into an efficient industrial city.

title: Uncharted Waters IV with Power Up Kit: HD Version - 30th Anniversary Edition
Atelier Yumia: Additional Map "Falbra Thicket"
description: Adds the new map "Falbra Thicket"! Pioneer an unexplored map! Adds the new map Falbra Thicket, located deep within the Ligneus region.

title: Elder Ring
description: As a Grand Immortal Cultivator (you), facing your greatest crisis! Having lost your body, your soul hides within a ring. Many people with different personalities will become your "master". Some of them are smart, some are stupid, some are greedy, some are righteous...

title: Hellmart
description: Supermarket simulator meets horror. You’re a clerk at a 24-hour convenience store in the far North. During the day — serve customers and hit your sales goals. At night — beware of strange clients. Hide, escape, defend yourself.

title: Echoes of Spellcraft
description: Echoes of Spellcraft is a single-player game that combines the strategic depth of roguelike deck-building with the thrill of real-time dynamic combat. Play powerful spells at the right moment, encounter different events, and adopt unique strategies in each game to defeat endless waves of enemies!

title: Backstreet Warriors
description: Intense and minimalistic Beat'em up made for Pico-8.

title: Fishtank: Reality TV Simulator
description: It's time to run the show! Give yourself the opportunity to direct the internet reality experience, Fishtank.live, and enjoy the chaos that comes with it!

title: Oh My Dollz
description: Fashion game where you dress up your virtual doll.

title: Graphite
description: Unleash your creativity as a kid’s drawings spring to life in this thrilling roguelike RPG. Build your party, navigate a dynamic timeline, and shape your fate through notebook scenarios that test your team in a world where the heroes don’t know they’re imaginary.

title: Aerial Aces
description: Aerial Aces is a multiplayer arena shooter with fast paced combat and large open maps. Host a server and face off against friends in frantic deathmatch, or hone your movement abilities in offline practice.

title: Debugging Hero
description: As the Debugging Hero chosen by the Legendary Sword, you have gained the ability to manipulate character variables! Use this powerful ability to overcome the dungeons blocking your path and defeat the Demon Lord!

title: Atelier Yumia: Yumia and Flammi Swimsuit Set
description:
Adds a unique swimsuit costume for both Yumia and Flammi (two total).

List of Contents:
- "Waterside Alchemist" Costume for Yumia
- "Flying Water Jug" Costume for Flammi

title: Atelier Yumia: Swimsuit Set
description: Go investigating in swimsuits. A set of swimsuit costumes for each of the seven party characters.

title: Broken Needle
description: A short horror game on RPG Maker about a father creating a body with corpses for his daughter.

title: Warrented Humanity
description: Warranted Humanity is a post-apocalyptic 2D side scroller where choices matter. Fight different infected and rival factions, scavenge, skill up, craft, manage your shelter and other survivors, all in a race against time to ensure humanity’s survival before everyone is irreversibly infected.

title: Master of Monsters SSB
description: The ultimate choice of strategy: individual strength or military power! A fantasy simulation game set in the Age of Exploration, where masters with the power to summon and control monsters go on an adventure.

title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Berracutta
description: A powerful Naval Commander who protects your trade routes using the overwhelming firepower of the Bannerless Berracutta - available to unlock and hire in the Soul Tree once a Bannerless population of 190 has been met.

title: Beat Bulwark
description: The world is bound to a now-fading pulse. You must restore it. Jump, attack, and maneuver on beat with the music through handcrafted levels in this short, challenging, rhythm-based action platformer. Unlock new abilities, defeat the corruption, and then replay levels to improve your best times!

title: Eldritch Bulwark
description: An explosive tower defense experience like no other. Protect a crab colony from waves of invaders. In Eldritch Bulwark, you'll place barricades, deploy specialized units, and use traps on various levels. You'll encounter diverse enemies, including armored brutes, ranged bone-throwers, and ducks that multiply when defeated, requiring you to adapt your strategy. Your available defenses range from melee units to explosive traps.

title: Bulwark
description: Bulwark is a medieval-themed 2D pixel tower defense game with a dynamic block-based building system. Construct and fortify your castle, manage resources, and recruit troops to defend against waves of enemies. Build, strategize, and adapt in this unique blend of fortress construction and combat.

title: Two Point Museum: Fantasy Finds
description: Two Point Museum Fantasy Finds Map Pack unlocks a new fantasy expedition map, and a treasure trove of magical exhibits that may or may not eat your guests…

title: Rift War Tower Defense
description: An eldritch-inspired 2D pixel art tower defense game. Take control of the battlefield and manage limited resources to spawn units and cast spells to defeat your enemy. Destroy the enemy rift portal before they destroy yours.

title: Mould
description: Mould - is an adventure horror game about a shattered Soviet dream. The Earth is slowly becoming uninhabitable, humanity is gone, and its place has been taken by a monstrous life form, capable of surviving in the planet's new conditions.

title: Sonic Speedfreshed
description: Sonic Speedfreshed is a 3D side scrolling Sonic fan-game. This fan-game aims to improve apon the flawed aspects of the original classic games, like the bosses for example.

title: Rattus Velocitas
description: In Rattus VELOCITAS, race as Rats with Jet-powered hoverbikes competing for pole position in procedurally generated race courses! Collect items to give yourself an advantage or take out the competition in this high speed rodent frenzy!

title: Rat Toy
description: A small platformer where the mouse has to reach the cheese.

title: In My Orbit
description: In My Orbit is a chat-sim style otome visual novel. Abandoned in space, all hope seems lost until you receive a strange signal... which installs a dating app onto your computer of all things!? You finally have someone to talk to, maybe you won't die alone and a virgin in space after all..

title: Dear me, I was…
description:
Dear me, I was… is an interactive adventure that lets you enjoy a story woven with beautiful visuals, fusing the vibrant watercolor style of Taisuke Kanasaki with rotoscoping technology.

In this story, you will relive the life of a certain woman. Experience joy, sorrow, and growth through her ordinary and humble life. Witness the story she weaves in a life interconnected with others.

title: Demons' Night Fever
description:
Misdeed, Theft, Abduction, Plunder. This is a tale of “Evil,” where anything goes.
Where the hero is a dull boy named Kyoshiro, who hates the world. And a self-proclaimed evil god having lost his powers appears to him. Team up with the evil god and go beyond the limits of evil! Steal! Abduct! Terminate! Let your evil show!

title: Bubble Bobble: Sugar Dungeons
description: Adventure again and again! Get stronger! The first step-up Bubble Bobble in the series! Go on an adventure through strange dungeons that change every time you step inside!

title: Damon and Baby
description: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Lunacy of Legion
description: A Metal Gear Solid fangame made using RPG Maker 2003 that mixes it with The Legend of Zelda

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Hangang Park
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Pocheon-si
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Tomb of Prince Imyeong
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Arcade Archives: Crazy Balloon
description: A thrilling balloon ride that’s not just hot air!

title: Brain Workout! Find the Difference in Classic Art
description:
Spot the Differences in Famous Masterpieces!
Train Your Brain and Eyes While Enjoying Art

title: Colorizing: Satisfaction
description: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

title: Cryken Part4
description:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players!
30 stages in total. Normal and hard difficulty levels!

title: Duo Games
description: Fun, fast, and fiercely competitive – perfect for two players on one Nintendo Switch!

title: Eggconsole Fray PC-9801
description: An action RPG featuring Fray, a popular character from the “Xak” series! Enjoy a comical, lighthearted story full of excitement!

title: Escape Game:The Kitty The Vacant Lot
description:
A puzzle-solving and escape game set in a nostalgic vacant lot where you used to play as a child!
Solve the riddles in the vacant lot and try to escape.

title: How 2 Escape Collection
description: How to Escape Time is running out! Each wagon is timed in different ways that you’ll discover. Running out of time means defeat. The longer you wait, the more difficult it is to see clearly...

title: Sugoi Girls: Dragon Love
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Super Sucker
description: Suck it all in… then launch it like a maniac with a cannon!

title: Mado Monogatari: Fia and the Wondrous Academy - Deluxe Edition
3 on 3 Soccer
description: Fast. Fun. 3 on 3.

title: Misdie: Into the Game
description: A Digital Dream... or Your Worst Nightmare?

title: The Room Collection
description: Fireproof Games' The Room Collection featuring - The Room, The Room Two, The Room Three and The Room 4: Old Sins.

title: Shardbreakers
description: Reclaim and synergize raw Shards to craft your own Magic in this fast-paced bullet-hell action roguelike. Unlock new heroes, unleash chaos, and conquer hand-crafted realms swallowed by darkness.

title: Stackbound
description: Stack geometric blocks into towering structures using physics and strategy. Combine deckbuilding mechanics with precision placement as towers grow taller and challenges intensify across persistent rounds.

title: Eyes Behind
description: EYES BEHIND is a retro-style FPS survival horror inspired by the classics. Can you survive a deadly game of hide-and-seek with a sinister stranger? Use your wits and courage to stay alive in this tense psychological thriller.

title: Spaceship Man 2
description: It's time to go fight in space. Good thing I can't die.

title: Pixel Empires
description: Pixel Empires is a pixel-art real-time strategy game where you build and manage medieval colonies, automate resource gathering with intuitive AI, explore uncharted lands, and wage tactical battles to expand your empire’s reach.

title: Cargogo
description: Each time you press a key, your vehicle gains movement power. Every destination reached unlocks a new car. Whether working, studying, or gaming... every keystroke you make will help the girls unlock new maps and continue their journey. Ready to ride? Let's go!!!

title: Froggy Brews
description: Froggy Brews is a cozy narrative adventure, where every cup of tea tells a story. Play as a tea-loving frog returning to your old neighborhood that has changed over time. Brew tea for villagers, uncover heartfelt stories, and rediscover your place in this world.

title: BitColony
description: In this sci-fi simulator game you manage a company charged with colonizing the solar system. Balance company interests, logistics, research, space armadas, politics, buildings, dangerous planets, and outside alien threats.

title: Breadbulls
description: Breadbulls is an idle economy simulator.

title: HelmetFire
description: HelmetFire is a rougelite motorcycle multitasking type endless runner that is as relaxing, or as taxing, as you want it to be. Unlock endless score multipliers and compete on the online leaderboard to be the best, or unwind and watch the numbers go up at your own pace

title: Natural Corde
description: Yuuna is Kouta's beautiful childhood friend, and he's had a crush on her for as long as he can remember. However, when Kouta finds out she's dating his perfect older brother, he resolves to do the unthinkable and win over Yuuna's heart.

title: Moon Princess
description: A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!

title: Alice in the Manor
description: Alice in the Manor is a point-and-click escape adventure game. You must explore every corner of a large manor filled with various puzzles and gimmicks and escape safely.

title: Laura Bow and the Mechanical Codex
description: LAURA BOW IS BACK, in an all new point-and-click adventure! Get ready for lots of wonderful nostalgia, in this third installment of the Laura Bow franchise, originally created by Sierra Online and designed by Roberta Williams & Bruce Balfour.

title: Dating and Dragons: A Love Quest
description: Dating & Dragons – A Love Quest is a narrative RPG dating sim packed with every fantasy trope you love. Sneak out with the thief, wreak havoc with the warrior, or flirt with the bard. Explore branching adventures with multiple endings and hidden secrets. Roll those dice and watch out for dragons!

title: The Ratline
description: A murdered priest. A secret list. Hunt Nazi fugitives across the globe in this gritty 1971 detective thriller. Analyze evidence, follow leads, and make sharp deductions before the trail goes cold. From the creators of Family, Rivals, Conspiracy, Echo Beach and Riley & Rochelle.

title: Night of the Extinct
description: Go back in time and see the prehistoric creatures of yesterday, but you might be doing more than seeing. These creatures come to life at night, and it's your job to make it out alive.

title: Forestless
description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure where you'll journey through a world of fears armed only with a magical arrow of hope. Explore biomes that embody human nightmares - from misty wastelands of loneliness to scorched deserts of loss.

title: Babbling Brook
description: Sculpt sand to create winding streams through lush forests and rolling meadows. Babbling Brook is a relaxing indie game about messing around with water and sand. Also, there's a flock of rubber ducks trying to escape to the open sea...

title: What The Hack!
description: What The Hack! Is a humoristic, story puzzle game, where you, a computer program, tries to avoid getting destroyed by escaping a facility. Doing so by hacking and hijacking devices in your surroundings.

title: 100 Dogs in Brazil
description: Find 100 dogs in Brazil! A simple hidden object game made with Kivy. Do you recognize the real-life locations in the background?

title: SlimeCraft
description: SlimeCraft is a 2.5D crafting roguelike where the player mines objects, gathers resources, and crafts items to defend themself against waves of enemies in order to continue their journey exploring new worlds as a blue slime.

title: Aghori
description: Aghori is a psychological horror game set in the Himalayan foothills. Unravel dark rituals, cursed forests, and forgotten villages as Rudra searches for his missing friends in a narrative-rich journey through fear, mysticism, and the unknown

title: Bunnimon
description: Bunnimon is a cozy yet mysterious adventure where puzzles, spirits, and the secrets of a fractured world collide. Dive into Pocket, a handcrafted realm on the brink, where you'll calm ancient guardians and guide lost Wanderers back to themselves.

title: Architect Life: Architect's Home Office
description: Transform your office into the perfect workplace with the ARCHITECT'S HOME OFFICE pack, and design spaces where every detail enhances your creativity and focus!

title: Invocation
description:
Necromancers and demons have captured you, imprisoned you, and destined you for certain death, escape from the prisons.

Join the wizards and challenge the demons buried in the depths of the earth; sword, bow, and magic will be your weapons during this battle. Render services to the spirits that accompany the wizards and learn to summon them.

title: Ahanar
description: Ahanar is an interactive experience about a fictional (hopefully) town in Buryatia where all men were mobilized and none came back. Now Russia sends random men there and the women aren't having it. This is a 40-60 minute experience intended to play in one sitting. It is an anti-war project and as such deals with hard topics of oppression, racism, warmongering, power abuse, homophobia.

title: Mega Man Battle Network
description:
The celebrated entry that kicked off the series. Branching off from the main Mega Man games, this entry's unique world and battle system created a Mega Man for a new generation!
Follow Lan in the Real World, and MegaMan in the Cyber World, as they work together to resolve incidents surrounding them.
What is the aim of the shadowy organization WWW (World Three)? And why are they set on destroying Net Society?

title: Bonzi's Solitaire
description:
Bonzi's Solitaire is the Solitaire game built into the 1999 desktop assistant Bonzi Buddy.
Bonzi Buddy is a discontinued freeware desktop virtual assistant created by Joe and Jay Bonzi. Upon a user's choice, it would share jokes and facts, manage downloads, sing songs, and talk, among other functions. People called it spyware after it was found out to have collected user's personal information before serving them pop-up ads. Because of this, it had to pay $75k in fines, and was discontinued in 2004.

title: Patriot: Democratization
description: Patriot: DemocratiZation is a single-player shooter set in 2017 Russia invaded by the United States. You play as a guerrilla soldier fighting against the invaders.

title: Kopi
description: Welcome to KOPI, a family-friendly cooking game that can be enjoyed solo or with friends in co-op mode. In KOPI, you'll craft increasingly elaborate drinks and dishes for ever-demanding customers. Whether you're brewing, cooking, frying, cleaning, or serving, remember: it’s not over until the customer leaves happy.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 3
description:
A special collaboration with FINAL FANTASY XIV Online, the hit MMORPG, is coming in Title Update 3!
Experience a fanciful story featuring characters who have wandered from the faraway realm of Eorzea—the world of FINAL FANTASY XIV Online.
Get ready for a surge of awesome collaboration content!

title: Stranded Souls
description: Step into the haunting world of Stranded Souls, A co-op horror game designed to challenge your wits and test your courage, this game lets you gather up to 4 players to face the unknown, unravel mysteries, and survive the horrors that lie ahead.

title: Dungeon CompAInions
description: In Dungeon CompAInions, choose a class—Mage, Druid, or Ranger—while AI-controlled allies help you survive waves of enemies. Pause to slow the pace at a cost, or push on for higher scores. Earn upgrades after each round as difficulty steadily increases.

title: Avoren
description: You are assigned to explore worlds and realms totally lost to sanity, face mystical creatures with elemental powers, and try to stay alive! Find fuel and keep the train going!

title: DayZ: Badlands
description: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

title: Cyber Haze
description: Cyber Haze is a retro-style 2.5D platformer in which Haze, a delivery robot, must defend his world against a horde of viruses that have begun to take over the digital world!

title: Goblin Quest: Void
description: Goblin Quest: Void is a local platformer game. The aim is to cooperate with the other players to complete the various stages and challenges.

title: Folklorests
description: In the bowels of the Amazon forest, ancient treasures and terrors await you. Face vengeful spirits and folkloric creatures in Folklorests, a hack ‘n slash that mixes classic action with strategic exploration in a dark and vibrant world.

title: Last Presence
description:
Last Presence is a first-person psychological horror game.

You play as Raheem, who returns to his childhood home after having strange dreams and hearing rumors that his grandmother might still be alive, even though she was declared dead years ago.

As Raheem explores the house, he finds it empty… but something is not right. Strange puzzles appear, and he starts doing things without meaning to, as if someone else is controlling him.

But in the end, Raheem is not just visiting the house, he might never leave it.

title: Hysteric Kingdom
description: Hysteric Kingdom is a hack 'n' slash game with frame-by-frame animations in a medieval setting inside its own universe, where you control the protagonist Afortunado. After a great tragedy, he ends up in prison and can only count on the help of a mysterious sword that appears to be more than just a weapon...

title: KiroKiro BoBon
description:
You control KiroKiro: a crazy yellow creature who’s always traveling, always spinning, and always hungry for stars!
He runs through psychedelic haunted places, jumps over danger, dashes through space, and causes mischief wherever he goes!

title: Love Sick Cats
description: Love Sick Cats is a fast-paced roguelike about revenge. Play as Sashi, a cat hunting down her nemesis across infected zones. A parasitic alien entity is spreading through the planet, warping animal bodies into grotesque forms. Kill everything, survive, and discover a macabre, tragic story.

title: In The Hours of Darkness
description:
Enter the world of In The Hours of Darkness, an action-adventure 2D game, set in a city where magic is commonplace, and danger and wonder lurk in each corner.

As unemployed artist Rex Nemo, explore the City of Shores as you try to solve the riddle of a magic book, before its too late. Use acrobatic skill, combat prowess, and an assortment of spells in order to outsmart your foes and unlock the secrets of the City.

title: Poker Game: World Poker Club
description: With millions of players worldwide, numerous in-game events to choose from, and the certified Fair Play guarantee, the World Poker Club is the ultimate go-to poker game that offers much more than just tables and bets.

title: Sānguó Zhào Yún Zhuàn Zhī Zònghéng Tiānxià
description:
San Guo Zhao Yun Zhuan Zhi Zong Heng Tian Xia is the sequal of San Guo Zhao Yun Zhuan, a game based on popular historical figure Zhao Yun during The Three Kingdom period in Chinese history.

It is an action RPG which highlights Zhao Yun’s military career, filled with daring charges and hard-fought victories. Compared to the previous title, the combat system has undergone major upgrades: battles now unfold as large-scale clashes involving multiple factions. Iconic military strategies once confined to books or real-life history — from siege warfare and rescue operations to breakouts, night raids, and psychological tactics — are now fully integrated into the gameplay.

Both in terms of scale and intensity, the action is far more ambitious than before. No longer is the battlefield just a place for chaotic button-mashing; intelligence and strategy are just as important as raw strength. Every decision the player makes influences the course of the game, shaping not only how battles unfold, but also how the story is written.

title: Retro Arsenal
description: Live the dream of incorporating your favorite retro games into powers that will help you defeat hundreds of monsters in your path. In Retro Arsenal, you will immerse yourself in a 2D and 3D world bringing together the past and future of technology in this frantic adventure. Find the cartridges, eliminate everyone in your path, escape with your life.

title: Chaosborn
description: Team up with friends in a roguelite adventure! Fight enemies, collect loot, and power up your character to take on harder maps. Each run is unique, and the stronger you get, the deeper the challenge goes. How far can your team go?

title: Raccoons to Riches
description:
Strike it rich in this non-combat Roguelike Deckbuilder. Run an item shop as a raccoon shopkeeper. Sell items, manage your time, and customize your shop to stay in business for a whole month!

Raccoons to Riches is a small solo-developed Roguelike Deck Builder about managing an item shop as a little raccoon trying to stay in business! Your goal is to keep up with weekly payments on your shop for a whole month while you make as much gold as possible. Supply townsfolk and adventurers alike as you customize your shop and manage your time for maximum profit!

title: Celestia
description: Celestia is a solo-developed indie game. An angelic bullet-hell shoot-'em-up where you defeat enemies throughout the skies, and relax on a floating island with your companions.

title: Meltopia
description: A minimalist game where you venture into a snowy world filled with mysteries and glacial secrets. Explore by melting snow with a heat cannon, collect valuable resources and ancient artifacts, and rescue frozen characters. But most importantly — find and assemble the remains of an ancient Mammoth!

title: Roller Heist
description: Roller Heist is a stylish action game where you glide through museums around the world recovering looted pieces. Armed with a paintball gun, skate and splat your way past security guards and repair history.

title: The Last Love Letter
description: The Last Love Letter is a challenging 2D platformer set in World War II. Control Antonio, a wounded carrier pigeon unable to fly, must cross dangerous trenches to repair radio antennas and retrieve love letters left by fallen combatants.

title: The Stochastic Dungeons of Apogee
description:
"When the moons reach their apogee, the world's protective seal shall weaken, thus bringing forth entities and events never before seen."

Each run will be a different experience; the weapons you acquire may never be acquired again, and your most reliable tool is your knowledge of the elements within the dungeon.

title: Project Fleet
description: Project Fleet is a 2D Sci-Fi real-time strategy, puzzler, fleet managment, autobattler in a roguelite style. Trade with NPCs, expand your base and hangar. Launch expeditions to the 12 available planets or compete with other players worldwide in Highscore-Mode

title: Cataclysm: The Last Generation
description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike set in modern-day New England. Scavenge tools to craft an arsenal capable of dealing with the ever-evolving hordes of zombies, mutants, aliens, and robots in one of the deepest survival sims around.

title: Lost Letter
description: Lost Letter is an incremental idle game where you explore countries, collect more than 500 unique stamps, and upgrade vehicles to find a mysterious person. Experience relaxing gameplay with randomized targets, resource management, and a charming collage-inspired art style.

title: Chain Letter
description: Persuade your friends, unlock their skills, and fight through rhythm battles. Chain Letter is a story-driven rhythm-defense roguelike combining key combo mechanics, tactical positioning, and emotional narrative progression.

title: Seas of Raesenia
description: Explore a naval fantasy world in an ancient battleship. Defeat anyone who wants to take your ship, and raise a valiant crew. Solve the mystery of the Veil in a multi-hour story-based campaign!

title: Valiants: Arena
description: Strategic multiplayer monster battle game

title: Coralina: Illacrimo
description: Lost in nostalgia, surrounded by ghosts, Coralina goes through the Elysian Fields to find a long lost alchemy artifact, all before the world ends. The girl that can enter memories travels through these Posthumous Lands once again, in her own Psychedelic Odissey.

title: Feywood Wanderers
description: Explore the Feywood as you defeat enemies in tactical, turn-based battles. Find loot, abilities, secrets and meet helpful denizens of the forest as you delve deeper, customize your character with a great variety of classes, races, and equipment in this highly replayable extraction roguelike.

title: Morro Acima
description: Morro Acima is an open-world 3D platformer with a focus on missions where you do parkour in the favela of Morro da Abobrinha. Explore and find secrets while helping the locals with their crazy stories and strengthening the surrounding community with your skills. From rooftop to rooftop, Morro Acima!

title: Bloodpunished: No Time Por Patience
description: BLOODPUNISHED is a horror platformer where you try to escape a mysterious place with very little room for error. Presented through hand-drawn sketches in his diary, you'll step into the shoes of this victim as he documents his descent into madness.

title: Forest Ranger Services: Episode 2
description: Horror game series about the investigation of missing hikers in the U.S. National Parks. Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances - several episodes that tell one story! Based on true events.

title: My Ranch
description: This is an open-world farm game that includes planting, raising, building, survival, fishing, and other gameplay elements. In this game, you need to manage your resources wisely to expand your farm.

title: Cry Pic.
description: This is a 2D action shooting game that focuses on fighting large enemies (bosses).

title: Self-Comb Women: Home Left Behind
description: Self-Comb Women: Home Left Behind is a first-person walking simulator where players step into traditional Cantonese architecture and experience the unique cultural heritage of the Pearl River Delta through immersive visuals and storytelling. @Old Media Art x Pu Xiaoyue

title: Old Hero
description: Short (15h~) JRPG inspired by the classics. Expect short dungeons, snappy battles, turn-based combat, zero tutorials, random encounters, quirky dialogue, lots of game over screens, save points, and a zany cast out to save the world!

title: 101 Cats in Medina
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Medina landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Row Hard
description: Paddles, splashing of water and hard racing. Build your team, coach, mentor and lead them through tough choices to Olympic gold. Learn the price of victory! Deep story with resource management and rhythm sports races. What are you willing to sacrifice to win?

title: Somnambulo
description: Enter a psychological horror experience where a young psychologist must navigate a surreal world shaped by forgotten memories and fears – both her own and those she once tried to heal. Face what was buried. Reclaim what was lost. Escape – before it’s too late.

title: Coffee & Boobs: Grand Gala
description: New adventures for Sam and the staff of "Serenity" coffee shop. Unexpected challenges, pleasant encounters, old friends and foes. Immerse yourself in a hot story flavored with a hint of coffee and sensual encounters!

title: Space Dingus
description: Space Dingus is a co-op horror road trip, in SPACE! Manage your ship, lead a crew full of jerks, and explore a dangerous galaxy in a last-ditch effort to save your home. Every run is randomized, with new stories, characters, and events each time you play. From the team behind Death Road to Canada!

title: Palianytsia
description: In this game, you are a palianytsia — a traditional Ukrainian bread. You escape from the kitchen, solve puzzles, and explore your own nature. Over time, the game shifts from bright and cheerful to eerie and unsettling, and your goal is to uncover what is really going on.

title: Touhou Volleyball Danmaku
description: A volleyball game with a twist: shoot bullets while dodging them. Play as one of your favorite Touhou characters in a hybrid of sports and shoot-em-up action.

title: Passer
description: It's a minesweeper game from a third-person perspective. Marking all mines is the task of each level. In the levels, you will encounter guards who prevent your action. You have a wealth of skills to fight them and even fly.

title: A Little to the Left: Packed
description: A Little to the Left wraps up with the free, final Packed Update.

title: Promesst
description: A Windows puzzle game inspired by Corrypt and Game Title.

title: Ultimate Custom Night: Recode
description: Ultimate Custom Night with recoded mechanics and rebalanced gameplay. This recoded version was made with the purpose of making UCN more fun and challenging for all players, and making gameplay very chaotic and unique.

title: Ultimate Custom Night: Deluxe
description:
This is a modified and improved version of the ultimate FNAF mashup "Ultimate Custom Night"

Test your skills against the 50 selectable animatronic foes spanning between seven different Five Nights at Freddy's games. The options for customization are nearly endless as you mix and match any assortment of these loved animatronic characters and set their difficulty anywhere from 0-20. From the office desk, you must manage two side doors, two vents, as well as two air ducts, all of which lead directly into your office.

title: Petmancer
description: A whimsical roguelite dungeon crawler where you recruit magical pets, unlock ancient talents, and explore ever-changing pixel dungeons. Choose your hero, build your party, and battle the 7 Archmages to master the art of Petmancy.

title: The Fog Encounters
description: There's a passenger who's gone mad from the fog, and a captain who's gravely injured inside the near-deserted airport. Counter the madman, follow the captains instructions and get your aircraft fueled to ESCAPE WITH YOUR LIFE.

title: Real Vampires
description: Real Vampires is a dark and funny folklore adventure where you play as both vampire and folk, exploring real Eastern European legends. Mini-games use inverse mechanics—failure is not the end, but the beginning of a greater understanding. Dig, bite, bake, and uncover the Real Vampires.

title: Nightlanders
description: Dive into a dark fantasy world torn apart by war. Command vast armies and construct mighty fortresses. Engulf opponents in volleys of deadly bullets. Nightlanders combines real-time-strategy with shoot-em-up mayhem to define a new genre of gameplay.

title: Leavers Rift
description: Explore the surreal world surrounding the Leavers Rift in this immersive roguelike deckbuilder. Build powerful decks, collect treasures, and lose yourself in a dramatic story about humanity in a realm of magic. Uncover the influence of foreign forces and save your world!

title: Content King: Streamer Simulator
description:
Content King: Streamer Simulator puts you behind the camera with one goal—build a streaming career from scratch and turn it into something worth watching.

Start with basic gear and zero followers. Stream regularly, improve your content, and grow your audience. Upgrade your setup, manage your time, and decide how you’ll rise—stay genuine, stir the pot, or cut corners for quicker success.

Expand your channel, work with other creators, and turn your online presence into a serious business. Just don’t forget: the internet loves a star—but it loves a scandal even more. Ready to chase clout or chaos? The camera’s on.

title: Cattopia
description: Cattopia is an energetic momentum-based 2D platformer where you use a fishing line to swing around! Help Catto swing through many branching paths while catching fish and helping out his friends along the way.

title: Peaches Interplanetary
description: Peaches Interplanetary is a short relaxing game about growing peaches on a spaceship. Explore the ship, talk to trees, drink some tea or coffee, and help Margot prepare for her first day spreading the power of peaches throughout the stars.

title: Nightmare Owl
description: "Nightmare Owl" is a first-person horror game where Chrissy, trapped by a satanic book, is hunted by demons on her family's farm. Her only hope is finding a mysterious owl. Use your flashlight, wits, and stealth to survive and escape the nightmare.

title: One Hard Game Please!
description: "One Hard Game Please" is a brutally difficult rage game inspired by The World's Hardest Game. You control a constantly moving player that bounces off walls, with the goal of reaching the finish line without touching hazards. Can you survive?"

title: Uncanny Valley: Le Petit Morte
description: Step into the shadows of NYC in an open world vampire JRPG where each choice matters. Play as a fledgling vampire navigating a sprawling city—where alliances oft turn to betrayals as 12 bloodlines vie for power! Dive into darkness, battle your hunger, forge your legend in the city that never sleeps!

title: Fallen / Brand New World
description:
The long war has ended, leaving knights and mercenaries without work.
Living quietly in the tavern left by your grandfather, you one day take in a lone girl.
Your carefree retirement comes to an end,
and a busy life of running the tavern alongside Lily begins...

title: Konpira Fune Fune
description: Konpira Fune Fune is a 2D roguelike rhythm duel demanding sharp reflexes and strategy. Choose opponents, earn points, and invest in passives and actives to create potent combos! Save enough to unlock tougher stages while powering up to survive each challenging battle.

title: Sweatshop Simulator
description: Build a lucrative business from the ground up, navigating the gray areas of the entrepreneurial world. Manage resources, hire workers, and balance risk and reward in a game of strategy and business sense. A simulator that has you take on the role of a business owner who will do whatever it takes.

title: Harem of Three Thousand
description: Take on the role of Sophia, a concubine's daughter navigating palace intrigue in this court-themed AVG. Gain imperial favor, uncover conspiracies, manage relationships, forge alliances, train assassins, and raise a prince. Enjoy freedom, multi-route plots, and uncover palace secrets.

title: Shadows of the Blade
description: A classic sci-fi pixel art adventure platformer about a young swordsman trying to save his village from invaders.

title: Orbcraft Survivors
