description: Orbcraft Survivors is a roguelite survival game about crafting and combining orbs to fend off relentless enemies. Mix various perks and orbs to create powerful builds, survive, and become the ultimate wizard.

title: Flame Dragon Plus: Marks of Wind
Survival in Space Is Not Guaranteed
description: Survive and Escape! Crash-landed on an asteroid, your oxygen is running out. Explore, mine precious resources, build a base, and repair your ship to survive the dangers of space. Do you have what it takes to escape?

title: Idle Crypto Mining
description: Short, simple, fun idle game to run in the background while playing other games!

title: Overwork Empire
description: This is a business simulation + tower defense + card game. Players will play the role of the boss, use cards to build facilities, allocate talents, and force overtime to make profits. Players will jump out of the perspective of workers and experience the overtime culture as operators.

title: Spintronics
description: A labyrinth computer program to train you for your new body. A platform puzzle game.

title: Project: Num
description: Project: Num is a rhythm game centered around accuracy, combo, and the numpad. Hit appearing notes to the beat of the music to earn new highscores and compete against your friends.

title: Duck Blitz
description: Duck Blitz is a fast-paced arcade shooter that invites you to ruffle some feathers in the most quacktastic way possible! Grab your trusty blaster, dive into a flurry of colorful ducks swooping in from all angles, and chase high scores in frantic, action-packed rounds.

title: Final Stand
description: This is a top-down shooting game. You will fight alone or form a team to break through the apocalypse of monsters. By combining random weapons, talents and relics, you can create a unique fighting style and experience the thrill of counterattack from struggling to survive to mowing down enemies!

title: SkyTaxi
description: Navigate a vibrant cyberpunk world in SkyTaxi, a futuristic game where you manage flying taxis, dodge rising dangers, and solve dynamic challenges. Explore colorful cityscapes, transport passengers, and master innovative mechanics in this thrilling aerial adventure.

title: Suburbadrome
description: Not everything is as it seems in your hometown of Cainsveil, Washington. You awoke like any other day, but the road to work seems unusually long. Explore strange environments and solve puzzles in SUBURBADROME.

title: Votica
description: Votica is a election simulation game. Create your politician, run a strategic campaign, and win the votes of Velkarya's citizens. Every election is unique thanks to randomized demographics. With both single-player and multiplayer modes, it offers a humorous yet deep political experience.

title: Devastablance Mountain Brotherhood
description: A dynamic sci-fi adventure, the events of which unfold in a post-apocalypse setting, the catalyst of which is a terrifying nuclear war.

title: Orbital Challenge
description:
Roll, jump, and teleport through 10 intense levels in this fast-paced platformer!
Master challenging obstacles, dodge creative traps, and fight for the fastest time on the global leaderboards.
Precision, chaos, and pure platforming fun await!

title: Deltascention
description: Deltascention is a fast-paced action roguelike with a ton of upgrades and a whole collection of editable arena's, and not to mention the weapons! Fight your way through all 50 waves to take out the final boss and save the world outside!

title: Square Brothers
description: Two bandit brothers, One epic heist! Solve spatial challenges and steal shiny treasures on this brand new Megadrive game.

title: Living Pipes
description: A narrative-driven first-person puzzle game set in the dystopian future of 2080. Take on the role of a maintenance worker investigating strange malfunctions in a crumbling apartment building, where nothing is as it seems.

title: Frick It
description: Chill looking, co-op horror game about the world is ending, a giant magnetic storm is after us. As conscious robots, collect fuel with our scrap vehicle, dig crytals, fight monsters and try to survive on the endless road and learn the story from other failed robots.

title: King of Bones
description: King of Bones is a fast-paced dinosaur fighting game with physics-driven skill-based combat. Dash, dodge, stomp, headbutt, and smash your way through multiple unique game modes and over two dozen unique species as you fight to dominate the arena.

title: Inflamed
description: NO INFLATION WITHOUT REPRESENTATION! UNITE and fight for the rights of wacky Inflatables everywhere by causing destructive mayhem through a campaign of protests staged across the nation. Flop and Flail together in a memorable righteous rampage.

title: The Elomont Raider
description: The Elomont Raider is a fantasy-themed top-down arcade-style game. Attack！Dodge！and Find your way overcoming difficulties！ Enjoy a pure, retro, joyful gaming experience with extra fun! A little bit of hardcore.

title: One-In
description: 4 players. One revolver. One decision.Spin, aim, and bluff your way through twisted rounds of risk and reward in this psychological multiplayer shooter.

title: Dreamrealms Resurgence
description: Dreamrealms Resurgence: A casual shooter meets farm sim! Grow crops, customize skill combos, and mow down endless monster hordes!

title: I Don't Want to Be a Good Woman
description: A walking simulator based on the real-life experiences of women living under Islamic law in Iran.

title: Spooky Driving
description: It is the dead of night and you decided it would be a nice time for a drive. Little did you know... it would be a spooky drive. Pay attention to all surroundings in this goofy "horror" game, or else it will spell your doom.

title: Creeps: Halls of Insanity
description: A thrilling game in a place no man has ever escaped....

title: GleanBound
description: GleanBound: is first-person horror semi-realistic maze runner that mixes adrenaline-fueled chase mechanics with creepy events and terrifying creatures. Collect soul stones and stay ahead of what's hunting you — but remember, every corner could be your last.

title: Obakeyashiki
description: Find your way out of a haunted house like a maze. A first-person horror exploration adventure.

title: Brainrot Royale
description: Step into Brainrot Royale and play as your favorite Italian Brainrot meme characters in a up to 16 players battle royale with tons of surprises!

title: Hyper Paddle
description: Break Bricks better than before! Classic arcade action meets modern graphics. Explore each of 5 colorful worlds and top the leaderboards on each. Use Attract and Repel to gain control over the balls direction and use powerups to quickly melt through hundreds of bricks.

title: Dungeon Fight Tactics
description: An Auto Battler game where you strategically assemble a team of characters to enter randomly generated dungeons. Customize your characters with items and skills from spellbooks, then let them fight automatically for victory. Build your unique team and conquer the dungeon!

title: Camel Keeper
description: Embark on a delightful desert adventure in Camel Keeper, a charming Tamagotchi-inspired simulation where you become the ultimate camel caretaker!

title: Space Station: Beyond
description: Play as a variety of creatures or characters and try to survive either maintaining or attacking a space station while everything that can go wrong has already gone wrong.

title: Hookah Simulator
description: Start with a small cozy hookah lounge and turn it into the most popular spot in the city! Your goal is to craft perfect hookahs, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

title: Rockoon
description: Rockoon is a game that combines a linear narrative with dark humor and third-person shooter elements, offering the player an unconventional experience while reflecting a unique comic inspired style. Be a master of the sword and save the troubled.

title: The Professor
description: The Professor is a third-person point of view adventure-based game, characters are customizable, game contains various of different map settings, different bosses, intense battles, variety choices of weapons varying from different timezone, the exploration awaits.

title: We Are Locked
description: -Hide from vengeful ghosts, search for the key, and escape the haunted house before it's too late. Stay quiet, stay hidden, and survive.

title: Radial Overdrive
description: Strap in, hotshot! Welcome to Radial Overdrive! Weave through the city of opportunity and style in your state-of-the-art high-speed hovercraft. Upgrade your vehicle to keep those turns smooth and nerves loose. Push the limits of what's possible in this endless racing rogue-lite!

title: Floworlds
description: Terraform barren worlds by dropping ice from orbiting ice-clusters. Completing each FLOWorld puzzle requires strategic use of limited ice-cluster resources. Grow your galactic sector one world at a time.

title: Pact of Blood
description: Blood is the price of survival, and you are trapped forever. Explore kingdoms through ancient portals, battle twisted creatures, and craft the tools you need to survive in this first-person single-player survival adventure.

title: Strawberry Test
description: Play as an AI interacting with users.

title: Spore Valley
description: A bite-sized resource management puzzle, inspired by engine-building board games and the weird world of real-life slime molds, fungi, and lichen.

title: Reverse 1999: 1987 Cosmic Overture
description:
Version 2.7 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Hissabeth, Kiperina, and Name Day
• New Garments for Voyager, Argus, Barcarola and Rabies
• New main event: 1987 Cosmic Overture
• New Anecdote for Fatutu
• …and more!

title: Brno Transit
description: Brno Transit is a narrative-driven psychological horror game about a trainee metro driver trapped in the dampest subway east of anything that matters.

title: Silly Tanks
description: Choose a turret and a body to make your own tank to shoot, blast, and burn friends to claim your victory! Play classic game modes like Free for All, Team Death Match, Capture the Flag, and King of the Hill on your own custom-made maps in Silly Tanks.

title: Selling Game
description: Draw your product, name it, and create a slogan — then compete with others and turn doodles into dollars!

title: SFZ Project: E0 Deluxe Remake
description:
"SFZ Project: Episode Zero. Deluxe Remake" is a complete reimagining of the 2020 mod with updated gameplay and visuals, as well as redesigned Kordon location and various side-quests.

The general plot of the story remains the same - in the Zone there was a third large release, which attracted the attention of Professor Sakharov, who supplied a group of scientists to go to the Chernobyl NPP. The connection with the expedition is cut off and a former mercenary and friend of the professor is sent to the Zone to find out the circumstances.

title: Lixing's Picross World
description: In this Picross puzzle game, team up with lively Lixing to solve 525 creative levels! Decode starry patterns through numbers, blending logic with fun. Enjoy her full voice-over, cheering you with heartwarming lines!

title: World War II Armored Recon
description: North Africa, 1942. Command a U.S. tank. Lead your men against the Axis powers. Learn the hard lessons of war. The odds are against you. A text-based historical novel, 700,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

title: Lucifer's Grand Adventure
description: A cute 2D platformer about a cat trying to escape a lab, save all the stray kittens and find a home for all of them to live.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Japan Find & Color
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 100 hidden cats across a beautifully hand-drawn map. Play solo or invite a friend to join online, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette — all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: America vs. America
description: American vs. America is a card-based political simulation game themed around the 2024 U.S. presidential election. Choose your faction and play a wide variety of election-year event cards to shape your own unique election outcome.

title: The Coffin of Sarah
description: A 2D top down horror game that takes you on a story about a girl named Sarah. Will you be able to solve the puzzles, escape the horror hiding in the dark, and figure out the secrets hiding in this small town?

title: Curyeux
description: Dive into the mind of Lucienne, a tormented painter. Leap through emotional memories, solve puzzles where shapes deceive and emotion leads the way. A dreamlike platformer where each painting brings you one step closer to yourself.

title: Bless You, Rip
description: Bless You, Rip is an action adventure game starring a rabbit boy named Rip, who must find his missing brother. Along with his friends, he sets off to explore unfamiliar parts of the city while fending off an invasion of strange creatures.

title: Sef Saga
description: Shape your unique adventure in Sef Saga, a roleplaying sandbox, every game is different! Master 14 skills, talk to anyone, and forge your path. Explore above ground, delve to Magamada, or hunt for treasure in desert Labyrinths. Be a combatant, a farmer, or a trader and more - your destiny awaits.

title: Revengeful Ghost
description: This title is a horror adventure game. The story unfolds mainly through line messages on smartphones. Just like real time, the in-game time is also ticking away, and messages arrive in real time. The player must use mysterious videos and messages as clues to unravel the mystery of the incidents.

title: Give Me Back My Fruit
description: Give me back my fruit is a single-player 2D platformer.Punish the fruit-stealing friends and take back your delicious fruit!

title: Cross and Gun
description: You are an exorcist. Find anomalies to uncover hidden demons—and eliminate even the ones who don't hide. Use your holy cross and your gun. Defeat all the demons and escape the cursed house.

title: Madman's Maze
description: Enter a first-person psychological labyrinth where madness and horror lurk around every corner. Will you make it out alive?

title: I Had a Friend
description: In I Had a Friend, Richard returns to his family's house to care for the cat while his parents are away. What starts as a simple task turns unsettling as strange events unfold. With a dark atmosphere, the game focuses on exploration and the growing sense that something's not right.

title: The Legend of Gandar III
description: An epic fantasy world returns. This is the next chapter of the highly anticipated The Legend of Gandar III installment developed by Jeddead. The Legend of Gandar III takes place 2 years after the events of The Legend of Gandar II and The Legend of Gandar.

title: Bling: Fortune Memories
description: Explore a temple filled with traps and secrets in Bling: Fortune Memories. Use your wits, collect gems, and activate your invisibility ability to overcome challenges while searching for your missing brother. With tactical grid-based movement and a minimalist style, will you achieve fortune?

title: Brainkilled
description: BRAINKILLED is not an easy puzzle game! 2 games in 1:Main puzzle game: Based on logic, observation and interaction while clues can be hidden anywhere within the level.Math puzzle game: Requires basic as well as advanced math knowledge!

title: Seven Days Until Morning
description: Seven Days Until Morning is an atmospheric horror game that leaves you isolated on the dwarf planet of Pluto. You play as an survivor of the collapse of humanity. Escape the end and survive to see the morning.

title: Culinary Wizard
description: A magical action platformer following the life of an apprentice chef learning to master the secrets of the culinary arts under the tutelage of a newfound teacher. Journey through magical lands, bring ingredients to life, and slay foes using kitchen tools, all in a classic 32-bit pixel art style.

title: Undertale: Gameboy Edition
description: An Undertale Fan-Game containing remade and altered versions of all of Undertale's main boss fights, in addition to a new one. All of it is created in the style of an original Gameboy, using the same screen resolution, color limitations, and sound limitations (for the most part).

title: Hardest
description: Rock-Paper-Scissors Card Game Roguelike - stop time, summon tsunamis, shoot with bubble guns, feed cards to mimic, collect rare negative cards!

title: 4Wheel Challenge
description: A challenging 3D platformer where you control a wheelchair-bound character to overcome dynamic obstacles, jump between platforms, and test your skills in action-packed levels. Fail and go back to the previous level to try again!

title: Trytka
description: Survival base-building game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, craft tools, build defenses, and survive relentless nightly waves of hostile robots determined to destroy your base. Have fun!

title: Tile Tides
description: Ocean themed relaxing puzzle.

title: Planets Ambrosia
description: All-out 360-degree assault! A roguelite shooter where you pilot an sci-fi fighter to eliminate grotesque enemies fused with fruit and machinery, constantly upgrading your weaponry.

title: Zurd Hunt
description: In the year 2,000,000,009, a team of bounty hunters infiltrate a massive facility swarming with hostile AI. Can they find Zurd?

title: The Bullet Hell
description: A true bullet-hell game. Dodge an onslaught of bullets as a variety of ships while surviving until the boss is whittled down enough. Fight the main bosses in a linear order or play special gamemodes that go on forever.

title: Light of the Ancients
description: Light of the Ancients is a relaxing first-person puzzle game where you solve environmental challenges to unlock ancient pathways and uncover a long-lost secret.

title: USAID Approvals Department
description: Play as a relaxed Woke DEI hire in USAID's Approvals Department, an outlandish ASMR and LOFI style US Government sim: review request, Approve or Deny, then File It before vacationing on a gifted yacht ride. Process absurd funding requests, dodge DOGE investigators, and avoid getting “Epsteined"

title: Margin of Error
description: Margin of Error is a Balatro-inspired roguelike deck-building game with a mathematical puzzle twist, where you play not just with numbers - but also with logic and strategy. it features a card system with numbers 0-9 and unique operators like +, -, ×, (pi), etc.

title: Pinballers
description: An incremental pinball roguelike to satisfy the flipping nostalgia of the 80s

title: Boom Gear
description: Boom Gear is a demolition derby where you crash and smash your way to victory. Drive and smash your vehicle into others, destroy them and become the king of the demolition pit!

title: Deltarules
description: Deltarules is a Deltarune Hard mode with internet humor, new bosses and new bullet patterns

title: Gen-Abyss
description: The thriller horror mystery RPG. Influencer Feng Cimu witnesses her crew vanish one by one. As sinister phenomena relentlessly emerge, her descent into the mountain's secrets unravels a shocking conspiracy—while buried truths about her own past and identity begin clawing their way to the surface...

title: Anime Dream Match: Primates
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool anime primates.

title: Asymm
description: Asymm is a single game with multiple classes and each represents a different genre - an FPS class that play like Destiny, a RTS class that plays like Starcraft, and an RPG class that plays like Elder Scrolls Online.

title: Restaurant Rush
description:
The long-awaited sequel to Burger Rush is here!

Join Heidi in here quest to become a world-class chef by cooking over 50 international dishes such as Filet Mignon, Dim Sum, and Pizza Marinara.

With brand new features such as the Farmer`s Market, Cooking Competitions and Bonus Challenges, Restaurant Rush is 2x as addicting as Burger Rush!

title: Santa Claus in Trouble... Again!
description:
Santa Claus in Trouble ... again has the same premise as its predecessor: Santa Claus has lost all the presents. Now the player takes his role and has to retrieve them.

This game is a standard 3D platformer, meaning the player uses his keyboard to jump through the 12 levels. He has to avoid pits and enemies. Since Santa is a peaceful guy there is no way to kill them.

The basic goal of the level is to reach the exit alive. On the way the player finds the presents, for each one he collects he gets points - more challenging to get are more rewarding. There are also health boosts and reset points. But these are just temporary saves when the player dies - if all lives are lost or he ends the game he has to start all over.

title: Coven: All Powerful
description: A chaotic spell-slinging party brawler where Sages clash in ever-changing magical realms. Stack wild enchantments, unleash devastating spells and combos, and outlast your friends in fast, unpredictable battles full of pure arcane mayhem.

title: Sonic Valkyria: Kanon
description: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

title: Skill Hockey
description: ``Skill Hockey'' is a super exciting new air hockey game where you enter commands during play to activate flashy special moves and drive the puck into your opponent's goal!

title: Beautiful Escape Dolls
description: This is a horror adventure/simulation game based on the Lolita Slave Toys urban legend. You play as the dollmaker doctor, many years after the infamous post. You are retired, but delicate family matters have forced you to go back to making dolls. You must now handle your family, your day job, and your secret craft.

title: Room 502
description: A cynical high schooler, Hae-eun's mundane life takes a colorful turn as she and her dorm roommates in Room 502 unravel mysterious incidents on campus. This game blends academy life, mystery, and youth in a captivating detective adventure.

title: Decodence
description: Decodence is an ultra fast paced first person movement shooter set in a Deco-Punk universe. It brings a highly advanced, open ended movement system together with hard to learn, skill based combat mechanics.

title: Tradie Tapper
description: Tap, hire, and rebirth your way to tradie stardom in this Aussie-made idle clicker. Build job sites, collect gear, unlock skill trees, and climb the monthly leaderboards. Whether you're laying bricks or chasing ranks, the grind never stops.

title: Robo Oh vs. Uchu Mega Fight
description: With simple 2-button controls,anyone can jump in and enjoy the thrills of tag-team fighting action. This game is developed using the 8-bit fantasy console PICO-8.Experience the dynamic animations that push the limits of this tiny engine!

title: Love Sphere
description: Love Sphere is a Adventure told from a first-person perspective. Relive the dull middle-aged man's brief encounter.

title: Rise to Mayhem
description: Ascend a deadly tower, blast through waves of enemies, dodge incoming fire, battle fierce bosses, and chase high scores in explosive pixel-art action as a jetpack soldier.

title: Mobile Police Officer Earth Gumble
description: ■Side-scrolling belt-scrolling exhilarating action game A very, very, very difficult berserk game in which the player tries to defeat the last boss with no recovery of energy at all!

title: LEO: Low Earth Orbit
description: Two joysticks, two thrusters, a horde of enemies to weave and burn your way through! Fluid movement, experimental arsenals, and a little robot!

title: Kotaro Survivor
description: "KOTARO Survivor" is an auto-shooting roguelike action game.Defeat relentless waves of enemies, build the ultimate loadout, and survive the battlefield until the timer runs out!

title: Gordian
description: A mix between perspective and spacial understanding, Gordian tasks you with translating knots diagrams to a hexagonal grid. Chill vibes, difficult puzzles, and a first of it's kind knot detection system. Chase scores or get creative, tie the knot in Gordian!

title: Drakula's Ascension
description: Prove your ability to reach your true potential and enjoy retro platforming and combat with a potential cost of starting from the bottom all over again in Drakula's Ascension! Overcome the demons keeping you down, all for your freedom and the view at the top of your castle that once was yours.

title: RPG: The Legends of Power Volume 1
description: (RPG) The Legends of Power Volume 1 is a pixel, adventure and horror game. You have to choose the fate determined of characters they'll be alive or death, but there might be other things that could help you to have advantage...

title: Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino
description: Life seemed simple... until the cracks appeared. Dive into absurdity, intrigue, and uncanny coincidences in a visual novel where nothing happens by chance.

title: Pullback Racers
description: Online multiplayer racing without gas, steering, or brakes! Pull back and launch your toy cars into fast-paced tracks with friends, using only your mouse. After each round, modify an ever-extending track by building bunch of stuff that's probably harmful for everyone.

title: Nippon Dojo
description: Fun stylized cute themed learning experience. Jump in on the fun in this immersive Casual / Edutainment game. Tailored for beginners and experienced Japanese language students.

title: Space Mechanics: Repair Hiring Crafting
description: In "Space Mechanics: Repair | Hiring | Craft" you are the owner of a space repair station in which you have to work. Repair spaceships, get money for it, hire them and create items for sale or for your own purposes.

title: Yuika My Bestie
description: Experience a pastel-toned emotional journey in Yuika My Bestie, a short visual novel you can complete in under 15 minutes per playthrough. With 5 unique endings and heartfelt choices, it takes just 30-40 minutes to explore every path of this soft, late-night cry.

title: Justice Became Prey
description: Ali, who lives an ordinary life, loses all the happiness and peace he once had in a single day. And with a glimmer of hope, he begins searching for the peace he can no longer find in this world — for himself and his little sister.

title: Clicko
description: clicko redefines clicker games. Place squares on screen, avoiding overlaps and collisions in this progressively challenging test of accuracy. Earn points to access a market for vital boosters. Discover unpredictable in-game effects for unique advantages.

title: Maze in Your Mind
description: Maze In Your Mind is a game about a three-layer maze connected by static portals where the player must find the right portal to unlock the final portal. Avoid enemies and explore the maze, but not the maze you see, but the maze you don't see, the maze in your mind.

title: Slime Tower
description: Slime Tower is a bright and cute 3D platformer game. Various traps and enemies are waiting for you. Collect various collectibles and reach the top of the tower.

title: Fear the Unknown: Jamie Story
description: This story is one of the rare accounts we've managed to document a tale from the few who have encountered UFOs and lived to tell the tale. Jamie's story has reached us and now, it's time to uncover what really happened.

title: Love Hotel Manager
description: Love Hotel Manager is a game where you own your own Love hotel! Manage and customize unique and whacky rooms while dealing with strange customers and their needs. Slowly expand your hotel to become a thriving business.

title: Taiwan Coolfox
description: 3D animal anthropomorphic characters, horizontal scrolling, action-adventure game, exciting fighting moves, and gorgeous background images. Controls are in side-scrolling combat mode: move left, move right, jump, punch attack, kick attack, dodge, wall jump, and special move.

title: Swarm Sweeper
description: In an abandoned space station that is being overrun by aliens, you are assigned a mission to destroy the facility. You'll enjoy wiping out alien swarm and fighting for survival alongside your lovely pug.

title: Touhou Volleyball
description: A fast-paced casual volleyball game featuring iconic Touhou characters. Jump, receive, and spike in chaotic 1vs1 matches!

title: Idle Universe Creator
description: Compete against others to create a universe in the shortest time in a unique take on the idle game genre. In Idle Universe Creator, your task is to craft atoms to fill an empty universe. Will you recreate our universe or craft brand new ones? What matters is how fast you can reach the target mass.

title: Assault Mayhem
description: Choose a character and battle through waves of enemies while leveling up and purchasing new weapons and equipment from a mysterious vending machine of unknown origins that spawns at the end of each wave.

title: Monster Mayhem
description: Face the mayhem! Monster Mayhem is a fast-paced 2D rogue-like action game with a cartoon art style. Battle through progressively harder levels, unlock new heroes and skills, and survive waves of monsters to unlock the next stage!

title: Peter's Apostles
description: Peter's Apostles is a strategy game of the Tower Defense genre set in a Cyberpunk world where you place a large arsenal of Towers, or here called Arms, capable of stopping and destroying the Malwares and Malicious programs and messages that threaten the security of the server you protect.

title: Penguin Rocketeer
description: Penguin Rocketeer is a fun, frantic flying game in which you help the penguin reach the moon, bouncing on clouds to propel you into the skies, and collecting as many coins, diamonds and other collectables as you can along the way!

title: Bit Dancer
description: BIT DANCER is a simple and casual rhythm game featuring retro original game music and cute pixel art. All you need are the arrow keys and a mouse. It runs in a small window, making it perfect for quick, one-handed play during breaks.

title: Dark Neighbors
description: Overview: a mischievously fun action game where you're one of the kids from the "Darkien Crew" on a mission to turn a picture-perfect suburban neighborhood into your personal splash zone. Armed with beautiful red water balloons and other cool items.

title: Ninjas on Trampolines
description: What if ninjas fought in a trampoline park, but with paint?

title: Cricket Captain 2025
description: Build your dream team with Cricket Captain 2025. Complete interface overhaul, with easier to use, clean look. New Player Editor for batting, bowling, fielding, aggression and opener type. Match engine update with more accurate 20 Over simulation. Fast-play engine.

title: Strange Place
description: Riding a flying dragon, catching pets, fighting demons. Turn based combat adventure game.

title: Invader Simulator
description: Absurd sci-fi action game about robots colonizing an alien world.

title: Shield Hero
description: Wrenched from your world by a rift, you awaken in a hostile arena. Your only defense is an ethereal shield that evolves with each wave of foes you vanquish. With no memory and no way home, you must master the shield's power to survive and uncover the secrets of this strange dimension.

title: Cyber Sensation: MicroLife
description: A quirky microgame collection with a 2.5D RPG twist, follow an indie team as they scramble to meet their final deadline in this charming, fast-paced adventure!

title: Pochard Jamie
description: "Pochard Jamie" is a platform action-puzzle game. The diving duck Jamie encounters numerous difficulties during migration. Unlock new levels, scenes, and items to help Jamie complete his mysterious migratory journey.

title: Millispeed
description: Eat. Grow. Survive.

title: Jumper's Doom
description: Jumper's Doom is a challenging 2D platformer with a retro vibe, where every obstacle could be your last. Play solo or in local co-op and restore color to the world as you jump through a dark, black-and-white landscape.

title: Collapse of the Midnight Sun
description: "Collapse Of The Midnight Sun" is a cozy indie game with metroidvania and time loop mechanics that is less than one hour long.

title: Seasons of Chiba
description: Players roleplay as a resident returning to their hometown, making choices at various stages of the town's development to influence its future and story outcomes. Return to your childhood town and continue life's journey.

title: Elysian Siege
description: Stand in Keziah’s footsteps and heed the Divine Order. Jump your way through, reclaim your goddess’s temple, obliterate enemies, and find the Tear of Creation in this beautiful platformer game!

title: Big Theft Valkeala
description: Open world shooter action game where player controls Terentius Duval in big open world. Mission is hang around and find money bags in big different open world

title: The Warp: Cephisso
description: Descend into the infested corridors of the Cephisso in this dark, atmospheric VR sci‑fi shooter. Wield the heavy JDE bolt‑action, load every round by hand—and feel the tension in each silent chamber. Find the survivor. Unravel the ship’s horror. Survive The Warp.

title: Vexbox
description: Uncover and activate the hidden effects of an ever-changing pyramid in this minesweeper-like game of mystery boxes.

title: Virtual Chess
description: VirtuaChess is the commercial version of the Écume and Cumulus 2 chess programs (which finished second in the blitz tournament in Munich and which tied 2nd/3rd in the 7th World Championships in Madrid). It runs on a PC with MS-DOS and can use all of the available memory for its hash tables. It has a splendid graphical interface written by the French firm Titus. Most of the chess engine is written in 32 bit assembler, and the program includes dynamic evaluation of king safety and pawn structure. It is based on PVS and uses null-move pruning. The program has perfect knowledge of KPK endgames. The evaluation function attempts to build plans whenever it recognizes important features in a position. VirtuaChess runs at 20,000 nodes per second on a Pentium 90.

title: Golftacular!
description: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf… barely.

title: Golf Of America
description: A game about hitting a ball around till it finds a hole.

title: Endless Furry Killer 2020
description: Endless Furry Killer 2020 is the game that lets you kill furries endlessly! Shoot furries in a endless 2D top down action packed adventure! Fun for the whole family!

title: Stick Figure Combat
description: Stick Figure Combat is a game where you fight other stick figures to secure the highest score possible. Try to survive as long as possible against endless hordes of grey enemies! Or create your own map and have your own fun!

title: Stick Figure Combat: Scythe
description: Unlocks the Scythe weapon in Stick Figure Combat!

title: Stick Figure Combat: Rocket Launcher
description: Unlocks the Rocket Launcher weapon in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Stick Figure Combat: Sniper Rifle
description: Unlocks the Sniper Rifle weapon in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Stick Figure Combat: Laser Saber
description: Unlocks the Laser Saber weapon in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Stick Figure Combat: Double Laser Saber
description: Unlocks the Double Laser Saber weapon in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Stick Figure Combat: Paintball Gun
description: Unlocks the Paintball Gun weapon in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Stick Figure Combat: Top Hat
description: Unlocks the Top Hat gear in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Stick Figure Combat: Legplates Large
description: Unlocks the Legplates Large gear in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Stick Figure Combat: Chestplate Large
description: Unlocks the Chestplate Large gear in Stick Figure Combat.

title: Endless Furry Pinball 2D
description: Welcome to Endless Furry Pinball 2D! The fourth installment of the "Endless Furry" Series! Just a basic Pinball game. Destroy Furries with your Pinball and gain points!

title: Eternal Hunt
description: Isometric action RPG, where you embark on an adventure to slay enemies in order to level up and unlock different skills to grow stronger.

title: Draftycar 2
description: Let chaos reign. Join the ultimate high-speed chess match at 200 MPH. DRAFTYCAR 2 is a multiplayer stockcar racer. Battle with up to 43 opponents. Easy to learn, impossible to master—it's pure, brainy, bumper-to-bumper madness. One wrong move and you'll be in the middle of a sheet metal blender.

title: LetDeco
description: Explore a world full of cute doll friends and decorate their homes!

title: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox
description: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox is an immersive game that stands out for its realistic ragdoll physics, which together with various creation and damage tools, provides the player with a mix of realism and fun.

title: Jungle Rot
description: Jungle Rot is a fixed-camera survival horror game that makes use of pre-rendered graphics to deliver the most cutting edge horror experience possible in 1999. Manage your resources wisely, solve puzzles and fight your way through undead monsters hungry for your flesh!

title: 100 Hong Kong Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all? ️

title: 100 Amsterdam Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

title: 100 Camp Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

title: Lambdarune
description:
Lambdarune is a take on Deltarune by Zet. It's a Deltarune AU that includes original Chapters 3 to 7, with some subtle things in Chapters 1 and 2 being recontextualized. Lambdarune is Zet's main project and has been shown through animations, music, and mostly community posts… until now.

The game is structured into Chapters 3-7, with each chapter divided into 2-4 Installments.

title: Veil of Torment
description: Enter the abandoned Black Water Asylum in search of a missing girl. Veil of Torment is a psychological horror game where reality twists, shadows whisper, and every step drags you deeper into madness.

title: HellHeart Breaker
description: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

title: Feral Echoes
description: Feral Echoes is an exciting survival adventure where every step counts. The game combines elements of survival, exploration, magic, and combat. Explore wild lands, build shelters, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and create your unique story.

title: Dread Flats
description: This is a first-person Chinese horror game, players will go to a murder building, uncover the truth of the murder, find the missing people. Players will experience an intense sense of claustrophobia and horror, carefully designed scary points, a 1990s Chinese atmosphere, and mysterious, eerie, and twisted unknown entities.

title: Star Legacy
description: Venture into the depths of space and leave your legacy among the stars. In Star Legacy, explore galaxies, upgrade your ship, and survive on unknown planets.

title: Nightin Cage
description: Play as a unique hero in a fantasy dungeon crawler. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, battle enemies, evade traps, solve puzzles, collect diverse items and distinctive costumes, master skills, and freely combine abilities to forge your personal combat style.

title: A Game That Rhymes With Grug
description:
In an alternate universe with no cars, no planes, no homes, and no fashion... You must travel back in time and steal the inventions of the man who invented it all... His name? It rhymes with Grug...

Quickly find all of Grugs inventions and escape back to the future, don't let Grug catch you. Grug is after you, he knows you don't belong, he knows you don't rhyme with Grug.

title: Luckrot
description: Roguelike shooter set in a dystopian, livestreamed gameshow. Obliterate waves of deformed freaks, earn donations from your sadistic audience and gamble your earnings for upgrades. Your life is a Performance. Your Death is Content.

title: Echoveil: The Last Guest
description: A short, atmospheric first-person horror game set in an abandoned motel where guests vanish without a trace. Explore, uncover secrets, and escape before becoming the next lost soul

title: The Black Signal
description: Card Combat RPG featuring Sci-Fi aesthetics, a twisted meta-narrative and social criticism.

title: Keyboard Warrior Simulator
description: Keyboard Warrior Simulator — fight internet trolls by typing key combinations quickly! Your speed and accuracy are the only weapons in meme battles and the final boss fight. Are you ready to prove that you are the king of the keyboard?

title: Total Driftin': Touge Dreams
description: Master each corner, burn rubber, and become a legend high in the Japanese mountains. Total Driftin': Touge Dreams is a tribute to classic '90s drifting, with precise physics, retro aesthetics, and a cult-like soul. Do you have what it takes to become a touge god?

title: Whispered Secrets: Cursed Wealth - Collector's Edition
description: Can you find the truth hidden behind the castle walls?

title: Vulcard
description: In this two-player, time-based, roguelike deckbuilder, you have to collaborate to survive! Communication is key, but you need to be fast because enemies don't wait for you to end your turn. Devise unique strategies, meet curious creatures and battle your way to the top of the volcano.

title: Cats Hidden in Chang'an
description: Travel back to Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty of China and find 100 hidden adorable kittens  in a captivating hand-drawn art scene. Do you want to challenge yourself?

title: Conlutus
description: Conlutus is a short arcade adventure game featuring one large level. Collect coins and stars as you progress and manage you're oxygen levels to survive and beat you're previous high score.

title: Port Shipping Tycoon
description: Flip tiles to grow your shipping empire. A relaxing maritime logistics idle game.

title: Turbo Truck Islands
description: Monster Truck Racing with 6 customizable truck, 4 tracks in day and night mode, damage, and boost/power/chassis upgrades along with 8 high-tempo original music tracks. Single Race and Championship Play modes.

title: Arrow Dungeon
description: A tactical action roguelike where you survive a dark dungeon with limited arrows, light-based exploration, and fast-paced bow combat.

title: My Pet Fan
description: An Inanimate Insanity fan-made virtual pet and simulation game where you take care of the character 'Fan' from the series.

title: Build & Survive
description: Build, craft, and survive in an endless sandbox world filled with danger. Gather resources, fight enemies, and upgrade your base as threats grow stronger. Will you endure or fall in this fast-paced survival challenge?

title: The Last Shot: Arcades
description: The pack of Arcades in The Last Shot Universe

title: Tsan-shadow Ninja
description: Tsan-shadow ninja is a 2D platform adventure game with stealth and combat elements The mechanics are based on stealth and the use of abilities acquired through ninja training! You will feel like a real shinobi when you attack unexpectedly or sneak around unnoticed...

title: Nekomin Kittens Invasion
description: Nekomin is a cute puzzle action game where you use a cat toy to guide kittens into a hole! Solve puzzles with items and tricks within the time limit or simply enjoy watching the kittens play. Collect sneaky thief cats and complete your Neko List Collection!

title: Operation Ninurta: Eris Portal
description: Operation Ninurta is a third-person tactical shooter with roguelike elements. Explore an infinite procedural maze on Eris, face mutants and bosses, find three crystal keys, and reactivate the portal to win. With limited ammo, upgrades, and warped realities, strategy is vital.

title: Living Shadows
description: In Living Shadows, explore a dystopian future where humans and shadows have been separated. Solve puzzles, face challenges, and dive into a deep narrative as you uncover hidden secrets in a dark world.

title: The Chess
description: The ChessThemed Chess offers a relaxing, minimalist chess experience with multiple boards, piece sets, AI opponents, and multiplayer. Play in 3D or 2D, learn the game's history, and explore RPG-themed DLC. Free to Play - Download now and enjoy endless strategy!

title: Growing Things Up
description: In Growing Things Up, you will be a young man living in a new city full of expectations and insecurities. However, things take an intriguing turn when you are mistakenly placed as a guest in a dormitory where only women are allowed. In this place, you will meet beautiful girls with strong personalities who will need your help to better explore their sexualities and fetishes. Now it is up to you to find ways and the energy to delve into the sordid desires that some pretty faces can hide.

title: Super Ultra Mustard Man
description: A cute and colorful pixel adventure!

title: Paizuri Fantasies
description: Paizuri Fantasies is a series of adult comic 'kinetic' visual novel stories... In Paizuri Hotel; Joshua has inherited the Pai Hotel and satisfy the 'needs' of the female residents. In Yuuki's Fantasies; Yuuki gets to explore her own sexual fantasies... Also includes bonus issue: Paizuri Fantasies.

title: Vtuber Survivor
description: Vtuber Survivors is a roguelike survival game that allows you to play as your favorite Vtuber. Strengthen your beloved Vtuber to battle against technological byproducts invading their home. Help restore a peaceful sanctuary for the Vtubers.

title: Fairytale Thief: Sleeping Beauty
description: Will you wake him up?

title: Tung Sahur Zombie
description: Escape a deadly dungeon as Tung Tung Tung Sahur, the last survivor of a brainrot zombie outbreak. Dodge deadly traps, jump through chaotic levels, and reunite with your lost friends in this fast-paced, physics-based 3D platformer full of absurd charm and challenge.

title: Shadow Protocol
description: Suit up as an elite undercover agent in Shadow Protocol, a fast-paced, word-powered spy puzzle built entirely in Python. Crack cryptic clues, complete rapid-fire missions, and outwit a global threat. Now available on Windows.

title: FlipCard
description: If you know topological sorting, you will quickly understand how to play this game. The cards on the left are the predecessors of the cards on the right. Eliminate the cards without predecessors first, and you will win if you finally clear all the cards.

title: Pixel Troopers
description: In Pixel Troopers you will fight against all kinds of insects, gather your friends and prepare to survive as long as possible, or face each other in a Deathmatch in this Cooperative Multiplayer game.

title: Far Fishing
description: Far Fishing is a short and relaxing fishing game. Set off on a journey to the edge of the world, catching a variety of fish and upgrading your boat along the way.

title: Streets of Fear
description: Streets of Fear is a gritty side scrolling beat 'em up where you play as Phobia, a chaotic force tearing through a corrupt city. The police aren’t heroes, they are terrified targets.

title: Ball Travel
description: Help the Ball to save his girlfriend. Go on a trip around the world. Go through obstacles and solve puzzles. Collect as many stars as possible.

title: Cyber Dungeon X Monster Girls
description: A synth-soaked mining game about paying off an unfair debt and Monster Girls. Break blocks while your employee battles endless legions of monstrous women.

title: Silent Survivor: Under the Crisis
description: Get ready for chaos! In Silent Survivor, you control unique heroes fighting off relentless hordes in intense survival arenas. Your goal? Last as long as possible — and that takes more than brute strength.

title: Kiritan Thruster
description: Reach the top of mountain with Kiritan Cannon!! Slightly hardcore 2d platform.

title: The Last Among The Dead
description: Dive into a devastated world where survival depends not only on your weapons… but on your choices. In The Last Among The Dead, play as a survivor trapped in a land ravaged by a mysterious infection.

title: ALife
description: A mysterious lifeform, ALife, survives by consuming ores. Watch their lives unfold—slow-paced and endearing. You cannot control or upgrade ALife. All you can do is observe and watch over them. Witness generations of ALife as they live their lives. Relax in a laid-back world with soothing BGM.

title: Apocalypse Tale
description: This is a post-apocalyptic survival farming game where you can plant crops, chop wood, fish, mine, trade, play the stock market—but most importantly, plan how to stay alive.

title: Volcano Jumper
description: The floor has turned into lava. Escape the volcano by stepping on various objects! Use the W, A, S, D key to move and press space to jump. Can you find the hidden super jump?

title: Orange Simulator
description: An exciting platformer where you play as an orange navigating a series of challenging obstacles to reach the top. Jump and roll your way through a dynamic environment, all in pursuit of the ultimate prize—the fruit bowl at the peak.

title: Plumber’s Legacy
description: Plumber's Legacy is a classic 2D platformer where you run, jump, and stomp your way through colorful levels to uncover a forgotten legacy. Simple, nostalgic fun with a few enemy surprises along the way!

title: Out of the Ordinary
description: This is a car simulation game where you drive vehicles through levels. In carefully crafted levels, you control vehicles to advance through the levels and storyline in a fictional world, challenging your patience, following the protagonist's growth, and experiencing the thrill of driving vehicles.

title: Gargouti Simulator
description: Open your humble food stand in a lively Algerian neighborhood and begin your journey into the world of traditional street food!

title: BirdQuest Find the Difference
description: Find the Differences — A Fun Adventure in the World of Birds!Embark on a colorful journey through 70 levels where all sorts of birds await you: vibrant parrots, exotic birds on roller skates! Some are just chilling on branches, while others surprise with their activity and character.

title: The Last Heroine
description: A 3rd-person adventure game of sword fighting against powerful enemies.

title: ThrowDown
description: ThrowDown is a familiar yet unique tower defense game with randomly generated maps, reactive mobs, and is designed for replayability.

title: Deltarune: Reimagined - Angelic Altercation
description:
Deltarune:Reimagined - ANGELIC ALTERCATION is the first small fangame of Deltarune:Reimagined created by ZET, an Alternate Universe of Toby Fox's Deltarune— showing the first battle you have with Chapter 4's Secret Boss.

In it, you play as Kris, who, after falling from a very high place while trying to escape from the Faith Enforcer, has lost their friends and must traverse a Crystalline Forest, when all of the sudden, they find a strange path...

title: Undertale Yellow: Shades of Justice
description: Undertale Yellow: Shades of Justice is a mod for Undertale Yellow that expands upon the Pacifist Route by providing new character interactions and a twist to the follower system!

title: Onigiri Run
description: You are an onigiri that escaped from a convenience store. Dash through the city, dodging cars and obstacles on your way to freedom! A simple yet addictive high-speed onigiri running action game!

title: Kaskade
description: Connect an evolving delivery network in Kaskade, a minimalist strategy game. Construct intricate paths to ensure each delivery gets to the right destination. Unlock upgrades to manage the increasing complexity as your network grows. Relax to the ambient soundtrack and the satisfying puzzle vibes.

title: MeloMisterio: Play Your Melody
description: The melody you play moves the world — experience a brand-new kind of musical 3D platforming action.

title: Joltt: Battle Pillars
description: A hyper-accessible 2D fighting game where challengers face off in magical jousts. Outmaneuver your opponent's attacks and knock them off their pillar to be the last one standing. No close combat. No blocking. Dodge and counter everything to be victorious!

title: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
description: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

title: Die Deep
description: Die Deep delivers a pure and focused combat experience - it’s all about reading your foes and mastering your timing to strike back. Nothing stands in your way but combat! Dive into a constantly changing abyss, take down every enemy in your way, and enjoy the ultimate head-to-head battle experience.

title: Depth:Origin
description: Depth:Origin is a rhythm game that takes the approach of a shooting game. ・Shoot the enemies that attack you in time with the rhythm ・Avoid the boss's attacks in time with the music Use these two actions to save energy for your ship and defeat the boss.

title: Demon Raiders: Bloody Gems of Blood
description: A vulgar, cute & competitive party game! Stab your friends (2~4 players) and splatter their blood across loads of levels! Pools of blood will spawn rotten-blood monsters and power-up chests! Get stabbed! Get eaten! Never die! Even if you become poop! Single player co-op campaign also in development!

title: Delve Survivors
description: An old-school roguelike game with modern survivors-like action! Delve into multiple retro pixelated dungeons where you control the pace with fast, reactive turn based movement and ever expanding skills which enable you to plow through hordes of enemies before escaping with the loot

title: Ballad: As the Music Goes
description: Ballad is a musical cosy 3rd person 3D adventure game. Explore several biomes, discover melodies in order to call, help, sooth, interact with the world and villagers around you thanks to your Kalimba ! Or just chill and jam in a colorful place, whatever you choose, magic of music awaits you !

title: Awaking Beauty
description: Let’s save the world through dreaming—together! "Awaking Beauty" is a two-character roguelite action game that blends sci-fi and fantasy. You’ll play as selected high school girls piloting dream-diving mechas to rescue those trapped in the dream world.

title: A Passing in the Night
description: Immerse yourself in a third-person adventure game in which you take a timed, one hour-long night walk. Explore a reactive and surreal neighborhood where reality bends and spirits lurk in the shadows. Converse with other lost wanderers and reclaim hope in a bleak world.

title: Echoes of Light: Child of the Balance
description:
In Echoes of Light, step into the worn boots of Kaela, a lone swordswoman on a desperate journey to rescue her kidnapped brother and restore the balance between light and shadow.

Explore a crumbling world consumed by darkness as you fight your way through corrupted forests, forgotten temples, and realms beyond time. With no magic to aid you-only steel and skill-you'll face brutal enemies and haunting bosses, each guarding a piece of the truth.

title: Arena Returns
description: Arena Returns is a tactical turn-based fighting game set in the colorful World of Twelve universe. Players engage in strategic PvP battles using customizable teams of characters, each with unique classes, spells, and abilities drawn from the beloved MMORPG.

title: Kick Yourself On
description: A puzzle game about riding rails, kicking switches, and radio waves. You find yourself at the base of a radio tower. Can you make it to the center?

title: Dumb AF
description: Dumb AF is a 3D, Stylized platformer where you tackle challenging obstacles on a quest to reach an ancient pyramid. Dodge lethal sandstorms and navigate absurd, goofy traps in a funny, high-stakes race that tests your reflexes and wit.

title: Rectifier: In Bloom
description:
To the world of Aelyria, you are known as an Angel, but to you, you're "Rectifier".

Regardless of the terminology, your role is the same. Save humanity from itself.

You find yourselves in a party of 7 men, all with their sinful...quirks.

title: Robots With Guns
description: Robots with Guns is a PvP rouge-lite shooter where you have to outplay your opponents with fast-paced shooting, dashing and gathering items! Each time you win, your opponent gets stronger. Overcome this imbalance to claim ultimate victory!

title: Bolek i Lolek: Język angielski dla najmłodszych
Cheems Bonk
description: Cheems Bonk is a casual single-player zone-denial arcade game. Defeat an endless wave of Evil Cheems.

title: Connected Colors
description: A peaceful platformer game where u need to switch colors

title: Gutbuster
description: Digest the ravenous Rebbecca's meals in this arcade style run and gun erotic comedy game. Dodge and blast the chewed food, collect powerups, and spend lipids at the upgrade shop to survive the challenge and prevent indigestion! For mature players.

title: Domestic
description: Domestic is an early "walking simulator" that repurposes the Unreal engine to recreate a remembered childhood home after a house fire. Players navigate a dreamlike, memory‑mapped space of warped scales, shifting texts, and oversized family snapshots, encountering fire and using symbolic "coping mechanisms"—romance‑novel covers—to contain it. Blurring architectural realism and psychic interiority, the work invites slow exploration and reflection on how space, memory, and narrative intertwine.

title: Torrente On-Line
description:
Torrente On-Line is an expansion that comes with the FX Interactive version of Torrente, released only physically in Spain, and bundled within the same disc without extra installation.

The game came with standard game modes, such as (Team) Deathmatch or Capture the Flag.

The developers released the dedicated server files, although self-hosting is possible without downloading them.

title: Hotel Investigation 09
description: An archival of a strange game that cropped up online. Play as Howlz, explore the hotel's halls, and rescue the captive under the building.

title: Till Midnight
description:
Till Midnight is a narrative-driven management simulation game with world-shattering consequences, inspired by true historical events.

You are a commanding officer navigating a darkly atmospheric submarine amid critical communication failures.

Which side of history will you fall on?

title: 15 Minutes to the End of the World
description: 15 minutes to the End of the World is a third person shooter inspired in anime and japanese culture, with a story based on the best time-loop Hollywood feature films - with a twist!

title: Arcturus
description: A dark psychological horror science fiction game where survival is based on your knowledge acquired through observation and exploration of the unique biomes in this inhospitable alien world of Arcturus.

title: Thunder of the DemonKing
description: Thunder of the Demon King is an action tower defense game with simple controls. Play as the resurrected Demon King, battling the kingdom’s forces alone. Use powerful thunder attacks to protect yourself and enjoy the thrilling battles as you take down waves of enemies.

title: Usersleepwalker
description: usersleepwalker is a short pointnclick, abstract, horror and shooter where sleepless nights stretch on in the search for solace.

title: My Husband is a Stranger
description: A psychological/drama/romance visual novel about a sweet marriage that slowly rots into a nightmare. Over the course of seven days, try to navigate a rocky relationship with your husband and unravel the mysteries surrounding this man... who might not be the man you married.

title: Iron Dice
description: The empire has fallen. Will you reunite its factions or forge your own path? Iron Dice is an open-ended grand strategy game set in a fictional, early medieval world. Outmaneuver and outwit your neighboring kingdoms as you develop your economy, research new technologies, and conquer territory.

title: Ultimate Pro Football Coach
description: A strategic franchise mode football sim where you run the front office and call all the shots —build your roster, manage the franchise and handle the play calling to guide your team to glory across seasons of immersive franchise-building.

title: Rogueball Recess
description: Today you are the captain! Draft your winning team from a lively cast of jocks and geeks in this Roguelike team builder, set in an early 90s schoolyard. Combine cliques’ unique abilities to build powerful synergies, and dominate the other teams in Rogueball Recess.

title: Sin & Siege
description: Sin & Siege is a rogue-lite strategy where you must restore the shattered circles of Hell. Harvest and process sinful souls, amass Sins, forge new demons, populate the abyss, and defend it from holy monstrosities.

title: Sisyphus Simulator
description: A casual, incremental clicker based on the famous Greek myth. Roll up an infinite mountain, earning money to unlock upgrades and decorations for your customizable boulder!

title: Teeny Tidy
description: A tiny desktop idle game where a little robot tidies a small room sitting on your screen. Customize the room with countless options, maybe put them in outer space? Or even in a dojo room inside a witch’s shop?!

title: I Am Night
description: A folk horror roguelike deckbuilder where you tear apart and scrap together cards to face monsters, unravel mysteries, and survive a world forged in fear. Set out on a brave, twisted adventure of self-discovery.

title: Arcane Rings
description: Defend your imperial cities against the invasion of underworld mages! Rally survivors, mages and soldiers, strengthen your defenses and fight for survival in this epic tower defense fantasy.

title: The Search For Sonic Mania 2
description: A joke game made for RAGE 2024, The Search For Sonic Mania 2 sees Sonic exploring a familiar world in the search for a lost sequel.

title: Cats Away
description: A nautical adventure featuring beautiful pirates, adorable talking cats and nail-biting sea battles, Cats Away brings real-time strategy to the high seas! Give orders to your ever-expanding cat crew and save the world from the reawakening of an ancient evil!

title: Halo: GoldSource
description: Halo: GoldSource recreates the legendary gameplay of the iconic & beloved franchise in the Half-Life engine.

title: The Forgers
description:
The goal is to correctly fill in all the sentences in your answers list in order to crack the case.
Look for any contradictions between the picture/plaque and external sources, that may point to it being a forgery.

title: Super Cabbage Kabumi
description: The roguelike all about bonking cabbages! Make incredible builds with a vast array of items, wield powerful weapons, change the game entirely with pets, fight fantastical bosses, and so much more!

title: Tanks Blitz
description:
Tanks Blitz is a F2P massively multiplayer tank PVP shooter with an age rating of 12+.

The game boasts a huge number of different locations, modes, and vehicles. The gameplay is based on team battles, where each side seeks to capture the base, earn points, or destroy all enemy tanks.

title: House on [Redacted] Street
description:
In this "Case of the Golden Idol" inspired game, players will search through an abandoned house to discover what happened to the family that used to live there.

Rifle through letters.

Unlock doors.

Unravel a surreal mystery.

Fill out exciting paperwork reports including A44-D1, A44-C2, and more!

title: Amnesia: A Coward's Debt
description:
Your name is Jean. You are 42 years old. You live alone with your wife Evangelyne in your French estate. These are the only things you know for sure.

You awaken in your home, with no memories of the past few weeks. Your wife is nowhere to be found. Through the windows you can only see inky blackness. What’s more, you can hear something stalking the hallways of your home. And it’s getting closer.

title: Empire in Decay
description:
Empire in Decay is a roguelike deckbuilding turn-based tactical game, loosely based on chess. Its gameplay has been broadened with the use of cards and the progression of units. In the game, you'll proceed through procedurally generated routes across the districts of Daandria, the capital of the Empire.

In your journey to the Throne Hall to face the King, you will have to fight turn-based combats through different locations, collect cards and upgrade them, recruit units to support your cause and enhance them, find relics and forge artifacts to boost your powers, and use all your cunning and skill to make your way through waves of enemies.

title: Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business
description: Buck Trucker must gamble and sweet-talk his way through The Golden Palm Casino, Las Vegas, to save an orphanage back home—or succumb to Sin City's many temptations in this choice-driven story featuring mini-games, multiple endings, and a cast of outlandish characters.

title: Stoned
description: Three stoners accidentally become possessed by the soul of an Ancient Cosmic Wizard and gain magical powers. They then go on an adventure to try and get rid of said powers. A Turn-Based RPG with a unique story and "pong-style" battle mechanics.

title: Durga: The Lionhearted
description: Play as Durga, a fearless village girl on a journey of survival and self-discovery. A story driven RPG blends puzzles with adventure into the Indian forest. Unravel ancient Indian tales, face wild beasts, and embrace a legacy that transforms her from a brave villager to a guardian of culture.

title: Shift 0
description: Co-op for 2–4 players. Carry fully physics-based objects, complete tasks, and move up floor by floor, but don’t forget that time is limited. Your internship ends with either a job offer or a full reset.

title: Full Metal Schoolgirl
description:
In the year 2089, the United Federation of Japan is an industrial powerhouse, while also being one of the world’s leading countries in overtime work.

In this sickening future, the economy is booming and working 24 hours a day is considered virtuous.

The core of this country’s industry, economy, and social system are controlled by a single giant corporation.

The rampage of a fully mechanized schoolgirl—a fully armed cyborg heroine storms into a giant corporation and unleashes a relentless barrage of gunfire and sword action in this exhilarating cyborg schoolgirl action adventure. The feeling of immorality is irresistible when you break into an office and wreak havoc.

title: Secret HavEat
description:
I am...

The world that the train has brought us to is a mysterious world.
This is a game in which a girl, HavEat, walks through a mysterious world.
What is the secret of HavEat that awaits her at the end of her walk?

title: Limbus Stable
description: Parody fangame for Limbus Company based on Horse Race Tests by Blake Andrews. Watch your sinners race around in 7 different maps or fight to the death in the Battle Royale mode.

title: Fruitimo!
description: Fruit exploration action adventure of a boy [Vimita] and an android [Grandpa]!Let’s go on an adventure to collect giant fruits in a juicy and colorful theme park.

title: WanderersTip
description: WanderersTip is a stealth adventure about accidentally joining a cult. Blend in with the flock. Sneak through mazes. Combat enemies. Your actions define your survival and the fate of the cult.

title: Don't Let Me Fade
description: Don't Let Me Fade is an interactive adventure about memory, identity, and loss. Piece together fragments of a life - even if a simple teddy bear is the last symbol of connection to oneself in a world without time.

title: Hell Builder
description: Build your infernal domain by strategically placing hell structures from cards. Master synergistic placement to earn Souls, unlock new buildings, and complete the Dark Lord's vision. When resources run low, Transmute Hell for powerful relics and begin anew in this roguelike city builder.

title: Diablo IV: Sins of the Horadrim
description: New bonds are forged as old enemies arise, reborn and hellbent on untold destruction. On July 1, Season 9: Sins of the Horadrim lets you wield powerful Horadric Spellcraft and unearth the secrets of the past in a new Seasonal Questline. Unearth and cleanse Blood Relics infused with Astaroth’s corruption to staunch his malevolent return to Sanctuary. This update also brings permanent updates to Nightmare Dungeons for both Seasonal and Eternal Realms, including new Horadric Strongroom micro-dungeons, endgame Escalating Nightmares, and new Nightmare Dungeon affixes.

title: Sagittarius: The Lost and Cursed
description: Sagittarius: The Lost and Cursed is an indie horror game that lets you experience elements of survival, psychological horror and puzzle solving. Survive through five unique nightmares, where each one is worse than the last. Dig up the secrets the Gray family tried to bury.

title: Killer Aces Volleyball
description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's clubs in the world!

title: Meow Weight Loss Diary
description: The cat has turned into a ball? Exercise the cat in the game world by continuously jumping upward, burning calories, relaxing your mood, and being careful not to fall.

title: Kisten Royale
description: Kisten Royale – the chaotic, team-based box battler mayhem. Available for Windows and Linux.

title: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator
description: Electronics Repair Simulator lets players operate their own electronics workshop where they diagnose and fix various devices including receivers, phones, and speakers. Players use authentic repair techniques like soldering and component replacement while managing a growing business. Through successful repairs, they earn money to expand their workshop and take on more complex projects.

title: Magical Capture
description: A cosy, relaxing escape into a world of wonder—Magical Capture wraps you in warmth and quiet charm.

title: Iron Tangle Breakout
description: Play as a robot trying to escape from a metal maze while being hunted! Evade the machines tracking you, avoid the traps and obstacles throughout the maze, blow up any foe that gets in your way! Survive for as long as you can while trying to Escape from the Iron Tangle!

title: Knight vs. Monsters
description: Fight as a fearless knight against endless waves of monsters. Use your sword, collect power-ups, and survive the onslaught. Boost your health and speed to stay alive in this fast-paced, wave-based action game.

title: Skybound Saga
description: Skybound Saga is a sandbox RPG where you explore floating islands, build skybases, craft powerful gear, and reshape the world block by block. Adventure above the clouds awaits!

title: Waifu Wave Defenders
description: Fast paced, hack and slash action game with female protagonist and antagonists

title: Batta? Batta!
description: "Join the adventure with Battery Knight Beta!"

title: PathSketch
description: PathSketch is a classic puzzle-solving game.

title: Worldshadow
description: Explore the vibrant streets of Manhattan in an immersive open world experience. Navigate the city's , engage in thrilling missions, and uncover secrets in a dynamic, living environment. Your choices shape the world around you, offering a unique adventure with every playthrough.

title: Hack n Slash Prototype
description: The Hack n Slash Prototype created for the 2012 Amnesia Fortnight.

title: Idle Guy
description: Idle Guy is a life simulation game in which absolutely everything is available! Real life simulator! Adventures in a real life business simulator are waiting for you. Build a Rich Inc. campaign in the world of a life simulator! Simulator of an idle life in which absolutely everything is available!

title: Lone Labyrinth: Burden of the Just
description: A morally-charged action RPG where you hunt the condemned to decide who deserves salvation–or punishment.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Chill of Ravenloft
description: Venture to Lamordia, a land forever bound by ice and shrouded in darkness. Amidst bleak alleys, derelict factories, and grotesque laboratories, sinister secrets fester beneath the surface; mysterious disappearances, grisly murders, and ghastly experiments gone awry. Confront the scientific horrors crafted by the brilliant but terrifying Dr. Viktra Mordenheim.

title: Over the Moon
description: The final game in The Rose Garden Trilogy. Can you convince Moon to come home, or will her anger towards you be ever resolute?

title: Troubled Waters
description: Explore an ocean of horror and memories in search of the cursed mirror in the abyss. Collect loot to upgrade your equipment, avoid malevolent entities and make sure you have enough rope to resurface safely.

title: Beasts of Fortune
description: A roaming-warband roguelike with procedurally generated units and autobattler combat.

title: Bellatores
description: Bellatores is an open-world adventure MMORPG set in the 15th-century medieval era, centered around conflicts between noble houses. Amid loyalty and betrayal, war and unity, your decisions may change the course of history. A journey to uncover the kingdom’s hidden truths awaits you.

title: Garden Hunt
description: Watch out for sharp corners… Dash through a garden maze as a slug snail, collecting slimes while dodging enemies! A gooey, dot-eating style slime tag game!

title: Bird Like
description: Bird Like is a casual roguelite flight game where you soar toward destination, dodging all kinds of obstacles along the way. Pick upgrades, equip mysterious artifacts, and build your own path. What awaits at the edge of the world? Time is running out. The most important thing is—just keep going.

title: Four Divine Abidings
description: Complete the Path to Liberation in the mindfulness-themed idle/incremental game inspired by Buddhist philosophy. Enjoy a calm, atmospheric hand-painted Journey with strategic depth and multiple layers of progression.

title: Our Summer Festival 2
description: The time for Our Summer Festival has come around again! Get ready for tons of festive fun with friends!
