title: LinkedOut
description: Try your best and improve as a human resources at Davos, Inc. For this, you will use Linkedout, the best tool to know a possible employee. A game developed for Fuck Capitalism Game Jam 2025.

title: Glorious Golf
description: A fun rage platform game where you ascend a farm as a golf ball!

title: Konran;Zanki
description:
Fujita Anju, an average college student, finds herself trapped in an unfamiliar location with several other people. As their memory loss as well as the ominous situation indicates that something's going wrong, a weird cubic creature named Dokuroku appears with the intention to hack into their Prisms, a daily-use microship implanted in the body at birth, and enroll them in a thrilling,
deadly adventure.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Autumn 2020
description:
Beautiful autumn pictures
Content: 5 puzzles in 4 levels of difficulty.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Monkeys & Apes Puzzles
description:
Puzzles of monkeys & apes!
Content: 13 Puzzles in 4 levels of difficulty.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Puppies 2
description:
Puzzles of beautiful puppies!
Content: 17 Puzzles in 4 levels of difficulty.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Waves
description:
Puzzles of great waves!
Content: 18 Puzzles in 4 levels of difficulty.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Winter 2021
description:
Beautiful puzzles about winter!
Content: 17 Puzzles in 4 levels of difficulty.

title: Submission
description:
Submission is originally one of twelve games that made up the third Dread X Collection.

You basically wander around a farm and help Potato the Donkey collect apples, meet some of his friends, and that's really pretty much it.

title: The Esoteric Archive
description: Those with a thirst for knowledge, and an understanding of the weavings, may find themselves in a library like no other. A deep perseverance and an amount of aimless wandering is required to find this place, but should you find it, you would surely find all the answers you seek. For this Esoteric Archive is vast, possibly endless, and filled with knowledge not meant for mankind. However, you have need of such knowledge, don’t you. Otherwise, why would you have come to such a place?

title: Hatsune Miku: Project Diva Future Tone - Future Sound
description: Main content packs focusing on songs that debuted on PlayStation platforms.

title: I Wanna Start a Party
description: A fan-game of I Wanna Be The Guy based on the Mario Party series, with minigames and characters based on both games, plus IWBTG's various fan-games and community -in-jokes. Play alone or with friends with fully functional 4 player online, with boards based on various video games, from popular to obscure.

title: Crash Bandicoot: Respun
description: A new Crash Bandicoot fangame has been released by ‪RS Project‬. It’s called Crash Bandiocot: Respun and it plays like the original PS1 games.

title: .G
description: Avoid meteorites and survive until the end.

title: Astro Surge
description: Dive into retro twin-stick chaos in Astro Surge! Shoot through endless waves, level up fast, and unleash pixel-powered mayhem in space.

title: Ballista Wall Defense Rush
description: Ballista Wall Defense Rush is a defense game where you upgrade your ballista and fight off endless waves of monsters. Earn gold from each kill, improve your defenses, and see how long you can survive against increasingly stronger enemies!

title: Bats Bits Balls
description: Welcome to BITS BATS BALLS - the place where your dual-analog reflexes are put to the test! Destroy blocks, collect bits, and progress from one level to the next, only to find yourself in an infinite mode catered for the most hardcore of players!

title: Birthday of Horrors
description: It’s your party, you’ll scream if you want to.

title: Call of Brothers: The Backrooms Zombie Survival
Command Under Fire RTS
description: Take Command. Build Power. Conquer Islands.

title: Fear of Hunger
description: Healthy breakfast before school lunch

title: DeviLevel: Try Again
description: Precision Platforming Meets Demonic Challenge

title: Fill The Cup 2
description: The main challenge lies in guiding the stream of water around obstacles that block its direct path to the cup. With only a limited supply of water, players must think strategically by avoiding unnecessary barriers and carefully managing their resources to fill the cup and bring a smile to its face. As the game progresses, each level becomes difficult.

title: Gemz Burst
description: Gemz Burst puts you in control of a high-speed ship orbiting a deadly space zone. Fire toward the center to break spinning rings of energy gems and expose the turret core at the heart of the chaos. Time your shots and dodge incoming fire as you blast through each layer of danger in this intense outer-ring shooter.

title: Gray War Conflict
description: Every mission could be your last — are you ready?

title: Saturday Morning RPG: It's So Bad Edition
description: Saturday Morning RPG is an episodic JRPG set in world heavily inspired by 1980s Saturday morning cartoons and pop culture. Players take the role of Martin 'Marty' Michael Hall, an average high-school student who has just been granted an incredible power - a power that ultimately leads him to attract the ire of the world's most notorious villain, Commander Hood! Saturday Morning RPG features a full soundtrack by legendary composer Vince DiCola (Transformers: The Animated Movie, Rocky IV) and his composing partner, Kenny Meriedeth (contributor for DuckTales, Power Rangers, X-Men, and others).

title: BeatQuest: Rhythm Riders
description: Hit every note. Own every stage.

title: Boost Zero
description: Boost Zero is a vibrant homage to classic anti-gravity arcade racing games, where excitement and speed merge in adrenaline-fueled futuristic competitions.

title: Become the Smartest in the Room! Brain Power Boost Plan
description: Have you ever wanted to become smarter? This guide shows you how to unlock the full potential of your brain and enhance your thinking, decision-making, and focus.

title: Cozy Adventures
description: Relax, explore, and uncover hidden beauty.

title: Eggconsole Zanac EX MSX2
description: The Zanac battle, which was supposed to have ended, was not over. To suppress the reactivated organic intelligence, Zanac takes flight once again!

title: House Fighters: Total Mess
description: House Fighters: Total Mess is a PvE aerial arcade shooter where toy planes battle in everyday spaces. Engage in fast-paced dogfights in this nostalgia-filled world, take on clever foes, and fight to save your fellow toy friends!

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Namyangju-si
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Lush Season
description: Quiet paths lead to hidden wonders.

title: Make it! Choco Banana
description:
It's time for a cute choco banana-making challenge!
Make as many as you can, and watch your food cart prosper!

title: Miko Girls
description:
Many mysterious and cute shrine maidens appear!
An easy puzzle game that anyone can play!

title: Mystery Hotel: Hidden Objects
description: Solve the riddle of the mysterious murder at the Hotel Noir

title: Not Not & Not Not 2
description: NOT one game, but NOT NOT two games!

title: Pet Show
description: Draw a line to enclose the area and uncover the image underneath. Watch out for enemies who can catch you or cut your line!

title: Turbo Circuit: Sports Car Racing
description: Feel the Grip. Master the Track. Own the Circuit

title: Yabai Girls: Saucy Police
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Myst House
description: After your car breaks down near your late grandfather’s abandoned house, you step inside in search of help. But your search quickly descends into a nightmare — the house is no longer empty, and a violent madman is on the loose.

title: Novel Rogue
description: In the mystical Ancient Library, a young apprentice named Wright trains under Yuisil, the Witch of Portals. As part of his magical studies, he delves into the stories of four enchanted books, each offering a unique realm to explore. From reclaiming a fallen kingdom to unraveling the mysteries of the underworld, your choices shape the destinies of captivating characters and their intertwining tales.

title: Run Sausage Run!: Cop, Crime and Crazy
Run Sausage Run!: Old, Ancient and Fossil
Run Sausage Run!: Honey, Light and Poison
Run Sausage Run!: Good, Bad and Curious
